agnews:train:4149.orig: California Condor Chick Dies Near Nest (AP) AP - A California condor chick that was part of an ambitious breeding program was found dead near its nest, the week after another was discovered with a broken wing and 35 bottle caps in its gullet.
agnews:train:4149.para: A California condor chick, which was involved in an extensive breeding initiative, was discovered deceased close to its nest. This occurred just a week after another chick was found with a fractured wing and 35 bottle caps lodged in its esophagus.

agnews:train:4303.para: Men's volleyball: The U.S. team lost to Russia in four sets, dropping their record below .500 in Pool B play on Thursday in Athens, Greece.

agnews:train:4406.orig: Football: US-Jamaica CONCACAF Semifinal Qualifier Ends in Draw Second-half substitute Brian Ching scored the first goal of his international career in the 89th minute to give the United States national soccer team a 1-1 come-from-behind draw against Jamaica in Kingston.
agnews:train:4406.para: In the CONCACAF Semifinal Qualifier, the United States and Jamaica drew 1-1. Brian Ching, who entered as a substitute in the second half, netted his first international goal in the 89th minute, salvaging a tie for the U.S. team in Kingston.

agnews:train:4603.orig: GOP Convention Delegation More Diverse (AP) AP - Republicans point to record levels of diversity among delegates to their upcoming convention, though the GOP isn't close to matching the makeup of the U.S. population overall or the Democratic delegation that met last month in Boston.
agnews:train:4603.para: The GOP Convention Sees Increased Diversity (AP) - Republicans highlight the highest levels of diversity among their convention delegates so far. However, the GOP still falls short in reflecting the U.S. population's makeup and lags behind the diverse Democratic delegation that convened in Boston recently.

agnews:train:4645.orig: Where's the WiFi? Park's developer wants to know Ten years ago, Boston real estate developer Norman B. Leventhal spearheaded the transformation of a grungy Financial District garage into a park that's become a downtown oasis.
agnews:train:4645.para: Where is the WiFi? The developer asks. Ten years ago, Boston real estate developer Norman B. Leventhal led the renovation of a dilapidated Financial District garage into a park that has since become a central urban retreat.

agnews:train:4674.para: "Hey...interested in the gear for cybercrime? " Now, some websites are providing visitors with the opportunity to download free "phishing kits" that include all the necessary graphics, web code, and text to create the fake sites used in internet phishing attacks.

agnews:train:4677.orig: Turnabout fair play for Peirsol On a night when a disqualification was posted, protested, counterprotested twice and ultimately tossed out, the American swimmers claimed their largest medal haul of the meet so far.
agnews:train:4677.para: In a night marked by disqualifications that were disputed and contested twice, the American swimmers secured their biggest medal tally of the competition thus far.

agnews:train:4679.para: Phelps is aiming for his eighth gold, which is now his target, given that he has two more events left in an already exhausting Olympic schedule for this 19-year-old American swimmer.

agnews:train:4717.orig: Message loud and clear A funny thing happened as Orlando Cabrera triumphantly rounded the bases after he knocked in Johnny Damon with his walkoff double off the Green Monster in Tuesday's 5-4 thriller over the Blue Jays. In the stands, Cabrera's wife, Eliana, noticed during the celebration her cellphone ringing. And ringing. And ringing.
agnews:train:4717.para: Clearly, a humorous incident unfolded when Orlando Cabrera crossed home plate with a walkoff double, scoring Johnny Damon and securing a 5-4 victory over the Blue Jays on Tuesday. agnews:train:4782.orig: Eli has his moments CHARLOTTE, NC - The Eli Manning Summer School took its first field trip last night, an outing designed to ramp up an educational process that is reaching a critical stage.
agnews:train:4782.para: Eli's Educational Adventure Began CHARLOTTE, NC - The inaugural field trip of the Eli Manning Summer School occurred last night, marking a pivotal phase in its educational initiative.

agnews:train:4941.orig: Report: Bush Spent Nearly  #36;46M in July (AP) AP - A fresh wave of ads pushed President Bush's spending to nearly  #36;46 million for July, the Republican's highest level since he launched the first ad blitz of his re-election campaign in March, a campaign finance report filed Friday shows.
agnews:train:4941.para: Report: Bush Ad Spending Reached Nearly $46M in July (AP) - President Bush's advertising expenditure surged to almost $46 million in July, marking his highest spending month since the initial wave of campaign ads began in March, according to a recently filed campaign finance report.

agnews:train:4948.para: Report: The FDA Plans Label Changes for Antidepressants Following New Analysis; Major Drugmakers Affected. NEW YORK (Reuters) - The Food and Drug Administration is set to propose updates to antidepressant labels based on recent research...

This once again highlights weightlifting as the Olympics' most problematic sport concerning performance-enhancing substances. Five...

agnews:train:4980.orig: World is  #39;in more danger #39; PAKISTAN #39;S president has warned that the war on terror has made the world a more dangerous place. Gen. Pervez Musharraf said the world was  quot;absolutely quot; less safe because military action had done nothing to tackle the causes of terrorism.
agnews:train:4980.para: Pakistan's president, Gen. Pervez Musharraf, has cautioned that the global fight against terrorism has increased the world's peril. He stated that the world is "absolutely" less secure, as military operations have failed to address the root causes of terrorism.

agnews:train:4985.orig: Suzuki advances to semis Japan #39;s world open-weight champion, aiming to make up for compatriot Kosei Inoue #39;s shock loss in a lighter men #39;s division, defeated Yury Rybak.
agnews:train:4985.para: Suzuki progresses to the semifinals, representing Japan's open-weight champion. He seeks to recover from compatriot Kosei Inoue's surprising defeat in a lighter men's division, having just beaten Yury Rybak.

agnews:train:4986.orig: Jake White #39;s Springboks Are On the Cusp of a Historic First On Saturday against the Wallabies, they will accomplish what no previous Bok team has managed - winning the Tri-Nations despite losing both away matches.
agnews:train:4986.para: Jake White's Springboks are poised to achieve a historic first when they face the Wallabies on Saturday. They will become the first Bok team to win the Tri-Nations despite having lost both their away matches.

agnews:train:5140.orig: Reports criticize DHS for lack of progress on IT AUGUST 20, 2004 (COMPUTERWORLD) - As the debate about adding a national intelligence director proceeds, two government reports are shedding new light on an existing dilemma: If DHS CIO Steven Cooper can #39;t wrestle the agency #39;s sprawling bureaucracy into ...
agnews:train:5140.para: On August 20, 2004, COMPUTERWORLD reported that recent government studies are highlighting the ongoing challenge faced by DHS. agnews:train:5245.orig: 2 held over Madrid train bombings Madrid, Spain (CNN) -- Police arrested two men on Friday in eastern Spain for alleged links to the Madrid train bombings last March, an Interior Ministry spokeswoman told CNN.
agnews:train:5245.para:
Two Individuals Detained in Connection with Madrid Train Bombings
In Madrid, Spain (CNN) – Authorities apprehended two suspects on Friday in eastern Spain, who are believed to be associated with the train bombings that occurred in March, according to a statement from the Interior Ministry.

agnews:train:5276.orig: Militants Still in Control of Najaf Shrine NAJAF, Iraq - Militiamen loyal to rebel Shiite cleric Muqtada al-Sadr removed weapons from the revered Imam Ali Shrine in Najaf but remained in control of the holy site Friday amid efforts to end their 2-week-old uprising. agnews:train:5276.para: Militants Remain in Control of Najaf Shrine NAJAF, Iraq - Despite removing weapons from the Imam Ali Shrine in Najaf, fighters from Muqtada al-Sadr's Mahdi Army militia stayed inside the holy site on Friday, as negotiations continued to resolve their 14-day rebellion.

agnews:train:5282.orig: Groups Meet to Discuss Climate Change New strategies to confront global warming took center stage in Buenos Aires on Monday, where thousands of environmentalists and government policy-makers gathered for an international conference on climate change.
agnews:train:5282.para:

Climate change对策会议在布宜诺斯艾利斯召开，数千名环保主义者和政府政策制定者齐聚一堂，讨论新的应对全球变暖策略。

agnews:train:5319.para: The CRM Financial Quagmire - Part 4 (NewsFactor) - NewsFactor - Throughout this five-part series, CRM Daily explores regions that often turn into financial sinkholes for businesses undertaking or revamping a CRM initiative.

agnews:train:5419.para: Egypt has filed charges against an Iranian diplomat and an Egyptian individual for their alleged role in an assassination plot targeting an unknown public figure, as reported by AFP.

agnews:train:5486.orig: Marvell Posts 54 Increase in Earnings Shares of the Marvell Technology Group gained yesterday after the company said second-quarter earnings tripled as revenue rose 54 percent.
agnews:train:5486.para: Marvell Technology Group's stock rose yesterday following the announcement that its second-quarter earnings increased threefold, with revenue up by 54 percent.

agnews:train:5527.orig: Giving back in a big way WOBURN -- Few developers could build a commercial property empire of 74 debt-free office, industrial, retail, and research buildings valued at about \$800 million. Even fewer would then give most of it away.
agnews:train:5527.para: Building a significant philanthropic legacy WOBURN -- Rarely does a developer construct a commercial property empire comprising 74 debt-free office, industrial, retail, and research buildings worth approximately $800 million. agnews:train:5569.orig: Murder police carry out searches Police investigating the murder of a woman in south-west London carry out house-to-house inquiries.
agnews:train:5569.para: Police conducting searches in the area are investigating a murder that occurred in south-west London, and are also conducting door-to-door inquiries.

agnews:train:5588.orig: Militiamen begin to leave Shi #146;te shrine NAJAF, Iraq -- Militia fighters began to leave the Shrine of Imam Ali yesterday, taking up positions outside the sacred site or fleeing the city, after rebellious Shi'ite cleric Moqtada al-Sadr offered to return custody of the complex to moderate clerics.
agnews:train:5588.para: Militia members start departing from the Imam Ali Shrine in Najaf, Iraq -- Fighters from the militia left the Shrine of Imam Ali yesterday, either positioning themselves around the holy site or evacuating the city, following Moqtada al-Sadr's offer to hand over control of the complex to more moderate religious leaders.

agnews:train:5603.orig: Multifunction Devices Draw Back-To-School Crowd (Reuters) Reuters - The consumer electronics gizmo\that offers many functions in a small package is what's\compelling back-to-school shoppers to open their wallets.
agnews:train:5603.para: Back-to-school shoppers are being attracted to purchase multifunction devices that pack numerous features into a compact design.

agnews:train:5614.orig: Pinsent Wins Fourth Gold Rower Matthew Pinsent wins his fourth gold medal Saturday after his boat edges Canada by .08 seconds in the coxless four.
agnews:train:5614.para: Matthew Pinsent Secures His Fourth Gold Medal as the Coxless Four Crew Nabs Victory by 0.08 Seconds over Canada on Saturday.

agnews:train:5644.orig: Absence of linguistic skills could hamper thinking ability Not being part of a culture with a highly developed language, could limit your thoughts, at least as far as numbers are concerned, reveals a new study conducted by a psychologist at the Columbia University in New York.
agnews:train:5644.para: Lacking strong linguistic skills might restrict your cognitive abilities, particularly when it comes to numbers, according to a recent study by a psychologist at Columbia University in New York.

agnews:train:5749.orig: Greene set to back up big talk and he has said it in London, said it in Zurich and already said it here in Athens - he only had to turn up to retain his Olympic 100 metres title.
agnews:train:5749.para: Greene is ready to prove his words with actions, and he has done so in London, Zurich, and even here in Athens—his mere presence was enough to secure his Olympic 100 meters title.

agnews:train:5782.orig: Four golds in a row for Pinsent British rower Matthew Pinsent won a fourth consecutive Olympic gold medal when Team GB #39;s coxless fours crew triumphed in Greece.
agnews:train:5782.para: Matthew Pinsent, a British rower, secured his fourth consecutive Olympic gold medal as Team GB's coxless fours team won the event in Greece.

agnews:train:5848.orig: Smit lauds Boks resolve South Africa skipper John Smit paid tribute to his team #39;s resilience after the 23-19 victory over Australia, which won them the 2004 Tri-Nations.
agnews:train:5848.para: John Smit, the South African team captain, praised his squad's determination following their 23-19 win against Australia, securing the 2004 Tri-Nations title.

agnews:train:5968.orig: Unfriendly airline grounds its pension plans Fly the friendly skies may be United Airlines slogan. But employees of Americas largest carrier wont be so convinced this weekend, on the heels of it filing court documents saying it is likely to scrap its pension plans.
agnews:train:5968.para: United Airlines, known for its "Fly the Friendly Skies" slogan, is likely to disappoint its employees this weekend after filing court documents indicating it plans to terminate its pension plans.

agnews:train:6013.orig: Johnson Leaves Game With Strained Hip (AP) AP - Detroit Tigers right-hander Jason Johnson left his start Saturday against the Seattle Mariners with a strained left hip.
agnews:train:6013.para: Johnson Exits Game Due to Injured Hip (AP) - Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Jason Johnson was forced to leave his Saturday game against the Seattle Mariners owing to a strained hip.

agnews:train:6094.orig: Muller, Hewitt for final UNHERALDED Gilles Muller spoiled a star-studded finals scenario at the Washington Open today, muscling aside Andre Agassi 6-4, 7-5 to move into a match-up with Lleyton Hewitt.
agnews:train:6094.para: Gilles Muller, an unexpected contender, disrupted what promised to be a showcase final at the Washington Open today, defeating Andre Agassi 6-4, 7-5, and setting up a match against Lleyton Hewitt.

agnews:train:6179.orig: Brees Passes Chargers Past Cardinals 38-13 (AP) AP - Drew Brees continued his strong exhibition season, passing the San Diego Chargers to a big halftime lead and a 38-13 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Saturday night.
agnews:train:6179.para: Drew Brees Led the Chargers to a Dominant 38-13 Win Over the Cardinals, Securing a Strong Halfway Point in His Exhibition Season (AP)

agnews:train:6188.orig: 18 killed in grenade attacks in Bangladesh At least 18 people were confirmed killed, and some 300 were injured as unidentified assailants hurled over ten grenades toward a rally organized by the main opposition
agnews:train:6188.para: At least 18 individuals lost their lives, while around 300 were injured in grenade attacks targeting a rally led by the primary opposition party. The attackers, whose identities remain unknown, threw more than ten grenades at the event.

agnews:train:6467.orig: Rampant England eye top spot after seven wins in a row Despite having won 10 out of 11 tests so far this year, England are still a long way from being the best team in the world. Arch-rivals Australia hold sway at the
agnews:train:6467.para: England, with seven consecutive victories, are aiming for the top position, yet despite winning 10 out of 11 tests this year, they are not yet considered the world's best team. Their rivals, Australia, remain at the pinnacle.

agnews:train:6492.orig: Iraq clashes kill 40, handover talks stall US tanks rumbled to within 800 metres of a holy shrine in the Iraqi city of Najaf today as fierce clashes with Shiite rebels in a nearby town killed at least 40 Iraqis, officials said.
agnews:train:6492.para: In today's clashes near Najaf, at least 40 Iraqis lost their lives as US tanks advanced to within 800 meters of a sacred shrine. agnews:train:6493.orig: Train set ablaze as violence spreads in Bangladesh Dhaka, Aug 22. (PTI, UNI, AP): Angry opposition protestors set fire to a passenger train and clashed with police in southern Bangladesh today amid general strikes in several cities to protest the series of
agnews:train:6493.para: A passenger train was set on fire in southern Bangladesh today, as violent protests continued in several cities. The clashes erupted amid general strikes, organized by the opposition, to protest a series of events. (PTI, UNI, AP)

agnews:train:6544.orig: Patterson answers history and defending champ ATHENS - She did not have the magnetic power of Mary Lou Retton, or the dizzy charm of Sarah Hughes, but Carly Patterson did have one final dance in front of her, one last chance to prove that her face belonged on those 70 million McDonald #39;s bags and
agnews:train:6544.para: Patterson concludes her history-making run against the defending champion in ATHENS - While she lacked the magnetic appeal of Mary Lou Retton and the dizzying charm of Sarah Hughes, Carly Patterson still had one final performance to showcase, one last opportunity to ensure her image graced those 70 million McDonald's bags.

agnews:train:6598.orig: Judge #39;s ruling too close to home  quot;IG has verified that Colombian judge Oscar Buitrago Reyes, one of three officials suspended by the FIG (world gymnastics body) on August 21, has lived and worked in Ohio for several years, quot; the magazine #39;s website said on Sunday.
agnews:train:6598.para: The judge's decision feels personally relevant; the magazine's website reported on Sunday that Colombian judge Oscar Buitrago Reyes, one of three individuals suspended by the FIG (gymnastics world body) on August 21, has resided and worked in Ohio for several years.

agnews:train:6640.orig: Arsenal matches record of 42 league games without a loss Defending champion Arsenal matched a 25-year-old record of 42 league games without a loss in the top tier of English soccer by rallying past Middlesbrough 5-3 Sunday.
agnews:train:6640.para: Arsenal tied a 25-year-old record by maintaining an unbeaten streak of 42 consecutive league games, achieving this milestone with a 5-3 victory over Middlesbrough on Sunday.

agnews:train:6689.orig: Ulmer has golden glow Exhausted cyclist Sarah Ulmer is still on a high from taking gold at the Olympics in world record time. She is back at the Olympic village and still cannot believe the number of New Zealanders at the velodrome to cheer her on.
agnews:train:6689.para:
Ulmer Radiates Joy
Exhausted cyclist Sarah Ulmer is basking in her Olympic gold medal win, achieved in world-record time. She's back at the Olympic village, still in disbelief at the massive turnout of New Zealand supporters at the velodrome to cheer her on.

agnews:train:6732.orig: Sri Lankas finest hour Sri Lankas emphatic victory over the South Africans must count among the finest in their cricketing history. Graeme Smiths side were taken apart with the efficiency of crew changing tyres at a car race.
agnews:train:6732.para: Sri Lanka's most glorious moment must be their resounding triumph over South Africa, a victory that ranks among their proudest cricketing achievements. The South African team, led by Graeme Smith, was dismantled with the precision of a pit stop during a racing event.

agnews:train:6785.para: In a recent AL Wrap, Bengie Molina's impressive performance led the Anaheim Angels to a 4-3 victory over the New York Yankees, securing a three-game series sweep. Molina achieved this with four hits, one of which was a three-run home run.

agnews:train:6794.orig: Climbing Back Up Mary Meeker can tell you first hand about bubbles bursting. For much of the 1990s, she was called  quot;Queen of the Net, quot; for her knack for picking tech stocks and helping companies like Netscape go public.

agnews:train:6816.orig: Truckers #39; stir evokes mixed response New Delhi, Aug 21.(PTI): The indefinite nationwide truckers #39; strike protesting the imposition of service tax today evoked mixed response with a section of transporters in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu staying away from the protest.
agnews:train:6816.para: The indefinite nationwide truckers' strike, which began as a protest against the implementation of service tax, has received mixed reactions. In some parts, like Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, certain transporters chose not to participate in the protest.

agnews:train:6833.orig: Jolts of Electricity Reviving Coral Reef (AP) AP - As the late-afternoon sun bathes the beach with a soft warmth, gentle waves lap quietly at the shore  #151; and strollers occasionally stumble over a thick wad of white cables embedded in the fine, black sand.
agnews:train:6833.para: As the late afternoon sun casts a gentle warmth over the beach, soft waves gently kiss the shore, and now and then, pedestrians trip over a mass of white cables buried in the fine, black sand.

agnews:train:6977.orig: Ministers deny interest in raising inheritance tax Downing Street distanced itself last night from reports that inheritance tax will rise to 50 per cent for the wealthiest families.
agnews:train:6977.para: Ministers reject any notion of increasing inheritance tax, and Downing Street has clarified that it is not true that inheritance tax is set to rise to 50 percent for the most affluent families.

agnews:train:7114.orig: Fierce Fighting Erupts in Iraq's Najaf-Witnesses  NAJAF, Iraq (Reuters) - Fierce fighting broke out in the  holy Iraqi city of Najaf Monday, with numerous explosions and  gunfire echoing around a sacred shrine held by followers of a  radical Shi'ite cleric, Reuters witnesses said.
agnews:train:7114.para: Violent Clashes Erupt in Najaf, Iraq - Witnesses report intense fighting in the holy city of Najaf on Monday, accompanied by multiple explosions and gunfire near a revered shrine associated with a radical Shi'ite leader, according to Reuters accounts.

agnews:train:7119.orig: Men #39;s Gymnastics Mired in Scoring Fiasco In many Olympics competitions winners and losers are determined by less than a fraction of a point and even the slightest error in scoring can set back an athlete from the gold to the bronze.
agnews:train:7119.para: Men's Gymnastics Struggles with Precision Scoring Issues In many Olympic events, victories and defeats hinge on virtually infinitesimal differences in score, and even minor discrepancies in scoring can significantly impact an athlete's medal placement, potentially denying them gold in favor of bronze.

agnews:train:7172.orig: Report: Colorado hit by grand jury indictment A grand jury has handed down an indictment regarding the use of prostitutes to entice football recruits to the University of Colorado, The Denver Post reported yesterday.
agnews:train:7172.para: Report: Colorado faces grand jury indictment over alleged use of prostitutes to lure football recruits to the University of Colorado, according to a Denver Post report from yesterday.

agnews:train:7420.orig: Oil Holds at \$47 as Iraq Resumes Exports Oil prices held just below the \$47 mark on Monday as Iraq resumed exports from both its northern and southern outlets after lengthy disruption, despite fierce fighting in the holy city of Najaf.
agnews:train:7420.para: Oil Prices Stuck Near \$47 as Iraq Reinstates Exports Oil prices remained close to \$47 on Monday following the resumption of exports from Iraq's northern and southern ports, despite ongoing intense battles in the sacred city of Najaf.

agnews:train:7430.orig: FedEx Hikes Profit Forecast, Cites Demand FedEx Corp. (FDX.N: Quote, Profile, Research) on Monday raised its earnings forecast for the fiscal first quarter and full year, citing strong demand for its international express, ground and less-than-truckload services.
agnews:train:7430.para:

agnews:train:7442.orig: Talks begin in Abuja on conflict in Sudan's Darfur region (AFP) AFP - African Union-sponsored talks on the conflict in the western Sudanese region of Darfur began in the Nigerian capital Abuja.
agnews:train:7442.para: African Union-mediated discussions about the Darfur conflict commenced in Abuja, the capital of Nigeria (AFP).
