agnews:train:28762.para: PlaylistMag.com, a new resource for digital music enthusiasts on Mac or Windows, recently went live (MacCentral). Edited by Christopher Breen, a Macworld columnist and author of "Secrets of the iPod," the site offers free music downloads, celebrity and musician-curated playlists, and a community forum for users to exchange tips, tricks, and their own playlists with fellow digital music aficionados.

agnews:train:28820.orig: Coca-Cola Warns on Profit, Shares Fall  CHICAGO (Reuters) - Coca-Cola Co. <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=KO.N target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">KO.N</A>, amid signs that  is it losing market share to arch rival Pepsi, on Wednesday  warned that profit would lag Wall Street expectations for the  rest of the year because of weakness in key markets and said  there was no quick fix for its problems.
agnews:train:28820.para:
Coca-Cola Cautioned on Earnings, Stock Dips  
CHICAGO (Reuters) - Amid indications that Coca-Cola is losing ground to its long-time competitor Pepsi, the company warned on Wednesday that profits for the remainder of the year would fall short of Wall Street forecasts due to market weakness in crucial regions. Coca-Cola also stated that there is no easy solution to its current challenges.

agnews:train:28823.orig: China Threatens to Veto UN Darfur Draft -Diplomats  UNITED NATIONS (Reuters) - China is threatening to veto a  revised U.S. draft resolution that would consider U.N.  sanctions against Sudan's oil industry if Khartoum does not  rein in marauding militia fighters in its Darfur region,  diplomats reported on Wednesday.
agnews:train:28823.para:
China Warns of Veto on Updated UN Darfur Resolution - Diplomats

UNITED NATIONS (Reuters) - China is signaling it will veto an amended U.S. draft resolution, which proposes U.N. sanctions on Sudan's oil sector, unless Khartoum curbs the activities of militias in the Darfur region, according to diplomatic sources on Wednesday.

agnews:train:28867.orig: Taiwan, China Artists Breach Political Divide (Reuters) Reuters - In an abandoned Cold War bomb\shelter on Taiwan's frontline island of Quemoy, the music of\Bach and Beethoven jars with the boom and screech of a piano\being smashed to bits.
agnews:train:28867.para: In an old Cold War bomb shelter on Taiwan's front-line island of Quemoy, the classical music of Bach and Beethoven stands in stark contrast to the loud and chaotic sound of a piano being shattered.

agnews:train:28915.orig: Moy #39;s moment as Spain celebrate Four years ago in Barcelona, when Spain won the Davis Cup for the first time, Carlos Moy cut a rather sad and slightly dejected figure, an outsider who was forced to watch from the periphery because of an injured back.
agnews:train:28915.para: Four years ago in Barcelona, Carlos Moy appeared rather melancholic and somewhat discouraged when Spain secured their first Davis Cup victory. Despite being an integral part of the team, his injured back forced him to observe from the sidelines.

agnews:train:28949.orig: New Orleans Urges People to Take Shelter NEW ORLEANS - With 135-mph Hurricane Ivan closing in with frightening intensity, this flood-prone city scrambled Wednesday to get people out of harm's way, putting the frail and elderly in the cavernous Louisiana Superdome and urging others to move to higher floors in tall buildings.    Along some 300 miles of threatened coastline from Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle, the churning surf, ominous clouds, swaying traffic lights and escalating winds were all the reminders some people needed to take cover from the storm...
agnews:train:28949.para:
New Orleans Calls for Evacuation as Hurricane Ivan Approaches

NEW ORLEANS - As Hurricane Ivan intensified to 135 mph and bore down on the city, New Orleans on Wednesday took swift action to ensure residents' safety. The vulnerable, including the elderly, were relocated to the spacious Louisiana Superdome, while others were advised to seek shelter on upper floors of buildings. 

From Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle, a 300-mile stretch of coastline under threat, the turbulent waves, darkening skies, and increasing wind speeds served as stark reminders for people to seek protection from the storm.

agnews:train:29179.orig: Egyptians treated animals like kings Ancient Egyptians revered cats and other animals and took as much care in preparing them for their passage to the next life as they did with humans, scientists said Wednesday.
agnews:train:29179.para: Ancient Egyptians viewed animals as royalty, and they showed them the same level of respect as they did humans, scientists noted on Wednesday. They put in just as much effort to prepare animals for the afterlife.

agnews:train:29222.orig: Judge Dismisses Charges Vs. Bush Protester (AP) AP - A judge has dismissed charges against a war protester who was arrested during a visit by President Bush last spring.
agnews:train:29222.para: A judge has dropped charges against a protester who was arrested while opposing the war during the president's visit in the spring.

agnews:train:29294.orig: Ryder Cup underdogs pack a bite Ask the question a dozen times and you #39;ll get a dozen answers. Or a dozen shrugs, because nobody really knows. Every two years at the Ryder Cup, the Americans send out a team that looks, on paper, unbeatable.
agnews:train:29294.para: Ryder Cup underdogs carry significant impact. Ask the question a dozen times, and you'll receive a dozen different responses—or perhaps a dozen shrugs, as the truth remains uncertain. Every two years, the Americans field a team at the Ryder Cup that appears, on paper, invincible.

agnews:train:29313.orig: Bout shapes De La Hoya career Oscar De La Hoya is an underdog for the first time in his career and he doesn #39;t seem quite sure what to make of it. I know in my mind this is the one, #39; #39; said the Golden Boy.
agnews:train:29313.para: Oscar De La Hoya, who has always been a favorite, is now an underdog for the first time in his career, and he appears uncertain about it. "In my mind, this is the one," he remarked, referring to the upcoming fight.

agnews:train:29462.orig: Indons detain couple in connection with embassy bombing Police have detained a man and his wife in the port city of Surabaya and are questioning them in connection with last week #39;s deadly bombing at the Australian embassy, a spokesman said Thursday.
agnews:train:29462.para: Police in Surabaya have apprehended a couple and are interviewing them regarding the recent explosion at the Australian embassy, according to a police spokesperson who spoke on Thursday.

agnews:train:29464.para: Why PCCW is reaping profits while operating <strong>Letter</strong> TDD mode involves more than just transmitting data

agnews:train:29531.para: Sudan and Darfur Rebel Groups Await AU Mediation on Peace Talks (Reuters) Reuters - The Sudanese government and rebel groups from Darfur expressed on Thursday that they are awaiting a decision from African Union mediators regarding the continuation of peace talks, despite a deadlock over security issues in the western part of Sudan.

agnews:train:29732.para: OPEC Increases Nigeria's Oil Output by 82,000 Bpd Starting in November, the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) is raising its official production by one million barrels per day, with Nigeria receiving 82,000 barrels per day, which is 8.2% of the new allocation.

agnews:train:29818.orig: Milwaukee Brewers Team Report - September 16 (Sports Network) - The Brewers will try to keep Barry Bonds from getting his 700th homer today, when they close out their three-game series against the San Francisco Giants.
agnews:train:29818.para: Milwaukee Brewers Team Update - September 16 (Sports Network) - The Brewers aim to prevent Barry Bonds from reaching 700 home runs today, as they conclude their three-game series against the San Francisco Giants.

agnews:train:29841.para: In the UK, iTunes levies a price of STG0.79 per song, equivalent to about EUR1.20, whereas in France and Germany, the download price is merely EUR0.

agnews:train:29888.orig: Gasoline Fuels 7-Eleven's Growth The convenience store chain's sales growth depends heavily on high gas prices.
agnews:train:29888.para: The Growth of 7-Eleven Relies on High Gas Prices The success of the convenience store chain is significantly dependent on gasoline prices remaining high.

agnews:train:29889.orig: Success Can Be Bitter, Apple A U.K. consumer watchdog office is investigating claims of unfair pricing practices.
agnews:train:29889.para: Success May Have a Bitter Taste: The U.K. Consumer Watchdog Is Examining Allegations of Unfair Pricing Practices at Apple.

agnews:train:30050.orig: AOL Won't Use Microsoft Anti-Spam Standard (Reuters) Reuters - America Online Inc. on Thursday\shunned a Microsoft Corp. proposal to help weed out unwanted\"spam" e-mail because Internet engineers are reluctant to adopt\technology owned by the dominant software company.
agnews:train:30050.para: America Online declined Microsoft's spam-fighting proposal on Thursday, as internet engineers are hesitant to implement technology controlled by the leading software firm.

agnews:train:30100.orig: Afghan Leader Survives Assassination Try Assailants fired a rocket at an American helicopter taking President Hamid Karzai on a rare foray into Afghanistan #39;s troubled provinces Thursday, but it missed and he escaped injury.
agnews:train:30100.para: On Thursday, assailants launched a rocket at an American helicopter carrying President Hamid Karzai on an uncommon trip to Afghanistan's troubled regions, but the missile missed its target, and Karzai avoided any harm.

agnews:train:30107.orig: Reporter 'undercover in Commons' The Sun newspaper says it has had a reporter working undercover in the Commons for months.
agnews:train:30107.para: The Sun newspaper reports that it has employed a journalist to work undercover in the Commons for an extended period of several months.

agnews:train:30151.orig: Jan Baan launches Web services firm The enterprise software legend shifts his attention to Web services. Say hello to start-up Cordys and its integration software.
agnews:train:30151.para: Jan Baan is now focusing on Web services with his new venture, Cordys, which offers integration software.

agnews:train:30185.para: In KABUL - Afghan President Hamid Karzai narrowly avoided an assassination attempt on Thursday, as a rocket struck his US military helicopter during its landing in the southeastern town of Gardez, according to Reuters.

agnews:train:30248.orig: China #39;s Hu, Jiang in Struggle for Power Description: As leaders of China #39;s Communist Party meet in Beijing, much of the focus is on the rivalry between President Hu Jintao and former President Jiang Zemin.
agnews:train:30248.para: As China's Communist Party convenes in Beijing, significant attention is centered on the power struggle between President Hu Jintao and the former President Jiang Zemin.

agnews:train:30373.orig: Ousted Shell Chairman Assails Regulators Sir Philip Watts, in his first public statement since he was ousted as chairman of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group in March, said on Thursday that British financial regulators
agnews:train:30373.para: Former Shell Chairman Sir Philip Watts Criticizes Regulators In his initial public remarks following his March dismissal as Shell's chairman, Sir Philip Watts criticized British financial regulatory bodies on Thursday.

agnews:train:30424.orig: Boston #39;s Schilling first to 20 wins Boston, MA (Sports Network) - Curt Schilling won his seventh straight start and became baseball #39;s first 20-game winner, leading the Boston Red Sox past the Tampa Bay Devil Rays, 11-4 at Fenway Park.
agnews:train:30424.para: Curt Schilling, who had won his previous seven games, was the first pitcher to reach 20 wins this season. At Fenway Park, he led the Boston Red Sox to a 11-4 victory over the Tampa Bay Devil Rays.

agnews:train:30545.para:

JAKARTA (Reuters) - Indonesian law enforcement has secured their first detention related to the recent car bomb incident outside the Australian embassy, with a suspect apprehended in West Java, according to the police chief's statement on Friday.

agnews:train:30584.para: Sony cautions that its home electronics division is not anticipated to see profit improvements during the typically lucrative Christmas shopping period.

agnews:train:30738.para: Sony Plans to Introduce a Compact PS2 Model on October 26, According to Report (Reuters) - Sony Corporation is anticipated to reveal a more compact version of its widely popular PlayStation 2 gaming console on October 26, as reported on The Hollywood Reporter's website. agnews:train:30784.para: Ford Enhances Profit Projections  NEW YORK (Reuters) - Ford Motor Company上调了其第三季度和2004年的盈利预期，这得益于金融服务业务的强劲表现以及汽车制造成本的降低。

agnews:train:30944.orig: SEC Investigating WorldCom Creditors Committee The Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating WorldCom Inc.'s official creditors committee, requesting reams of documents related to members' dealings as well as information they reviewed about WorldCom's health and prospects.
agnews:train:30944.para: The Securities and Exchange Commission is probing WorldCom's official creditors committee, seeking extensive documents on members' interactions and details they examined regarding the company's financial health and future prospects.

agnews:train:31042.orig: FAO Warns of Locust Plague, If Funds Not Provided for Eradication <b>...</b> The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) says more funds are essential to combat locust swarms that are devastating crops in West Africa, and warns failure to act quickly, could result in a regional plague by the end of the year.

agnews:train:31115.orig: Nigerian Police Say Dozens Killed in Pipeline Blast  LAGOS (Reuters) - Dozens of people were killed in a  petroleum pipeline explosion in Nigeria's commercial capital  Lagos, police said Friday.
agnews:train:31115.para: Police in Lagos, Nigeria's commercial hub, reported on Friday that a pipeline explosion resulted in the deaths of several dozen individuals.

agnews:train:31128.orig: Indictments issued in software scam case A federal grand jury has indicted 11 people for conspiring to distribute nearly \$31 million worth of bootlegged software programs.
agnews:train:31128.para: In a federal grand jury decision, 11 individuals have been charged with working together to sell illegally copied software valued at approximately $31 million.

agnews:train:31228.para: Iomega Corporation, a global leader in data storage, has introduced the new Iomega NAS 100d entry-level network-attached storage server, bringing enhanced features and flexibility to its lineup. SAN DIEGO, September 16, /PRNewswire-FirstCall/

agnews:train:31260.orig: Amazon offers discount to A9 search users SAN FRANCISCO--Online retailer Amazon.com is offering a 1.57 percent shopping discount to registered users of its new A9 Web search service as a way to increase A9 use and promote sales on Amazon, the company #39;s Web site showed on Friday.
agnews:train:31260.para: Amazon is providing a 1.57% discount to registered A9 search users to boost A9 usage and drive sales on its platform, as evidenced by information from the company's website.

agnews:train:31262.orig: FTC Floats Spammer Bounty Scheme The FTC stipulated that, if successful, a bounty system for spammers would have to do several things: tie eligibility to a court order, rather than civil penalties; fund rewards separately from
agnews:train:31262.para: The FTC Proposed a Bounty Program for Spammers The FTC outlined that, for a bounty program targeting spammers to be effective, it would need to: link eligibility to a court order instead of civil penalties, and separate the funding for rewards from other sources.

agnews:train:31314.orig: Zim cricket team arrives in Pakistan A 15 man-squad from Zimbabwe led by cricket #39;s youngest ever captain Tatenda Taibu arrived in Pakistan yesterday for a tri-series starting later this month.
agnews:train:31314.para: The Zimbabwe cricket team, including 15 players with Tatenda Taibu, the sport's youngest ever captain, has arrived in Pakistan. They are set to participate in a tri-series that begins later this month.

agnews:train:31385.orig: Search Firm Cashes in on Google Warrants (AP) AP - Executive search firm Heidrick  amp; Struggles International Inc. on Friday said it earned nearly  #36;130 million by selling Google Inc. stock it got as payment for finding the Internet company a new CEO in 2001.
agnews:train:31385.para: Search Firm Profits from Google Stock Sale (AP) - On Friday, executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles International Inc. announced it had made close to $130 million by selling Google shares it received as compensation for helping the tech giant find a new CEO in 2001.

agnews:train:31417.orig: Drug lords stripped of 120m fortune in prison Two of Colombia #39;s most powerful drug lords were trapped in prison cells yesterday as the state seized their fortune estimated at more than 120 million.
agnews:train:31417.para: Two of Colombia's most influential drug lords found themselves behind bars yesterday, with the state seizing assets valued at over 120 million.

agnews:train:31444.orig: Microsoft Download Centre Demanding OS Validation The Microsoft Download Centre has been updated with some graphical improvements on both the search, listings and item pages. Crucially in the new look download centre many application downloads are now being
agnews:train:31444.para: The Microsoft Download Centre has undergone some visual enhancements to its search, listings, and item pages. Significantly, in this revamped centre, many application downloads now require OS validation.

agnews:train:31506.orig: A Long Division Test The Redskins, facing their first critical test against a division rival, know they must do well in the NFC East to make the playoffs.
agnews:train:31506.para: A Crucial Division Test The Redskins, encountering their initial key match against another NFC East team, understand they need to perform strongly to secure a playoff spot.

agnews:train:31546.orig: Tennis: Safin reaches China Open semis Fifth-seeded Marat Safin of Russia easily beat American Kevin Kim 6-2, 6-4 on Friday to move into the semi-finals of the China Open.
agnews:train:31546.para: In tennis, Marat Safin, the fifth seed from Russia, comfortably defeated American Kevin Kim 6-2, 6-4 on Friday, advancing to the semifinals of the China Open.

agnews:train:31599.orig: Michigan teen held on charges he planned bloody attack CLINTON TOWNSHIP, MICH. - A 17-year-old boy was arrested and police found weapons, ammunition and bomb-making gear in his home after a tip that he was making threats online against his high school, fellow students and an officer assigned to the building.
agnews:train:31599.para: A 17-year-old Michigan teenager was taken into custody following a tip that he had made threats online against his high school, students, and a school officer. Upon searching his home, police discovered weapons, ammunition, and materials used for bomb-making.

agnews:train:31664.orig: N. Korean blast remains a mystery; speculation rife SEOUL, South Korea - Was that a mushroom cloud that the satellite saw hovering menacingly over North Korea or merely a patch of bad weather?
agnews:train:31664.para: The North Korean explosion continues to be puzzling, sparking much speculation. SEOUL, South Korea - Could the satellite image of a looming cloud signal a nuclear test, or is it just a weather phenomenon?

agnews:train:31791.orig: Panthers running back out 2-5 weeks The news got worse for the Carolina Panthers Friday. Running back Stephen Davis was sidelined with a knee injury days after star receiver Steve Smith broke his leg.
agnews:train:31791.para: The Carolina Panthers faced more bad news on Friday when their running back, Stephen Davis, is expected to be out for 2 to 5 weeks due to a knee injury. This comes just days after their star receiver, Steve Smith, suffered a broken leg.

agnews:train:31812.orig: Closure with a touch of deja vu The news that Jaguar is to end vehicle assembly at Browns Lane and invite several hundred employees to apply for what parent company Ford likes to call  quot;voluntary separation quot; prompted the great and good to shrug their shoulders and remark, rather lamely
agnews:train:31812.para: A sense of familiarity in closure: The announcement that Jaguar would cease vehicle production at Browns Lane and offer several hundred workers the option of what Ford terms "voluntary separation" elicited a collective shrug and somewhat tepid comments from those in the know.

agnews:train:31851.orig: U.S. Faces Mountain to Climb Against Buoyant Europe  BLOOMFIELD HILLS, Michigan (Reuters) - Ryder Cup red faces  have not been in short supply since the first event in 1927 but  few have been American.
agnews:train:31851.para: Since the inaugural Ryder Cup in 1927, the U.S. team has often looked disappointed, but few times have American players faced such a challenging situation as they do now, with Europe showing strong performance.

agnews:train:31945.orig: De La Hoya hopes history repeats against Hopkins CBC SPORTS ONLINE - Oscar De La Hoya will try and take a page out of the boxing history book while writing his own legend at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas tonight.
agnews:train:31945.para: Oscar De La Hoya aims to emulate historical boxing achievements as he seeks to create his own boxing legacy at tonight's fight at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas.

agnews:train:31992.orig: First Enron Criminal Case Set for Trial  HOUSTON (Reuters) - Nearly three years after Enron Corp.'s  <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=ENRNQ.PK target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">ENRNQ.PK</A> dramatic collapse into bankruptcy, the first  criminal trial against the disgraced energy company's former  employees is set to kick off on Monday.
agnews:train:31992.para: After nearly three years since Enron Corp.'s dramatic bankruptcy, the first criminal trial involving the company's former employees is scheduled to begin on Monday in Houston.

agnews:train:32049.para: The MGM Strategy: Receive Payment First, Finalize the Agreement Later. When a group of investors, headed by Sony Corporation of America, announced they had reached a preliminary agreement to buy Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer for close to $5 billion, it happened as follows:

agnews:train:32094.orig: Blair told Bush he  #39;would not budge #39; in support for war Leaked documents show a gulf between public statements on Iraq and private talks with the White House. Francis Elliott reports. Tony Blair privately promised George Bush he would not budge in his support for

As reported by Francis Elliott, Blair made it clear to Bush that he would not waver in his backing.

agnews:train:32155.orig: Macedonia cabinet survives vote The Macedonian government wins a vote of no-confidence introduced by the opposition.
agnews:train:32155.para: The Macedonian cabinet overcomes a no-confidence motion proposed by the opposition and retains its position.

agnews:train:32198.orig: Football: Anelka duo sinks Palace Two goals from Nicolas Anelka are enough to give Man City their first away win of the season.
agnews:train:32198.para: Football: The Anelka Brothers Secure Victory for Man City With Two Goals, Securing Their First Away Win of the Season.

agnews:train:32238.orig: No. 13 Tenn. Stuns No. 11 Florida 30-28 KNOXVILLE, Tenn. Sept. 19, 2004 - James Wilhoit missed the easy one to tie, then made the tough one to win it. Wilhoit kicked a 50-yard field goal with 6 seconds left after missing an extra point that would have tied the game to give No.
agnews:train:32238.para: On September 19, 2004, in Knoxville, Tenn., James Wilhoit executed a remarkable comeback. After missing the extra point that would have tied the game, he successfully kicked a 50-yard field goal with just 6 seconds remaining, securing a 30-28 victory for No. 13 Tennessee over No. 11 Florida.

agnews:train:32277.orig: Charitable champ takes it easy on De La Hoya Coming into this middleweight title bout, which turned out to be more mega-event than mega-fight, Oscar De La Hoya called Bernard Hopkins a bully.
agnews:train:32277.para: Charitable champion Bernard Hopkins was given a relatively easy task in this middleweight title match, which ended up being more of a grand event than a fierce battle. Before the fight, Oscar De La Hoya referred to Hopkins as a bully.

agnews:train:32339.orig: De La Hoya given the hook in ninth LAS VEGAS -- Joe Louis was once told that an opponent,  quot;Didn't like it to the body, quot; to which he replied,  quot;Who do? quot;
agnews:train:32339.para: De La Hoya was given a warning about the opponent's preference in Las Vegas. Joe Louis was once advised that his opponent "didn't like it to the body," to which he responded, "Who does?"

agnews:train:32351.orig: Musharraf To Shed Off Military Uniform By Year End: US Washington, Sept. 19 (NNN): The United States strongly believes that Pakistan President General Pervez Musharraf will step down as countrys Army Chief by the end of 2004.
agnews:train:32351.para: By the End of 2004, Musharraf Plans to Abandon His Military Role: Washington, Sept. 19 (NNN) - The United States is confident that Pakistan's President, General Pervez Musharraf, will resign from his position as the country's Army Chief by the year's end.

agnews:train:32367.orig: Serbs Vote for Councils and Belgrade Super-Mayor  BELGRADE (Reuters) - Serbs went to the polls in local  elections on Sunday in the first test of voter opinion since  they chose pro-Western President Boris Tadic in June.
agnews:train:32367.para: On Sunday, Serbs participated in local elections, marking the first gauge of public sentiment following the selection of pro-Western President Boris Tadic in June.

agnews:train:32418.orig: Hamas chief Meshaal surfaces in Cairo (AFP) AFP - Khaled Meshaal, the political chief of the Palestinian Hamas movement who is at the head of Israel's most-wanted list, has surfaced in Egypt, Cairo airport sources revealed.
agnews:train:32418.para:
Cairo Airport Sources Reveal: Hamas Leader Meshaal Makes an Appearance (AFP)
AFP reports that Khaled Meshaal, the political leader of the Palestinian Hamas movement and a top target for Israel, has been spotted at Cairo's airport.

agnews:train:32532.orig: Hotel Workers in 3 Cities May Strike Sunday Hotel workers in Washington, DC, San Francisco and Los Angeles held out the threat of a strike on Sunday, but have told management they will resume contract talks, a DC union official said.
agnews:train:32532.para: Hotel employees in three cities—Washington, DC, San Francisco, and Los Angeles—are considering a strike on Sunday, though they've indicated to management they're willing to resume negotiations, according to a union representative in DC.

agnews:train:32694.orig: Far Right Groups Gain in Two German State Elections Voters in two east German states angry over high unemployment handed a rebuke Sunday to Germany's two biggest parties, giving big gains to far right and former Communist groups, television projections showed.
agnews:train:32694.para:
In Two East German State Elections, Far-Right Groups See Significant Gains
Voters in two eastern German states, frustrated with high unemployment rates, dealt a notable setback to Germany's two largest parties on Sunday. According to television projections, far-right and former Communist groups gained substantial ground.

agnews:train:32799.orig: China Completes 1st Orderly Power Transfer (AP) AP - Hu Jintao became the undisputed leader of China as the country completed its first orderly transfer of power in the communist era on Sunday with the departure of former President Jiang Zemin from his top military post  #151; giving a new generation a freer hand to run the world's most populous nation.
agnews:train:32799.para: China Successfully Executes First Smooth Leadership Transition (AP) - Hu Jintao emerged as the unchallenged leader of China on Sunday, as former President Jiang Zemin stepped down from his key military position, paving the way for a younger generation to lead the world's most populous country with greater autonomy.

agnews:train:32917.orig: Maoists abduct over 100 students and teachers in Nepal Kathmandu, Sept 19 (PTI) Suspected maoist rebels have abducted more than 100 students and teachers from three schools in western and eastern districts of Nepal over the weekend, media reports said today.
agnews:train:32917.para: Suspected Maoist rebels have kidnapped more than 100 students and teachers from three schools in Nepal's western and eastern districts over the weekend, according to recent media reports.

agnews:train:32976.orig: German fringe parties make gains Parties on the far right and left made gains in two state elections Sunday in Germany, with voters delivering a rebuke to Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder #39;s Social Democrats as he tries to rein in German welfare programs.
agnews:train:32976.para: In two recent state elections in Germany, parties from the far right and left saw increased support. This outcome reflects a voter backlash against Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder's Social Democrats, as they attempt to reduce German welfare benefits.

agnews:train:33035.orig: Canyon Holds Ancient Civilization Secrets (AP) AP - The newly discovered ruins of an ancient civilization in this remote eastern Utah canyon could reveal secrets about the descendants of the continent's original Paleo-Indians who showed up before the time of Christ to settle much of present-day Utah.
agnews:train:33035.para: A Remote Utah Canyon Yields Clues to an Ancient Civilization (AP) - Recently uncovered ruins in an isolated eastern Utah canyon may uncover mysteries about the descendants of Paleo-Indians, the continent's earliest inhabitants, who arrived in what is now Utah before the birth of Christ.

agnews:train:33053.orig: AOL #39;s True Believers Wall Street is down on AOL Time Warner -- and worried about its moguls. Yet deeper in the ranks, a cadre of executives is working hard to bring the troubled colossus to life.
agnews:train:33053.para: Despite Wall Street's skepticism and concerns about AOL Time Warner, a group of dedicated executives within the company is diligently striving to revitalize the struggling giant.

agnews:train:33058.orig: Souness wins first league match as Newcastle manager Newcastle manager Graeme Souness won his first league match in charge Sunday in a 2-1 victory over his former club Southampton. Steve Carr scored the winner in the 57th minute with a 30-yard
agnews:train:33058.para: Graeme Souness secured his initial league triumph as Newcastle's manager on Sunday, defeating Southampton 2-1. Steve Carr netted the decisive goal in the 57th minute from 30 yards out.

agnews:train:33062.orig: Hamas fire rocket into settlement A ROCKET fired by Palestinian militants from the Gaza Strip landed in the southern Israeli town of Sderot today but did not cause any injuries, military sources said.
agnews:train:33062.para: Palestinian militants based in Gaza launched a rocket that struck a town in southern Israel, specifically Sderot, but no one was hurt, according to military reports.

agnews:train:33109.orig: UK police arrest Cisco source code suspect UK police have arrested a man on suspicion of stealing source code from networking giant Cisco. The 20 year-old was arrested following Metropolitan Police Computer Crime Unit raids in Manchester and Derbyshire on 3 September.
agnews:train:33109.para: UK authorities have apprehended a 20-year-old individual on suspicion of hacking Cisco to steal its source code. The Metropolitan Police Computer Crime Unit conducted searches in Manchester and Derbyshire on September 3rd as part of this investigation.

agnews:train:33119.orig: Pakistan will oppose India for permanent UNSC seat NEW YORK: Pakistan will strongly oppose Indias bid to become a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), Pakistans permanent representative to the UN Munir Akram told a group of Pakistani journalists on Saturday.
agnews:train:33119.para: Pakistan plans to firmly resist India's attempt to secure a permanent spot on the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), according to Munir Akram, Pakistan's UN representative, who shared this information with a gathering of Pakistani journalists on Saturday.

agnews:train:33152.orig: Los Alamos to Remove Nukes Within a year, officials plan to move all weapons-grade nuclear material from Los Alamos National Laboratory to the Nevada Test Site. The transfer will begin this month.
agnews:train:33152.para: Within the next year, officials have scheduled the relocation of all weapons-grade nuclear materials from Los Alamos National Laboratory to the Nevada Test Site. The process is set to commence this month.

agnews:train:33196.orig: Uncertain fate for S. Africa's giants PILANESBERG NATIONAL PARK, South Africa -- Ecologist Rudi van Aarde leaned back on a veranda that overlooked dry grasslands and a group of bull elephants, his shoes still dusty from an 8,000-mile tour of game reserves in southern Africa. Van Aarde was on a mission: saving elephants from sanctioned killings.
agnews:train:33196.para: Ecologist Rudi van Aarde, with dusty shoes from an 8,000-mile journey through southern African game reserves, leaned back on a veranda overlooking dry grasslands and a herd of bull elephants. His mission: to prevent sanctioned killings of elephants.

agnews:train:33225.orig: In face of losses, Woods answers questions BLOOMFIELD TOWNSHIP, Mich. -- There was a stern look on his face when he won the first hole, courtesy of Paul Casey's three-putt bogey, and when Tiger Woods went 2 up at the fifth, he hardly showed emotion.
agnews:train:33225.para: When Woods secured the first hole due to Paul Casey's three-putt bogey, he wore a serious expression. As he went 2 up at the fifth hole, he showed virtually no emotion.

agnews:train:33282.orig: Fed's rate decision not apt to affect market NEW YORK -- Wall Street opinion is split on whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates tomorrow, with conventional wisdom siding with a rate increase. But either way, the decision probably won't have as much impact on what happens to stock prices this week as will news of corporate earnings surprises.
agnews:train:33282.para: Opinions on Wall Street are divided regarding the Federal Reserve's potential rate hike tomorrow, with most expecting an increase. However, regardless of the outcome, the Fed's decision is likely to have less influence on this week's stock price movements compared to any unexpected earnings announcements.

agnews:train:33330.orig: Stelmar Being Acquired for \$677 Million  NEW YORK (Reuters) - Private equity firm Fortress  Investment Group LLC has agreed to buy oil tank operator  Stelmar Shipping Ltd. <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=SJH.N target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">SJH.N</A> for \$677 million, Stelmar said on  Monday.
agnews:train:33330.para: Private Equity Firm Fortress Investment Group LLC Has Reached a Deal to Acquire Stelmar Shipping Ltd. for $677 Million. NEW YORK (Reuters) - Stelmar Shipping Ltd., an oil tanker operator, announced on Monday that it has agreed to be acquired by the private equity firm Fortress Investment Group LLC for $677 million.

agnews:train:33383.orig: India to Ask Private Experts to Determine Extent of HIV Infection <b>...</b> India says it will appoint private consultants to determine the number of people infected with the AIDS virus. The Indian government estimates the number at 5.1 million, the second most in the world after South Africa.
agnews:train:33383.para: India Plans to Engage Private Experts to Assess HIV Infections <b>...</b> The Indian government intends to hire private experts to evaluate the extent of HIV infections, following its current estimate of 5.1 million infected individuals, which ranks second globally after South Africa.

agnews:train:33615.orig: N. Korea Won't Give Up Nuke Development (AP) AP - North Korea said Monday that it will not give up nuclear development in light of unauthorized nuclear experiments by South Korea, where U.N. inspectors nuclear inspectors were conducting an investigation.
agnews:train:33615.para: North Korea Stands Firm on Nuclear Development (AP) AP - On Monday, North Korea declared it will not halt its nuclear development efforts, following South Korea's unauthorized nuclear tests and the ongoing UN inspection in the South.

agnews:train:33687.orig: Ferdinand returns for Manchester United after ban Manchester United #39;s England defender Rio Ferdinand was named in his club #39;s starting lineup for their Premier League match against Liverpool at Old Trafford on Monday, marking the end of his eight-month ban.
agnews:train:33687.para: Rio Ferdinand, Manchester United's English defender, has been reinstated for the team. He was included in the starting lineup for their Premier League game against Liverpool at Old Trafford on Monday, signifying the conclusion of his eight-month suspension.

agnews:train:33822.orig: Video Shows Beheading of Man Said to Be US Hostage in Iraq BAGHDAD, Iraq - One of the American hostages kidnapped last week in Iraq has been beheaded by the Al Qaeda-linked group of Jordanian terror mastermind Abu Musab al-Zarqawi (search ), according to a Web site.
agnews:train:33822.para:
A Video Emerges Showing the Beheading of Alleged US Hostage in Iraq
BAGHDAD, Iraq - A website has reported that one of the American hostages abducted last week in Iraq has been executed by decapitation. This act is attributed to a group linked to Al Qaeda, led by the Jordanian terrorist Abu Musab al-Zarqawi.

agnews:train:33864.orig: Awesome Aussies have no worries Adam Gilchrist was standing by himself in one section of the indoor nets centre at Edgbaston on Monday. He contemplated the large area that had been cleared of any distractions, just the three stumps placed at one end.
agnews:train:33864.para: On Monday, Adam Gilchrist stood alone in a section of the indoor nets at Edgbaston, surrounded by a spacious, distraction-free area. He focused on the three stumps positioned at one end.

agnews:train:34103.orig: Tropical storm Jeanne to bring floods and deaths to Haiti HAITI - At least 90 people died due to floods caused by heavy rains brought by Tropical storm Jeanne. Hundreds of people in Port-au-Prince, Haitis capital, have to save their lives from powerful water streams on the roofs of their properties.
agnews:train:34103.para:
Tropical Storm Jeanne Caused Flooding and Loss of Lives in Haiti

At least 90 individuals lost their lives in Haiti due to flooding triggered by heavy rainfall from Tropical Storm Jeanne. In Port-au-Prince, the capital city, hundreds of residents had to seek safety on their rooftops to avoid powerful water currents.

agnews:train:34138.orig: Blue Jays Rookie Pitcher Handcuffs Yankees (AP) AP - Gustavo Chacin became the first lefty starter to win his major league debut against the Yankees in the Joe Torre era, pitching the Toronto Blue Jays past New York 6-3 Monday night.
agnews:train:34138.para: In the Joe Torre era, Gustavo Chacin achieved a historic feat by securing the first left-handed victory in his major league debut against the Yankees. He helped the Toronto Blue Jays defeat New York with a 6-3 score on Monday night.

agnews:train:34172.para: CBS News Offers歉意 NEW YORK - CBS News on Monday expressed an apology for its "judgment error" in a report that cast doubt on President Bush's National Guard experience, stating it was deceived by the document source, which multiple experts now consider fraudulent. agnews:train:34233.para: San Diego's Financial Challenges Resurface It's certainly not the type of report an incumbent mayor would want to see published just six weeks before an election: On September

agnews:train:34272.para: Fed Anticipated to Hike Rates Amid Concerns (Reuters) Reuters - The Federal Reserve was set to increase U.S. interest rates for the third time this year, maintaining higher borrowing costs from historically low levels, even as there were some indications of economic weakening.

agnews:train:34313.orig: Soccer Legend Maradona Arrives in Cuba (AP) AP - Former soccer great Diego Maradona returned to Cuba on Monday to resume treatment for cocaine addiction after a relapse confined him to a psychiatric hospital in his native Argentina and sparked unsuccessful attempts by his family to keep him at home.
agnews:train:34313.para: Soccer Icon Maradona Returns to Cuba for Treatment (AP) - Former soccer star Diego Maradona has arrived in Cuba to continue his recovery from a cocaine addiction relapse. He was previously hospitalized in Argentina at a psychiatric facility due to his relapse, and his family had tried but failed to keep him at home.

agnews:train:34316.orig: Airlines Likely To Change Tack An aviation analyst believes Air New Zealand and Qantas will amend their bid to form an alliance and work instead on sharing resources.
agnews:train:34316.para: An aviation expert predicts that Air New Zealand and Qantas will adjust their strategy and focus on resource sharing instead of pursuing their current alliance bid.

agnews:train:34320.orig: Critics see political taint All presidents claim credit for economic success - and are tarred for failure. But most economists say the Federal Reserve has the greater influence.
agnews:train:34320.para: Critics often perceive a political influence on economic outcomes. Every president tends to take credit for economic successes, while blaming the Fed for any failures. However, many economists argue that the Federal Reserve actually has more significant impact.

agnews:train:34336.orig: Toronto Blue Jays News As far as improbable endings go, this one has to rank high on the  quot;Rudy quot; scale. Gustavo Chacin was the ultimate underdog on Monday night, a Double-A pitcher summoned to face the toughest team in the American League.
agnews:train:34336.para: Toronto Blue Jays Update In terms of surprising outcomes, this one certainly measures up to the "Rudy" standard. Gustavo Chacin, an underdog par excellence, was called up to pitch on Monday against the top team in the American League, which is Double-A material.

agnews:train:34345.orig: Tempers flare in M #39;s loss ANAHEIM, Calif. -- With players getting hurt left and right, the Anaheim Angels defeated the Mariners 5-2 last night at Edison Field.
agnews:train:34345.para: Temperatures rise as the Mariners suffer a 5-2 loss to the Angels ANAHEM, Calif. - Despite numerous injuries, the Angels triumphed over the Mariners at Edison Field last night.

agnews:train:34484.orig: Death Toll Nears 700 from Haiti Flooding  PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti (Reuters) - The death toll in Haiti  from flooding and mudslides triggered by Tropical Storm Jeanne  rose above 660 on Tuesday and government officials were still  struggling to reach areas cut off by flood waters.
agnews:train:34484.para: The Death Toll from Haiti's Flooding Approaches 700  PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti (Reuters) - The number of fatalities in Haiti due to flooding and mudslides caused by Tropical Storm Jeanne climbed to over 660 on Tuesday. Authorities are still having difficulty accessing regions that remain isolated by floodwaters.

agnews:train:34491.orig: US Fed 'set for third rate rise' Economists are betting that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates to 1.75 on Tuesday, the third rise this year.
agnews:train:34491.para:
Economists Predict Third Rate Hike by US Fed
The US Federal Reserve is expected to increase interest rates to 1.75 percent on Tuesday, marking the third hike of the year.

agnews:train:34492.orig: Israel strike cripples business About 400,000 public sector workers are on strike in Israel,  crippling business around the country.
agnews:train:34492.para: A strike involving around 400,000 public sector workers in Israel is severely disrupting business operations across the country.

agnews:train:34536.para: Cricket Australia has warned of canceling the upcoming tour to India in response to the intensifying dispute over television rights in the region.

agnews:train:34764.para: BCCI to Announce Its Strategy on TV Rights Soon: Dalmiya, Sept 21 (UNI) The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) indicated today that it will soon determine its next steps after ESPN-Star Sports withdrew its petition against the BCCI in the Bombay High Court today.

agnews:train:34772.para:
Mac Gaming in Japan: A Decline and a Surprise Rescuer
The Mac gaming scene in Japan is currently experiencing a downturn, with no Mac games available. However, an unexpected savior has emerged to revive Mac gaming in the country. Nobuyuki Hayashi provides the latest from Tokyo.

agnews:train:34979.orig: JPMorgan Chase To Shuffle Management; Financial Chief To Leave NEW YORK -(Dow Jones)- JPMorgan Chase  amp; Co.  #39;s (JPM) chief financial officer, Dina Dublon, will resign at the end of the year and be replaced by Michael Cavanagh , currently head of middle market banking.

agnews:train:36248.para: Despite the music industry's strong efforts to combat peer-to-peer file sharing online, the majority of musicians believe that illegal file sharing does not negatively impact them, as indicated by a recent survey.

agnews:train:37617.orig: Woman Gives Birth After Tissue Transplant LONDON - The first baby conceived after an ovarian tissue transplant was born Thursday in Belgium in a procedure that could one day allow women to delay motherhood beyond menopause.    The birth, announced by The Lancet medical journal, which is to publish the results of the procedure Friday, marks the first time fertility has been restored to a woman after doctors cut out and froze some of her ovarian tissue and transplanted it back into her body years later...
agnews:train:37617.para: In Belgium, a baby was born on Thursday following the world's first successful conception after an ovarian tissue transplant. This procedure, detailed in an upcoming publication by The Lancet medical journal, signifies a breakthrough that may enable women to postpone motherhood beyond menopause. The transplant involved removing and freezing some ovarian tissue, which was later reinserted, restoring the woman's fertility.

agnews:train:43348.orig: Gangs on Prowl in Storm-Wracked Haiti GONAIVES, Haiti - Victims who lost relatives, homes and belongings in Tropical Storm Jeanne are now tormented by street gangs who attack food convoys, raid homes at night and shoot those who get in their way.
