agnews:train:46767.orig: DNA Testing May Curb Illegal Ivory Trade Description: Delegates from 160 nations are gathering in Thailand for a meeting on international trade in endangered species. They will discuss new genetic research that makes it easier to trace poached ivory.
agnews:train:46767.para: Delegates from 160 countries are convening in Thailand to address international trade in endangered species. The meeting will include discussions on recent genetic studies that simplify the tracking of illegally poached ivory.

agnews:train:46898.orig: RIAA hunts down more file-trading scum The RIAA (Recording Industry Association of America) knows how to kick of the back-to-school season with a splash, sending out another load of lawsuits to collegians everywhere.
agnews:train:46898.para: The RIAA initiates its annual back-to-school legal campaign by targeting college students for file-sharing activities once again.

agnews:train:47046.orig: Volandri Upsets Massu in Palermo (AP) AP - Defending champion Nicolas Massu was upset by Filippo Volandri 6-3, 3-6, 6-4 Friday in the quarterfinals of the Campionati Internazionali di Sicilia.
agnews:train:47046.para: In Palermo, Filippo Volandri Surprises Nicolas Massu (AP) - In the quarterfinals of the Campionati Internazionali di Sicilia, defending champion Nicolas Massu suffered an unexpected loss to Filippo Volandri, with scores of 6-3, 3-6, 6-4.

agnews:train:47063.orig: Els duels with Troon nemesis Hamilton Perhaps it was the name at the top of the leaderboard which inspired Ernie Els. Todd Hamilton was the first round leader but Els cruised past the Open champion with an eight
agnews:train:47063.para: Els outpaced Hamilton, the round one leader, perhaps spurred by seeing his name atop the leaderboard. Els easily overtook the Open champion, gaining eight positions.

agnews:train:47094.orig: Scalia Jokes About Orgies in Mass. Speech (AP) AP - Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia's recent speeches have ventured into some surprising territory, with the staunchly conservative father of nine joking about sexual orgies.
agnews:train:47094.para: Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia, a conservative with nine children, recently made unexpected remarks during a speech, humorously mentioning orgies in Massachusetts.

agnews:train:47272.orig: SUN 61, LIBERTY 51 Balanced Sun Knocks Liberty Off-Balance ith five minutes left in Game 1 of the Eastern Conference finals last night at Madison Square Garden, the Connecticut Sun had the Liberty down, if not out.
agnews:train:47272.para: SUN 61, LIBERTY 51: The Sun Maintained Control In Game 1 of the Eastern Conference finals at Madison Square Garden, the Connecticut Sun kept the Liberty off balance with just five minutes remaining.

agnews:train:47305.orig: Sun Scorches Liberty Nykesha Sales scores 13 of her 15 points in the first half and the Sun beat the Liberty 61-51 on Friday night in Game 1 of the WNBA's Eastern Conference finals.
agnews:train:47305.para: In the first half, Liberty Nykesha Sales contributed 13 of her 15 points as the Sun defeated the Liberty 61-51 in the opening game of the WNBA Eastern Conference finals on Friday night.

agnews:train:47413.orig: Netflix, TiVo Partner To Offer Online Films (TechWeb) TechWeb - Netflix, TiVo team up to work with Hollywood studios to develop technology for the delivery of video programming over the Internet.
agnews:train:47413.para: Netflix and TiVo Have Joined Forces to Collaborate with Hollywood Studios on Internet-Delivered Video Technology (TechWeb)

agnews:train:47416.orig: SAVE OUR GRAND PRIX: BY ECC! MOTOR racing boss Bernie Ecclestone, the man trying to axe the British Grand Prix, is backing the Mirror #39;s campaign to save the Silverstone showpiece.
agnews:train:47416.para: SAVE OUR GRAND PRIX: SUPPORT FROM ECC! The motor racing chief, Bernie Ecclestone, who has been working to eliminate the British Grand Prix, is now supporting the Mirror's initiative to preserve the Silverstone event.

agnews:train:47417.orig: The fat lady finally sings Olympic Stadium has always had the lighting of a morgue. Stark and blindingly white, you could roll out a gurney and perform an autopsy at home plate - which is what #39;s now in order, given there #39;s been a needless death at The Big O.
agnews:train:47417.para: The Olympic Stadium has long been known for its harsh, clinical lighting, reminiscent of a morgue. The stark, blinding whiteness is so intense that one might as well set up an autopsy there. Given the recent tragic event at The Big O, it's now more fitting than ever.

agnews:train:47501.orig: Hostage brother hits out over police raid THE brother of Iraq hostage Ken Bigley hit out at police today after officers investigating the kidnapping raided his home. Paul Bigley said the raid had made him feel like a criminal and had wasted time in the race to save his brothers life.
agnews:train:47501.para: The sibling of kidnapped Iraqi citizen Ken Bigley expressed dissatisfaction with the police raid on his residence today. Paul Bigley felt the action made him seem like a suspect and believed it was a misstep in the urgent effort to rescue his brother's life.

agnews:train:47517.orig: At peace with Microsoft, Sun chief whips off the gloves over Red <b>...</b> Sun Microsystems Inc. #39;s combative chief executive, Scott McNealy, fresh from resolving his long-running quarrel with archrival Microsoft Corp.
agnews:train:47517.para: Sun Microsystems' feisty CEO, Scott McNealy, who has just settled his longstanding dispute with Microsoft, now adopts a more confrontational stance towards Red.

agnews:train:47534.orig: Iraqi Kidnappers Demand Release of Militant Indonesian Cleric Kidnappers holding two Indonesian women hostages in Iraq are demanding the release of a militant cleric accused of leading a terrorist group in Southeast Asia.
agnews:train:47534.para: Kidnappers in Iraq are seeking the release of a militant Indonesian cleric, who is alleged to have led a terrorist group in Southeast Asia, in exchange for two Indonesian female hostages they are holding.

agnews:train:47547.orig: Wal-Mart Says Sept. Sales Up 2.3 Percent  CHICAGO (Reuters) - Wal-Mart Stores Inc. <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=WMT.N target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">WMT.N</A> on  Saturday said sales at stores open at least a year rose 2.3  percent, according to its preliminary tally, helped by sales of  bedding, electronics, food and pet supplies.
agnews:train:47547.para: Wal-Mart Reports September Sales Increase of 2.3%  CHICAGO (Reuters) - Wal-Mart Stores Inc. reported on Saturday that sales from its stores open for at least a year saw a 2.3% rise, based on its preliminary figures. This growth was driven by strong sales in bedding, electronics, food, and pet supplies.

agnews:train:47646.orig: ***** WNBA Playoff Game Capsules - Friday, October 1st ***** Final Score: Connecticut 61, New York 51 New York, NY (Sports Network) - Nykesha Sales scored 15 points to lead Connecticut to a 61-51 win over New York in Game 1 of their best-of-three Eastern Conference Finals series at Madison Square Garden.
agnews:train:47646.para: ***** WNBA Playoff Game Summaries - Friday, October 1st ***** Final Result: Connecticut 61, New York 51 In New York City, Nykesha Sales scored 15 points, leading Connecticut to a 61-51 victory over New York in the first game of their best-of-three Eastern Conference Finals series at Madison Square Garden.

agnews:train:47726.orig: Hamas Gunmen Vow More Attacks on Israel JEBALIYA REFUGEE CAMP, Gaza Strip Oct. 2, 2004 - Israeli troops and aircraft hit hard at Palestinian militants Saturday, killing at least 10 on the third bloody day of a massive Israeli incursion into the
agnews:train:47726.para: On October 2, 2004, in Jebaliya Refugee Camp, Gaza Strip, Palestinian militants affiliated with Hamas pledged further attacks on Israel. Concurrently, Israeli forces and aircraft launched a significant offensive, resulting in at least 10 fatalities on the third consecutive day of intense conflict.

agnews:train:47785.orig: Dodgers can clinch division title Friday BRISTOL, Connecticut (Ticker) - The Los Angeles Dodgers are closing in on their first playoff berth in eight years. Beating the San Francisco Giants for the National League West title would make it that much sweeter.
agnews:train:47785.para: The Los Angeles Dodgers are nearing their first playoff spot in eight years and could secure the National League West division title on Friday, which would be particularly sweet against the San Francisco Giants.

agnews:train:47850.orig: U.S. Warns of Big Mount St. Helens Blast (AP) AP - Government scientists raised the alert level Saturday for Mount St. Helens after its second steam eruption in two days was followed by a powerful tremor. They said the next eruption was imminent or in progress, and could threaten life and property in the remote area near the volcano.
agnews:train:47850.para: Government Scientists Issue High Alert for Mount St. Helens (AP) - Following a second steam eruption in two days and a strong tremor, government scientists increased the alert level for Mount St. Helens on Saturday. They warned that the next eruption is likely to occur soon and could pose a threat to life and property in the remote vicinity of the volcano.

agnews:train:47874.orig: Tinker With Your Computer, and Reap the Rewards While Microsoft and Google dominate many computer activities like search and Internet browsing, programs and utilities from smaller companies offer worthy alternatives.
agnews:train:47874.para: Explore Lesser-Known Programs and Utilities, and Enjoy the Benefits Though Microsoft and Google dominate areas such as web search and browsing, there are valuable alternatives provided by smaller software companies.

agnews:train:47890.orig: Purdue's Orton Shines Kyle Orton throws four touchdowns, including a 97 yarder to Taylor Stubblefield, to lead the No. 15 Purdue Boilermakers to a 41-16 victory over Notre Dame.
agnews:train:47890.para: Kyle Orton, the quarterback for No. 15 Purdue, excelled with four touchdown passes, notably a 97-yarder to Taylor Stubblefield, guiding the Boilermakers to a decisive 41-16 win against Notre Dame.

agnews:train:47948.orig: Federer destroys the dreams of Asia #39;s hero Federer, who has not lost a final in well over a year, stands a step away from a 10th trophy this season; he awaits a winner from another star-studded semi-final: Andy Roddick versus Marat Safin.
agnews:train:47948.para: Federer, who hasn't lost a final in over a year and is just one win away from his tenth title of the season, crushes the hopes of Asia's hero. He now faces the winner of a highly anticipated semi-final between Andy Roddick and Marat Safin.

agnews:train:47997.orig: Boxing: Trinidad floors Mayorga to win middleweight fight NEW YORK : Three-time former division champion Felix Trinidad shook off the rust from 29 months of retirement by beating Ricardo Mayorga in the eighth round of a middleweight contest.
agnews:train:47997.para: Boxing: Trinidad Dethrones Mayorga in Middleweight Clash NEW YORK: After a 29-month hiatus, three-time former champion Felix Trinidad regained his form, defeating Ricardo Mayorga in the eighth round of their middleweight match.

agnews:train:48004.orig: Israeli Forces Kill 12 in Gaza Camp Raid JEBALIYA REFUGEE CAMP, Gaza Strip - Israeli troops and aircraft hit hard at Palestinian militants this weekend, killing at least 12 in a massive Israeli incursion into the Gaza Strip's largest refugee camp, as masked Hamas gunmen vowed more rocket attacks on Israeli towns.    About 2,000 soldiers have taken control of a 5-mile-deep chunk of northern Gaza to counter militants firing homemade rockets into Israel...
agnews:train:48004.para:
Israeli Forces Kill 12 in Gaza Camp Raid

In JEBALIYA REFUGEE CAMP, Gaza Strip, Israeli military units and aircraft launched a significant operation against Palestinian militants this past weekend, resulting in at least 12 fatalities during a large-scale incursion into the Gaza Strip's primary refugee camp. Meanwhile, masked Hamas fighters declared they would intensify rocket attacks on Israeli communities.

Approximately 2,000 soldiers have secured a 5-mile-deep section of northern Gaza to address the threat of homemade rockets being launched into Israel.

agnews:train:48020.orig: IAEA Chief in South Korea for Nuclear Talks The head of the UN nuclear watchdog, Mohamed ElBaradei, arrived in Seoul Sunday to discuss South Korea #39;s nuclear experiments after last month #39;s two intrusive inspections.
agnews:train:48020.para: The UN nuclear oversight chief, Mohamed ElBaradei, arrived in Seoul on Sunday to discuss South Korea's nuclear experiments following the two thorough inspections conducted last month.

agnews:train:48092.orig: Jumbos hold off Bates Jason Casey threw a pair of second-quarter touchdown passes and Tufts stymied a fourth-quarter uprising to hold off Bates, 14-12, yesterday at Ellis Oval/Zimman Field in Somerville.
agnews:train:48092.para: In yesterday's game at Ellis Oval/Zimman Field in Somerville, Jason Casey threw two second-quarter touchdown passes, and Tufts successfully defended against Bates' late push, securing a 14-12 victory.

agnews:train:48185.orig: Canas Thrashes Burgsmuller to Win Shanghai Open  SHANGHAI (Reuters) - Argentine Guillermo Canas crushed  Germany's Lars Burgsmuller 6-1 6-0 to win the Shanghai Open on  Sunday.
agnews:train:48185.para: Argentine player Guillermo Canas dominated and defeated Germany's Lars Burgsmuller with scores of 6-1 and 6-0, securing the victory at the Shanghai Open on Sunday.

agnews:train:48292.orig: Fresh Blasts Rock Northeast India Suspected separatists bombed a crowded market, a tea plantation and other sites Sunday, killing seven people in a second day of explosions and gun attacks that have left at least 57 dead and more than 100 wounded in northeast India.
agnews:train:48292.para: In Northeast India, new explosions struck on Sunday, targeting a busy market and a tea plantation among other locations. This follows a day of attacks that have resulted in at least 57 deaths and over 100 injuries, with suspected separatists responsible for the bombings and gunfire.

agnews:train:48338.orig: Nigerian rebel leader reaches out to rival in troubled oil region (AFP) AFP - Nigerian rebel leader Mujahid Dokubo Asari assured his arch rival in the battle for the control of oil resources in the Niger Delta, Ateke Tom that he was ready to make peace.
agnews:train:48338.para: The Nigerian rebel chief, Mujahid Dokubo Asari, extended an olive branch to his long-standing adversary, Ateke Tom, in their contentious struggle over oil resources in the Niger Delta, expressing his willingness to pursue peace.

agnews:train:48371.orig: Bigley: Gaddafi to help London - Members of Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi #39;s family have pledged to support efforts to free British hostage Kenneth Bigley, his brother claims.
agnews:train:48371.para: Bigley: Gaddafi's Family to Aid in Bigley's Release - Kenneth Bigley's brother states that members of Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi's family have committed to assisting with the effort to free the British hostage.

agnews:train:48450.orig: SpaceShipOne Bid Seen Opening Space for Business A private space plane is set to shoot beyond Earth #39;s atmosphere for the second time in a week on Monday in a pioneering bid to win a \$10 million prize and prove that space is open for business.
agnews:train:48450.para: A Private Spacecraft Set to Reach Beyond Earth's Atmosphere Again This Week, Paving the Way for Commercial Ventures In an ambitious attempt to claim a $10 million prize, a private space vehicle is scheduled to launch into space for the second time in a week on Monday. This pioneering endeavor aims to demonstrate that space is accessible for business operations.

agnews:train:48574.orig: Disabled Are Pleased With E-Voting (AP) AP - This November, Eileen Rivera Ley, 41, will vote by herself for the first time. Blind voters in Maryland and several other states will use electronic voting machines equipped with technology that allows the disabled to vote independently.
agnews:train:48574.para: Blind Voters to Cast Independent Votes This November (AP) AP - For the first time, Eileen Rivera Ley, 41, will vote on her own this November. Blind voters in Maryland and other states will utilize electronic voting machines that come with features enabling them to vote independently.

agnews:train:48592.orig: Bonds, Suzuki Win Batting Titles (AP) AP - Barry Bonds won his second National League batting title in three seasons and shattered the on-base percentage and walks records he set two years ago.
agnews:train:48592.para: Bonds and Suzuki Claim Batting Titles (AP) According to AP, Barry Bonds secured his second National League batting title in three years, breaking the on-base percentage and walks records he established two seasons ago.

agnews:train:48649.orig: Afghan Death Toll Mounts As Voting Nears (AP) AP - The killing in Afghanistan spirals onward, undermining U.S. claims of success in pacifying the country with less than a week to go before an historic experiment with democracy  #151; direct presidential elections.
agnews:train:48649.para: As the death toll in Afghanistan continues to rise, it casts doubt on U.S. assertions of progress in stabilizing the nation, with just days left until the country's first direct presidential election.

agnews:train:48710.orig: Northwest #39;s CEO Deplanes And then there was one. Northwest Airlines (NWAC ) reported Oct. 1 that its CEO, Richard H. Anderson, is quitting to take a job in the health-care industry.
agnews:train:48710.para:
Northwest's CEO Steps Down; Health Care Move Announced
On October 1, Northwest Airlines disclosed that its CEO, Richard H. Anderson, is resigning to pursue a career in the health-care sector.

agnews:train:48716.orig: Turkey At The EU #39;s Door Turkey #39;s decades-long quest to join the European Union looks set to take a great leap forward. On Oct. 6 the European Commission in Brussels is due to release its opinion on whether Turkey has met the legal
agnews:train:48716.para: Turkey's Long-Awaited EU Membership Turkey's multi-decade effort to join the European Union is poised for significant progress. On October 6, the European Commission in Brussels will announce its assessment of whether Turkey has fulfilled the legal criteria for membership.

agnews:train:48838.orig: Fastow might be called as hostile witness in Enron trial HOUSTON -- Enron Corp.'s former finance chief, Andrew Fastow, is not a defendant or a prosecution witness in the first criminal trial to emerge from the energy company's crash, but he could be called to testify for the defense -- possibly as a hostile witness.
agnews:train:48838.para: Fastow could potentially testify as a hostile witness in Enron's criminal trial. IN HOUSTON -- Although Enron Corp.'s former finance chief, Andrew Fastow, is neither a defendant nor a prosecution witness in the initial trial stemming from the company's collapse, he might be summoned to give testimony on behalf of the defense.

agnews:train:48846.orig: Els earns title as Woods is relegated Ernie Els got the better of Thomas Bjorn yet again yesterday to win his first solo World Golf Championships title. And on a horribly wet and windy day at Mount Juliet in County
agnews:train:48846.para: Ernie Els secured his first individual World Golf Championships title by outperforming Thomas Bjorn once more, despite the challenging conditions of heavy rain and strong winds at Mount Juliet in County.

agnews:train:48854.orig: Israel Urged to Limit Military Response (AP) AP - The State Department called on Israel Friday to limit its military response to a rocket attack by Hamas that killed two small Israeli children.
agnews:train:48854.para: The State Department Requested Israel to Restrict Its Military Retaliation Following a Hamas Rocket Strike That Resulted in the Deaths of Two Young Israeli Children.

agnews:train:48978.orig: Vivisimo #39;s Clusty Takes on Google Search engine company Vivisimo have launched the beta of their new Clusty search engine, and it #39;s open to the public to try out.
agnews:train:48978.para: Vivisimo has released the beta version of its Clusty search engine, which is now available for the public to test.

agnews:train:48994.orig: BioSET Offers New Twist on the Healing Touch Doctors routinely use plates, rods and screws to bolt a nasty bone fracture back together. But all of that hardware won't help heal the bone and muscle tissue surrounding the injury, said Thomas G. Roueche, president and chief executive of BioSurface Engineering Technologies Inc. of College Park.
agnews:train:48994.para: BioSurface Engineering Technologies Inc., led by Thomas G. Roueche, notes that while doctors commonly use plates, rods, and screws to stabilize a severe bone fracture, such hardware doesn't address the healing of the surrounding bone and muscle tissue.

agnews:train:48996.orig: S Korea to scrutinise Citigroup South Korea's markets watchdog says it is to inspect Citigroup's local operation, days after regulators censured the bank's Japanese business.
agnews:train:48996.para: South Korea's securities regulator plans to examine Citigroup's local operations, following the recent reprimand of the bank's Japanese division by Japanese authorities.

agnews:train:49094.orig: Neb. Professor Connects Football, Physics (AP) AP - A physics professor at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln has published a book that explains how the laws of nature interact with the game of football.
agnews:train:49094.para: A professor at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln has released a book detailing how physical laws influence the sport of football.

agnews:train:49159.orig: Space shuttle return to flight delayed The record series of four hurricanes that hit Florida in recent weeks has ended NASA #39;s hopes of returning the space shuttles to flight in March 2005, NASA announced on Friday.
agnews:train:49159.para: NASA's plans to resume space shuttle flights in March 2005 have been postponed due to the severe impact of four hurricanes that struck Florida over the past few weeks, as NASA announced on Friday.

agnews:train:49214.orig: Dollar gains after G-7 meetingCurrency market awaits US payrolls <b>...</b> CHICAGO (CBS.MW) - The dollar moved higher Monday in the wake of little new policy direction from a weekend meeting of finance ministers and central bankers from the world #39;s economic powers.
agnews:train:49214.para: The dollar rose following the G-7 meeting, with the currency market now focusing on upcoming US payrolls data. CHICAGO (CBS.MW) - After a recent G-7 meeting that didn't provide significant new policy guidance, the dollar strengthened on Monday.

agnews:train:49222.orig: Revised law on trial of Khmer Rouge leaders approved Phnom Penh (VNA) - The Cambodian National Assembly on Monday approved the revised law on the establishment of a Cambodia-United Nations tribunal to try Khmer Rouge leaders.
agnews:train:49222.para: Phnom Penh (VNA) - On Monday, the Cambodian National Assembly gave its approval to the amended law that sets up a Cambodia-United Nations tribunal for the trial of former Khmer Rouge leaders.

agnews:train:49229.orig: US economic growth seen slowing in 2005 US economic growth should slow over the coming year as consumers cut back on spending but improved business confidence should help beef up hiring, a wide-ranging survey of forecasters found.
agnews:train:49229.para: Forecasters expect US economic growth to decelerate in 2005 as consumers reduce their spending, although enhanced business confidence is anticipated to support job creation.

agnews:train:49290.orig: SpaceShipOne has made Space History Brian Binnie (top left in image), grabbed previous Pilot #39;s Mike Melvill #39;s torch and flew the second leg of the X Prize competition in Burt Rutan #39;s SpaceShipOne.
agnews:train:49290.para: Brian Binnie, positioned to the top left in the image, has taken over from Mike Melvill and successfully completed the second part of the X Prize challenge as the pilot of Burt Rutan's SpaceShipOne.

agnews:train:49336.orig: Pope #39;s wish list startles The Pope, looking tired and speaking with difficulty, has ploughed into fresh controversy with two startling new beatifications. Among the five people he set on the road to canonisation
agnews:train:49336.para: The Pope, appearing fatigued and struggling to speak, has stirred new controversy by announcing two unexpected beatifications, adding to the five individuals he has placed on the path to sainthood.

agnews:train:49355.orig: Feds probe J amp;J Procrit sales BOSTON (CBS.MW) -- Federal investigators have asked Johnson  amp; Johnson to turn over documents related to the sales and marketing of its anti-anemia product Procrit.
agnews:train:49355.para: Federal authorities are seeking documents from Johnson & Johnson concerning the sales and marketing practices of their anti-anemia drug, Procrit.

agnews:train:49376.orig: France Calls Crisis Talks Over Iraq Hostages Farce French Prime Minister Jean-Pierre Raffarin called a ministerial crisis meeting on two French journalists held hostage in Iraq on Monday as efforts to secure their release threatened to turn into a fiasco.
agnews:train:49376.para: French Prime Minister Jean-Pierre Raffarin convened an emergency cabinet meeting on Monday regarding the two French journalists who are being held captive in Iraq. The situation to rescue them is at risk of becoming a dismal failure.

agnews:train:49394.orig: Turkey Rejects Special Conditions for EU Bid  ANKARA/BRUSSELS (Reuters) - Turkey signaled growing unease  on Monday that the European Union wants to impose special  conditions on its drive to join the wealthy bloc and insisted  it must be treated in the same way as any other candidate  country.
agnews:train:49394.para: Turkey Expresses Concern Over EU's Special Conditions for Membership  ANKARA/BRUSSELS (Reuters) - On Monday, Turkey indicated increasing discomfort with the European Union's proposal to apply special conditions to its bid for EU membership. The country stressed that it should be treated equally to any other candidate nation.

agnews:train:49512.orig: Top nuclear official briefs Majlis committee TEHRAN (IRNA) -- Iran #39;s top nuclear official went to parliament Monday to brief its National Security and Foreign Policy Committee on the process of work on the country #39;s peaceful nuclear program.
agnews:train:49512.para: Iran's leading nuclear official appeared before the National Security and Foreign Policy Committee of the Majlis on Monday to provide an update on the progress of the nation's nuclear program for peaceful purposes.

agnews:train:49561.orig: Lockheed Martin Wins Big US Postal Service Contract Bethesda-based Lockheed Martin has been chosen by the US Postal Service to provide managed network services in a potential \$6 billion deal.
agnews:train:49561.para:
Lockheed Martin Secures Major US Postal Service Agreement
The US Postal Service has selected Bethesda-based Lockheed Martin to offer managed network services in what could be a $6 billion contract.

agnews:train:49584.orig: Packers trade Mike McKenzie to Saints Defensive back Mike McKenzie of Green Bay was traded Monday to the New Orleans Saints. The Saints gave up a second-round pick in 2005 and third-string quarterback JT O #39;Sullivan for McKenzie and a future draft choice.
agnews:train:49584.para: On Monday, Mike McKenzie, the defensive back from the Green Bay Packers, was traded to the New Orleans Saints. In exchange, the Saints provided a 2005 second-round draft pick and third-string quarterback JT O'Sullivan, along with another future draft choice.

agnews:train:49589.orig: Consensus eludes key issues at IMF-WB meet Save for the promise of a new plan by the year-end to resolve the long-pending issue of debt relief to poor countries, the International Monetary Fund-World Bank annual meetings have ended without any consensus on critical issues.
agnews:train:49589.para: At the IMF-World Bank annual meetings, agreement was not reached on crucial issues, with the exception of a commitment to introduce a new plan by year-end to address the ongoing debt relief needs of impoverished nations.

agnews:train:49700.orig: Clippers exercise option on Wilcox Los Angeles, CA (Sports Network) - The Los Angeles Clippers Monday exercised the contract option for the 2005-06 season on forward Chris Wilcox.
agnews:train:49700.para: The Los Angeles Clippers opted to retain forward Chris Wilcox for the 2005-06 season, as they exercised his contract option on Monday.

agnews:train:49839.orig: AMD Warns of Lower Sales (Reuters) Reuters - Semiconductor maker Advanced\Micro Devices Inc.  warned on Monday that its quarterly\revenue will be lower than forecast, citing softness in sales\of its memory chips used in cell phones and other devices. The\company's shares fell after the warning.
agnews:train:49839.para: Advanced Micro Devices Inc., a semiconductor manufacturer, issued a warning on Monday, stating that its quarterly revenue will fall short of expectations. This is due to a decline in the sales of its memory chips, which are used in cell phones and other devices. As a result of this warning, the company's stock price dropped.

agnews:train:49930.orig: Fernandez Racing Post-Race Notes: Toyota Indy 400 Adrian Fernandez scored his third career IRL IndyCar Series win this afternoon, claiming victory in the Toyota Indy 400 at California Speedway.
agnews:train:49930.para: Fernandez Racing's Post-Race Observations: Adrian Fernandez secured his third IRL IndyCar Series triumph today, winning the Toyota Indy 400 at California Speedway.

agnews:train:49935.orig: Fears for rhino as hunters are allowed to kill again Big game hunters can return to Africa to shoot the black rhino after a 20-year worldwide ban on trade in the animals was lifted yesterday.
agnews:train:49935.para: Rhino conservation concerns arise as hunting permits are reinstated Following a 20-year global ban, it has been lifted today, allowing big game hunters to once again travel to Africa to hunt black rhinos.

agnews:train:50033.orig: Arabs tell Israel  #39;stop incursion into Gaza #39; Arab nations demanded in a draft UN Security Council resolution yesterday that Israel immediately halt its incursion into the northern Gaza Strip, where fighting has left at least 65 Palestinians dead.
agnews:train:50033.para: Arabs urged Israel to cease its Gaza operation in a UN Security Council draft resolution released yesterday, calling for an immediate halt to the incursion in the northern Gaza Strip, where clashes have resulted in at least 65 Palestinian fatalities.

agnews:train:50041.orig: Genentech Receives US Subpoena in Rituxan Marketing Probe Genentech Inc., the world #39;s second- biggest biotechnology company, received a subpoena from the US Attorney #39;s office in Philadelphia as part of a criminal and civil investigation into marketing of its top-selling drug, Rituxan.
agnews:train:50041.para: Genentech Inc., the globe's second-largest biotechnology firm, has been served with a subpoena by the Philadelphia U.S. Attorney's office as part of an ongoing criminal and civil inquiry into the marketing practices of its flagship product, Rituxan.

agnews:train:50060.orig: SpaceShipOne shows what initiative, daring and great personal <b>...</b> The terms were simple enough. Be the first to fly three people or the equivalent weight 62 miles high. Do it a second time within two weeks.
agnews:train:50060.para: SpaceShipOne demonstrated the power of initiative, boldness, and individual effort. The requirements were straightforward: be the first to carry three people or an equivalent weight of 62 miles into space. And then repeat the feat within two weeks.

agnews:train:50070.orig: Dowie relieved by victory Boss Iain Dowie admitted his relief after Crystal Palace grabbed their first Premiership win of the season. Dowie also singled out Andy Johnson for special praise after the striker scored to set Palace on their way to a 2-0 win over London rivals Fulham.
agnews:train:50070.para:
Dowie Expresses Relief Following Crystal Palace's Premier League Triumph
Boss Iain Dowie felt relieved after Crystal Palace secured their initial Premier League victory of the season. He also highlighted Andy Johnson's performance, praising the striker for his goal that helped Palace defeat London rivals Fulham 2-0.

agnews:train:50079.orig: Chiefs Beat Ravens 27-24, End Winlessness BALTIMORE - Winless no more, the Kansas City Chiefs rendered the Baltimore Ravens defenseless with an almost unimaginable display of ball control and patience.    Priest Holmes ran for 133 yards and two touchdowns, and the Chiefs wore down the highly touted Baltimore defense in a 27-24 victory Monday night...
agnews:train:50079.para: The Kansas City Chiefs Defeated the Baltimore Ravens 27-24, Eradicating Their Losing Streak IN BALTIMORE - The Chiefs ended their winless streak with a remarkable performance, overwhelming the Baltimore Ravens' defense through exceptional ball handling and strategic patience. agnews:train:54684.para: The US Government Has Initiated Its First Legal Action Against Internet  "Spyware" A New Hampshire Resident Is Now Facing Lawsuits For Unauthorized Software That Takes Over A User's Computer Without Consent.

agnews:train:54699.para: Sports: F-One Qualifying Delayed in Suzuka, Japan - The qualifying session for this weekend's Japanese Grand Prix, part of the Formula One circuit, has been rescheduled due to an expected typhoon.

agnews:train:54890.orig: Space racers set sights on orbital frontier It might sound like a space-age case of sour grapes, but Rod and Randa Milliron say they #39;re glad they don #39;t have to think about the \$10 million Ansari X Prize anymore.
agnews:train:54890.para: Space enthusiasts are focused on the orbital frontier, and Rod and Randa Milliron express gratitude that they no longer need to consider the \$10 million Ansari X Prize.

agnews:train:54893.para: Journalist Roundup: Was It Intentional Deception? European newspapers addressed the Iraq Survey Group's announcement that Iraq lacked weapons of mass destruction and also talked about Elfriede Jelinek's receipt of the Nobel Prize in Literature.

agnews:train:54965.orig: Furcal Shrugs Off Distractions in Playoffs (AP) AP - Rafael Furcal will spend three weeks in a cramped, windowless jail filled with about 70 inmates when the postseason ends for the Atlanta Braves.
agnews:train:54965.para: Rafael Furcal will spend three weeks in a crowded, windowless jail with around 70 other inmates once the playoffs conclude for the Atlanta Braves.

agnews:train:55105.orig: BALCO Defendants Want Steroid Case Dropped Defendants at the center of the BALCO steroid scandal asked a court to drop charges against them Friday, claiming misconduct by prosecutors in a case which has tarnished several top sporting names.
agnews:train:55105.para: The BALCO defendants sought to have their steroid-related charges dismissed on Friday, alleging misconduct by prosecutors in a case that has sullied the reputations of prominent athletes.

agnews:train:55141.para: A report highlights that U.S. oil firms profited from the sale of Iraqi oil through the U.N. oil-for-food program, acquiring advantageous vouchers that allowed them to purchase the oil.

agnews:train:55308.orig: Cambodian leader to beg king to stay on throne Cambodia #39;s national assembly president left for China on Saturday to beg King Norodom Sihanouk to change his mind about abdicating, but left open the option of a new monarch being appointed.
agnews:train:55308.para: The Cambodian national assembly president traveled to China on Saturday to plead with King Norodom Sihanouk to reconsider his decision to abdicate. However, the possibility of appointing a new monarch remains on the table.

agnews:train:55309.orig: 65 passengers wounded as a plane skids off Bangladesh airport: World News: Dhaka, Oct 8 (ANI)- A passenger plane of Biman Bangladesh Airlines skidded off the runway at northeastern Sylhet Osmani International Airport on Friday, leaving most of its 79 passengers on board wounded, according to officials.
agnews:train:55309.para: On Friday, at Sylhet Osmani International Airport in northeastern Bangladesh, a Biman Bangladesh Airlines passenger plane veered off the runway, resulting in injuries to 65 of the 79 passengers onboard, as reported by authorities.

agnews:train:55369.orig: Center stage:  #39;A great moment for the Pac-10 #39; Los Angeles -- Cal wide receiver Chase Lyman was pondering today #39;s showdown with USC at the Memorial Coliseum. He gazed off for a moment, briefly lost in his own thoughts.
agnews:train:55369.para: Center stage: 'A momentous occasion for the Pac-10' — In Los Angeles, Cal wide receiver Chase Lyman was reflecting on today’s match-up against USC at the Memorial Coliseum. For a brief instant, he drifted into his own thoughts, lost in contemplation.

agnews:train:55383.orig: S P 500 Companies to Show Growth  CHICAGO (Reuters) - Third-quarter earnings get under way in  earnest next week -- led by several large banks, as well as  technology companies Intel Corp. <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=INTC.O target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">INTC.O</A> and Yahoo Inc.  <A HREF="http://www.investor.reuters.com/FullQuote.aspx?ticker=YHOO.O target=/stocks/quickinfo/fullquote">YHOO.O</A> -- with many expected to post double-digit growth.
agnews:train:55383.para: Next week marks the beginning of third-quarter earnings for S&P 500 companies, with several major banks and tech giants like Intel Corp. (INTC.O) and Yahoo Inc. (YHOO.O) at the forefront. Many are anticipated to report double-digit growth.

agnews:train:55388.orig: Suu Kyi Proves Tricky Topic for Asia-Europe Summit  HANOI (Reuters) - Leaders from Asia and Europe pledged on  Saturday to tackle everything from climate change to terrorism  but dodged calling for the release of Myanmar democracy icon  Aung San Suu Kyi at the end of their two-day summit.
agnews:train:55388.para: At the conclusion of their two-day summit, leaders from Asia and Europe committed to addressing issues like climate change and terrorism, yet they avoided calling for the release of Myanmar's democracy leader, Aung San Suu Kyi.

agnews:train:55776.orig: Cambodia to ask donors for \$2bn One of the world's poorest countries, Cambodia, is set to ask for almost \$2bn in aid over the next three years.
agnews:train:55776.para: Cambodia, one of the poorest nations globally, plans to request approximately $2 billion in assistance over the next three years.

agnews:train:55956.orig: McBride helps US knock off El Salvador SAN SALVADOR -- Thanks to Brian McBride and Eddie Johnson, the United States can advance to the final round of qualifying for the 2006 World Cup with a victory over Panama Wednesday.
agnews:train:55956.para: Thanks to goals from Brian McBride and Eddie Johnson, the United States secured a win against El Salvador, allowing them to progress to the final stage of qualifying for the 2006 World Cup, with their next match against Panama on Wednesday.

agnews:train:55962.orig: Suicide Bomber Kills 17 Near Baghdad Police Academy  BAGHDAD (Reuters) - A suicide car bomb killed 17 people  near Baghdad's Oil Ministry and a nearby police academy Sunday,  a ministry spokesman said.
agnews:train:55962.para: A Suicide Vehicle Blast Results in 17 Deaths Near Baghdad Police Academy - BAGHDAD (Reuters) - A suicide car bomb explosion caused the deaths of 17 individuals in an area close to Baghdad's Oil Ministry and a nearby police academy on Sunday, according to a ministry spokesperson.

agnews:train:56000.orig: Somali MPs Vote for President in Peace Bid (Reuters) Reuters - Somali lawmakers began voting on Sunday\for a president in the 14th attempt in a decade to return\government to the lawless Horn of Africa state.
agnews:train:56000.para: Somali Legislators Initiate Presidential Election in Quest for Peace (Reuters) Reuters - On Sunday, Somali lawmakers commenced their voting for a president, marking the 14th effort in a decade to restore governance to the lawless Horn of Africa nation.

agnews:train:56027.para: When naming their businesses, many founders opt for personal choices. In seeking names for their new ventures or products, entrepreneurs frequently turn to their own names. This approach can be successful, as evidenced by the achievements of companies like Ben & Jerry's and Dell.

agnews:train:56090.orig: 2 UN peacekeepers wounded in Haiti shootouts PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti - Two UN peacekeepers were wounded in shootouts with supporters of ousted President Jean-Bertrand Aristide in Port-au-Prince and civilians believed to be Aristide opponents in flood-ravaged Gonaives - the first casualties of the

agnews:train:56184.orig: New Backup Voting System May Pose Problems (AP) AP - Call it the law of unintended consequences. A new national backup system meant to ensure that millions of eligible voters are not mistakenly turned away from the polls this year, as happened in 2000, could wind up causing Election Day problems as infamous as Florida's hanging chads.
agnews:train:56184.para: The New Backup Voting System Might Trigger Issues (AP) AP - Consider it the principle of unforeseen outcomes. This newly implemented nationwide backup system, designed to prevent millions of eligible voters from being wrongly barred from the polls this year, like what occurred in 2000, could end up creating Election Day dilemmas just as notorious as Florida's hanging chads.

agnews:train:56233.orig: Iran, Russia Nearing Nuclear Fuel Deal Russian Foreign Minister, Sergey Lavrov, left, listens to a question during a joint press conference with his Iranian counterpart, Kamal Kharrazi, right, in Tehran, Iran, Sunday, Oct. 10, 2004.
agnews:train:56233.para: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, along with his Iranian counterpart Kamal Kharrazi, held a joint press conference in Tehran on October 10, 2004, where Lavrov addressed questions from the media, indicating that Iran and Russia are close to reaching an agreement on nuclear fuel.

agnews:train:56300.orig: Google SMS is good for the Company and the Users I have tested Google search on WAP and it works fine. But considering Google has around 4.2 Billion pages (as per their homepage), finding information on a mobile phone is not fun.
agnews:train:56300.para: Google's SMS service benefits both the company and its users, as I've found the mobile search to function well. However, given that Google indexes approximately 4.2 billion pages, searching for information on a mobile device can be quite challenging.

agnews:train:56442.para: Broncos 20, Panthers 17: As Julius Peppers looked up, he saw a gap of 104 yards of Denver sky between him and the end zone.

agnews:train:56463.orig: San Francisco 49ers SAN FRANCISCO (Ticker) -- Tim Rattay authored a much-needed fourth quarter comeback for the San Francisco 49ers. Rattay accounted for 16 points in the last 4:36 of regulation, and directed a drive that led

agnews:train:56468.orig: Mount St. Helens Shoots Out More Steam (AP) AP - Mount St. Helens vented a new column of steam Sunday, a lazy plume that rose out of the crater of the snow-dusted volcano.
agnews:train:56468.para: Mount St. Helens Released Additional Steam on Sunday (AP) - On Sunday, Mount St. Helens emitted another plume of steam, which gently rose from the volcano's crater, covered in snow.

agnews:train:56483.orig: The Relentless Patriots Reach a Magic Number The Patriots set the N.F.L.'s unofficial record for consecutive victories at 19 (counting playoff games) with another grind-it-out performance.
agnews:train:56483.para: The Patriots Achieve an Unofficial Record Streak The team extended the N.F.L.'s unrecorded string of consecutive wins to 19 (including playoff games) through another hard-fought victory.

agnews:train:56531.orig: Kenneth Bigley #39;s final TV plea THE Iraqi militants who murdered Kenneth Bigley delivered a final affront to his memory yesterday, when they released a videotape of him appealing to the Prime Minister for help moments before he was decapitated.
agnews:train:56531.para: THE Iraqi extremists who killed Kenneth Bigley showed further disrespect for his memory by releasing a video of him pleading to the Prime Minister for assistance just before he was beheaded.

agnews:train:56572.orig: Nigeria fuel price strike starts A four-day general strike begins against fuel price rises in Nigeria, Africa's biggest oil producer.
agnews:train:56572.para:
Nigeria Launches Four-Day Strike Over Fuel Price Hikes
A four-day nationwide strike has commenced in Nigeria, the largest oil producer in Africa, protesting against increases in fuel prices.

agnews:train:56601.orig: With Precision and Power, Cardinals Stop the Dodgers St. Louis advanced to the N.L. championship series for the third time in five years, beating the Los Angeles Dodgers, 6-2, Sunday night.
agnews:train:56601.para: With precision and power, the Cardinals halted the Dodgers, advancing to the N.L. championship series for the third time in five years with a 6-2 victory on Sunday night.

agnews:train:56705.para: Neumann Secures Victory Neiselotte Neumann claims her first LPGA Tour win in six years, narrowly defeating Grace Park's late push for a three-stroke triumph at the LPGA Asahi Ryokuken International.

agnews:train:56710.orig: Piracy rule is definition of misguided If a shopkeeper tried to charge \$1,000 for a broken computer, you'd probably be outraged. You might even complain to the government.
agnews:train:56710.para: The piracy rule is a clear example of misguided thinking. If a shopkeeper attempted to sell a broken computer for $1,000, you would likely be furious and might even report them to the authorities.

agnews:train:56822.orig: Australia #39;s Gribbles Has Received Expressions Of Interest MELBOURNE (Dow Jones)--Australian diagnostics and pathology provider Gribbles Group Ltd. (GGL.AU) said Monday that it has received expressions of interest regarding ownership of the company.
agnews:train:56822.para: Gribbles Group Ltd., an Australian diagnostics and pathology company based in Melbourne, announced on Monday that it has garnered expressions of interest concerning potential changes in ownership.

agnews:train:56863.para: US troops entered Latifiya this weekend to locate the terrorist group responsible for the deaths of two American contractors and the beheading of British engineer Kenneth Bigley the previous week.

agnews:train:56913.orig: US gov targets spyware outfit A company which makes software that infiltrates users #39; computers and demands \$30 to be removed has been targeted by US authorities.
agnews:train:56913.para: A firm that develops spyware aimed at compromising users' computers and requires a $30 payment for removal is now facing action from US government officials.

agnews:train:56922.orig: Count Delay in Afghan Poll, Candidates Coming Round  KABUL (Reuters) - Afghan officials delayed counting ballots  on Monday to deal with complaints of fraud in a historic  presidential election, but several candidates appeared to be  pulling back from an initial decision to reject the vote.
agnews:train:56922.para:
Afghan Officials Extend Ballot Count Due to Fraud Allegations; Candidates Reconsider Rejection

On Monday, Afghan authorities extended the ballot counting process in the country's significant presidential election to address fraud complaints. Simultaneously, several candidates seemed to be reconsidering their initial stance to invalidate the entire election.

agnews:train:57035.orig: Bush camp in new attack on Kerry The Bush campaign runs a new attack ad against John Kerry, saying he fails to understand the war on terror.
agnews:train:57035.para: The Bush campaign releases a fresh advertisement targeting John Kerry, claiming he lacks comprehension of the war on terror.

agnews:train:57039.para: SunTrust Banks Inc., the seventh-largest US bank, announced that it needs to restate its earnings for the first and second quarters of the year due to an error in calculating loan losses.

agnews:train:57056.para: Microsoft is once again focusing on the TV market with Windows XP Media Center, a pursuit that has long eluded the company. Previous attempts included selling WebTV and developing software for TVs and cable boxes.

agnews:train:57085.orig: SportsNetwork Game Preview (Sports Network) - The Houston Astros have never won a playoff series in franchise history. Winners of 13 straight division titles, the Atlanta Braves are also hoping to break a Division Series jinx.
agnews:train:57085.para: SportsNetwork Game Preview (Sports Network) - The Houston Astros have yet to secure a playoff series victory in their team's history. Despite winning 13 consecutive division titles, the Atlanta Braves are also aiming to overcome their Division Series curse.

agnews:train:57135.para: Parker Hannifin, a manufacturer of motion-control systems, announced on Monday that it has finalized its purchase of Sporlan Valve Co., a company specializing in refrigeration and air conditioning components.

agnews:train:57170.para: Boeing: CEO Clarifies Pact Stance Boeing's top executive stated on Monday that his advocacy for the U.S. to terminate the aircraft development funding agreement with Europe was not motivated by seeking political backing before the U.S. presidential election.

agnews:train:57283.para: SGI introduces advanced visualization capabilities to its Linux offerings. By incorporating high-end graphics into systems running on an open-source platform, the company aims to expand beyond its traditional proprietary solutions.

agnews:train:57300.orig: Australia #39;s Andre Stoltz Wins First US PGA Event in Las Vegas Andre Stoltz won the Michelin Championship at Las Vegas by one stroke, the first career US PGA Tour victory for the 34-year-old Australian.
agnews:train:57300.para: At 34, Australian golfer Andre Stoltz secured his first US PGA Tour win by one stroke at the Michelin Championship in Las Vegas.

agnews:train:57312.orig: Lockheed to Run Post Office Networks Lockheed Martin Corp. won a contract potentially worth \$3 billion to provide managed network services to the U.S. Postal Service.
agnews:train:57312.para: Lockheed Martin has secured a contract valued at possibly $3 billion to offer managed network services to the U.S. Postal Service.

agnews:train:57449.orig: Ascension Health Awards Computer Sciences 10-Year IT Support <b>...</b> Under the \$1.35 billion deal, CSC will provide help-desk, network, security, and telecommunications services at more than 80 Ascension facilities across the country.

agnews:train:57465.orig: 'Laughingstock' Portugal Hopes to Rebound (AP) AP - A headline in a Lisbon newspaper called Portugal's soccer team "Europe's Laughingstock." agnews:train:57465.para: A Lisbon newspaper referred to Portugal's soccer team as "Europe's Laughingstock," and Italy, France, and the Netherlands faced harsh criticism following disappointing performances in recent World Cup qualifier matches.

agnews:train:57526.orig: Kidnappers #39; double-headed strategy in Iraq The city of Liverpool spent the weekend in mourning for one of its residents, Mr Ken Bigley, the British hostage who was beheaded in Iraq.
agnews:train:57526.para: In Iraq, kidnappers employed a dual approach, resulting in the beheading of Mr. Ken Bigley, a resident of Liverpool, who was mourned over the weekend.

agnews:train:57617.para: MINISTERS WERE TOLD LAST NIGHT THAT THE UK CANNOT DELAY ANY LONGER FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO MAKE RADICAL DECISIONS TO ADDRESS THE GROWING PENSIONS CRISIS.

agnews:train:57723.orig: Nikkei Falls on Higher Oil Price  TOKYO (Reuters) - The Nikkei average fell 1 percent by  midsession on Tuesday as auto makers declined following a rise  in crude oil to another record high, and as the yen's rise  against the dollar stoked concern over exporters' earnings.

agnews:train:57861.orig: No relief seen as Michigan gas prices top \$2 a gallon The average price of gasoline topped \$2 a gallon in Michigan this week, and experts say they do not see any relief in sight. The price of self-serve regular gasoline rose an average

agnews:train:57894.para: On October 12, oil futures prices reached a new peak on Monday due to a strike starting in Africa's biggest crude exporter, intensifying global supply worries amid robust demand and diminished stockpiles.

agnews:train:57909.para: FOOTBALL: FREDDY SHEPHERD DEFENDS NEWCASTLE OVER WOODGATE'S INJURIES NEWCASTLE's chairman, Freddy Shepherd, has responded to criticism from Real Madrid regarding Jonathan Woodgate's persistent injuries, stating: "We have no reason to feel embarrassed."

agnews:train:58054.orig: Megawati Loses Out The outgoing Indonesian President's unwillingness to accept defeat has held up a peaceful transition
agnews:train:58054.para: The outgoing Indonesian president's refusal to acknowledge her loss is hindering a smooth handover of power.

agnews:train:58099.orig: School Ups Grade by Going Online A program called HIPSchools lets parents track assignments and communicate with teachers online. For a Brooklyn middle school with a failing grade from the state, the system has meant a dramatic turnaround. By Cyrus Farivar.
agnews:train:58099.para:
A Program Transforms School with Online Tools
HIPSchools, a program that enables parents to monitor assignments and connect with teachers via the internet, has led to a remarkable improvement for a Brooklyn middle school previously rated as failing. By Cyrus Farivar.

agnews:train:58166.para:

agnews:train:58270.orig: LG.Philips: This Side Up The joint venture between Korea #39;s LG Electronics and the Netherlands #39; Philips (NYSE: PHG) reported an increase in year-on-year sales for its fiscal third quarter (up 12).

agnews:train:58301.para: The clock on global warming is "speeding up," as rising levels of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere have raised alarms about the planet's ability to handle greenhouse gas emissions. agnews:train:58342.para: No more matches in Bangalore, please. Did India make a mistake by hosting the Test series opener there? There are strong indications that they did, one of which is our loss by 217 runs.

agnews:train:58460.orig: Fannie Mae Discloses Document Request The mortgage giant said today that prosecutors had asked the company to preserve documents as part of an investigation into Fannie Mae's accounting practices.
agnews:train:58460.para: Fannie Mae Reports Document Request The housing giant announced today that investigators have requested the company retain documents as part of an inquiry into Fannie Mae's financial record-keeping methods.

agnews:train:58461.orig: Stanley Furniture Gets Comfortable The wood furniture maker uses a niche strategy to work around industry problems.
agnews:train:58461.para: Stanley Furniture Finds Its Niche Approach The company, which specializes in wood furniture, employs a targeted strategy to navigate through industry challenges.

agnews:train:58550.orig: France May Allow Jamming of Mobile Phones PARIS (AP) -- Watch a movie or make a mobile phone call. Soon, in France, you might not be able to do both at once...
agnews:train:58550.para: France Could Prohibit Mobile Phone Use During Movies PARIS (AP) -- In France, you might soon have to choose between watching a movie and making a mobile phone call.

agnews:train:58564.para: IBM Introduces Advanced Storage Solutions The newly launched IBM DS6000 and DS8000 storage systems feature a highly scalable storage option alongside an ultra-dense storage solution that is compatible with both.

agnews:train:58565.para: According to sources, the newest iteration of Apple's classic iPod will feature photo viewing capabilities and is set to launch within the next 30 to 60 days at a price of $499.

agnews:train:58695.orig: US court refuses piracy appeal THE US Supreme Court has rejected an appeal by the recording industry seeking to force internet service providers to turn over the names of subscribers suspected of music piracy.
agnews:train:58695.para: THE US Supreme Court has declined to enforce the recording industry's request to have internet service providers disclose the identities of users allegedly involved in music piracy.

agnews:test:5.orig: Open Letter Against British Copyright Indoctrination in Schools The British Department for Education and Skills (DfES) recently launched a "Music Manifesto" campaign, with the ostensible intention of educating the next generation of British musicians. Unfortunately, they also teamed up with the music industry (EMI, and various artists) to make this popular. EMI has apparently negotiated their end well, so that children in our schools will now be indoctrinated about the illegality of downloading music.The ignorance and audacity of this got to me a little, so I wrote an open letter to the DfES about it. Unfortunately, it's pedantic, as I suppose you have to be when writing to goverment representatives. But I hope you find it useful, and perhaps feel inspired to do something similar, if or when the same thing has happened in your area.
agnews:test:5.para:
Open Letter on British Copyright Education in Schools

The British Department for Education and Skills (DfES) recently initiated a "Music Manifesto" program, ostensibly to educate future British musicians. However, they partnered with the music industry (including EMI and various artists) to promote this initiative, which has led to a concerning outcome. EMI has secured favorable terms, resulting in schoolchildren now being taught about the illegality of downloading music. This approach struck me as both ignorant and audacious, prompting me to write an open letter to the DfES. While the letter is somewhat pedantic, given the nature of government correspondence, I hope it proves useful and inspires you to take similar action if a similar situation arises in your region.

agnews:test:177.para: Olympics: Leontien Zijlaard-van Moorsel, a Dutch cycling legend, won her Olympic time trial gold medal with great emotion.

agnews:test:181.para: In the 2005 season, Real Salt Lake and Club Deportivo Chivas USA, the two new expansion teams of Major League Soccer, will be part of the Western Conference.

agnews:test:201.para: According to a NetRatings Inc. survey conducted on August 18, 2004, more than half of US home Internet users now access the web via broadband connections.

agnews:test:209.para: As of Tuesday, wildfires have consumed more than 5 million acres in Alaska, surpassing a previous record, according to forestry officials. This new high points to potential shifts in climate conditions and the makeup of the extensive forested areas.

agnews:test:220.para: Olympic Daily Forecast - Thursday, August 19, Athens, Greece (Sports Network) - Paul Hamm brought home the gold for the U.S. in the men's all-around gymnastics event on Wednesday. Could the United States achieve a clean sweep on Thursday?

agnews:test:225.para: This holiday shopping period continues to show slow sales, as U.S. consumers remain cautious with their spending, according to indices released on Tuesday during the season's second week.

agnews:test:233.orig: NetApp CEO: No Storage Spending Shortfall (TechWeb) TechWeb - Customers are decoupling storage from server purchases, which explains why EMC and NetApp earnings were up and why Sun and HP were flat or down, Warmenhoven says.
agnews:test:233.para: NetApp's CEO notes that customers are separating storage purchases from server buys, which is why EMC and NetApp reported earnings increases, while Sun and HP saw stagnant or declining results, according to Warmenhoven.

agnews:test:234.para: Justices Will Hear Case on Direct Mail Wine Shipments Ray and Eleanor Heald, who enjoy critiquing wine, have grown disillusioned with their freelance role. This is due to Michigan's prohibition on direct wine shipments from other states.

agnews:test:236.para: Oil prices reach a new peak of over $47 per barrel WASHINGTON — Oil costs jumped to a fresh record above $47 a barrel yesterday, driven by worries over Iraq's instability, uncertainties surrounding the future of Russian energy giant Yukos, and the globe's limited spare production capacity.

agnews:test:239.orig: After Wait, Google Set for Market Debut  NEW YORK (Reuters) - Shares of Google Inc. will make their  Nasdaq stock market debut on Thursday after the year's most  anticipated initial public offering priced far below initial  estimates, raising \$1.67 billion.

agnews:test:244.para: Qantas, Australia's leading airline, has announced a new record annual net profit, yet it cautions that rising oil prices could impact its future performance, potentially leading to higher surcharges on tickets to cover increased fuel costs.

agnews:test:269.para: Ran Carthon, son of Maurice, initially steered clear of football following the pain it caused his father. However, influenced by family ties, friends, and the realities of life, he ultimately decided to change his mind.

agnews:test:347.para: Jerkens ultimately made the correct decision regarding Society Selection's entry in Saturday's Grade 1 Alabama at Saratoga, despite his hesitation earlier in the week.
