yelp:train:23311.para:
I believed Fry's stayed open a bit later on Fridays—until 11pm or midnight, I thought. But it was actually closing at 10pm. My friend and I arrived with our lists, confident in what we needed. There were no closing announcements, and we headed to the self-checkout. To be clear, I dislike self-checkouts as I believe they reduce jobs, but that’s just my opinion.

When we got to the self-checkout, the single open cashier had a long line, so I chose to use the self-checkout instead.

I finished my items, and my friend started scanning hers when the machine suddenly stopped working. The cashier said, "Oh, were you planning to buy that? I thought you were done. I turned off the registers." She then complained about the hassle of turning them back on. Really? It’s just a matter of turning the key. Unless she needs to call a manager, which I’m not sure about their procedure.

I kept thinking, "She’s just going to leave with it."

Instead, my friend replied, "Since it’s such a bother for you to turn the registers back on, I’ll go to another store. There are plenty of others that are still open."

yelp:train:23498.orig: The salad was excellent.  The bread and butter was incredible.  I thoroughly enjoyed the main entree of fettucini Alfredo.  It was obviously made from scratch and tasted so good!  Dont let the location fool you. What a great find.
yelp:train:23498.para: The salad was outstanding, and the bread and butter was truly remarkable. I really savored the main course of fettucini Alfredo, which was clearly prepared from scratch and was simply delicious. Don't be misled by the location; it's a fantastic discovery.

yelp:train:23517.orig: The chips and salsa are fantastic...that's what keeps bringing us back.  This is my one year olds favorite restaurant as she loves the salsa.  The food is pretty good...I have to admit it's not the best Mexican food I've ever had, but it's always consistently good.
yelp:train:23517.para: The chips and salsa are outstanding, which is why we keep returning. This place is a hit with my one-year-old, who adores the salsa. The food is decent; I should mention it’s not the finest Mexican cuisine I’ve tasted, but it’s reliably good.

yelp:train:23660.orig:
We are pretty much regulars at Brennans now. It is a reliable place to watch the game with cheap drinks. There is a great view of the TV from almost every spot.

The bartenders are AWESOME. They are quick,  friendly, and really seem to care about providing good service. 

The servers are good too. Very sweet and take care of their regulars. There is confusion among them sometimes about who is helping our table but it is usually resolved quickly and they are apologetic.

The food that is good is very good, the food that is bad is pretty bad. Luckily, the number of items on the menu that is good outnumbers the bad. Here is a rundown on the good stuff- the Irish Nachos, Mexican pizza, cheese curds, potato skins, wings, enchiladas. All pretty good. Oh, and salsa too. It's freshly made and very zippy!

I would stay away from the zucchini and mozzarella sticks. Both are too greasy and lacking in flavor. The mozzarella stick is ginormous, which seems appealing at first but it is just too much cheese and too little breading. 

I wish they had more food specials because the appetizers will set you back 7-10 bucks a plate. But the portions are huge. They do have an amazing mexican
yelp:train:23660.para:
We frequent Brennans quite often. It's a dependable spot for watching games with affordable drinks, and the TVs offer a fantastic view from almost anywhere.

The bartenders are outstanding. They are prompt, friendly, and genuinely care about delivering excellent service.

The servers are also quite good. They are very kind and attentive to regulars, though there can be some confusion about who is serving our table, but it's usually sorted out quickly and they are apologetic.

The food is hit-or-miss. The good dishes are really good, while the bad ones are pretty disappointing. Fortunately, there are more tasty options than not. Here are some of the best: Irish Nachos, Mexican pizza, cheese curds, potato skins, wings, enchiladas, and of course, the salsa, which is freshly made and quite zesty!

Avoid the zucchini and mozzarella sticks. They are overly greasy and lack flavor. The mozzarella sticks are enormous, which sounds appealing, but there's too much cheese and not enough breading.

I wish they offered more food specials since the appetizers can be pricey at 7-10 bucks a plate, but the portions are generous. They do have some amazing Mexican options.

yelp:train:23916.orig: My 3 children and I had the pleasure of taking this tour with Tim and a great Aussie family.\nThis otherwise long 4 hour ride was fun and entertaining. Tim kept us interested by providing us with tons of facts about AZ and joking with us the whole way.  We stopped for lunch at the Indian Reservation and did some light shopping.  The Grand Canyon was spectacular and Tim was so accommodating taking our pictures along the way.  \nTim was the highlight of the trip.  He provided the visiting Australian family with tips on visiting Sedona and showed us some great things along the way.  He had a supply of water he kept encouraging us to drink. My daughter left our camera in the car and he graciously returned it that very night.  Thanks Tim and SouthWest for providing us with a great experience.
yelp:train:23916.para: My family and I enjoyed a delightful tour with Tim and another Australian family. Despite the lengthy 4-hour journey, it was filled with乐趣和娱乐。Tim 不断地向我们介绍亚利桑那州的知识，并与我们开玩笑，使整个旅程充满乐趣。我们在印第安保留地停下来吃午餐，并进行了些轻松的购物。大峡谷的壮观景象令人叹为观止，Tim 还为我们沿途拍照。Tim 是这次旅行的亮点，他不仅为我们提供了游览塞多纳的建议，还沿途展示了许多精彩的地方。他一直鼓励我们喝水，并且在我们把相机忘在车里后，当晚就归还了。感谢Tim和SouthWest为我们提供了如此美好的体验。

yelp:train:24388.orig: Had Carolina's for lunch yesterday.  Just happened to be downtown with some clients I am consulting for.  Got the beef enchilada combo.  The food was great as always.  I usually go for the burros, although I rarely get through a foot long (who could?).\n\nMy colleagues got cheese enchiladas and chicken tacos.  Everyone was very happy with the food, and we all left stuffed.  They even paid!  The only thing better then lunch at Carolina's is a free lunch at Carolina's.
yelp:train:24388.para:
Yesterday, I dropped by Carolina's for lunch while I was in downtown for a client consultation. I opted for the beef enchilada combo, and as expected, the food was delicious. I typically prefer the burritos, but even those are hard to finish (who can resist?). 

My colleagues ordered cheese enchiladas and chicken tacos. We were all very satisfied with our meals and left feeling quite full. And to top it off, they even covered the bill! There's nothing quite like a free lunch at Carolina's.

yelp:train:25580.orig:
I describe Ranch Market as the Disneyland of Supermarkets. 

Seriously, this is not the place to shop too late at night or you'll never get to sleep from all the excitement you just experienced!  The music is loud, the lights bright and festive, and the smell of the food makes your mouth salivate.

I mainly shop here for three things:
1) I always buy my nieces birthday cakes there.  The price is fantastic for a customized cake for kids.  The selection is incredible!
2) If you are familiar with the Mexican baked goods - this place is a one stop shop!  For for a nice change from traditional french bread, try a ""bolillo"" (a Mexican roll).
3)  Rotisserie Chicken.  

But ....just so you know...the produce is great and less costly than Frys.

Two warnings .  First it's difficult to get in and out of the Ranch Market on S. Central on the weekends -- it's VERY VERY CROWDED!  Second, this is an ""ethnic"" experience.   My husband, a ""gringo,"" has, on occasion, encountered some language barrier challenges, but has always been successful in navigating it. - so don't let it stop you!

The Ranch Market is always on the tour for out-of-town-guests who visit us from the Eas
yelp:train:25580.para:
I liken Ranch Market to a supermarket version of Disneyland. If you visit after dark, you might find it hard to sleep due to the excitement. The music is loud, the lights are bright and festive, and the aroma of the food is irresistible.

My primary reasons for shopping there are:
1) I purchase my nieces' birthday cakes there. They offer fantastic prices for custom kids' cakes, and the variety is amazing.
2) It's the perfect place for Mexican baked goods. Try a "bolillo," a Mexican roll, for a change from regular French bread.
3) Their rotisserie chicken is top-notch.

Additionally, the produce is excellent and cheaper than Fry's.

Be aware that on weekends, getting in and out of Ranch Market on S. Central can be challenging due to heavy crowds. It's also an "ethnic" experience, which might pose a language barrier for non-native speakers, but my husband, a "gringo," has always managed to navigate it successfully. So, don't let that deter you.

Ranch Market is a must-visit for out-of-town guests staying with us from the East.

yelp:train:25621.para:

yelp:train:26507.orig:
Yes, I am a fan. It is similar to ""Fresh choice"" in California, but I like the variety and freshness of the dishes. The salad bar is the same, so I won't go into to much detail about that. We like to go on Sundays after church for lunch.

What I do like is there soup bar, 5 to 6 different types of soups are very delicious ranging from (chicken noodle, clam chowder, Irish potato lech, spicy chili bean, minestrone lentil), 

Fresh baked goods are refreshed every hour. Corn bread, blueberry muffins, pizza, french rolls.

They have a stir fry section, which changes daily depending on breakfast lunch or dinner. I personally like the cheesy macaroni. They have Baked potatoes with all the fixing's. 

The usual dessert par includes: fresh fruit, jello, pudding, chocolate/ vanilla soft server.

bonus; on occasion a server will come by with fresh baked chocolate chip cookies.

One thing I noticed though, is even though this place is suppose to be healthy. All you can eat doesn't help from gorging myself.
yelp:train:26507.para:
Certainly. Here is the paraphrased text:

I am a fan, and while it shares some similarities with "Fresh Choice" in California, I appreciate the variety and freshness of the dishes here. The salad bar is consistent, so I won't elaborate on that. We typically visit on Sundays after church for lunch.

What I particularly enjoy is the soup bar, which offers 5 to 6 delicious options, including chicken noodle, clam chowder, Irish potato lech, spicy chili bean, and minestrone lentil.

Fresh baked goods are replenished hourly, featuring items like cornbread, blueberry muffins, pizza, and French rolls.

There's a stir-fry section that varies daily based on whether it's breakfast, lunch, or dinner time. I especially like the cheesy macaroni. They also serve baked potatoes with all the fixings.

The dessert bar includes fresh fruit, jello, pudding, and chocolate or vanilla ice cream.

An added bonus is that servers sometimes bring by fresh-baked chocolate chip cookies.

One thing I've noticed is that even though this place is marketed as healthy, the all-you-can-eat option can lead to overindulgence.

yelp:train:27173.orig:
We were from out of town, and this was the best restaurant we hit all trip. The dining experience starts off with a quick hello to the huge cow outside the restaurant. 4. finally they brought out complimentary cotton candy! it was funny to get, and you can't go wrong with cotton candy. 

just remember..
- Come ear
yelp:train:27173.para:
We were visiting from elsewhere, and this restaurant was the highlight of our trip. The dining experience begins with a quick greeting by the large cow outside. Once inside, after checking in, you're led to a fun slide to enter the downstairs dining area; there are also stairs, but the slide was a blast. The staff is dressed in cowboy outfits, which adds to the ambiance. We secured a great window seat with a fantastic view. Our dinner started off wonderfully:

1. Bread and butter: They served Indian fry bread, which was incredibly delicious, and biscuits that were also tasty. There was regular butter, cinnamon butter, and honey to top them.
2. Salad: It had a generous amount of dressing and was quite good, served family-style.
3. Then, we ordered a variety of dishes. My family and I tried many items; I enjoyed the grilled chicken, which was perfectly barbecued with a fantastic sauce. The corn was also excellent, and everyone was pleased with their meals (ribs, shrimp, etc.). The food was overall outstanding.
4. Finally, they brought out complimentary cotton candy, which was a fun touch, and cotton candy is always a hit.

yelp:train:27403.para:
AVOID THIS PLACE

The service was subpar, though I don't hold the server personally responsible. My boyfriend and I visited a few months ago, and numerous issues arose. It was a weekday, and they were severely understaffed. Our waitress, who was clearly overwhelmed, took about 15 minutes to arrive with our drink orders. When I asked the host to speak to a manager, he responded with an attitude, saying the manager was too busy. The food was just okay, which isn't surprising for an Applebee's.

yelp:train:28077.orig: My DH & I  went for our anniversary last night, 03/27/10. The staff were friendly when we arrived and told us \""Happy Anniversary\"", we received a card, as well. We went with their winter 3 course menu for $35. I got the lettuce wraps, tiger shrimp, and chocolate souffle. My husband got the rock shrimp tempura, salmon, and guava tart. Both of our appetizers were ok, nothing special. The entrees were about the same, nothing special, the shrimp were overcooked, and the salmon had too much sauce on it, you couldn't taste the salmon, the ingredients were good, but the way they prepared both entrees, were not very good. The highlight of the evening were the desserts, they were both good! \n\nWe've been to Roy's before, and we enjoyed our experience, so this was a complete disappointment.  Last year we went to Noca, and the food and experience was much better.
yelp:train:28077.para:
On our anniversary, 3/27/10, my husband and I dined at the restaurant. Upon arrival, the staff greeted us warmly and wished us a "Happy Anniversary," even giving us a card. We opted for the winter 3-course menu for $35. I had lettuce wraps, tiger shrimp, and chocolate soufflé, while my husband chose rock shrimp tempura, salmon, and guava tart. Both appetizers were satisfactory but not exceptional. The main courses were similarly unremarkable; the shrimp were overcooked, and the salmon was overly sauced, masking the flavor of the fish. Despite the quality of the ingredients, the preparation methods left much to be desired. The desserts, however, were the standout part of the evening, both being delicious.

This visit was a letdown compared to our previous experience at Roy's. Last year, we enjoyed our meal at Noca much more, finding both the food and overall experience superior.

yelp:train:28156.orig: I remember the first time going into the Elephant Bar and thinking the has to extensive a menu.  For me that is usually a sign that overall the food is not going to be consisten, just to much  of a variety.  My compliments to the chef, I have never had anything that hasn't been quite good.  That is saying something as I over all over the menu.  My dining companion has looked at what at my entree more than once and said \""you are going to eat that?\""  The ambience of the Elephant Bar is rather nice as well.  Not that you don't see the cutoffs and flip flop crowd but it is some place that one can enjoy dressing a bit for a nicer casual dinner.  \n\nThe only drawback of the Elephant Bar is the service.  As a whole it is usually very good but occasionally you do get a zinger.  To the management's credit, those people usually don't last.
yelp:train:28156.para:
When I first entered the Elephant Bar, I was struck by its extensive menu, which often leads me to believe the food quality might be inconsistent. However, I must commend the chef; everything I've tried has been quite good. This is particularly impressive given the variety of options. My friend has also been surprised by my choices, asking if I was really going to eat what I ordered. The bar's ambiance is quite pleasant, offering a more dressed-up casual dining experience despite the presence of casual attire. 

The only downside is the service, which is generally excellent but occasionally encounters issues. Still, the management deserves praise for swiftly addressing these problems, as problematic staff members tend to leave quickly.

yelp:train:28819.orig: This has gone to the point of absurd.  We have been told we owe a balance of $307 for no insurance.  We have insurance, we have always had insurance.  In the past when our baby has been sick, they have refused to see us because of this past due bill.  My wife has spoken to the billing manager twice who has told us she will run it through our insurance.  My wife has called our insurance company multiple times and has been told that they have NEVER attempted to run this bill through our insurance.  My wife has talked to her human resources department at her work and they have verified that our daughter is on our insurance and always has been.\n\nThe bottom line, our end is taken care of.  There is proof that Mesa Pediatrics has made zero attempt to run this through our insurance though everyone in the billing department says they'll \""do it\"".  The lack of effort from their billing department has just made every experience with trying to see a Doctor a difficult one.  I am sure if we had a 0 balance in their system we would be treated differently but the front desk people who have access to letting us see doctors do not care what our excuses are, they will not make an appointment f
yelp:train:28819.para:
This situation has become absurd. We are expected to pay $307 for a service that should be covered by insurance, despite having insurance all along. In the past, our child's illness was turned away due to this outstanding bill. My wife has spoken to the billing manager twice, who assured us they would process it through our insurance. However, my wife has also contacted our insurance company multiple times and been told they have never attempted to submit this bill. Additionally, my wife has spoken to her workplace’s HR, confirming that our daughter is and has always been covered by our insurance.

In summary, our insurance coverage is clear and complete. Yet, the billing department claims they will "do it," while there is no evidence they have ever tried. The lack of effort from their billing team has made every doctor visit a challenge. If our balance were zero, we would likely be treated more favorably, but the front desk staff, who can schedule appointments, disregard our explanations and refuse to book an appointment.

yelp:train:28948.orig:
Visit #1 Extremely poor service. The waitress was rude and obviously poorly trained. She dropped the food and drinks off at the side of the table, was a bit sassy, frowning, and never came to check on us or ask if we needed anything else. As someone who has worked in the service industry, I know its not that hard to at least pretend you like your job and do things right. My friend's icecream had hair in it, the mocha I got was just an iced coffee, and another friend's sprite was extremely watery. To top it off, the manager wasn't even apologetic and seemed completely unconcerned with our less-than-enjoyable experience. I eat out frequently, and have of course had some crappy servers and food, but this was one of the worst.


Visit #2 Tried it again to see if maybe it was just a bad day for them... Was still really let down. My friend received her pie that had whipped cream in the picture with no whipped cream. Upon asking for some, she was informed that she would be charged $3 for it... She then pointed out that it was on the picture, which the waiter then went on to argue that it was something else. However, he did go off to ask a manager afterwards and bring her some whipped c
yelp:train:28948.para:
Visit #1 was a disappointing experience with very poor service. The waitress seemed untrained and rude, dropping our food and drinks at the edge of the table. She was sassy and frowning, and never checked on us or offered anything else. As someone with experience in the service industry, I know it’s not difficult to put on a good face and do things correctly. My friend’s ice cream contained hair, my mocha was just iced coffee, and another friend’s sprite was abnormally watery. The manager didn’t even apologize and appeared indifferent to our unsatisfactory experience. I dine out often and have had subpar service before, but this was one of the worst.

Visit #2 was another letdown. My friend’s pie, which had whipped cream in the picture, arrived without any whipped cream. When she asked for some, she was told it would cost $3. She pointed out the discrepancy, but the waiter argued it was something else. Eventually, he brought her some whipped cream after consulting a manager.

yelp:train:29218.orig: We had dinner there today. Very poor service. They didn't answer when we pushed the order button. The drive through was out of order. I went into the kitchen to make an order. We probably won't be back. So sad cause we like Sonic.
yelp:train:29218.para: We dined there today and were very disappointed with the service. The order button wasn't working, and the drive-through was down. I had to go inside to place our order. It's likely we won't return. We're really sad because we usually enjoy Sonic.

yelp:train:29699.orig: Salesman was persistent on trying to update my $19 wash to a $99 detail. He was borderline argumentative and aggressive, I would not recommend this place at all. The entire establishment is ran by shady looking people, it's not a good sign when you look at other customers and they all look nervous. The lady waiting next me mentioned how she would just be happy if all her belongings are still in the car when they were done. :(
yelp:train:29699.para: The salesman strongly pushed to upgrade my $19 wash to a $99 detail, coming across as almost argumentative and aggressive. I definitely wouldn't recommend this place. The entire place seems to be run by suspicious individuals; it’s concerning to see other customers looking nervous. The woman waiting next to me expressed only hoping that all her belongings would still be in the car after they were done. :(

yelp:train:29861.orig: As good as it gets for fast food and you can have it however you like. Breakfast is good also.
yelp:train:29861.para: It's fantastic for fast food, and you can get it in any way you prefer. Breakfast options are also great.

yelp:train:30221.orig: You can expect: cold fries , gross or uncarbonated drinks , cold burgers that have been sitting there ect. I usually don't write reviews but with flu , fever , and gross food; I'll be going hungry tonight. \nSave yourself a trip and go to Ellsworth.
yelp:train:30221.para: You might encounter: cold fries, unappetizing drinks, and burgers that have been sitting out for a while. Given my current state of having the flu, a fever, and dealing with such poor food quality, I won't be eating there tonight. Save yourself the trouble and try Ellsworth instead.

yelp:train:30542.orig: I had 3 bad experiences here before and started using another car wash.  In an emergency I had to use this one again as my regular one was closed.  Same result as the past year.  This place does not care about customer service at all.  Ordered the WORKS.  Prep was ridiculous.  Employees were more interested in playing around and getting each other wet than doing the car.  The equipment is old and does not work very well.\nThe people who dry the car were the same.  Not too concerned with doing a decent job, let along a good one.  Had to ask to have the tire dressing done again because they only did part of two tires.  When I got home I looked closely at the car.  Front windshield still had crud on it.  Interior on drivers side was good but passenger side looked as if they never bothered to wipe the door at all.  The back windshield was streaked so bad I had to wipe it clean myself.  There are too many good car washes in the area to bother with this one.
yelp:train:30542.para:
Previously, I had three unsatisfactory experiences here and switched to another car wash. However, when my usual place was closed, I had no choice but to return to this one. The outcome was the same as before. This establishment clearly doesn't prioritize customer service. I ordered the "Works" package, but the preparation was extremely poor. The staff seemed more interested in playing and splashing water on each other rather than washing the car. The equipment is outdated and not very effective.

The drying process was equally subpar. The workers didn't seem to care about doing a thorough job, let alone a good one. I had to ask them to redo the tire dressing on two tires because they only partially completed the task. Upon returning home, I noticed that the front windshield still had residue. The interior on the driver's side was acceptable, but the passenger side looked as if they hadn't even wiped the door. The back windshield was so streaked that I had to clean it myself. Given the quality of car washes available in the area, there's no reason to bother with this one.

yelp:train:30657.orig: Purchased a 60 inch sharp led TV at Tempe marketplace, got it home, and it was cracked. Went back the next day to this store to do an exchange after reading bad best buy reviews all day about them not taking back cracked screens, and they made it very simple and quick here for me. Eased my nerves immediately. They even offered to open the other tv, check it out, and repackage it.
yelp:train:30657.para: I bought a 60-inch Sharp LED TV from the Tempe marketplace and took it home, only to find it cracked. The following day, I returned to the store to exchange it, having read negative reviews about Best Buy not accepting cracked screens. The process was straightforward and swift at this store, which instantly calmed my concerns. They went above and beyond by offering to inspect and repackage the other TV as well.

yelp:train:30682.orig: Took more than 2 hours for front tire changes and a patch. Only reason I came here was because I had a coupon. When I got the bill, it was more than what I was quoted on the phone.  When we went over the bill, they had double charged me for some items.  Be very careful when you go here!!!  Will not go back again.
yelp:train:30682.para: It took over two hours to change the front tire and apply a patch. The sole reason for my visit was a coupon I had. Upon receiving the bill, I found it exceeded the price quoted over the phone. During our review, they charged me twice for certain items. I strongly advise you to be cautious if you decide to go there. I won't be returning.

yelp:train:31714.orig:
I send flowers every week and I wanted to make sure this flower shop could accommodate.  I called the store to speak with the manager and he was out to lunch. I was told by the girl working there that he would call me back when he returned.  He never returned my call. 

A couple days later I sent an email and no response.

If this is what they call customer service,  they are not worth my money.
yelp:train:31714.para:
I deliver flowers weekly and needed to confirm the flower shop's availability. I tried calling the shop to speak with the manager but found him absent for lunch. The employee on duty said the manager would get back to me once he returned. However, I never received his call. 

A few days later, I sent an email, but there was no reply.

Given this level of customer service, I don't think they deserve my business.

yelp:train:31755.orig: Overpriced and 2 weeks later i call to find out where my computer is and they say \""It's on the bench , just finishing up\"" twice this happened. $149 quote at lessors and $75 at another place and they called in one day.
yelp:train:31755.para: I received an overpriced quote and, two weeks later, when I called to check on my computer, I was told it was "on the bench, just finishing up" twice. This has happened before. The quote was $149 elsewhere, and another place charged only $75, but they called me the same day.

yelp:train:32070.orig: Rude sales people.  Sales guy said I needed a wax and leather cleaner for the seats.  I told him my son has a friend I use for this service.  He said \""you don't know how many times I have heard that one\"".  Seriously, don't talk down to the customers, they won't be back.  I know I won't come back.
yelp:train:32070.para: Unfriendly sales staff. The salesperson insisted I needed a wax and leather cleaner for my seats. I mentioned that my son has a friend who handles this task for me. He responded, "I've heard that excuse many times." Truly, it’s unwise to dismiss customers; it drives them away. I can confirm I won’t be returning.

yelp:train:32118.orig: I went for a yearly check up and apparently, you are not allowed to ask questions. If you ask any questions they charge extra (in my case,over $300!), which of course was not communicated to me at the time. Now my appointment that should have been covered by insurance I'm having to pay a sizeable amount out of pocket. When I called the billing office to find out why I was charged the extra fee I was told they charge the extra fee if you need a prescription for birth control too. Having been to a gyno for 16 years I've never been charged for asking questions or needing a birth control script. The visit with the doctor itself was nothing special, the doctor was mildly friendly tho somewhat frazzled. It was also a bit odd that they do not have a front desk, just assistants with tablets who sit in the waiting area and approach you as you enter to check you in.  I had previously gone to the Maricopa office and had NO problems. I will not be returning.
yelp:train:32118.para: During my annual check-up, it seemed questions weren't permitted; any inquiries resulted in additional charges—over $300 in my case—which wasn't mentioned beforehand. Consequently, what should have been an insured visit now requires me to pay a significant amount out-of-pocket. When I inquired about the extra fee, I was told it applies if you need a birth control prescription too. Over the past 16 years, I've never faced such charges for questions or birth control prescriptions. The doctor's visit was unremarkable, though the doctor was somewhat friendly. It was peculiar that there was no front desk; instead, assistants with tablets checked us in from the waiting area. Previously, I had no issues at the Maricopa office. I won't be returning.

yelp:train:32417.orig: Great service! terrible food, a shame.  The Ceasar salad had the wrong type of lettuce, wrong dressing. Came with tomatos!  Lasagna bland and mushy!  And why. The Tv??!
yelp:train:32417.para: Excellent service, but the food was terrible—quite disappointing. The Caesar salad had the wrong kind of lettuce and dressing, and it included tomatoes! The lasagna was bland and mushy! And what about the TV?

yelp:train:32627.orig:
Surprised I haven't written a review for this place earlier since Pita Jungle is only a few blocks away. This place is Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian, and Vegan friendly so really you can find something for everyone at this place. In addition, there is outdoor sitting by the lake, which is just perfect when the weather cools down.  Just don't mind the ducks. ;)

The food here is really good and fresh. This evening I'm having the Couscous salad with a Passion Fruit iced tea, but I've also had many of the other menu items throughout my several visits to this spot. I can usually never finish the salads since they are so huge, but they taste just as good the next day. The Hummus is a must, and any kind will do they're all really good. If you're watching carbs, you can order it with cucumber slices instead of a pita which is fantastic and very refreshing on a warm day. 

All in all, I really like this place and the service is great. Not too slow, but not too rushed either. This is one of my go-to places when I really crave something super healthy.
yelp:train:32627.para:
I was surprised not to have reviewed this place sooner, as Pita Jungle is just a few blocks away. It caters to vegetarians, non-vegetarians, and vegans, ensuring there's something for everyone. Plus, the outdoor seating by the lake is perfect when the weather cools down—just ignore the ducks! ;)

The food here is both delicious and fresh. Tonight, I'm enjoying the Couscous salad with a Passion Fruit iced tea, but I've tried many other items during my multiple visits. The salads are enormous, but they taste just as good the next day. The Hummus is a must-try; all varieties are excellent. If you're watching your carb intake, you can order it with cucumber slices instead of pita, which is refreshing on a warm day.

Overall, I really enjoy this place, and the service is top-notch—not too slow, but not rushed either. It's one of my go-to spots when I crave something super healthy.

yelp:train:33120.orig:
So, the 2 stars is because I typically would give it 4 but our horrible Thanksgiving dinner at this location would warrant 1 star. 
Clearly they overbooked for Thanksgiving...this became apparent because I made a reservation a MONTH ahead and we were told it would be a 45-50 minute wait when we walked in the door at 1:45 pm.  What point is a reservation then really? 
Only because another gal told us it would be 15 minutes and we were rather vocal about the situation did they manage to acquire a booth for us about 20 minutes later. 

Then there was the food...past years we ate at another Mimi's and thoroughly enjoyed our meal and the crowd was managed much better. Additionally, there were snacks and drinks available for those having to wait to be seated (Note to Chandler location: this is extremely helpful when people are hungry and not expecting a long wait time after booking a reservation).  The salad and bread were sadly the best part of the meal...the sweet potatoes were so sweet none of us ate them and half of us wouldn't try the green bean casserole and the other half regretted that they did.  
Additionally my husband and I ordered red wine and they ran out of wine glasse
yelp:train:33120.para:
I gave it 2 stars instead of 4 due to our terrible Thanksgiving dinner experience. It was clear they overbooked, as I had reserved a month in advance and was told to expect a 45-50 minute wait when we arrived at 1:45 pm. The reservation system seemed pointless in this case. We only got a booth about 20 minutes later, after we voiced our concerns to another staff member.

The food was disappointing. In past years, we enjoyed our meals at another Mimi's location, and the crowd management was better. They should offer snacks and drinks for those waiting to be seated (Chandler location, take note). The salad and bread were the highlights, but the sweet potatoes were overly sweet and went uneaten. Half of our group didn't even try the green bean casserole, and those who did regretted it. Additionally, my husband and I ordered red wine, but they were out of wine glasses.

yelp:train:33179.orig: Don't go through the drive through. They F you in the drive through. Multiple different times throughout 3 years, I have been F'ed consistently. Hamburgers with no meat (hard to validate when driving through). Missing items. Just go in and check your order.
yelp:train:33179.para: Avoid using the drive-through; it's a recurring issue for me. Over the past three years, I've repeatedly encountered problems. Drive-through orders have lacked meat, which is hard to verify while driving. Items have gone missing too. It's best to go inside and confirm your order directly.

yelp:train:33694.orig: I decided I needed to write a review since the 5 star review I saw was from 2008!!! Since it is 2014- here is my take: I would give it no stars - except that the front desk managers are amazing!!! They are friendly and even when our dog was annoying other guests with his barking, the gentleman at the front offered to watch him while we went to dinner- way above the call of his job!! We are in the process of relocating to Chandler and the relocation company put us up here for 11 days while we wait to get in our apartment...for a Hilton, I'm very disappointed!! Guests shouldn't even hear our dog if the walls weren't so thin!! We are at the end of the hallway and away from any other room but the quality of this hotel is so very low! The beds are DOUBLE size and for 2 adults, doubles just are too small for numerous days. Hampton Inn which is next door and also Hilton seems like a better option! The coffee at Homewood Suites is mediocre at best- for people who enjoy the Hampton Inn Robust, this is terrible!! The rooms are clean but not Hilton quality
yelp:train:33694.para: I felt compelled to write this review because the last 5-star review I saw was from 2008, and it's now 2014. Here’s my perspective: I wouldn't give it any stars, except for the exceptional front desk managers. They are incredibly friendly, and when our dog was bothering other guests with his barking, the front desk staff kindly offered to watch him while we had dinner—way beyond their job description! We're in the process of moving to Chandler, and the relocation company has been putting us up here for 11 days while we wait for our apartment. For a Hilton, I'm quite disappointed. Guests shouldn't hear our dog if the walls weren't so thin! We're at the end of the hallway, yet the hotel's quality is very low. The beds are double-sized, which is too small for two adults over several days. The Hampton Inn next door seems like a better option. The coffee at Homewood Suites is just okay; it's not as robust as the Hampton Inn's. The rooms are clean, but not up to Hilton standards.

yelp:train:34173.orig: Baja Fresh is going down hill.  The burrito size is shrinking, and the price  is growing!  WTF!  Did they think I wouldn't notice?  I still like their burritos, I just don't think it's worth it now.  I can get a much more filling burrito from my friends at Chipotle for less $.  Oh and I normally like mango salsa but this time theirs tasted like dookie.
yelp:train:34173.para: Baja Fresh is declining in quality. The burritos are getting smaller, while prices are rising. Really? Did they think I wouldn't realize? I still enjoy their burritos, but now I find them overpriced. I can get a more satisfying burrito at Chipotle for a better price. Plus, their mango salsa this time tasted awful, almost like it was spoiled.

yelp:train:34221.orig: With $1.00, I can either get 4 gum balls from the gum ball machine at the mall, or choose an item from the plethora found on Wendy's value menu.  I rarely choose the gum balls.  I give Wendy's 5 stars because in my opinion it is everything you could ask for in a fast food joint: Value, friendliness, and most importantly, speed.  I like to play a game called 'How many seconds from the time I finish placing my order until the time I have my order in hand and am driving away?'.  Today it was 24 seconds - now that's fast food!  They are so quick when taking the order, charging at the first window, and delivering your food to you at the second.  And that was around the time of the lunch hour rush.  My favorite game, however, is called 'Don't come to a complete stop when picking up my food'.  Since they usually have my order hanging out the window before I even get there, I can just roll right through, grab my food while still in motion, and be on my way (With a \""Thank you\"" of course).  This location usually has hot girls working there too.  Did I mention that the girls at both windows said \""have a good day!\""?.  Well now I did.  In fact, the second one even asked me how I was doi
yelp:train:34221.para: For $1.00, I could buy 4 gum balls from the mall machine or select an item from Wendy's value menu. I seldom opt for the gum balls. I award Wendy's 5 stars as it excels in fast food: offering value, friendly service, and most crucially, speed. I enjoy timing how quickly my order is served, and today it was just 24 seconds from placing to picking up my food—truly fast! They are efficient at every step, from taking the order to delivering it. Even during the lunch rush, they manage to hand over my food before I arrive. My favorite challenge is to avoid stopping completely when picking up my food; they often have my order ready as I approach, allowing me to grab it while moving. This place usually has attractive staff, and both windows always wish me a good day. The second one even inquired about my day.

yelp:train:34994.orig: This place is amazing I have been going here for at least 10 years, great food, family owned and run business.
yelp:train:34994.para: I've been visiting this amazing place for at least a decade, and it continues to impress with its fantastic food. It's a family-run business that has remained a favorite of mine.

yelp:train:35316.orig: First visit and not a good experience. My breakfast came minus the biscuit and gravy and with no assigned server (you stand in line to order and food runners bring your plate) I had to go back inside (we sat in the outside patio) and request the rest of my breakfast. My breakfast was served but not the other two in my party. After a ten minute wait I started to eat it because it was getting cold. We stopped two different  food runners and asked about the rest of our order and were told \""I'm sure it will be right up\"". We waited forty five minutes and nothing. The only thing they did right was refund the charge for the food that never came. They did apologize for the lousy service but we won't be going back.
yelp:train:35316.para: On my first visit, the experience was unsatisfactory. The breakfast I ordered lacked the biscuit and gravy, and there was no assigned server (you order at the counter and food runners bring your plate). I had to return to the restaurant (we were seated on the outdoor patio) to ask for the missing items. My meal was eventually brought, but not for the other two in my party. After waiting about ten minutes, I started eating to avoid it getting cold. We approached two food runners and inquired about the rest of our order, only to be told, "I'm sure it will be up shortly." We waited an additional forty-five minutes with no further action. The only positive was a refund for the food that never arrived. They apologized for the poor service, but we won't be returning.

yelp:train:35663.orig:
Was here today for the Peach Festival and could not believe how rude the lady making the pancakes was! I think this is Carrie Schnepf since she was the one I saw on the news. I was standing over by the refrigerator where the water bottles are kept looking for a sign posted stating the price of a water bottle. I had made brief eye contact with her and she screamed, ""What??!"" and threw her hands up in the air obviously annoyed by my very presence. I was so appalled and just responded with asking how much the water was. Then she screamed ""$2.00!!"". 

Maybe she is a nice person, I don't know but I do know that is no way to treat a customer that contributes to keeping your business alive. A little kindness and courtesy is all I'm asking for - especially from the owner and especially after paying $12.00 for pancakes I could have made better myself.

Other than that it was a pretty fun day. I do think the farm could use some overall clean up. There were just random objects laying around every where that didn't appear to have much purpose. Just makes the place a little junky looking.
yelp:train:35663.para:
Attended the Peach Festival today and was shocked by the lady serving pancakes, whom I believe is Carrie Schnepf, as I saw her on the news. While I was near the refrigerator where water bottles are stored, looking for a price sign, I briefly made eye contact with her. She suddenly yelled, "What?!" and flung her arms up, clearly irritated by my presence. I was deeply offended and simply asked about the water price. She then shouted, "$2.00!" 

Maybe she's a nice person, but treating customers this way is unacceptable, especially after spending $12 on pancakes that I could have made at home. A bit of politeness and courtesy would be appreciated, particularly from the owner. 

Apart from that, the day was enjoyable. I do think the farm needs some general cleanup; there were random items scattered everywhere with no clear purpose, making the place look a bit cluttered.

yelp:train:36569.orig: Love their breakfast! Waffles are just like home cooked. If you need breakfast in a hurry this is the place, with in 5 mins of ordering your food is at the table.
yelp:train:36569.para: I absolutely adore their breakfast! The waffles are so similar to those made at home. If you're in a rush for breakfast, this is perfect—your food arrives at the table within just 5 minutes of placing your order.

yelp:train:36631.orig: I booked this place through priceline during the heart of spring training season and the prices were reasonable (less than $150/night).  The hotel reflects local architecture with cacti everywhere.  The room was more than adequate for our 3 night stay.  We stayed at one end of the hotel so walking to the main lobby area did get a bit annoying but our room's location was very quiet and peaceful.  We used both pools/jacuzzi's - very nice and not that crowded.  The coffee bar was great for morning breakfasts.  The location was very convenient - only a few minutes drive to the fashion mall.  Very good value!
yelp:train:36631.para: During the peak of spring training, I secured a room through Priceline for less than $150 per night, which was quite reasonable. The hotel's design incorporated local architecture, with cacti abundant throughout. Our room was sufficient for our three-night stay. We were situated at one end of the hotel, which made walking to the main lobby a bit cumbersome, but our room was notably quiet and peaceful. We enjoyed both the pools and jacuzzi, which were very nice and not overly crowded. The coffee bar was excellent for our morning breakfasts. The location was convenient, just a short drive to the fashion mall. Overall, it was a very good value.

yelp:train:36829.orig: Gas is decently priced but if you are a smoker, one of the best priced around.
yelp:train:36829.para: Gas is reasonably affordable, and if you're a smoker, it's one of the more budget-friendly options available.

yelp:train:36844.orig:
I must admit, based on the reviews I was a bit nervous taking my photos there to be developed, but they seem to be one of the last 3 local, pro camera places left in Phoenix that develops pictures.  Walgreens, Walmart and Target are awful for pictures (I don't have a Costco membership), and I'm one of those weird people who still likes to have an actual photo instead of an electronic image.

Wilson's was open on Saturday (Tempe Camera, get with the times, no weekend hours for photo developing?).  I dropped my pics off and they were ready by Tuesday.  4 x 7 glossy, just like I ordered, of my vacation pics.  The quality was superb!  Rivals Jones Photo in Tucson who I used for 30+ years until moving to Phoenix.  Wilson made good pics look even better.  Color and detail were great.

Service both on Sat. and Tues. was very friendly and fast.  I'm no pro and can't tell you anything about their cameras, prices, classes... just their photo developing.  I'll definitely be back again!
yelp:train:36844.para:
To be honest, I was a bit anxious about getting my photos developed after reading the reviews, but Wilson's is one of the few professional camera shops left in Phoenix that still offers this service. Walgreens, Walmart, and Target produce subpar results, and I don't have a Costco membership. As someone who prefers physical photos over digital ones, I was glad to find a place that could meet my needs.

Wilson's was open on Saturdays, which was a plus (Tempe Camera, consider offering weekend hours for photo developing). I dropped off my photos, and they were ready by Tuesday. I ordered 4x7 glossy prints of my vacation photos, and the quality was outstanding! It rivals the photos I used to get developed at Jones Photo in Tucson for over three decades. Wilson's even enhanced the quality of my already good photos, with excellent color and detail.

The service on both Saturday and Tuesday was very friendly and efficient. While I'm not an expert on their cameras, prices, or classes, I can confidently say that their photo developing is top-notch. I plan to return!

yelp:train:36928.orig: Unbelievable that a \""egg\"" restarunt does not know how to poach an egg. 3x for eggs benedict and still wrong. 2xs eggs not cooked 3x killed them. I gave up.
yelp:train:36928.para: It's astonishing that an "egg" restaurant can't poach an egg properly. They got my eggs benedict wrong three times, and two of them weren't even cooked. The third one was overdone. I gave up trying.

yelp:train:37510.orig: Have dined there many times. Best chicken piccata around. But got bad Salmon on Sat. night ended up with food poisoning,tasted OK but very sick later. Will avoid the salmon at all cost.
yelp:train:37510.para: I've eaten there numerous times, and their chicken piccata is outstanding. However, on Saturday night, I ordered salmon that was terrible; it made me very sick later, even though it tasted okay at first. I'll definitely steer clear of the salmon from now on.

yelp:train:37615.orig: I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. I work nearby and frequent Jolta Java at least 4 times a week. Mostly for just Iced Tea (which is delicious!). I love supporting locally owned places and the staff at Jolta Java is why. They always remember who you are and what you like. When I eat lunch there they always ask how it is and for any feedback. \n\nMy only suggestion would be more veggie friendly menu options! Even their caprese salad has buffalo chicken on it?? Their soups however, are FANTASTIC. I wish they served them on more of a regular schedule because I love the Jalapeno creamed corn soup but never know when it is being offered.
yelp:train:37615.para:
I can't understand why I haven't reviewed Jolta Java yet, as I work close by and visit there at least four times a week, mostly for their delicious iced tea. I really enjoy supporting local businesses, and the staff at Jolta Java are the reason for that. They always remember me and my preferences, and when I have lunch there, they ask about my meal and seek my feedback. 

The only thing I'd suggest is adding more vegetarian-friendly menu options. Even their caprese salad includes buffalo chicken, which is a bit of a surprise! However, their soups are outstanding, especially the jalapeno creamed corn soup, which I wish was available more often.

yelp:train:38318.orig: Food not that good overpriced. My Calmari was very tough must have been old. Sauce was good\nSkimpy salad.  Service not that good. Will not go back, very dissapointing, and the place was empty.
yelp:train:38318.para: The food wasn't great and was quite pricey. My calamari was quite tough; it probably was old. The sauce was decent, though. The salad was small. The service wasn't great either. I won't be returning; it was very disappointing, and the restaurant was nearly empty.

yelp:train:38386.orig: Got bagels and coffee to go this morning and was very disappointed. For a breakfast place their coffee is awful and they don't even have real half and half out or the right cups for iced coffee. They also do not have stevia or raw sugar.. They need to get an update on this bandwagon. I'll give it to them that their bagels are fresh but our bagel sandwich was half heartily put together. It was dry and they did not get either orders right I asked for a jalape\u00f1o bagel and got plain and I asked for pepper jack cheese and got cheddar.. Needless to say I will find a different place to get bagels and coffee.
yelp:train:38386.para: This morning, I picked up bagels and coffee, but I was quite let down. Despite being a breakfast spot, their coffee is terrible, and they lack real half and half, as well as appropriate cups for iced coffee. They also don't offer stevia or raw sugar. While their bagels are fresh, our bagel sandwich was poorly assembled; it was dry, and they got our orders wrong—instead of a jalapeño bagel, we received a plain one, and cheddar cheese was substituted for pepper jack. Consequently, I'll be seeking a different place for my bagels and coffee.

yelp:train:38555.orig:
I would not eat here because I don't care for extra mucus with my meal.

The parent company, Darden, is threatening to turn full-time employees into part-time employees in order to dodge the requirements of the Affordable Care Act.

Do you want your food handled by people who can't afford a doctor's visit because they are uninsured part-timers, AND they can't afford to miss a day of work if they are sick, because they are part-timers?
yelp:train:38555.para:
I wouldn't eat here due to the presence of extra mucus in the food.

Darden, the parent company, is considering converting full-time staff to part-time to avoid Obamacare mandates.

Would you prefer your food prepared by part-timers who might forego medical care due to lack of insurance, and who risk losing their jobs if they fall ill?

yelp:train:40045.orig: I always remark to myself about the professional demeanor of the people who work here.\nWalt runs a tight ship.
yelp:train:40045.para: I frequently notice the professional attitude of the employees here. Walt manages everything with great efficiency.

yelp:train:40145.orig: Seems like every time i come here lately, a side order of bad attitude that i didn't order, is served up!  Won't be coming back after the particularly snotty attitude I got from a Ms. Elizabeth tonight though. What a shame, the sweet potato fries were actually decent here...
yelp:train:40145.para: It appears that with each visit recently, I've received an unwanted side of bad attitude. The particularly snooty demeanor shown to me by Ms. Elizabeth tonight was the final straw. I won't be returning, despite the fact that the sweet potato fries were quite good.

yelp:train:41150.orig:
Slightly touristy in that there's a lot of memorabilia scattered around the place, not to mention a tank with rattlesnakes right when you enter and an old west town made up of prop store fronts and a stage for live music out back, but other than that, it's all history.  The restaurant has been around since 1957 according to the website, and the history is pretty evident upon first glance.  The cieling is covered in snipped neckties and business cards dating back decades - just look for the dustiest ties and the yellowest cards, you'll see what I mean.  Along many of the interior walls there are hundreds of beer related trinkets, tap handles, old label artwork, bottle caps, old photos of the first breweries, and unique bottle openers.  It's a pretty interesting place to just walk around (and, of course, there's a gift shop for all your last minute christmas gifts).  

There's also a local brewery attached to it, Sonoran Brewing Company, and all of their beers are served at the restaurant.  I recommend trying their Inebriator Stout and the Victorian IPA if you like craft beer or your tastebuds could use a wake-up call.  

The food isn't oh-my-gawd amazing, but it's good.  The ste
yelp:train:41150.para:
The place has a bit of a touristy vibe, with lots of memorabilia scattered about, including a tank with rattlesnakes at the entrance and an old west town with prop storefronts and a stage for live music. However, the history is evident everywhere you look. The restaurant, which has been around since 1957, is adorned with ceiling ties and business cards from decades past—look for the most dusty and yellowed ones. The interior walls are filled with hundreds of beer-related items, such as tap handles, old label artwork, bottle caps, photos of early breweries, and unique bottle openers. It’s a fascinating place to explore, and there’s even a gift shop for last-minute Christmas gifts. 

Attached to the establishment is Sonoran Brewing Company, where all their beers are served. I suggest trying their Inebriator Stout and Victorian IPA if you enjoy craft beer. The food is decent but not outstanding.

yelp:train:41379.orig: Competent tech, got the unit running, good response, very expensive. Charges $80 per pound for R-22 freon when the current contractor purchase price is $11 per pound. If gas stations charged the same mark up, gas would be $24 per gallon. Suggest getting other quotes Fountain Hills.
yelp:train:41379.para: The tech did a good job getting the unit running, but the response time was quick. However, the cost is very high—$80 per pound for R-22 freon, compared to the current contractor's price of $11 per pound. If gas stations marked up their prices similarly, gas would be $24 per gallon. I recommend getting quotes from other providers in Fountain Hills.

yelp:train:41593.orig: I have been to this store several times with disappointment.  You really have to watch expiration dates.  There organic boxed salads are almost always expired.  I always have to find an employee to get me items from the back room that are fresh and should be out on the shelf.  it should be a normal routine to go through the produce and throw out the aged items.   This happens ALL the time. Believe it or not, Wal-Mart is now selling quite a bit of wrapped organic produce items.  Better to buy it pre-wrapped than to have everyones hands all over the unwrapped veggies.
yelp:train:41593.para: I've visited this store multiple times with a sense of disappointment. You need to be vigilant about checking expiration dates; the organic boxed salads are frequently past their prime. I often have to ask an employee to fetch fresh items from the back, which should be readily available on the shelves. It's a regular occurrence that the produce needs to be inspected and older items discarded. This issue persists consistently. Interestingly, Wal-Mart now offers a significant amount of pre-wrapped organic produce, which might be a safer option compared to unwrapped vegetables that could be handled by many people.

yelp:train:41743.orig: This mall has unfortunately gone done hill since my family moved to Arizona 10 years ago. My sister and I used to come here and hang out back in the high school years and just spend time walking the mall and having a good time. I do not think I would feel safe hanging out around here any longer.\n\nWe most recently came here on a Sunday afternoon. We don't usually shop the stores very often at AZ Mills but we were waiting to see a movie and had some time to kill. We made our way in by the movie theater and made our way around the mall. The hallways were so crowded at times we were barely able to make it through. There were so many kids screaming and running around without it parents it was alarming. Do not come here if you plan to have a nice leisurely day around the mall unless you enjoy shrill high pitch screams around every corner. At one point we were making our way around the Rainforest Caf\u00e9 (which was oddly blaring loud club music) and we heard a couple arguing very loudly outside the restaurant. Eventually they started screaming at each other in the middle of about 15 people passing by. The woman screamed that she was going to call security on him, lovely. Once again, d
yelp:train:41743.para:
Since my family moved to Arizona a decade ago, this mall has declined significantly. My sister and I used to visit frequently during our high school days, enjoying the mall and spending quality time together. Nowadays, I wouldn't feel safe hanging out there anymore.

Our last visit was on a Sunday afternoon. We rarely shop at AZ Mills, but we were waiting to see a movie and had some free time. We entered through the movie theater and wandered around. The hallways were often so crowded that we struggled to move. The noise from children running and screaming without supervision was concerning. If you plan to have a peaceful day at the mall, avoid this place unless you enjoy hearing shrill, high-pitched screams around every corner. We even passed by the Rainforest Café, where loud club music was playing, and heard a couple arguing loudly outside. They eventually started screaming in the middle of a group of people, with the woman threatening to call security.

yelp:train:41798.orig:
What is not to love about this wonderful Bakery. It is in a great location right on Southern in Tempe. If you did not know it was there however, you might not realize what it is.
 Lots of parking in the lot. Very clean and wonderful smelling inside.
Their pastries and baked goods are fabulous. Fresh and wonderful.
 Plus you can order almost any type of cake that you would like. 
My girlfriend got me a Tiramasu Birthday Cake here and it was one of the best I have ever had, short of Italy itself.
Fresh , creamy, and smooth. The lady fingers were fantastic!
If you ever need a cake or even some lovely morining snacks. This is the place to go.
yelp:train:41798.para:
This delightful bakery is a gem, situated conveniently on Southern in Tempe. You might miss it if you don't look for it, though. There's ample parking available, and the interior is both clean and fragrant.

Their pastries and baked goods are outstanding, freshly made and delicious. They offer a wide range of cakes to choose from, and I had a Tiramisu birthday cake that was among the best I've ever tasted, rivaling even those from Italy.

It was fresh, creamy, and smooth, with fantastic ladyfingers. Whether you need a cake or some tasty morning treats, this bakery is the perfect choice.

yelp:train:41947.orig: Hour wait when I had a reservation. Only two salespeople on the morning of a new phone release. Are you kidding me!
yelp:train:41947.para: I had to wait for an hour even though I had a reservation. There were only two salespeople on the morning of the new phone release. Are you kidding me?!

yelp:train:42382.orig: Good, thorough and experienced\nI don't know who \""lucky\"" saw but it wasn't the Dr. Ponitch I saw. I had a skin screening at a college health fair was told to get some dry patches removed before they became cancerous. The Doc said the same thing and took care of all them - quite a few little ones and a couple of larger. He was thorough, explained the after care and only charged the co-pay for all the work and exam.
yelp:train:42382.para: Certainly, I had a positive experience with Dr. Ponitch. During a skin screening at a college health fair, I was advised to address some dry patches before they potentially developed into something more serious. Dr. Ponitch confirmed this and efficiently treated all the patches, including several small ones and a couple of larger ones. He was very thorough, provided detailed instructions for aftercare, and only charged my copay for the comprehensive examination and treatment.

yelp:train:42495.orig: 4.5 stars.  They make a really good thin crust  NY style pizza.  We also like the wings ALOT!    We do delivery 9 times out of 10 and they are fast and the pizza and wings hold up well.  I don't care for the BBQ wings but my kids love them.  We all like the honey hot wings. \n\nThey hands down have the best lunch special in town. We were here the other day and got 3 slices plus a drink and 2 waters for $10 plus change.  I had a slice of the special pizza with sausage, pepperoni and jalape\u00f1os. I'm usually not a fan of sausage but this stuff was really tasty.  The slices are huge too.  I left full but if your a huge eater you might want 2 slices.  They are local too so I like to support local businesses.
yelp:train:42495.para:
4.5 stars. They offer an excellent thin crust New York-style pizza. We particularly enjoy their wings a lot! We usually opt for delivery, and they consistently deliver quickly with pizza and wings that remain delicious. I don't prefer the BBQ wings, but my children adore them. We all really like the honey hot wings.

They undoubtedly serve the best lunch special in town. Recently, we ordered three slices plus a drink and two waters for just over $10. I had a slice of the special pizza with sausage, pepperoni, and jalapeños. Despite not typically being a fan of sausage, this pizza was surprisingly tasty. The slices are generously sized, too. I felt satisfied, but if you have a big appetite, you might want to order two slices. Since they are a local business, I enjoy supporting them.

yelp:train:42649.orig: love this place. You can always find a great deal, but the shoes section is out of order on most days. but the deals are worth it. Check often as new merchandise is brought in often
yelp:train:42649.para: I really love this store. While the shoe section is usually closed, there are always fantastic deals to be found. It's definitely worth checking in frequently since new items are constantly being added.

yelp:train:42696.orig: I have come here quite a few times with friends who love hot wings.  I am not a hot wing person, but the menu is enormous and lots to choose from.  I have never been disappointed with the food... it is your typical bar food pizza, burgers, sliders, sandwiches, and many other things.  My only complaint is we sat on the patio and it smelled like a sewer out there.  I don't recall this being a issue before... so not sure if this is a problem that can be resolved or only going to get worse.  My suggestion... if you are going there and want to sit on the patio... sit as far to the east as possible.  It didn't smell as much over there:)
yelp:train:42696.para: I've visited this place several times with friends who adore hot wings, but I'm not a fan of spicy food. The menu is vast, offering a wide range of options. I've never been let down by the food, which consists of typical bar fare like pizza, burgers, sliders, and sandwiches. My main issue is the patio's odor, which smells like a sewer—something I didn't notice before. I'm unsure if this is a persistent problem or if it's getting worse. My advice: if you plan to sit outside, choose a spot as far east as possible, as it's less smelly there.

yelp:train:43172.orig: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE FIRST THEY STOLE THE 75 cent that I was going to fill up my water jugs, then they told me they topped off my fluids which they did not my car almost OVERHEATED and now my radio plays softly even though my car is totally off. All I went there for was an oil change, that was all. WTF!!!
yelp:train:43172.para: WHAT A DISASTROUS VISIT! THEY TOOK THE 75 cents I had for filling my water jugs, and then claimed they topped off my fluids, which they clearly didn't. My car was almost overheating as a result, and now my radio is barely audible even when the engine is off. I only went for an oil change. THIS IS UNBELIEVABLE!!!

yelp:train:43209.orig:
With family in upstate New York, I grew up with trips to Ted's while visiting back east.  The charcoal grilled hot dogs always tasted sooo good.  

In high school, I discovered that Ted's had a location in Tempe, only a bit away from my parent's house in Mesa.  The yumminess of the food definitely translated west of the Mississippi.  Everything is so good and has that awesome taste of being grilled and perhaps fried (like the fries and onion rings)  without being too heavy.

I love standing in line, calling out my order when asked, buying Weber's mustard (I haven't found it sold anywhere else in Arizona), drinking fountain rootbeer that has a kick, looking at the Buffalo, NY paraphenalia that decorates the walls. 

On the trays, there is a paper with a quiz that I pretty much have memorized.  I know, from the quiz, that Ted's uses 7 million pickle spears per year.  I also always laugh with my friends over the easiest question on the quiz: ""True or False; there is a Ted's Hotdogs location in Tempe, AZ"" (the quiz was clearly written for my Ted's friends to the east).

It gets pretty crowded at lunchtime and stays that way through the afternoon.  I would suggest going slig
yelp:train:43209.para:
Growing up in upstate New York, I visited Ted's often during family trips to the east. Their charcoal-grilled hot dogs were always incredibly delicious. 

In high school, I found a Ted's location in Tempe, close to my parents' house in Mesa. The food's quality remained excellent, with that perfect grilled and possibly fried taste, yet it wasn't overly heavy.

I enjoy standing in line, shouting my order, buying Weber's mustard (which isn't sold anywhere else in Arizona), drinking the fizzy rootbeer from the fountain that has a nice kick, and looking at the Buffalo, NY-themed decorations on the walls. 

Each tray comes with a quiz sheet that I know by heart. From the quiz, I learned that Ted's uses seven million pickle spears annually. My friends and I always chuckle at the easiest question: "True or False; there is a Ted's Hotdogs location in Tempe, AZ" (clearly written for my friends from the east).

The place gets quite busy during lunch and stays that way throughout the afternoon. I recommend going slightly earlier to avoid the crowd.

yelp:train:43449.orig: I'm a Marriott Rewards Gold member and spend lots of leisure trips and business trips at Marriott brand hotels. The Buttes, unfortunately, did not meet my expectations. The service was good, but the rooms were quite outdated and the food (room service and The Top of The Rock Restaurant) was mediocre at best. There was a strange, unpleasant smell in our hallway and room foyer, as well. On the bright side, the spa was fabulous. I had an 80 minute massage that rocked my world.  Overall, however, I was pretty underwhelmed by this resort.
yelp:train:43449.para: As a Marriott Rewards Gold member who frequently stays at Marriott hotels for both leisure and business, my recent experience at The Buttes fell short of my expectations. While the service was satisfactory, the rooms appeared quite old-fashioned, and the food, whether from room service or The Top of The Rock Restaurant, was only marginally good. Additionally, there was an odd, disagreeable odor in our hallway and room entrance. On the positive side, the spa was exceptional; my 80-minute massage was truly outstanding. Nevertheless, I found the resort overall to be quite disappointing.

yelp:train:43659.orig:
I joined it for the climbing wall, then found myself going there all the time. it is by far the best gym I have ever been to. Everything is spread out and there are enough machines and weights so I never really find myself waiting for anything. 

They are also open 24 hrs so I can go at odd times. 

My only complaint is that the climbing wall has very limited hours. I wish teh wall was open as long as the gym is!
yelp:train:43659.para:
I started going there primarily for the climbing wall, but soon found myself visiting frequently. This gym is undoubtedly the best I've ever used; everything is well-organized, and there are ample machines and weights, so I rarely have to wait. 

Moreover, it's open 24/7, which allows me to workout at any time. 

The only downside is that the climbing wall is only open for limited hours. I wish the wall was available as much as the gym itself!

yelp:train:43799.orig:
I have tried every other mongolian bbq in the valley and none compare to YC's. It is just plain better. Price is right for the portion. I pay extra for the box and go nutts at the line and take home the extra. Meat is always the best quality, the veggies are always fresh. Though busy at peak times, they always get you through the line quick. 

YC's needs a seafood night with lobster and shrimp etc. I'd pay allot more a coupel times a month to step it up.

As for the frozen yogurt, don't bother. They need to pick up the brand Sweet Tomatoes uses and add a little fixin bar and I would pay the extra for dessert.
yelp:train:43799.para:
I've visited numerous Mongolian BBQ places in the valley, but none match YC's in quality. It's simply superior, and the price is fair for the portion size. I often opt for the to-go box and indulge at the counter, taking home extra. The meat is consistently of the best quality, and the vegetables are always fresh. Despite being busy during peak hours, they efficiently serve customers. 

YC's should consider adding a seafood night with options like lobster and shrimp; I'd gladly pay more for such special occasions. 

Regarding the frozen yogurt, it's not worth it. They could improve by using a better brand like Sweet Tomatoes and adding a fixings bar, which would make me willing to pay extra for dessert.

yelp:train:43854.orig: I went to Ana to have my nails done not even a week ago and the gel is peeling off of all my nails!!! Horrible job and I spent $45.00 which is a lot higher than most in the Valley.  Will not be back!!
yelp:train:43854.para: Just a few days ago, I visited Ana for my nail service, and now the gel is coming off my nails entirely! The work was terrible, and I paid $45, which is quite pricey compared to other places in the area. I definitely won't be returning.

yelp:train:44629.orig:
I walked over from gym in want of healthy chicken and rice and upon entering i was the only customer. The two employees were sitting down on their phones while there was trash on the table and customers wanting food! 

Upon getting my food for what I thought was gonna be a standard teriyaki chicken bowl , was a al le cart huge bin of chicken , then a huge been of rice . I thought wow im gonna have some left over. I began to eat and the chicken was full of gristle so long story short threw it away .. 

Not impressed
yelp:train:44629.para:
After my workout at the gym, I headed to a restaurant hoping for a healthy chicken and rice meal. When I arrived, I was the sole customer, and I noticed the staff were on their phones while the table was cluttered with trash. 

I ordered what I expected to be a regular teriyaki chicken bowl, but instead, I was given a large bin of chicken and a huge pot of rice. I thought I’d have leftovers. As I started eating, I found the chicken to be very tough and full of gristle, so I ended up throwing it away.

I wasn’t impressed.

yelp:train:44966.orig:
I hate for my first official review to be a one star review but Macayo's really disappointed me last night. When I first pulled into the parking lot last night I was surprised to see how many empty parking spaces there were. I immediately got excited because normally any restaurant on Bell road any night of the week has a wait. However, when I walked inside I saw a slew of people waiting to be seated. I walked up to the hostess stand and put my name on the list and the hostess did not give me a time quote and when I asked how long it would be she quoted me, ""not too long."" We waited about 15 minutes before being shown to our table which is where the trouble really began. 

Once we were at our table we were quickly greeted by our server (yay) however, she told us she had another table's drink order to get and then she would be back for ours (boo). So we waited for her to take the other two tables drink orders before coming back to take ours. 

After about 10 minutes we got our fountain drinks and then 5 minutes later she came back to take our food order. Then it took about 50 minutes for our food to come out. Seriously, 50 minutes.... that's about how long I planned to spend
yelp:train:44966.para:
I was quite disappointed to give Macayo a one-star review on my first official visit. When I arrived at the parking lot, I noticed several empty spots, which was unusual since most places on Bell Road are always busy. Excited by this, I went inside and found a long line of people waiting to be seated. I asked the hostess for an estimated wait time, but she only said it wouldn't be too long. After waiting for about 15 minutes, we were finally seated, marking the start of our issues.

Our server greeted us promptly, which was a positive start, but she immediately left to attend to another table's drink order. We had to wait for her to return to take our order, which took about 10 minutes. We received our fountain drinks shortly after, but it was another five minutes before she came back to take our food order. The food then took an excruciating 50 minutes to arrive, which felt like an eternity, as that was roughly how long I had anticipated spending there.

yelp:train:45139.orig: Been visiting Padre Murphy's for years! Always dependable for some good Irish food and definitely the fried fish. Love the fact you can eat drink and bet on races at the same time at the same place what more could you ask for?
yelp:train:45139.para: I've been frequenting Padre Murphy's for ages! It's consistently reliable for great Irish cuisine, especially their fried fish. What I really appreciate is that you can dine, drink, and place bets on races all in one spot—what else do you need?

yelp:train:45863.orig: I was severely disappointed with my trip to Sakana. I remember coming to this restaurant and it being good quality, however I this trip changed my opinion. While I will say that the wait-staff was nice and the atmosphere was ok, the food quality was below average. I had a selection of nigiri and most of the pieces were dry and had a \""fishy\"" taste to them. Both attributes that I associate with low quality fish. I was disappointed with my visit.
yelp:train:45863.para: My recent visit to Sakana left me quite disappointed. Although I recall the restaurant being of good quality in the past, this time altered my perception. While the service was pleasant and the ambiance acceptable, the food quality was subpar. The nigiri I ordered was mostly dry and had a distinct "fishy" taste, which are characteristics I typically associate with poor-quality fish. Overall, I was let down by my experience.
