yelp:train:46357.orig:
My girlfriend and I went here on Saturday night around 7:15 PM.  It was nearly full.  Here are my impressions.

1) Service : dreadful.  It took literally 20 minutes for someone to take our drink orders and another 20 minutes to receive them and bread.  There was only one server for the entire restaurant, including the outside patio.  Another 15 minutes later we received the caprese which was adequate.  Water glasses and drinks remained empty far too long.  Waitress was snippy at times, too.

2) Food: I had the chicken saporito which was marginal.  The chicken was a bit rubbery but the sauce was okay.  The pasta was done well, however.  My girlfriend had shrimp fra diablo which was bland and not spicy in the least.  The sauce was watery and lukewarm.

3) Ambience:  Tense, people all over the restaurant were annoyed at the wait for service.  It's in a strip mall.  It's a hole in the wall.

4) Overall:  Stay away.  Poor food, dreadful service, we wasted $50.
yelp:train:46357.para:
On Saturday evening at about 7:15 PM, my girlfriend and I visited this place, which was nearly at full capacity. Here are my observations:

1) Service: It was extremely poor. It took about 20 minutes for our drink orders to be taken and another 20 minutes to receive them and bread. There was just one server for the entire establishment, including the outdoor seating area. Fifteen minutes later, we finally got our caprese, which was just okay. Our water glasses and drinks were left empty for far too long, and the waitress was often short-tempered.

2) Food: I ordered the chicken saporito, which was only average. The chicken was a bit chewy, but the sauce was decent. The pasta was cooked well, though. My girlfriend had the shrimp fra diablo, which was tasteless and not spicy at all. The sauce was watery and warm, not hot.

3) Atmosphere: The atmosphere was tense; everyone in the restaurant seemed frustrated with the long wait times. The location is in a strip mall, and it feels like a small, unremarkable spot.

4) Overall: Avoid this place. The food was subpar, and the service was terrible. We felt we wasted $50 on this experience.

yelp:train:46678.orig: Great community of people - love the outreach to the community!
yelp:train:46678.para: A wonderful community of individuals - I really appreciate the efforts to engage with the community!

yelp:train:46808.orig: While I do not disagree that the staff there is pleasant, I had the unfortunate need to use their services for a small wound that needed stitches and my regular Vet was closed.  I walked out with a bill for over $800.  This is completely ridiculous!  Buyer beware that in times when people are having to make cutbacks in their budgets, this office is contributing to people being forced to not seek proper care for their beloved pets.  Please seek reasonably priced care elsewhere.
yelp:train:46808.para: Although I acknowledge that the staff is friendly, I was compelled to utilize their services for my pet's wound that required stitches when my usual vet was unavailable. The charges exceeded $800, which I find utterly unreasonable. Be cautious; during budget cuts, this clinic may push pet owners to forego necessary care. I recommend finding more affordable options.

yelp:train:46972.orig: I worked for this company for many months up front and as a groomer. They use the cheapest shampoo they can buy. They also have their groomers use the same toothbrush on many many dogs. They do not clean their kennels on a regular basis, only if a pet has soiled the kennel other than that out of all the months I worked there the kennels were never cleaned. The manager is a nice girl but way too young and inexperienced to handle the job properly. They Have groomers there that abuse the animals. The owners are never there. When I was injured on the job they told me I can't go to the Dr if I do I have to pay for it due to another employee getting hurt and going to the Dr using workmans comp.They told me if I go using it they will raise their cost. So I had to seek treatment and pay for it myself.
yelp:train:46972.para: For several months, I was employed by this company as both a general worker and a groomer. They opted for the most affordable shampoos available. Additionally, the groomers shared the same toothbrush among numerous dogs. The kennels were rarely cleaned; they were only tidied up if a pet had an accident. Throughout my tenure, the kennels remained uncleaned otherwise. The manager, though kind, was far too young and inexperienced to manage the role effectively. There were groomers who mistreated the animals. The owners were rarely present. When I was injured on the job, I was informed that I couldn't see a doctor without paying for it myself, as another employee had previously used workers' compensation. If I sought medical treatment, they threatened to increase costs. Thus, I had to pay for my own treatment.

yelp:train:47365.orig:
This little gem is located inside of Sun Villiage, a 55+ community. However, it is open to the public.  My in laws live there and my mom is looking for a place in there as well. We decided to try out the restaurant which I have heard is pretty good. Mom and I go in for lunch, and wow, Im kind of shocked at the decor. Somehow, it isnt at all what I pictured.. It was well, a little diner.. with blue booths and chairs and dated.. but ok. 

We sit, have great service and both order from the ""basket menu"".. for $5-6.00 you get a giant beverage, and a basket with fries, and your choice of a burger, fish (this is what I have heard is great here) and shrimp, and oh, something else but I cant recall it now). Anyway... just great. I ordered the burger with cheese (it was extra) but it was the perfect portion size and just delish. Moms fish & chips... wow, my favorite. While I am not a fish or seafood person, I am slowly venturing into it by means of fish frys. I know, not the healthy way.. but my way nonetheless. I loved it.  Its nice and crispy but not too heavy with coating.  

It was good enough in fact that since it was a Friday night, I was telling my husband about the place and
yelp:train:47365.para:
This charming spot is nestled within Sun Village, a 55+ community, but welcomes everyone. My parents reside there, and my mom is searching for a place to live there too. We chose to give the restaurant a try, as I've heard it's quite good. We visited for lunch, and I was genuinely surprised by the decor—it wasn't at all what I expected. It turned out to be a quaint little diner with blue booths and chairs, and a somewhat dated feel, but it was still acceptable.

We were seated and received excellent service. Both of us ordered from the "basket menu," which costs between $5-6. You get a large drink and a basket with fries, plus your choice of a burger, fish (which is highly recommended here), or shrimp, and another option I can't quite remember now. Anyway, it was fantastic. I had the burger with cheese (an extra charge), and it was the perfect size, absolutely delicious. My mom's fish and chips were outstanding. Even though I'm not typically a fan of fish or seafood, I've been trying to incorporate it into my diet through fish fries. I really enjoyed it. It was nicely crispy but not overly coated. 

In fact, it was so good that on a Friday night, I was telling my husband about the place and

yelp:train:47435.orig: Just an amazing church. From Praise & Worship to the Message. My family has been looking for a church close to us and we found it.
yelp:train:47435.para: What a wonderful church! It excels in both praise and worship, as well as delivering the message. We've been searching for a church nearby, and we've finally found one that suits us.

yelp:train:47442.orig: Pretty decent location for a nice target store.\nWhen I lived in the area I would frequent this target location and was happy with the service and product selection.\nLocated in the surprise town center shopping district alongside many great shops.
yelp:train:47442.para: The location is quite good for a Target store. During my time in the area, I often visited this Target and was satisfied with both the service and the product range. It's situated in the Surprise Town Center shopping district, next to numerous other excellent stores.

yelp:train:47549.orig: Worst service experience ever!!  I had Fletchers change the brakes on my truck.  They will not set up an appointment, rather they have you bring the vehicle in at 7am.  I did just that, and didnt receive my truck back until after 3pm and several calls inquiring about the status.  Doesnt end there.  I had to take my truck back 2 months later because the brakes were squealing worse than when I originally brought it in.  Same story, no appointment, truck dropped off before 9am, and didnt get back until 5pm.  On top of that, they try pushing several other items on you.  Last time I ever use this company for anything.
yelp:train:47549.para: My experience with Fletcher's for brake work on my truck was horrendous! They refuse to schedule appointments, instead insisting I bring the vehicle in early in the morning. I did so on the first visit, only to pick it up late afternoon after multiple calls. The issue wasn't resolved, and two months later, I had to return because the brakes were even noisier. Again, no appointment, drop-off before 9am, and pickup after 5pm. They also tried to upsell additional services. This will be my last time dealing with this company.

yelp:train:47621.orig: Our first dining experience at Bucca was awful.  The service sucked and food  was awful.  A few months later decided to try again. Service was good and salad was good, however, the baked rigatoni we ordered took some time to be served to us  and when we did get it, it was lukewarm.  The  serving bowl was hot but the food was not which told us it was microwaved.  We shall not frequent this restaurant again. The manager did not find it necessary to come our table  to apologize but had the waitress tell us it would be taken off the bill. No further compensation offered. The waitress did suggest we take the food home  but we declined. Why would we take home what we didn't enjoy there.  No recommendations from us to visit this establishment. We could write a book from the other horrific experience  but why bother?
yelp:train:47621.para: Our initial visit to Bucca was extremely disappointing. The service was poor, and the food was terrible. A few months later, we decided to give them another chance. This time, the service was better, and the salad was enjoyable, but the baked rigatoni we ordered was served late and was lukewarm. The serving bowl was warm, but the food itself was not, indicating it had been microwaved. We won't be returning to this restaurant. The manager didn't even stop by to apologize; instead, the waitress offered to remove the charge from our bill. No additional compensation was provided. The waitress suggested we take the food home, but we declined. There's no point in taking home something we didn't enjoy. We won't be recommending this place to anyone. We could recount many more negative experiences, but there's no need to go into detail.

yelp:train:47853.orig: We had the coupon special $14.00 Rib-eye the overall service was very good! very impressed by wait staff, but our steaks were not good at all, kinda tough, and not tasty at all, just taste like grilled cardboard, not flavor of beef, hummm! not sure why, I've been to other firebirds and never had this to happen. We paid over $50 for our meal celebrating our 32nd year anniversary, and I felt cheated. I took my steak home to see if I can revive it to taste better, too much money wasted on it.
yelp:train:47853.para: The coupon offered a Rib-eye for $14.00, and while the service was excellent, our steaks were disappointing. They were quite tough and lacked any beef flavor, tasting more like grilled cardboard. This was unusual for me, as I've enjoyed other meals at Firebirds. We spent over $50 on our anniversary dinner and felt cheated. I even took my steak home to see if I could improve its taste, but it was a waste of money.

yelp:train:47913.orig: Average to poor food. I've had orange chicken, a salad, and chicken enchiladas. They all sucked. They all cost more then they should have.
yelp:train:47913.para: The food was mediocre at best. I tried orange chicken, a salad, and chicken enchiladas, and I found them all disappointing. Additionally, the prices seemed higher than they ought to be.

yelp:train:48416.orig: Best karate center ever.Highly recommend attending. Teachers are firm but fair. Facility is good and students are friendly.
yelp:train:48416.para: This is the absolute best karate center. I strongly recommend you visit. The instructors are strict yet fair. The place itself is great, and the students are very friendly.

yelp:train:48783.orig: Very slow service, over 55 minutes to check out . Lady did not know what she's doing.
yelp:train:48783.para: The service was extremely slow, taking more than 55 minutes to complete the checkout. The lady seemed unsure of what she was doing.

yelp:train:48933.orig:
Best Hawaiian food in Vegas by far!!!! The mochico chicken and fried rice is a must! 

The place is run by local ppl from Hawaii and not by Chinese ppl like L&L that's how you know food is done the right way.  

The prices are pretty reasonable considering the amount of food you get on your plate.  On average $6 you get meat of your choice 2 scoops of rice (or for me i get the fried rice), and macaroni salad.  

I highly recommend Ross J's to anyone from hawaii thats missing that island flavor and to everyone else willing to experience HAWAII'S VERSION OF ""SOUL FOOD""!
yelp:train:48933.para:
Absolutely top-notch Hawaiian cuisine in Vegas! The mochico chicken and fried rice are definitely a must-try.

This place is operated by locals from Hawaii, not by Chinese owners like L&L, ensuring the authentic taste.

The prices are quite reasonable given the generous portion sizes. On average, you can get your choice of meat, two scoops of rice (or fried rice for me), and macaroni salad for around $6.

I strongly recommend Ross J's to anyone from Hawaii craving that island flavor, and to everyone else looking to experience true HAWAIIAN "SOULED" FOOD!

yelp:train:48961.orig: Solid food for the price. One can easily get by with spending $6 for lunch. For a mixed special rice bowl with spicy chicken cost me that. What you get? A large bowl of rice is piled high with meat and doused with teriyaki sauce. I didn't know that there were no veggies, but they offer a side of them for an additional $1. \n\nThe service is warm and quick. It is no surprise that they have so many people stopping in to get lunch.
yelp:train:48961.para: The meal is quite affordable, as one can comfortably spend $6 on lunch. My mixed special rice bowl with spicy chicken came to that price. What you receive is a generous portion of rice topped with meat and coated in teriyaki sauce. I was unaware that there were no vegetables included, but they do offer a side for an extra $1. The service is both friendly and swift, which explains why so many people come for lunch.

yelp:train:49784.orig: Great service and yummilicious ice cream!!!  5 stars in my book
yelp:train:49784.para: I received fantastic service and absolutely delicious ice cream! I would give it a perfect 5-star rating.

yelp:train:51225.orig:
Hands down the best sandwich shop in town. Their signature sandwiches such as the Bobbie and Capastrami are second to none. If your ever in the mood for a sandwich, skip Subway and Quizno's and head to your local Capriotti's Sandwich shop!

**NOTE**

-Make sure to tip these guys out as they are all very appreciative for the beer money. :)
yelp:train:51225.para:
Capriotti's Sandwich Shop is undoubtedly the top choice for sandwiches in town. Their signature dishes, like the Bobbie and Capastrami, are unparalleled. Whenever you're in the mood for a sandwich, consider skipping Subway and Quizno's and instead visit your local Capriotti's.

**NOTE**

- Don't forget to tip them, as they greatly appreciate it, especially for a cold one. :))

yelp:train:51590.orig: While the food was ok, they shorted me 2 soups, 2 egg rolls, and 2 crab rangoons.  I don't like getting ripped off, so that makes China A Go Go, a no no!  $28 for $20 worth of food.  No thanks!  It's like buying a 20 ounce coke, and only getting 16 ounces.
yelp:train:51590.para: Although the food was satisfactory, I was shortchanged on 2 soups, 2 egg rolls, and 2 crab rangoons. Not appreciating being cheated, China A Go Go is now off my list. Paying $28 for what amounts to $20 worth of food feels like it. It’s akin to purchasing a 20-ounce Coke and receiving only 16 ounces.

yelp:train:51612.orig:
Shop here quite a bit, love the fresh produce selections,

Just want to compliment the fact the have cactus pears in which my mother in law loves to eat.

One of only a few stores in town that carry these.
yelp:train:51612.para:
I frequent this store often and really appreciate the variety of fresh produce they offer.

I especially wanted to mention that they have cactus pears, which my mother-in-law enjoys eating. 

This is one of the few places in town that stocks them.

yelp:train:51802.orig: Played Rio Secco yesterday and it was extremely slow due to the groups in front of us using the girl caddies ( that they paid $200 per girl)...so they were in no rush to play golf...it was mostly drinking and slow play by the groups in front of us....to top it off the staff encourages this kind of frat party environment...so if you are a real golfer skip this place as quick as you can...plus it is over priced and poor condition ( the traps are dirt and gravel )...Las Vegas and Henderson have numerous great courses...try them out and don't bother the hassle of Rio Secco and their poor customer service
yelp:train:51802.para: Yesterday, I played at Rio Secco, which was incredibly slow because the groups ahead of us were using the female caddies, who they paid $200 each. These groups weren't in a hurry, spending most of their time drinking and playing slowly. The staff even seemed to encourage this party-like atmosphere. If you're a serious golfer, avoid Rio Secco at all costs. It's also overpriced and in poor condition—some of the traps are just dirt and gravel. Las Vegas and Henderson have many excellent courses; give those a try instead, as Rio Secco offers poor customer service.

yelp:train:51900.orig: Trying to figure out why they charged me $14 for two pairs of dress pants. They did offer me a 10% off coupon bringing the total down to $12.60. Still not good enough.
yelp:train:51900.para: I'm puzzled by the $14 charge for two dress pants. While they did give me a 10% off coupon, reducing the price to $12.60, it's still not acceptable.

yelp:train:51914.orig: Yes the food is good. But the service?  Depends on who you get...Sheryl and Rhonda are great but the men???  The young guys are pretty good but the older men should really take some classes. We took 2 business associates out for dinner. The first bottle of wine was good except the waiter  forgot to give me some wine after I did the tasting. When the second bottle came he brought 1 new glass, let me taste out of the new glass then proceeded to refill everyone else's glass even though it still had wine in it!  Come on...for the price of the food you would think the waiters would at least know how to pour wine correctly!!!  The older men including the host (at least the night we were there) did not have a very professional attitude...when we arrived ahead of our guests and told the host this, he said, \""well, do you wanna sit down?\"".  Hmmm, I think the next time we will take our money to a more professional place.
yelp:train:51914.para: The food is indeed tasty, but the service quality varies. Sheryl and Rhonda are excellent, but the male staff need improvement. The younger men are decent, but the older ones should consider some training. We had two business associates for dinner. With the first wine, the waiter forgot to provide a taste glass after the initial tasting. For the second bottle, he only brought one new glass, let me taste from it, and then refilled everyone else's glass despite it still having wine. This is unacceptable for a restaurant at that price point! The waiters should know basic wine service. The older staff, including the host, seemed unprofessional. When we arrived early and informed the host, he merely asked if we wanted to sit down. This attitude is not professional. We might choose a more professional establishment next time.

yelp:train:51951.orig: Service at the bar was great, the wine was great, but the food wasn't that great! Your typical franchise Italian restaurant!!
yelp:train:51951.para: The service at the bar was excellent, and the wine was fantastic, but the food fell short of expectations. It's a standard franchise Italian restaurant.

yelp:train:53470.orig: The absolute worst nail experience I have ever had !!! I went for a gel manicure and a pedicure.  Mimi was not pleasant nor friendly, never smiled, no personality.  Then the tools were not sterilized ! And there was no cleaning of my feet with any nice abrasive scrub.  I actually have to go home and work on my feet with my own products and tools.  She finished with a very quick polish and then started my manicure .  I noticed there was polish all around the skin of my toes .  Very sloppy ! Of course I asked her to clean it up which she did .  Then the manicure .  I had a tear in my nail . Usually don't they just repair it . Not Mimi .  She was ready to polish right over it .  So I asked before she polishes if she would repair the nail .  She said if you want perfect nails get acrylics ! Miss personality ! I picked a color based on their selections .  Well another horrible experience ! The color looks nothing like the chart she shows you ! My nails are almost black.  She said the sample was only one coat ! Ha ! Even with one coat it was nothing like the color on my nails. Then she asked if I wanted to start over with a new color .  By this time all I wanted was this experience to be
yelp:train:53470.para: What a terrible nail experience I've had! I got a gel manicure and pedicure, but it was far from ideal. Mimi wasn't friendly at all; she didn't smile and seemed to lack any personality. The tools weren't sterilized, and there was no foot scrub with a nice scrubbing tool. I had to clean my feet at home with my own products. She quickly did the polish, and then started my manicure. I noticed polish around my toe skin, which was very messy. I asked her to clean it up, and she did. For the manicure, she didn't fix a tear in my nail, instead, she was about to polish over it. When I asked her to repair the nail, she suggested getting acrylics for perfect nails. I chose a color from their selection, but it was a disaster. The color on my nails looks nothing like the one shown in the chart; they are almost black. She said the sample was just one coat, but even with that, it didn't match. She then offered to start over with a new color, but by then, I just wanted this experience to end.

yelp:train:53510.orig: Fantastic coffee shop! It definitely has that cozy atmosphere that reminds me of coffee shops in my small college town. The staff was awesome and very friendly too! They were great about giving me reccommendations on the best food to eat. I also got a chai tea latte which was amazing! 5 stars for sure! Will definitely be back!
yelp:train:53510.para: What a wonderful coffee shop! It exudes a cozy ambiance reminiscent of the coffee shops in my college town. The staff were fantastic and incredibly friendly, offering great recommendations for the best foods to try. I also had a chai tea latte that was outstanding! I'm giving it a solid 5 stars and I'll definitely return!

yelp:train:53800.orig: Service here is horrible!  They always seem to forget that were there. And there's always an Asian guy here who gives attitude as he's serving us.  Maybe because we always get all you can eat KBBQ and we can eat like bottomless pits.\n\nAs me and my friends quickly eat the first serving of brisket, we ask for another, we notice something different, turns out they gave us beef tongue instead.
yelp:train:53800.para:
The service here is really poor; it often feels like they don't acknowledge our presence. Additionally, there's an Asian server who tends to be grumpy while serving us. Perhaps it's because we frequently order all-you-can-eat KBBQ and can eat a lot. 

As my friends and I quickly finish our first portion of brisket, we request more. To our surprise, we get beef tongue instead.

yelp:train:55525.orig: The steak was good... Very cool old gangster atmosphere. This place has some old roots... Cool restaurant.
yelp:train:55525.para: The steak was delicious... There's a really intriguing old-school gangster vibe here. It has a lot of history... A cool place to eat.

yelp:train:55873.orig: This place really doesn't have much selection.  At all.  I guess I expected a store this large that carries JUST home goods to have, well, more home goods.  There is just a lot of empty space.  Maybe I got my hopes up to see something unique or different.  But really, when I visited, it was the same stuff you can find at my local Macy's... just more of each particular item.  \n\nBoo.  I wanted to like this.
yelp:train:55873.para: This store surprisingly lacks variety, completely so. I assumed a big home goods store would offer a wider range. The place feels mostly empty. Perhaps I was hoping for something distinctive. But honestly, what I found was just more of the same items available at my local Macy's. Disappointingly, I was hoping to find something special here.

yelp:train:56069.orig: Horrible! It must be under new management, the last time I came here it was way better. This time I had to wait for 2 people that came after me before I even got started. I had to walk out I was so upset. NEVER COME HERE.
yelp:train:56069.para: Terrible experience! It seems they've changed management recently, as the place was much better the last time I visited. This time, I had to wait for two other customers to be served before it was my turn, which was unacceptable. I left in a huff and am so disappointed. I definitely won't be returning.

yelp:train:56813.orig:
This was my second attempt at getting a deal here which is elusive at best. Even with insurance, 2 pairs of glasses cost us over $200. This is the first pair of glasses I've bought since age 14 that did NOT fit properly at all! I'm trying to calm down before I go back to fix this fiasco. The glasses in 1 hour does not exist. You can ask and get your hand slapped. Go ahead. You're a big girl. 

Last time I was there, I made the mistake of getting my exam at Red Rock Eye Care. I had a $10 copay for an exam and they tried to charge me $150 for me and my son, NOT including contact Rx! We were the only people there and forced to wait with an antsy 3 year old for over an hour. Then they didn't want to give me the Rx's until we cam back for another visit to check contact fitting! Total BS scam! 

Then we exited eye doctor room into store where eyeglass world employees-all dudes-were hypnotized by twerk videos on YouTube. Classy.
yelp:train:56813.para:
My second try at securing a deal here was challenging, as deals are hard to come by. Despite insurance, two pairs of glasses still cost over $200. This is the first time since I was 14 that the glasses I bought did not fit properly at all! I'm trying to stay calm before I return to address this issue. The "glasses in an hour" service is a myth; you might as well try and get a handshake instead. 

Previously, I fell into the trap of getting my exam at Red Rock Eye Care. I had a $10 copay, but they attempted to charge me $150 for both my son and me, not including contact lens prescriptions! We were the sole customers and had to wait for over an hour with a restless 3-year-old. They wouldn't provide the prescriptions until we returned for another visit to check the contact lens fit. That was a total scam! 

Upon leaving the eye doctor's office, we entered the store where the Eyeglass World staff—entirely male—were engrossed in twerk videos on YouTube. Not exactly the image I had in mind.

yelp:train:57160.orig:
I usually come here a lot and never complain about anything. When I came here this time I  ordered their icy strawberry jelly drink with squid balls and wings. 

When I got my drink and took one sip....OMG I seriously thought I drank pure
Strawberry syrup with crushed ice. It was so sweet I had to ask for water and pour half it in there to dilute it. I didn't bother complaining because I fixed it with water. 

Other than that the wings were slightly over cooked and I loved the squid balls.
yelp:train:57160.para:
I frequently visit this place without ever having any complaints. This time, I ordered their icy strawberry jelly drink with squid balls and wings. 

Upon receiving my drink and taking a sip, it was overwhelmingly sweet; I almost thought I was drinking pure strawberry syrup with crushed ice. The sweetness was so intense that I had to ask for water and mix half of it in to balance the flavor. I didn't bother to complain since I managed to dilute it myself.

Apart from that, the wings were a bit overcooked, but I really enjoyed the squid balls.

yelp:train:57315.orig: The room was okay. Nothing was gross or anything. Everything in the room seemed like it was from the 70-80s.. no renovated anything. \n\nThe hotel seemed to be full of crackheads and gangsters. If you have little kids this is probably not the best place to say. My friends and I got woken up at 6:00am by the loud thumping of a cars stereo system. It lasted at least and hour. I think it took so long to have someone tell them to turn it down out of fear of getting shot or something.
yelp:train:57315.para: The room was fine, with nothing particularly unpleasant about it. It appeared to be furnished in a 70s or 80s style, with no recent renovations. The hotel felt like it was frequented by people who might not be the most pleasant company, and I wouldn't recommend it if you have young children. My friends and I were disturbed at 6 a.m. by the loud car stereo, which played for over an hour. I suspect it took so long for someone to ask them to turn it down due to concerns about potential violence.

yelp:train:57818.orig: I had perhaps the worst business/merchant experience in my life here. I was charged for $700 worth of entertainment and actually only received about $300 worth. Which itself was outrageously over priced. Then they continued to try and charge another $330 on my credit card which they said wouldn't go through. That was for other fees that I did not agree to , nor did I receive services for! \nI complained to management twice but they wouldn't do anything for me. I urge you not to visit this establishment. If you do, certainly do not, under no circumstance agree to go to VIP room. That is where the ripoff begins! The same thing happened to a friend of mine this same night, only on a smaller scale. I am going to try to take this to a higher level. Checking legal sources first!
yelp:train:57818.para: My experience as a customer was undoubtedly the worst I've ever encountered. I was billed for $700 worth of entertainment but received only about $300, which was already excessively priced. Furthermore, they attempted to charge an additional $330 on my card for fees I neither agreed to nor received services for. I reported this issue to management twice, but no action was taken. I strongly advise against visiting this place. If you do go, absolutely do not enter the VIP room; that's where the scam starts. A friend of mine had a similar experience that night, albeit on a smaller scale. I plan to pursue this matter further, starting by checking legal options.

yelp:train:58144.orig: I don't understand all the glowing reviews of this place.  The mashed potatoes and gravy were INSTANT and kraut came from a can.  I cannot say enough that for 12.50, someone had better have at least BOILED the potatoes.  Over priced, it deserves to be on Kitchen Nightmares.  Unless we just happed to be there on the one day in their history to have used instant and prepackaged things, I would pass it on by.  Their kitchen has at least 3 microwaves visible from the dining area, and they charge for lunch avg $15 a plate?  No thank you.
yelp:train:58144.para: I'm puzzled by the overwhelmingly positive feedback for this establishment. The mashed potatoes and gravy were clearly made with instant mix, and the sauerkraut was from a can. For $12.50, the potatoes should have been at least freshly boiled. It's overpriced, and the kitchen seems to rely heavily on instant and prepackaged items. Given that I witnessed multiple microwaves and the lunch prices average $15 per plate, I wouldn't recommend it.

yelp:train:58339.orig:

(We had six small dishes of a seaweed salad, bean sprouts, kim-chi, potato pancake, fish cake). We ordered the Cha Dol Baeki (thin sliced beef with no marinade) and a soup. Both were really, really good. My friend asked for a lot of other little things (lettuce to wrap the me
yelp:train:58339.para:
A few days ago, after attending the CES Show, my girlfriend and I arrived here. Our plan was to visit Lotus of Siam, which is in the same shopping center, but it wasn't open yet at 5:05. So, we opted for Korean BBQ instead, choosing a place called "Elephant BBQ," not "Elephant Snack," as the latter only appears on the receipt.

We struggled to get the waitress's attention; there were only three other tables in the restaurant. It took a while for her to reach us, as she was busy with another table nearby. By 5:27, after waiting for nearly half an hour with nothing on our tables and feeling quite hungry, we considered leaving and going back to Lotus of Siam. Eventually, she brought us some water, and my friend asked for the small starters, which turned out to be quite fresh and tasty. We had six small dishes: seaweed salad, bean sprouts, kimchi, potato pancakes, and fish cakes. We also ordered Cha Dol Baeki (thinly sliced beef without marinade) and a soup, both of which were really delicious. My friend then requested more items, including lettuce to wrap the meat.

yelp:train:58526.orig: Food is just amazing. Associates are very funny. As food food I suggest kalderetang kambing (goat) it's the bomb.com and halo halo for desert is a killer!!!
yelp:train:58526.para: The food is incredible, and the staff are quite humorous. For a meal, I highly recommend kalderetang kambing—it's outstanding. And for dessert, halo halo is simply phenomenal!

yelp:train:58759.orig: Store puts labels incorrectly and do not stand by the label price.
yelp:train:58759.para: The store places labels inaccurately and fails to honor the labeled prices.

yelp:train:58943.para: Visited there due to hiccups, and the process was swift. Shortly after, a PA attended to me. The situation quickly deteriorated from there. They drew blood, and the PA concluded I was having a heart attack. They insisted I go to either Valley or UMC, but neither was my preference. Where are my choices? Despite being at the hospital, I wasn't fed, and my stress test came back normal. My hiccup issue was never addressed, which is disappointing.

yelp:train:59211.orig: Horrible customer service. Had to talk to 3 different employees to locate a portable iPhone charger. Not because the employees didn't know the answer, but because no one was willing to help. Just short answers and \""it's over there\"" type of responses.
yelp:train:59211.para: Terrible customer service experience. I spoke with three employees to find a portable iPhone charger, yet no one seemed willing to assist properly. They provided brief, unhelpful responses like "it's over there."

yelp:train:60759.orig: DO NOT GO HERE. I went to her as a child for orthodontics and it was such a horrible experience that my dad made her remove them. Then 8 years later i've had to have another set of braces due to her poor treatment! DO NOT GO HERE!!!!
yelp:train:60759.para: AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS. I visited her as a child for orthodontic work, and the experience was so terrible that my dad had her remove the braces. Eight years later, I found myself needing another set of braces because of her subpar treatment. AVOID THIS PLACE!!!!

yelp:train:60833.orig: I played this course today and have played in the past as well. Today the course was in excellent condition, the grass on the tee boxes was a little long and some is the sand traps were not taken care of ( hard and wet ), but the fairways were in great condition as well as the greens. Now I know everyone says 4 to 4 1/2 hours is an acceptable time to play a round of golf but I don't agree with that, anyone can easily shave off an hour at least if they just played the game and acted like they were pros. It took our group 4 1/2 hours to play 18 holes today and on a few tee boxes there were two to three groups backed up all because one group ahead of us had no time management or common courtesy to move along at a quicker pace, they would wait until the group ahead of them cleared the green before teeing off and from the way I saw them hitting the ball, there was no need for them to wait, there was also no marshal on the course to help move along play, I know my group can and has played a round in about three and a half hours and we are not rushing at all. It's just a sad state that someone, somewhere said it should take that long to play a round and so people make it take that long an
yelp:train:60833.para: I've played this course before and today was no exception. The course was in top-notch condition, with the fairways and greens in particular looking great. However, the grass on the tee boxes was a bit long, and some of the sand traps were in poor shape, being hard and wet. Despite these minor issues, the overall experience was positive. While many say it's acceptable to take 4 to 4.5 hours to complete a round, I believe that's unnecessary. My group managed to play 18 holes in just 4.5 hours, but we saw several groups delayed because the group in front of us was moving very slowly. They waited for the group ahead to clear the green before teeing off, even though their play didn't require such a delay. There was no marshal to help expedite play. My group, and many others, can easily finish in around 3.5 hours without rushing. It's disappointing that some people think it should take that long, leading others to prolong their rounds.

yelp:train:60970.orig:
I don't think this is a 1 star place by any means. I've been here twice now. They have been consistent, which is all I need from a haircut.

I haven't had to wait either time. The first was a true weekday morning, and the second was today, Memorial Day. They were actually open, which is nice. The first time, the lady (I think Valerie was her name) was patient enough to explain why they needed my name and phone # (it's for keeping track of when I go and who my hair is) and to work through my uncertainty with the size of the clipper attachments.

The haircuts each seemed to take no more than 10 minutes - surprising since I think it used to take longer at my last barber shop - and the ladies are nice enough not to try to chat with you much if you're quiet (I'm not a very chatty person).

I will gladly continue to return, especially if they keep providing Valpak coupons online. I wanted to help the rating with 5 stars, but I'm keeping it at 4 stars since there's nothing mindblowingly awesome about it.
yelp:train:60970.para:
I definitely wouldn't rate this place as a 1-star establishment. I've visited twice, and the consistency has been reassuring, particularly for my haircuts.

I haven't had to wait either time. On the first visit, it was a regular weekday morning, and today was Memorial Day. They were open, which is a plus. During my first visit, the stylist (I believe her name was Valerie) patiently explained the need for my name and phone number for tracking purposes and helped me with my hesitation about the clipper attachments.

Each haircut seemed to take no more than 10 minutes, which is surprising given that it used to take longer at my previous barber. The stylists are considerate enough not to push conversation if I'm not inclined to chat, as I tend to be more reserved.

I plan to keep coming back, especially if they continue to offer Valpak coupons online. While I wanted to give it a 5-star rating, I've settled on 4 stars because there's nothing exceptionally outstanding about it.

yelp:train:61096.orig: I really feel comfortable and pampered here. I've never enjoyed mani's and pedi's before because no one really explained what I was supposed to do. Linda, who first helped me, was very patient and explained everything. Only lost one star because sometimes they take too many walk-ins.
yelp:train:61096.para: I genuinely feel at ease and well-cared for here. I had never truly enjoyed mani and pedi treatments before because the instructions were never clear. Linda, who assisted me initially, was extremely patient and walked me through everything. The only reason I didn't give it a perfect score is that they sometimes have too many walk-in customers.

yelp:train:62509.orig:
I should've known better than to come here, but I was out running errands, was starving and saw this place as I drove out of the nearby CVS. The restaurant looks like an older run down place serving up Americanized Chinese food. The whole time I was sitting inside and reading the menu I felt unsure if I really wanted to eat here but I told myself I should at least try it since I was there. I ordered a beef chow fun to go since it's kind of hard to mess that dish up so I figured I was safe.
 
When my order was ready it was handed to be in a bag where I noticed they didn't provide utensils or chopsticks but I was too lazy to go back in since I was already in the car. Strike 1. When I opened the box I noticed that the portions were way smaller than most other Chinese places while they are charging a full entree price ($8.50-10.00)  for everything including the beef chow fun. Strike 2. The beef was fully cooked but had a weird taste to it and the dish overall just seemed bland. Strike 3. 

I would not recommend this place at all and even Panda Express would be a better choice since their food has more flavor. This place also has a $20 card minimum so bring cash if you're not going
yelp:train:62509.para:
I shouldn't have come here, but I was hungry after running errands and spotted the place while leaving the CVS nearby. The restaurant appeared old and rundown, serving Americanized Chinese food. While perusing the menu inside, I felt uncertain about ordering but decided to give it a try. I opted for beef chow mein to go, thinking it would be a safe choice.

Upon receiving my order in a bag without utensils, I decided not to return for them since I was already in my car. Strike one. When I opened the box, I noticed the portions were much smaller than at other Chinese restaurants, and the prices ($8.50-10.00) were the same for everything, including the beef chow mein. Strike two. The beef was overcooked and had an odd taste, making the dish seem bland. Strike three.

I wouldn't recommend this place at all; even Panda Express would be a better option due to its more flavorful food. This restaurant also requires a $20 minimum for a card, so bring cash if you plan to visit.

yelp:train:62528.orig:
Good deeds? Great deals? I don't know...

I have a disability, EM (Erythromelalgia). Store manager, Ben Niebauer, rudely discriminated against me by requiring me leave the Savers located at 3121 N. Rancho Dr. in Las Vegas, NV. I had spent quite a bit of time & effort picking out cloths to try  on. He would not let me try them on. He threatened to call the police to have me removed, even though I explained my handi-capped condition & showed him a letter from my doctor. I said I would sign a letter relieving Savers of all responsibility for my safety. He continued to threaten to call the police, but he didn't. All he did was get louder & more aggressive. So I told him I would call the police. I went outside with my mother to wait for the police. When they arrived, the police were told he had left.
I have never encountered this kind of treatment for being disabled.

(For more info on EM: http://www.erythromelalgia.org/WhatisEM.aspx). 

Did I see good deeds or great deals? No, but I would have liked to.
yelp:train:62528.para:
I faced a challenging situation at Savers on 3121 N. Rancho Dr. in Las Vegas, NV, where the store manager, Ben Niebauer, treated me unfairly due to my disability, EM (Erythromelalgia). Despite spending considerable time and effort selecting clothes to try on, he refused to allow me to do so. He even threatened to call the police to remove me, despite my explanation of my condition and presentation of a doctor's letter. I offered to sign a liability waiver, but he persisted in his threats, becoming increasingly aggressive. Eventually, I threatened to call the police and went outside with my mother to wait for them. By the time the police arrived, the store manager had already left.

This was the first time I've experienced such discrimination as a disabled person.

Did I find any good deeds or great deals? Unfortunately, no, but that’s what I hoped for.

yelp:train:62958.orig:
I have had 2 experiences at Summerlin Hospital.

I will say the place is very neat and clean. The water fountains were so polished and clean you actually didn't mind drinking from them.

The first experience I had was when my Nephew was born in October 2011..
I felt that the Maternity Ward was a bit difficult to find and there weren't enough signs to point you in the right direction.
When we did find it and ask for my Sister-in Laws room the Nurses acted like we were bothering them which made us a bit uncomfortable.

The second time was when my man extreme pain and was bleeding from the mouth. Even though he was bleeding and rolling around on the floor in pain (there were only 3 others waiting and all so sick they were vomiting on the floor) they would not see him right away and said it would be a 3 hour wait. 
We chose to go to another Hospital and he only waited 15 minutes to be seen.
yelp:train:62958.para:
I've visited Summerlin Hospital twice, and while the facility is very tidy and the water fountains are spotlessly clean, making them a pleasant choice for hydration, my experiences were mixed.

In October 2011, when my nephew was born, I found the Maternity Ward hard to locate, with insufficient directional signs. Once we found it and asked for my sister-in-law's room, the nurses seemed irritated, which was uncomfortable.

On another occasion, when my partner was in extreme pain and bleeding from the mouth, there were only three others waiting, all in critical condition. Despite this, we were told to wait three hours. We ended up choosing another hospital, where my partner was seen within 15 minutes.

yelp:train:63274.orig:
Food is decent. Service needs help. Walked in 8pm, place not even 1/3 full and immediately told I'll be right with you. No hi welcome or nicety. More like what you would expect from flos diner. 
Seated and waited WAY too long for menus and drinks to order. 
Maybe I am too critical but I expect my water to be refilled without asking, to be asked - when my beer is empty - if I would like another, be checked on during appetizers and the meal as to if we are enjoying the meal and is everything good. 
With all that being said and the food being adequate there are many other choices with better pizza and service - which may be why the place was 2/3 empty. I will move onto other places - good luck
yelp:train:63274.para:
The food is acceptable, but the service could use improvement. Upon arrival at 8 pm, the restaurant was less than a third full, yet we were promptly told we'd be served right away, with no greeting or courtesy. It felt more like the service at a budget diner.

We were seated, but had to wait an unusually long time for our menus and drinks to arrive. Typically, I expect my water to be refilled without having to ask, for my beer to be refilled when it's empty, and for some attention during the meal to ensure everything is to our satisfaction.

Given the service and the food quality, there are plenty of other options with better pizza and service, which might explain why the place was only two-thirds full. I'll explore other restaurants; good luck with your business.

yelp:train:63729.orig: Great for the price. Nice and cozy. Was expecting much less. Cheap and not too far from anything
yelp:train:63729.para: Priced well, it's also very comfortable and snug. I had lower expectations, but it exceeded them. It's affordable and conveniently located near everything.

yelp:train:63850.orig:
So I found this place from Yelp and it was the closest Barber shop to my location.  I was able to walk in without an appointment on Saturday at 11:30am and was seated immediately.  That was awesome because the place was busy I just got lucky I guess.

I was told over the phone a haircut was $11 but found out the Fohawk cut I was getting was $13.  Still a bargain though because the guy did a great job.  Love the classic Barber shop style where they use a proper razor.

When the Barber finished up I was surprised to learn that he was Nelson!  Definitely will be coming back next month.
yelp:train:63850.para:
I discovered this barber shop on Yelp, and it turned out to be the nearest one to my location. I walked in un预约制，时间是周六上午11:30，立刻就被安排坐下。这真是太棒了，因为店里人很多，我算是挺幸运的。

电话里说理发11美元，但我的Fohawk发型是13美元。不过，理发师手艺很好，这个价格还是挺划算的。我喜欢那种传统的理发店风格，他们用的是正宗的剃须刀。

理发师完成工作后，我惊讶地得知他叫Nelson！我肯定会下次再来。

yelp:train:63993.orig: Food is mediocre but the fact is its so damn cold to eat here. Would maybe be 3 stars, if they cared at all about the temp. \nThe four groups eating here are complaining and huddled in one small area where it's all the way up to 50 degrees.
yelp:train:63993.para: The food is average, but the real issue is how unbearably cold it is to eat here. It would rate about three stars if the place weren't so neglectful of the temperature. The four groups dining here are all bundled up and huddled together in one small area, where it's a cozy 50 degrees.

yelp:train:64075.orig:
