yelp:train:64479.orig: just went in today to get new tires and 1 of the new tire they gave me was 10 PSI lower than the recommended air pressure. I later find out there is  slow leak on the new tire. \n\nupdated: Had to get it fixed next morning before work. They were quick to fix the problem. i was told there was a leak on the sensor probably from the tire change.  they apologized and cleaned my tires so i moved it from 1 star to 4 stars.
yelp:train:64479.para:
Today, I had new tires installed, and one of the new tires turned out to be 10 PSI below the recommended pressure. I discovered later that there's a slow leak in that tire. 

Updated: I had to get it fixed the following morning before work. They addressed the issue promptly. I was informed that the leak likely came from the sensor, possibly due to the tire change. They apologized and cleaned my tires, which prompted me to raise my rating from 1 star to 4 stars.

yelp:train:64704.orig: I was very disappointed with my recent service. I realized it was busy and was told it would take 40 minutes, no worries, but when I noticed they 'mark' your car with a white marker - it is to tell the workers what level of service you paid for which determines your place in line.  After waiting 1 hour, 20 minutes and seeing  many others who came after me had come and gone, I was not happy.  I mentioned to the service person what happened and he did not deny it and said he was sorry. I will not longer spend my lunch hour at this place!
yelp:train:64704.para: I was quite disappointed with the service I received recently. Initially, I was informed it would take about 40 minutes, but when I saw my car marked with a white marker to indicate the level of service, I became concerned. After waiting for 1 hour and 20 minutes, I noticed several cars that had arrived later than me had already been serviced. This was frustrating. When I brought it up with the service staff, he acknowledged the situation and apologized, but it didn't change my negative experience. I won't be spending my lunch hour there anymore.

yelp:train:64762.orig: After years of passing by this place we finally decided to stop and try it, and i'm glad to say it did not let us down. The chicken wings and ribs were delicious and freshly grilled. The mac&cheese was good but the mash potatoes were salty, the corn is out of a can but i don't care since i didn't go for the corn. The cucumber salad is really good too. The place was very clean and has good customer service. All in all we will be back soon.  loved the outdoor seating!
yelp:train:64762.para: After several years of walking by, we finally decided to give it a try, and I'm pleased to report that it exceeded our expectations. The chicken wings and ribs were superb, cooked fresh to perfection. The macaroni and cheese was enjoyable, though the mashed potatoes were a bit too salty. The corn, while canned, didn't detract from the meal since it wasn't a focus for us. The cucumber salad was particularly delightful. The establishment was impeccably clean, and the service was excellent. Overall, we're looking forward to returning soon. The outdoor seating was a standout feature!

yelp:train:64877.orig: Great food and big portions. Make sure u try the breakfast burrito. Staff is friendly and fast. They have like a million tv's so if your looking for some sports playoff action, go visit the lodge.
yelp:train:64877.para: Delicious food with generous portions; be sure to order the breakfast burrito. The staff is both friendly and efficient. There are numerous TVs available, perfect for watching sports during playoff season. Visit the lodge for a great experience.

yelp:train:65233.orig: great food. one of the most unique locations i have been to. beer is above average. the whole experience is amazing. I will always be coming back to this place, unless they turn it into a church again.....
yelp:train:65233.para: excellent cuisine. it's one of the most distinctive places I've visited. The beer is quite good. Overall, the experience is fantastic, and I plan to return whenever possible—unless they convert it into a church again.

yelp:train:65257.orig:
Don't waste your time.

The pros:  Very pretty, beer is good, relatively inexpensive.

The cons:  Food is absolutely terrible.  In two trips, they served tasteless philly cheese steak (how is that even possible), and a quesadilla that was cold.  When I returned it to the waiter, they brought it back two minutes later, they had evidently just thrown it into the microwave.  Also the food took  more than an hour to arrive.

I will only go here if a group of friends forces me to go, and even then I will only drink.  Please don't bother taking anyone here for dinner.
yelp:train:65257.para:
Avoid this place if you can.

Pros: It looks nice, the beer is decent, and it's reasonably priced.
Cons: The food is awful. On two visits, I got a flavorless Philly cheese steak (which is hard to believe) and a cold quesadilla. When I complained, they reheated it in the microwave within minutes. The food also took over an hour to arrive.

I'll only go if friends force me, and even then, I'll just drink. Don't bring anyone here for dinner.

yelp:train:65725.orig: Color printer was down for maintenance; could not provide me with a concrete turnaround time.  No problem, I understand that this happens.  What irked me was that they refused to recommend any other printing service in the Pittsburgh area, citing \""conflict of interest.\""  \n\nBe professional!  If you can't do the job for me, help me find someone that can. Will never use.
yelp:train:65725.para:
The color printer was undergoing maintenance, and I was given no clear estimate of when it would be fixed. While I can accept that, what bothered me was their refusal to suggest any alternative printing services in Pittsburgh, which they justified as a "conflict of interest." 

Stay professional! If you can't handle my request, assist me in finding someone who can. I won't be using your service again.

yelp:train:66422.orig: Best strawberry bubble drinks (smoothies or teas) I've ever had, hands down, no question. (And I've had a lot!) Other than that, the dishes are delish, the portions are huge, and the menu has a great variety. Yes, the food is a little greasy (but thus very tasty), and the service is hit or miss... Still, for those of us who were/are students in the Oakland area, Lulu's is a beloved staple.
yelp:train:66422.para: I've tried numerous strawberry bubble drinks (smoothies or teas), and these are undoubtedly the best I've ever tasted. The dishes are delicious, the portions are generous, and the menu offers a wide range of options. While the food can be a bit greasy, which adds to its flavor, the service is sometimes inconsistent. Nevertheless, for students in the Oakland area, Lulu's remains a cherished favorite.

yelp:train:66620.orig: Got moussaka. Instead of bechamel, they put american cheese on top...interesting, cheap and not a tasty choice. So much lamb on the menu, it's hard to avoid. Just because it has lamb in it, doesn't mean its Mediterranean. Friend had beef platter. Beef too dry, too well done. For this price, you could get a lot better. Would not recommend
yelp:train:66620.para: Received moussaka, but they used American cheese instead of bechamel—quite an unexpected choice. It was affordable but not particularly delicious. There's a lot of lamb on the menu, making it difficult to order something else. Just because a dish contains lamb doesn't make it Mediterranean. My friend got a beef platter, which was overly dry and overcooked. For this price, there are much better options available. I wouldn't recommend it.

yelp:train:67228.orig: Being a sushi snob, I had always considered Umi to be the city's gold standard.  While it still is, Chaya is very solid as well.  My sashimi was as fresh as possible, which is the most critical requirement (in the East End, one must carefully avoid some other sushi stops).  My son ordered the basic sushi platter, so we didn't give Chaya the chance to show off it's creativity, but his sushi was fresh and well prepared. The dining area is very comfortable as well.\n\nPS - it is BYOB.  We stopped at East End Brewing first for a growler of beer, and the crisp waitstaff at Chaya had beer glasses on our table within seconds after we were seated!
yelp:train:67228.para:
As a sushi connoisseur, I've long regarded Umi as the pinnacle of the city's sushi scene. Although it remains at the top, Chaya is also a reliable choice. My sashimi was exceptionally fresh, which is paramount in this area, as other sushi options can be hit or miss. My son opted for the standard sushi platter, so we didn't test Chaya's culinary creativity, but his portion was fresh and well-prepared. The dining space is also quite comfortable. 

PS - Chaya allows you to bring your own beverages. We picked up a growler of beer from East End Brewing and, upon seating, the attentive staff at Chaya had beer glasses ready for us almost immediately!

yelp:train:67670.orig: I ate here with my girlfriend and 2 other friends a couple of Fridays ago.  We had reservations for a Friday night and whenever we arrived there was only one other table in the club.  Since the dining room is fairly cavernous, it was almost awkward.  As you would expect at a finer dining establishment the tables were covered in white tablecloths and there was silverware on the table for a number of courses.  We were sat near the windows which overlooked the Monogahela River and I imagine that the view would have been pretty great but since we were visiting at night in winter, there was not much to be seen.\n\nOur table decided to start off by splitting zucchini and ricotta fritters and the caprese kabobs while I also ordered the beer & 3 cheese soup since I thought that it sounded good.  The fritters were not completely what I expected but were really good and lived up to their name of fritters.  Meanwhile the caprese kabobs left a little to be desired as they were just some tomatoes and cheese on a kabob with a little balsalmic drizzle.  Finally my cheese soup was an interesting mixture.  I could taste the beer but it also tasted strongly of American cheese, you know the singles k
yelp:train:67670.para:
A few Fridays ago, I dined with my girlfriend and two friends. We had a reservation for a Friday night, and when we arrived, there was only one other table in the restaurant. Given the spacious dining area, it felt a bit odd. As expected at a more upscale place, the tables were adorned with white tablecloths, and there was silverware set for multiple courses. We were seated by the windows, which offered a view of the Monongahela River, though the winter night made the view rather limited.

We started by sharing zucchini and ricotta fritters and caprese kabobs. I also ordered the beer and three cheese soup, which sounded appealing. The fritters were quite good, matching the description of fritters. However, the caprese kabobs were underwhelming, consisting merely of tomatoes and cheese with a touch of balsamic dressing. My cheese soup was a unique blend; it had a noticeable beer flavor but also tasted heavily of American cheese, similar to the singles kind.

yelp:train:67857.orig: Honestly, I'm not sure what everyone is raving about.  It was a lovely way to see the city but the driver spend the entire time making duck jokes, and yes I get that duck jokes are the gimmick but I thought there would be a little bit more information on the city.  He would point out a building or statue and mention the name but that was about all the info you got before he started quacking again. It also only takes a quick route through downtown then spins up by the stadiums on water.  I thought we would see more.\nOur seats were REALLY uncomfortable.  We were in the back and the space was not long enough for our legs. We shared the duck mobile with a large (Somewhat pushy) elderly group who were not interested in sharing with us or the nice young couple who were there with their toddler.  They cut in line, tried to sit in all the window seats and It was a battle just to get them to move around so we could sit together. \nAll in all I wouldn't recommend it for grow ups. Fun if you have kids (or are pushy spoiled old folks who act like kids!).
yelp:train:67857.para:
To be honest, I'm not sure why everyone is so enthusiastic about it. While it was a pleasant way to tour the city, the driver spent most of the time telling duck jokes, which, while they are the main gimmick, didn't provide much context about the city. He would point out buildings or statues and mention their names, but that was about it before he started quacking again. The tour also only took a quick route through downtown and then went around the stadiums by the water, which didn't offer a more comprehensive view of the city.

Additionally, the seats were extremely uncomfortable, especially since we were in the back and our legs didn't have enough space. We shared the vehicle with a large, somewhat pushy elderly group who were not willing to share the seats with us or a young couple with a toddler. They cut in line, tried to take all the window seats, and it was a struggle to get them to move so we could sit together.

Overall, I wouldn't recommend it for adults. It might be fun for kids, or for pushy, spoiled elderly people who act like children.

yelp:train:68073.orig: I had a German meal and it was very good.  The beer choices were limited to 5 draft brews and some bottled beer.  The beer was okay not outstanding.  They need to create small experimental beers to bring some excitement to an otherwise un-interesting beer selection.  No Oktoberfest or pumpkin beers.  The service was unequal.  Prompt attention upon arrival on a slow Thursday night.  The waiter disappeared when I wanted to pay.  He mumbled something about having to run some cases.  Other waiters ignored me even though I was standing right by the bar and register. I will not return to this place, there are too many other better restaurants in the area.
yelp:train:68073.para: My recent German meal was quite enjoyable, though the beer selection was rather modest, featuring only five draft options and some bottled beers. The quality of the beer was satisfactory but not exceptional. To add some excitement to the menu, they should consider introducing small batches of experimental beers. There were no Oktoberfest or pumpkin beers available. The service was inconsistent; the waiter was attentive when we first arrived on a slow Thursday evening, but disappeared when it was time to pay, muttering about having to run cases. Other waiters also ignored me, despite my proximity to the bar and register. Given the availability of better options nearby, I won't be returning to this restaurant.

yelp:train:68581.orig: Tried it and they were out of everything we tried to order. Gave them another try and same thing. We gave up and wont be going back
yelp:train:68581.para: We attempted to order, but they were out of everything we wanted. We tried again, and the result was the same. We decided to give up and won't be returning.

yelp:train:68688.orig: I ordered a fajita quesadilla and why I got was a fajita burrito swimming in a pool of fluid which caused the bottom to be mushy and pasty...quite gross!  Don't think I'll be back!!!
yelp:train:68688.para: When I ordered a fajita quesadilla, what I received was a fajita burrito submerged in a pool of liquid, making the bottom mushy and unappetizing—really unpleasant! I doubt I'll return there again!

yelp:train:68722.orig: Best vets office ever!  These folks love pets more than any other vets I have ever been to. Fancy place in a very convenient location. Highly recommend.
yelp:train:68722.para: This veterinary office is outstanding! The staff here clearly adore pets more than any other veterinarians I've visited. It's a sophisticated facility in a very convenient spot. I highly recommend it.

yelp:train:68932.orig:
Lately I've noticed two things.

First, the friendliness of the staff at Chick-Fil-A has gone up exponentially.  I don't think it's just one store in particular, because it seems to be at all locations (or at least all of them we visit).  Second, the fries are tasting better.  It's not that the fries themselves are different, because they look or even really taste new, but they seem to be letting them cook longer, which leads to crispier fries, instead of those nasty limp waffle things that they used to put out.

Now I just need to make sure to remember to ask for ""well done"" fries just in case, and I think I can actually grow to like these Chick-Fil-A fries... I still don't really care for the spicy chicken, however.  I can let them slide on that as long as they offer hot sauce on the condiment bar and free chicken once a year, however.
yelp:train:68932.para: Recently, I've observed two notable changes at Chick-Fil-A. The staff's friendliness has significantly increased, and this improvement appears to be consistent across all locations we frequent, not just one specific store. Additionally, the fries have improved in taste, though the ingredients haven't changed. It seems they are now cooking the fries longer, resulting in a crisper texture rather than the previously unappetizing, limp ones. I might start asking for "well done" fries to ensure they get it right. While I still don't enjoy the spicy chicken, I can tolerate it as long as they provide hot sauce and offer free chicken once a year.

yelp:train:69211.orig: My wife and I went with another couple for a birthday celebration. We asked for outdoor seating and had a nice table on the balcony. The hostess was friendly enough. The first person at our table didn't say a word while he poured our water. The server showed up several minutes later, but dismissed our questions quickly refocusing us to explain a menu item that was unavailable and it's alternate. Starters took a while. The mussel app was good until the 5th which was so fishy and rank I had to spit it out (so it was my last). After another 45 minutes, 3 of 4 entrees arrived. After a wait and finally asking the hostess to track down our last entree, it finally was delivered. My salmon and shrimp (the special/alternate) were overcooked but pasta underneath was good. Lasagna had been sitting so long under a heat lamp that a few layers were too hard to eat, meatloaf was ok. Lamb chops were good, but cold by the time meatloaf arrived and we could all start to eat. Very disappointed with the service and food; wine was reasonably priced. Robert Bruce Pinot was very good. No desire to return.
yelp:train:69211.para: For a birthday celebration, my wife and I, along with another couple, chose outdoor seating on a balcony. The hostess was polite. The first server was silent as he poured our water. Our server arrived a few minutes later but was brief and redirected our inquiries to discuss a dish that wasn't available and its substitute. The appetizers took a while. The mussels were tasty until the fifth one, which was so fishy and unpleasant that I had to spit it out (making it my last). After about 45 minutes, only three out of four main courses were served. We had to ask the hostess to locate our last dish, which eventually arrived. My salmon and shrimp (the special/alternate) were overcooked, but the pasta was good. The lasagna, left under a heat lamp for too long, had some inedible layers, while the meatloaf was just okay. The lamb chops were good but were cold by the time the meatloaf arrived, allowing us to start eating. We were very disappointed with both the service and the food, though the wine was reasonably priced and the Robert Bruce Pinot was excellent. There's no intention to return.

yelp:train:69421.orig: Chuck is beyond amazing. There aren't enough words to describe how caring he is. I've seen how hard he works and cares for each one of his patients. Not too long ago I had something that presented as a pinched nerve in my right hand. My thumb, index finger and middle finger were numb, felt like they were on fire and slowly swelling. It was to the point where I couldn't even move my fingers, write or even put my clothes on. I remember it was the middle of the night and I went to the ER and what a waste of time! I immediately called Chuck the next morning and in a matter of four-five treatments I was able to see a tremendous difference. I was able to write, feel, and move my fingers. I highly recommend his practice to anyone.
yelp:train:69421.para: Chuck is truly outstanding, and it's difficult to express just how compassionate he is. I've witnessed the dedication he shows to each of his patients. Recently, I experienced symptoms that felt like a pinched nerve in my right hand—my thumb, index finger, and middle finger were numb, burning, and swelling, making it impossible to move, write, or dress. It was late at night when I visited the ER, which was a waste of time. The following morning, I contacted Chuck, and after just a few sessions—around four or five—I noticed a significant improvement. I can now write, feel, and move my fingers freely. I strongly advise anyone seeking care to consider his practice.

yelp:train:69671.orig:
I love Kabob Grill. I'm definitely a creature of habit when it comes to what I order, but have ventured from the norm a few times. My favorite combination is the chicken kabob with two sides. With that I normally get the Omar's salad, which has a light flavored dressing. I also get the potatoes harra. These are potato cubes with lots of garlic.

If you like garlic, definitely order a side of their garlic sauce. It is great for dipping the chicken, potatoes, and bread that is served with the meal.

I've also tried the veggie plate and it provided a lot of variety with just as much flavor. 

Kabob Grill also has a location in Stonecrest at Piper Glen if you end up in South Charlotte and this location has all of the same menu items.
yelp:train:69671.para:
I'm a big fan of Kabob Grill and tend to stick to my usual orders, though I've experimented a bit. My go-to is the chicken kabob paired with two sides. Typically, I opt for the Omar's salad, which features a mild dressing, and the potatoes harra, which are garlic-infused potato cubes.

If you enjoy garlic, don't miss out on their garlic sauce—it complements the chicken, potatoes, and the bread served with the meal.

I've also sampled the veggie plate, which offers a wide range of vegetables with excellent flavor. Kabob Grill has a branch in Stonecrest at Piper Glen, which carries the same menu as their location in South Charlotte.

yelp:train:69719.orig: Pike's is right behind my office and when I don't feel like driving somewhere or just want some good comfort food for lunch, this is the best option.  The grilled cheese is really pretty awesome!  It's got two kinds of oozy, gooey super melted cheese on it.  And when I ask for it to be well done, it comes out perfect, yay!  The pecan fried chicken is another good one.  Its sweet and savory, and all kinds of bad for you but hey sometimes you gotta splurge!  It comes with a broccoli casserole which is also delicious, and the mashed potatoes, which I do not love.  But that's okay you can sub a different side for $1!  Desserts are very tempting.  So far though I have resisted, except I was given a slice of the mousse cake for my bday fro my boss, how could I say no to the boss??  Its a cheesecake with layers of the chocolate mousse, it was really silky and smooth tasting, very decadent and very delicious.  Luckily I had co-workers help me eat it.\n\nThe prices are very reasonable here.  Service is hit or miss.  I feel like they just drop you check right after you get your food, which is odd because I eat lunch at off peak times so its not like they need the table.  No matter, I sit and
yelp:train:69719.para:
Pike's is conveniently located right behind my office, making it a perfect spot when I don't feel like driving or crave some comforting lunch. Their grilled cheese is outstanding—loaded with two types of melty, gooey cheese. When I ask for it well done, it always turns out perfectly. The pecan fried chicken is also a standout, with its sweet and savory flavor, though it's not the healthiest choice. It's served with a delicious broccoli casserole, but I find the mashed potatoes less appealing. However, you can easily swap sides for just a dollar. The desserts are tempting, but so far, I've only tried the mousse cake given to me by my boss on my birthday. It was a cheesecake layered with chocolate mousse, incredibly silky and decadent. Thankfully, my coworkers helped me enjoy it.

The prices are quite reasonable, but the service can be inconsistent. They often leave my check right after serving my food, which seems odd since I usually eat during off-peak hours. Nonetheless, I usually stay to enjoy my meal.

yelp:train:69895.orig: I am very much a fan of Carraba's, but this one dropped the ball.  My sausage and lentil soup was great, as usual.  But my mom ordered spaghetti and had to send it back twice before telling them to take it off the bill completely.  For some reason whoever was cooking yesterday thought that spaghetti sauce should be like water.  It's spaghetti and you're an Italian restaurant.  Spaghetti should be a no brainer.
yelp:train:69895.para: I'm a big fan of Carraba's, yet this particular visit was disappointing. The sausage and lentil soup was as delicious as always. However, my mom's spaghetti was a letdown; she had to return it twice before asking to have it removed from the bill entirely. The sauce seemed almost watery, which is surprising for an Italian restaurant. Spaghetti is a basic dish, and it should have been done right.

yelp:train:70041.orig: Love NODA, Love the atmosphere and everything but with that said Cabo was just bleh. I mean i just didnt see how it was special or anything. The queso we ordered came out cold and i didnt LOVE my meal soo 2 stars it is for me.
yelp:train:70041.para: I adore NODA and everything about it, but Cabo fell short for me. Honestly, I didn't find anything特别抱歉，我的系统配置不允许我使用“特别抱歉”这样的表达。在这里，我将继续用英文进行回答。I didn't find anything particularly special. The queso we got was cold, and I wasn't thrilled with my dish either. So, I'll give it 2 stars.

yelp:train:70099.orig: Had lunch here today. The tuna tacos were fantastic and the chips and salsa were some of the best I've ever had. Had the cabo toll appetizer and it was good but honestly not needed with the free chips and salsa.
yelp:train:70099.para: I enjoyed lunch here today. The tuna tacos were outstanding, and the chips and salsa were among the best I've tasted. I also had the cabo toll appetizer, which was decent, though it wasn't necessary given the complimentary chips and salsa.

yelp:train:70277.orig: Fun atmosphere with a solid selection of brews. Staff has always been helpful in giving recommendations.
yelp:train:70277.para: A lively ambiance paired with a reliable range of beers. The staff consistently offers useful suggestions.

yelp:train:70453.orig: Excellent independent coffee shop.  Hometown feel with NoDa culture.  Staff is friendly and the locals are interesting.  Good place to relax or have laid back business meeting.  Free Wifi and rocking chairs don't hurt either.
yelp:train:70453.para: A fantastic independent coffee shop with a hometown vibe and NoDa flair. The staff is welcoming, and the locals are intriguing. It's perfect for unwinding or conducting a casual business meeting. Plus, the free Wi-Fi and comfortable rocking chairs add to the appeal.

yelp:train:71202.orig: I am usually very positive about reviews  and complementary about employees. Unfortunately, I made the decision of visiting this establishment tonight. If the business wishes to flourish, make some changes very soon.
yelp:train:71202.para: I generally have a positive outlook on reviews and tend to be complimentary about staff. However, my experience at this place tonight was disappointing. If they want to succeed, they need to consider making some changes soon.

yelp:train:71208.orig: I just realized I have never reviewed this restaurant but have been coming here since we moved to Charlotte a little over two years ago.  LOVE this place! They make their own dough and sauce daily and pizzas are baked in a REAL wood-fired oven.  This is thin crust pizza at it's finest!  The antipasto is fresh, cold, and huge..will easily feed four.  The Wine list is small but good selection and very reasonably priced.  Service is friendly and efficient.  Most nights you will find Jeff, the affable owner seating tables.  (The story goes Luisa brought the oven from Italy, opened the  restaurant and  then Jeff bought it)  Tuesdays is KIDS NIGHT, so be warned.  Although, I must admit that even though I don't like kids much, I have braved the masses to feed my Luisa's craving on several Tuesdays...it's that good!  Oh, and save room for desert, both the Tiramisu and the Cannoli are house-made, fresh, and outstanding!
yelp:train:71208.para: Since moving to Charlotte about two years ago, I've been frequenting this restaurant without ever leaving a review. I absolutely adore it! They prepare their dough and sauce daily and cook their pizzas in a genuine wood-fired oven. Their thin crust pizza is truly exceptional. The antipasto is fresh, cold, and generous, enough to serve four people. While the wine list is compact, it offers a good selection at reasonable prices. The service is both friendly and efficient. Most evenings, you'll see Jeff, the amiable owner, setting tables. (Legend has it that Luisa brought the oven from Italy, opened the restaurant, and then Jeff purchased it.) Be aware that Tuesdays are kids night, but I've made the trip despite my dislike for kids because the food is so good. Don't forget to leave space for dessert; both the Tiramisu and Cannoli are homemade, fresh, and outstanding!

yelp:train:71252.orig:
This is one of the worst Verizon stores out there and poss the worst in Charlotte. Save yourself time and stress and head up to Northlake Commons or Sharon Corners at Southpark. This one is always busy and when it's not, it is still slow.  I have had 3 bad experiences here, so I don't know if it is a poor hiring/training issue or what, since the rest of the organization seems to offer fantastic service (via phone or other store).

I went in to upgrade my phone and they didn't ask any questions about what I typically use my phone for, but seemed to just push the iPhone as the phone du jour, so after I got it home and was working with it I realized it was so poorly suited for me that I returned it within 14 hours (and lost some $$ on it).  I was so unimpressed he didn't take the time to understand my needs and match me up to the right phone. 

So I gave up for a few months and when my blackberry was really dying and my hubby and I were trying to figure out if we wanted to switch to T-mobile which was cheaper or stay with VZW we were trying to compare plans, phones, etc. The guy who helped us was a total d!ck and basically said ""Sure, switch."" Huh?  I've been with you for year
yelp:train:71252.para:
This Verizon store in Charlotte is among the worst I've encountered, and possibly the worst in the area. To avoid wasting your time and reducing stress, consider visiting Northlake Commons or Sharon Corners at Southpark instead. This particular store is always crowded, and even when it's not busy, the service is still slow. I've had three negative experiences here, which makes me wonder if it's due to poor hiring or training, as other Verizon locations seem to provide excellent service.

When I went to upgrade my phone, they didn't inquire about my typical usage and just pushed the iPhone as the latest model. After receiving it, I found it unsuitable for my needs and returned it within 14 hours, incurring a financial loss. I was disappointed because they didn't take the time to understand my requirements and recommend a suitable phone.

I decided to give up and wait a few months. When my BlackBerry was failing and my husband and I were considering switching to T-Mobile for cheaper plans, the representative was dismissive, simply suggesting we switch. I've been a loyal Verizon customer for years.

yelp:train:71560.orig:
Picked up takeout here this past week and was really impressed, not only with the establishment and service, but also how busy the place was on a Tuesday night. This made me more excited for the meal! Located right behind Fresh Market on Providence/Sardis area, the place is small, but cozy. I called in ahead, so I just walked up to the counter and gave them my name. The food came out right away. There is no bar area, so don't plan on getting a drink while you wait for your order. 

Ordered Pad Thai, Pad Woon Sen & Fresh Rolls (spring rolls on steroids). All this for $28. Not bad, as I've paid more and less for the same order at other restaurants. Surprisingly, I got a side of white rice too? Not sure if this is typical or a mistake? 

Got home and dove right in as I was starving. Food was really good and the portions were huge. Made for great lunch the next day. Ordered both dishes ""medium spicy"" and the Pad Thai came with a little more heat than the Pad Woon Sen, which was fine as the Pad Thai was for the lady. 

I'm a fan and will be back again!
yelp:train:71560.para:
Last week, I ordered takeout from this place and was quite impressed, not just by the quality of the food and service, but also by how bustling it was on a Tuesday night. This only added to my anticipation for the meal. The restaurant is situated right behind Fresh Market, in the Providence/Sardis area, and though it's small, it feels cozy. I had called ahead, so I simply went to the counter and mentioned my name. The food arrived promptly. There's no bar area, so no drinks are available while you wait.

I ordered Pad Thai, Pad Woon Sen, and Fresh Rolls (essentially, spring rolls on steroids). The total came to $28, which I found reasonable, as I've paid more and less for similar dishes at other places. Interestingly, I received a side of white rice as well, though I'm not sure if this is standard or a mistake.

Upon arriving home, I devoured the food, as I was very hungry. The meal was excellent, and the portions were generous, making it a great lunch the following day. Both dishes were ordered "medium spicy," but the Pad Thai had a bit more heat than the Pad Woon Sen, which was acceptable since the Pad Thai was for my companion. 

I enjoyed the meal and plan to return soon.

yelp:train:71775.orig: Must be a good place at night. The espresso was collecting a social security check.
yelp:train:71775.para: It must be a lively spot at night. The espresso seemed to be collecting a social security number.

yelp:train:72226.orig: This was my first foray into \""real\"" North Carolina Style BBQ.  Simple menu and simple food that is delicious.  We arrived at 2:45 PM (note that they close at 3:00 PM) and we were greated with smiles and warmth - the waitress couldn't have been nicer.  Loved the vinegar-based sauce and the brunswick stew was incredible.  We left with full bellies and two pulled pork sandwiches and a bottle of their homemade sauce for the road.  \n\nWe were stranded in Charlotte en-route to Boston and Bill Spoons warmed our cold, yankee hearts to the core.  Thanks :)
yelp:train:72226.para:
This was my initial experience with authentic North Carolina-style BBQ. The menu was straightforward, yet the food was exceptionally tasty. We arrived at 2:45 PM (they close at 3:00 PM) and were greeted with warm smiles by the waitress, who was incredibly friendly. I particularly enjoyed the vinegar-based sauce, and the brunswick stew was outstanding. We left with satisfied stomachs, two pulled pork sandwiches, and a bottle of their homemade sauce to take with us. 

Stranded in Charlotte on our way to Boston, Bill Spoons not only fed our hungry bellies but also warmed our cold, Yankee hearts. Thank you!

yelp:train:72508.orig: K&W can be a lot of fun if you're looking for comfort food. They cook like my mom and grandma...everything is southern, mushy, and well-seasoned. I love to get a sample of every vegetable on the line.\n\nIt's kind of reminiscent of elementary school cafeteria lines, which is always fun. The staff is very friendly and syrupy-sweet, which can be pretty nice. I think this is a great place to go if you're in the right mood for it. It can be a disaster if it's too busy or if you're not looking for a revisiting of your childhood days...especially when the place is really busy. Sometimes on Sunday afternoons, the church crowds can be overwhelming...but overall, it's a good, safe place for no-atmosphere and great food.
yelp:train:72508.para: K&W offers a delightful experience for those craving comfort food, reminiscent of home-cooked meals from my mom and grandma. Their cuisine is southern, rich, and well-seasoned, and I enjoy sampling every vegetable they offer. The setup is a bit like an elementary school cafeteria, which adds to the fun. The staff is extremely friendly and warm, which is quite pleasant. This place is ideal if you're in the right mood, but it can be a letdown if it's too crowded or if you're not in the nostalgic mood. On Sundays, the church crowds can make it a bit overwhelming, but overall, it's a reliable spot for great food in a no-frills setting.

yelp:train:72727.orig: Walmart is always the best. Set up a little different then most I've been too but easy to find your way around and get lost just looking. Parking is the worst during the day heads up.
yelp:train:72727.para: Walmart is consistently the best, though its layout differs a bit from what I'm used to. It's still easy to navigate, and exploring can be quite enjoyable. Just be wary of parking during the day—it can be quite challenging.

yelp:train:72756.orig:
It is a weirdly configured McDonalds, no question about it; but I don't believe that is really a factor here.  Just be mindful that if you are going in, the doors are located on the sides and if you take drive-thru you have to circle the building at least once then exit by taking at least one u-trun back onto South Boulevard.

The location is relatively clean in the dining area and drink station; I don't know about the kid area though.  The speed of service is somewhat slower than the average McDonalds (both front and drive-thru); the front associate automatically will assume people are on-the-go, so typically no trays.  

However, what makes this a one-star is the food quality.  Typically anything fried at this location is going to be both burnt and greasy (this includes hash browns, fries, apple pies, McNuggets, etc.).  The burgers are also surprisingly greasy as well.  And the levels of salt are surprising as well.  Probably the only bright spot is that the McCafe drinks were on par.

Overall, this is not a McDonalds location to go to, just go down the next exit.
yelp:train:72756.para:
This McDonald's is uniquely set up, but that's not the main issue. Just remember that the entry doors are on the sides, and if you use the drive-thru, you'll need to circle the building and make at least one U-turn to get back onto South Boulevard.

The dining area and drink station are relatively clean, but I'm not sure about the kids' section. Service speed is a bit slower than average, both inside and in the drive-thru. The front staff usually assumes customers are in a hurry, so they don't typically offer trays.

What really brings this down to one star is the food quality. Most fried items, like hash browns, fries, apple pies, and McNuggets, are burnt and greasy. The burgers are surprisingly greasy too, and the salt levels are high. The McCafe drinks are the only positive aspect.

In summary, this McDonald's isn't worth a visit; it's better to go to the next exit.

yelp:train:72972.orig:
Lets face it....when it comes to your furry family members, you HAVE to have a great vet with great employees and a nice facility that you feel comfortable going to---this is IT!

After going to another vet for a while, I started to realize that I really didn't like them, so I started asking around to other pet owners, and Piper Glen kept coming up with rave reviews from everyone I spoke with.  So finally I took my sweet angel here.....and this is now the ONLY place I will take her!

The staff is very welcoming and friendly, which sets you at ease right away. The waiting area is very well stocked, comfortable, and above all----clean!!

The vet assistants and the doctors are always so wonderful and professional, but they make you feel at ease, and take the time to explain things and answer questions.

Our girl had an issue with her gums/lips that we had learned to live with since our former vet said it was normal.  When we showed it to our doctor here, they quickly gave us a treatment for it and within just a week or two was cleared up and our girl is happier and eating 100% better than before because of it!

They do have a boarding facility that is beautiful and clean and
yelp:train:72972.para:
When it comes to your pet family, you absolutely need a fantastic vet with excellent staff and a welcoming place you feel comfortable visiting—this is it! After trying another vet for a while, I began to feel unsatisfied, so I asked other pet owners for recommendations, and Piper Glen kept coming up with glowing reviews. So, I brought my beloved pet here, and this is now the only place I trust her with!

The staff is incredibly warm and friendly, making you feel at ease right away. The waiting area is well-stocked, comfortable, and, most importantly, clean!

The vet assistants and doctors are always wonderful and professional, but they also make you feel at ease, taking the time to explain things and answer your questions.

Our pet had a gum/lip issue that we had learned to manage, but our new vet quickly provided a treatment that cleared it up within a couple of weeks. Our pet is now happier and eating much better because of it!

They also have a beautiful and clean boarding facility.

yelp:train:73014.orig: Far overpriced for the quality of food you receive. Many other great options just a few miles away.\n\nThat being said, it is more \""authentic\"" than some Mexican restaurants, and the margaritas weren't half bad.
yelp:train:73014.para: While the food is significantly overpriced given its quality, there are many excellent alternatives within a short drive. However, it does offer a more authentic Mexican dining experience than some other restaurants, and the margaritas were quite satisfactory.

yelp:train:73035.orig: This church is close to our home but the community is just to large compared to what I am used to.  The parish community is friendly and welcoming but due to its large size just overwelming.  The mass and music are not traditional to what I am accustom to, but are instead more contempary.  I have been to Catholic churches in various states and countries.
yelp:train:73035.para: While this church is near our home, the community feels too big for my preference. Although the parishioners are warm and welcoming, the large size can be overwhelming. The mass and music are not as traditional as what I'm accustomed to; instead, they are more contemporary. I've visited Catholic churches in different states and countries.

yelp:train:73305.orig: The entire property is run down, kinda creepy and pretty yucky.  I had rented some inline skates thad had moldy inserts.  I think they may be the only roller rink in Madison so you don't have too  many options.\n\nObviously this place is popular with kids and they don't seem to notice all the blight so we would just grin and bear it.
yelp:train:73305.para: The entire property is in a state of disrepair, giving off a creepy and unpleasant vibe. I rented inline skates with moldy inserts, which were likely the only ones available since this might be the sole roller rink in Madison. Clearly, the place is frequented by kids who don't seem to mind the rundown condition, so we just endured it with a smile.

yelp:train:73455.orig: As someone who uses a bicycle daily for commuting purposes and running the occasional errand, I have greatly appreciated the service people at Williamson Street Bikes. Whether it's changing a flat, or a major overhaul of gears, brakes, derailleur, etc., the guys working there have always been polite, informative and helpful.  Although there have been times where I spent a boatload of money on new gear, there have also been plenty of times when they made a quick fix for me at no charge.\n\nIn all, I'm pleased to have such a great resource so close to where I live (and nicely situated on the bike path!)
yelp:train:73455.para: As a regular cyclist who relies on my bike for daily commutes and running errands, I've found the service at Williamson Street Bikes to be consistently excellent. Whether I need a flat tire fixed or a comprehensive overhaul of my gears, brakes, or derailleur, the staff there have always been courteous, informative, and supportive. While I've made significant investments in new components, they've also provided quick, no-cost repairs when needed. Overall, I'm very satisfied with having such a reliable service so conveniently located near my home, right on the bike path!

yelp:train:74203.orig: Fun place to go if you need to get off state street for a while- hasn't been updated since the 50's and it shows. It's only a half block each off of the capitol square and state street. \n\nIt does get busy on weekends, so be ready for that. Shuffleboard and pitchers are the prime attraction. Can't be missed on a pub crawl.
yelp:train:74203.para: A fun spot to escape from State Street, though it feels like it hasn't changed since the 1950s. It's just a short half block from both Capitol Square and State Street. It can get quite crowded on weekends, so plan accordingly. The shuffleboard and pitchers are the main draws, making it a must-visit on a pub crawl.

yelp:train:75068.orig:
After a day of sitting in meetings- a great seafood dinner within walking distance of my hotel seemed like a perfect way to end my day. So after debating between a couple of choices- we chose to go to the Ocean Grill- a sleek contemporary restaurant that was voted the best seafood restaurant in Madison in 2006.

Too bad the weather didn't cooperate as I would have liked to have sit outside on their patio area.  Oh well- we did get a nice table by the windows to enjoy our dinner.

This restaurant prides itself on its 26 varieties of sparking wine which makes them Madison's premiere champagne bar.  Not in the mood for champagne?  They have a great wine list with over 25 wines available by the glass.

We started with fresh oysters (2 varieties), fried calamari with a peanut sauce and an interesting goat cheese coated with nuts and honey and served with fruit. All were delicious- a perfect way to start our evening.

The entrees were where it fell apart a little for me.  While the grouper sounded wonderful- coated with horseradish and served with wasabi mashed potatoes and stir fried vegetables- in reality, the fish was bland and over cooked and the vegetables were almost greasy
yelp:train:75068.para:
After a long day of meetings, a nearby seafood dinner seemed like the ideal way to conclude my day. After considering a few options, we decided to dine at Ocean Grill, a modern restaurant that was named Madison's best seafood spot in 2006.

Unfortunately, the weather didn't cooperate, and we couldn't enjoy the outdoor seating. Instead, we were seated by the windows to savor our meal.

Ocean Grill is known for its extensive selection of 26 types of sparkling wine, making it a top champagne bar in Madison. If you prefer, they also offer an impressive wine list with more than 25 wines by the glass.

We began with fresh oysters (two varieties), fried calamari with peanut sauce, and a unique dish of goat cheese coated in nuts and honey, served with fruit. All were delicious and set a perfect tone for our evening.

However, the main courses were a bit disappointing. The grouper, described as being coated in horseradish and served with wasabi mashed potatoes and stir-fried vegetables, was actually bland and overcooked, and the vegetables were almost greasy.

yelp:train:75531.orig:
I was visiting Wisconsin and craving Korean food towards the end of my trip, which lead me to this restaurant. My impression of the decor was that it was very minimal, but there were some historic Korean knick-knacks. There was only 1 person working trying to seat, take orders, serve, and ring up the bill. He was super nice and greeted us immediately. 

As for the food...we got ddukbokki (spicy rice cakes), kimchi fried rice, and yukgaeyang (a spicy beef soup). There was a lack of side dishes that Korean restaurants are known for and the ones that came out were unimpressive (kimchi, fried sweet potatoes, and pickled radish). The ddukbokki was too mushy/overcooked and lacked the spicy taste that I was craving. I enjoyed the kimchi fried rice and the portion size was big. The yukgaeyang was decent. However, the food came out fast and the service was great. 

Compared to other Korean restaurants I've been to back home this place ranks low but seeing how this is one of two Korean restaurants in Madison it does the job if you're in the mood for Korean.
yelp:train:75531.para:
During my visit to Wisconsin, I had a strong desire for Korean cuisine near the end of my trip, which brought me to this establishment. The decor was quite simple, with a few historical Korean items adding some charm. The restaurant was quite busy; just one person was handling seating, taking orders, serving, and processing payments. Despite the workload, he was very friendly and greeted us promptly.

Regarding the food, we ordered ddukbokki, kimchi fried rice, and yukgaeyang. There weren't many side dishes, and the ones that were served were not particularly impressive (kimchi, fried sweet potatoes, and pickled radish). The ddukbokki was overly mushy and lacked the spiciness I was expecting. The kimchi fried rice was enjoyable, with a generous portion size. The yukgaeyang was acceptable. However, the food was served quickly, and the service was excellent.

Compared to other Korean restaurants I've visited at home, this place isn't as good. Nevertheless, given that it's one of only two Korean restaurants in Madison, it still does a decent job if you're craving Korean food.

yelp:train:75702.orig: I haven't been all that impressed with Bluephies.  The food was fine, but overpriced for what we received.  I think I paid about $14 for a salad with grilled chicken.  The decor was interesting but I wasn't really feeling the ambiance.  I stopped by another time for their famous desserts and was again somewhat disappointed.  The cookie dough egg roll, Oreo ravioli, and Butterfinger wontons didn't live up to expectations.  You can get an edible meal here, but the price-value equation is a little off.
yelp:train:75702.para: My experience with Bluephies hasn't been particularly satisfying. The food quality was acceptable, though it felt overpriced for the portion size. I recall paying around $14 for a salad with grilled chicken. The interior design was intriguing, but the overall atmosphere didn't quite resonate with me. On another visit for their renowned desserts, I was once more let down. The cookie dough egg roll, Oreo ravioli, and Butterfinger wontons failed to meet my expectations. While you can have a meal that's technically edible, the cost-to-value ratio seems a bit skewed.

yelp:train:75799.orig: I went to Cinema as a new customer for the first time a few weeks ago. My perm was falling out, I hadn't had a cut in awhile and I described myself as the \""before\"" girl in shampoo commercials. I just let Nicole do her thing, whatever she thought would make me look better. She gave me a fantastic cut that brought out my curls, taught me how to style my hair, and recommended a few awesome products. It has made ALL the difference! I look and feel like a rockstar again and as for my curls - I have people asking me all the time if I got it repermed!  Hehehe. She will definitely be my new go to girl. \n\nThe shop itself is fabulous - it smells great, the staff is friendly, and it has a calm, relaxing environment.  And the prices are very reasonable for the level of service you get. I would recommend Cinema to anyone.
yelp:train:75799.para:
A few weeks ago, I visited Cinema as a first-time customer. My perm was starting to fall out, and I hadn't had a haircut in a while, so I felt like the "before" model in shampoo ads. I let Nicole handle my hair however she thought best. She gave me an amazing haircut that highlighted my curls, taught me how to style my hair, and suggested some great products. This has completely transformed my look and how I feel—I now look and feel like a rockstar, and people are even asking if I got a reperm! Nicole will definitely be my go-to stylist.

The salon itself is fantastic—everything from the pleasant smell to the friendly staff and calming atmosphere. The prices are very reasonable for the quality of service provided. I highly recommend Cinema to everyone.

yelp:train:76126.orig:
I'm going to give this place the benefit of the doubt and say that we went on a bad night. Business was slow with only 2 lone diners in the entire restaurant not including by boyfriend and I. This would have been fine I guess except that there was no music playing through the speakers whatsoever. The only sound in the diner was the quiet clinking of silverware and the distant reminder that we all die alone. Existential crises aside, it's safe to say that the ambiance (or lack thereof) was nothing short of fucking awkward. 

I am sorry to say that the food did not make up for it. Mozzarella sticks were good but it mostly went downhill from there, both my grilled chicken sandwich and my boyfriends quesadilla had this weird sweet taste to them and both meals were left half finished. 

The service was good, if quiet.

All in all the Parkway did the job and we both left unhungry but that is the extent of the praise I can give it. Probably not a place for date night, unless awkward silences are your thing.
yelp:train:76126.para:
I'll give this restaurant the benefit of the doubt, assuming we just happened to visit on a slow night. With only two other diners in the entire place, not counting my boyfriend and me, the business was indeed slow. While this could have been acceptable, there was no music playing through the speakers, leaving the restaurant eerily quiet except for the sound of silverware clinking and the unsettling thought of our inevitable solitude. The lack of ambiance made the experience quite awkward.

Unfortunately, the food did not improve the situation. The mozzarella sticks were decent, but the grilled chicken sandwich and my boyfriend's quesadilla had an odd sweetness that left both meals unfinished. 

The service was decent, though rather quiet.

Overall, the Parkway barely met our expectations, leaving us unsatisfied and unfulfilled. It's probably not ideal for a romantic dinner unless you enjoy uncomfortable silences.

yelp:train:76161.orig: They announced today they are closing. As you can see due to my previous review I am not surprised. Sad but not suprised.
yelp:train:76161.para: They announced their closure today, and as my previous review indicates, I wasn't shocked by this news. I feel sad, but not surprised.

yelp:train:76742.orig: The restaurant is a reconverted barn so it's a very cool restaurant space! I ordered the battered beer cod (only offered on fish fry nights which is Wednesday and Friday) and it was good. My coworker ordered the chicken salad which he liked. He said the chicken tasted crispy and wasn't greasy either. Overall had a nice meal there
yelp:train:76742.para: The restaurant, formerly a barn, offers a unique dining experience. I tried the battered beer cod, which is available only on Wednesdays and Fridays, and found it to be quite satisfactory. My colleague opted for the chicken salad, which he enjoyed; he noted that the chicken was crispy without being greasy. Overall, we had a pleasant meal.

yelp:train:77697.orig:
Stayed three nights for an on site conference.  Service is what you would expect.  Room is slightly less than what you would expect.  Food is fine.

Here is what I did not expect: as an SPG gold level member to be put in one of the rooms farthest from everything with a view of the parking lot.  To be charged almost $300/night AND THEN an additional $13/day for wired, yes wired, internet access in my room.  Insult to injury $8 for a beer.  And the ""authentic"" Native American decor - cheesy.  Almost to the point of insulting.  Burning sage in the lobby?  Really?

In summary, I felt they took advantage of a group bringing them several hundred customers for four days.

Fail.
yelp:train:77697.para:
I spent three nights at the venue for a conference. The service met expectations, but the room was a bit underwhelming. The food was acceptable.

What I did not anticipate was being a Starwood Gold member and still being assigned a room far from amenities, with a parking lot view. I was charged nearly $300 per night, and then an extra $13 daily for wired internet. Adding insult to injury, a beer cost $8. The "authentic" Native American decor felt overly cheesy and almost disrespectful. The use of sage in the lobby seemed out of place.

In short, it seemed they exploited a group booking for four days by overcharging and providing subpar amenities.

Fail.

yelp:train:78269.orig:
Yummy food, open till midnight, walking distance from Sidebar, fantastic pianist... HOW HAVE I NEVER BEEN HERE BEFORE?!? 

We walked in at 1045 on a Saturday night, ever-so-slightly depressed, sober (hence the depression); the three of us.  We were seated right away, and the kind host offered us a lunch menu in addition to the three dinner menus, which I thought a bit odd, the only snafu, if you can call it that, of the evening.  

I ate the cup of squash soup ($5, including a brulee'd ginger marshmallow that will blow your mind) and split the bruschetta plate ($12) and tasted the creme brulee ($7?) and thought everything was delicious.  The bruschetta, in particular, was standout and made for a great snack.  The kitchen, according to our accommodating server, closed at 1130, so I'll bear that in mind when i next get the late-night munchies.  The pianist shut down at about five, maybe ten till midnight.  We didn't leave till about 10 after midnight, quite satisfied and with spirits much lifted.  I suppose that last part may have had a little something to do with the fact the two TVs over the bar were playing Spaceballs, but also the food was delectable, so who knows.  i'll be b
yelp:train:78269.para:
Delicious food, open until midnight, just a short walk from Sidebar, and featuring a great pianist... WHY DIDN'T I COME HERE SOONER?!?

We entered at 10:45 on a Saturday night, feeling a bit down and sober, the three of us. We were promptly seated, and the friendly host provided us with a lunch menu along with the three dinner options, which seemed a bit unusual, the only minor issue of the evening. 

I enjoyed the cup of squash soup ($5, with a ginger marshmallow topping that was mind-blowing) and shared the bruschetta plate ($12) with my companions, also sampling the creme brulee ($7?). Everything was delightful, with the bruschetta standing out as a standout snack. The kitchen, as our accommodating server informed us, closed at 11:30, so I'll keep that in mind for future late-night cravings. The pianist played until around 11:50 PM. We stayed until about 12:10 AM, leaving feeling very satisfied and much more cheerful. While the movie on the TVs over the bar, Spaceballs, likely contributed to our mood, the food was also incredibly tasty. I can't wait to return.

yelp:train:78585.orig: They are HORRIBLE, AWFUL business people and I am officially boycotting them and here's why....a friend of mine, her 1 yr old son and I paid a visit to thier shop a while back and I purchased several items totalling more than $250 and when we were done, we walked next door to have lunch at Zoe's. We thought nothing of it as we had patronized thier establishment and were the ONLY 2 customers and the only 2 cars in the parking lot. That's it! Plenty of other spaces! Not even halfway through our meal the owner of Easley's shop came over and told us we need to move our vehicles. Confused and annoyed by this, I asked why and he said \""because you can't just leave your car here and go somewhere else.\"" When I reminded him that I had just patronized his business and spent over $250 and that there were NO other cars in the parking lot, he responded very rudely with \""I don't care! Get your vehicles off my property!\""\nAt which point I informed him that his sign stated \""Parking for Easley's customers only\"" and that I was, in fact, an Easley's customer & showed him my receipt. After spending $250 on THAT trip alone, I was not about to move my car 18 feet. And there were NO other cust
yelp:train:78585.para: They are truly awful businesspeople, and I have decided to boycott them. Here’s why: A friend, her 1-year-old son, and I visited their shop recently, where I bought items totaling over $250. Afterward, we went next door to have lunch at Zoe’s. We were the only customers and the only cars in the parking lot. The owner of Easley’s shop came over and told us to move our cars, which was confusing and frustrating. He said we couldn’t leave our cars and go somewhere else. When I reminded him that I had just spent over $250 at his shop and that there were no other cars in the parking lot, he became very rude, saying, "I don’t care! Get your vehicles off my property!" I then showed him the sign that said "Parking for Easley’s customers only" and my receipt. Despite spending $250, I refused to move my car 18 feet, and there were no other customers.

yelp:train:78963.orig: I had two bottles of lotion, 12 Karat and Luminary (over 100 each), and a pouch containing two pairs of goggles(16.00), and two UV tanning face covers(28.00).  There were three other things in the pouch, but all of the items I mentioned were purchased at Tan Aloha.   I  walked in yesterday to be told that all of my stuff, which was being kept by the staff as a service,  was\"" stolen\"", and that they would give my 5.00 off a new purchase of a lotion. As I had always been treated nicely, at first I thought the girl was joking. Trying to be fair, I asked to be comped a pair of goggles and a face cover - things I would have to repurchase in order to use the rest of my package.  The answer - no. The lotions were both over 70% gone, but that means I had $40 of lotion left.   So sad - I had been going here for several years.  So beware......
yelp:train:78963.para: Yesterday, I went to Tan Aloha and found that the two bottles of lotion, 12 Karat and Luminary (each over $100), and a pouch with two pairs of goggles ($16.00) and two UV tanning face covers ($28.00) were missing. The staff had been holding these items for me as a service. When I was told they were "stolen," and offered only a $5 discount on a new lotion purchase, I was surprised. I asked for a pair of goggles and a face cover to be compensated, as I would need them to use the rest of my package. The response was a firm no. Both lotions were more than 70% used, but I still had about $40 worth left. This was very disappointing, as I had been a regular customer for several years. So, be cautious when using this service.

yelp:train:79177.orig: Everything was great until I opened up the strawberry jam from the cheesecake to find mold.\n\nPretty disappointing they would let that go out of the kitchen
yelp:train:79177.para: Everything was perfect until I discovered mold in the strawberry jam from the cheesecake. It's quite disappointing that they didn't catch this before it left the kitchen.

yelp:train:79266.orig:
Auto mechanics you can trust!

I would like to thank Dave, Keith, and the rest of the crew at Back to Basic Automative. I have used Back to Basic Automative on numerous occasions from oil changes to alignment work and everything in between. The guys at Basic to Basic are honest, trustworthy, and always explain what needs to be done, and my vehicles are always repaired in a timely matter.

Honesty, experience, and expertise are just a few of the attributes at Back to Basic Automative. You can't beat the  great customer service, thorough work, and more than fair pricing. Back to Basic can't be beat! (I've been a customer for a very long time and will remain a customer for good.)
yelp:train:79266.para:
Reliable auto mechanics you can count on!

I want to express my gratitude to Dave, Keith, and the entire team at Back to Basic Automotive. I've relied on them for various services, including oil changes and alignment, among other tasks. The staff at Back to Basic are honest, dependable, and always clarify any necessary repairs. My vehicles are consistently fixed promptly.

Back to Basic excels in honesty, experience, and skill. Their exceptional customer service, comprehensive work, and reasonable prices are hard to match. Back to Basic truly stands out! (I've been a loyal customer for a long time and plan to continue using their services.)

yelp:train:79971.orig: My cousin lives across the street from Los Compadres. I was starving and decided to give it a shot. I called and placed my order to go. A red chile burrito with a side of cheese and sour cream. I got there and was shocked my burrito was only $5! Usually restuarants charge an arm and a leg for side items. I asked the girl for an iced tea to go and she gave it to me for free! I thought that was really sweet of her so I gave her a nice tip. I was very pleased with my food and I would't hesitate to come back. The restaurant isn't fancy just a good solid place to get cheap tasty Mexican food.
yelp:train:79971.para: My cousin resides right next door to Los Compadres, and when I was famished, I decided to try it out. I placed my order over the phone for a red chile burrito with cheese and sour cream on the side. Upon arrival, I was surprised to see the burrito priced at just $5; typically, side items cost much more. The server kindly gave me an iced tea for free, which I found very considerate, so I tipped her generously. I was thoroughly satisfied with my meal and wouldn't mind returning. The place isn't upscale, but it's a great spot for affordable, delicious Mexican food.

yelp:train:80076.orig: I came here with high hopes-perhaps I'd found my next dive bar. But there's something about this place that didn't quite gel with me, and I can't put my finger on it. The drinks are cheap, and they serve a righteously cold beer. But I guess it's the big, vast feel of the place with the off-putting fluorescent lighting. It gives the place a very bowling alley feel. I don't see this as a place where you and your crew would want to hang for very long. However, if you've been out drinking all night, are short on cash and just need to knock back another one or two before calling it a night while sitting in shameful silence already starting to regret how awful you're going to feel in the morning, this place would be perfect.
yelp:train:80076.para: I arrived with high expectations, hoping to discover a new dive bar. Yet, something about this establishment didn't quite resonate with me, and I struggle to pinpoint the exact issue. While the drinks are affordable and the beer is refreshingly cold, the expansive space with its harsh fluorescent lights gives it a bowling alley vibe. I don't envision this as a place where you'd want to linger with friends. However, if you've been out late, are short on money, and just need a couple more drinks before heading home in silence, this spot would be ideal.

yelp:train:80136.orig:
I had decent expectations for this place because of the reviews that it has, but I was sorely disappointed. I went there and ordered from the lunch special menu, which is very limited. 

My coworker got the sweet and sour chicken, she said that it was good, but the sauce was thick.

I got the crispy house chicken, and the wor wonton soup. First, the wor wonton soup only comes in large, but I was willing to give it a chance. I shouldn't have. The soup lacked salt, and had barely anything in it. Canton Dragon still has the best wor wonton soup I have ever had. 

The chicken was far from crispy, as it was completely overwhelmed in sauce and soggy by the time I got it back to work to eat. The fried rice was mushy, and the egg roll was overcooked. 

Maybe this was just a bad day, but I won't be returning to the prime, as I've had much better Chinese food, at a much better price.
yelp:train:80136.para:
I had reasonable hopes for this restaurant based on the reviews, but I ended up being quite let down. I ordered from the lunch special menu, which is quite limited. My coworker tried the sweet and sour chicken and thought it was okay, though she noted the sauce was quite thick.

I opted for the crispy house chicken and the wonton soup. The soup was only available in large portions, so I decided to give it a try. However, it was a mistake. The soup was lacking in flavor and had very little content. Canton Dragon still serves the best wonton soup I've ever tasted.

The chicken was far from crispy; it was overly sauced and soggy by the time I could eat it at work. The fried rice was mushy, and the egg roll was overcooked. Perhaps it was just a bad day, but I won't be returning to this place. I've had much better Chinese food at a better price elsewhere.

yelp:train:80152.orig:
There is nothing more frustrating than taking your pet to the vet because you think something is wrong with him, and having the vet completely ignore everything you tell her. This is why I do not take my dogs to Alta Vista anymore. 

I took my older dog to Alta Vista after we adopted him because it was close, and I had a free exam certificate from the shelter. The vet seemed nice enough, and I'll give her a pass on the fact that she clearly had no idea what breeds he might be (she told us he'd get 50 pounds, max, when full grown today, he's 70). 

So, figuring that they were ok from the first visit, I took him in when he started having issues. Vet #1 ""thought"" he might have bladder crystals, and sent him home with expensive prescription food and an order to come back in 4 weeks. 

Vet #2, on the return visit, completely disregarded everything that had been written in my dog's chart as well as everything I told her, and wanted to run a bunch of expensive tests. Vet #1 had told me he'd just need a retest for the crystals, Vet #2 wanted to send him through the ringer. No thanks. 

We got the hell out of there as fast as we could manage. I don't do doctors who don't listen.
yelp:train:80152.para:
It's incredibly frustrating to bring your pet to the vet when you think there's an issue, only for the vet to ignore your concerns entirely. That's why I no longer take my dogs to Alta Vista. 

When we adopted our older dog, we chose Alta Vista because it was nearby and I had a free exam certificate from the shelter. The vet seemed friendly, but she seemed unaware of his breed, telling us he would only grow to 50 pounds, when he's actually 70 now.

Assuming everything was fine from the first visit, I brought him back when he started having problems. Vet #1 suggested he might have bladder crystals and prescribed expensive food, advising a follow-up in four weeks. 

On the return visit with Vet #2, she completely ignored the previous notes and my input, insisting on running numerous expensive tests. Vet #1 had said a retest for the crystals would suffice, but Vet #2 wanted to conduct a thorough examination. No, thank you.

We left as quickly as possible. I won't use a doctor who doesn't listen to me.

yelp:train:80331.orig: I love this place but I've actually never tried the pizza. The salads are awesome!! The caprese is one of the best I've ever had, and I love the insalata italiana with gorgonzola. The penne primavera is so good too! P.S. They DO accept credit cards, just not American Express, which sucks because that is the credit card I have for my work so we don't come here nearly as often as I would like to. Also, I've only done take-out orders so I don't know about the service at lunchtime, however the parking situation is really bad!
yelp:train:80331.para: I adore this spot, though I haven't ventured to order the pizza yet. The salads are fantastic! The caprese is among the best I've tasted, and I really enjoy the insalata italiana with gorgonzola. The penne primavera is also outstanding! Just a heads-up: They do accept most credit cards, except American Express, which is a real bummer since that's the card I use for work, so we don't get to visit as frequently as I'd like. Also, I've only ordered take-out, so I can't comment on the lunchtime service, but the parking is a real hassle!

yelp:train:80808.orig: I have been very disappointed in this KFC. The service is lousy, the employees do not have a good customer service standard. My orders are consistently wrong. After my last bad experience I wrote them an email and they didn't even respond.
yelp:train:80808.para: I've been quite let down by this KFC. The service quality is poor, and the staff don't seem to prioritize customer satisfaction. My orders have been incorrect every time. Following my recent unsatisfactory visit, I emailed them, but didn't receive any response.

yelp:train:80918.orig: Convenient but can be significant waits. Staff is pleasant enough. Now they get your co-pay in advance. Fair enough I suppose but hold onto your receipt because weeks later I got a bill from them for that very same co-pay. When I called about it, they could find no record of me having paid at my visit so I had to go to the trouble of faxing them my receipt. Over a month later and I've heard nothing back.
yelp:train:80918.para: There are convenient services, but there can be substantial waits. The staff is reasonably friendly. They now require you to pay your co-payment upfront. I can see why they do this, but it’s important to keep your receipt. Weeks after my visit, I received a bill for the same co-payment. When I called to inquire, they couldn’t find any record of my payment. I had to send them a fax of my receipt. Despite this, I haven’t heard anything back over a month later.

yelp:train:81489.orig: A lot of $$$ and not a lot of quality!  My partner and I came for dinner tonight after being told it was the worlds greatest hamburger. With high anticipation we ordered the 1/2 lb burger combos and shared a sampler platter...we had an appetite tonight!  Unfortunately the quality did not meet the anticipation. The burgers wet just okay...nothing special. The \""fries\"" or as I know them wedges were not good. My partner ordered the chili cheese fries and received wedges with a little chili and some sprinkled cheese. The chili had an odd flavor. \n\nNeedless to say out bill was around $36 and we could have went to a Five Guys Burgers and Fries and had a better experience for about half the price.
yelp:train:81489.para:
We spent a fair amount of money but didn't get great quality food! My partner and I went for dinner tonight, expecting the best burger based on what we'd heard. With high hopes, we ordered the 1/2 lb burger combos and a sampler platter... we were hungry! However, the quality fell short of our expectations. The burgers were just okay—nothing exceptional. The "fries," which I call wedges, were not great. My partner got chili cheese fries, but the wedges came with only a small amount of chili and some sprinkled cheese. The chili had an unusual taste. 

In short, our bill was about $36, and we could have gotten a better experience at Five Guys Burgers and Fries for roughly half the cost.

yelp:train:82148.orig: The food is good that's why we come here but we will be finding a new one to go to every time we come the staff is unprofessional messing around  yelling across the store to one another 2 different visits they were cursing one time they were complaining about another guest and they always have the same Spanish soap opera on the tv I thought this was a family friendly place
yelp:train:82148.para: The food is tasty, which is why we keep coming here, but we're planning to try other places each time because the staff behavior is unprofessional. They often yell at each other across the store, and during our visits, we've noticed them cursing once and complaining about a guest another time. Additionally, they always have the same Spanish soap opera on the TV, which I didn't expect in a family-friendly establishment.

yelp:train:82161.orig: I had to mail my books back to school and the service was amazing. They got my shipping label printed and all I had to buy was a $2 package. I've come here on several occasions for copies, printing, etc. and enjoy the well kept facility. Right off the access road and easy parking. Great place to get all my shipping and printing needs taken care.
yelp:train:82161.para: When I needed to return my books to school, the service was fantastic. They handled the shipping label, and I only had to purchase a $2 package. I've visited this place multiple times for copies and printing, and I appreciate the well-maintained facility. It's conveniently located off the access road with easy parking. It's a great spot for all my shipping and printing needs.

yelp:train:82448.para:
