yelp:train:82546.orig: Their food is GREAT! Actually, I love their gigantic antipasto salad. The small is enough for two. \n\nTheir lunch specials are great deals as well.
yelp:train:82546.para: I absolutely adore their food, especially their enormous antipasto salad; even a small portion is sufficient for two people. Additionally, their lunch specials offer fantastic value.

yelp:train:82870.orig:
20 years ago as a kid a friend's mom took us here. I remembered it being good, in fact it is excellent.  My kids and I are total snobs when it comes to Chinese food. I hate paying and they hate eating things inferior to our own escapades in the kitchen. 

We ordered beef skewers, crab puffs and soup for appetizers.  The beef was tender and marinated/seasoned well, crab puffs had homemade as opposed to commercial grade wrappers which was a nice treat. The sizzling Rice Soup was delicious and the the meat was not tough. 

The main course was Orange Chicken and Chicken Chow Mein listed as Mandarin style on the menu (meaning soft not crispy noodles). The chicken had a perfect light breading, nice and crisp upon biting and the chicken was a quality cut, no gristle, very juicy and tender.....the sauce involved no artificial orange colors or flavors, cavities from high fructose sugars.... just a perfect balance of salt, citrus and garlic. Chow Mein was equally delightful with fresh veggies, seasoned well, noodles were cooked to perfection.

 We didn't order any egg rolls but I saw a few walk buy and they were the size of small footballs. Next time we will get those....as for this ti
yelp:train:82870.para:
Twenty years ago, as a child, my friend's mom brought us to this place. I recall it being quite good, and now I can say it's excellent. My kids and I are very particular about Chinese food; we dislike paying for anything that doesn't meet our high standards from our own cooking.

For starters, we ordered beef skewers, crab puffs, and soup. The beef was tender and well-marinated, and the crab puffs had homemade wrappers, which was a pleasant surprise. The sizzling rice soup was delicious, and the meat was not tough.

For the main course, we had Orange Chicken and Chicken Chow Mein, both labeled as Mandarin style. The chicken had a perfect light coating, was nicely crisp, and the meat was of a high-quality cut, without any gristle and very juicy and tender. The sauce was free of artificial colors or flavors and high fructose corn syrup, offering a perfect balance of salt, citrus, and garlic. The Chow Mein was equally enjoyable, with fresh vegetables, well-seasoned noodles cooked to perfection.

We didn't order egg rolls, but I noticed they were quite large, like small footballs. Next time, we'll definitely get those.

yelp:train:82912.orig: I heard alot about this place through Yelp so when I came across it I decided to give it a try. I didnt know that they were more of a luncheonette type place. I ordered a medium hot coffee and try a glaxed donut. The coffee tasted like it was burnt and the donut wassoft but just didnt taste right. It almost seemed like the glaze was bad or something. Either way I was not impressed with Rainbow Donuts and will continue to go to Dunkin Donuts since no one can seem to match their amazing coffee! (and donuts too!)
yelp:train:82912.para: I had heard a lot about this place from Yelp reviews, so when I found it, I decided to give it a try. I didn't realize it was more of a luncheonette-style establishment. I ordered a medium-hot coffee and a glazed donut. The coffee tasted burnt, and the donut, while soft, just didn't taste right. It seemed like the glaze might have been the issue. Overall, I wasn't impressed with Rainbow Donuts and will continue to stick with Dunkin Donuts, as no one can match their fantastic coffee (and donuts too)!

yelp:train:83634.orig: Awesome service! In home repair and service of our grandfather clock was easily arranged with a simple email and phone call. He arrived right on time and fixed everything up good as new with no added surprise charges. This place is the BEST!
yelp:train:83634.para: What an excellent service! We managed to schedule in-home repair and maintenance for our grandfather clock with just a quick email and phone call. He arrived punctually and restored everything to like-new condition, with no unexpected extra charges. This company truly excels!

yelp:train:84258.orig:
I'm not a big fan of beef chinese dishes, but their Beef with broccoli is truly awesome! I liked it so much, that I had it 3 days in  row for lunch. Even better than going to the Chinese Cultural Center restaurants, more affordable and tastier! Lunch specials are affordable as are the dinner combos.

My personal list:
Beef with broccoli - AWESOME!
Lemon chicken - yum!
Moo Shu pork - another of my personal faves
Sesame Chicken
BBQ Pork  
Fried Shrimp - mmm, try mixing ketchup into soy sauce for dip.
Crab puffs
Pork fried rice
Honey Garlic Chicken
Sweet n sour pork

I don't care for the egg rolls (however, my son LOVES them) or pot stickers (deep fried rather than steamed with oil). I wasn't impressed with the egg flower or hot and sour soup.
 
I work close by and their delivery service has been primo. On time and food is hot! Their staff is friendly and very helpful. Everyone I have introduced to this restaurant has been very pleased. I sincerely recommend this place.
yelp:train:84258.para:
I generally don't enjoy beef dishes in Chinese cuisine, but their Beef with Broccoli is outstanding! I relished it so much that I ordered it three days in a row for lunch. It's even better than the options at the Chinese Cultural Center restaurants, offering a more affordable and delicious experience. The lunch specials and dinner combos are both reasonably priced.

My personal favorites include:
- Beef with Broccoli - absolutely fantastic!
- Lemon Chicken - delicious!
- Moo Shu Pork - one of my top picks
- Sesame Chicken
- BBQ Pork
- Fried Shrimp - try dipping in a mix of ketchup and soy sauce
- Crab Puffs
- Pork Fried Rice
- Honey Garlic Chicken
- Sweet and Sour Pork

I don't particularly like the egg rolls (though my son adores them) or the pot stickers (which are deep-fried rather than steamed with oil). I was also underwhelmed by the egg flower and hot and sour soup.

The restaurant's delivery service is top-notch; the food arrives on time and hot. The staff is friendly and very helpful. Everyone I've introduced to this place has been very satisfied. I wholeheartedly recommend it.

yelp:train:84422.orig: when i first moved here I thought this pizza place was the bomb but apparently I came on a good day. I have ordered pizza twice since my last post and have been disgusted. I asked the girl on the phone for a bbq chicken pizza, and she says they can make it. So when I came to pick up my order, the pizza literally had hot wings on top... HOT WINGS!  i have never seen a bbq CHICKEN pizza with hot wings on top, however despite the disapointment in my pizza and the rude service, I figured I'd \""try\"" it. I was repulsed, tossed the pizza and called papa johns. NEVER AGAIN.
yelp:train:84422.para: When I first moved here, I thought this pizza place was fantastic, but it seems I had a lucky day back then. Since then, I've ordered twice and been thoroughly disappointed. I called to place an order for a BBQ chicken pizza, and she assured me they could make it. Upon picking up my order, I found hot wings on top of the pizza—HOT WINGS! I've never seen a BBQ chicken pizza with hot wings before. Despite the poor service, I decided to give it a try, but I was repulsed and threw the pizza away. I ended up ordering from Papa John's instead. I won't be returning.

yelp:train:84838.orig: Unique take on New Mexican, especially their lasagna-like stacked enchiladas. Good atmosphere, and friendly service. The owner is a good Nebraska guy, and very personable with the patrons.
yelp:train:84838.para: A distinctive approach to New Mexican cuisine, particularly their layered enchilada dishes reminiscent of lasagna. The ambiance is pleasant, and the service is friendly. The owner is a warm Nebraska native who interacts warmly with the customers.

yelp:train:84964.orig: I've visited several times for both breakfast and lunch.  They strive to have a homey feel, but the fake wood floors just make the place overly noisey.  The staff is very nice.  The food always reminds me of what I make myself when I'm in a hurry, rushing out the door.  Overall, I don't enjoy the place very much.
yelp:train:84964.para: I have visited multiple times for both breakfast and lunch. While they aim for a cozy atmosphere, the artificial wood floors result in excessive noise. The staff is quite friendly. The food often tastes similar to what I whip up in a hurry when leaving home quickly. In summary, I don't find the place very appealing.

yelp:train:85016.orig: Negative stars! Ugh, seriously, how can anyone give this place any stars at all? I guess if you're white trash and/or an alcoholic, you'll like the experience. I've done it once and I will never ever do it again, even if someone paid me. yelp:train:85016.para: Five-star negativity! Truly, how could anyone rate this place positively? It seems only those from less fortunate backgrounds or with alcohol issues might enjoy it. yelp:train:85083.orig: Slow service, cold food, and no manager to be found....  Not a good experience.  This place is usually ALOT better!
yelp:train:85083.para: The service was sluggish, the food was chilly, and there wasn't a manager around... Definitely not a satisfying visit. This establishment is typically much better!

yelp:train:85113.orig:
just moved around the corner from Flor De Michoacan. On a referral went into check it out. WOW! The owner Floyd happened to be there and let my wife and I sample all kinds of ice cream. It was amazing! We now go almost every single day. Stephanie and Gabriella are the nicest ladies and represent well. You can see the pride in their Hispanic heritage in their service levels. You gotta try the strawberries and creme. The best. U GOTTA GIVE THIS PLACE A TRY. I just have to workout more now! lol

Customer for life,
Don D.
yelp:train:85113.para:
Recently, I moved close to Flor De Michoacan and a friend recommended I visit. I was blown away! Floyd, the owner, was there and let my wife and I taste numerous ice cream flavors. It was outstanding! We now drop by almost daily. Stephanie and Gabriella are incredibly kind and do a great job. Their service truly reflects their Hispanic pride. The strawberries and cream flavor is exceptional. You really should give this place a try. I just need to exercise more now! lol

Customer for life,
Don D.

yelp:train:85488.orig: Other than the long wait to be seated, the restaurant is great. The food was delicious.
yelp:train:85488.para: Apart from the lengthy wait for a table, the restaurant is excellent, with particularly tasty food.

yelp:train:85571.orig: Love this place , they have the best breakfast burritos ( about 5 bucks)  I have ate here at all hours and the food is always good.  Plus it is open 24 hours a day!
yelp:train:85571.para: I adore this spot; their breakfast burritos are outstanding (around $5 each). I've dined here at various times, and the food has never disappointed. And the best part? They're open 24/7!

yelp:train:85593.orig: Food was good but the bakery was the best. Please try the Lemon Merigne pie. To die for!\n\nThe yelp app was a life saver since we had no idea where to eat.
yelp:train:85593.para: The food was delicious, but the bakery stood out the most. I highly recommend the Lemon Meringue pie—it's incredible! The Yelp app was incredibly helpful because we had no clue where to dine.

yelp:train:86765.orig: Wednesday: walk into the kitchen and flip on the lights... and nothing.  I check a few things, flip the breakers, even pulled off the plates on the switch and a dead outlet to check for lose wires, no such luck.  I called Dodge Electric on Friday afternoon and scheduled an appointment for 9 AM Monday morning.  9:01 AM Monday morning I meet the electrician and describe the problem to him and he gets to work.  9:40 AM, he finds a loose neutral wire in a smoke detector on a wall that's in no apparent way connected to the room without power.  9:41 AM I have lights in my kitchen and a slightly dumbfounded look my face.\n\nSummary: The electrician from Dodge Electric was punctual, friendly, knowledgeable, quick and efficient.  The price for the repair was also very reasonable.
yelp:train:86765.para:
Wednesday: I entered the kitchen and turned on the lights, but nothing happened. After checking a few things, I flipped the circuit breakers and even inspected the switch plates and a dead outlet for loose wires, but to no avail. On Friday afternoon, I contacted Dodge Electric and scheduled a 9 AM appointment for Monday. At 9:01 AM on Monday, the electrician arrived, and I explained the issue to him. By 9:40 AM, he had identified a loose neutral wire in a smoke detector on a wall that wasn't directly connected to the room without power. By 9:41 AM, my kitchen was lit, and I had a slightly bewildered expression on my face.

Summary: The electrician from Dodge Electric was punctual, friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient. The repair cost was also quite reasonable.

yelp:train:87749.orig:
Went in this morning for breakfast with my husband and daughter. Glad we arrive before 10 am because the restaurant filled up pretty quickly after that time. 

I had the green flannel hash -- Amazing. A terrific portion and super tasty. The dollop of sour cream is perfect to cool the spice of the jalapenos.  I don't generally order a more savory meal for breakfast, generally preferring french toast or pancakes, but the green flannel hash is a must have at Orange Table.

My daughter enjoyed her pancake, scrambled eggs and a slice of bacon.  Just the right size for a hungry nine-year-old. She ate her entire meal.  I snagged a bit of her bacon and it was awesome! Thick cut and cooked to perfection.  She also had a hot chocolate.  No thin, out-of-a-machine beverage-- the real deal with chocolate and whole milk.  An indulgence!

My husband loved his garlic and mushroom omelet. He asked to have spinach added to which our waiter replied, ""Sure. No problem!"" His omelet arrived with a really nice helping of spinach included.  My husband replied that he's not always a fan of omelets but he wanted to give this one a try.  It was cooked to perfection-- not too thick and eggy but a ni
yelp:train:87749.para:
This morning, I went for breakfast with my husband and daughter. We were glad we arrived before 10 am, as the restaurant quickly filled up afterward.

I ordered the green flannel hash, which was outstanding. The portion was generous, and it was incredibly delicious. The sour cream added the perfect touch to balance the jalapenos' heat. Usually, I prefer French toast or pancakes for breakfast, but the green flannel hash is a must-try at Orange Table.

My daughter enjoyed her pancakes, scrambled eggs, and a slice of bacon. It was just the right size for a hungry nine-year-old, and she finished her meal. I took a bite of her bacon, and it was fantastic—thick-cut and perfectly cooked. She also had hot chocolate, which was rich and made with real chocolate and whole milk, a true indulgence.

My husband loved his garlic and mushroom omelet. He asked for spinach to be added, and the waiter happily obliged. His omelet came with a good amount of spinach. My husband said he's not always a fan of omelets but decided to give this one a try. It was cooked to perfection—not too thick or eggy but just right.

yelp:train:87876.orig: Good place to pick up a nice essential piece to build outfits around. The sale rack is your friend, it's worth taking five minutes to flip through it. Employees are attentive but not pushy, which frankly, I'd rather be ignored until I'm ready to purchase something, but as long as they're not breathing down my neck, I'm good.
yelp:train:87876.para: A great spot to find a versatile essential that can be the foundation of your outfits. Don't miss the sale rack; spending a few minutes there could yield a good find. The staff are considerate without being intrusive, which is exactly what I prefer—let me browse on my own time, but they're fine as long as they keep their distance.

yelp:train:87997.orig: Always busy for HH! They have great patio seating (not in the sun). Food is fast and fabulous. A great place for out of towners to go see the Scottsdale scene and not be disappointed!
yelp:train:87997.para: HH is always bustling! Their patio offers excellent seating,避开阳光. 食物既快又美味. 对于外地游客来说，这里是一个不错的选择，可以感受Scottsdale的氛围，绝对不会失望！

yelp:train:88318.orig: I went to Grazie with my family, visiting from out of town. It was cold out that eve so I requested the front door be closed. The waitress told me, \""We are supposed to keep it open.\"" Not a very accommodating voice or comment. I looked around and the only reason I could see for this was that the woodfired oven is in the direct path of the air from the front door. GOD FORBID THE COOK GET HOT while he is making our pizza. We, and the other patrons ate pizza with our COATS ON. Really? The pizza isn't as good as it used to be. And the service BLOWS.
yelp:train:88318.para: My family and I visited Grazie during our stay in town, and it was chilly outside that evening. I asked the waitress to close the front door, but she replied, "We're supposed to keep it open." Her response didn't seem very welcoming. Observing the area, the only explanation I could find was that the wood-fired oven was directly in the path of the air coming from the front door. It seemed absurd to me that the cook would get too hot while making our pizza. We and the other customers had to eat our pizza while wearing our coats. Was that really necessary? The pizza isn't as delicious as it used to be, and the service is terrible.

yelp:train:88794.orig: Extremely disappointed with this place.....was looking forward to \""Beat the Heat -- Arizona Winterfest\"" at The Venue Scottsdale last Saturday, but as other reviewers have mentioned...it was quite simply a disaster.  No A/C. No A/C. No A/C.  Enough said.\n\nI did at least get my money back.
yelp:train:88794.para: I was very disappointed with my visit to The Venue Scottsdale for the "Beat the Heat -- Arizona Winterfest" last Saturday. As other reviewers have noted, it was a complete disaster—no air conditioning at all. This was mentioned three times for emphasis. Suffice it to say, it was not a pleasant experience. At least I received a refund.

yelp:train:88926.orig: Very family-friendly; one area of the restaurant is kid-oriented. Service was fast and friendly and the prices reasonable. Delicious ice cream.
yelp:train:88926.para: This place is very family-oriented, with a dedicated area for kids. The service was quick and courteous, and the prices were reasonable. The ice cream was particularly delicious.

yelp:train:89554.orig: I would recommend Arizona Academy of Real Estate INSTEAD.  Arizona School of Real Estate & Business is overkill if you ask me.  You need to take your test and pass before you can take the state test.  Well if you fail the school test they won't show you your test scores to help in any way.  In fact you get sent home to find out if you pass online.  Funny because even the state test is graded immediately, and breaks down the test in sections so you know what to study when you retake the test.  My friend went to Arizona Academy of Real Estate and said they scan your test right in front of you when you turn it in, and it breaks down each section to let you know what you got wrong so you know what to study.  Same format as the state test. Oh, and their study guide was so small.  Well if you go to ASREB you definitely won't be able to say the same.  Arizona School of Real Estate gives you 3 different study guides.  The National Study guide has two study guides they tell you to memorize.  One study guide for this has 522 questions, study guide 2 has 320 questions, and the state study guide has 279 questions. That is 1,121 questions they send you home with for a school test that only has
yelp:train:89554.para: I suggest Arizona Academy of Real Estate instead. In my opinion, Arizona School of Real Estate & Business is more than necessary. You have to pass a test from the school before you can take the state test. However, if you fail the school test, they won't provide your scores to help you improve. Instead, you're sent home to find out your results online. It's ironic, as the state test is graded immediately and breaks down the sections to guide you on what to study for a retake. My friend attended Arizona Academy of Real Estate and said they scan your test right in front of you, providing detailed feedback on each section. This format is similar to the state test. Additionally, their study guide was quite minimal. In contrast, Arizona School of Real Estate offers three different study guides. The National Study Guide includes two memorization guides, with 522 questions in one and 320 in the other. The state study guide has 279 questions, making a total of 1,121 questions for the school test.

yelp:train:89560.orig:
This was not a very good experience for me, my husband, or my daughter.  Made a visit to the Scottsdale mall store and an incredibly rude younger dark haired woman helped us. 

 I guess she wasn't happy that we were asking the prices.  Maybe she felt our $500 purchase was a waste of her precious bitch time, not sure.  I came over to the counter to help my daughter pick something that she really wanted and not to go for the cheaper closure because she was probably worried she was taking advantage of us.  I was pointing her to something of more quality and of course more expensive because I would prefer she gets something nice that will last a very long time and that she would be happy with.  The bitch actually told me to go take a seat in the man chair because they were close to a decision.  I actually made that bitch more money but I think she may have been too stupid and too impatient to even realize nor do I think she cares about our piddly little purchase.  Normally I would educate a dumb bitch like that but I just didnt need the drama so I walked away.

yelp:train:89560.para: This wasn't a pleasant experience for my family. At the Scottsdale mall store, a young, dark-haired woman was extremely rude to us. She seemed upset that we were inquiring about prices. Perhaps she thought our $500 purchase wasn't worth her time. I approached the counter to assist my daughter in choosing something of better quality, not the cheaper option, as I wanted her to have something that would last and bring her joy. Instead, she told me to sit in the waiting area, suggesting we were nearly done. Despite making her more money, she seemed too ignorant or impatient to care about our small purchase. Usually, I would have given her a piece of my mind, but I decided to avoid the drama and left. When I entered the store, no one noticed we were together as I arrived a few minutes after my family.

yelp:train:89743.orig: Incredibly knowledgeable staff. Great book signings.
yelp:train:89743.para: Staff with remarkable knowledge. Excellent book signings.

yelp:train:89926.orig: Malee's was very good.  My mom was here visiting from Washington State.  She had never had Thai food before but I knew she would love it.  We had the fresh spring rolls to start with, this is a meal here but in most places might have been an app.  We liked these so much that I am going to try to recreate these for dinner at home one night.  We also had the chow Mein, which was very good!  There could have been more meat but it was still good.  I would go back to Malee's for sure!
yelp:train:89926.para: Malee's exceeded expectations, especially for my mom, who was visiting from Washington State and hadn't tried Thai food before. We began with the fresh spring rolls, which are considered a full meal at Malee's but typically an appetizer elsewhere. These were so delightful that I plan to attempt making them at home. We also enjoyed the chow mein, which was quite good, though I wished there was more meat. I'm definitely returning to Malee's in the future!

yelp:train:90582.orig: Ordered the nachos and the veggie enchiladas, and 2 margaritas.  The beans on the nachos were incredibly salty - could not eat without drowning them in sour cream.  The dinner plate was loaded with so much cheese you could choke from it... unhealthy and fattening meal, and unfortunately the taste, quality of food, or flavor did not justify the calories.   The atmosphere is very nice, unfortunately the food made it such that I'll never return.  Service was good overall.  The manager walked over to ask us how we were doing, but didn't stay long enough to hear the answer.  Enjoyed the 80's alternative music.
yelp:train:90582.para: I ordered nachos, veggie enchiladas, and two margaritas. The nachos had an excessively salty bean topping; I had to cover them in sour cream to make them palatable. The dinner plate was overloaded with cheese, which was both unhealthy and unappealing. The taste and quality of the food didn't match the caloric intake, making the meal unsatisfying. Although the ambiance was pleasant, the food quality was poor, and I doubt I'll return. The service was decent, with the manager checking in briefly, but not staying to hear our feedback. I appreciated the 80s alternative music playing in the background.

yelp:train:90686.orig:
Yeah Im a BIG FAN.  

This place is great for getting a bite to eat like a burger or ribs.  I have gone to this place for many years and I always leave satisfied.  The wait staff is great and they bring out a complimentary chopped liver platter that is so good, and don't knock it till you try it. 

I would bring family here or if your a sports fan and with a couple buddies thats good.

Sign up for there rewards program and you will get emails giving deals.  During Suns games and other sports events burgers at the bar for like 8 bucks and for you birthday they give you a 25 dollars off for spending 50.

Recommendation:  To anyone that likes good stakes and burgers, and has a craving for awesome fries, copped liver, and good service.
yelp:train:90686.para:
Absolutely, I'm a huge fan of this place. It's perfect for a quick meal, whether it's a burger or ribs. I've been coming here for years, and I always leave feeling satisfied. The service is fantastic, and they offer a complimentary chopped liver platter that's really delicious—don't dismiss it without trying it first.

I'd recommend bringing your family or a group of sports fans here. They have a rewards program where you can sign up and receive special deals. During Suns games and other events, burgers at the bar can be as low as $8, and they offer a 25% discount on your birthday if you spend $50.

For those who enjoy great steaks and burgers, and have a craving for amazing fries, chopped liver, and excellent service, this is the place to go.

yelp:train:90980.orig: News Flash!  Pepins is a far cry from traditional Spanish cuisine and somehow, someone thought that they would classify it as \""Basque Cuisine\"" also.  I guess it sounds good to throw that in.  Me thinks not!  The cuisine has nothing to do with Basque cuisine.  The Spanish cuisine is very much Americanized.  Since most people on this planet have not traveled to Pais Basco (Basque Country, located in the most northern, central region of Spain and partly in France) the owners of Pepins must think that the consumer will take their word for it.  Pepins food is not \""terrible\"", but it's not Spanish, and it's definitely not Basque!  The service was atrocious when we went.  The Paella, was hardly a paella.  The garlic shrimp was pretty good though.  And what's up with the Salsa dancing in a \""Spanish\"" restaurant.  Weird.\n\ni'm giving it an extra star because I'm nice guy.  If I told actually thought, Yelp would have to come up with a separate rating scale.
yelp:train:90980.para:
Breaking News! Pepins is a far cry from traditional Spanish cuisine, and someone apparently decided to categorize it as "Basque Cuisine." I can't believe that's a thing! The food has nothing to do with Basque cuisine. It's actually quite Americanized. Since most people haven't visited the Basque Country, the owners likely assume consumers will trust their classification. While the food isn't terrible, it's definitely not Spanish or Basque! The service was terrible when we visited. The paella was barely recognizable as paella. The garlic shrimp was the highlight, though. And why is there salsa dancing in a "Spanish" restaurant? It's bizarre. 

I'm giving it an extra star just because I'm a nice guy. If I truly thought about it, Yelp might need a separate rating scale.

yelp:train:91589.orig: Beware gift cards expire. Who does that anymore?  If I pay you $100. Why should it expire?  Stupid!
yelp:train:91589.para: Be cautious; gift cards often have expiration dates. Isn't that ridiculous? If I give you $100, why should it expire? That's absurd!

yelp:train:92246.orig:
Great place with great wine.  I am a regular and always look forward to coming here for a Red Zin.   

They always have one by the glass and it's always a treat to see which one they picked to pour!   

As soon as the weather is a bit better, the patio is great.
yelp:train:92246.para:
A wonderful spot with excellent wine. I frequently visit and eagerly anticipate stopping by for a Red Zin. 

They consistently offer a Red Zin by the glass, and it's always delightful to discover which one they've chosen to serve. 

Once the weather improves, the patio is fantastic.

yelp:train:92792.orig: I love our timeshare where we have been calling home for the past week. The staff is super friendly, the gym although small has recently been renovated/upgraded, and everything is within a 15 minute drive which is nice. Our studio has the basics (which is perfect since we are minimalists) and a nice patio to relax and enjoy the sunrise. There are 2 jacuzzis (one is for adults only) and the pool is decently sized and has a nice waterfall overhang.  CVS/Pharmacy, coffee, groceries and places to get things you forgot/ need for your stay is located along the way to this place. You can walk to the Fairmont (ten minutes or less) to meet up for drinks or friends. My only gripe\nis the wall are thin... either that or the two older women have naturally loud voices... I guess it is perk because they are our alarm clocks... and I am sure since we go to bed 2 hours later than them they hear us blaring the Olympics.
yelp:train:92792.para: We've been staying at our timeshare for the past week, and it feels like home. The staff is incredibly friendly, and while the gym is small, it has been recently renovated. Everything is conveniently within a 15-minute drive, which is great. Our studio is minimalistic and has the essentials we need, plus a pleasant patio for relaxing and watching the sunrise. There are two jacuzzis (one for adults only) and a decent-sized pool with a nice waterfall feature. Along the way to the timeshare, you'll find CVS/Pharmacy, coffee shops, grocery stores, and places to grab anything you might have forgotten. You can easily walk to the Fairmont for drinks or to meet friends (it's just a ten-minute stroll). The only downside is that the walls are thin, or perhaps the two older women have naturally loud voices, but it works as an alarm clock for us. They must be hearing us watching the Olympics late at night since we go to bed two hours later than them.

yelp:train:92862.orig: We had went to rawhide Aug 30 and to celebrate my 10 year anniversary and to try the rattlesnake. First of all it started ok until the new waiter spilled water all over my Dad's back. I understand he was training but the only comp we got from them was \""oh sorry he was a trainer\"" and we got 2 baskets of  cornbread. What kind of comp  is that?  They did not even offer to get his clothes dry cleaned or even dried off. \nNext the food ... Rattlesnake was no different from popcorn chicken. It was not what I expected. The steak and prime rib was dry and the sides were not good. And I got sick the next day with diarrhea and vomiting. \nI  spent a lot of money and was disappointed with the entertainment. Overall my experience was 1 one star. Not a happy customer
yelp:train:92862.para:
On August 30, we visited Rawhide to celebrate my 10-year anniversary and to try the rattlesnake dish. Initially, things seemed fine, but a new waiter accidentally spilled water on my dad's back. While they acknowledged it was a training session, the compensation of just two baskets of cornbread was inadequate. They didn't even offer to dry clean or dry off his clothes.

Regarding the food, the rattlesnake tasted no better than popcorn chicken, which was not what I anticipated. The steak and prime rib were dry, and the sides were subpar. Additionally, I fell ill the following day with diarrhea and vomiting.

I invested a significant amount of money and was let down by the entertainment. Overall, my experience rated one star, and I am not a satisfied customer.

yelp:train:92973.orig: Food was delicious. I had the meatloaf and the brown tomato gravy on top was fantastic. Hubby had the Catfish and said it was great. Large portions...we didn't finish. Server was very attentive.
yelp:train:92973.para: The food was superb; I enjoyed the meatloaf, particularly the brown tomato gravy that was outstanding. My husband had the catfish, which he found to be excellent. We both had generous portions that were too much for us to finish. The server was very attentive throughout our meal.

yelp:train:93028.orig: It's always the first place I eat at when returning to Scottsdale.
yelp:train:93028.para: Whenever I return to Scottsdale, this is the very first restaurant I head to for a meal.

yelp:train:93389.orig: Went into Denny's to get my all you can eat pancakes once out of the year for Veterans Day and got denied.  Apparently they already have deeply discounted menu options like there value slam, so they disregard there promise of all you can eat pancakes on Veterans Day(only Denny's near me)
yelp:train:93389.para: I went to Denny's to enjoy their all-you-can-eat pancakes for Veterans Day, but was denied. It seems they offer already discounted menu options like their Value Slam, which apparently overrides their promise of all-you-can-eat pancakes on this holiday (at the Denny's near me).

yelp:train:93528.orig:
It's Friday...strike that, Saturday morning.  I have one mud covered high heel.  I have had a few vodkas, so have my friends.  We took a cab, but that doesn't stop us from getting a burrito.  I buy one for the cab driver too since he was nice enough to turn off the meter and didn't mind that my shoe was extremely dirty.  

The pastor taco is delicious.  The chorizo burrito is delicious.  The bean and cheese burrito is delicious, not that you can mess up something that simple.  The guy behind the counter is super and puts up with my drunken food requests (basically, that means adding sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo to everything).  It also helps that my best friend speaks fluent Spanish and that the counter guy has a crush on me.

Super burrito is not only great for drunk binge eating, but also for awkward heart to hearts with your friends.  If you can't say it over burritos on the patio, when can you say it?  It reminds me of those 'chew it over with Twix' commercials, only you shove a burrito in your mouth instead of candy bars.
yelp:train:93528.para:
It's Saturday morning...let's just say it's Friday. I've got one muddy high heel, and we've all had a few vodkas. We took a cab, but that doesn't stop us from ordering a burrito. I even bought one for the cab driver, who was kind enough to turn off the meter despite my extremely dirty shoe. 

The pastor taco is fantastic, as is the chorizo burrito, and the bean and cheese burrito is simply perfect—there's no room for improvement in something so straightforward. The guy at the counter is amazing and accommodates my drunken food requests, which basically means adding sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo to everything. Plus, my best friend speaks fluent Spanish, and the counter guy has a crush on me, which makes the whole experience even better.

Super burritos are not just for drunk eating; they're also perfect for heartfelt conversations with friends. If you can't express your feelings over burritos on the patio, when can you? It's like those 'chew it over with Twix' commercials, but with burritos instead of candy bars.

yelp:train:93679.orig:
When gramps said we (me, him and dad) were going here on Christmas Day, I spent the past four days despairing the idea. Seeing a year's worth of 1-star reviews didn't help my negative attitude going into this festive meal, either. I was fully planning on adding my own snarky one-star review to this place after I vomited up whatever I happened to ingest here, however I'm giving as optimistic of a two-star review as I can.

First off, don't kid yourself. The food is as bad as all the reviews here say. They did have some decent turkey they were slicing up, though, and i had some rice that appeared to be the only side item not swimming in goo. 

And yes, the bathrooms are as disgusting as other reviewers have mentioned. Nearly the entire men's room floor was wet and there were no less than three wet floor signs in there. Hazmat suit recommended.

However, I bumped this to a 2 - more like a 2.5 - because the poor Christmas-day staff was straight busting ass to keep the overflowing crowd stuffed full of breaded cardboard-like substances, and they were doing a fine job of reaching that goal. The manager was being as nice as he could to his employees while they were all no doubt pret
yelp:train:93679.para:
When Gramps announced our trip to this place on Christmas Day, I spent the last four days dreading it. The mountain of one-star reviews didn't improve my mood going in. I was prepared to add a scathing one-star review, but after the experience, I'm giving it a more optimistic two-star rating.

Firstly, the food is as bad as everyone says. They did have some decent turkey, and the rice was the only side that wasn't soaked in a gooey mess. 

Yes, the bathrooms are as filthy as other reviews claim. The men's room floor was mostly wet, and there were at least three "wet floor" signs. A hazmat suit might have been necessary.

However, I upgraded my rating to a 2, closer to a 2.5, because the staff, despite being short-handed on Christmas Day, worked tirelessly to keep the crowd fed with what seemed like cardboard-like food. The manager was doing his best to keep everyone happy.

yelp:train:93888.orig: I've been going here since I was a kid.....um a while ago. They are the lease expensive place to go for glasses by far, they take there time with you and their selection is always great.  You sometimes have to wait since they are very popular, but they are popular for great reasons. I don't go anywhere else.....its the very best bang for your buck for something noone wants to have to have.
yelp:train:93888.para: I've been visiting here since I was young... quite some time ago now. They offer the most affordable prices for glasses, and they take their time to ensure you get the best fit. Their selection is consistently impressive. There might be a wait due to their popularity, but it's well worth it. I never go anywhere else; it's the absolute best value for a necessity that no one really enjoys.

yelp:train:94030.orig:
Based on the Szechwan Chicken and the Spicy Chicken dishes two stars seems about right.

The menu here states that the spicy chicken would be in a bean sauce but we received it in approximately eighty percent sriracha sauce and the rest was mostly oil. This was the better dish.

The Szechwan Chicken I couldn't eat because it was extremely sweet and could have passed for a dessert sauce.

Both meals were made with nicely cooked white meat chicken. The vegetables in both dishes were bell peppers, onions and mushrooms that were a good ratio. They gave us two plates of white rice that were approximately three cups each.

Maybe other dishes on the menu are better I don't know.

This place is very casual you order at the counter and seat yourself.

I do note this place is very clean and spotless.
yelp:train:94030.para:
Based on the Szechwan Chicken and the Spicy Chicken, two stars seem appropriate.

The menu indicates the Spicy Chicken should be in a bean sauce, but we got it in about eighty percent sriracha with the rest being mostly oil. This dish was the standout.

I couldn't finish the Szechwan Chicken as it was extremely sweet, almost like a dessert sauce.

Both meals featured well-cooked white meat chicken with bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms in a good balance. We received two portions of rice, each about three cups.

Other dishes on the menu might be better, but I can't say for sure.

The place is quite casual, with ordering at the counter and self-seating.

I do observe that the establishment is very clean and spotless.

yelp:train:94722.orig: Good beer. Terrible food. Bland, bland, bland. First off it took 15 minutes for anyone to realize we were in the place. Secondly the food was as if the cook just took the food out of the package threw it on the grill and then served it. I never thought of salt as a spice but seeing as it was the only thing to make the food have any taste guess it will have to do. The one upside our server was very nice.
yelp:train:94722.para: The beer was decent, but the food was awful, incredibly bland. Initially, it took 15 minutes for staff to notice our presence. The dishes seemed to be straight from the packaging, grilled and served without much effort. Salt was the only thing that added any flavor, which was surprising since I usually think of it as a basic seasoning. On the bright side, our server was quite pleasant.

yelp:train:95315.orig: Great room for the price. Paid 70 and we were expecting a shitty hotel.  Rooms looked newly remodeled, beds were comfortable and the place was clean.
yelp:train:95315.para: The room was excellent for the cost; we paid 70 dollars and didn't expect much from a hotel, but the place exceeded our expectations. The rooms appeared to have been recently renovated, the beds were comfortable, and everything was clean.

yelp:train:95496.orig: My problem is with their undergraduate admissions dept. I had sent $2 for a transcript request to my high school, not to mention rude service from them, to get me off this financial hold. Today, I had spoken with a rep from ASU undergraduate, and she was rude. I have asked her to speak with the person that deals with the actual PO Box that receives the transcripts, and she asked me, \""why?\"" I had told her that My school had sent the paperwork, she had told me that there's nothing they could do. I think that this college want me to pay out of pocket instead of receiving financial aid. Im tired of playing these games. I had thought that ASU had a good reputation.
yelp:train:95496.para: My issue lies with ASU's undergraduate admissions office. I sent $2 for a transcript request to my high school and dealt with rude service. Today, I spoke with a representative from ASU's undergraduate department, who was also rude. I asked her to communicate with the person handling the PO Box that receives transcripts, and she questioned why. She informed me that they couldn't do anything since my school had sent the paperwork. I believe they want me to pay out of pocket rather than using financial aid. I'm fed up with these games. I had assumed ASU had a good reputation.

yelp:train:95855.orig: The pizza is good ,but not great, the service is almost always slow and the place is generally a dump, yet for some reason I can't stop going back.  Maybe it's the fact that it's on my way to campus.  Maybe it's because it's the only place i've found near campus where I can get 2 slices and a drink for $5.  Maybe I just get a kick out of the fact that the middle aged balding guy (manager?) is almost always yelling at one of the mexican dudes in the back.  For whatever unknown, illlogical reason I just like this place!
yelp:train:95855.para: The pizza is decent, though not exceptional, and the service is typically slow, with the place generally in a state of disarray. Despite these issues, I keep returning for some reason. Perhaps it's the convenience of its location on my way to campus. Or maybe it’s the affordability; it’s the only place nearby where I can get two slices and a drink for just $5. Could it be the entertainment value of watching the middle-aged, balding manager (likely the owner) frequently yelling at one of the Mexican employees in the back? Regardless of the inexplicable and illogical reasons, I just can't get enough of this place!

yelp:train:95987.orig: Spring rolls, egg rolls and Pho are just as good or even better than the best Vietnamese in other cities (San Jose, NYC and Denver, to name a few)...but the building, service and drink offerings are lacking. There's water and juice and...water...\nKinda sucks to waste a nice Date Night outfit on this drab locale. So don't bother. T-shirts and flip-flops abound.\nThe Lemongrass Chicken isn't quite as spicy as my husband remembered from \""the old days\"" but he still enjoyed it.
yelp:train:95987.para:
While spring rolls, egg rolls, and Pho here are just as delicious or even superior to the best Vietnamese food in San Jose, NYC, and Denver, the ambiance, service, and drink options fall short. The menu features water, juice, and, disappointingly, more water.

This place doesn't justify a nice date night outfit, making it a drab choice. Opting to visit here is not recommended; instead, you'll likely see people in casual attire like T-shirts and flip-flops.

The Lemongrass Chicken isn't as spicy as my husband remembers from the past, but he still found it enjoyable.

yelp:train:96235.orig: Excellent pizza marguerite and guacamole appetizer was big and excellent and as always the cookie dessert was fabulous!
yelp:train:96235.para: The pizza margherita and guacamole appetizer were both outstanding and generous in portion, and, as expected, the cookie dessert was fantastic!

yelp:train:96268.orig: Always the best.  Been going to Oregano's for over 20 years.  Great place.
yelp:train:96268.para: For more than two decades, I've been a regular at Oregano's, and it remains one of the best places around.

yelp:train:96333.orig:
I have tried this location twice for custom print work. My two star goes to the terribly unhappy woman that works behind the counter. And this locations lack of attention to detail. 

Honey, for Pete's sake, be nice. You have lovely manicured nails, nice skin and a you stand with a strong presence. Why do you have to be so pissed off looking? It makes your customers uncomfortable. 

Team, small things, like cutting a straight line along the edge of a print job. It goes a long way. They were invitations to a party, not some cheap flyer! Couldn't you have paid closer attention to detail so that it didn't look like a five year old cut them out with hand scissors?
yelp:train:96333.para:
I've visited this place twice for custom printing, and I've given the counter staff a two-star rating due to their poor service and lack of attention to detail. 

Sweetie, for goodness' sake, try to be more pleasant. You have beautiful nails, nice skin, and a commanding presence. Why do you have to look so grumpy? It makes customers feel uncomfortable. 

Team, even small things like ensuring a clean, straight edge on a print job can make a big difference. These were invitations to a party, not cheap flyers! Couldn't you have paid more attention to detail so they didn't look like they were cut with scissors by a five-year-old?

yelp:train:96372.orig:
This place is a nice little surprise next to the gym I recently started working out at. It's . . . quaint, but the people there are friendly enough and the drinks and smoothies are surprisingly tasty. 

I am sipping back on a protein berry something or other right now that is on point. 

They do things a little differently over here than at your local Jamba Juice. They allow you to choose a base (soy, yogurt, etc.), a flavor, and then a boost to mix in, making it sort of a do-it-yourself version of its counterpart. 

There is also a wide selection of protein blends and pills to use as supplements for workouts, but, frankly I don't trust those things all that much. Anything that engineered can't be that healthy for you, regardless of their claims of being naturally occurring or whatever. I bet that's what they told Barry over at Balco, too. 

There is a tanning salon attached that I also skip by. For pretty much the same reasons as I skip the supplements. Engineered sunlight can't be a good thing in heavy doses, no matter how you spin it. 

All in all, a good place to stop in and use their internet (did I mention it also doubles as an internet cafe?) and sip on something b
yelp:train:96372.para:
This spot is a delightful surprise right next to the gym I began working out at. It’s charming, and the folks there are quite friendly. The drinks and smoothies are surprisingly delicious.

Right now, I’m enjoying a protein berry smoothie that’s really hitting the spot.

They offer a unique approach compared to your typical Jamba Juice. You can pick your base (soy, yogurt, etc.), choose a flavor, and add a boost, creating a customized version of their smoothies.

They also have a range of protein blends and pills for workout supplements, but I’m not entirely convinced. Anything that’s engineered probably isn’t as healthy as it claims, whether it’s marketed as natural or not. I’m sure the same logic applies to the tanning salon attached, which I avoid for the same reasons.

Overall, it’s a good spot to grab some internet access (they also function as an internet cafe) and a refreshing drink.

yelp:train:96990.orig:
I spent half my life at Coney Island and wanted a NY hot dog. It wasn't here. Try Nathan's at the AZ Mills Mall...and even that ain't a Coney Island dog.

I seem to remember the very sweet and helpful waitress saying Jim wasn't from Coney Island, so I gave her a good tip before shootin' her.

Don't be fooled by the name. Looked like it was out of business last time I drove by. Maybe somethin' happened to Jim. You know what I'm talkin' about!?
yelp:train:96990.para:
I spent half my life at Coney Island and craved a New York hot dog, but I couldn't find one here. Try Nathan's at the AZ Mills Mall, but even that isn't a true Coney Island dog.

The nice and helpful waitress told me Jim wasn't from Coney Island, so I tipped her well before leaving. 

The place looks like it might be closed; I saw it last time I drove by. Maybe something happened to Jim. You know what I mean!

yelp:train:97026.orig: Service was slow but the food was awesome! Fun atmosphere! Pool table, lots of tvs, games... Great time! And a bar!
yelp:train:97026.para: The service was a bit slow, but the food was outstanding! The place had a great vibe with a pool table, multiple TVs, and various games. It was a fantastic time, and there was even a bar!

yelp:train:97269.orig: My ritual every morning is to get their columbian coffee with chocolate and nature valley's salty and sweet peanuts snack bar from this place. They have the fastest service ever as they kept the line going and nobody has to wait more than 5 minutes to pay. The friendliest customer service! Woh!
yelp:train:97269.para: Each morning, I start with a Columbian coffee mixed with chocolate and a Nature Valley snack bar that's both salty and sweet. The service here is incredibly quick; there's always a steady flow, and no one waits longer than five minutes to pay. The staff are so friendly! Wow!

yelp:train:97445.orig: I am so glad I found this place because I no longer have to make baklava when ever I get the craving. Yes I know there are places to get baklava around Phx but they were either too soggy, too sweet, too sugary, too stale, etc. Something was always wrong. But this place is definitely a diamond in the rough. They have a basic selection of middle eastern food like the sherwarma and the kabobs, which are all very tasty and well prepared and much cheaper than the Persian Room (I'm not the biggest fan of the Persian Room bc its just not worth the drive and money unless you are on a date and trying to impress someone). They also have a great selection of baklava like almond, pistachio, cashew, walnut, and the princess which is think is a combination of all the nuts. Regardless of what you get, you will be happy (both mouth and wallet). \n\nThe downside is that since it is in a grocery store, its a bit crowded and sometimes the wait can be a bit long, but I don't really mind the wait bc I know everything is fresh and prepared when ordered.
yelp:train:97445.para:
I'm thrilled to have discovered this place because it means I no longer need to make baklava whenever I get a craving. While there are other baklava options in Phoenix, most were either too soggy, too sweet, too sugary, or too stale—something was always off. However, this place is a real gem. They offer a basic selection of Middle Eastern dishes like shawarma and kabobs, all of which are delicious and well-prepared, and much more affordable than the Persian Room (I'm not a big fan of the Persian Room as it's not worth the drive and expense unless you're on a date and want to impress someone). They also have an excellent variety of baklava, including almond, pistachio, cashew, and walnut, with a princess option that combines all the nuts. No matter what you choose, you'll be satisfied (both mouth and wallet).

The only downside is that it's located in a grocery store, which can be a bit crowded and have longer wait times, but I don't mind the wait because I know everything is fresh and made to order.

yelp:train:97490.orig: The food is great, the shawarma plate, hummus, mixed grill, it could've been better tho. The staff and service is ok.\n\n4-star mostly is for the garlic souce
yelp:train:97490.para: The food is delicious, with standout items like the shawarma plate, hummus, and mixed grill, though there's room for improvement. The service and staff are satisfactory. I'd give it 4 stars mainly for the garlic sauce.

yelp:train:97813.orig:
Time will tell.  My son had his oil changed there on Thursday, Feb 9th and then came home later that evening and parked in the driveway in Sahuarita.  On Saturday, I was looking at the tires because the service rep indicated they needed to be replaced (they have at least 20k) more miles when I depth checked them.  I noticed a significant oil leak. 

I crawled under the vehicle and found that the oil plug was loose and I was able to turn with my fingers.  When I hand tightened the plug, I found that the hole had been stripped when they did the oil change.  Nothing was ever said and thankfully I found the issue before he seized the engine.  I've called American 5 Star and left a message as they close at 1 Saturday.  I'll update the review with their response.

*************
Owner took in car and fixed the oil leak.  He was really good to work with, listened to my concerns and took care of my son.  Thank you!!
yelp:train:97813.para:
Time will reveal the outcome. My son had his oil changed on Thursday, February 9th at that location, and returned home that evening to park in the driveway in Sahuarita. On Saturday, I inspected the tires, as the service representative mentioned they needed replacement (with at least 20, 000 miles remaining). During the inspection, I noticed a significant oil leak.

I crawled under the vehicle and discovered that the oil plug was loose, which I could tighten by hand. Upon hand-tightening the plug, I found that the hole had been stripped during the oil change. Fortunately, I identified the issue before the engine seized. I contacted American 5 Star and left a message, as they were closed on Saturday. I will update this review with their response.

*************
The owner took my son's car to fix the oil leak. He was very cooperative, listened to my concerns, and took good care of my son. Thank you!

yelp:train:97918.orig: By far for me, this is the best Pizza around. I love the sweet sauce, for some it might be to much but for me it is perfect. I would recommend sticking with the thin crust as the tradition is a little to much dough. I have had salads, spaghetti and meatballs, pretty much everything on the menu and not once was anything bad. the only complaint I have is there is not one by me.
yelp:train:97918.para: In my opinion, this pizza is the absolute best I've had. I really enjoy the sweet sauce—it might be too much for some, but I find it just right. I'd suggest going with the thin crust; the traditional option has a bit too much dough for my taste. I've tried salads, spaghetti, meatballs, and pretty much everything on the menu, and everything has been excellent. The only downside is that there isn't a location near me.

yelp:train:98108.orig: small uncomfortable beds, have to pay for Internet, have to pay for breakfast, and let's just say my bath towel was not clean. didn't get to go to the pool or gym but they looked really nice and modern. rather not stay here again tho.
yelp:train:98108.para: The beds were quite small and uncomfortable, and I had to pay extra for Internet and breakfast. My bath towel wasn't clean either. Although the pool and gym looked nice and modern, I didn't get to use them. I don't really want to stay at this place again.

yelp:train:98235.orig: Good food, really cool, old restaurant. Had a history lesson from the waiter before ordering. Definitely recommend this place!
yelp:train:98235.para: This is a fantastic restaurant with a rich history. The waiter provided an interesting lesson before we placed our order. I highly recommend it!

yelp:train:98675.orig: I have not known a person who spoke of this place in anything but glowing terms. This was over many years. I have had their food a few times and felt the fish was like cardboard and nothing to speak well of.
yelp:train:98675.para: For years, everyone I've spoken to about this place has only spoken highly of it. However, when I tried their food a few times, I found the fish to be tasteless, almost like cardboard, and not worth mentioning positively.

yelp:train:98677.orig: Didn't care for our square fish or the sauce. Both of us ended up feeling and getting sick that night.  I won't be returning.  I don't understand the appeal at all.
yelp:train:98677.para: I didn't enjoy the square-shaped fish or the accompanying sauce. We both fell ill that evening. I won't be coming back, and I genuinely can't grasp what makes it appealing.

yelp:train:98684.orig:
I have never bought a car sight unseen before, and if it wasn't for the confidence I had after talking with Kris Le Suer on the phone, I would not have gotten on a plane.  After the event, and the few days of driving my new car, I am even more pleased with my experience at Le Suer.  I had been to new VW dealerships here in CA and gotten the total run-around, so when I found this family run operation, I was thrilled.

Kris and team, GREAT job.  Your pride in your company and honest [to a fault] approach made me leave this review and I will refer you ANY chance I get.  Your newer pre-owned inventory is stunning, so I'm sure my friends here in CA will find great choices.

All the best to you!  And you thanks again!~
yelp:train:98684.para:
I've never purchased a car without seeing it in person before, but my trust in Kris Le Suer from our phone conversation was what convinced me to fly out. Following the event and a few days of driving my new vehicle, I'm even more satisfied with my experience at Le Suer. I had previously visited new VW dealerships in California and felt ignored, so discovering this family-owned business was a real relief.

Kris and your team did an outstanding job. Your passion for the company and your straightforward approach inspired me to write this review and I'll recommend you whenever I can. Your pre-owned inventory is impressive, and I'm confident my friends in California will find excellent choices.

Best wishes to you all! Thank you again!

yelp:train:98796.orig: Minimal selection of food but  tasty. The reason why I'm writing this review is because of the drinks. Hopefully you go in on a night when Matthew is bartending. He makes the most amazing off the top of his head concoctions that are unbelievable. I wouldn't even know what to ask for the next time I come in. I told him I like sweet but not too sweet with a kick and he came out with a glass of perfection. When I wanted to try something else the next one was even better.  If I come back here it will definitely be for the drinks! I will be checking to see if Matthew is there first!
yelp:train:98796.para: The menu offers a limited variety of food, yet it's quite delicious. I'm writing this review primarily to highlight the drinks. I hope you visit when Matthew is bartending; his creations are truly outstanding. They are unique and surprising, and I couldn't have predicted what he would mix up next. He tailored a drink to my preference for something sweet but not overly so, and it was fantastic. The following drink he made for me was even better. I'll definitely return for the drinks, and my first step will be checking if Matthew is working!

yelp:train:99502.orig: I've been going here since I was little. Hands down, the best BBQ in AZ (in my opinion.) \n\nI've had just about everything on their menu and they've never disappointed me. The service is great as well. :)
yelp:train:99502.para: I've been visiting here since my childhood, and in my view, it's the top BBQ joint in AZ. I've tried numerous items from their menu, and I've never been let down. The service is also outstanding. :)

yelp:train:99696.orig: The last time I visited Burke Veterinary hospital was a few years ago. But since I was reviewing Vets I thought I would include this place. Anyways, what stands out in my mind was the fact that the veterinarian seemed very aloof and almost arrogant. That was enough to turn me away permanently.
yelp:train:99696.para: My visit to Burke Veterinary Hospital a few years back left a strong impression on me. As I was reflecting on veterinarians, I decided to add my experience to the mix. What really stood out was how the vet appeared quite distant and almost haughty. That demeanor was enough to make me never want to return.

yelp:train:99822.orig:
I have been here many times. Sadly, they would have a better review years ago. Although it may not have been the most outstanding place on the outside, they had good food inside and always a crowd. Now after many 'Under New Management' changes it appears as if the new management does not care about even former loyal customers. Our last visit saw a full parking lot. On two previous occasions, we came to CB only to find that they would not refill their hot trays with food. Some were even empty. If you pressured her she would eventually call to the kitchen to bring out what you wanted. Or she would ask what do you want and then have someone to bring it out. CB has plenty
yelp:train:99822.para:
I've visited here numerous times, and while it had better reviews in the past, the quality has declined. Despite not being the most impressive from the outside, the food was decent and it was always busy. However, with multiple 'Under New Management' signs, it seems the new owners don't value even their long-time customers. Our last visit found the parking lot full, but when we approached the restaurant, it was nearly empty. As we entered, six customers glanced at us with pity, and we noticed about ten of the owner's friends in the back.

The service was slow, even with just a few of us, and the main issue was the lack of food. This wasn't surprising; on two previous visits, we found the hot food trays almost empty, and when we inquired, the hostess would suggest trying something else or would eventually call the kitchen. She often handled these tasks with a loud, impatient attitude.

yelp:train:99971.orig:
The food here is delicious! I am mostly impressed with the competent, helpful and friendly staff.  I go there often and see the manager always working hard and nice to her employees and customers.  All of the food I have gotten here has been good.  The helpful friendly staff will guide you in making food choices which is nice with so many options.  The Togo menu has the nutrition which is up front and helpful.
Love the salsa bar! Love the iced tea! 
Love this place! 
Thank you for being a reliable, consistent place to get a bite to eat, or enjoy a beer on the patio.
yelp:train:99971.para: The food is absolutely delicious, and I'm particularly impressed by the skilled, helpful, and friendly staff. I frequently visit and notice the manager working diligently and kindly towards both her team and customers. Every dish I've tried has been excellent. The staff is very supportive in helping me choose from the many options, and the Togo menu clearly lists nutritional information, which is very useful. I adore the salsa bar and the iced tea! I truly love this place! Thank you for consistently offering a great dining or patio drinking experience.

yelp:train:100275.orig: A Touch of European Cafe is a well kept little secret of Glendale Arizona. If you enjoy Eastern European fare, or just want to try something new, visit this small, picturesque cafe, which is located on a charming and quiet side street within the historic square of Glendale. Weather permitting, dine at the outdoor patio under mature shade trees, where you may feel as if you are no longer in the desert Southwest. This is a place where you can casually relax with some quality authentic food in a quaint, possibly romantic setting. Tip: Call ahead about their Sour Pickle Soup... you do not have to be pregnant to develop cravings for this unusual yet appetizing soup recipe!
yelp:train:100275.para: Hidden in the heart of Glendale, Arizona, A Touch of European Cafe is a delightful gem that offers a taste of Eastern Europe. Whether you're a fan of traditional Eastern European cuisine or simply looking to explore new flavors, this charming cafe is a must-visit. Nestled on a quaint, peaceful street within the historic center of Glendale, it's the perfect spot for a leisurely meal. On sunny days, enjoy your meal al fresco under the canopy of mature trees, which can make you feel like you've stepped away from the arid desert. This cozy, potentially romantic setting is ideal for a casual, relaxing dining experience with authentic, high-quality food. A tip: Don't forget to call ahead to reserve a bowl of their famous Sour Pickle Soup—it's so delicious, you might find yourself craving it even if you're not pregnant!

yelp:train:100758.orig:
First we have been getting pizza and wings from here for years. Always good and good service. 
Tonight we ordered a large supreme and after getting it home and eating over half with the family we discovered a cricket on the pizza. 
We called them and returned the evidence. Very apologetic and returned our money. 
Hopefully this does not happen to anyone else and they clean the place up. 
Will be looking elsewhere for our pizza.
yelp:train:100758.para: For years, we've been enjoying pizza and wings from this place, which has consistently been of good quality and comes with excellent service. Tonight, we ordered a large supreme pizza, and after sharing most of it with our family, we found a cricket on it. We contacted them, returned the evidence, and they were very apologetic, refunding our money. We hope this doesn't happen to anyone else and that they clean up their establishment. We'll be seeking pizza elsewhere from now on.

Throughout management and staff change  I've continued to come here on and off (whenever I'm in Arizona)\nAnyways, I signed up again in April (I hadn't tanned here in about a year and a half, if not longer) a few weeks later my mom signed up and the girl who took my moms info told me I would get a free month. I explained everything to the lady working and with a puzzled look on her face she allowed me to tan. I explained everything to her & to my surprise that free month does NOT exist. If you sign someone up you get a free upgrade for the month. I never knew this, or else I would have. Well Jill was very understanding and friendly. In fact the whole staff there is very nice!! Everyone except for one girl. She's not necessarily rude, but she does seem as if you're irritating or interrupting her by
yelp:train:100791.para: My first tanning salon experience was nearly a decade ago, and I've kept coming back, especially when I'm in Arizona. In April, I renewed my membership after about a year and a half, and my mom did the same. The staff member who took my mom's details offered me a free month, which was fantastic! However, when my paid month ended, I was informed that my membership had expired. Despite explaining the situation, the staff member let me tan, and this happened a couple more times. Each time, I had to reiterate the details about the free month. I assumed the information wasn't saved or entered. Today, when Jill was working, I explained everything, and to my surprise, the free month didn't exist. Apparently, if you sign someone up, you get a free upgrade for the month. I had no idea, but Jill was very understanding and friendly. In fact, the entire staff is quite nice! The only exception is one girl who, while not rude, seems to find you irritating or disruptive.

yelp:train:100919.orig: Found this place on my Yelp app and we ate here after the Gladiator Rock n Run.  BEST mexican food I've had in a long time!  Service was a tad slow, but they didn't anticipate the large groups coming in from the event.
yelp:train:100919.para: I discovered this place through my Yelp app and decided to dine here after the Gladiator Rock n Run event. The Mexican food was outstanding—arguably the best I've enjoyed in quite some time! The service was a bit slow, though, as they hadn't expected the influx of large groups from the event.

yelp:train:101896.orig: Ehhh. It just serves its niche clientele. if you are older and are accustomed to that style of food and service go and enjoy. Do not expect too much
yelp:train:101896.para: Well, it caters to a specific group of customers. If you're more on the older side and are used to that type of cuisine and service, feel free to enjoy it. Just don't have high expectations.

yelp:train:101948.orig: Oh wow ! I hear about this place a lot.... I went to get some burgers and shrimp. Well , what can I say ... yelp:train:101948.para: Wow, I've heard so much about this place! I decided to try their burgers and shrimp. While I tried to find something positive, my experience was quite disappointing. When I placed my order, they only accepted cash, so I had to go to the bank. After returning, I noticed kids playing in the kitchen, which wasn't ideal. Eventually, my order was ready. However, my burger was extremely dry, and one side was burnt. The shrimp was a letdown; all I had was the breading, and the actual shrimp was nowhere to be found. Pete, if you're still around, I must say, it really SUCKS! The place only lives up to its name, and the food isn't the best. I won't be returning to Pete's place.

yelp:train:101977.orig: Glamis Status parties every other SAT. They have anything you ever want to do with playing in the dirt. BMX, MOTORCROSS, MUD BOG, SAND DRAGS, FREE STYLE TRACK, RC CAR TRACK, LEGIT STREET QTR MILES DRAGS.
yelp:train:101977.para: Glamis hosts status parties biweekly on SATs. They offer a wide range of activities involving outdoor play, including BMX, motorcross, mud bogging, sand drags, free-style track events, an RC car track, and legitimate street quarter-mile drag races.

yelp:train:102003.orig:
The Hole-in-One, has not changed seemingly for ever.  You can count on their food and serve.  The food is fixed to the taste of its customers.  Not fancy, just basic neighbor hood caffee food.  They have the community table in one side for the daily locale customers, as well as ample booths and table.   Stanley they are open half days Sunday so their staff can have at the very lest part of Sunday off.  

I have are adding some new items as over the past couple of years 
or so, such as French fried sweet potato.
yelp:train:102003.para: The Hole-in-One appears to have remained largely unchanged for a long time. You can rely on both their food and service. The menu is tailored to suit their customers' tastes, offering straightforward, neighborhood-style cuisine. They have a community table for regular locals and plenty of booths and tables. On Sundays, they operate in the afternoons only, allowing their staff a portion of the day off. Recently, I've introduced some new items, including French fried sweet potatoes.

yelp:train:102101.para:

yelp:train:102260.para:
We've passed this place numerous times, always curious about what it was. Finally, we figured it out—it's a BBQ joint. After some spontaneous shopping, my best friend and I were craving some BBQ.

Upon entering, the place was quite crowded! The decor is...unique...very reminiscent of "grandma's living room," but it creates a cozy atmosphere.

I was torn between the brisket sandwich and the pulled pork, so I asked our server for advice. He recommended the brisket, which I followed. I'm glad I did.

I ordered two different sauces on the side. This place actually serves the brisket sliced thinly with sauce on the side, just like my dad used to do! 

Their Cajun BBQ sauce is outstanding! It's not overly spicy but incredibly flavorful. The brisket is incredibly tender and flavorful, and surprisingly lean. The bun is soft and not overly bread-like—sorry, but a too-bready bun can really ruin a sandwich!

I thoroughly enjoyed the meal and plan to return soon.

If you can, request a table by the window overlooking their little "garden"—you might spot a few of the cutest bunnies you've ever seen!

yelp:train:103393.para:
After coming back from Las Vegas, particularly from the airport, I always feel the need for a thorough cleaning. 

Oh no!

The Southwest terminal is a breeding ground for some of the filthiest individuals from across the country. They are rough, smelly, and greasy.

Check-in lines are typically very long, especially on Sundays. The cab lines are just as bad.

Baggage Claim is also a nightmare; I've rarely waited so long for a piece of luggage, except maybe at OAK.

The Virgin America Terminal is slightly better.

Thankfully, the free Wi-Fi is incredibly useful.

yelp:train:103398.orig:
Impressions of a large airport in bat country.

- Where the hell are the flight monitors?
- stainless steel stools for computer users.
- Sbarro is your best bet for chow.
- more crowded than airports in some airports Asia (reminds me of Kai Tak).  I mean it's really crowded.

+ the air conditioning is strong

yelp:train:103398.para:
Experiences at the airport in bat country:

- Where are the flight display boards?
- The computer workstations have stainless steel stools.
- Sbarro is the best option for food.
- It's more congested than some Asian airports, like Kai Tak; it's really packed.
- Poor signage (many directional signs don't explain what they point to).
- It feels dark and dingy, like a bus terminal.
  
- I recall it smelling worse on my previous visit.
- The slot machines are quieter.
- The air conditioning is powerful.
- The music is more rock-oriented, with a bit too much Van Halen.
- Free Wi-Fi is available for me to express my displeasure.
  
McCarran Airport is praised for its convenient access from the Strip and its infrequent delays, thanks to the generally good weather.

yelp:train:103733.orig:
