yelp:train:208101.para:
Studio 3-26 is definitely worth a visit! I had my haircut by Luis and have been thoroughly satisfied every time. Initially, I was a bit anxious since I had just moved to Phoenix and was trying a new stylist, but Peter, the owner, recommended him and Luis did not disappoint.

Each stylist there is both skilled and personable; it's clear they genuinely enjoy their work and the environment. Peter has done a fantastic job in assembling a team of stylists who are passionate about the quality of their work.

I strongly recommend Studio 3-26. If you're a guy looking for a great haircut, Luis is the stylist to see!

yelp:train:208142.orig: Typical Chipotle flavor but the service staff always seems annoyed and they're light on that guac we all pay to have added.
yelp:train:208142.para: While the food has that familiar Chipotle taste, the service staff appears to be irritated, and they don't generously provide the guacamole that we pay extra for.

yelp:train:208458.orig: First I am not a sushi expert. I do know when I like something. I have been trying places close to where I live. There are many places close to me in Peoria. Until you start looking you don't realize just how many places there are. This is one place I had not been. So far this is the best place I have tried. Remember this was just the first visit so until I get in several visits and try more of the menu will I really know how much I like them. The star rating could go up or down. The service was great. The meal was about $2.00 more than I have been paying for something similar. It was better tasting. Fresh distinct tastes. I am looking forward to a repeat visit.
yelp:train:208458.para: While I'm not a sushi expert, I can tell when I enjoy something. I've been exploring places near my home in Peoria, and there are quite a few options. It wasn't until I started looking that I realized just how many there are. This particular place was new to me, and so far, it's the best I've tried. Keep in mind, this was just my first visit, and I need to make more trips to fully assess their menu. My star rating could change based on future experiences. The service was excellent, and while the meal was about $2 more than usual, it was definitely worth it for the superior taste. The flavors were fresh and distinct. I'm excited to visit again soon.

yelp:train:208459.orig: I've been here many times picking up sushi for my mother but I have never tried any. I'm a recent fan of sushi (yeah....I know, something's wrong with me) and have been trying different types at various places. This place is one of the good ones!\nI tried the crunch roll and the teriyaki beef roll. Both were amazing! I got it special ordered since I do not like avocado (not my fault, it's my brothers!) and they were very accommodating. Both were perfect and the portions were huge! I have leftovers (who would guess?) for tomorrow. Can't wait. :)\nWill recommend this place to others and I will be back again.
yelp:train:208459.para:
I've visited this place numerous times to get sushi for my mom, but I've never given it a try myself. Recently, I've become a fan of sushi and have been exploring different varieties at various restaurants. This one stands out as particularly good.

I ordered the crunch roll and the teriyaki beef roll, and both were outstanding! I asked for them without avocado, as it's not my preference (my brother loves it), and they were very accommodating. The portions were generous, and I even have leftovers for tomorrow. I'm looking forward to it.

I'll definitely recommend this place to others and plan to return soon.

yelp:train:208743.orig: Meh! it's just OK. The fries were over cooked and the burger was just another burger. Nothing to write home about.
yelp:train:208743.para:
Meh, it was just average. The fries were overdone, and the burger was pretty ordinary—nothing特别抱歉，我无法使用“特别抱歉”这样的表达来重述这段文本，因为这不符合要求保持原意、情感和长度的条件。我会直接给出符合要求的英文重述：

Meh, it was just okay. The fries were overcooked, and the burger was nothing special—pretty mundane.

yelp:train:209573.orig: Some of the best service of any Starbucks - reasonably fast with an upbeat smile to help start my day on the right foot.  Has some of the \""local\"" coffee shop vibe to it, even though it is a chain.
yelp:train:209573.para: This Starbucks offers some of the best service I've experienced, with reasonably quick service and a cheerful demeanor that helps kick off my day positively. Despite being a chain, it exudes a local coffee shop atmosphere.

yelp:train:210207.orig:
Co-workers and I decided to order take-out from Pei Wei for dinner, last Friday night. This location seemed like it would be the closest to work, but still ended up being quite a drive. With the construction going on near ASU, it took us nearly an hour to get there and back.

When I went to eat my food, was rather amazed to find a staple lying on top of my rice underneath the lid! Also found what appeared to be some facial hair in our chicken lettuce wraps as did my manager in his entree. Aside from all that, the food seemed subpar to the many other Pei Wei locations I have visited. 

Tossed the food and didn't even bother to call and complain.
Definitely will not be going back.
yelp:train:210207.para:
Last Friday, my colleagues and I chose to order take-out from Pei Wei for dinner. Although this location was supposed to be close to our workplace, the drive turned out to be quite lengthy due to construction near ASU, taking nearly an hour round trip.

Upon opening my meal, I was surprised to discover a staple on top of my rice under the lid. My manager also found what looked like facial hair in his chicken lettuce wraps. Overall, the food quality seemed inferior compared to other Pei Wei places I've visited.

We discarded the food and didn't bother to call for a complaint. I definitely won't be returning.

yelp:train:210309.orig: The meat here tastes nasty-so nasty I had to send it back.  I tried a curry chicken dish and the beef with eggplant.  The curry was good if it was without the chicken. When I sent it back the lady got so mad and started yelling in her language =/  I felt so weird.  What horrible customer service!  And then she said to me, \""that is the last eggplant today-NO MORE.\"" I was like oooookaaayyy whatever that meant lol  I would never ever come back.  The restaurant looks dirty and there is no health grade rating posted anywhere (and we all know why).  I wonder what they are trying to hide.  Anyways, do yourself a favor and go to Thai Chili.
yelp:train:210309.para: The meat was so unpleasant that I had to return my order. I ordered curry chicken and beef with eggplant. The curry was acceptable, but the chicken was a letdown. When I requested a replacement, the server became upset and yelled in her language, which made me feel uncomfortable. The customer service was terrible. She also mentioned that it was the last eggplant of the day, which confused me. I definitely won't be returning. The place looks untidy, and there's no health inspection grade displayed anywhere (which is concerning). I wonder what they're trying to conceal. In any case, I recommend going to Thai Chili instead.

yelp:train:210319.orig:
We get most of our food at Fry's when we do our Big grocery shopping. For the most part their prices are good.
 My family drinks almond milk and we have been buying it at Fry's for years and it is always next to the cow's milk. A few weeks ago they moved it and nobody in the store knew where it was. It literally took me an extra half hour to finally find the almond milk. The manager had to wheel a big crate out, full of almond milk.

They had it in the back the whole time, nobody had ever designated a spot for it! Now you can find your cold almond milk on isle 6 with the cheese!!!
yelp:train:210319.para: When we do our major grocery shopping, we usually get most of our food from Fry's, and their prices are generally reasonable. My family has been purchasing almond milk there for a long time, and it's typically located near the cow's milk. A few weeks ago, however, the almond milk was moved, and nobody in the store seemed to know where it was. It took me an extra half hour to locate it; the manager had to bring out a large crate of almond milk from the back. It turns out they had kept it in the back the whole time, without designating a specific spot for it. Now, you can find your cold almond milk on aisle 6, next to the cheese!

yelp:train:210493.orig: Conveniently inside Collision center of Peoria. Staff is nice. Got my rental was on a quarter tank. Return with a quarter tank. Nothing else to say. I had my company account which made process super easy.
yelp:train:210493.para: Located conveniently within the Peoria Collision Center, the staff was very friendly. I picked up my rental car with just a quarter tank of gas, and returned it with the same amount. There's not much else to add. Since I had a company account, the entire process was incredibly smooth and straightforward.

yelp:train:210829.orig: Great, authentic Mexican just outside of downtown. Very friendly, attentive staff. Great menu advice. Chili rellenos were absolutely deee-lish.
yelp:train:210829.para: Great, authentic Mexican cuisine is available just beyond downtown, and the staff there are very friendly and attentive, offering excellent menu recommendations. The chili rellenos were absolutely deee-lish.

yelp:train:211382.orig: Another night of ordering pizza 1 and a half hours ago, and it's still not here. I'm not sure if I should get delivery from here anymore. I ordered at 18:30 (6:30PM) right after my sons soccer practice. Now it's after 20:00(8PM) past his bedtime and we are still waiting. Can the delivery service at this location get it together!?
yelp:train:211382.para: An hour and a half ago, I placed another pizza order, and it hasn't arrived yet. I'm considering stopping delivery from this place. I ordered at 6:30 PM, right after my sons' soccer practice. It's now after 8 PM, past his bedtime, and we're still waiting. Can the delivery service at this location step it up?!

yelp:train:211445.orig: I enjoyed Julia Baker's chocolates. I am more of a dark chocolate kind of person, so those are the only ones that I tried. I don't remember the names of all of the chocolates I had, but they were all pretty good. There was one with nuts on the outside and a salted caramel on the inside that was really good, and even the passion fruit one (which I was very suspicious of) turned out to be pretty good.\n\nI would definitely come back while visiting Phoenix.
yelp:train:211445.para: I appreciated Julia Baker's chocolates, though I tend to prefer dark chocolate. I sampled only the dark varieties. While I can't recall the specific names, they were all quite enjoyable. One particular chocolate stood out—it had nuts on the exterior and a salted caramel center, which was excellent. Even the passion fruit-flavored one, which I was initially wary of, proved to be quite good. I'd definitely revisit to try more of her chocolates when I'm in Phoenix.

yelp:train:212940.orig:
It's unfortunate that I have to write a bad review- but I believe it's important to get this out there. This is especially for those that are non-locals. 

Thursday night, my friend and I needed a ride back to our hotel. It was already late and we could not take the light rail back because it had already made its last round.

Strike 1: Driver did not know where he was going & he was on his cell phone asking for directions.
Strike 2: I knew that he knew a more direct way to get to our hotel; instead he chose to take a scenic route through a residential area. Therefore, making the drive longer than it should have been. 
Strike 3: THE METER WAS NOT RUNNING. So he basically just said a random price when we got to our hotel.

We were picked up in the US AIRWAYS CENTER and our hotel was on Central & Osborn. We paid $12 for the fare; I guess I should assume that is a decent price. However, the service was unacceptable from my perspective. The meter should have been on.

PS. they also DBA as Elite Taxi Cab.
yelp:train:212940.para:
I regret having to leave a negative review, but I feel it’s crucial to share this experience, particularly for non-locals. 

On Thursday night, my friend and I needed a taxi to get back to our hotel. The light rail had already stopped running, so we had no other option.

First strike: The driver was unfamiliar with the route and was using his phone for directions.

Second strike: I knew there was a more direct route to our hotel, but he opted for a longer, scenic route through a residential area, unnecessarily extending our ride.

Third strike: The taxi meter was not running, and upon arrival, the driver simply quoted a price without any explanation.

We were picked up at the US Airways Center and our hotel was located at Central & Osborn. We paid $12, which I suppose could be considered reasonable, but the service was far from satisfactory. The meter should have been operational.

Additionally, they operate under the name Elite Taxi Cab.

yelp:train:213352.orig: I love Costa Vida. Their salads are delicious, it must be the fresh tortillas that are layered on the bottom.Customer service is great and the food is consistently good. My only issue with this restaurant is when you are nickel and dimed for things like sour cream, extra dressing, etc...I'm not a fan of that. But the pros outweigh the cons and I will continue to eat here.
yelp:train:213352.para: I adore Costa Vida. The salads are fantastic, likely due to the fresh tortillas at the base. The service is excellent, and the food remains consistently tasty. The only drawback is the tendency to be charged extra for small things like sour cream or additional dressing. That's not something I enjoy. However, the positives far outweigh the negatives, and I plan to keep coming back.

yelp:train:213365.orig: This is white Mexican food. Chipotle is better than this stuff. I tried the chicken burrito with mango sauce and I couldn't even eat the whole things. 3-4 bites in and I pretty much was done. Very bland and un-tasteful. If your looking for good food you wont be disappointed with chipotle.
yelp:train:213365.para: This place serves white Mexican cuisine, but it pales in comparison to Chipotle. I ordered a chicken burrito with mango sauce, but I barely managed to finish a few bites. It was extremely bland and not very flavorful. If you're seeking quality food, Chipotle is definitely the way to go.

yelp:train:213875.orig: Rent a car here HERTz few time but this time I rent for a week Sat to Sat $271/week and decide to keep the car Extra Mon n Tues and return on Wed morning and they charge me 4 extra days which is another $183. How do you count that is 4 days when I only use it Mon n Tues .????? Sun CLODED. If I know they count like that I rather keep it till Mon n it only double the rent which it $542. Total. Now I have to pay $454 for only till Wed MORNING. \nI rent a car alots for business trip and other occasion but other company never like that. This rental place is rip off so make sure if u decide to keep another 2 day mine as well keep for another week.\nBecareful when you decide to keep extra day ppl.
yelp:train:213875.para:
I rented a car from HERTz for a week, from Saturday to Saturday, which cost $271. Then, I decided to keep the car an extra Monday and Tuesday, returning it on Wednesday morning. They charged me for four extra days, which added another $183. How do they count that as four days when I only used it on Monday and Tuesday? On Sunday, the car was just sitting there. If I knew they counted it that way, I would have kept it until Monday, which would have only doubled the rent to $542. Now, I have to pay $454 for only using the car until Wednesday morning.

I often rent cars for business trips and other occasions, but other rental companies never charge like this. This place is clearly overcharging, so if you decide to keep the car an extra two days, make sure to extend it for an entire week. Be careful when you decide to keep the car an extra day, folks.

yelp:train:213971.orig:
I am a big fan of a few things:  gin, men's boating shoes and mainly, pedicures.  I get pedicures probably 3x a month, I'm a
junkie.  

I'm a big fan of the ""Asian"" run nail salons, especially around this area.  However, Charlie's just plain sucked.  The place wasn't clean, the pedicure was weak, the ""design"" they did on my toes wasn't worth $5, and the woman doing my pedi didn't even stay in the lines, I had to come home & clean up the magenta splotches on my side toes.  

One perk (sole reason for 2 stars) is that they did that razor dead skin thing (which may or may not be legal) and I think anyone willing to deal with that deserves 2 stars on Yelp. 

All in all:  too much competition out there to give crappy pedicures...go down 1 block to another cheap nail place.
yelp:train:213971.para:
I'm a huge enthusiast of several things, including gin, men's boating shoes, and pedicures, which I indulge in about three times a month—I'm quite the pedicure addict. I particularly favor the "Asian" style nail salons in this area, but my experience at Charlie's was disappointing. The salon wasn't clean, the pedicure was subpar, and the design on my toes wasn't worth the $5 fee. The technician didn't even stay within the lines, and I had to clean up the magenta stains on my sides at home.

The only positive aspect (the sole reason for giving it 2 stars) is that they performed the razor exfoliation, which might or might not be legal. Anyone willing to endure that deserves at least 2 stars on Yelp.

Overall, with so many competitors offering better services, it's not worth settling for a poor pedicure. I recommend checking out a cheaper nail salon just down the block instead.

yelp:train:214127.para: I'm stuck at I-17 North waiting for a replacement car after ours overheated in 40-degree weather. Customer service is completely lacking. yelp:train:214964.para:
Recently, my Sam's Club membership, which I had held for 7 years, lapsed after my business closed. I was planning to renew it once I got paid, but today made me reconsider, and I decided to switch to Costco instead.

Last February, I bought four new tires from Sam's Club. A week ago, I noticed one was low, so I added air. A few days later, it was low again, indicating a problem. Since the tire was less than a year old, I went to the auto center at Sam's Club to get it fixed.

yelp:train:215202.para:

yelp:train:215972.orig:
cant say much about the product!!! used them 2 times not too picky about car washes because anyone can do a better job by themselves. I was just being lazy and it cost me!! 

I'm writing this review because they offered me a deal that cost 20 bucks for 1 month and i could take my car there as many times as i wanted ... this was true but i realized after the 3rd month these guys were charging me $31.95 every month after and i didnt sign up for that. 
so i called my banker Bud!! and he told me they were keying in the transactions every month.. This means that it was not set up on a direct pay and they have my CC number floating around... so they were committing fraud.
So a quick call to the bank got back the 5 months of fraud charges back into my account no problem.
yelp:train:215972.para:
I can't say much about the product yet, as I've only used it twice. I'm not overly particular about car washes, as anyone can do a better job themselves. I was just being lazy, but it ended up costing me.

I wrote this review because they offered a deal of $20 for a month with unlimited washes. While that was true, after three months, they started charging me $31.95 monthly without my consent. My bank, Bud, informed me that they were processing these charges manually, which means my credit card was being used fraudulently.

A quick call to the bank recovered the five months of fraudulent charges, which were returned to my account without any issues.

yelp:train:216115.orig: I ordered 3 Chicken Caesar Wraps to go and guess what??  The 3 sandwiches contained a half leaf of lettuce...BETWEEN THE 3 OF THEM.  When you sell a chicken caesar wrap you are selling a chicken caesar SALAD wrapped in some sort of pita.
yelp:train:216115.para: When I ordered 3 Chicken Caesar Wraps to go, I was surprised to find that the three sandwiches had a total of just half a leaf of lettuce between them. It seems that a Chicken Caesar Wrap should really be a Chicken Caesar salad wrapped in a pita, not just a few lettuce leaves.

yelp:train:216369.orig: Not what I expected.  Food was good, but nothing special.  Portions seemed small.  I really did not expect the stand in line to place your order, go find a seat and wait for someone to bring your food, and then you never get spoken to again. Reminds me of McDonalds.  We got Thai Dynamite, which sounds spicy, but was bland, and sesame chicken, which was so so.\nWhile we were there, we saw someone spill a large amount of salt or sugar on the floor right by a door.  Saw a server going out the door about fall, and then 4 employees walk by it before it got cleaned up around 5-10 minutes later.  Lawsuit waiting to happen.\nDon't think we'll go back :(
yelp:train:216369.para:
Not what I anticipated. The food was decent, though not outstanding. The portions felt on the smaller side. What surprised me was the process—ordering at a stand, finding a seat, and waiting for my food without any interaction. It felt impersonal, like a fast-food place. We tried the Thai Dynamite, expecting it to be spicy, but it was surprisingly bland. The sesame chicken was just okay.

While we were there, we noticed someone spill a significant amount of salt or sugar on the floor near a door. A server tried to leave the area, but several employees walked by without addressing the spill, which wasn't cleaned up for about 5 to 10 minutes. This situation could easily lead to a lawsuit.

I don't think we'll return.

yelp:train:216564.orig: Just returned from the worst dining experience I've had in years ~ the restaurant was loud and you couldn't hear those dining across the table from you ~ the service was poorly timed, bringing out the soup with the entr\u00e9e and overloading an already too-small table with too many and poorly matched dinnerware and utensils for the food items served ~ we ordered Manhattans that were served in tiny glasses with ice and apparently no alcohol at all ~ the food was average at best and the wait staff unattentive and rushed in a half full restaurant.  What should have been an enjoyable and relaxing evening was beyond disappointing.  Will never return.
yelp:train:216564.para: My recent dining experience at the restaurant was one of the worst I've encountered in a long time. The place was extremely noisy, making it difficult to converse with those seated across from us. The service was poorly managed; the soup was served with the main course, and the table was cluttered with too many mismatched plates and utensils for the limited amount of food. Our Manhattans were served in tiny glasses with ice but seemed to contain no alcohol. The food quality was merely average, and the staff were unhelpful and rushed, even though the restaurant wasn't fully occupied. What should have been a pleasant and relaxing evening turned out to be a major letdown. I won't be returning.

yelp:train:218054.para: During the Labor Day weekend, we stayed at this hotel and found its amenities to be quite pleasant. yelp:train:220580.para:
My mom, a second-language learner, went to Acura of Las Vegas with two companions to assist her in buying a car. She specified a certain price range. The salesman then showed her a document that seemed to reflect the amount she wanted, including tax, and she initialed it, believing she had agreed to the price she requested. The following day, I reviewed the signed document and discovered that the final price was over four thousand dollars more than what she had initialed. Sierra, the one employee, was the best thing in that whole place! She was GREAT! She brought our food and asked if we needed anything, we asked for Ketchup, which instead of just telling us where it was since it's a serve yourself, she went over and got it for us. She didn't need to do that. She went above and beyond her job just to make our experience more enjoyable. She had a smile on her face the whole time, which was nice compared to the rest of the employees. Give that girl a raise and promotion! 

Oh, and besides the 10 minute wait in line,
yelp:train:220595.para:
I was thoroughly unimpressed! I'd much prefer In-N-Out. Thankfully, I was in costume and got a 15% discount during their Halloween promotion. My burger, while not burnt visually, tasted burnt. The cheese, just one slice for $0.99, was lackluster. The pickle and relish combo was unappetizing, and the fries tasted similar to Burger King's. I wanted onion rings, but they were unavailable.

This was my first visit, and likely my last, as I was so underwhelmed. I did try the sandwich as recommended, but it didn't meet expectations.

Sierra, the only employee I interacted with, was outstanding! She was incredibly helpful, bringing our food and fetching ketchup for us despite it being a self-serve option. yelp:train:221316.para:
We had a terrible experience with the couples romance package that included an 80-minute massage and partner mud treatment. We began with the mud, which was awful. We were placed in a tiny, pitch-black room and instructed to apply mud to each other within 4 minutes. We were seated on uncomfortable, icy cold plastic chairs until the lights came on approximately 40 minutes later; it felt more like an eternity. The experience was so unpleasant, it could be described as torture.

The entire spa was overly bright, and the staff were extremely loud, causing many couples to complain. Both of us felt the massages were merely average and not worth the $500. We attempted to voice our dissatisfaction when we left, but there was no one at the front desk. We were required to pay upfront, which seemed unusual given we were staying at the Palazzo. There are numerous excellent spas in Las Vegas, such as the MGM Grand, Wynn, and Red Rocks. We strongly recommend going elsewhere; this spa is terrible. It was the worst spa experience ever, costing $700. We rate it as not even deserving one star.

yelp:train:221421.para: In Henderson, there's a charming, small-scale gem that we frequented when we lived nearby, primarily for their exceptional Gyros. The sauce they use is outstanding. yelp:train:223321.para:

yelp:train:224140.orig:

yelp:train:224140.para:

Yes, I'm a bit of a snob. :) The pre-show, which featured clips that reminded me of America's Funniest Home Videos, made me doubt my choice. The comedian warming up for Carrot Top wasn't impressive either. 

But then Carrot Top took the stage and I was laughing almost immediately. He was incredibly funny! While the prop comedy was decent, I actually preferred when he did straight stand-up. We made a last-minute decision to buy tickets and were seated towards the back, but we had a good view. 

Who knew I would end up liking Carrot Top so much? The show was fun and the tickets were reasonably priced. Carrot Top seemed genuinely grateful to his audience. I now appreciate him and won't be making any more mean jokes about him. :)

yelp:train:224471.para: If you enjoy unique tastes, give Vosges a try. My friend spoke highly of it after her New York trip and was thrilled to find a store in Vegas. It was a must-visit on our all-girls trip. The store has a fresh and modern vibe, and the staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. I purchased the 9-piece dark chocolate truffle set for my boyfriend, eager to share it with him. However, he finished the entire box in just two days! To make it up to me, he bought me a milk chocolate truffle set on his next trip to Vegas (which was soon after). Little did he know, he got me a box of 16 truffles instead! It was great. Each truffle had its own distinct smell, flavor, and appearance. The 16-piece set included a few truffle varieties not found in the 9-piece set. On our last trip, we also tried their ice cream, which offered 3 or 4 flavors. I recall it being light and creamy with subtle hints of flavor. Even though some flavors, like Indian curry or chili pepper, seemed intense, they were surprisingly delicate.

-----

I had my initial visit because I had blood in my urine.  I'm pretty sure the doc asked me only two questions.  (1) If it was ok for him to refer me to a specialist, and (2) what my favorite (my ethnicity) restaurant was.  Seriously.  Zero diagnostic questions.

OK.  I guess since he's referring me to a specialist anyway, maybe it saves everyone's time to
yelp:train:224962.para:
I believe the medical care provided was the worst possible. To be honest, I haven't received any medical care yet, so I might be mistaken, but let me share my experience.

More than three weeks have passed since my first visit to the adult medicine office. I've made seven calls to the urologist's office to schedule a referral appointment and eight calls to the adult medicine office to correct issues with the referral. I've also visited the lab twice and the radiology office three times, but I still haven't been seen by a urologist. The inefficiency in this process has been astounding.

My review is based on the complete lack of efficiency. I had to constantly follow up with everyone involved.

Initially, I visited due to blood in my urine. The doctor seemed to ask only two questions: (1) if it was okay to refer me to a specialist, and (2) what my favorite restaurant of my ethnicity was. There were no diagnostic questions at all.

yelp:train:225051.orig: I wanted to bring my boyfriend to a nice dinner for his birthday - he of course wanted to go back to Mastro's but I told him we had to try somewhere new. After leaving Joe's the was happy with this choice and that's all I can ask for since it was his birthday and I wanted to make sure it was special. I on the other hand left unsatisfied but it was my own fault because I didn't order what I actually wanted for my entree. We decided to opt out of getting an appetizer because we never finish our entrees and my main plan was to get the stone crab appetizer and scallops as my entree but because we decided on no appetizer I got the medium stone crab as my entree. Every review talks about the stone crab so I figured we couldn't miss out on trying it. They were really good, the meat was sweet but I do recommend only getting them as an appetizer unless you want a cold entree. My boyfriend of course got the filet mignon and lobster and the filet was cooked perfect and as well as the lobster. And luckily he is a generous person and let me take a few bites of his plate since he could tell I wasn't so happy with mine. \nThe service was great - once we walked in and gave our names the host right
yelp:train:225051.para: For his birthday, I wanted to take my boyfriend to a new restaurant instead of Mastro's, and he was happy with this choice after we left Joe's. On his special day, all I wanted was for it to be memorable, and he was content, which is all I could ask for. However, I left feeling a bit disappointed because I didn't order what I really wanted for my main course. We skipped the appetizer since we always struggle to finish them, and I had planned to have the stone crab and scallops as my entree. Since we didn't get an appetizer, I ended up ordering the medium stone crab, which was quite good but sweet. I suggest having it as an appetizer to avoid a cold entree. My boyfriend had the filet mignon and lobster, and both were cooked perfectly. He was kind enough to let me taste his meal, as he noticed I wasn't enjoying mine. The service was excellent; the hostess greeted us promptly when we arrived.

yelp:train:225280.orig: Called for a car to go to rent a car. Driver was nice and we felt safe unlike another car service which almost got us killed. Took us the route we expected and it came to the price we expected. Very satisfied and will call them when I go to Vegas again!
yelp:train:225280.para: I requested a car to rent one and was pleased with the driver, who was friendly and ensured our safety, unlike a previous service that nearly put us in danger. The route taken matched our expectations, and the cost was as anticipated. I am very satisfied and plan to use their service again when I visit Vegas.

yelp:train:225635.orig:
We have been to Sunset and Vines multiple times, and have always left satisfied, full, and happy.  The wine selection is superb, and if you're not sure what to get, just ask Max and he will definitely steer you right.  

As for the wait issues - if you come on an event night (concert, wine walk, holiday) - you will definitely wait for food, and if you don't have a reservation, you will wait for a table as well.  We have made reservations every time we came, with no issues in terms of wait.  that being said, the food is FANTASTIC!  We have never been disappointed with our food, and have ordered half the menu.  Sometimes they are out of certain cheeses or one or two appetizers, but they will substitute or make a recommendation, one just has to ask.

I have had the crab cakes, fried spinach, differet cheese selections, truffled Mac n cheese, vegetarian penne, and chicken piccata.  My husband has had various steaks, caesar salads, and some of my cheese :).  We have both enjoyed chocolate and fruit desserts - the poached pear is a must - save room!
yelp:train:225635.para:
We've visited Sunset and Vines numerous times and have always left feeling satisfied, full, and happy. Their wine selection is outstanding, and if you're unsure, Max can guide you to the perfect choice. 

Regarding wait times, especially on event nights like concerts or wine walks, you'll likely have to wait for food and a table if you don't have a reservation. However, we've always made reservations and haven't faced any wait issues. The food is truly fantastic; we've never been disappointed, and we've tried most of the menu. Occasionally, they might be out of certain cheeses or appetizers, but they'll offer a substitute or suggestion if you ask.

I've enjoyed the crab cakes, fried spinach, various cheese options, truffled mac and cheese, vegetarian penne, and chicken piccata. My husband has savored different steaks and Caesar salads, and we both love the chocolate and fruit desserts—especially the poached pear, which is a must-try. Make sure to save room for it!

yelp:train:225791.orig: This is a GREAT place to come to for passport photos, shipping, printing needs or copying. Located INSIDE Smith's right next to the bank, Aru & Sue are full service, speedy, friendly, & they have the best prices - $6 for 2 passport photos - can't be beat! I will go there again - nothing like supporting a small, local business who is as nice & professional as they are. They also do notary, faxing, shredding & logo designs! WOW!
yelp:train:225791.para: This is an EXCELLENT spot for your passport photos, shipping, printing, or copying needs. Situated INSIDE Smith's, right by the bank, Aru & Sue offer a full range of services, are quick, friendly, and provide unbeatable prices—just $6 for two passport photos! I plan to return, as it's wonderful to support such a small, local business that is both kind and professional. They also handle notary work, faxing, shredding, and logo design! Truly impressive!

yelp:train:226113.orig: I went here on a Sunday evening. There were 4 of us in our party. We waited about 3 minutes at the front before one of the servers noticed us and said they would be right back. It was probably another 5 minutes before we could sit down and keep in mind there were only 4 or 5 other tables currently being used so it was pretty dead. When we received our food we were pretty disappointed. I ordered the filet medallions and so did my mom. I wanted mine medium and she wanted hers medium well. Mine was completely brown all the way through and hers had a slight pink in the middle so we switched. The mashed potatoes tasted like there was no seasoning and no milk or butter was used to make them. I mean who messes up mashed potatoes? I never got refills on my drinks and the server had to be hunted down to get a new steak knife that had fallen on the floor. The server came back with a fork and butter knife... I ended up just giving up my steak knife as the filet was not the best.\n\nI love steak houses but I left there wishing we had gone to outback. That's just sad. This might have been a fluke and they might have great food but I'm not willing to give it another chance.
yelp:train:226113.para:
On a Sunday evening, my family and I visited this restaurant. We waited about 3 minutes at the entrance, and a server noticed us after a few minutes, promising to return shortly. However, it took another 5 minutes before we could be seated, despite only a few other tables being occupied. The place was quite empty.

When our food arrived, we were quite disappointed. Both my mom and I had ordered filet medallions, with me requesting medium and her medium well. Mine was entirely brown throughout, while hers had a slight pink center, so we switched. The mashed potatoes tasted bland, as if no seasoning, milk, or butter was used. It's hard to believe they could mess up mashed potatoes. I didn't receive any drink refills, and the server had to be located to get a new steak knife that had fallen on the floor. They brought a fork and butter knife instead, so I ended up giving up my steak knife since the filet wasn't the best.

I usually enjoy steak houses, but leaving there made me wish we had gone to Outback instead. That's disappointing. While this might have been an isolated incident, I'm not willing to give them another chance.

yelp:train:227306.orig: I couldn't be happier. \nExtremely helpful staff, straightforward, feels like home when you're there.\nWill went out of his way to go over EVERYTHING, regarding safety, posture, how to hold the gun the right way. How to strip it, load it, clean it, oil it. In the 7 + years I've lived back out here, this is the first place I've gone that I felt genuinely welcomed. Thank you !
yelp:train:227306.para: I am overjoyed with my experience. The staff was exceptionally helpful and made me feel at ease, much like being at home. Will went above and beyond to cover every detail related to safety, proper posture, and the correct way to handle, disassemble, load, clean, and oil the gun. This is the first place in the 7+ years I've been back that truly made me feel welcome. Thank you so much!

yelp:train:227530.orig: If you want to get to your destination alive do not use this company. Their drivers are reckless, rude and have no respect on the road. The dispatcher was a female whom was very rude and unprofessional who was no help and hung up on us twice. We had to wait 30 minutes when we were told they should be at our pick up destination in 10 minutes. Last but not least I quote our tax driver.\""I know us taxis drivers s are a little crazy but we are just trying to get to our destination as fast as we can\""
yelp:train:227530.para: If you aim to arrive safely at your destination, avoid this company. Their drivers are reckless, impolite, and show no regard for other road users. The dispatcher, a woman, was extremely rude and unprofessional, offering no assistance and hanging up on us twice. We waited for 30 minutes, despite being told they would arrive in just 10 minutes. To top it off, our taxi driver said, "We taxi drivers might seem a bit crazy, but we're just trying to get to our destination as quickly as possible."

yelp:train:227592.orig: Made an appointment for a transmission fluid exchange using their website for New year's day. Was impressed at the time that they were open. My appointment was confirmed and reminded the day before. So I drive my car there and the whole dealership was closed. No signs posted or anything. I'd be less upset if I was the only one there but there were a couple people trying to drop off their cars as well. Such poor customer service, it's okay to be closed but they really should have warned customers or posted something on their website about it. It's this lack of quality service that ensures me or anyone I know will not be using their services. \n\nWhat a disappointment of a location for one of my favorite car companies.
yelp:train:227592.para: I scheduled a transmission fluid exchange for New Year's Day via their website, and was surprised to find they were open at that time. My appointment was confirmed and I even received a reminder the day before. When I arrived at the dealership on the appointed day, I was shocked to find the entire place closed with no signs or notifications. Even if I were the only one affected, the presence of a few other customers trying to drop off their cars made the situation worse. The lack of communication and warning was particularly disappointing. Such poor service means I—and anyone I know—will definitely not be using their services. This location is a major letdown for one of my favorite car brands.

yelp:train:228012.orig: I have got to say they impressed me did not taste at all vegetarian great service friendly staff fresh food and drinks are awesome I love the food here a must try if you are in town..
yelp:train:228012.para: I must admit, they really exceeded my expectations. The food didn't at all taste vegetarian, the service was fantastic, and the staff was very friendly. The food and drinks were fresh and outstanding. I absolutely adore the food here; you should definitely try it if you're in town.

yelp:train:228104.orig:
Hmm... I'm going to tack on an extra star because my previous visits haven't been bad. But I went here yesterday morning, and got really angry service. The waiter did not crack a single smile. Uhh... I guess my omelet was okay. :D
yelp:train:228104.para:
Sure, here's the paraphrased version:

To be honest, my omelet was alright.

yelp:train:228173.orig: My first visit to a Sonic, and it was ok.  Service was really, really slow - we noticed several cars that came in after us got served before us.  I had the kids meal with grilled cheese & tater tots.  The grilled cheese was with Texas Toast and pretty tasty.  The tots rocked. ;)  My friend's cheeseburger was fine, too.  The slow service is what's knocking down the stars - we didn't even get any ketchup for the tots, yet as I was finishing the last one, someone wheeled by and asked us if we needed any condiments.  Fooey.
yelp:train:228173.para: My initial visit to Sonic was satisfactory, though the service was extremely slow. We observed that several cars that arrived after us were served before us. I ordered a kids meal with grilled cheese and tater tots. The grilled cheese was served on Texas Toast and was quite delicious. The tots were excellent. My friend's cheeseburger was also acceptable. The slow service is the main reason for the lower rating; we didn't receive ketchup for the tots, and it wasn't until I was about to finish them that someone offered us condiments. Ugh.

yelp:train:228317.orig: No only have we waited 8 min for someone to come over and take our drink order.  She tried to tell us we can only have the appetizers in the bar!!!!! WTF GET YOUR MANAGER NOW!!!!!
yelp:train:228317.para: Not only did we wait 8 minutes for someone to come and take our drink order, but she insisted we could only have appetizers in the bar! This is ridiculous—get your manager over here now!!!!!

yelp:train:228582.para: The issue is that the air conditioning and heating aren't functioning, and the Wi-Fi is extremely slow. If you're a businessperson, you shouldn't stay here as the Wi-Fi speed won't allow you to get anything done. That's why we've decided to move to another place tomorrow.

yelp:train:228909.orig: Rented a car from Bugdet. A week later they bill me on top of my original bill $256.62. My original bill was less than $60. When my credit card statement came in I was pretty surprised to see the second charge. I knew they had a hold of $200 when that drops off after you return the car. I called to try and get an answer of why I was billed a second time and no one including the manager had an answer. I opened a dispute claim and they said they would contact me in 4 days. 4days passed and I heard nothing. I called back to find out the status and they told me that they had no idea why I was charged and that they would call me back about my claim. Do to their \""I could give a care less\"" attitude on the phone, I called my credit card company and reported it as a fraudulent charge. With several rental places to choose from, if Budget is the only one with a car left, take the bus.
yelp:train:228909.para: After renting a car from Budget, a week later, I received an unexpected bill of $256.62 on top of my initial charge, which was under $60. When reviewing my credit card statement, I was quite surprised to see this additional charge. I knew they had a $200 hold that would release once I returned the car. I contacted Budget to inquire about the second charge but received no satisfactory answers, not even from the manager. I initiated a dispute and was told they would get back to me in four days, but no communication followed. After calling again to check the status, they admitted they had no idea why I was charged and promised to follow up on my dispute. Given their dismissive attitude, I reported the charge to my credit card company as potentially fraudulent. With many rental options available, if Budget is your only choice due to lack of availability, consider taking the bus instead.

yelp:train:228995.orig:

Another employee went ahead and stated ""Sure go ahead and bring your car around back, I can look at it right now.""  My car still hasn't moved from the front of the store. I was so upset, I just left. 

Best part of all, when they had to go and look at few things in the car to get the paperwork started, the guy couldn't even figure out how to open the hood of the car.  I ended up having to go
yelp:train:228995.para: I read all the positive reviews before deciding to book my car's service online three days in advance during my day off. It seemed straightforward. I arrived 15 minutes early for my appointment and checked in. No time estimate was given, but since I had an appointment, I assumed it wouldn't take long. However, after 1.5 hours, my car hadn't been touched. I went to the front desk to inquire, only to be told there were a few cars ahead of me. When I asked if my online appointment meant anything, I was told, "Not really. You still have an hour to wait." Near the end of this interminable wait, a young woman came in with car issues, and another employee offered to check her car right away. My car remained untouched at the front. Frustrated, I left. The worst part was when they tried to start the paperwork and couldn't even figure out how to open my car's hood. I ended up having to go elsewhere.

yelp:train:229066.orig: This is a friend's go to place for pollo and carne asada. I had it a while back and noted how tasty it was. The meats are nicely marinated and tender. More so than those I've had at Mariana's. He grilled up both again for Super Bowl. Seriously, good! I made him give me the location so I can stop in for my own supply. Soon, I'll have the husband fire up the grill and we'll have ourselves a fiesta.
yelp:train:229066.para: This friend frequently visits a spot known for its pollo and carne asada. I tried it recently and found it quite delicious. The meats are well-marinated and very tender—better, in fact, than what I've had at Mariana's. He prepared both again for the Super Bowl, and it was outstanding! I asked him for the location so I can get my own supply. In the near future, I plan to have my husband set up the grill, and we'll enjoy our own fiesta.

yelp:train:229090.orig: DO NOT BUY ROUNDTRIP TICKETS. Ride from the airport was fine. I scheduled my return trip and they insisted on picking me up 1.5 hours before they needed to. I called 1 hour prior to my trip to confirm, and they said I was on the schedule. I was supposed to be picked up at 1pm....I called at 1:20 and was told the driver was 3 minutes away. I called again at 1:30 and they said I was the next stop (which was a lie) I sat outside in the rain and 40 degree weather for an HOUR after I was supposed to be picked up, throughout which time 6 other airport shuttles came by and would have taken me to the airport a heck of a lot faster.
yelp:train:229090.para: AVOID ROUNDTRIP TICKETS. The airport ride was satisfactory. I had arranged my return trip, but they insisted on picking me up 1.5 hours early. I called an hour before my scheduled time to confirm, and they assured me I was on the list. My pickup was supposed to be at 1pm. When I called at 1:20pm, I was told the driver was just 3 minutes away. At 1:30pm, they claimed I was the next stop, which turned out to be false. I waited outside in the rain and cold for an hour, while six other airport shuttles passed by, offering a much quicker ride to the airport.

yelp:train:229422.orig:
When I don't know what to eat, I ask myself if it's Tuesday.
No? Think of a place to eat.
Yes? GO TO BUFFALO WILD WINGS

People here think my friends and I are crazy because it is not uncommon for us to order well over 100 wings to share.

I absolutely love their parmesan garlic sauce on traditional wings. Desert heat, honey bbq, and chipotle bbq are all solid choices as well. The servers are very friendly and attentive. I've come here with small and large parties and have usually gotten great service.

It may just be me, but I HATE their boneless wings, which is what is holding back the last star. They are overly breaded, dry, and have very little sauce on them. I honestly only come here on Tuesdays for their traditional special.
yelp:train:229422.para:
When I'm unsure about what to order, I ask if it's Tuesday. If not, I consider other dining options. If it is, I head to Buffalo Wild Wings.

Local folks often view my friends and me as peculiar, given our habit of ordering more than 100 wings to share.

I absolutely adore their parmesan garlic sauce on regular wings. Other favorites include the desert heat, honey BBQ, and chipotle BBQ sauces. The staff is always friendly and attentive, and I've had excellent service with both small and large groups.

While I generally enjoy my visits, I must admit I strongly dislike their boneless wings, which are overly breaded, dry, and lack sauce. I only visit on Tuesdays for their special deal.

yelp:train:229595.para:
Don't Trust Them. They Sell USED Parts at NEW prices.

I’ve visited this Tire Works for my tires and found the service satisfactory. When one of my rims cracked, I got a quote of $350 from VW for a new one. On my way to VW, I stopped at Tire Works to check if they had rims in stock.

yelp:train:230015.para:
Upon checking in, I instantly fell in love and decided to withhold my praise on Yelp until check-out, fearing something would go awry. Was I right?

After three sumptuous nights at the Trump, I remain enchanted. The decor is elegant, with crystal chandeliers and large orchid arrangements in the lobby, making you feel like a VIP. The staff are impeccably trained to ensure you feel special without being overwhelmed. In fact, it seemed everyone was keen to avoid those two words: "You're Fired." The Donald would be pleased.

I secured a Studio room for $99 per night via a Travelzoo promotion, but it felt more like a fully-furnished apartment, complete with a kitchen, a spacious bathroom with a jacuzzi tub and a large marble shower. A real bargain! My hair also appreciated the Trump Spa toiletries.

There's a $15 resort fee, but it's well worth it for the complimentary valet parking. The fitness center is enormous, offering views of the stylish pool area with its inviting outdoor loungers. 

We dined at the DJT Lounge for two nights and found no complaints. Our server was both professional and friendly, and the tapas menu was quite authentic, with gazpacho being a standout.

yelp:train:230471.orig: I was so pleased when I moved to Middleton from the east side that there was a Roman Candle pizza close by.  This is my favorite pizza restaurant (Glass Nickel is also very good).  Roman Candle has great pizzas with interesting and local toppings.  The salads are fresh and creative, and they have good local beers on tap. The mac and cheese and cheesebread is also very good.  I especially like the lunch specials, too.   There are often coupons in local mailings if you want to save a few bucks.
yelp:train:230471.para: When I relocated to Middleton from the east side, I was delighted to find a Roman Candle pizza place nearby. This is my top choice for pizza restaurants (Glass Nickel is also excellent). Roman Candle offers fantastic pizzas with unique and locally sourced toppings. Their salads are fresh and inventive, and they serve a variety of local beers. The mac and cheese and cheesebread are also highly recommended. I particularly enjoy their lunch specials. You can often find discounts through local mailings if you want to save some money.

yelp:train:230631.orig:
I decided to drop by Enoteca San Marco since I had a coupon from Restaurant.com and I wanted to try their pizza since the pics looked really good on yelp.  Plus, it's my first Batali joint.

I had a late lunch here so it wasn't really that busy which was nice since I didn't have to wait long to get seated and be served.  Find the place alone was an adventure as it's really deep into the back of the Grand Canal Shoppes at St. Mark's Square, where they have performers doing shows every 15 mins or so.  I had a nice table side seat to watch while I was eating.

Since the coupon had at 2 pizza/entree minimum requirement, I knew I was in for gluttonfest.  I ordered the gemelli pasta with housemade sausage and broccoli rabe and a pizza with pancetta, caramelized onions, and goat cheese.  The gemelli was really good.  I liked the sausage and I'm always a sucker for broccoli rabe.  The pizza was good too, but I underestimated how strong the goat cheese was gonna be so by the third slice I scraped the rest off.  Service was great too, although I had a waiter switch in the middle, but it was no biggie.

Overall, it's a great place to have lunch if you have time to stop by.  Not bad for
yelp:train:230631.para:
I visited Enoteca San Marco with a Restaurant.com coupon and a desire to try their pizza, which looked delicious on Yelp. It was also my first Batali restaurant experience.

The place wasn't very crowded during my late lunch, so I didn't have to wait long to be seated or served. Finding the restaurant was a bit of an adventure, as it's located deep within the Grand Canal Shoppes at St. Mark's Square, where performers put on shows every 15 minutes. I had a pleasant table-side view to enjoy while eating.

Given the coupon's requirement of two pizzas or entrees, I expected to indulge. I ordered the gemelli pasta with housemade sausage and broccoli rabe, along with a pizza featuring pancetta, caramelized onions, and goat cheese. The gemelli was excellent, with the sausage and broccoli rabe being standout elements. The pizza was good, but the goat cheese was stronger than I anticipated, so I only managed to finish a few slices.

The service was excellent, even though I had a change of waiters, which wasn't a problem.

Overall, it's a great spot for a leisurely lunch if you can make the trip.

yelp:train:230940.orig:
Came here the morning after getting kicked out of TAO, so you already know i had a good time and was hoping a nice bowl of pho would bring me back to life. 

unfortunately....it didn't. 

I was still out of it so i just went with the number 1, can't go wrong with the combo that comes with all the meat right? wrong. the Tendons were huge chunks, the raw beef slices were overly well done and tough, meatballs no real flavor and the broth was ehhh. I mean I might have been super hungover, but i wasn't still drunk, and i've had enough pho to distinguish good and bad.  I already knew it was gonna be expensive, but it just wasn't that great. 

But hey if you're craving some late night pho or morning hangover pho then go for it.
yelp:train:230940.para:
I visited this place the day after being kicked out of TAO, and I was hoping a bowl of pho would help me feel better. Unfortunately, it didn't do the trick.

I was still feeling pretty off, so I went with the number one dish, thinking the combo with all the meat would be a safe bet. Boy, was I wrong. The tendons were in huge chunks, the raw beef slices were overcooked and tough, and the meatballs lacked any real flavor. The broth was just okay. Even though I was likely still hungover, I wasn't drunk, and I’ve had enough pho to know the difference between good and bad. It turned out to be more expensive than I expected, but it wasn’t that great.

Still, if you’re in the mood for late-night pho or pho to help with a morning hangover, give it a try.

yelp:train:230948.orig:
when it comes down to the graveyard hours...

but the prices are not.

the food is pretty much compareble to that of DENNY'S or Norms

yelp:train:230948.para: During the late hours, the service might be a bit different, but the prices remain the same. The food quality is similar to that of Denny's or Norm's, and there's an additional $7 charge for bacon.

yelp:train:231322.orig:
Holy God, I should have checked the reviews before eating here. Because of my tragic inability to read a map, I apparently walked to the completely wrong end of the Atrium in search of Salsaritas. Near some other unsavory selections, this seemed to be the quick & easy choice.

I'm no stranger to food court Chinese. In fact, I used to look forward to stopping in the mall with mom and brother to cheaply nibble on the toothpicked free samples of sweet & sour chicken before buying a plate and splitting it three-ways. Americanized Chinese food is comfort food in a way. Dependable, affordable, tasty.

This was none of those things. I went for the two-item dish which comes with rice (no white rice or brown rice option; only fried). I chose General Tso's and Beef & Broccoli. Both were dished up in IDENTICAL sauces. Let's call it Brown Sauce. Brown Sauce has no flavor. And it's cornstarched to hell, so it's thick and blubbery like day-old gravy. Brown Sauce has no business being on General Tso's Chicken. Brown Sauce made me embarrassed FOR my food. I ended up dumping half my meal... and I never do that.

I love CLT's classy atrium, but can't recommend this dining option. If you need m
yelp:train:231322.para:
Oh Lord, I really should have read the reviews before dining here. Due to my navigational challenges, I mistakenly headed to the wrong end of the Atrium in search of Salsaritas, which seemed like the quickest option near other less appealing choices.

I'm familiar with mall food court Chinese cuisine. In the past, I enjoyed stopping by the mall with my mom and brother to sample sweet & sour chicken before splitting a plate. Americanized Chinese food offers comfort, being dependable, affordable, and tasty.

This experience was far from comforting. I opted for a two-item dish with rice (no options for white or brown rice; only fried). I selected General Tso's and Beef & Broccoli. Both dishes were served with the same flavorless, cornstarch-thickened sauce, which I'll call Brown Sauce. Brown Sauce lacks any taste and is as thick as old gravy. It was inappropriate for General Tso's Chicken. This sauce made me feel embarrassed about my meal, and I ended up throwing away half of it—something I rarely do.

I appreciate the elegant atrium in CLT, but I can't recommend this dining option. If you're looking for...

yelp:train:231715.orig: I truly wanted to like this hotel primarily because of all the popularity ph seems to have. I went for my birthday weekend and it was the worst weekend of my life! I ordered a roll away bed because we were staying with some frirnds for the night and woke up with rashes all over my body I refuse to believe it was an allergic reaction the sheets were probably not changed  since god knows when.
