yelp:train:231715.para: I had high hopes for this hotel due to its widespread popularity, but my birthday weekend turned into one of the worst experiences ever. I booked a rollaway bed for a night with friends, only to wake up with rashes all over my body. I doubt it was an allergic reaction; the sheets might not have been changed since who knows when. When I asked for new sheets, they said they couldn't help because they were out! After persistently asking all night and trying to speak to the manager, they finally brought some sheets at 1 a.m.! Additionally, my friend lost his wallet in the room, and I strongly suspect someone who works there took it, as he used his key to enter. I won't be returning to this place with terrible customer service, and neither will my friends. It seems they don't care about their customers anyway.

yelp:train:233465.orig: Tasty lamb dishes and the garlic naan is addicting. Will be back!
yelp:train:233465.para: The lamb dishes are delicious, and the garlic naan is incredibly addictive. I'll definitely be coming back!

yelp:train:233583.orig: BEWARE...Staff cannot be trusted!! Accidentally left debit card on table after paying the waitress. 20 min later my bank called and said fraudulent purchases were being made. Went back there, they returned my card and said only the waitress and bartender had possession of it. They both denied making any charges. Needless to say, I will never go there again! BEWARE!!!!
yelp:train:233583.para: CAUTION...Do not rely on the staff! I mistakenly left my debit card on the table after paying the waitress. Fifteen minutes later, my bank contacted me about unauthorized transactions. When I returned, they gave me back my card and claimed that only the waitress and bartender had access to it. Both denied making any charges. Needless to say, I will never return there! CAUTION!!!!

yelp:train:233721.orig:
I had a great time at this resturant on Pittsburgh light up night thanks to the excellent service I received. The decor is bright and colorful and the open kitchen is a real show. The food for the most part was really good. The problem was the items that were good were really good and bursting with flavor but they really over shadowed items that were less flavorful.  We made the mistake of ordering some  of the ""light up night special tapas"" that were put to shame by the rest of the meal. I was in a group of 4 at happy hour which allowed us to try many different tapas. 

We had 2 preparations of sushi,  the traditional preparation with shrimp was fantastic and fresh tasting while the avocado with corn prep paired with salmon was good but not as good as traditional.

We also had the beef brisket tacos and the salmon tacos, the beef tacos were very good with flavorful tender beef  but the salmon tacos which were a ""Light Up Nite special"" were not very flavorful at all and the fish, while cooked well was not seasoned at all. It was basically a small piece of fish on a tortilla.

We tried the Chicken quesadillas and Vegatarian tostada both very good with creamy melted the
yelp:train:233721.para:
During Pittsburgh Light Up Night, I enjoyed my visit to this restaurant thanks to the outstanding service. The interior was vibrant and colorful, and the open kitchen was a real spectacle. The food was mostly delicious, but there was a noticeable disparity in flavor. The standout dishes were exceptionally flavorful, which overshadowed the less flavorful options. We regretfully ordered some of the "Light Up Night special tapas," which paled in comparison to the rest of the meal. Our group of four enjoyed various tapas during happy hour.

We tried two types of sushi; the traditional shrimp was fantastic and fresh, whereas the avocado with corn paired with salmon was good but not as impressive. The beef brisket tacos and salmon tacos were also on the menu. The beef tacos were very good, with flavorful, tender beef, but the salmon tacos, a "Light Up Night special," were not flavorful at all. The fish was well-cooked but lacked seasoning, essentially just a small piece of fish on a tortilla.

We also had the chicken quesadillas and vegetarian tostada, both of which were very good, with creamy, melted cheese.

yelp:train:233946.orig: So the wife and I eat here at least every other week. She likes the omelettes and I usually get the nova and bagel. She thinks the omelettes are light and fluffy and this is the only place I've found with decent lox and bagels. This last experience might just have changed our opinion though. I ordered the corned beef sandwich, which in the past has been good, and she got her usual. Her omelette came out burnt and tough, and my corned beef was entirely inedible, it was dry, cold and flavorless. I never knew  corned beef could be that bad. The waiter made himself scarce after dropping the food. And the cashier made a joke when she asked me how everything was and I replied that it was horrible. When I said no i was serious that it was horrible, she said \""ok, sorry.\"" Completely uninterested in what was wrong or how they could improve it.\n\nWhile I've always thought this was the best deli food in town, that really has been mostly due to a lack of good competition. With the lack of concern I saw with customer satisfaction, though I would have to say it wouldn't take much competition to get me to go somewhere new.
yelp:train:233946.para:
We visit this place at least every couple of weeks, and my wife enjoys the omelettes while I typically order the nova and bagel. She finds the omelettes light and fluffy, and this is the only spot I've discovered with satisfactory lox and bagels. However, our latest visit might alter our stance. I had the corned beef sandwich, which has been consistently good in the past, and she had her usual omelette. Her omelette was overcooked and tough, and my corned beef was inedible—dry, cold, and lacking flavor. I had no idea corned beef could taste so bad. The waiter was nowhere to be found after serving the food, and the cashier made a joke when I mentioned everything was terrible. She responded apologetically but seemed uninterested in addressing the issues or improving the service. 

While I've always considered this the best deli in town, that opinion was largely due to the absence of better alternatives. Given the lack of concern for customer satisfaction, I now believe even a small competitor could persuade me to try somewhere else.

yelp:train:234403.orig: I love this place. Great food, great coffee, great views, great prices. And I love that it's local. You've gotta check it out.
yelp:train:234403.para: This spot is fantastic; it offers delicious food, excellent coffee, wonderful views, and reasonable prices. Plus, it's locally owned, which I really appreciate. You should definitely give it a try.

yelp:train:234813.orig:
Great place for good food at a decent price.

Servings are huge...if you are coming with only 1-2 people, you're best to just buy one entree or pasta plate and maybe an appetizer or dessert if you want to bring food home (or have extras).

Had the spicy chicken Rigatoni and it was excellent.  Tons of food and tons of flavor!

The bread/oil/vin they serve is excellent as well.  No idea why, but it is just delicious.

Also ordered the calamari but it wasn't earth shattering..I'd probably skip it next time.

Server was great and very helpful.  Atmosphere is very ""homey"" and has a classic feel.

Check it out if you are thinking Olive Garden for dinner.
yelp:train:234813.para:
A fantastic spot for quality meals at reasonable prices. 

Portions are quite generous, so if you're dining with just one or two people, it's wise to order a single main course or pasta dish, along with perhaps an appetizer or dessert to take home (or to have leftovers).

I tried the spicy chicken rigatoni, which was outstanding—plenty of food and flavor!

The bread, oil, and wine served are also top-notch; they're simply delicious.

The calamari was good but not exceptional; I might pass on it next time.

The service was excellent and very accommodating. The ambiance is cozy and has a classic, homey feel.

If you're looking for a more affordable Olive Garden experience, give this place a try.

yelp:train:235762.orig:
We have continued to order pizza from here & have been more than pleased every time. I also have a new favorite salad, the Domenica & their house dressing.. O.M.G! I even bought a bottle of it the last time we were there for dinner, SO good. Unfortunately it doesn't have a slow pour top so my 10 year old ended up pouring more than half of it on his salad one night :( I will gladly spring for another bottle though, even at $4.99!

The pizzas we have especially loved were the Modesto & the San Gennaro. We ordered the family platter of Chicken Parmigana one night & while it was a TON of food for the money ($35.95 for about 15-20 breasts in a foil tray covered with sauce & cheese.. ended up being enough for lunch & dinner for 3 days!) it wasn't the best Chicken Parmigana I've ever had & we will probably just stick to their pizza for the most part.   

Also, try their Spumoni Gelato sometime, you won't be disappointed!
yelp:train:235762.para:
We've kept ordering pizza from this place and have been thoroughly satisfied each time. I've discovered a new favorite salad, the Domenica, along with their house dressing, which is absolutely delicious. I even bought a bottle the last time we dined here; it's that good! The only downside is that the bottle doesn't have a slow pour top, so my 10-year-old accidentally spilled more than half of it on his salad one night. But I'd happily purchase another bottle, even at $4.99.

Among the pizzas we've enjoyed, the Modesto and San Gennaro stand out. We also tried the family platter of Chicken Parmigiana, which was a generous portion for the price ($35.95 for about 15-20 chicken breasts covered in sauce and cheese, enough for lunch and dinner for three days). However, it wasn't the best Chicken Parmigiana I've had, so we might stick to their pizza in the future. 

Also, give their Spumoni Gelato a try; it won't disappoint!

yelp:train:235887.orig:
I haven't been to Ginseng Korean BBQ II for a long time.  When there were not many Korean restaurants in Vegas, I used to take my friends or visitors to this place because they were staying one of the hotels on the strip and it was very convenient for them to come to have a warm meal after a show or shopping.  After having too much of buffet food, they always wanted to have some Korean food on the last day of their departure.
But, it is still pricey and they don't do AYCE Korean BBQ.
My cousin was in town with her friends and she wanted to have a dinner at Ginseng II.  She said she really liked their food every time she was in Vegas to try Korean BBQ.  Since she leaves in Korea town in LA & I'm pretty sure that she must have tasted the greatest Korean BBQ in LA.  I was wondering why she wanted to try the food that she could get better ones in K-town?
I agreed to have a dinner with her at Ginseng II right after Christmas.  The place was pretty busy with all the tourists.  We all shared some of the dishes including Bibimbap, Kimchi Jjigae, Kalbi, and Chadolbaegi(brisket).  I was amazed that all the dishes we had that night were so delicious!  Especially, the Kimchi Jjigae was outs
yelp:train:235887.para:
I haven't visited Ginseng Korean BBQ II in a while. In the past, when there weren't many Korean restaurants in Vegas, I would take my friends or visitors there, as it was conveniently located near their hotel on the strip. They would often crave Korean food after a show or day of shopping, having grown tired of the buffet options. 

The place remains pricey, and they don't offer an all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ. My cousin was in town with her friends, and she expressed a strong desire to dine at Ginseng II, despite having access to better Korean BBQ in Koreatown, LA. I was curious about her preference.

We decided to have dinner there right after Christmas. The restaurant was bustling with tourists. We shared several dishes, including Bibimbap, Kimchi Jjigae, Kalbi, and Chadolbaegi (brisket). I was surprised to find that all the dishes were exceptionally delicious, especially the Kimchi Jjigae.

yelp:train:235976.orig: Great food great service.  I have eaten at great restaurants all over the world and if I do say so myself, I am an excellent judge.  You won't be disappointed.  This is one of my favorites in Pittsburgh.  Prices very good for what you get.\n\nSteve
yelp:train:235976.para: I've dined in many top restaurants globally, and if I may, I consider myself quite discerning. The food and service here are outstanding, and I assure you, you won't be let down. This place is one of my top picks in Pittsburgh, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality you receive. Steve

yelp:train:236098.orig: My boss told me to stop by this place to grab cupcakes for my coworkers birthday and I'm glad he did! I really like this place because you get to choose your own frosting & fillings for it. I don't really like desserts that are overly sweet and I felt like their cupcakes were just right. The cake had a hint of the flavor and it wasn't overly sweet so it went perfectly well with the frosting.
yelp:train:236098.para: My boss asked me to pick up cupcakes for my coworkers' birthday at this store, and I'm really happy he did! I enjoy this place because you can customize the frosting and fillings. I usually prefer desserts that aren't too sweet, and I found their cupcakes to be just right. The cake had a subtle flavor, and the frosting wasn't overly sweet, making it a perfect match.

yelp:train:236132.orig: Had a great dinner Friday Night at Big Ben.  Quick, courteous service. I had chicken diane, rice and veggies,  excellent!  My friends enjoyed fish and chips and chicken pot pie.  Food was awesome,  great drinks and entertainment was such a plus.  Always enjoy our time at the Pub!
yelp:train:236132.para: On Friday night, I had an excellent dinner at Big Ben. The service was prompt and the staff was very polite. I tried chicken diane, accompanied by rice and vegetables, which was fantastic. My friends relished their fish and chips and chicken pot pie. The food was outstanding, and the drinks were delightful. The entertainment added a wonderful touch. We always have a great time at the pub!

yelp:train:236218.orig: Is there a negative star for a nasty burger place where you get ignored....you wait an hour for your medium well burger and its served to you MEDIUM RAW? The meat was so cold and pink I almost threw up... \n\nNEVER AGAIN!
yelp:train:236218.para: Is there a negative star for a burger joint where you're ignored and have to wait an hour for a medium well burger that turns out to be MEDIUM RAW? The meat was so cold and pink it almost made me sick... NEVER AGAIN!

yelp:train:236256.orig: We spent a week in Vegas and ate at at least 10 burger places during that time. This was the BEST one we found overall. The portions are large, everything was made perfectly, our waitress was great, the drinks were excellent, good people watching and best of all, its not over priced. I didn't think we would find a reasonably priced place on the strip, but here it is. Hidden in a corner. We will definitely be coming back during our next trip
yelp:train:236256.para: During our week in Vegas, we visited at least 10 burger joints, and this place stood out as the best. The portions were generous, the food was flawlessly prepared, our server was excellent, the drinks were top-notch, and there was great people-watching. Most importantly, it wasn't overpriced. We didn't expect to find a reasonably priced option on the strip, but we did. It's tucked away in a corner. We'll definitely return on our next visit.

yelp:train:236303.orig:
I have been a fan of Firehouse subs for almost 8 years, since I ate at one of the very first restaurants in Jacksonville, Florida. When I stopped traveling for work, Firehouse was one of the chains that I missed the most.

One day, I was at Cars & Coffee across Eastern, stomach growling, grumbling, nay, SCREAMING for food. When it gets to this point, there is no easy decision, everything and nothing sounds good. Something caught my eye as my head turned to check out a loud car, a familiar white and red sign, no, it couldn't be. Scanning actively for the sign again, staring at it incredulously, I thought I had to be imagining something in my hunger induced haze.

Fortunately, I was not imagining it! I made my way across the street to make a Hook & Ladder intimate friends with my belly in short order. Ordering my food, I brought out my trusty Firehouse punch card from the East coast and asked the lady how long they had been open. I was absolutely SHOCKED to find out that they were celebrating their one year anniversary. How could such delicious food be so close to me, and they not advertise at all?!

My go-to order is always the Hook & Ladder with a sweet tea. The heated turkey
yelp:train:236303.para:
For nearly 8 years, I've been a loyal customer of Firehouse subs, starting with my visit to one of the earliest locations in Jacksonville, Florida. After I stopped traveling for work, I found myself missing Firehouse the most among the chains I used to frequent.

One day at Cars & Coffee on Eastern, my stomach was in full protest, practically demanding food. With no clear choice, everything sounded appealing yet nothing did. Then, my eyes caught a familiar white and red sign. Could it be? I double-checked, staring at it in disbelief, wondering if my hunger was playing tricks on me.

Fortunately, it wasn't a mirage! I quickly crossed the street to become friends with my belly and order from the Hook & Ladder. I pulled out my trusty Firehouse punch card from the East coast and asked the staff how long they had been open. I was stunned to learn they were celebrating their one-year anniversary. How could such delicious food be so close to me, and not be advertised at all?!

My usual choice is the Hook & Ladder with sweet tea, and the heated turkey...

yelp:train:236308.orig: I love the taste and quality of their sandwiches. Their service is always polite and the place is always clean. The one downside for me is the price. At 17 dollars for two large sandwiches that's a bit steep for me. If I made it a meal then bam I am at  25 bucks for a couple of sandwiches, chips and a drink. I love their sandwiches but this is a once every six months type of place for me. If I am going to spend 10-15 dollars a person I will go somewhere that I get a waitress and get to take up a booth for an hour.
yelp:train:236308.para: I adore the taste and quality of their sandwiches, and I appreciate that the service is consistently polite and the establishment is always clean. The only drawback is the price; at $17 for two large sandwiches, it feels a bit expensive. When I factor in the chips and drink, it comes to $25 for a couple of sandwiches, which is quite pricey for a meal. Despite loving their sandwiches, I can only afford to visit here about once every six months. If I want to spend around $10 to $15 per person, I prefer going somewhere where I can enjoy a waitress and have a table for an hour.

yelp:train:236963.orig: Went to the AT&T store located inside the Galleria Mall.  3 different employees told us 3 different things about purchasing a new cell phone. We are already customers, and they still wanted to charge us extra for plans we didn't need. Then, when we called AT&T Customer Service, we got a great deal and when we told the employees in the store what AT&T told us on the phone, they were going to honor the new deal, but after showing us that they had the phone in stock, they then said it was \""store policy\"" that they would need to ship us the phone.  We felt they were trying to punish us for getting a better deal because we would have saved over $200! Very underhanded way to treat customers. Also, BEWARE of \""Authorized Dealers\""! They aren't actual AT&T stores and they won't tell you about good deals because they will lose money if they  do.  I would avoid this store!! Terrible attitude toward customers and they didn't care about us at all.
yelp:train:236963.para: Visited the AT&T store in Galleria Mall, where three employees gave us conflicting information about buying a new phone. Despite being existing customers, they still tried to charge extra for unnecessary plans. When we called AT&T Customer Service, we received a better deal, which the store employees initially agreed to honor. However, upon checking stock, they claimed it was "store policy" to ship the phone instead. This seemed like an attempt to penalize us for finding a better deal, as we would have saved over $200. Their approach was very deceptive. Be cautious of "Authorized Dealers" as they might not disclose good deals since it could reduce their profits. I strongly advise avoiding this store; their customer service was terrible, and they clearly didn't care about us.

yelp:train:237127.orig: Had the best cheeseburger ever and I dont really even eat burgers. The salmon burger was a bit fishy but the place is really fun!!
yelp:train:237127.para: I had an amazing cheeseburger, even though I don't usually eat burgers. The salmon burger had a slight fishy taste, but the restaurant is genuinely enjoyable!

yelp:train:237405.orig:
Wow, if only I would have gone back to MY OWN original review, I could've avoided this, lol.

Server was attentive, but gave off the vibe that we bothered her.  My mom's food was cold and instead of bringing her an entire new plate, they heated up the cut into food and brought it back, which scared me.

Pancakes were not very good, sausage was strange...

Now I will seriously NEVER be back..Overpriced and just not good food.

Shoulda just had McDonald's
yelp:train:237405.para:
If only I had read my own initial review, I could have steered clear of this place, ha. 

The server was attentive, yet it seemed like she was just trying to get rid of us. My mom's meal was cold, and instead of serving her a fresh plate, they just warmed up a portion of her food, which made me uneasy.

The pancakes were subpar, and the sausage was odd. 

I truly won't be returning here. The food was overpriced and just not up to par. I should have just gone to McDonald's instead.

yelp:train:237569.orig:
I'm gonna take some heat for this, but I really don't care.  I LOVE Claim Jumper.  Say what you will about chain this and chain that, but I hold this restaurant higher than your average chain and with reason.

It takes everything bad about American dining - huge portions, over-the-top decor incl impressive old-school ceiling fans, fattening desserts and huge tedious menus and unabashedly flaunts it.  I call it the Sierra Nevada version of Cheesecake Factory.

I've been going here for years - so I may be blinded by the nostalgia value, but I think the food is of better quality than your typical chain.  I very rarely come here anymore because every location is far-flung since Claim Jumper is adored by suburban soccer parents from here to Chicago, but my buddy out in South Tempe got me to make the trek last week for his birthday.

My favorites here are:
* Tri-tip french dip, which is delicious and classically Californian.  
* Rotisserie chicken with red skinned mashed potatoes or cheese potatocakes as an option.
* Country Fried Steak - with the mashed potatoes adorned with a red apple. :)
* Parmesan crusted chicken with angel hair marinara.
* Meatball calzone which is bigge
yelp:train:237569.para:
I'm prepared to face some criticism for this, but I couldn't care less. I absolutely adore Claim Jumper. While others might dismiss it as just another chain, I regard it with a higher esteem than your average restaurant, and for good reason.

Claim Jumper embraces all the aspects of American dining that some might find excessive—large portions, elaborate decor, rich desserts, and extensive menus. It’s like the Sierra Nevada version of Cheesecake Factory.

I've been a regular customer for many years, and while I might be influenced by nostalgia, I believe the food is of superior quality compared to typical chains. I don't visit as often now because every location is quite distant, as Claim Jumper is beloved by suburban parents across the country. However, my friend in South Tempe convinced me to make the trip last week for his birthday.

Some of my favorite dishes include:
- The tri-tip French dip, which is both delicious and quintessentially Californian.
- Rotisserie chicken served with red-skinned mashed potatoes or cheese potato cakes.
- Country Fried Steak, topped with mashed potatoes and a red apple.
- Parmesan-crusted chicken with angel hair pasta and marinara sauce.
- And the meatball calzone, which is sizable.

yelp:train:237589.orig: this is a totally awesome place to eat. great service and staff. have not found anything on the menu that i did not like. the baby back ribs fall right off the bone and the potato soup is soooo creamy. you gotta try the onion rings but make sure you have more then one person to eat them. a huge order.
yelp:train:237589.para: This is an absolutely fantastic dining spot with excellent service and friendly staff. I haven't come across a single dish on the menu that I didn't enjoy. The baby back ribs are incredibly tender, falling off the bone easily, and the potato soup is incredibly creamy. You really should order the onion rings, but be prepared to share since a large portion is a must-have.

yelp:train:237623.orig: Took forever to get my food. Approximately 45 minutes for just a Kids Pizza and A Burger... I definitely would not recommend this location. And the manager's are so tacky... Never again...
yelp:train:237623.para: My food took an eternity to arrive—about 45 minutes for a Kids Pizza and a burger. I definitely don't recommend this place. The managers are really tacky too. I won't be coming back.

yelp:train:237828.orig:
I love this place for breakfast. With just a few menu choices, it's tough to go wrong. My personal fave, the Switch Benedict is a tasty combo of potatoes and eggs benedict is a scrumptious white hollandaise sauce. It may not be good for you, but it's great for your tastebuds.

Sadly, I've never seen this place busy, but seeing as how I've only been there on weekends, I'm not too surprised. I expect the light rail to help out a bit with this, as it really is a great place.

If you like Fez or Ticoz, be sure to hit Switch up.
yelp:train:237828.para:
I adore this spot for breakfast; even with limited menu options, it's hard to make a bad choice. My absolute favorite is the Switch Benedict, which blends potatoes with eggs benedict in a delightful white hollandaise sauce. While it might not be the healthiest option, it certainly satisfies my taste buds. 

Unfortunately, I've rarely seen it bustling, though I wasn't surprised given I've only visited on weekends. I believe the light rail will help increase its popularity, as it truly is an excellent place. If you enjoy Fez or Ticoz, you should definitely check out Switch.

yelp:train:238445.orig: Had a blast here! Attended \""Ditch Fridays.\"" It's so much fun. They had different blow ups in the pool, only downside sometimes peoples drinks get knocked. A blast though!!!!
yelp:train:238445.para: Had an amazing time at "Ditch Fridays"! The pool had various inflatable toys, which was super fun. The only drawback was that drinks would occasionally get knocked over. Still, it was a blast!!!!

At first I went to find a sales associate to find where these markers are that you can write on glass were, while he was nice and helpful, he was not very specific on where the markers were and I was still very confused on where to find the markers and which ones had the ability to write on glass. \n\nHowever, the real problem with this store began when I had to find another sales associate to give me more information about  the glass markers. yelp:train:238513.para:
I can't believe the poor customer service at this store. Initially, I approached a sales associate to locate the markers that write on glass, and although he was polite and helpful, he didn't provide clear directions, leaving me confused about their location and which ones worked on glass.

The bigger issue arose when I needed to find another sales associate for more information on the glass markers. I had to follow a sales associate around the store to locate someone who could assist, and when I finally caught up, she went into the break room, making me wait for 5 minutes. yelp:train:238941.orig: 4.9 / 5. One of the best pizzas in Phoenix. Got the New York special and it was excellent. You have to eat it with a fork because the crust is very thin and can't support the weight of the toppings. The cheese is creamier than most. Toppings were very fresh and meat quality very very good. Not sure what they could do better. Definitely going back.
yelp:train:238941.para: 4.9 out of 5. This pizza is among the top in Phoenix. I ordered the New York special, and it was outstanding. A fork is necessary to enjoy it due to its ultra-thin crust, which isn't sturdy enough for the heavy toppings. The cheese is exceptionally creamy, surpassing most others. The toppings were extremely fresh, and the meat quality was top-notch. I can't think of any improvements they could make. I plan to return.

yelp:train:239063.orig: Ok, im writing this review after seeing the news on panera bread dogging gun  owners. Seems for not much of a reason panera has told all people with guns legally that we care not for your business.  Thats how their words on guns are being taken including myself as a gun owner.  \n  Considering the food and company it isnt a place i have to have. Bread and soup is their strong suit. The rest to me isnt all that for the price.  I do have to say in the past i did feel the customer service was pretty good though. Have not had a issue with their employees.  \n  So, in conclusion i will not be back till they back off my gun rights and stop trying to be johny-do-good in the public eye.
yelp:train:239063.para:
After reading about Panera Bread's stance on gun owners, I decided to write this review. It appears that Panera has essentially excluded gun owners, even without a valid reason, from their customer base. This aligns with how their statements about gun owners are perceived, including by me as a gun owner.

While the food and service are decent, Panera isn't a place I feel compelled to frequent. Their bread and soup are their standout offerings, but the rest of their menu doesn't justify the price for me. 

In the past, I did appreciate their customer service and haven't had any issues with their staff. 

In summary, I won't return to Panera until they respect my gun rights and stop trying to be a self-righteous public figure.

yelp:train:239267.orig: Not the best venue in the area by a mile. They should rename it the Douchehouse. The unfortunate proximity to ASU and the all ages policy/PBR on draft really bring in the drunken jackasses who are there to talk rather than watch the show. Parking is a pain in the ass; the business complex next door was blocked off and the lot was full. The bathroom situation is a serious joke. I've never been in a place where the better option is to leave and go next door to piss. The DJ playing music before the show should be fired. You've got an incredibly hot electro-indie band about to come on, and you crank up the hip-hop and 70's disco? Retard.\n\nSound is good-that's the only positive thing I have to say. I won't be going back unless it's a band I absolutely have to see.
yelp:train:239267.para: This place is far from the best venue around. It might as well be called the Douchehouse. Its unfortunate location near ASU, combined with the all-ages policy and PBR on tap, attracts a lot of drunk, disruptive people who prefer talking over watching the performance. Parking is a nightmare; the neighboring business complex was closed off, and the lot was packed. The bathroom situation is laughable—there's no choice but to use the ones next door. The DJ playing hip-hop and 70s disco before the show should be fired; it's completely inappropriate for an electro-indie band about to perform. The sound quality is the only positive aspect. I won't return unless it's for a band I absolutely have to see.

yelp:train:239268.orig:

yelp:train:239268.para:
To be completely honest, I really don't enjoy this place at all. I've been going here for years, and it feels like I used to live here during my teenage years when I dated band members. I never really liked it back then, and my opinion hasn't changed much after last night's show.

It's small, dirty, and disorganized. It's located in a strip mall next to a burrito place, which is quite odd. On a packed night, it's nearly impossible to get a drink from the large bar that takes up most of the space. You have to order two at a time; otherwise, you'll have to double-fist your drinks at The Clubhouse. They serve food, but it's prepared at a restaurant next door and brought over, which is a bit strange, though the nachos looked pretty good. The bathroom situation is terrible; with only one stall, I waited in line for over 20 minutes. Women do take their time, but seriously, hurry up and pee!

The parking lot is a mess, and there are never any spots. Park in the business complex next door instead, but be careful; if your little sister tries to sneak out of a show early to sleep in the car, you'll likely return to find it surrounded by police.

I know I've said nothing positive about this place before, but...

yelp:train:239430.orig: This place is adorable! I love the decor and ambiance!!  They have private rooms in the very front of the restaurant (unfortunately facing the parking lot!!) but they are beautiful!! The happy hour (at the bar only) from 5 - 7 pm is awesome.. they have bottomless mimosas for $8! \n\nThe rolls are great, averagely priced sushi for the location... You'd think Red Rock would be charging $15 minimum per roll, but no.. You can get a roll for $8 - $11 just like everywhere else.  Great place for a first date!
yelp:train:239430.para:
This spot is charming! I adore the decor and atmosphere! Although the private rooms at the front of the restaurant look out onto the parking lot, they are still very pretty. The happy hour, which runs from 5 to 7 pm and is only available at the bar, is fantastic—bottomless mimosas are just $8! 

The sushi rolls are excellent, with prices that are quite reasonable for the area. You might expect Red Rock to charge at least $15 for a roll, but they're actually priced similarly to other places, ranging from $8 to $11. It's a wonderful venue for a first date!

yelp:train:239507.orig: The sushi and sashimi were amazingly delish. I ordered to go and promptly picked up the order. It was well prepared and packaged to look as if they were plated. I was impressed at the attention to detail even with takeout. But more importantly the food was wonderful. The flavors explode in your mouth. Anyways, fresh sushi is the only way to go. It was a little pricey but hey...You're getting fresh food prepared as you order it. We will be back again.
yelp:train:239507.para: The sushi and sashimi were incredibly delicious. I placed my order to go and quickly collected it. The food was expertly prepared and beautifully packaged, almost as if it were presented on a plate. I was particularly impressed by the meticulous attention to detail, even in takeout. However, the most significant aspect was the quality of the food itself. The flavors burst in my mouth with each bite. In fact, fresh sushi is the only way to go. While it was a bit on the expensive side, you're getting freshly prepared food made to order. We look forward to returning.

yelp:train:239890.orig: Love my bevmo. I can always find what I want here. Service is great. Prices a great. My only complaint - I have a kiddo and it would be helpful if they offered to help me get the booze into my vehicle. Other than that I love my bevmo!
yelp:train:239890.para: I adore my local BevMo! They consistently have everything I need. The service and prices are fantastic. The only thing that could be better is if they offered to assist me with carrying the alcohol to my car, given I have a child. Overall, I really enjoy shopping at BevMo!

yelp:train:240115.orig:
My friend and I decided to try this place while the rest of our group stayed in the hotel room sleeping because of the night before. I was so hungry I just wanted to eat anything. 

Fortunately the buffet had started here around 11am for 11.99 per person. (does not include drinks )

It was a Italian style buffet. Spaghetti , lasagna, meatballs , and Parmesan chicken. They also served a soup and salad.

I hate to say it but the food quality was very poor. My clam chowder was disgusting and the only thing I enjoyed from my plate was the fettuccine . I kind of stuffed myself with bread because I was worried I was not going to get my money's worth. 

I was surprised how cold some of the food was judging that they just opened the buffet right as we got in. We were even the first ones!
yelp:train:240115.para:
My friend and I ventured out to this restaurant while the rest of our group opted to stay in and rest from the previous night. I was ravenous and eager to eat anything available. 

Fortunately, the buffet began around 11am and cost $11.99 per person (excluding drinks).

It was an Italian-themed buffet with options like spaghetti, lasagna, meatballs, and Parmesan chicken. They also offered soup and salad.

Unfortunately, the food quality was subpar. My clam chowder was awful, and the only thing I enjoyed was the fettuccine. I ended up eating a lot of bread, fearing I wouldn't get my money's worth. 

I was surprised to find that some of the food was quite cold, even though they had just opened the buffet when we arrived, and we were the first customers.

yelp:train:240265.orig: I really like this place.. Great tea, great service, locally owned store.. Can't beat it. Few yrs ago I remember working with the owner on a neighborhood school fundraiser, she donated the tea on many occasions. It's a great place to checkout.
yelp:train:240265.para: I absolutely adore this store. The tea is outstanding, and the service is fantastic. It's a locally owned business that I highly recommend. A few years back, I recall assisting the owner with a neighborhood school fundraiser, and she generously donated tea on numerous occasions. It's an excellent spot to visit.

yelp:train:240503.orig: Born and raised in Phoenix, first time at Mel's Diner. We stopped for breakfast on our way back to Tucson. The staff was friendly and efficient. The meal was fresh, House Fries were homemade, not frozen. Pancakes were light and fluffy. We spent a little less than we would at IHOP and the food was much better. We'll definitely return to Mel's Diner.
yelp:train:240503.para: Growing up in Phoenix, this was our first visit to Mel's Diner. We popped in for breakfast on our journey back to Tucson. The service was both warm and prompt. The food was freshly prepared; the House Fries were homemade, unlike the frozen ones at other places. The pancakes were light and airy. We spent less than we typically do at IHOP, and the quality was significantly better. We're definitely planning to revisit Mel's Diner.

yelp:train:241457.orig: What can I say about Chompie's that hasn't already been said? This place is amazing - delicious food, friendly staff, a clean building and oh, did I mention the delicious food? I never miss a chance to go to Chompie's.
yelp:train:241457.para: How can I express my thoughts about Chompie's when so much has already been said? It's simply incredible—excellent food, warm and welcoming staff, and a spotless environment. And let's not forget the fantastic food again! I always find an excuse to visit Chompie's.

yelp:train:241708.orig: I don't think I'll be going back anytime soon. The new decor is really nice and fresh but it ends there. The food was not very good. No presentation and no taste. The only thing I liked was the wedding soup. I visited with 5 other people and they all said the food was not very good. Good things were the decor, no wait, fast service but that's it. I think they need an overhaul on the menu and some more spices to help the bland food.
yelp:train:241708.para: I don't foresee returning any time soon. While the new decor is appealing and modern, the food left much to be desired. It lacked both presentation and flavor, with the wedding soup being the sole exception. My group of five also found the food unimpressive. The positives were the decor and the quick service, but that's about it. I believe they need to revamp their menu and add more spices to enhance the bland dishes.

yelp:train:241735.orig: This place use to be really good, but it feels as if it is run-down now. Our family of four was seated and it took an hour for our food to come out. \nAlso, the Caesar salad did not taste good. I ordered the eggplant Parmesan and it did not look appetizing at all. Our family also ordered chicken Parmesan and it was burnt all around the edges.\nThere are better Italian places to go. I don't like waiting an hour for my dinner.
yelp:train:241735.para: This spot used to be excellent, but it seems quite neglected now. My family of four was seated, and our meal arrived an hour later than expected. The Caesar salad wasn't very flavorful. I had the eggplant Parmesan, which looked far from appealing. My family also got chicken Parmesan, which was overcooked around the edges. There are definitely better Italian restaurants to choose from. I really don't appreciate waiting an hour for my dinner.

yelp:train:241941.orig: We have been here 3 times now and love coming back. The appetizers and desserts are great, as well as the servers. I recommend doing the wine flight to try out a little of everything!
yelp:train:241941.para: We've visited three times and always enjoy returning. The appetizers and desserts are excellent, and the servers are terrific too. I highly recommend trying the wine flight to sample a variety of wines!

yelp:train:242347.orig:
My favorite Thai Restaurant in Las Vegas. It's a hidden little restaurant by chinatown. I ordered the House Special Tom Yum Noodle dish for lunch along with the Papaya salad. 

I also ordered to go the Duck Fried Rice, Pad See Ewe and even Pad Thai (which is not my fav Thai dish) and all three were amazing.

Price wasn't even expensive. Under $8.00 dishes. I love it!
yelp:train:242347.para:
I adore a little-known Thai restaurant in Las Vegas, tucked away near Chinatown. For lunch, I enjoyed the House Special Tom Yum Noodle dish and the Papaya salad. 

I also got to-go orders of Duck Fried Rice, Pad See Ewe, and even Pad Thai (which isn't my top choice of Thai dishes), and all were fantastic.

The prices were very reasonable, under $8.00 per dish. I absolutely adore this place!

yelp:train:242455.orig: Just found out they were on Ch. 13's Dirty Dining in April.. ew
yelp:train:242455.para: I just learned they were featured on Ch. 13's Dirty Dining in April—yuck!

yelp:train:242993.orig:
The Well opens at 6am, earning a visit and review for my Early Bird Watering Holes list.

Pulled into the parking lot around 6:30am on my way home from work. Stepped inside the door to find that the bar is *immediately* to your left.  6 ft and I'm on a bar stool.  So far so good.

Ordered the usual gin and grapefruit tall, for $4.50.  The place was empty save for myself and another guy at the bar.   The bartender that day was Geno, she informed me that the owner of The Well used to be a bartender at the Coach House, just down the road.  

I asked about breakfast options and Geno recommended a coffee shop a few doors down that was supposed to have excellent take out.  I decided to take a pass on that and ordered a breakfast beer instead.  I ended up having a real nice time at this place, just the three of us chatting and hanging out, enjoying the mellow morning.   Geno is a local treasure, btw.
 
I was treated to the (by now) standard assortment of wild stories that have become a standard feature of my bar exploration adventures.   The highlight of this particular morning was the one about the male transvestite school bus driver that caused a ruckus by using the ladies room
yelp:train:242993.para:
The Well starts at 6am, prompting me to visit and add it to my Early Bird Watering Holes list.

I arrived at the parking lot around 6:30am on my way home from work. As soon as I entered, the bar was on my left, and I was quickly seated on a stool. All was well so far.

I ordered my usual gin and grapefruit tall for $4.50. The place was nearly empty, with only another person at the bar. Geno, the bartender, informed me that the owner used to work at the Coach House, just a short distance away.

I inquired about breakfast options, and Geno suggested a nearby coffee shop with great takeout. Instead, I opted for a breakfast beer. I had a pleasant time there, chatting with Geno and another patron, enjoying the calm morning atmosphere. Geno is truly a local gem.

I was regaled with the usual collection of wild stories that are a hallmark of my bar exploration experiences. The standout story of the day was about a male transvestite school bus driver who caused a stir by using the ladies' room.

yelp:train:243144.orig: I don't have a lot of experience with cars or car repair places. I never owned a car until moving to Phoenix. I went here when my husband's car needed some work and vowed to bring my car when the need arose.\n\nWell, 3 months and I'm not a customer. I got a discount on services because my husband referred me. This place is so freaking cool on the inside. The lounge is clean, comfortable, and visually appealing. The staff is hard working and honest. I'm referring EVERYONE I know to 180.
yelp:train:243144.para:
I lack experience with cars and auto repair shops, having never owned one until moving to Phoenix. When my husband's car needed repairs, I brought it here and promised to take mine when necessary.

Unfortunately, after three months, I'm no longer a customer. I received a discount because my husband referred me. The interior of this place is really impressive; the lounge is clean, comfortable, and aesthetically pleasing. The staff is diligent and trustworthy. I'm recommending 180 to everyone I know.

yelp:train:243179.orig: Please give this place a try, you will definitely be pleasantly surprised. \nI was amazed by the delicious food, relaxing and classy atmosphere, and the excellent service. If you are looking for a somewhat hidden treasure, this place is really it.
yelp:train:243179.para: I encourage you to visit this spot; you're sure to be pleasantly surprised. The food is delicious, the ambiance is both relaxing and elegant, and the service is top-notch. If you're seeking a hidden gem, this is definitely the place to go.

yelp:train:243493.orig:
Last week while attending a conference in Las Vegas some colleagues made reservations for Aureole. I'm vegan, so I usually like to call ahead and just mention that and make sure something can be done, but someone else made the reservations, and it was last minute. I've never been treated as poorly or snottily from a supposedly high class restaurant as I was at Aureole.

I discretely asked the waiter if something could be done vegan when he came by initially to introduce himself. He replied ""oh, it is very difficult, but we will try."" I should have left right then. ""Just pick something out and I will talk to the chef."" ""OK, I'll take a look."" Every dish headlines with animal protein, but a fennel orzo that came with one dish sounded nice and maybe close to vegan if the fish that came with it was left off. When the waiter returned, I asked for the green salad and asked if the fennel orzo that normally came with fish could be made vegan. The waiter,without checking with the kitchen,said ""no, that would be difficult"" and offered no suggestions and asked no other questions. I said, ""OK, how about the spring rolls?"" ""Yes, that will be easy.""

5 minutes later -
yelp:train:243493.para:
Last week, during a conference in Las Vegas, some colleagues booked a table at Aureole. As a vegan, I typically inform restaurants about my dietary needs in advance, but this time, the reservations were made without my knowledge, and it was a last-minute arrangement. My experience at Aureole was notably poor and unaccommodating, far worse than any other high-end restaurant I've visited.

When the waiter approached to introduce himself, I discreetly inquired if anything on the menu could be made vegan. His response was, "It's very challenging, but we'll give it a try." I should have left immediately. He suggested, "Just pick something, and I'll speak to the chef." I replied, "Okay, I'll take a look." The menu featured animal proteins in every dish, but the fennel orzo that came with one item seemed promising, possibly vegan if the accompanying fish was omitted.

When the waiter returned, I ordered the green salad and asked if the fennel orzo could be made vegan by excluding the fish. Without consulting the kitchen, the waiter said, "No, that would be difficult" and offered no alternatives or further questions. I then asked about the spring rolls, to which he responded, "Yes, that will be easy."

yelp:train:243701.orig:
First off, it still surprises me that people don't know what they're getting into at this place. There are signs up explaining the premise, AND they ask you if you've been there. So... Every trip to Dick's is different. Each server will be different from the last. 

We went around 4 in the afternoon with my teenage daughter and 8 yr old.  My kids got a kick out of the place, and the server was age appropriate with his Dick-like ways. He made my little girl a hat that says ""I pee in the pool"" and she thought it was hilarious. 

But holy crap it's expensive. $4.00 for a soda? Pay the .75 for water. Yes, you have to pay for water but the cups are great to refill when you're walking the strip.  I think they had 2 for 1 drinks at the bar but I didn't have any.  The food was ok. Typical bar food that is crazy overpriced. Yikes. I think we paid around $65 for 5 of us, and only one person ate an entree, we shared an app and got one dessert.  Half our bill was probably for soda. Ugh. 

I will only go back to this place if someone is just dying to go the next time I'm in Vegas.
yelp:train:243701.para:
Initially, it amazes me how many people are unaware of what to expect at this establishment. They have signs that explain the concept, and they even ask if you've been there before. So, each visit to Dick's is unique, with each server bringing a fresh experience. 

We visited around 4 PM with my teenage daughter and an 8-year-old. My kids really enjoyed the place, and the server, who was age-appropriate, entertained them with his Dick-like antics. He made my little girl a hat that said "I pee in the pool," and she found it hilarious.

However, the prices are outrageous. A soda costs $4.00, but you can get water for just $0.75. Yes, you have to pay for water, but the cups are great for refilling when you're walking around the strip. They had 2 for 1 drink deals at the bar, but I didn't take advantage of them. The food was just okay—typical overpriced bar food. Our total bill was about $65 for five of us, and only one person had an entree. We shared an appetizer and got one dessert, with half the bill going to sodas. Ugh. 

I'll only return to this place if someone really wants to go the next time I'm in Vegas.

yelp:train:243813.orig: Love it!  This place was a lot of fun, had a great band and a decent sized dance floor.  It was fun partying upstairs under the stars while The Streets played set after awesome set.  It's a mixed crowed.  I didn't feel like the oldest one there.  I don't know about the food.  I didn't even know they served food!  It was free to get in and drinks were about $6 bucks.  I would definitely go back.  We made a night of it and were very pleased.
yelp:train:243813.para: I really enjoyed it! The venue was a blast with a fantastic band and a spacious dance floor. Dancing under the stars to The Streets' incredible sets was a highlight. The crowd was diverse, and I didn't feel out of place. I'm not sure about the food; I didn't even realize they had it! Entry was free, and drinks cost around $6. I'd definitely return, and we had a great time overall.

yelp:train:244050.orig: I am very picky with restos but with our original flight cancelled, I had to give up my reservations at Mon Ami Gabi. So the hubby and I walked the strip hunting down a place to grab some grub. We decided to check this place out. Typical Vegas resto, loud BUT the gal was gracious enough to ask us if we want to be seated at the back. Adam was our server and he was a gem. We are easy diners, got the staples, guac with chips (in love with avocados) and split the fajitas. Food was good, the mango margarita was yummy but our server made a difference between as so-so dinner to an enjoyable one!
yelp:train:244050.para: Although I'm usually very selective about restaurants, my original flight got canceled, forcing me to give up my reservations at Mon Ami Gabi. My husband and I strolled along the strip in search of somewhere to eat. We chose to try this place. It's a typical Vegas restaurant, quite noisy, but the hostess was kind enough to offer us a seat in the back. Adam was our server, and he was outstanding. We opted for standard fare, including guacamole with chips (we adore avocados) and shared the fajitas. The food was decent, and the mango margarita was delightful, but it was our server's exceptional service that transformed what could have been just a mediocre meal into a truly enjoyable one.

yelp:train:244125.orig: There weren't many options in this wing of Charlotte's airport, and we were starving, but had we read the reviews we would have skipped Stock Car Cafe. As others have noted, service was prompt and fine, but the food was so bland and boring for what you pay. I would rather have spent less for fast food and gotten the same quality for less.
yelp:train:244125.para: In this part of Charlotte's airport, our choices were limited, and we were quite hungry. Had we checked the reviews beforehand, we would have avoided Stock Car Cafe. While the service was quick and satisfactory, the food tasted overly bland and uninteresting for the price. I'd prefer spending less on fast food that offers similar quality at a lower cost.

yelp:train:244573.orig: At our recent Vegas trip, we stayed at the PH Westgate Towers and this joint was situated nicely in the hotel.  It will now be a staple for us every time we're in need of a good sandwich.  We tried the Earl's Club and the Full Montagu (both hot).  I don't know what they put in their sandwiches...maybe crack (j/k)??  The sandwiches were awesomely delicious!  My only complaint is that I wished they were bigger!
yelp:train:244573.para: During our recent trip to Vegas, we stayed at the PH Westgate Towers, and the PH joint was conveniently located within the hotel. It's now a must-visit for us whenever we crave a great sandwich. We sampled the Earl's Club and the Full Montagu (both served hot). I have no idea what they use in their sandwiches—it's a mystery to me! (Just kidding, of course.) They were incredibly delicious! My only wish is that they were a bit larger.

yelp:train:244598.orig: Overpriced, small portions.  The sandwich (a club) tasted fine, but it's about 6 inches long and was like 7 bucks.  Believe it or not, Subway is a better deal for both quantity and the fact that you can customize your sub, unlike at Earl.\n\nThis place is for casino drunks that want to eat late night and don't care about wasting money, but simply want something to eat.  My wife and I tried it out in the late afternoon and regretted it.  We actually like Quizno's better too!
yelp:train:244598.para:
The portions are tiny and prices are high. The club sandwich, while acceptable, is only about 6 inches long and costs around $7. Subway offers better value with larger portions and customization options, which Earl's lacks.

This place caters to late-night casino patrons who don't mind spending more for a quick meal. My wife and I visited in the early evening and were disappointed. We actually prefer Quizno's for quality and value.

yelp:train:245541.orig: Ordered fried chicken that was dry and I ate some bone fragments. OMG!  Pancit was bland.  It was not good at all.  Will not be coming back to try anything else. (
yelp:train:245541.para: The fried chicken I ordered was dry, and I even found some bone fragments. Yuck! The pancit was tasteless too. Overall, it was terrible, and I won't be returning to try any other dishes.

yelp:train:245560.orig: Food are ok but they have the best ube boba tho. I use to work here like 2 years ago and I decided just to order something that doesnt involve them cooking because truthfully they dont wash the dishes correctly, they reuse the sanitize water over and over even if it had some food in it. YUCK! I am sorry.
yelp:train:245560.para: The food is decent, but their ube boba is the standout. I used to work here about two years ago, and I opted to order something that didn't require them to cook, as I noticed they didn't clean the dishes properly. They reused the sanitizing water, even when it was contaminated with food particles. That's really unhygienic! I apologize for the negative feedback.

yelp:train:245920.orig:
Alright, so here's the thing:  I like to drink.  It's something I do well, and I figure that anything you can do well should be done often.  With that being said, I do not take it lightly when a restaurant names itself after an alcoholic beverage (we'll get to Jimmy Buffet's Margaritaville later).

That being said, it was my brother of all people who introduced me to Sake Bombers.  He said to me ""Las Vegas rolls, chicken wings and a sake bomber will do you just right.""  He wasn't lying.

The problem that people may have with me reviewing a sushi bar is that I don't eat seafood.  I'm allergic to a lot of it.  So you may be thinking ""Why in the shit am I reading this, you twit?""  Well, because I'm not allergic to alcohol or appetizers, two things that Sake Bombers does well.  

The chicken wings they serve have an Asian influence and a spice to them, though I wouldn't call them spicy.  They're a dry rub, not sauced, and they're swear-to-god delicious.  Now, I don't eat sushi, but I'm told by all that accompanied us that the Las Vegas roll, with jalapeno in it, and the White Castle roll, with cream cheese and horseradish, are delicious alternatives to the more standard f
yelp:train:245920.para:
Sure, here's the paraphrased version:

I enjoy drinking, and I believe in doing things well often. However, I take special care when a restaurant names itself after an alcoholic beverage, like Margaritaville. My brother introduced me to Sake Bombers, recommending that I try their Las Vegas rolls, chicken wings, and sake bomber. He was right.

Some might question my review of a sushi bar since I don't eat seafood due to allergies. But since I'm not allergic to alcohol or appetizers, which Sake Bombers excels in, you should read on.

The chicken wings at Sake Bombers have an Asian flavor and a bit of spice, though not overly so. They're seasoned with a dry rub and are absolutely delicious. While I don't eat sushi, those who did say the Las Vegas roll with jalapeno and the White Castle roll with cream cheese and horseradish were fantastic options.

yelp:train:245928.orig: This place isn't terrible but....I've had better.\nThe outside is tacky and it was hard to find the entrance. \nThe set up is just weird, its more of a bar than a sushi place. Like a run down bar not a nice bar or even Applebees equivalent. Wait time for your food was long. The sushi fell apart easily and the Crunch Roll was more gritty like sand than \""crunchy\"". They are trying, I will be back in few months to try it again. Hope its better.
yelp:train:245928.para: While this place isn't awful, I've experienced better options. The exterior is rather tacky, and finding the entrance was challenging. The setup feels more like a bar than a sushi restaurant, and it's not a pleasant one at that—it's more reminiscent of a rundown bar rather than a nice establishment or even something akin to Applebees. The wait for our food was quite long. The sushi was delicate and fell apart easily, and the Crunch Roll had a gritty texture, almost like sand, rather than being crunchy. They're making an effort, and I plan to return in a few months to give it another chance, hoping it improves.

yelp:train:246044.orig: Even though pho is not on the higher end for demands in vegas, we came here to dine for breakfast during our vacation since my boyfriends parents' previous experience was good. despite that fact, what we experienced this time around was nothing compared to what it was before. The pho was edible, but not what you'd settle for if you knew how pho is really supposed to taste like. A few of us thought that the broth tasted weird, and that the meat somehow tasted fake. Personally, i thought it was mediocre, just not the high quality kind you'd expect from a vietnamese-rooted restaurant. At the end of our meal, the check came out to be 102, with only 8 of us all ordering pho, which does not add up. I guess somewhere along the way, the math got messed up, or they tried to gyp us due to our large party. either way, go elsewhere for pho if you're considering this place. if not, then save your cravings for when youre back home!
yelp:train:246044.para: Although pho isn't typically a high-demand dish in Vegas, we decided to try it for breakfast during our vacation, based on my boyfriend's parents' positive experience. However, our visit didn't live up to expectations. The pho was passable, but far from the delicious version we were hoping for. Some of us found the broth off-tasting, and the meat seemed artificial. Personally, I found it to be just okay, not the high-quality Vietnamese pho we expected. Our bill came to $102, despite only eight of us ordering pho. This seems suspicious, possibly due to a miscalculation or an attempt to overcharge for a large group. In any case, I recommend looking elsewhere for pho. If you're not planning to visit, enjoy your cravings at home!

yelp:train:246420.orig: This place has just about everything you need as a \""Super Target\"". I used to go to the nearby Walmart but Target is just a much more pleasant shopping experience. It's clean and much less crowded. I've come at various times and never had to wait long at checkout. Parking is easy at this location. I've also found some really go deals here.
yelp:train:246420.para: This store offers almost everything you'd need for a \""Super Target\"". Previously, I shopped at the nearby Walmart, but Target provides a much more enjoyable shopping experience. It's cleaner and less crowded. I've visited at different times and have never had to wait long in line. Parking is convenient here. Additionally, I've discovered some great deals during my visits.

yelp:train:246472.orig: I live on the west side of town and I still make the drive for this place.  The customer service is always great and the food doesn't get any better than this.  I love spicy food and if you're a fan too, then you have to try the Spicy Shrimp Hand Roll.  That is a must order for me when I go there.\n\n5 Stars!
yelp:train:246472.para:
I reside on the west side of town, yet I still travel here. The customer service is consistently excellent, and the food here is unmatched. If you enjoy spicy cuisine, you must try the Spicy Shrimp Hand Roll; it's a definite must-order for me. 

5 Stars!

yelp:train:246522.orig: Love small airports like these.  Traveling is so fast and easy here.  Returned a car rental, checked in at the ticketing desk, went through airport security and arrived at the gate in under thirty minutes total.  That's the way I like to travel!
yelp:train:246522.para: I really enjoy traveling at small airports. Everything is so quick and convenient. I returned the rental car, went to the ticket counter, went through security, and made it to my gate in less than thirty minutes. That's the kind of travel experience I prefer!

yelp:train:246682.orig:
I'm really troubled about this review!  My darling and I decided to give it a go in lieu of ""The Thirsty Lion"" as I had not been there before.

The place was not real busy and we sat at the bar in order to watcha bit of NFL action and were immediately greeted by our bar tender/waiter staff and he was great.  Really great !

yelp:train:246682.para:

yelp:train:246705.orig:

J and K
yelp:train:246705.para: Our group of four dined here, but two of us had to return our cold meals. The menu has undergone changes, and the current offerings are lacking compared to before. Unfortunately, we won't be returning anytime soon due to the prices.

yelp:train:246905.orig:
