yelp:train:262713.para:
When CUT first opened in Vegas, I was eager to visit, given the buzz about its Beverly Hills location. So, for my fifth wedding anniversary, I decided to go.

Service received 5 stars - We had early (5:30pm) reservations but arrived about 20 minutes late. There was no issue. After greeting the hostess, we were seated right away. Our waiter introduced himself within seconds. Throughout the evening, we were frequently attended to, and our water glasses were always full (tap water, not bottled). We ate quickly (our meal took about 2 hours), but we never felt rushed. The timing of the dishes matched our pace, and there was ample time between courses for digestion. Excellent communication between the front and back of house!

Food received 4 stars - As an amuse-bouche, we received cheddar cheese puffs. While they were delicious, they weren't like Cheetos and tasted more like Red Lobster chef muffins. Too bad they weren't on the bread tray! My wife ordered the fava bean and artichoke salad, which was surprisingly unappealing. I'm not a fan of beans, so I might be biased. My wife wished she had ordered something else.

yelp:train:263002.orig: Rolls have been better and service was good today. 1 star back.
yelp:train:263002.para: Today's rolls weren't at their best, but the service was satisfactory. I'm giving it 1 star.

yelp:train:263113.orig:
I read several of the reviews & they are consistent with what I've experienced.  I've been to this place about 5 times...both for lunch...and late night.  The food is actually pretty good.  I've had the BBQ pork & fries and it was very good.  At night, the place is fun.  They have the bull to ride...and it's interactive to meet people.

But, the BIG, BIG drawback is the service.  Seems like other people have had the same experience -  it's downright terrible.  Every single time I've been there I've had some issue (I'm not that picky either).  The service is very, very slow.  They hired some hot girls..but they certainly aren't the brightest.  The charged my friend for several drinks that we didn't have...and it took them almost 1/2 hour to correct it.

Because of the service, I can only give this place 2 stars.  Good food but I think it's run by a high Shool student.
yelp:train:263113.para:
After reading through several reviews, I found them to align with my own experiences. I've visited this establishment around five times, both for lunch and late-night meals. The food is quite satisfactory; the BBQ pork and fries were particularly delicious. At night, the place has a lively atmosphere with interactive activities to meet new people.

However, the major downside is the service, which is consistently poor. It seems others have had similar issues. Every visit has come with some problem (and I’m not overly picky). The service is extremely slow, and the staff, despite being attractive, are not very competent. They even overcharged my friend for drinks we didn’t order, and it took nearly half an hour to rectify the mistake.

Due to the service, I can only rate this place two stars. The food is good, but the management appears to be run by someone with little experience.

yelp:train:263427.orig: Just one word: YUM!\n\nOne of the better establishments on Mill. The ice cream is pretty good, and I like the cookies--nice and thin. They make all different kinds, but I just go with chocolate chip. Then you choose an ice cream (I like the oreo) and they will make a sandwich out if it. I get the half size (one cookie folded in half) and it is huge! The prices are pretty low, and my boyfriend likes the fresh lemonade they have (doesn't  mix well with ice cream though). The service is good, and the owner is usually there and is really friendly. A nice alternative to the over-priced Coldstone down the block ...
yelp:train:263427.para:
Sure, here's a paraphrased version of the text:

Mill Street has a great ice cream shop that I highly recommend. The ice cream is tasty, and I enjoy the thin, crispy cookies they offer. They have various types, but I stick to chocolate chip. You can pick your ice cream flavor (I prefer Oreo), and they'll create a sandwich with it. I opt for the half-size, which is surprisingly generous. The prices are reasonable, and my boyfriend appreciates their fresh lemonade, though it's not ideal with ice cream. The service is friendly, and the owner, who is usually on hand, is particularly approachable. It's a refreshing choice compared to the more expensive Coldstone nearby.

yelp:train:263712.orig:
I love ordering their food Thai-Hot (thats the hottest you can get here). If you like you're food spicy, you can't go wrong. Their pre-meal salads; which come with every dine-in meal, has an awesome salad dressing. They also sell their salad dressing for ($5) to take home. I forget how many oz. they said it was. I think its close to 12 or 16, but don't quote me on it. Every meal seems to come with a slice of fresh cut watermellon.  The watermellon is a nice refreshing pre or post meal snack and also light on the added calories; although the rest of the meal may not be.

My favorite dish is their garlic dish; either rice or noodle, ive had it with chicken and tofu before. The tofu is prepared in such a way that it has a crispy outside and a buttery inside. I don't think that I've ever ordered a tofu dish before and thought ""I might order this again some time."" 

Their lunch meals will cost you about $10-$11 after tax + tip, so I don't visit all the time, but they are a great choice if you can't stop thinking about thai food and you're in the midtown area near central ave and thomas.
yelp:train:263712.para:
I absolutely adore ordering their Thai-Hot food, which is the spiciest option available. If you enjoy spicy cuisine, you won't be disappointed. Each dine-in meal comes with a complimentary pre-meal salad, which is paired with a fantastic dressing. They even sell this dressing at $5 for take-home use, though I'm not sure of the exact quantity—around 12 to 16 ounces, I believe. Every meal is served with a slice of fresh watermelon, which makes for a delightful pre- or post-meal treat, though it's low in calories. 

My favorite is their garlic dish, whether it's rice or noodles, and I've tried it with both chicken and tofu. The tofu is particularly impressive, with a crispy exterior and a buttery interior. It's such a unique and delicious preparation that I've always wanted to order it again. 

Their lunch specials typically run about $10 to $11 after tax and tip, so I don't visit as often, but they're an excellent choice if you're craving Thai food and are in the midtown area near Central Ave and Thomas.

yelp:train:264089.orig:
Crowded. Cheesy. But it's free.

Wow, so you really get what you pay for. This show is free and you shouldn't expect much. The viewing area gets really crowded and when it's your typical sweltering day in Vegas, this viewing area can be the worst place to be. 

The show is really bad. I miss the old show that used to be in this same lagoon, it actually made sense. Oh well, can't dwell on the past. 

Good: It's free.

Bad: Terrible show and packed viewing area.

Final: If you happened to walk by it and it's not crowded, stop and watch it so you can experience how bad it is.
yelp:train:264089.para:
Free but crowded and cheesy—exactly what you'd expect for no cost.

The show is subpar, and the viewing area is packed, especially on hot Vegas days, making it a less-than-ideal experience.

The performance is awful. I preferred the previous show in this lagoon; it was more coherent. Moving on, there's no point in reminiscing.

Pros: It's free.
Cons: The show is terrible, and the viewing area is overcrowded.

Conclusion: If you stumble upon it when it's not busy, take a look to see just how poor it really is.

yelp:train:264474.orig: This place was on triple D. One of the best tequila line ups I have seen and their beer selection is off the charts. I got the 4 taco sampler with plantains and chips and salsa. Also got a Mexican coke, in a glass bottle (the only way to have a coke).  Service was prompt and everyone was nice. It was a Tuesday night and a little slow.  There was a live band with a jazz flute. Nice touch.
yelp:train:264474.para: This establishment offered an impressive array of tequilas and an outstanding beer selection. I tried the 4-taco sampler featuring plantains, chips, and salsa, along with a Mexican Coke in a glass bottle—the authentic way to enjoy a Coke. The service was quick, and the staff was friendly. On a Tuesday evening, the place was a bit quiet. There was a live band playing jazz flute, which was a pleasant addition.

yelp:train:264821.orig: The Yard House at Town Square is one of my favorite places for lunch or happy hour.  I like the large beer selection and all the menu items too.  My favorites are the double mac n cheese and the street tacos.  The burgers are very good too.  The staff is always awesome very friendly and take the time to really provide good customer service even though they are really busy.  I never feel rushed there.  It doesn't matter if its dining for two or twenty the service is always the same.  definitely a thumbs up in my book.
yelp:train:264821.para: I adore The Yard House at Town Square for both lunch and happy hour. I appreciate the extensive beer choices and the variety on the menu. Standouts for me include the double mac n cheese and street tacos. The burgers are also excellent. The staff is consistently fantastic, incredibly friendly, and dedicated to excellent customer service, even when they're very busy. I never feel hurried there. Whether dining for two or twenty, the service remains top-notch. It's a definite thumbs up in my book.

yelp:train:264944.para: A bustling airport restaurant. That says it all.

yelp:train:264953.orig: Okay, what is everyone ordering here because I recently had dinner here with my BF and we both thought it was very mediocre. \n\nWe tried 4 different types of rolls and the mixed tempura and thought everything was just okay. The best thing was the dragon roll but thats pretty hard to mess up. I usually order a baked roll of some sort when I hit up a sushi joint (ca roll topped with some sort of baked seafood with dynamite sauce) and theirs was really disappointing. They really skimped out on the baked topping. The fish was average, too. I probably wont be back since there are a few other sushi places that I feel do it better.
yelp:train:264953.para:
Sure, here's a paraphrased version of the text:

"After my recent dinner with my boyfriend, we both found the place to be rather unimpressive. We sampled four different types of rolls and the mixed tempura, and everything was just middling. The dragon roll stood out as the best, but that's typically hard to botch. As usual, I opt for a baked roll when I visit a sushi restaurant, like a California roll with a baked seafood topping and dynamite sauce, but their version was quite underwhelming. They didn't use much of the baked topping, and the fish was just average. Given that there are other sushi places that do it better, I probably won't return."

yelp:train:265541.orig: Pretty pretty good (in the famous words of Larry David)...food was very good however, not sure what was going on with the service.  Server was very friendly and knowledgable; however, we ordered 5-6 apps / sushi rolls in waves...everything came out at once.  Small table for two and the entire table was filled with plates.  Hmmm...not ideal.  The tempura green beans were excellent. Everything else was pretty good.  I'd go back fo' sho'...
yelp:train:265541.para: Pretty good, indeed (as Larry David would say)...the food was excellent, but I'm unsure about the service. The server was very friendly and knowledgeable, but we ordered about five to six appetizers and sushi rolls in batches, and they all arrived at once. Our small two-person table was completely covered in plates. Hmm, not the most ideal situation. The tempura green beans were outstanding, and everything else was pretty good too. I'd definitely return.

yelp:train:265918.orig:
Been here multiple times even as a child and still disappointed. 
Only went here again (in years) on Christmas believing that it might of improved & probably have better food since it's the holidays......but nope......still the same as it ever was. 

HARDLY any food choices. I think the Dessert section had MORE choices than the dinner section too. 

I really don't understand why there's always a line here. Mc Donald's in Midway is better than this. 

Really one star; gave it another for the chocolate fudge cake they had (probably the only good thing there in my opinion).
yelp:train:265918.para:
I've visited here several times since childhood and remain consistently disappointed. The last time I returned, after years, was during Christmas, hoping for an improvement and better food due to the holiday season... but it was the same as ever. 

There are very limited food options, and I noticed the dessert section had more choices than the dinner menu. 

I truly don't comprehend why there's always a line here. McDonald's in Midway is superior. 

Overall, I'd rate it one star, but gave it an extra point for the chocolate fudge cake, which is probably the best thing they offer.

yelp:train:266030.orig: They charged a cover, were stingy with the liquor, and the DJ sucked. Disappointing.
yelp:train:266030.para: The entrance fee was charged, the alcohol was sparingly served, and the DJ was lackluster. It was a letdown.

yelp:train:266168.orig:
I HATE Blue Wasabi. I had the WORST experience here. You couldn't pay me to consume that repulsive crap they call ""Sushi"". 
Quick summary of my experience.... My boyfriend and I went on a date. We sat on the patio. It took FOREVER to get our food. Granted it was kinda busy, we only ordered 2 rolls & some edamame. It shouldn't take an hour & a half. The waiter offered no apologies or explanation. The rice was sooo stale & dry. Sushi looked like it had been sitting out for an hour. We couldn't even choke it down. It was horrible, no joke. 
Then some poor girls purse was stolen right from the patio. Some dickhead drove up to the patio, his friend jumped out & snatched this womans purse who was dining on the patio. 
It was a horrible experience. Blue Wasabi SUCKS!
yelp:train:266168.para:
I absolutely detested my experience at Blue Wasabi. It was the WORST meal I've ever had. I would never force myself to eat that inedible "sushi."

To summarize, my boyfriend and I went on a date and sat on the patio. Despite it being busy, our order of just two rolls and some edamame took over an hour and a half. The waiter didn't offer any explanation or apology. The rice was extremely stale and dry, and the sushi appeared to have been sitting out for a while. We found it nearly impossible to eat, and it was truly awful.

To top it off, a woman's purse was stolen right from the patio. A man drove up, his friend jumped out, and snatched the woman's purse while she was dining.

Overall, it was a terrible experience, and Blue Wasabi is a complete disappointment.

yelp:train:266683.orig:
Unassuming deli spot with a huge menu including their own crafted meats, bagels, breakfast, and desserts. 4.5

Food: 4.5, Atmosphere: 3, Service: 4
Cost to worth it rating: 3
Return worthiness: yes!
Eve award: best non-burger sliders I've ever had

Highlights:
- Jewish sliders: tender sliced beef brisket on top of deliciously seasoned crispy potato pancakes in between 2 soft dense shiny challah buns. Top in with the gravy it comes with, and you're close to true bliss. Amazing!!! Though that man vs food guy tried to eat a dozen in a half hour--that's a bit much.
- Corned beef hash: one of my fave breakfast items and this is one of the best. Smooshed ground version with crisped edges but not processed tasting or too salty
- Fries: crispy wedges but potatoey soft inside. Fantastic when dipped in the gravy
- Brisket dip: twist on the traditional French the hub enjoyed
- Could take large groups: we had 16 and there was a party in the back room with 30

Lowlights:
- Some breakfast items have time restrictions: things like eggs benedicts are only served til 3pm (there was a crazy one I wanted to try on top of a potato pancake)

Had a great family meal here and would come
yelp:train:266683.para: This unassuming deli offers a vast menu with homemade meats, bagels, breakfast dishes, and desserts. It scores 4.5 for food quality, 3 for atmosphere, and 4 for service. The cost-to-worth ratio is rated 3, but it's definitely worth returning. The standout dish is the Eve award-winning non-burger sliders, which are tender beef brisket between soft, shiny challah buns, topped with gravy for a heavenly taste. Also, the corned beef hash is one of the best, with a smoky flavor and crispy edges. The fries are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, perfect with the accompanying gravy. They also offer a brisket dip and can accommodate large groups, as we had 16 people and there was a separate room for a group of 30. However, some breakfast items have time restrictions, like eggs benedicts, which are only served until 3 pm. Despite this, we had a fantastic family meal and would definitely return.

My kid had the roadies or w/e they were supposed to be like slider's there was 2 missing the meat! So we call to see what's up maybe they had an off night. The gm wanted to send us a gc for the meal ok....weeks go by we call her, again she apologizes. We finally get them and she had sent like 3x the original amount. YAY!\n\nWe decide to take some friends with us since it was FREE. Well once again it was pretty gross no one really ate much, 2 people got their filets they ended up well done. yelp:train:267239.para:
I went to this place based on a recommendation from Sarah (thanks, Sarah) and had a pretty bad experience. Our takeout order was a disaster; it looked like it had been dropped. My child's meal, which was supposed to be sliders, was missing two pieces of meat! We called to inquire, and the general manager offered a gift card for the meal. Weeks passed, and we called again, and she apologized. Eventually, she sent three times the original amount, which was great.

We decided to bring some friends for a free meal, but it was still pretty disappointing. Nobody really ate much; only two people got their filets, and they were overcooked. One had to be remade but ended up the same. They basically said that's how it would be if you ordered later in the evening, no matter what. The service was poor, and this led to six of us never returning. I'm okay with that because I don't like chains. Will people ever learn that chains are not good? This place shouldn't even have one star; the only good thing is the peanut shells for the kids to throw on the ground.

yelp:train:267469.orig: Interesting & informative tour. We enjoyed it, as well as the various flavor samples of specialty olive oils and other goodies! The atmosphere is pleasant & everything we tried was delicious!! Enjoy a glass of sangria (or share a carafe)
yelp:train:267469.para: An engaging and enlightening tour that we thoroughly enjoyed, along with sampling a variety of specialty olive oil flavors and other treats! The ambiance is delightful, and everything we tasted was absolutely delicious! Don't forget to savor a glass of sangria (or share a carafe).

yelp:train:267889.orig:
Hell yeah! What is it? The Wednesday after? And I'm still recovering!
The parade was glittery gorgeous fun. Fun crowd, good groups at the festival. Plus, I won a big tube of fancy German lube!

I had a really good time, but it was mostly because of the people I was with, and that the last time I went was about 3 years ago. Three year intervals seem to work best for me, in order to prevent a bad case of been-there-done-that.
yelp:train:267889.para:
Wow! What happened next? Was it the Wednesday following? And I'm still feeling the effects!

The parade was spectacularly fun, with a great crowd and impressive groups at the festival. Oh, and I even won a large tube of fancy German lubricant!

While I had a great time, it was mainly due to the company and the fact that it's been about three years since my last visit. I find that a three-year gap works best for me to avoid feeling like I've done it all before.

yelp:train:268093.orig: Super friendly customer service, clean atmosphere and AWESOME MILITARY DISCOUNT!  We will be regulars:)
yelp:train:268093.para: We had super friendly service, a clean environment, and an EXCELLENT MILITARY DISCOUNT! We're definitely coming back regularly.

yelp:train:268146.orig: great pizza, apparently the pepperoni is in \""the top twenty\""
yelp:train:268146.para: The pizza is excellent, and it seems the pepperoni is among the top twenty toppings.

yelp:train:268212.orig: For one thing when you ask for medium rear it should not be medium well and the shoe string fries tasted like crap the service was not great it is the worst 120 I spent for two never again
yelp:train:268212.para: Firstly, when you order medium rare, it shouldn't come out medium well. The shoestring fries were terrible, and the service was subpar. It was the worst meal I've had for $120, and I'll never return.

yelp:train:268302.orig:
I have been to the Herb box for lunch  twice and have loved it each time. Located in the very chic DC ranch at Pima, the restaurant is best enjoyed if seated outside in the patio on a lovely March afternoon. 
The mango lemonade is very soothing and the refills keep coming. Had the salmon with tsatziki and a side if the sweet potato chips . The salmon here is one of the best i have eaten and the chips are really addictive. 
I didnt have dessert this time around but have tried their graham cracker chocolate mousee before and its delicious. 
Would love to go back whenever the weather permits patio seating.
yelp:train:268302.para:
I've visited The Herb Box for lunch twice now, and I've enjoyed it both times. Situated in the trendy DC Ranch area, the restaurant is particularly delightful when you sit outside on the patio during a sunny March afternoon. 

The mango lemonade is incredibly refreshing, with free refills provided. I had the salmon with tsatziki and a side of sweet potato chips. The salmon is among the best I've tasted, and the chips are highly addictive. 

I didn't have dessert this time, but I've previously tried their graham cracker chocolate mousse, which was delicious. 

I'd love to return whenever the weather allows for outdoor seating.

yelp:train:268409.orig:
This rating is not about the cupcakes...because I didn't get to have any. 

Aside from seeing my fabulous friends, this place was what I was most looking forward to on my trip to the area. I've heard about the yummy treats for a while now, and was SO excited to get to go.

So, post dinner and hockey game on Saturday night, we waltzed down Walnut...just in time to see the shop being locked up. Whaaaa? I(well,  we ALL) were expecting late night goodies at a place known for late night hours. Evidently, Cakes on Walnut has recently changed their hours, and alas, are now not the ""post bar"" go-to. No biggie, we'll just stop back tomorrow. Errr, wait.  Closed on Sundays. Hmmm...Monday, before we leave??? No dice. They don't open 'till Noon. 

Boo Hiss. 

Perhaps if I'm ever in town and get to taste these cakes, I can actually rate them. 

*I'm giving them two stars, because only  Funky-McNasty places with bad service get one star in my book(which I don't think would describe this place)...but my bummed out sweet tooth thinks I'm a softie.
yelp:train:268409.para:
This review isn't about the cupcakes, as I didn't get to try any. 

Despite being excited to see my friends, this place was the highlight of my trip. I've heard so much about their delicious treats and was really looking forward to visiting. 

After dinner and a hockey game on Saturday night, we headed to Walnut Street, only to find the shop locked. What? We were expecting late-night treats at a place known for staying open late. Apparently, Cakes on Walnut has recently changed its hours, and they're no longer the go-to spot for post-bar snacks. No problem, we'll come back tomorrow. Wait, they're closed on Sundays. Monday, before we leave? Nope, they don't open until noon. 

Boo hiss. 

Maybe someday, when I visit again, I can actually taste these cakes and rate them properly. 

*I'm giving them two stars because, in my book, only places with bad service get one star, but my disappointed sweet tooth thinks I'm being too kind.

yelp:train:268620.orig: The garden during the holiday season is very relaxing and enjoyable.  There was a section of lights that were completely out and that was a little disappointing.  \n  Strolling amongst the lights you feel like you have completely left the city.  At the end of our exploration of the lights we went into the chocolate factory and had some hot chocolate.  They were so busy and making the hot chocolate so fast that it was a little on the cool side.\n  Their chocolate products are delicious and we enjoy going there every year.
yelp:train:268620.para: The holiday garden is a serene and delightful place to visit. While a few light sections were dark, which was a bit disappointing, the overall experience was very relaxing. Walking through the illuminated paths, it feels like you've stepped away from the city. After our light tour, we entered the chocolate factory and enjoyed some hot chocolate. Although they were very busy and served it quickly, the drink was a bit chilly. Their chocolate products are outstanding, and we always look forward to visiting there each year.

yelp:train:268926.orig: Beautiful church that you can tell the members take care of. I recently moved here and was looking for some place warm and I have to say when I walked in I was  a bit intimidated by the size and the amount of people but by the end of mass I was in love. The music is so beautiful, the singers are passionate, you can hear it in their voices. That's a big part for me, I like to sing along at mass. The mass was wonderful and the community was so welcoming. They have greeters at the door which is a nice touch, makes you feel that one on one connection. The priest stays after to chat with members and all in all it is just amazing. I look forward to mass.
yelp:train:268926.para: The church I've joined is beautifully maintained, evident by the care its members show. Although I was initially a bit daunted by its size and the number of people during my first visit, I ended up feeling very warmly welcomed. The music was incredibly beautiful, with the singers clearly passionate about their performance. This resonated with me, as I enjoy singing along during mass. The service itself was wonderful, and the community was exceptionally friendly. There are greeters at the door, adding a personal touch that makes you feel valued. The priest also takes time to chat with the congregation after the service, which is a lovely gesture. Overall, it's an amazing place, and I eagerly look forward to attending mass.

yelp:train:269463.orig: New to the Tattoo world I went here due to a referral. I spent over $700 dollars and got the worst tattoo...the artist ? can't remember his name colored in my whole chest with green...like paint by numbers-no outline of florals....had to go to another shop since they refused to fix or even take my calls. I am now $1500 into a tattoo that still has bizarre green back ground. If you have a picture they probably do fine...for me I was trusting the artistic ability and they don't have it.
yelp:train:269463.para: As a newcomer to tattooing, I chose this place based on a recommendation. Despite spending more than $700, I ended up with a subpar tattoo—green paint-by-numbers style covering my entire chest without proper outlining of the floral design. I had to seek help elsewhere because they wouldn't even address my request for a fix or return my calls. Now, I've invested over $1500 in a tattoo that still has an odd green background. While their work might be acceptable from pictures, their actual artistic skills clearly fell short for me.

yelp:train:269594.orig:
Pro: drunks singing, public insults, friendly atmosphere 

Con: upstairs

So, drinking and singing, I managed to get a song in (part of the your world)... too bad it was a weeknite and the place closed early. 

Next time I am in Phoenix, I would be coming back for more.
yelp:train:269594.para:
Pros: impromptu singing, public banter, warm ambiance

Cons: the upstairs area

I stumbled upon this place late at night while in Phoenix on a business trip. I was familiar with the Shout House from its SD location, and it turned out one of the pianists was on loan from there. Enjoying drinks and singing, I even got to perform part of "Your World"... unfortunately, it was a weekday and the place shut down early. 

I plan to return to this spot next time I'm in Phoenix for more of the same.

yelp:train:270104.para: On December 9 to 14, I rented a car and left my Garmin in the driver's seat when I returned it. At the airport, I called to inform them about it. Upon arriving home, I received a message saying the Garmin was in lost and found and to contact Rosa. I called her every three days, but she was always on vacation and never at work. yelp:train:271310.orig:
It is a good eat. They use all white meat chicken and give you plenty to eat. My wife always gets sweet and sour chicken. It is enough to feed to boys from one plate. They all love it. 

The orange chicken is is just too sweet for me. If it wasnt so syrupy and had more spice, it would be better. I like white meat chicken with some spice. Good, but just too sweet.

Mongolian beef is very tasty. Thats usually what I get. Again, not quite the kick I like. I usually add some sriracha hot sauce. Mmmmmm.
yelp:train:271310.para:
It's a great meal; they exclusively use white meat chicken and serve generous portions. My wife always orders the sweet and sour chicken, which is plentiful enough for the boys to share and enjoy. They all love it.

The orange chicken is overly sweet for my taste; it's too syrupy and lacks spice. If it had more heat, it would be much better. I prefer white meat chicken with some kick, so I usually add some sriracha. It enhances the flavor nicely.

The Mongolian beef is very delicious, and that's typically what I order. However, it doesn't quite have the spiciness I prefer, so I usually add some sriracha hot sauce to give it that extra kick. Mmmmmm.

yelp:train:271704.orig: On my way back from vegas, i thought of having a quick lunch at this burger king located within airport premises. I ordered a burger. First it around 20 minutes for them to serve it, ridiculously long for a fast food joint located at airport, with around 8 people staffsize, but to add to a misery, the burger served was with burned buns and yes!..the buns were charred black from inside!! Didnt get a chance to raise my concern with the outlet manager since i was running late to board my flight. But overall it was the worst possible burger experience i had till date. Would NOT recommend this place to anyone..
yelp:train:271704.para: During my return trip from Vegas, I considered stopping at a Burger King inside the airport for a quick bite. I placed my order for a burger. However, it took about 20 minutes to receive my food, which seemed unusually long for an airport fast-food restaurant with a staff of around eight people. To make matters worse, the burger came with burnt buns that were black both inside and out. Unfortunately, I didn't have the opportunity to speak with the manager because I was running late for my flight. In summary, it was the poorest burger experience I've ever had, and I would definitely not recommend this place to anyone.

yelp:train:272064.orig: This is the best LVAC in town! I never have to wait for equipment, the staff is decent and I do not feel like I am in a roid-raged meat locker. Use caution in the parking lot because the crazies who are there to work out, don't believe in walking far to get to their work out. I have also seen several cars broken into so BE CAREFUL not to leave your valuables in the car.  Aside from that, there's something for everyone and the classes are kick %$@!
yelp:train:272064.para: This LVAC is top-notch in the area! I never face long waits for equipment, the staff is satisfactory, and the atmosphere isn't intimidating. Be wary in the parking lot, as some workout enthusiasts park right by their machines. I've also noticed several car break-ins, so make sure to secure your valuables. Otherwise, there's a variety of options available, and the classes are incredibly intense!

yelp:train:272389.orig: We dined last night. When we entered we asked the hostess for a table on the patio by a heat lamp. She said that would be no problem. We get out to the patio and all the heat lamps are bundled together and off. I see her tinker with one and then walk away. A few minutes later our server approached our table and took our drink orders. We mentioned the heat lamps and he said the owner was probably fixing them for us. (We had two kids with us who were freezing). Just as our drinks arrived another table was sat. The hostess/owner came back out to the patio and started to fix the heat lamps by the NEW table. We ordered our food and said if we could not get a heat lamp we would like to move inside. For the next 15 minutes the owner set up and got working two heat lamps for the new table. Once our food arrived she came over and started on ours. I felt like a second rate citizen. We mentioned that it was cold and she said it was because we were drinking margarita's. I said the kids were not drinking margaritas and their hands were freezing she said they should have gotten up and warmed them by the fire pit. With this kind of hospitality from the OWNER I won't need to ever dine here again.
yelp:train:272389.para: Last night, we dined at the restaurant and requested a patio table near a heat lamp. The hostess assured us it would be fine. Upon reaching the patio, we noticed all the heat lamps were grouped away from our intended spot. She fiddled with one but then left. A few minutes later, our server arrived, mentioning the owner was likely addressing the issue. Our children were shivering, so we brought it up again. Just as our drinks arrived, another table was seated, and the hostess/owner began fixing the heat lamps for them. We asked if we could move inside if we couldn't get a heat lamp. For the next 15 minutes, she set up and activated two heat lamps for the new table, then turned to ours. I felt undervalued. She suggested the cold was due to our margaritas, despite the kids not drinking them and their hands being cold. She advised them to warm up by the fire pit. Given this level of service from the owner, I won't be returning.

yelp:train:272571.orig: I usually come here every morning on my way to work. The staff is friendly and when I go into the store it's always clean. The drive thru is 80% of the time very slow. I've waited 15 minutes for coffee stuck in the drive thru with a moderate/shorter line. I don't know what they do behind the scenes after you order, but they need to pick up the pace.
yelp:train:272571.para: I visit this place daily on my commute to work. The employees are always friendly, and the store is consistently clean. However, the drive-thru can be quite slow, about 80% of the time. I've experienced waiting up to 15 minutes in a moderately long line. I'm not sure what happens after I place my order, but they need to speed things up.

yelp:train:272658.orig:
I go on a 3 day horseback riding trip twice a year.  When I do, I always stop by REI to pick up supplies for the trip.  On my last visit, I found a 10 degree sleeping bag for $70, not bad!  It's kept me very warm and comfortable.

The employees at this REI are always helpful and answer all of my stupid questions. Since I'm a novice outdoors guy, I ask a lot of basic questions.  They're always willing to help me.

Return Factor - 93%
yelp:train:272658.para:
I embark on a 3-day horseback riding trip twice annually, and each time, I visit REI to gather necessary supplies. During my most recent trip to REI, I discovered a 10-degree sleeping bag priced at $70—quite a bargain! It has kept me warm and comfortable throughout my rides.

The staff at this REI store is consistently helpful, answering all my basic questions with patience. As a beginner in outdoor activities, I often ask simple questions, but they are always willing to assist me.

Return Factor - 93%

yelp:train:273149.orig:
I completely forgot about my experience 2 years ago and went back to eat  again...
This time, they didn't list the auto-grat in bill. Instead, they just added to the credit card bill after wards!!
My bill was $26.04, I put $28.00 in total, my statement says $30.04. They didn't like what I wrote for tip, so they gave themselves a little more. I left little for a reason. They didn't do anything to serve us! All they did was took the order, brought the food (not even at the same time. 3 meals came in 3 different times.) And the bill. No refill, no checking on how we're doing, or how the food tasted, or need anything else! 
Keep your receipt and check your account to make sure they don't add more amount than you wrote in.
I'm not concerned about $2 they added more, it's the principle of the fact that they did it. Very bad way to do business. A scam.
yelp:train:273149.para:
Two years ago, I had completely forgotten about my visit, so I returned to dine again. This time, the automatic gratuity wasn't included in the bill; it was added to the credit card statement afterward. My bill was $26.04, and I paid $28.00 in total, but my statement showed $30.04. They adjusted the tip I had written, giving themselves a bit more. I left a small tip for a reason—they didn't provide any service beyond taking our order and bringing the food, which arrived in three separate servings over different times. There were no refills, no checks to see how we were doing, or any follow-up on the food's quality. 

Make sure to keep your receipt and verify your account to ensure they don't add more than you specified. While the extra $2 isn't a big deal, the principle of their actions is concerning. This is a very poor way to conduct business and feels like a scam.

yelp:train:273298.orig: They actually open at 11:00 am , not 9:00. Also, the address listed is wrong. It is actually 2630 rio solado parkway. Other than that, the facility is okay. Staff isn't very tentative.
yelp:train:273298.para: The establishment opens at 11:00 am, not 9:00. Additionally, the address provided is incorrect; the correct location is 2630 Rio Solado Parkway. Apart from these issues, the facility itself is satisfactory. The staff could be more attentive, though.

yelp:train:274127.orig:
I haven't been to this Red Robin in a while, and I came back with a friend of mine this afternoon to meet up for some food.  What a good time!  It was busy for a Sunday afternoon, but fortunately we didn't have to wait.

We were seated in the bar area and our server greeted us promptly.  We already had the menu's at our table, and after scouring it, I went with the fries.  My friend went with a chicken salad, and I her sister went with the fish and chips.  Overall, our food was tasty, and I really had a good time.

While we were busy gabbing, our server always refilled our drinks, and after I bill came we had our bill split.  She was friendly and nice, and I really enjoyed our time here.  I will say, the handicapped bathroom was out of service when I was there, and it was a bit messy and needed attention overall.  Nothing horrendous, but could have used someone to go in there and clean up the towels on the floor and mop some.

Overall a positive experience and I had a good time. Will be back when I'm in the area again!  Oh, and happy hour all Sunday long!
yelp:train:274127.para:
I hadn't visited this Red Robin recently, but I returned with a friend this afternoon for a catch-up over some food. What a great visit! It was quite busy on a Sunday, but we didn't have to wait.

We were seated in the bar area, and our server greeted us promptly. We had menus at our table, and after reviewing them, I opted for the fries. My friend chose a chicken salad, and her sister went for the fish and chips. The food was delicious, and I thoroughly enjoyed myself.

Throughout our conversation, our server kept our drinks topped up, and when the bill arrived, we split it. She was very friendly and accommodating, and I had a wonderful time. However, I noticed that the handicapped bathroom was out of service and was a bit messy, needing some attention. It wasn't a major issue, but it could have used some cleaning.

Overall, it was a positive experience, and I had a great time. I plan to return when I'm in the area again! And, by the way, happy hour is available all day on Sundays!

yelp:train:275213.orig:
I went to this salon and had a great time! The place is beautifully decorated and they played a lot of fun music. The people are very friendly. They gave me free champagne as I got my hair done.  
Campbell did my hair and gave great advice as I was unsure what I wanted to do. The haircut was better than i could have pictured it! 
After my hair was done, Gina did my make-up. She made me look like a completely different person! I especially loved my eyes. The way she made them stand out was so impressive. 
I would recommend this salon to everyone.
yelp:train:275213.para:
I recently visited this salon and had an amazing experience! The interior is stunningly decorated, and they played lots of enjoyable music. The staff is incredibly friendly. As a special treat, they served me free champagne while I was getting my hair done.

Campbell handled my hair and provided excellent guidance since I wasn't sure about my preferences. The haircut turned out even better than I imagined!

Following my hair styling, Gina did my makeup. She transformed me into a completely different person! I particularly adored how she highlighted my eyes; it was truly impressive. 

I highly recommend this salon to everyone.

yelp:train:275445.orig: I want to love Amelie's I really, really do. On the whole they are trying very hard but when you consider the $ they just fall so short. Let's consider- 24.00 for a soda, cup of soup, brownie, tart, sandwich and lemonade. Boylan soda out of a bottle, 2.15 so no big deal. The soup was Spicy Thai, easy on both points but more meh for 3.99. Salted caramel brownie was ok.  Turkey and brie the merest of both drowned in 'seasonal fruit compote' which was raspberry so sour it was all you could taste, the bread IS delicious. French Lavender Soda- mmmnope, just carbonated water with a splash of lemonade, again very sour and definately no lavender and 3.49. Meh. My final complaint is that even though the counter lady was nice she did not have a clue what 'apricot' is and pulled tart after tart after tart out- No, that's apple, No that's pear, No that's almond...I finally gave up. Apple tart it was. Again, just ok but a king's ransom at 4.59!!!! I certainly hope the owner reads these reviews and takes them to heart because she seemed on the ball as she served in the dining room very aware of customers reactions. She seems sweet and earnest and is just so close to being on target. Honestly, I
yelp:train:275445.para: I genuinely want to love Amelie's, but the prices and quality just don't match up. For instance, a soda, soup, brownie, tart, sandwich, and lemonade cost $24.00 in total. A Boylan soda in a bottle is $2.15, so that's not too bad. However, the Spicy Thai soup, priced at $3.99, was just okay. The salted caramel brownie was decent, but the turkey and brie sandwich, with a meager amount of turkey and brie drowned in raspberry compote that was extremely sour, was a letdown. The French Lavender Soda, at $3.49, was just carbonated water with a hint of lemonade, and it was also very sour. The apple tart, at $4.59, was just okay, too. Even though the server was friendly, she seemed unsure about the menu items, particularly apricots, and kept showing me tarts that weren't apricot. I ended up getting the apple tart, which was just fine but overpriced. I really hope the owner reads these reviews and pays attention, as she seems to be on the right track in the dining room. She appears genuine and is very close to hitting the mark.

yelp:train:275666.orig: We went there on Wednesday night for dinner.  It's a very typical asian buffet set-up. The selection was below average. We were looking for the fresh oyster everybody talked about, and they were a no-show. We felt gypped. The check for 2 including tip was $30 which I can get some good chinese food from a nearby restaurant seem a little high.
yelp:train:275666.para: We dined there on Wednesday evening, and it featured a standard Asian buffet layout. The variety wasn't impressive. We had heard about the fresh oysters, but they were missing, leaving us feeling cheated. The bill for two, including tip, came to $30, which seemed a bit steep when compared to the quality of Chinese food I could get from a nearby restaurant.

yelp:train:275710.orig: I have been there for both lunch (at only $8.75), and dinner (at only $12.75). I actually liked some of the sushi selections, but hate that they put ham in their fried rice (kinda gross), they do have other food selections that are pretty decent though. For dinner, which starts at 4pm, they add crab legs & oysters... Just be sure to bring your patience with you because some of the servers dont understand english, are kinda rude, and it gets so packed with people who bring their little kids, and let them run around unattended while yelling and screaming, as if the buffet was a personal playground. Other than that, yeah, the place is okay.
yelp:train:275710.para: I've dined there for both lunch (just $8.75) and dinner (only $12.75). While I enjoyed some of the sushi options, I really dislike the ham in their fried rice—it's quite off-putting. There are still other menu items that are quite good. For dinner, starting at 4pm, they offer crab legs and oysters. Just remember to bring your patience; some servers struggle with English and can be a bit rude. The place can get very crowded, especially with families letting their children run around without supervision, which can be quite noisy. Overall, it's a decent place, but there are definitely areas for improvement.

yelp:train:276904.orig: Place was dirty and did not serve vegetarians. They guy said over the phone they did. Otherwise nice people.
yelp:train:276904.para: The location was messy and didn't offer any vegetarian options, even though the guy on the phone claimed they did. The staff were otherwise quite friendly.

yelp:train:277230.orig: My husband and I went to this restaurant last week after going to the Beatles show. My husband ordered the I-80 burger; he ordered his burger well done but it came burned and couldn't really get our server to replace it because he hardly ever showed up to see how the food was and how we were doing. I ordered the California chicken and it was nothing amazing, in fact I couldn't finished it because the sun dried tomatoes were so salty it made it hard to enjoy. We also ordered the sweet potato fries but can't tell you if they were good because we never got them , our server gave us the wrong kind.The only thing that we did enjoy was their buffalo chicken wings, they were really good.As I mentioned before our server never checked on us except for when we were done and ready to pay. I would definitely not recommend it to anyone, unless you want to pay a lot for mediocre food.
yelp:train:277230.para: Last week, after attending a Beatles show, my husband and I dined at this restaurant. He opted for the I-80 burger, which was overcooked, but arrived burnt. We struggled to get our server's attention; he was rarely around to check on our meal or our satisfaction. My choice, the California chicken, was underwhelming; the sun-dried tomatoes were excessively salty, making it difficult to enjoy. We also ordered sweet potato fries, but never received them, as our server mistakenly brought the wrong order. The only positive was the buffalo chicken wings, which were quite delicious. Our server was absent throughout the meal, only appearing when we were ready to pay. Given the experience, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone, unless you're willing to pay a premium for subpar food.

yelp:train:277379.orig: I gave birth to my baby here in August 2011. The nurse that checked me in was rude and unfriendly. The nurse that I had from the time I got into my room until an hour after giving birth was fantastic! My baby needed to go to the NICU, but we weren't really told the reason for taking her there. Our baby was in the NICU for 7 days, so we met almost all of the nurses up there. About 2/3 were rude and not friendly (IN THE NICU). The other 1/3 was friendly and wanted to answer our questions. I was there every 3 hours to feed my baby while she was staying at San Martin so I met everyone that came in. We didn't meet the doctor caring for my baby until day 5 after I demanded to talk to him. They were very vague about why she was staying there and treated us as if we were stupid! For my next baby I will not be delivering at San Martin Campus.
yelp:train:277379.para: In August 2011, I gave birth to my child at San Martin. The nurse who registered me was unfriendly. However, the nurse who attended me from entering the room until an hour after the birth was excellent! My baby required NICU care, but we weren't fully informed about the reasons. She stayed in the NICU for seven days, during which we encountered most of the NICU nurses. About two-thirds were rude and unhelpful, while one-third were kind and willing to answer our questions. I visited my baby every three hours during her stay, meeting all the staff who came in. We didn't meet the doctor responsible for my baby's care until day five, after I insisted on speaking with him. The hospital was vague about her condition and treated us as if we were uninformed. For my next delivery, I won't choose San Martin Campus.

yelp:train:277500.orig: This pub is my favorite place for beer and food.  I think I would stop by this place everyday if I could.
yelp:train:277500.para: I absolutely adore this pub for both beer and food. If possible, I'd visit it every day.

yelp:train:277712.orig: After watching my favorite TV chef  Daisy Martinez prepare ropa vieja in her PBS cooking program last night, I had an overwhelming craving for that dish, so today I headed to Sabor Cubano where this was my fave dish when I came for buffet. As one of the recent reviewers mentioned, this establishment is NO LONGER A BUFFET, but is now a full-service restaurant. But that was OK, I came here for the ropa vieja. It was as delicious as I remembered it to be from my previous trips here, and came with a tasty side of moros (black beans and rice), a simple fresh salad, and toasted buns. A great satisfying meal, which would have been perfect if they lowered the volume of the music on their sound system.
yelp:train:277712.para: Last night, after watching my favorite TV chef, Daisy Martinez, prepare ropa vieja on her PBS show, I got a strong craving for the dish. So, today I went to Sabor Cubano, a place where I used to enjoy this meal during the buffet. However, as a recent review noted, it's no longer a buffet but a full-service restaurant. That was fine with me, as I was there specifically for the ropa vieja. It was just as delicious as I remembered from my past visits, served with a tasty side of moros (black beans and rice), a simple fresh salad, and toasted buns. It was a great, satisfying meal, though the music volume on their sound system was a bit too loud.

yelp:train:277964.orig:
I had a great time at Mullen's. I partied, danced, had some drinks, hung out with old friends, met new friends, and generally enjoyed myself for a few hours before heading out. Despite all of this, I can't get over how awful of an establishment this place is. As much fun as I had, I credit this to the party organizers (some outside group) and my friends.

Aside from the drinks being weak, I was forgotten about, given the wrong drinks, overcharged, and apologized to every time I went up to the bar to get a round. Bud Light, whiskey-coke, vodka-tonic turned into Miller Lite, rum-coke, you wanted what else? This eventually turned into a free round after the bartender set the drinks to the side and walked away (?), leading to another bartender/sad puppy approaching me.

There was a DJ, and the songs he played were alright, but he played them through a Mac hooked up to a the speaker system, and wasn't much for transitions. Top-40 bangers spastically lost tempo and glitched into uncomfortably sped mp3s of The Monster Mash; The Cupid Shuffle cut off early to allow for some unheard-of request right as everyone got on the dance floor. They have a big and awesome looking disco ball that
yelp:train:277964.para:
At Mullen's, I spent a few hours partying, dancing, and socializing with both old and new friends. Despite the enjoyable time, I found the place to be subpar. The fun I had was largely due to the party organizers and my companions, not the venue itself.

The drinks were notably weak, and I faced numerous issues at the bar. I was often ignored, given incorrect drinks, overcharged, and apologized to repeatedly. For instance, a Bud Light or a vodka-tonic became a Miller Lite or rum-coke. Eventually, after the bartender left the drinks unattended, I received a free round, only to be approached by another bartender or a disheartened staff member.

The DJ played a mix of songs, but the sound quality was poor. He used a Mac connected to the speakers, which resulted in abrupt tempo changes and glitches. Top-40 hits lost their rhythm and awkwardly transitioned into sped-up versions of oldies like "The Monster Mash" and "The Cupid Shuffle." The venue featured a large and impressive disco ball, but the lighting and music coordination were lacking.

yelp:train:278343.orig: I eat here regularly with my co-workers for lunch.  We go for one of two reasons.  Reason number 1: we are in the mood for Indian food.  It is the best Indian restaurant near the office.  Reason number 2: we can't think of any other places to eat and we haven't been to the Taj Mahal in three days.  The food is always great.   The lunch special is a good deal.  There is a rotation with three options.  You select your preferred spiciness level, one through ten, and naan or garlic naan.  Lunch also comes with lentil soup and yogurt sauce.
yelp:train:278343.para: I frequently dine here with my colleagues for lunch, typically for one of two reasons. First, we crave Indian cuisine, and this is the top Indian eatery close to our office. Second, when we're short on options and have been to the Taj Mahal three days ago, this place is our fallback. The food consistently impresses. The lunch specials offer a good value, with three choices to choose from. You can pick your spice level, from 1 to 10, and opt for naan or garlic naan. Each meal includes lentil soup and yogurt sauce.

yelp:test:1.orig: Last summer I had an appointment to get new tires and had to wait a super long time. I also went in this week for them to fix a minor problem with a tire they put on. They \""fixed\"" it for free, and the very next morning I had the same issue. I called to complain, and the \""manager\"" didn't even apologize!!! So frustrated. Never going back.  They seem overpriced, too.
yelp:test:1.para: Last year, I had to wait an extremely long time for new tires during my appointment. This week, I returned to have a minor tire issue addressed. They claimed to fix it for free, but the problem reoccurred the following day. I called to express my dissatisfaction, but the "manager" didn't even offer an apology. I'm so frustrated that I won't be returning. Additionally, I find their prices to be on the high side.

yelp:test:3.orig: The food is good. Unfortunately the service is very hit or miss. The main issue seems to be with the kitchen, the waiters and waitresses are often very apologetic for the long waits and it's pretty obvious that some of them avoid the tables after taking the initial order to avoid hearing complaints.
yelp:test:3.para: The food quality is satisfactory, but the service is inconsistent. The primary problem appears to stem from the kitchen, as waitstaff frequently apologize for lengthy wait times. It's clear that some servers try to steer clear of tables after taking the initial order to avoid dealing with customer complaints.

yelp:test:34.orig: I'm a creature of habit--I've been getting a savory and sweet item each time I'm around the neighborhood. White lily cake is divine! Quiches always tasty. Macarons are alittle too sweet. I wish the cake slices weren't $4/pop. Otherwise, would be a regular here.
yelp:test:34.para: I follow a routine and enjoy a combination of sweet and savory treats when I'm in this area. The White Lily cake is absolutely delightful! Quiches are consistently good. However, the macarons are a bit too sweet for my taste. I'm a bit disappointed that each slice of cake costs $4. If these issues were addressed, I'd likely become a frequent customer.

yelp:test:40.orig:
My girlfriend and I went to Casbah for the first time recently and we both enjoyed our experience.

The atmosphere is dressy, but the restaurant isn't so formal that it feels stuffy or uncomfortable, which is a welcome change compared to most classy restaurants.  The environment was relaxed, and it was easy to have a quiet conversation throughout the meal.  As for the meal itself, we had a reservation and were promptly seated when we showed up.

Our waiter was courteous and provided good, fast service without being overbearing or constantly hovering, which was quite nice.  For an appetizer, we ordered the cheese tray which was tasty as well as fun and unique.

Following the cheese tray, I dined on the cioppino while my girlfriend had the casereccia.  Both dishes were tasty and our seafood was skillfully cooked, particularly the sea bass in my dish which was delicious.

I'd recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to celebrate an occasion or have some good, out of the ordinary food.
yelp:test:40.para:
We recently visited Casbah for the first time, and both of us had a pleasant experience there. The ambiance was elegant, yet not overly formal, making it a refreshing alternative to most upscale dining spots. The setting was relaxed, allowing for easy, uninterrupted conversations during the meal. Upon arrival, we were promptly seated as we had a reservation.

Our waiter was polite and offered efficient, unobtrusive service. We started with the cheese tray, which was both delicious and unique. For the main course, I enjoyed the cioppino, while my girlfriend had the casereccia. Both dishes were flavorful, and the seafood was expertly prepared, especially the sea bass in my dish, which was outstanding.

I would suggest this restaurant for those seeking a special occasion or a memorable meal with exceptional food.

yelp:test:90.orig:
Port Authority (formerly known as PATransit, or ""PAT"") operates a fairly extensive network of buses and (in the South Hills) light rail. Instead of running school buses, the school district gave high schoolers bus passes to get to class, and I have used the bus since 1997.

I've had a great experience using the bus in Pittsburgh. I didn't get a driver's license until I was almost 19--the bus (""Miss Pat""--another nickname) and my bike got me everywhere I needed to go. There will inevitably be delays and problems, but that is common to all modes of transportation. The price is right (especially with a ""free"" bus pass; students see below) and if you live and work in the city, you should consider making the bus your main means of commuting.

The system is largely built on the legacy of pre-World War II trolley lines, so the neighborhoods that were developed before 1950 are fairly well-served, while more recent developments can be harder to navigate by bus. The system just had a major overhaul (in spring 2010) but still travel many of the same routes.

yelp:test:90.para:
Pittsburgh's Port Authority (previously PATransit or "PAT") runs a substantial bus network, including light rail in the South Hills. Instead of school buses, the district provided high school students with bus passes, and I've been using the service since 1997.

My experience with the bus has been positive. I didn't get my driver's license until nearly 19, and the bus ("Miss Pat") and my bike were sufficient for all my needs. The fares are reasonable, especially with a "free" student pass, and if you live and work in the city, the bus should be your primary mode of transportation.
