yelp:test:1221.orig: Really a nice little find. Four stars for the gyro dinner, veggie plate and greek salad. They were all really good and the price is definitely right. i will definitely be back here again!
yelp:test:1221.para: Truly a delightful discovery! I've given it four stars for the gyro dinner, veggie plate, and Greek salad—each was excellent, and the prices are very reasonable. I look forward to returning here soon!

yelp:test:1259.orig: This is a great place to go in the morning or late at night after partying.  I will forever enjoy going to this place because it reminds me of truck stop food while traveling.  The hungry traveller will always fill you up with bottomless pancakes but the country fried steak is also something I always get.  It gets 4 stars because sometimes they are understaffed and takes a bit to get service.  But when I go, I'm usually not in a hurry anyways.  The staff is always friendly day or night. Even a simple side salad is fresh and deserving of props.  The awesome thing is the fresh desserts and pie will satisfy any drunk or Sunday camper.  If you're tired of the usual IHOP or hole in the wall breakfast place, enjoy the old school diner atmosphere that th\nis place has to offer.
yelp:test:1259.para: This spot is perfect for a morning visit or a late-night meal after a night out. I cherish going here as it evokes memories of truck stop dining during my travels. For a hungry traveler, the bottomless pancakes are a must, and I always order the country-fried steak too. It earns four stars due to occasional understaffing, which can slow down service, but I'm usually relaxed when I visit. The staff is consistently friendly, regardless of the time. Even a basic side salad is fresh and well-prepared. The best part is the fresh desserts and pies that can satisfy anyone, whether they're hungover or just a weekend camper. If you're tired of the usual chain or small diners, this old-school diner offers a unique experience worth trying.

yelp:test:1267.orig:
02.05.10-02.08.10

We paid $150 + $5/day parking for our entire stay.  After reading the other Yelp reviews, I was really afraid of getting jumped (or worse).  But low expectations sometimes are good.

We checked in Friday night; they had no problem switching our king sized bed to a double bed suite.  The suite has a mini fridge and a microwave.  Definitely necessary after long nights of partying.  We are two doors down from the gym.  There are two flat screens.  Definitely better than expected.

Free made-to-order breakfast every morning.  Weekdays until 9:30, weekends until 10:00.  French toast, omelets, hash browns, etc.  It's pretty awesome if you can actually wake up for it.  The chefs actually come over to the tables to check up on how you're doing.  

The pool/hot tub is open from 6:00 a.m. to midnight.  Also amazing after a long day of hiking, or shopping, whatever floats your boat.

Recommend!
yelp:test:1267.para:
From May 2 to May 8, we paid $150 plus $5 per day for parking during our entire stay. Despite the cautionary Yelp reviews, my expectations were quite low, which turned out to be a positive factor.

We checked in on Friday evening, and they easily switched our king-sized bed to a double bed suite. The suite includes a mini fridge and a microwave, which are very useful after late-night parties. We are right next to the gym, and there are two flat-screen TVs. Overall, it was better than anticipated.

Every morning, there's a complimentary made-to-order breakfast from 9:30 a.m. on weekdays and 10:00 a.m. on weekends. The menu offers French toast, omelets, hash browns, and more. It's fantastic if you can manage to wake up for it, and the chefs even come to your table to check on you. 

The pool and hot tub are open from 6:00 a.m. to midnight, perfect for relaxing after a day of hiking or shopping. 

I highly recommend it!

yelp:test:1280.orig: Went to meet my mom for lunch last Friday with my little guy.  Instead of being greeted by the host staff, Carol walked up to me and announced that my stroller won't fit in the restaurant and that she would have to take it in the back.  What?  Ok...  This Britax B-Ready apparently warranted a scolding.  Carol was so incredibly rude and my stroller would have easily fit at a table- minus a chair.  What exactly is their procedure for wheelchairs or other special needs devices?  Do they simply not fit or are they not pleasing enough to the eye to accommodate?  They might want to come up with a better story and take a more discerning eye to the host staff.  I've always had such great experiences here in the past; what a disappointment.  We'll be over at Chelsea's.  They're cool with my wheels.
yelp:test:1280.para: Last Friday, I met my mom for lunch with my little one. Instead of being greeted by the host staff, Carol approached me and said my stroller wouldn't fit in the restaurant, insisting on taking it to the back. Really? My Britax B-Ready stroller deserved such a harsh comment. Carol was extremely rude, and the stroller would have easily fit at a table, just without a chair. What's their protocol for wheelchairs or other special needs equipment? Do they just not accommodate them or is it simply a matter of aesthetics? They should develop a better explanation and ensure their host staff is more discerning. I've had such positive experiences here before; this is a letdown. We'll be dining at Chelsea's instead, where they're okay with my stroller.

yelp:test:1289.orig: I'm stuffed!  No please, no more food!  Wait, it's free?  You just want to give me extra food because you feel like it?  Alright, I guess I could sacrifice and eat this delicious chocolate cake and free cookies you put in my valeted car!\nI swear that is how it is every time I dine at Vincent's.  They love providing extra treats which is why this place exceeds five stars.  The food alone is divine!  I love every item on their menu!  The souffles are to die for as well.  But they always seem to go above and beyond every meal.  If only every restaurant had the same level of customer service!
yelp:test:1289.para:
I'm so full! Please, no more food, though it's free. Are you just giving me extra treats because you feel like it? Alright, I'll indulge in this yummy chocolate cake and free cookies you've left in my valet parking.

This is exactly how it goes every time I dine at Vincent's. They always offer extra treats, which is why this place deserves more than five stars. The food is absolutely divine, and I enjoy every dish on their menu. Their soufflés are simply amazing. But they always go the extra mile with every meal. I wish every restaurant provided such excellent customer service!

yelp:test:1303.orig:
= = = = = =  THIS REVIEW IS FOR PETER PIPER'S WEEKDAY LUNCH BUFFET!  = = = = = =

This is a huge place, very inexpensive, & offers a buffet lunch of three kinds of salad, several pizza choices, & bread sticks.  Both the salads & the pizza were blah, & there was no other pasta, soup, potato salad, cottage cheese, or anything else like that to nibble on.  With rather loud music was playing, I couldn't enjoy reading the paper while I ate, so I bit down a few slices & left.

Ci Ci's next door is a better choice.
yelp:test:1303.para:
= = = = = =  THIS REVIEW IS FOR PETER PIPER'S WEEKDAY LUNCH BUFFET!  = = = = = =

This establishment is quite large and offers a budget-friendly lunch buffet with three types of salad, various pizza options, and bread sticks. However, both the salads and pizzas were unremarkable, and there were no additional pasta dishes, soups, potato salad, cottage cheese, or other snacks available. The loud music made it difficult to read the newspaper while eating, so I only sampled a few slices before leaving.

Ci Ci's, which is located next door, is a superior option.

yelp:test:1308.orig: Five stars due to this being the best Panda Express I've ever visited. The girl behind the counter was polite to the person in front of me OFFERING samples to them. When I stepped up she was super polite to me and offered me samples as well, and thanks to the sample I ended up getting the honey sesame seed chicken. Absolutely delicious. I asked for both noodles and rice and I expected the usual half-assed scoops of both but this girl hooked it up big time on everything! Despite all these bad reviews I will definitely be a repeat customer!
yelp:test:1308.para: I've given this Panda Express five stars because it's the best one I've ever been to. The server behind the counter was very polite to the person in front of me and even offered them samples. When it was my turn, she was equally courteous and offered me samples too. Thanks to the sample, I tried the honey sesame seed chicken, which was absolutely delicious. I ordered both noodles and rice, and instead of the usual small portions, she generously filled both for me. Despite the negative reviews I've seen, I'm definitely planning to return as a repeat customer!

yelp:test:1311.orig: I was lucky enough to get two tickets to the opening night of Giselle. What a beautiful performance. The scenery was beautiful, the dancers were great, the story was easy to follow for those of us who don't have training, overall it was amazing. This production made me want to go to the ballet again and again! Very professional and very entertaining.
yelp:test:1311.para: I was fortunate to secure two tickets for the opening night of Giselle, and it was a truly stunning experience. The set design was exquisite, the dancers were superb, and the narrative was accessible even for those without ballet training. In all, it was outstanding. This production has reignited my interest in ballet, making me eager to attend more performances. It was both professionally executed and highly entertaining.

yelp:test:1314.orig: I have never been so disappointed in an oil change! First they took my car and told me they would contact me when it was ready so I was free to do some shopping in Costco next door.  They never called.  I walked back over to pick up my car to find they never touched it and refused to work on it.  They said they heard a noise in the engine and would not tell me what it was.  (I had it checked out at different place).  Sears told me my engine could blow up at any moment.  All that was wrong was the O2 sensor was broken (nothing to cause and engine to blow up).  These guys were just lazy and did not want to do any work.  They chose to scare me instead.  I will never go back to a Sears Auto Center for anything.
yelp:test:1314.para: I've never felt so let down by an oil change experience! Initially, they picked up my car and assured me they'd contact me when it was ready, giving me the freedom to shop at Costco nearby. However, they never got back to me. When I returned to collect my car, I found it untouched and unworked on. They claimed to have heard a noise in the engine but wouldn't specify what it was. (I had it checked elsewhere.) Sears warned me my engine could fail at any moment, but the issue was merely a faulty O2 sensor (nothing that would cause an engine to explode). It seems they were just lazy and unwilling to do the job, opting instead to scare me. I won't be returning to a Sears Auto Center for any service.

yelp:test:1326.orig: My son likes to go there for poppers on the weekend.  His second choice is the chocolate chip coffee cake.  This is the second weekend in a row that they have been out of both.   The first time, I thought it was a fluke.  Two weekends in a row is a trend.  If you run out of something daily, make more of it.  Obviously, there's now more of a demand for both of these.  You can make more of them to meet the demand or don't and demand will go down from people like me not coming back to your store.  Dunkin Doughnuts, here we come again!
yelp:test:1326.para: My son prefers to get poppers on weekends, but his second preference is the chocolate chip coffee cake. This is the second weekend in a row they've run out of both items. Initially, I thought it was just a coincidence, but now it seems like a pattern. If they consistently run out of something, they should consider making more of it. It's clear that there's higher demand for these items. You can increase production to meet this demand, or risk losing customers like me who won't return. Dunkin' Donuts, it's time to step up!

yelp:test:1327.orig: My stylist was very knowledgeable. Yay, 13$/haircut!  She even knew about my natural curls & told me how that would work w/haircuts I wanted. Thanks!
yelp:test:1327.para: My stylist was incredibly knowledgeable. Hooray, only $13 for a haircut! She also understood my natural curls and provided great advice on haircuts that would suit them. Thank you!

yelp:test:1332.orig:
I've been in many presidential suites, few better than the one here.
Everything is superb.
Attention to detail, focused and sharp.
And the room itself?
Romantic with it's outdoor showers, making you feel almost naughty when showering.
And room service?
I enjoyed the eggs benedict, although it was somewhat cold.

Too bad I onlly have until till two o'clock to get this room cleaned and ready for shift manager inspection.
yelp:test:1332.para: I've stayed in numerous presidential suites, but this one stands out as exceptional. Everything is of the highest quality. The attention to detail is meticulous and precise. As for the room itself, it exudes romance, especially with its outdoor showers, which give a naughty yet delightful showering experience. Regarding room service, I particularly liked the eggs benedict, though they were a bit chilly. Unfortunately, I only have until two o'clock to clean and prepare this room for the shift manager's inspection.

yelp:test:1344.orig: I've eaten majority of their menu and haven't found anything that I haven't liked.  It's a great place for any meal.  My boyfriend is more a breakfast person and I'm more of a lunch person so this place is perfect for us.  I love their avocado pizza - we did it with proscuitto once and it was fantastic.  The spicy tuna roll makes a great appetizer.  The white sangria is probably one of the best I've had in Phoenix.  For dessert, the red velvet cupcake is unbelievable - the frosting is the best part.  The parking kinda stinks but you can always park across the street at arcadia room and walk to LGO.  Can't say how much I love this place!
yelp:test:1344.para: I've tried most of their menu items and haven't found anything I disliked. It's ideal for any meal. My boyfriend prefers breakfast and I enjoy lunch, so this place suits us perfectly. I particularly adore their avocado pizza, especially when paired with prosciutto—it was outstanding. The spicy tuna roll makes a great appetizer. The white sangria is one of the best I've tasted in Phoenix. For dessert, the red velvet cupcake is exceptional, with the frosting being the standout feature. While the parking could be better, you can easily park across the street at the Arcadia Room and walk to LGO. I truly can't express enough how much I love this place!

yelp:test:1359.orig: Parking is always a jam, but the food and atmosphere rocks.
yelp:test:1359.para: The parking area is perpetually congested, yet the cuisine and ambiance are outstanding.

yelp:test:1360.orig: I have enjoyed Postino's for a long time.  The Monday and Tuesday night madness are for those who have the patience to have a great deal.  This location is great due to the patio and indoor seating.  I've always enjoyed the prosciutto with brie sandwich.  Try to bring cash when possible for valet.. Parking can get pretty crazy.  \nService is always Outstanding!  Worth the drive and wait!
yelp:test:1360.para: I've been a regular at Postino's for quite some time. The special deals on Monday and Tuesday nights are best for those who are patient and want a good bargain. This place is fantastic, thanks to its patio and indoor seating options. I particularly love the prosciutto with brie sandwich. It's a good idea to have cash on hand for the valet, as parking can be quite challenging. The service is always outstanding, and it's definitely worth the drive and wait.

yelp:test:1365.orig: i thought it was good and it's cheap mexican. just dont expect anything fancy-don't know that i would actually eat inside.
yelp:test:1365.para: I found it to be decent and affordable Mexican food, but I wouldn't really consider eating there unless it's for takeout.

yelp:test:1402.para:
Wow.

My girlfriend and I took a bus to reach the shop, as we only have bikes. The journey took about an hour on a Sunday. Upon arrival, the mechanic inspected our bikes and quoted $10 for a new chain (reasonable) and $15 to install it. Wait, what? yelp:test:1436.orig: The atmosphere is decent, but the food is absolutely terrible.  It is nothing but chewy meat covered in cheap cheese and grease.   The quesadillas are served in a pool of grease and the nachos are some of the worst in Phoenix,  The quality is an insult to the prices charged and an affront to good Mexican food. yelp:test:1436.para: The ambiance is acceptable, yet the cuisine is overwhelmingly disappointing. The dishes are dominated by chewy meat drenched in cheap cheese and oil. The quesadillas are swimming in grease, and the nachos rank among the worst in Phoenix. The quality is a mockery of the prices, and a slap in the face to authentic Mexican fare. Opt for the beer instead.

yelp:test:1455.orig: This isn't the worse place I've been. In fact the pedicure was really pretty good, but the manicure chipped the very next day! yelp:test:1455.para: While this isn't the worst place I've visited, the pedicure was quite nice. However, the manicure chipped almost immediately after. They also seemed a bit reluctant about accepting my card payment, even though I tipped in cash. I only went for a wedding, and I doubt I'll return.

They scheduled someone to come out to \""check it\"", but they were a no-show for the scheduled appointment. Called again, and the run-around started. yelp:test:1473.para: A good variety of products is available, and the staff in the nursery are typically helpful. However, the customer service at the counter is disappointing, often slow and unresponsive. On my last visit, I purchased a 15-gallon tree, which seemed fine at first. Unfortunately, the tree lost most of its leaves within a few weeks. When we contacted them, they assured us it was normal. Despite waiting for the tree to recover, it eventually died. We reached out again, but they failed to send someone to check on it. After multiple follow-ups, we received no response. We've decided to give up on getting the tree replaced and won't return to Whitfill. Buyer beware.

yelp:test:1493.para:
After driving past Joey's for years without ever entering, my girlfriend and I finally decided to check it out. We were genuinely surprised by what we found inside—it was almost empty, even though it was only 6:30 pm on a Wednesday. I didn't want to seem ungrateful, as the staff was very friendly, but the place felt eerie and outdated. The decor reminded me of my grandmother's living room, and half the restaurant was dark. yelp:test:1529.para: My dog, weighing 86 pounds and acting like a big chicken, is a rescue who remains anxious around strangers, vacuums, doorbells, and wood floors. When scared, she can be quite intimidating. Despite this, she still requires annual checkups and booster shots, and Lookout Mountain Animal Hospital is the lucky recipient of her care. The front desk staff was very accommodating, quickly bringing her into the exam room to avoid the waiting area filled with unfamiliar faces. My dog responded exceptionally well to their gentleness, behaving better than she has with any other stranger, even the mailman. I'm very satisfied with how they handled her. They also take care of my cat, who has always had positive experiences there, too. He's always well-behaved, just relieved to be out of the carrier.

yelp:test:1570.orig: Used to come to this library often while I was in school.  Haven't come here many times after 2007.  But still come here once or twice just to vote for City of Phoenix elections.  Very good location right by PV Mall and near SR-51 and Loop-101.  I believe the city cut the library hours, so this location doesn't even open on Fridays anymore.  But I would agreed on the good librarians working in the library.
yelp:test:1570.para: I used to visit this library frequently when I was studying, but haven't been here much since 2007. However, I still stop by occasionally to vote in City of Phoenix elections. It's conveniently located near PV Mall and close to SR-51 and Loop-101. I understand the city has reduced the library's hours, and it no longer opens on Fridays. Despite that, I think the librarians are very good.

yelp:test:1596.orig:
Perhaps certain places don't deserve the lowest rating because the person doing the reviewing is not a good fit for that particular kind of place, and so, cannot review it accurately. Because of this, I gave this place an extra star just in case I am biased against these types of places.

Now I will paint humanity with a wide brush and put us all into two camps: 

1) Those who would rather play with a dog outside on the lawn on a nice warm afternoon.

2) Those of us who would rather slip outside the backdoor of a rock club in Berlin to snort a quick line.

Let me just say that in my camp we have no use for, nor desire to ever return to, this Outback Steakhouse type of establishment.

What I truly think about this place is not suitable for public utterance, but I will go so far as to say the food was dull, the drinks were mixed as if they were for a teething child and not a grown man, and the atmosphere looked as if the decorator was commissioned from the school of bathroom design.

If you died and went to this place, you would not be in hell, but you would not be very happy.
yelp:test:1596.para:
Maybe some venues shouldn't receive the lowest rating if the reviewer isn't a good match for that type of place, leading to an inaccurate assessment. For this reason, I added an extra star in case my bias against such places is influencing my judgment.

Now, let's broadly categorize humanity into two groups:

1) Those who prefer to play with a dog in the grass on a sunny afternoon.
2) Those who prefer to sneak out the back door of a Berlin rock club to take a quick hit.

In my group, we have no interest in or desire to return to places like this Outback Steakhouse.

While I won't publicly express my true thoughts, I can say the food was bland, the drinks were mixed as if for a teething baby, and the ambiance seemed to come from a bathroom design school.

If you ended up there after death, you wouldn't be in hell, but you wouldn't be very content either.

yelp:test:1612.orig: I love this place, I come here allot all the food is amazing and well priced. Karaoke every night! and now comedy on Wednesday nights and I believe one other night and it is funny!!!\nService is good, most of the time and the people are all sorts from skaters to bikers to vocalists, if you wanna have a good time and not spend to much this is where you go!!!
yelp:test:1612.para: I adore this spot and frequently visit because the food is outstanding and reasonably priced. They have karaoke nightly, and there's comedy on Wednesdays and another night too—very entertaining! The service is generally good, and the crowd is diverse, ranging from skaters to bikers to vocalists. If you want to have a great time without spending too much, this is the place to go!

yelp:test:1624.orig: i really hate to do this, but i have to. service was slower than slow. my bagel + cream cheese was super skimpy on the cream cheese. turkey chili was lukewarm and not as good as it should have been. the staff seemed gloomy and sad. it just wasn't a good experience. it really is too bad, i haven't had lunch at a einstein's in forever and i was hoping it would be as good as i remember it.
yelp:test:1624.para: I genuinely don't want to say this, but I have to. The service was incredibly slow, and my bagel with cream cheese had very little cream cheese on it. The turkey chili was barely warm and didn't live up to expectations. The staff appeared to be in low spirits. Overall, it was a disappointing experience. It's a shame, as I haven't eaten at an Einstein's in a long time and was hoping it would be as enjoyable as I remembered.

yelp:test:1628.orig: The doctors and techs at this hospital bar none have been the most caring and compassionate vet I have ever experienced . My dog swallowed the end of a rawhide bone yesterday and I rushed her there hysterical of course. They gave her immediate attention and saved her life . That let me sit with her as she woke up from sedation and also stayed with us as she came to. Dr.Isom was right by our side and couldn't have been more comforting through my hysterical crying. After all was said and done I returned home so grateful with my girl Jazzy. Thank you Indian Bend
yelp:test:1628.para: The doctors and technicians at this hospital are undoubtedly the most caring and compassionate veterinarians I've ever encountered. When my dog swallowed the end of a rawhide bone yesterday, I rushed her there in a state of panic. They provided immediate care and saved her life. I was able to stay with her as she woke from sedation and they remained with us as she recovered. Dr. Isom was constantly by our side, offering immense comfort during my hysterical moments. In the end, I returned home with such gratitude for my beloved Jazzy. Thank you, Indian Bend.

yelp:test:1660.orig: Before I talk about the food I must say that this place is crazy expensive.  We tried this place because it was close and got tired of driving down to 7th Street for Pei Wei or Flamingo Palace. The pork fried rice was decent,  the house chicken was not at all good and the chicken lo mein was simply terrible  And for this less-than-mediocre food you pay more than Pei Wei and approaching P.F. Changs.  Next time I want typical chinese fair, I'll drive the extra few miles to Flamingo.
yelp:test:1660.para: This establishment is incredibly pricey, which is why I mention it upfront. We chose to visit because it was nearby and we were tired of the longer drive to 7th Street for Pei Wei or Flamingo Palace. The pork fried rice was acceptable, but the house chicken was quite poor, and the chicken lo mein was awful. Given the subpar quality of the food, the cost exceeds that of Pei Wei and is nearly on par with P.F. Changs. For my next Chinese meal, I'll opt to drive the additional distance to Flamingo.

yelp:test:1667.orig: Very unaccomodating and expensive!  If your kids cannot make it to camp one day of the week, they will not allow a makeup day and the price stays the same.  They charge a \""late fee\"" if you want to come the same day, and don't seem to care whether they turn away new clients or customers because they are more interested in money.  Gold Metal Gymnastics in Chandler, although a bit further, is a better option.  They are friendly, kind, and know that with children and our lives, things don't always work out exactly as we want.  Save your money and go to another camp that cares about families and kids, and not about nickel and diming you.
yelp:test:1667.para: Extremely inflexible and pricey! If your children miss a day of camp, there's no makeup day, and the full cost remains. They impose a "late fee" if you try to attend on the same day and appear more focused on profits than customer satisfaction. Gold Metal Gymnastics in Chandler is a superior choice; they are welcoming, considerate, and understand that life with kids often doesn't go as planned. Save your money and find a camp that genuinely cares about families and children, not just about charging extra fees.

yelp:test:1675.orig: I was using this cleaner for a few months, but not really sure why. The staff is rude and even worse, they jacked up my clothes. I asked for some repairs on two pairs of suit pants. Instead of fixing them, they sliced the butt of one of the pants and did not repair the other, while still charging me. Stupid me for not checking them before paying and going home. I don't trust them to fix it so I took them elsewhere. WILL NOT BE GOING BACK.
yelp:test:1675.para: For a couple of months, I used this cleaner without fully understanding the reason. The service staff was quite rude, and to make matters worse, they damaged my clothes. I requested repairs on two pairs of suit pants. Rather than fixing them, they cut the back of one pair and neglected the other, yet still billed me. I should have inspected them before paying and leaving. Since I don't trust their work, I took my clothes elsewhere. I definitely won't be returning.

yelp:test:1717.orig: This is one of the better International airports in America.  The baggage unloading can be a slow process at times, but security lines, especially in the Delta terminal, go by in a flash!  My flights have always left on time, and I really, really appreciate the free WiFi!\n\nPHX is great!
yelp:test:1717.para: This airport ranks among the top international ones in the U.S. While baggage handling can sometimes be slow, the security lines, particularly in the Delta terminal, are surprisingly quick! My flights have consistently departed on schedule, and I'm genuinely grateful for the complimentary WiFi. PHX is fantastic!

yelp:test:1726.orig: The airport is clean and looks like its been recently renovated. I'm not really fond that the rental car location is 10  minutes away though. Also, i dislike how you have to do a full body scan and get your fingers swiped for bomb stuff.. its like... really? out of all the airports ive been to, this is the only one that made me do it. lastly, the US airways employee at the airport booked me the wrong flight.!!! she gave me a ticket but when she put us in teh system, it was to a different place. we ended up staying in phoenix another night since there were no more flights back to so.cal.. NOT COOL! AND, they wouldnt even cover the cost of the hotel. They only offered a discount.. suppppppper lame!
yelp:test:1726.para: The airport is clean and recently renovated, but I'm not a fan that the rental car place is 10 minutes away. Additionally, the full body scan and fingerprinting for security checks feel excessive. It's unusual; I've never experienced this at other airports. Moreover, a US Airways employee booked me on the wrong flight. She issued a ticket, but when she entered the details, it was for a different destination. As a result, we had to stay an extra night in Phoenix because there were no flights back to Southern California. That's not acceptable! And to make matters worse, they wouldn't cover the hotel costs; they only offered a discount, which is really disappointing.

yelp:test:1729.orig: Very confusing airport.  For an International Airport, I would have expected a more luxury feel.  Definitely not the airport you would want to get stuck for hours in.  I flew southwest and Gate C and D did not have great restaurant choices or stores to look in.  You have to walk what feel likes miles to buy a water or grab a magazine, and food.
yelp:test:1729.para: This airport is quite perplexing. Given that it's an international hub, I was expecting a more upscale atmosphere. It's definitely not somewhere you'd want to be stranded for long periods. Southwest Airlines passengers noted that gates C and D lacked appealing dining and shopping options. The journey to find basic necessities like water, magazines, or food feels like a long trek.

yelp:test:1737.orig: Awful place to have a layover. This airport is always overcrowded, hence, there is little seating and you'll likely find yourself squished between two strangers until your flight. To avoid the crowd, I recommend grabbing a book and finding a restaurant with bar seating to enjoy some quiet and a few drinks before boarding.
yelp:test:1737.para: A terrible spot for a layover. This airport is perpetually jam-packed, leaving limited seating and often forcing you to squeeze between strangers until your next flight. To dodge the crowds, I suggest picking up a book and finding a restaurant with bar seating to relax and have a few drinks in peace before your departure.

yelp:test:1781.orig:
There were such mixed reviews that I had to find out for myself. I've been looking for a new neighborhood pizza joint and hoped that maybe this place could be it. no No NOOOO WAYYYYYY!!!
First: I ordered hot wings, all drummies and extra crispy. The rep said that I couldnt have my requested order because the wings come ""pre-made"", in ""oven-ready containers"". When someone orders wings, they take it out of the fridge and place the container in the oven to heat it up. Therefore, unable to take special requests.
The pizza arrived piping hot but I had asked for well done with the cheese brown and bubbly. The cheese was melted. I have to agree with the other reviews, there was an odd taste to the sauce and cheese. I'm from Wisconsin so I can taste real, quality cheese. This was very odd tasting ""cheese"". 
The wings were absolutely disgusting. Barely warm. I put them under the broiler after they were delivered and they still tasted rubbery. The skin was drenched in sauce but unable to get crispy, even after my broiler attempt. Very fatty.
On a positive  note, the delivery was quick. I wish they would have taken the extra time to at least make an effort to make the customer
yelp:test:1781.para:
I had to experience it firsthand due to the mixed feedback I encountered. I was searching for a new neighborhood pizzeria and thought this place might be the one. Unfortunately, it was far from satisfactory!

Firstly, when I ordered hot wings, the representative informed me that I couldn't have my specific request because the wings were "pre-made" and came in "oven-ready containers." Typically, wings are taken from the fridge and placed in the oven to heat up. So, my special request was impossible to fulfill.

The pizza arrived scalding hot, but I had asked for it well-done with the cheese brown and bubbly. Instead, the cheese was just melted. I concur with other reviews; there was an unusual taste to both the sauce and the cheese. Being from Wisconsin, I can discern real, quality cheese, and this tasted very peculiar.

The wings were horrendous. They were barely warm, and even after placing them under the broiler, they still tasted rubbery. The skin was drenched in sauce but couldn't achieve crispiness. They were also very fatty.

On the bright side, the delivery was prompt. I wish they had taken the time to at least make an effort for the customer.

yelp:test:1798.orig: This is my new place for sushi in the Valley.  Went for lunch on Tuesday and the place was busy but service was very prompt.  We ordered 3 different sushi rolls and a salad.  The portions were so large we took plenty home.  The ingredients were fresh and very flavorful.  Had the eel, spicy crab, and Mexican caliente rolls and all of them were absolutely DELISH!!!  If you're a sushi lover, you will not be disappointed!
yelp:test:1798.para: I've discovered a new sushi spot in the Valley, and I visited for lunch on Tuesday. Despite the place being quite busy, the service was remarkably quick. We tried three different sushi rolls and a salad. The portions were generous, allowing us to take a good amount home. The ingredients were fresh and incredibly flavorful. I had the eel, spicy crab, and Mexican caliente rolls, and each one was simply outstanding! If you're a sushi enthusiast, you won't be let down!

yelp:test:1870.orig: they make smaller tables wait longer to be sat and the food is not that great you can get better food at mid level steakhouse
yelp:test:1870.para: The smaller tables often have to wait longer for seating, and the food quality isn't great; you can find better food at a mid-range steakhouse.

yelp:test:1879.orig:
I am really impressed by this facility. Every machine you could want, Racquetball courts, The best spin bikes anywhere, large arobics room, free weights, TV's on the cardio some with ipod hookups, pool, spa and a steam room.

I also am unsure about the aroma of the free weight area in back, To me it smells like a barn, but I think it is due to the glue used on the floor. Either way I do hope it dissipates soon.

The spin bikes are great, very smooth, digital read outs and so far 100% functional.

A small grip with the TV's on the cardio equipment is the channel selection. News stations spo
yelp:test:1879.para:
I'm truly impressed with this facility. It offers everything you could need, including Racquetball courts, top-notch spin bikes, a spacious aerobics room, free weights, TVs on cardio machines with iPod connectivity, a pool, a spa, and a steam room.

While the staff might be less than competent, and the sales team could be a bit shady, I'm fortunate to have been grandfathered in from PureFiness, so I rarely interact with them.

The biggest drawback for me is the parking lot. It has an excessive number of speed bumps, more per 100 feet than I've encountered in a whole day. I'm unsure why they added so many; it prevents me from driving my convertible here.

I'm also concerned about the smell in the free weight area, which to me resembles a barn. I suspect it's due to the floor's adhesive. Hopefully, it improves soon.

The machines are excellent, with typically two to three of each type, including the latest Eclipse models, which are smooth and easy to adjust.

The spin bikes are fantastic, very smooth, with digital readouts, and they've been 100% functional so far.

The TV controls on the cardio equipment are a bit cumbersome, with only news channels available.

yelp:test:1897.orig: Saw Dr. Hetrick..I went to this office for Chronic headaches and neck pains. I felt like they did not care about my health condition and now I have Migraines. I told them I take medication that helps me a bit to get through the day but gets worse to the point where i'm out of it.What's their fix, a bag full of more medications (watch out liver) feels like they thought I was faking or something. Worst place to go really unhappy that I wasted my money and time
yelp:test:1897.para: I visited Dr. Hetrick for chronic headaches and neck pain. I felt they didn't genuinely concern themselves with my health issues, and now I'm experiencing migraines. I mentioned that I take medication to manage my symptoms, but it's becoming increasingly ineffective, leaving me feeling disoriented. Their solution seemed to be prescribing more pills, which worries me about potential liver damage. It felt like they doubted my condition. This office is really disappointing; I regret spending both my money and time there.

yelp:test:1938.orig: I bought the voucher not knowing when I would use it. Then a carwash broke my windshield wipers on my brand new Q7 and the voucher came in very handy! I saved $25! Thanks YELP and Audi!
yelp:test:1938.para: I purchased the voucher without knowing when I would need it, but then my new Q7's windshield wipers were damaged at a car wash, and the voucher turned out to be extremely useful. I managed to save $25! A big thank you to YELP and Audi!

yelp:test:1949.orig: Checked out this place from the groupon last night. Friday night at 750 most tables were full ONE server. ordered our food, the the wings that were small and undercooked with generic sauce. got some garlic bread that we did enjoy. we had our drinks and all 3 cups were empty with some ice and I put them at the end of the table hoping the ONE server would notice, we had to call her over for refills, she said for which ones...... (I should have said only the EMPTY ones) ALL of our dishes from the garlic bread and wings sat on the table the ENTIRE time. we ordered the White pizza and realized when we got it there was no ricotta on it. I didnt want to complain I was tired of this place. The table behind us never had their pizza put in and they sat after us, and barely got their pizza as we were talking out the door. OIL everywhere on the pizza. That should not happen with white pizza. Here is the kicker, from about 820pm (FRIDAY NIGHT) they turned away 3 groups of people because \""they had NOTHING left in the kitchen\"" Really? you put out a groupon not preparing for the influx of customers?!?!??! Those people will NEVER come back when a pizza place is OUT OF FOOD at 845. such an embar
yelp:test:1949.para: Last night, I used a Groupon to visit this place on a Friday night around 7:30 PM. The restaurant was quite busy, yet there was only one server. We ordered our food, including small, undercooked wings with a generic sauce. The garlic bread was the only thing we enjoyed. Our drinks arrived in three empty cups with just a bit of ice; I left them at the end of the table, hoping the single server would notice, but we had to call her for refills. She asked about specific cups, but I should have mentioned only the empty ones. Our dishes, including the garlic bread and wings, remained untouched on the table the entire time. We ordered a white pizza, but it lacked ricotta. I didn't complain, feeling tired of the place. The group behind us never received their pizza, even though they arrived after us. The white pizza was covered in oil, which is unacceptable. Around 8:20 PM, they turned away three groups because they claimed to have "nothing left in the kitchen." How could they not prepare for an influx of customers with a Groupon? This is a major issue. These customers won't return when a pizza place runs out of food at 9:45 PM on a Friday night. Such a poor experience is embarrassing.

yelp:test:1968.orig: Chips, bean dip, and salsa was ok. Green burrito, rice and beans were below average. There was no green chili flavor at all - basically it was a brownish, dull flavor. The meat chunks were tough and not fit to eat. The rice and beans tasted a few days old. Margarita was ok, not much alcohol though. I usually go to Rositas which is right across the street - their green burrito (try it smothered in green sauce and cheese) is 100 x's better than Serranos - in fact every thing is better at Rositas. I will head over to the chandler Serranos and try that next time - hopefully they don't bring their food in from the same place as this one.  Honestly I can't believe this place is still in business. Try Rositas instead for some excellent mexican food.
yelp:test:1968.para: The chips, bean dip, and salsa were decent, but the green burrito, rice, and beans were underwhelming. There was no discernible green chili flavor; it tasted bland and brownish. The meat was tough and inedible, and the rice and beans seemed stale. The margarita was acceptable, but it lacked alcohol. I typically visit Rositas, just across the street, where their green burrito, smothered in green sauce and cheese, is far superior to Serranos. Everything at Rositas is better. I'll try the Chandler Serranos next time, hoping they don't source their food from the same place. Honestly, I find it hard to believe this place is still open. Opt for Rositas for truly excellent Mexican food instead.

yelp:test:2000.orig: Wow this is a really nice place. I've never visited this cinema before, but I was surprised. The restrooms are clean and modern, the theatre is a great size and they have a great selection at the snack bar. I will go back to this theatre for sure.
yelp:test:2000.para: What a pleasant discovery! I hadn't been to this cinema earlier, yet I was impressed. The restrooms are spotlessly clean and up-to-date, the theatre is nicely sized, and the snack bar offers an excellent variety. I definitely plan to return.

yelp:test:2015.orig: I had been going to them for years, but stopped a few years back feeling they lacked the attention to detail they once had. This feeling was confirmed recently when issues started presenting themselves. I've discovered incorrect parts (wrong size fuel filter, etc.) were installed...and the freeze plug they left in my engine! A few years back I had them replace some freeze plugs that were leaking. Well, they didn't tell me one popped into my engine and they did not try to retrieve it! A month ago the plug worked its way into my pump. Engine smoked, seized, and shredded my s-belt. Luckily it happened on a side street where I could immediately pull over, turn off the car, and have AAA tow to their shop. AAA discovered the issue, pulled the mangled plug out of my pump. Repair job costing me a few hundred dollars. I say lucky, because it could have been far worse, like the car is on the highway moving to another state and/or I completely lose the engine. I would be leery of their work. Especially with a safety concern. The attention to detail they once had, is and has been gone for some time now. Your better off doing the work yourself or taking it to AAA. The local AAA shop on E. Valle
yelp:test:2015.para: For years, I relied on their services, but I stopped a few years ago due to a noticeable decline in their attention to detail. Recent issues confirmed my concerns. I found that incorrect parts, such as a fuel filter of the wrong size, were installed. Moreover, they left a freeze plug in my engine, which they had replaced a few years prior. They didn't inform me that a new plug was inserted into my engine and didn't attempt to remove it. A month ago, the plug moved into my fuel pump, causing the engine to smoke, seize, and damage my serpentine belt. Fortunately, it happened on a side street, allowing me to pull over and have AAA tow my car to their shop. AAA discovered the issue, extracted the damaged plug from the pump, and the repair cost several hundred dollars. I consider myself lucky, as it could have been much worse, potentially leading to a catastrophic failure on the highway. I would be wary of their work, especially considering the safety concern. Their attention to detail has been lacking for some time now. It’s better to do the work yourself or take your car to AAA. The local AAA shop on E. Valle is a safer bet.

yelp:test:2029.orig: Service was bad and food was subpar.
yelp:test:2029.para: The service was poor, and the food did not meet expectations.

yelp:test:2041.orig:
I liked this place... because it's a local owned place with delicious greasy food. This place was written up in the East Valley Trib in one of their ""5 to try"" pieces, which is where I first heard about it. But, I actually think it's funnier that I have been in ""Hall of Fame"", a store located direclty next door several times and never given Giant Hamburgers a second glance. 

You walk into this place, past a grouping of tables and booths (only about 15 tables in the entire place)  to the cash register where you order your meal. We each got a burger and fries and they were both great, a real gut-bomb, but sometimes you're in the mood for something that fits just that description. We sat and ate, and they came to bus our table for us. 

On the way out, we noticed the ""Yelp"" sticker on the door. Bonus points.
yelp:test:2041.para:
I enjoyed this local spot due to its yummy, greasy food. I learned about it from an "East Valley Trib" article that featured "5 Places to Try." Interestingly, I've visited "Hall of Fame," a store right next door, numerous times without ever stopping at Giant Hamburgers. 

Upon entering, you pass by around 15 tables and booths to reach the cash register where you place your order. We each ordered a burger and fries, both of which were fantastic—truly a satisfying meal. We ate at a table, and they even came to clear our dishes for us. 

As we left, we spotted the "Yelp" sticker on the door, which was an extra positive touch.

yelp:test:2057.orig:
I was there this weekend, both Saturday and Sunday for a Youth Tournament for my son. Our ""home bowling alley"" is the Brunswick Zone on Southern and Dobson. This was my first time to this particular alley. This was the worst bowling alley I have ever been to in my entire 31 years of living. 

The location is hidden back behind some office buildings. The building is plain, late 60's decor. The interior, from what I was told, had not been updated in over a decade at least. The newest renovation was a strip of fluorescent carpeting and some fluorescent paint on the walls. (for neon bowling I presume) 

There is no real seating for the bowlers. There are tables and chairs randomly placed through out the building. Each table only gets 4 chairs, so if someone else steals a chair or you have more than 4 bowlers, someone is going to have to stand.  On a rack, in the corner, in the back, there are about 20 alley owned balls, so good luck getting one in the right weight. The bathrooms are tiny and dilapidated.  Whole chunks missing out of several spots in the tile. The handicapped stall has a baby changing station that does not fold up. It stays wide open, so you can't even get in th
yelp:test:2057.para:
This past weekend, I attended a Youth Tournament for my son at our local Brunswick Zone on Southern and Dobson. It was my first visit to this particular alley, and I found it to be the worst bowling alley I've ever experienced in my 31 years of living.

The place is tucked away behind some office buildings, and the building itself is unremarkable, with decor from the late 1960s. According to what I was told, the interior hasn't been updated in over a decade, with the most recent renovation being a strip of fluorescent carpet and some fluorescent paint on the walls, presumably for a neon theme.

There's a lack of proper seating for the bowlers; tables and chairs are scattered throughout the building, with each table only offering four chairs. If you have more than four bowlers, someone will have to stand. In a corner, there are about 20 alley-owned balls, but finding one in the right weight is challenging. The bathrooms are small and in poor condition, with missing chunks of tile in several spots. The handicapped stall has a baby changing station that doesn't fold up, leaving it permanently open and unusable.

yelp:test:2059.orig: Oh my gosh:(  This morning I didn't get a breakfast so stopped at this BK for breakfast sandwich and coffee.  I told her no cheese on my sandwich.  She asked me again to confirm no cheese which I said \""yes, no cheese please\"".  She said \""okay no cheese\"".  No cheese was said by her twice and by me twice.  So guess what I got??? Huge cheese all over my sandwich.  I love cheese but this morning I didn't want any.  So I had to take off the top and the ham which was drowning in cheese.  Had half of a sandwich with just egg and bottom biscuit.  Today my morning started off sucky!  Thanks BK in 2024 E Southern Ave, Mesa.  Last time going to this location.  I can't imagine how horrible they would be if they were busy.  This morning at 9:50am the place was semi empty.
yelp:test:2059.para: Oh my gosh! This morning, I didn't have breakfast and stopped by BK for a sandwich and coffee. I asked for no cheese, and she confirmed it twice. I also confirmed it twice. But when I got my sandwich, it was loaded with cheese. I love cheese, but I specifically asked for none. So, I had to remove the top and the ham, which were covered in cheese. I ended up eating just half of the sandwich, with only the egg and the bottom biscuit. Today, my morning started off really poorly! Thanks, BK at 2024 E Southern Ave in Mesa; I won't be returning anytime soon. If they were busy, I can only imagine how bad it would be. At 9:50 am, the place was only moderately busy.

yelp:test:2072.orig: Ordered empanadas to go. Three orders and $28 later...I cut them open and 75 to 80% of them were EMPTY!  (They werent great either) I called the manager and she indicated this is a known issue as they are made fresh onsite. Ok benefit of the doubt. yelp:test:2072.para: Placed an order for empanadas to pick up. After spending $28 on three orders, I found that 75 to 80% of them were empty. (They weren't even particularly good.) I contacted the manager, who said this is a known issue since the empanadas are made fresh on-site. She offered to send me some coupons, but that hasn't happened yet. I might have to contact American Express about this.

yelp:test:2078.orig: Having lived in Hawaii for over 5 years, I constantly have a craving for Hawaiian food. Moki's reminds me of little local restaurants in Hawaii. When I walk in I feel like I'm back in the islands. The atmosphere is very local style and the people are totally laid back. The decor has a do-it-yourself feel that IS local kine. \n\nI've tried every Hawaiian restaurant in the Valley and this is by far my favorite. I go back often and highly recommend Moki's to anyone looking for some great Hawaiian eats!
yelp:test:2078.para:
After residing in Hawaii for more than five years, I frequently crave Hawaiian cuisine. Moki's evokes the ambiance of small, local eateries in Hawaii. As soon as I step inside, I feel transported back to the islands. The atmosphere is authentically local, and the staff are incredibly relaxed. The decor exudes a homemade, locally inspired vibe.

Among all the Hawaiian restaurants in Valley, Moki's stands out as my absolute favorite. I visit frequently and strongly recommend Moki's to anyone seeking delicious Hawaiian food!

yelp:test:2092.orig: First off its a buffet , not a gourmet one you see at a high class vegas hotel or anything.. We moved here 8 mos ago from out of state and have been to another location but this particular location has been a great one! We usually go on Thurs nights because kids are only $1 to eat. Cant beat that! The food has been delicious both visits. The steak is Ranchers Reserve Sirloin and is always tasty and tender. The  hand carved roast beef is a perfect Med rare and is tasty and super tender as well. The servers stay busy so may not get plates off table super fast but its not that big of a deal.. We overall really are impressed with this location! They even have unlimited milk refills and and icee machine too with unlimited refills!!!!
yelp:test:2092.para: When we moved here 8 months ago from another state, we visited a different location first, but this particular spot has been fantastic! We typically go on Thursday nights when kids eat for just $1, which is unbeatable! The food has been delightful on both visits. The steak is Ranchers Reserve Sirloin and is consistently delicious and tender. The hand-carved roast beef is perfectly medium-rare, also very tasty and super tender. yelp:test:2275.para:
Jesse J. mentioned that we visited this place last night for sushi after checking it out on Yelp, and it was definitely worth it. So far, this might be the best sushi I've had in Arizona.

My favorite roll was the big and spicy, with its fantastic flavor from the seared salmon and yellowtail, topped with pickled jalapeño. The sauce was outstanding, enhancing the taste without needing soy sauce.

I also ordered spicy tuna, asking for it to be spicier, and the chef accommodated me. It was a fiery roll, but the spiciness didn't overpower the tuna. It left a bit of a burn, but it was amazing.

The rest of the meal was just as good, particularly the tsunami roll, which is like a Vegas roll without cream cheese (I don't enjoy cream cheese in sushi). It had a special sauce that was a perfect blend of heat and sweetness, providing a kick that was quickly balanced. Even those who don't like spicy food would enjoy this.

The only issues were that I never received the water I ordered, and some of the miso soup was cold, possibly due to the tofu not being warm enough. However, I plan to return soon and give it another try.

yelp:test:2320.para:
Not a great day, to be honest. I've enjoyed better meals at other Red Lobster places. The highlight of tonight was the waiter, Bryan—fast, efficient, polite, and funny, just what I appreciate. We ordered a Lobsterita (a large margarita) and shared it, but I ended up regretting it because it was overly sour and had a chemical taste. I only managed to drink two sips before switching to water, which tasted much better. The salads featured wilted lettuce and sad-looking tomatoes, while the croutons were acceptable. The hot bread, as usual, was good. The main course, a medium-rare steak and grilled shrimp, arrived on time. The steak was chewy, though the marinade was decent. The shrimp were well-grilled, not overdone or underdone. My wife's shrimp scampi was a letdown; the shrimp were overcooked and tasteless, swimming in some kind of shrimp juice with minimal butter and no garlic. Quite disappointing.

Given this experience, I believe this will be our last visit to this location. As I mentioned earlier, I've had better meals there, and the quality doesn't justify the price when we're not satisfied. Too bad...

yelp:test:2680.orig:
I've been here a few times. A couple of times with the husband to enjoy a Groupon and a special menu option. And twice for ladies night with the co-workers since they do a special ladies night menu the first Tuesday of every month - which has a good price for all you get!

We almost always call ahead and make reservations - on ladies night, a reservation is a MUST since it fills up quickly.  The staff is always really friendly and they are more than happy to walk you through the process if you are new here.  The drinks are strong and the food comes in stages so you can really make this an great date night.  

I'd be torn to choose between the cheese appetizer and the chocolate dessert for my favorite part of the meal, but since I'm more of a sweet than salty fan, I'll go with the dessert.  They always have special check-in offers and from time to time they offer Groupons, as well.  If you sign up online for their mailing list, you'll get some decent offers there, too!

Overall: A
A great spot for a date night experience, ladies night out, or special dinner for a loved one! Be sure to seek out specials since it can get a touch pricey.
yelp:test:2680.para:
I've visited a few times, including a couple of occasions with my husband using Groupons and a special menu. I've also gone twice for ladies night with coworkers, as they offer a special menu on the first Tuesday of each month at a great price.

We almost always reserve a table in advance, especially for ladies night, as it tends to fill up quickly. The staff is always very friendly and willing to guide new customers through the process. The drinks are strong, and the food is served in stages, making it ideal for a romantic date night.

Between the cheese appetizer and the chocolate dessert, I'm torn, but as a sweet tooth, I'd pick the dessert. They frequently have special offers and sometimes Groupons. Signing up for their mailing list can also get you some good deals.

Overall, it's an excellent spot for a date night, ladies night, or a special dinner for someone you care about. Just be aware that it can be a bit pricey, so look for special deals.

yelp:test:2913.orig:
My husband and I ate at the Siamese Cat for the first time last night. I am very disappointed in all the dishes we ordered.

When trying a new Thai restaurant for the first time, my husband I always get our favorite dishes. We ordered Laab Gai, chicken satay, phad kee Mao (drunken noodles) and phad bai kra prao. It's a lot of food but like most Asians, we like variety in our meal. 

The satay came out first and it was ok. Nothing memorable- you could taste a hint of the curry power but not much. The peanut sauce was super oily. 

Next was the Laab - I had high hopes for this because it usually is always good everywhere I go but this dish was much too salty.

The noodle dish was the worst dish. The noodles were really hard.  I could tell they did not warm up the noodles enough before cooking it. Also, there was no flavor to this dish at all. A big disappointment as phad kee Mao is always flavorful with the sauce and basil. 

Lastly the stirfry tasted nothing like what it should have tasted like. It was a typical stir fry and it was quite dry. 

Overall we phad 33 for everything so the food was cheap. The service is better than most Asian restaurants so we tipped our wait
yelp:test:2913.para:
Last night, my husband and I dined at the Siamese Cat for the first time, and I was quite let down by the dishes we ordered.

Typically, when we try a new Thai restaurant, we opt for our favorite items. We chose Laab Gai, chicken satay, phad kee Mao (drunken noodles), and phad bai kra prao. We ordered a substantial amount of food, reflecting our preference for variety in our meals.

The chicken satay arrived first and was merely satisfactory; it had a slight curry flavor but not much. The peanut sauce was excessively oily.

The Laab followed, and I had high expectations since it's usually delicious. However, this time it was overly salty.

The noodle dish was the most disappointing. The noodles were extremely hard, and it seemed they didn't properly warm them before cooking. There was no flavor at all, which is contrary to the usual rich taste of phad kee Mao with its sauce and basil.

The stirfry was also unremarkable, tasting dry and not like it should.

In total, we spent $33, making the food quite affordable. The service was better than most Asian restaurants, so we tipped our waiter accordingly.

yelp:test:2914.orig: helpful funny and nice staff. always try to get your the best deal weather it's a coupon from the paper or your insurance they want to get your the glasses you want for a good price. doctors are informative during procedure and always keep appointments.
yelp:test:2914.para: The staff is friendly, humorous, and kind, always striving to secure the best deal for you, whether it's through a newspaper coupon or your insurance. yelp:test:2919.orig: When I was the young age of 3, my mom brought me to YC's. I have been going ever since. yelp:test:2919.para: At the tender age of 3, my mother took me to YC's, and I've been a regular ever since. This place stands out from typical sit-down restaurants with their fixed menus. Instead, you can customize your own Mongolian stir-fry from a vast buffet of raw ingredients. You have a wide choice of meats, vegetables, toppings, and noodles to mix and match. Once you've assembled your dish, a "grill warrior" brings it to life on the large grills, ensuring it's perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. The result is always delicious and tailored to your preferences, which keeps me coming back. YC's also offers crispy wontons, rice, and chopsticks to complete your meal. The place is always clean, the staff is welcoming, and it's very affordable. I highly recommend everyone to "mo" (enjoy) it!

yelp:test:3000.orig:
There are several shared characteristics of a good dive bar:
1. Cash only for cheap, stiff drinks.
2. Pool tables (or alternately, shuffle board. darts must be combined with some other lure in order to count.)
3. Jukebox (classic rock required, the top 40 laughed out of the place.)
4. An air of disrepair (rips in the booth upholstery, musty smell of smoke on the air- because despite the ban, it's already been cured into the wood.)

This place has all those things in spades.

I hardly ever end up at the Time Out Lounge because I never carry cash, but the drinks are deliciously strong and don't strip your wallet of its greenery too quick. There's an ATM there too. The pitchers and half pitchers are also pretty cheap, but if you're drinking by yourself, you're required to get the half pitcher. Apparently they can't serve you a drink the size of your head in one sitting. What wacky laws.

There are several pool tables that take up the majority of the space, but if you're going during the rush, good luck securing one of them. I'm not that great at pool, but I really enjoy playing at this place (usually with a good partner I can coast off of and then gloat with after we win) be
yelp:test:3000.para:
A good dive bar typically shares these traits:
1. Drinks are paid for in cash only, and they're cheap but potent.
2. Pool tables are a must, or at the very least, shuffleboard and darts, but they need to be accompanied by another attraction.
3. A jukebox is essential, with a preference for classic rock; anything from the top 40 is unwelcome.
4. The place exudes a sense of neglect, with torn booth upholstery and a lingering smell of smoke, even though smoking is banned.

The Time Out Lounge embodies all these features in abundance.

I rarely visit the Time Out Lounge because I don't usually carry cash, but their drinks are surprisingly strong and don't empty my wallet too quickly. They have an ATM on-site. The pitchers and half pitchers are reasonably priced, but if you're drinking solo, you must order a half pitcher. It's a quirky rule, really. 

There are numerous pool tables occupying most of the space, but securing one during peak hours is challenging. While I'm not a skilled pool player, I enjoy playing here, often with a partner to rely on and gloat with after a win.

yelp:test:3215.orig:
We went out with the Central AZ Jeepers the other night to do a night run of the Maggie Mine Trail.  The plan was to start up at Bumble Bee, come south to Black Canyon City, then finish at Rock Springs Cafe for dinner and pie.

yelp:test:3215.para:
Last night, we joined Central AZ Jeepers for a night drive on the Maggie Mine Trail. Our plan was to start at Bumble Bee, head south to Black Canyon City, and end our adventure at Rock Springs Cafe for dinner and dessert.

Firstly, I must note that there were more than 20 Jeeps in our group, and the trail was clearly visible from the road. We must have looked quite impressive, winding our way through the mountains with our headlights lighting up the night. If anyone captured video...

I was excited about visiting Rock Springs Cafe. We had passed it many times but never stopped, so this was our chance. Cheri, our organizer, had arranged for the cafe to be prepared for our large group, ensuring we had seating when we arrived. However, parking was an issue; they were hosting a party at an outdoor venue nearby, which looked lively with good music.

DS and DSGF chose to stay in the parking lot to enjoy the music, which meant we couldn't have a leisurely meal followed by dessert. So, I couldn't comment on the food. But DH and I went inside to try some of the offerings.

yelp:test:3246.orig:
This ""restaurant"" is, quite possibly, the worst place I have ever eaten - and I've traveled through Arkansas, so that's saying something.  

The waitress was only mildly interested in being there, and our dining experience only went downhill from there.  The food was among the most mediocre I have ever eaten.  The BBQ sliders (dry pork with a drop or two of sauce and some cole slaw) I got for an appetizer were barely appetizing.  My entree was an 8-oz sirloin (because, at 6:00 on a Tuesday, they were out of the only other cut of steak on the menu), which was completely without flavor.  Ordered with grilled onions, it arrived with mushrooms on it, and when I sent it back for grilled onions, it came out covered in raw onions that had been dropped on the grill for less than 10 seconds.  The accompanying beer-battered onion rings were uninspiring, as were the steak fries. 

And the atmosphere - it is very hard to describe.  The decor is ambitious and has some potential - but it needs people to liven it up.  It won't, however, get people with the lackluster food and service.  Generally, the place seemed like an old adult book store where someone decided to serve food.
yelp:test:3246.para:
This establishment, likely the worst dining spot I've encountered in Arkansas, where I've traveled extensively, is a significant disappointment. The waitress seemed disinterested, and our meal only deteriorated from there. The food was among the least appealing I've tasted. The BBQ sliders, featuring dry pork with a minimal amount of sauce and coleslaw, barely met appetizer standards. My main course, an 8-oz sirloin (since they were out of the other steak option at 6:00 on a Tuesday), lacked any flavor. It was served with mushrooms instead of grilled onions, and when I requested grilled onions, they arrived covered in raw onions that had been briefly grilled. The beer-battered onion rings and steak fries were also underwhelming.

The ambiance is challenging to characterize. While the decor is ambitious and has potential, it needs more energy to engage customers. Unfortunately, the subpar food and service won't attract patrons. Overall, the place feels like an old adult bookstore repurposed for dining.

yelp:test:3278.para:
My husband and I were running around doing errands when we got really hungry. I had been craving Italian subs, thanks to Jersey Mikes, so we decided to head to the street nearby. I recalled a good experience from about six years ago when a friend recommended an Italian sub from a location in that same shopping center. yelp:test:3311.para:
I haven't visited Sweet Tomatoes before today, but I frequently go to Souper Salad and expected Sweet Tomatoes to be superior. 

Let's start with the positives.

Alright, now for the mediocre. I tried the chocolate bread muffin, which was enjoyable and chocolatey, though quite dark and not particularly sweet. As such, it didn't quite fit the dessert category and didn't pair well with other items.

Next, I sampled the chocolate bread pudding. It was really good, but it was almost finished, so I only got the edges. I didn't get much of the gooey, chocolaty texture I was hoping for. If I had arrived a few minutes earlier, this dessert would have been in the good category.

Now, the negatives. Starting from the beginning, the raw beets were not good at all. My first bite was mostly dry and stale. The light ranch dressing tasted like it was about to go bad, and the regular ranch was watered down. They were out of Coke, Dr. Pepper, and Rootbeer, and the only ice was at the cashiers' station, not in the soda fountain. yelp:test:3343.para:
