I took the food home, and guess what? There was hair in the orange chicken—long, black strands, possibly more than two. I had to throw it all away. Ugh, I'm so disappointed.

yelp:test:3691.orig: It was only after we were seated that they let us know no pizza was available due to an issue with the oven.  Didn't go over well with three kids in group.   Waiter dumped a heap of cheese on a dish instead of slowly shredding it.  Service was well intended, but not very good.  It's sad to see this chain slipping into oblivion.   This location is no exception.
yelp:test:3691.para: When we were seated, we were informed that pizza was unavailable because of an oven problem, which didn't sit well with the three kids in our group. The waiter piled cheese onto a plate rather than spreading it gently. While the service was meant well, it wasn't particularly good. It's disappointing to see this chain declining, and this location is a clear example of that.

yelp:test:3703.orig: When it comes to Pho in Vegas...look no further. You will not find any better Pho even on the strip.
yelp:test:3703.para: For Pho in Vegas, you won't find anything superior, even among the restaurants on the strip.

yelp:test:3736.orig: Doors locked, no furniture inside.  Apparently out of business.
yelp:test:3736.para: The doors are secured, and there's no furniture inside, suggesting the place has closed down.

yelp:test:3769.orig: The hotel isn't bad considering it's catering to the more mature audience.  The only thing that somewhat upsets me is that the price of the rooms are misleading.  You better read the fine print when reserving a room here because they might not inform you about the $14.95 per night surcharge.  Me and my friends wanted to find a fairly inexpensive hotel and when we booked online on expedia, the rooms were only $42/night.  But when we got there, we were informed of the ridiculous surcharge.  I can understand if it was something like $5.00 or something but $14.95?? If it was still summer time when we can at least use their ugly pool, i can also at least understand that.  I mean, even the GOLD COAST which is much more decent than Palace Station has a surcharge of only $3.00!  Okay, live and learn i guess.  Well, at least whoever is reading this could use the heads up, right? :)
yelp:test:3769.para: The hotel is decent for its target older clientele, but I'm a bit frustrated with the pricing. There's a hidden $14.95 per night fee that isn't clearly mentioned, which was a surprise when we checked in. Initially, we found the rooms on Expedia for $42/night, but the extra charge made it seem more expensive. I get that some additional costs are expected, but $14.95 seems excessive. If it were still warm enough to use their pool, I might be more forgiving, but even the more upscale Gold Coast only has a $3.00 surcharge. Well, at least this warning might help others avoid the same surprise. :))

yelp:test:3781.orig:
Good service and great food. We drank and ate a TON of food and our bill was $60. Things we ate that we would order again.

The Ramen with the pork kakuni
Monk fish pate with cucumbers and seaweed.
Beef Tataki
KIMCHI & PORK STIR FRY WAS THE BOMB!
The charashi roll-- I freakin loved the shiso in this roll!!

--------------------------------------------------
Since I wrote this review, I've been back 3 more times and I have down graded my 5 star review to a 4 star because of the service. This place is still da bomb but the service here is spotty. Drink your beer and order two more because they ain't comin' back to check. You want more sake? Good luck. Come here with patience and a flask.
yelp:test:3781.para:
Excellent service and delicious food. We consumed a lot of food and our bill was $60. Here are some dishes we enjoyed and would order again:

- Ramen with pork kakuni
- Monkfish pate with cucumbers and seaweed
- Beef tataki
- Kimchi and pork stir-fry, which was fantastic
- Charashi roll, especially the shiso in this roll

Since writing this, I've returned three more times and adjusted my 5-star review to 4 stars due to inconsistent service. The food is still outstanding, but the service can be hit or miss. Don't expect staff to refill your drinks; you might need to bring your own. Patience and a personal refill supply are recommended.

yelp:test:3797.orig: Friendly staff and quick service for auto tinting, but wow quality was so bad. Film was wrinkled in a couple spots, bubbles galore, and don't expect them to tint to the window edge. I swear there is a 1/8\"" and close 3/16\"" on some edges. Of course, I didn't discover the edge issue for 4 days after the job was done (due to instruction not to open the windows until after a week).  Well, for $150, what can you expect?  On the other hand, I've seen $150 jobs that were flawless.  It's probably just an inexperienced tinter.  So, if you want your \""baby\"" tinted, I'd take it elsewhere.
yelp:test:3797.para: The staff was friendly and the service was prompt for the auto tinting, but the quality was disappointing. The film had wrinkles in a few areas, and there were numerous bubbles. They didn't even try to tint the windows all the way to the edges. I noticed that some edges were about 1/8" and 3/16" away from being fully tinted only after four days, as per their instructions to keep the windows closed for a week. Given the $150 price, you might not get what you expect. I've seen $150 jobs that were perfect. This might just be due to an inexperience in tinting. Therefore, if you want a professional job, I recommend taking your car to another shop.

yelp:test:3798.orig:
Please be warned! Do not patronize Home Fabrics online!!! They are not trustworthy.

I placed a large order online, received a confirmation the same day, and then the following day received a second confirmation that my order was being processed, would ship in 3-5 days and be received in 7-12 days. 

After receiving the confirmation, I ordered multiple custom items to coordinate with the purchased fabric. Imagine my surprise when I received a call a full 7 days later stating that they didn't have the fabric I ordered, hadn't had it for a long time, and weren't going to get any more of it. 

The customer service person I spoke to first accused me of yelling (I wasn't, she was), then of being disrespectful (well, ya, you got me there) and hung up on me. I called back and spoke to her again. When she asked me if I would like a refund, I started laughing and said, ""Ya think?"" Well, she then yelled at me some more about disrespecting her and hung up a second time. I mean, really, they weren't sure if they could keep my money or if I wanted it back since I got a big fat nothing-burger from them? We'll see if I ever get my money back.

I've shopped Home Fabrics stores for year
yelp:test:3798.para:
Caution! Avoid Home Fabrics online at all costs—they are unreliable.

I placed a substantial order online and received confirmations on the same day, followed by another confirmation that my order was being processed and would ship in 3-5 days, with delivery expected in 7-12 days. 

After receiving these confirmations, I ordered several custom items to match the fabric I had purchased. Seven days later, I was shocked to be informed that they no longer had the fabric I ordered and wouldn't be getting any more. 

The customer service representative I spoke to initially accused me of yelling (I wasn't, she was), then of being disrespectful (I had to admit, she had a point), and hung up on me. I called back and spoke to her again. When she offered a refund, I laughed and said, "You think?" She then berated me for disrespecting her and hung up again. It's clear they're unsure if they can keep my money or if I want a refund since they provided nothing. I doubt I'll ever see my money again.

I've been a customer of Home Fabrics stores for years.

yelp:test:3809.orig:
We went here over Memorial weekend for brunch after church. We wanted to go to Harbor Palace, because that's where we usually go...but it had a long wait. Sam Woo was our second stop. It was pretty crowded, as expected. When we walked in the hostess station was empty, so we made our way to the cashier and asked to be put on the waiting list. She rudely told us to go back to the hostess station and wait for her there. We were given a ticket with the number 1 on it, so I was pretty hopeful. After about 20 minutes of waiting, we noticed that people that arrived after us were being seated. We got even more suspicious when the hostess asked us again how many were in our party & gave us a ticket with the number 8 on it. Things were obviously very disorganized.

My mom then caught the hostess' attention and asked her exactly how their seating was conducted, because we had been waiting awhile, parties were being seated before us that arrived after, and she wasn't calling any numbers. Her reply was, and I kid you not ""You know, don't worry about it. They have the bigger party and their table became available first. You just have to wait for a smaller table, so don't worry about it.""
yelp:test:3809.para:
We visited Sam Woo for brunch over Memorial Day weekend after church. We intended to go to Harbor Palace, our usual spot, but it had a long wait. So, we went to Sam Woo instead, which was quite busy as anticipated. Upon entering, the hostess was not there, so we approached the cashier to be put on the waiting list. She instructed us to go back to the hostess station, which we did, and we received a ticket numbered 1, giving us hope. After about 20 minutes, we noticed that parties arriving after us were being seated. This, combined with the hostess asking us again for the number of people in our party and giving us a ticket numbered 8, made us suspicious of the seating system. It seemed very disorganized.

My mom then drew the hostess's attention and asked how the seating was managed, given our long wait and the fact that parties arriving later were being seated before us. The hostess responded, "You know, don't worry about it. They have the bigger party and their table became available first. You just have to wait for a smaller table, so don't worry about it."

yelp:test:3846.orig:
Review about this place were right, BIG portions! Off the strip but only about 10 minutes away from the end of the strip. We ordered the Corned Beef Hash breakfast, a pancake, and an omelette
The Corned Beef Hash came with potato crisps, very flavorful and tasted just baked, not soggy at all.
I ordered the banana bread instead of toast, was pretty tasty! The servers were nice and attentive, only when we paid was there a wait, but no biggie to me.
Overall, food was good and the price just as good.
yelp:test:3846.para:
The reviews for this place are accurate—huge portions! It's a bit off the strip, but it's just about a 10-minute drive from the end of the strip. We had the Corned Beef Hash breakfast, a pancake, and an omelette.

The Corned Beef Hash was served with crispy potato chips and was incredibly flavorful, not at all soggy. I opted for banana bread instead of toast, and it was quite delicious!

The staff were very friendly and attentive, with the only slight delay being the wait to pay, but that wasn't a big issue for me. Overall, the food was excellent, and the prices were very reasonable.

yelp:test:3849.orig: I ordered the lox omelet which was delicious the only downfall was how massive my plate was that I couldn't come close to finishing it. The potato spuds were amazing and the pumpkin bread to die for\nMy mom had the Greek omelet and she said it was really great
yelp:test:3849.para: I enjoyed the lox omelet, which was fantastic, though I couldn't finish my huge plate. The potato spuds were outstanding, and the pumpkin bread was simply delightful. My mom tried the Greek omelet and reported that it was really great.

yelp:test:3884.orig: Miserable staff that works there. No thank yous for shopping at the store. Will never be back.
yelp:test:3884.para: The employees there are clearly unhappy, and there are no expressions of gratitude for customers. I won't be returning to this store.

yelp:test:3909.orig: What a great place.  Everyone was friendly.  The food was delicious.  Dinner for five and a child with drinks about $275.  The chef put on quite a show for us.
yelp:test:3909.para: What a wonderful spot! Everyone there was exceptionally friendly, and the food was absolutely delicious. For a group of five adults and a child, including drinks, dinner cost around $275. The chef even entertained us with a fantastic demonstration in the kitchen.

yelp:test:3918.orig: I do not recommend this place! I purchased groupon for the gel manicure and pedicure. I was defintely not satisfied. It was not worth the drive. In plus, they charged an extra five dollars for shellac, opi and other high quality nail polishes. That's ridiculous. On top of that, the pedicure sucks!
yelp:test:3918.para: I wouldn't recommend this place at all. I bought a Groupon for a gel manicure and pedicure, but I was definitely not pleased. The trip wasn't worth it. Moreover, they charged an extra five dollars for shellac, OPI, and other premium nail polishes, which I found unreasonable. To make matters worse, the pedicure was terrible.

yelp:test:3935.orig: If you go to a Chinese restaurant to eat make sure you see at least 10 Chinese people eating not standing around watching TV.  If you don't see them run. One of Funniest things I ever heard in my life the owner or maybe not was talking to a couple next to our table saying I require my staff to speak English. Really?  I asked for a jack and coke what came to the table was regular coke. I asked the server what's up? He said we don't have that. I said take the coke away he gave to the couple sitting next to us.  Joyful house! Our shrimp in lobster sauce came out with canned mushrooms strange.  My wife Asian was laughing. She said check out your fork I think they used that one to fix the drain in the kitchen seems the forks and spoons have been there sense 1980's it wouldn't be so bad if the food was really fantastic. Costco has GREAT deals on quality table wear on MLK (TIP OF THE DAY) I asked the server what is in the dumplings he said chicken. I asked if they had shrimp of pork dumpling he said you can go up the street if you want that. OMG! I said we will try the dumplings how many do you get ?  He said 5 - I said r u sure the menu says 6. He said 5 only. Ok served 6.  Keep in mind
yelp:test:3935.para: When you visit a Chinese restaurant, ensure you spot at least 10 Chinese diners, not just staff watching TV. If you don't, leave. I once heard the owner, or perhaps not, tell a couple at a nearby table that he demands his staff speak English. When I inquired about a Jack and Coke, they served regular Coke instead. When I asked the server, he said they didn't have it, but gave it to the couple next to us. The place was a joke! Our shrimp in lobster sauce came with canned mushrooms, which was odd. My wife, who is Asian, found it amusing and noted that the fork looked like it had been used to fix a kitchen drain, suggesting the cutlery hadn't been changed since the 1980s. The food wasn't that great, so the quality of the tableware from Costco would have been a better choice. I asked about the fillings in the dumplings, and he said chicken. When I inquired about shrimp or pork dumplings, he suggested going down the street. Wow! He said we'd get five dumplings, but the menu said six. He insisted on five. They served six, though.

yelp:test:3938.orig:
I only like one drink here, but it's enough for me to come in occasionally.  I love their green milk tea, other than that I am not a fan of the drinks here.  The fruit drinks aren't made of real fruits and sometimes they taste powdery.

As for the food, there is only 2 things I like.  The taiwanese sausage ( I don't know where else to get this in Vegas) and the spiced pork chop plate is a pretty good price for lunch.

I don't like going at night though because that's when all the young teenagers come out...and I hate the smokers too.  I wish lung cancer on all of them.  :oP
yelp:test:3938.para:
I enjoy just one drink here, which is sufficient for me to visit occasionally. I absolutely adore their green milk tea, but I don't particularly like the other drinks. The fruit drinks aren't made from real fruits and sometimes they taste powdery.

Regarding the food, I only really like two items. The Taiwanese sausage is hard to find elsewhere in Vegas, and the spiced pork chop plate is a good deal for lunch.

I avoid visiting at night because that's when lots of young people come, and I really dislike smokers. I sincerely hope they all get lung cancer. :oP

yelp:test:3969.orig:
Four on a good day, three on others.

It's a really nice custard, where it goes down to a three is day and time of day you show up.

This last visit, I was first in line when it opened, so, full selection of flavors for the day. And had flavors that were not vanilla or chocolate. The other flavors were very good. 

As others said, if stuck with vanilla, meh. Wrong day and or late in the day, the flavors they have left might not be inspiring.

So get there early in the day, and don't add extra stuff to it: order a plain cone or cup, and you should be happy.
yelp:test:3969.para:
On a good day, there are four options, but on other days, it's reduced to three.

The custard is quite delightful, but the availability of flavors can vary depending on the time of day you visit. During my last visit, I was the first in line when the place opened, so I had access to all the flavors of the day, including those beyond vanilla and chocolate. These other flavors were quite good.

As others have noted, if you're limited to vanilla, it might not be as enjoyable. If you visit later in the day or on a less favorable day, the remaining flavors might not be as appealing. 

So, to ensure a better experience, try to get there early in the day and keep it simple: order a plain cone or cup, and you should be satisfied.

yelp:test:4020.orig: Congratulations to the Democratic party for being so divided that they can't even agree on a candidate to be considered for the general election.  Nice job fellas.  You're pushing a candidate who didn't even get a clear majority of YOUR party's votes lol.  What's one half of one half?  A quarter of the whole?  Why don't you just give McCain the keys to the White House already.
yelp:test:4020.para: The Democratic party has done a commendable job of splitting themselves so much that they can't settle on a candidate for the general election. Well done. Your chosen candidate didn't even secure a majority of your party's votes, did they? Just like half of half is a quarter, your candidate represents only a quarter of your party's support. Maybe it's time to hand the presidency to McCain.

yelp:test:4112.orig: most horrible experience i have ever had at a restaurant. The pasta was very under cooked and the pasta sauce had no taste. horrible unprofessional wait staff
yelp:test:4112.para: I had the worst experience at this restaurant. The pasta was severely undercooked, and the sauce lacked any flavor. The wait staff were also extremely unprofessional.

yelp:test:4123.orig: This one is only visited out of convenience- meaning it's a quick trip in and out (when are we here, on this side of town? when we go to my MIL's house for dinner), but I don't really like this one. I could probably blame the area as a whole- the Wal-Mart (really ghetto) and 99 Cents Store (very ghetto- in fact, I could probably say that I hate this one- actually had a verbal altercation with a foreigner, maybe Russian- have not been there since). The parking lot is way too busy making it hard to get out of your parking space if you're parked right in front of the store. Also, many of the people shopping here seem, downright weird. This store doesn't have everything you're looking for, either, seems lacking.
yelp:test:4123.para: This place is only visited for convenience, typically when we're already in the area, like when we go to my mother-in-law's for dinner. I don't particularly enjoy it. I might blame the entire neighborhood; the Wal-Mart feels very run-down (I even had a disagreement with someone who might have been Russian), and the 99 Cents Store is even worse—so bad that I haven't been back since. The parking lot is incredibly crowded, making it difficult to exit your spot if you park close to the store. Additionally, many of the shoppers here seem quite odd, and the store itself doesn't offer everything you need, feeling somewhat lacking.

yelp:test:4174.orig: Hands down what a great experience it was for us. We came in a little after 10:00am and were greeted right off the bat by a very nice gentlemen. He asked where we were from and explained what we could do and if we bought stuff he would have them sign it. So we walked around a little and toured the shop. We then bought some merchandise and other guy took our stuff and got it signed. The General then came out and we took pics and talked a bit. These guys are so down to earth and fame sure as not gone to their heads! We then went into the office for a quote on a tank and ran into Brett. Talked with him a little and took a pic! Great place to visit and made a trip complete! Thanks for a great time ATM!! You guys and gals rock!!
yelp:test:4174.para: Absolutely, it was an incredible experience for us. We arrived a bit past 10:00am and were immediately welcomed by a very friendly gentleman who asked where we were from and what we were interested in. He also explained the signing process and offered to have the items signed if we made a purchase. We explored the shop for a while, then bought some merchandise. Another staff member then signed our items. The General then joined us, and we took some photos and chatted. These individuals are genuinely down-to-earth, and fame hasn't changed them at all! We later visited the office to get a quote on a tank and bumped into Brett. We had a brief chat and took a photo together! It's a fantastic place to visit, and it made our trip truly memorable! Thanks so much for the great time, ATM!! You guys and gals are amazing!!

yelp:test:4182.orig: Some things are better left unsaid.
yelp:test:4182.para: It's often wise to keep certain things unspoken.

yelp:test:4187.orig:
I had the WORST customer service experience at the Sprint Store on Pecos and Russell. The employees were completely unknowledgeable, and Torrie the manager was absolutely incompetent. They lied about their product, services, and inventory, and routinely tried to up-charge myself and other customers while I was in the store. 

Warning: AVOID THIS STORE AT ALL COSTS!!!

I recommend going to a corporate Sprint Store such at the Sprint Store on Flamingo and Maryland, as they care about customer relationships. The ""Sprint Store by Wireless Experts"" on Pecos is run by an unprofessional staff who don't know their elbows from their sassholes.
yelp:test:4187.para:
My experience with customer service at the Sprint Store on Pecos and Russell was horrendous. The staff lacked knowledge, and the manager, Torrie, was clearly incompetent. They misrepresented their products, services, and inventory, and attempted to overcharge me and other customers during my visit. 

Caution: Steer clear of this store if you can. 

I suggest going to a corporate Sprint Store, like the one on Flamingo and Maryland, where they prioritize customer relationships. The Sprint Store by Wireless Experts on Pecos is managed by an unprofessional team that seems clueless.

yelp:test:4226.orig: My review is for maternity ward only. I have never been to the er or any other place in the hospital. This hospital gave me the best delivery experience of my life. Each Dr/nurse was so caring and always checked on me and my pain level. One of the  nurses even recorded my delivery so my husband could be included in the video + cord cutting. Food was 9/10. Yes it really was that good!! Nurses were so caring. Thank you MV staff
yelp:test:4226.para: My feedback pertains solely to the maternity ward. I've never visited the ER or any other part of the hospital. This facility provided me with an outstanding delivery experience. Every doctor and nurse was incredibly attentive and checked on me frequently, monitoring my pain levels. One nurse even recorded the delivery so my husband could be part of it, including the cord cutting. The food was exceptional, scoring a 9 out of 10. The nurses were exceptionally caring. A big thank you to the MV staff.

yelp:test:4241.orig: I've been eating here for about 20 years and is my hands down favorite place in Vegas.
yelp:test:4241.para: For nearly two decades, this has been my go-to spot in Vegas, and it remains my absolute favorite restaurant there.

yelp:test:4254.orig: Always make a 7 AM appointment (for fasting tests) and usually get called in within 5 minutes of appointment time. Consistently good. We always go to the location at Lake Mead and Buffalo. Staff is pleasant and competent.\nOf course, today I called to get the results and was told that one test was still \""pending\"". The lab didn't receive the specimen until after midnight today despite the fact that the blood draw was taken at 7 AM yesterday. That's the last time I make an appointment for a Friday :-).\nOtherwise, I recommend this location highly.
yelp:test:4254.para:
I always schedule a 7 AM appointment for fasting tests and am usually called in within 5 minutes of my scheduled time, which is consistently reliable. We typically visit the Lake Mead and Buffalo location, where the staff is both friendly and skilled.

Today, when I called to get the results, I was informed that one test was still pending because the lab received the specimen after midnight, even though the blood draw was done at 7 AM yesterday. That experience has made me decide not to schedule appointments for Fridays anymore.

Overall, I highly recommend this location otherwise.

yelp:test:4272.orig:
This is my first 1-star review, after roughly 30 reviews.
Although reviews are subjective in nature, I think that Yelp reviews have an air of objectivity, which is why their reputation is what it is. I follow that credo. 
Since I've lived in Las Vegas, for one reason or another (mainly to play penny slots), I've been to practically every major casino in town, at all times of day: 6 AM, 12 PM, 6 PM, and most recently 2 AM.  
This is my review of the atmosphere of the Fiesta Rancho casino. I've never stayed in one of their rooms (because I'm a local), I can't remember eating at any of their restaurants, I've never skated on their rink, and I've never gone into any of their nightclubs.
I'm still scratching my head, regarding reviews written by other locals who live in the NW, yet have stayed in Fiesta rooms (and have checked-in multiple times). Can anyone clear that up for me?
In any event, I've not gambled at the Fiesta Rancho more than I have at any other casino.
However, I've personally heard or have been in close proximity to 3 disturbing incidents at this casino, whereas I've not seen 1 at all the other casinos combined.
While playing there, I've heard gun shots coming fro
yelp:test:4272.para:
This marks my first 1-star review after about 30 others. While reviews are inherently subjective, I believe Yelp reviews carry a sense of objectivity, which is why they are trusted. I adhere to this principle.

As a resident of Las Vegas, I've frequented most major casinos here, visiting them at various times—6 AM, noon, 6 PM, and even 2 AM. 

Here’s my take on the Fiesta Rancho casino’s ambiance. I haven’t stayed in their rooms or dined at their restaurants, nor have I visited their rink or nightclubs. 

I’m puzzled by reviews from locals who live in the northwest and have stayed at Fiesta’s rooms, checking in multiple times. Could anyone explain this?

Regardless, I’ve gambled at Fiesta Rancho no more than at any other casino.

However, I’ve personally heard or witnessed 3 unsettling incidents at this casino, compared to none at all the other casinos combined.

During my time there, I’ve also heard gunshots.

yelp:test:4273.orig:
I give it 2 stars because I love Dr. Roach: he is an amazing vet and individual. However, I will never return because they gouge you big time. Unless you are made of money and live nearby, I can't see any reason for coming here.

For instance, I just got my cat's teeth cleaned for $149 after a Living Social discount. The place I took her to normally charges $300. Craig Road quoted me a price of $550 for the exact same procedure.

I have blown so much money at this place for being too lazy to seek out alternatives. Don't be a sucker like me.

One more thing, I was expecting to also pay for a tooth extraction because one of the doctors at Craig Road told me a fang needed to be removed. I was pleasantly surprised when the new place told me the fang was fine.

I forgot to mention several things previously, and I will rectify the situation now. CRAH is dedicated to one thing and one thing only, and that is to bleed you as much as they can; they care about nothing but money.

On my last visit to this place, my cat was undergoing a procedure that put her under anesthesia, so I thought this would be an opportune time to get her shaved. Stupid me, one of those brilliant technician
yelp:test:4273.para:
I rate it 2 stars due to my admiration for Dr. Roach, who is outstanding as a vet and person. Yet, I won't return because of their excessive pricing. Unless you have plenty of money and live close by, there's no compelling reason to go there.

For example, I recently paid $149 for my cat's teeth cleaning after a Living Social deal, while the usual cost at my regular vet is $300. Craig Road quoted me $550 for the same service.

I've spent a fortune here due to my laziness in finding cheaper options. Don't make the same mistake I did.

Additionally, I was told at Craig Road that a tooth extraction was necessary, but the new vet informed me the tooth was fine, which was a pleasant surprise.

I forgot to mention earlier that CRAH is solely focused on extracting as much money as possible; they have no other concern but profit.

During my last visit, when my cat was under anesthesia, I thought it would be a good time to have her shaved. What a mistake; one of the technicians

yelp:test:4312.orig: I went as far as creating a Yelp account  after being informed of all the negative comments being made. I've been coming to this location for years, I've always enjoyed the pre-wash conversations that Rachel and I have. I told her yesterday that she is by far the sweetest young lady that works here. Then, once I bring my car into the garage, I'm always on the look out for Shakyra or Daniel. They both are such wonderful supervisors. I've spoken to the new manager on a few accounts, he seems like a wonderful person to work for as well. There is a new supervisor as well who I have yet to speak with, but over all, this is my absolute favorite location. Even the cashiers in the store make my experience enjoyable. So, Thank You all! I appreciate your services.
yelp:test:4312.para: Since learning about the negative feedback, I took the step of creating a Yelp account. I've been a regular customer here for many years, and I've cherished the pre-wash chats with Rachel. Yesterday, I complimented her on being the kindest employee I know. When I enter the garage, I always hope to see Shakyra or Daniel, as they are both outstanding supervisors. I've had a few interactions with the new manager, and he seems like a great person to work for. There's a new supervisor I haven't met yet, but overall, this is my favorite location. Even the store cashiers contribute to making my experience pleasant. Thank you all for your service!

yelp:test:4316.orig: Yesterday, two co-workers and I got $18 tee times at Desert Rose, which we had deemed a steal. We'd never been, but I knew that it was the oldest course in Las Vegas. It's also in a dire state of emergency; frankly I'm surprised it's still operating. I live on the east side near UNLV, which is no utopian paradise by any means. So when I say that the neighborhood surrounding the course is sketchy, I mean bombed out and on the verge of being condemned. There were more boarded-up houses on the entrance road than I could easily count. Somewhere around the 7th hole a kid in a neighboring house was yelling at us while we were teeing-off in an attempt to distract us. I believe it was the 16th hole where a gentleman in front of us intentionally drove a ball into another neigboring house (we assumed for similar circumstances). And, not sure which hole it was where someone had their home stereo cranked to 11 blasting some sort of favela crunk. \n\nEnough of the fun stuff, let's talk about the course:  There is a dry wash that cuts through Desert Rose, which is literally a trash dumping site. See my photos. This starts at the first hole, and continues through most of the course. There is also
yelp:test:4316.para:
Yesterday, my two colleagues and I secured $18 tee times at Desert Rose, which we considered a real bargain. We hadn't visited before, but I knew it was the oldest course in Las Vegas. The place is in a sorry state; I'm genuinely surprised it's still open. I reside on the east side near UNLV, which isn't exactly a model neighborhood. When I say the area around the course is sketchy, I mean it's in a dilapidated condition, with buildings on the verge of collapse. The entrance road was filled with more boarded-up houses than I could count. Around the 7th hole, a kid in a nearby house was shouting at us while we were teeing off, trying to distract us. We guessed it was around the 16th hole where a man in front of us deliberately hit a ball into another house (we assumed for similar reasons). And somewhere, I'm not sure which hole, someone had their home stereo cranked up blasting some loud music.

Now, let's move on to the course itself: There's a dry wash that runs through Desert Rose, which is essentially a dumping ground for trash. See the photos for proof. This starts from the first hole and continues through most of the course.

yelp:test:4323.orig: My girlfriend wanted to eat here since we've seen the commercials down in So Cal. Now I have eaten at a Ruby Tuesday before in Cleveland, OH, and I thought this one would be the same as its midwestern counterpart. Wow, this Ruby Tuesday was completely different. From the outside it looked like a Cocos or Sizzler. The Ruby Tuesday in Cleveland looked and felt like an upscale Chilis but with a better menu. They even had Stella Artois (my favorite beer) on tap!\n\nThe service here was okay at best, but the food was disappointing, especially after having an amazing experience at another RT. If you want to eat at a Ruby Tuesday, you might as well go to one in the midwest. Stay away from this one.
yelp:test:4323.para:
My girlfriend was eager to try this Ruby Tuesday after seeing the commercials in Southern California. I had previously visited a Ruby Tuesday in Cleveland, expecting this one to be similar. However, this Ruby Tuesday was quite different. The exterior reminded me of a Cocos or Sizzler, while the interior felt more like an upscale Chili's with a superior menu. They even had my favorite beer, Stella Artois, on tap!

The service was merely satisfactory, and the food fell short of expectations, particularly after my positive experience at another Ruby Tuesday. If you're looking to dine at a Ruby Tuesday, you might as well go to one in the Midwest. Avoid this one.

yelp:test:4333.orig:
This is one of the better places to go for curry!

I like the hole-in-wall family owned feel.  Everything I've had here has been good, but they truly shine when it comes to curry.  There are other Thai places I like more, but if I may emphasize just one more time, there are none that I like more in town for curry.

A few of my friends that lived in Thailand or have Thai parents will only eat here...that says something good i my book.
yelp:test:4333.para:
This is one of the top spots for curry that I've found.

I appreciate the cozy, family-run atmosphere. Everything I've tried here is delicious, but their curry is exceptional. While I enjoy other Thai restaurants, none in town come close to matching their curry.

A couple of my friends, who either lived in Thailand or have Thai parents, only eat here... and that speaks volumes to me.

Remember that sushi, and the idea of eating raw fish was not accepted by the American mainstream back then. The sushi bar that Shogo worked at was the only sushi bar in the area that had made it. Japanese people would drive 50+ miles just to eat there. yelp:test:4348.para: Have you ever wondered why so many middle-aged Japanese people in Las Vegas choose SUSHI ON RAINBOW over high-end sushi restaurants like Kabuto or Goyemon? Why do they prefer an older sushi bar with simpler decor? For many of us of Japanese descent, SUSHI ON RAINBOW is a source of pride for our community, and its owner is highly respected. When I was a child in Southern California, I first heard about Shogo-san and his famous sushi restaurant in Newport Beach. At the time, sushi was virtually unknown in the area, and every new sushi restaurant struggled to survive. Sushi and raw fish were not widely accepted by the American mainstream. The sushi bar Shogo worked at was the only one to succeed, and people would travel 50 miles or more to eat there. Shogo was one of the first-generation sushi chefs, alongside the renowned Ichiro Mashita, who came to America with dreams of making sushi popular.

yelp:test:4356.orig:
Okay I have to give it two stars just because it really isn't much more than a nice Motel 6 or Best Western that is in Las Vegas.  With that said though I was completely shocked with my stay.  My wife and I stayed one night just to catch some sleep before me moved over to one of the other hotels on the strip, and I was fearing the worst.

We paid $20 for one night, and I closed my eyes while opening the door to my room, half expecting to find a room that would make me wish my wife would let us sleep in the car.

The room was quite clean, surprisingly decent sized, and the bed was even somewhat comfortable.  I would definitely NEVER stay here for more than one night, but if you need a place for a one night layover or looking for an incredibly cheap place to stay, you may want to check it out.
yelp:test:4356.para:
I'll give it two stars since it's not much better than a standard Motel 6 or Best Western in Las Vegas. However, my stay was surprisingly pleasant. My wife and I stayed one night to rest before moving to another hotel on the strip, and I was dreading the worst.

We paid $20 for the night, and when I entered the room, I half-expected to find something so unpleasant that it would make me wish we had slept in the car.

The room was clean, surprisingly spacious, and the bed was even somewhat comfortable. I wouldn't stay here for more than one night, but if you need a cheap place for a brief stay or a one-night layover, it might be worth checking out.

yelp:test:4389.orig:
Great breakfast food at OPH.  Had the Belgin Waffles with a side of bacon.  The bacon was thick & delicious.  Ok, I don't get bacon often.  The Belgin Waffle was light and had a good taste.

If you are a grandparent or grandchild (55+, 12 & under) they have a good deal.  Under $5 for 3 pancakes, eggs & meat.

I recommend eating here vs. the breakfast buffet ($8).  The food tastes better.
yelp:test:4389.para:
At OPH, I enjoyed a fantastic breakfast, starting with Belgian Waffles paired with bacon. The bacon was thick and incredibly tasty—something I don't usually savor. The Belgian Waffle was light and had a delightful flavor. 

For grandparents and grandchildren (55+ and under 12), there's a great offer: less than $5 for three pancakes, eggs, and meat.

I advise choosing this place over the breakfast buffet, which costs $8, as the food here tastes much better.

yelp:test:4415.orig:
Just left this office and I've never been so impressed by a dental visit before!
New patient paperwork was minimal, wait time was barely enough to read 2 pages of my book, and I was introduced to Anita- the cheerful, friendly, and professional dental assistant with who I would spend the majority of my visit. 

Anita was downright bubbly and made an effort to get to know me as a person while also maintaining professionalism, explaining every procedure she was going to do, and giving additional dental info tidbits to help keep my teeth as healthy and attractive as possible. Dr. Ozaki was also super professional and made sure to go over my concerns before moving on, making it very clear that he could always be reached in the event of an emergency. Anita mentioned she has worked for Dr. Ozaki for decades, which I think speaks volumes about their level of professionalism and patient care.

Ultimately spent just over an hour here including xrays, cleaning, and scheduling additional work for a chipped tooth. Front desk staff were super helpful at answering some questions about my dental insurance coverage and went out of their way to look up pricing to replace a retainer. Super impre
yelp:test:4415.para:
I just left this office, and I've never had such a positive dental experience before! The new patient paperwork was minimal, and my wait time was short enough to read a couple of pages of my book. I was greeted by Anita, a cheerful, friendly, and professional dental assistant who would accompany me throughout my visit.

Anita was exceptionally bubbly and took the time to get to know me personally while maintaining her professionalism. She explained each procedure and provided additional dental tips to keep my teeth healthy and attractive. Dr. Ozaki was also very professional, addressing my concerns before proceeding and ensuring I knew he was available for emergencies. Anita mentioned she has worked with Dr. Ozaki for decades, which speaks to their high standards of professionalism and patient care.

The visit took just over an hour, including X-rays, a cleaning, and scheduling work for a chipped tooth. The front desk staff were incredibly helpful, answering questions about my dental insurance and even looking up pricing for a retainer replacement. Truly impressive!

yelp:test:4438.orig:
mmmmm...,,,,mmm... bad! This place was definitely not what a majority of my co-workers had described it.  How can you burn chicken that bad? Here are my ratings for their service:

Customer Service - 5 Stars
Chicken Pasta - 1 Star (only because the chicken wasn't burnt)
Mashed Potatoes - 1/2 Star (only for the effort)

I ordered the family 4 meal and it was terrible.  I was hoping to write a good review, but the chicken pasta was soaked in thousand island dressing.  Not a huge fan of thousand island sauce unless i can use it on my ""In & Out"" burger.  

Mashed Potatoes? Sooooooo disappointed, they covered my mashed potatoes with gravy for me so when i got home it had all blended in together.  Husband was not happy.  

Chicken was very bland in seasoning, but thanks to the charred areas, there was a burnt taste at least.  

I wish I could say more about the place, but unfortunately ""this is all she wrote"".
yelp:test:4438.para:
Hmm... Hmm... not good! This restaurant was quite different from what most of my colleagues had said. How could chicken be burned to such an extent? Here are my ratings:

Customer Service - 5 Stars
Chicken Pasta - 1 Star (just for the chicken, which wasn't burnt)
Mashed Potatoes - 0.5 Star (only for the effort)

I ordered the family meal for four, and it was awful. I was hoping to write a positive review, but the chicken pasta was drenched in thousand island dressing. I don't really enjoy thousand island sauce unless it's on my "In & Out" burger.

The mashed potatoes were a huge letdown; they were covered in gravy, which made them a mess by the time I got home. My husband wasn't pleased. The chicken was quite bland in terms of seasoning, but at least there was a hint of burnt taste from the charred parts.

I wish I could say more about the place, but unfortunately, "this is all I can say."

yelp:test:4459.orig: The company is a rouse!  Mike Ferry pays his sales staff a little above minimum wage...hourly.Some of these individuals have backgrounds like waitressing and internet gambling. yelp:test:4459.para: The company is a scam. Mike Ferry compensates his sales team just above minimum wage on an hourly basis.
