yelp:test:4486.orig: I can't actually comment on the food.  The place looked nice relative to a lot of neighboring establishments and was recommended by our lunch-time server @ Nola (very good Creole) and our concierge.  My low rating comes from the fact that I called twice to make a reservation and no one answered.  After taking a cab from downtown we learned there was a private party and we wouldn't be able to take in the Jersey Shore fist pumping scene (thanks Callan W for the visual).  Simply disappointed in the lack of basic customer service.\n\nWe ended up down the street at the Pittsburgh Steak Company.  Not sushi but the gorgonzola filet melts in your mouth!!
yelp:test:4486.para:
While I can't speak to the food quality, the restaurant appeared to be more appealing than its nearby competitors and was recommended by both our lunch server at Nola (excellent Creole cuisine) and our concierge. My low rating stems from the fact that I tried calling twice to make a reservation, but no one answered. Upon arriving by cab from downtown, we discovered there was a private event, preventing us from experiencing the Jersey Shore celebration (thanks Callan W for the vivid imagery). Overall, I was let down by the poor customer service.

We ended up at Pittsburgh Steak Company instead. Although not a sushi place, their gorgonzola filet was absolutely delicious, melting in your mouth!

yelp:test:4497.orig: I passed by this place and just decided to try it. I tried their burger. Man..it was so good. Best bang for the buck. Especially if you're a student.. I had plenty of fries. Completely stuffed. =) Definitely coming back here again.
yelp:test:4497.para: On my way, I decided to give it a try, and I opted for their burger. Wow, it was fantastic! Truly a great value. Perfect for students like me. I devoured a lot of fries and felt completely satisfied. =) I'll definitely be back.

yelp:test:4498.orig:
I've only been here once and according to my friend, when he was here earlier in the year it was waaaaaaay better but I found the food very bland and warm, friendly service and cute atmosphere couldn't make up for it. 

We tried the crab and artichoke dip and for dinner, inspired by Kitchen Confidential, I had one of their specials, a flounder filet with polenta. I'm usually expecting polenta to be this creamy, mushy puddle of heaven but here it was more like a quiche. So there was the flounder and a slice of polenta on their opposite sides of a plate, they didn't seem to go together. I wonder if it has anything to do with skipping out on the salsa that was supposed to go on top of the fish but I can't see how some chopped tomatoes would've made this any better. The dip was also plain and largely unmemorable. 

I did like the decor and the format, they have a smaller, quieter back room with just a few tables and a nice-looking, dark bar and more seating in the front. It's really romantic and I wish the food was tastier.
yelp:test:4498.para:
My visit was just one time, and my friend said it was much better when he was here earlier this year. While the service was warm and friendly, and the atmosphere was cute, the food was quite bland. The decor and seating arrangement, with a quieter back room and a nice-looking bar, were appealing, but they couldn't compensate for the lackluster cuisine.

For appetizers, we had the crab and artichoke dip, which was unremarkable. For dinner, I tried their special of flounder with polenta, inspired by Kitchen Confidential. I expected the polenta to be creamy and delicious, but it was more like a quiche. The flounder and polenta were placed on opposite sides of the plate, not complementing each other. I'm unsure if the missing salsa on top of the fish had anything to do with the dish's lack of flavor, as I doubt that chopped tomatoes would have improved it. The dip was also bland and forgettable.

yelp:test:4519.orig:
Since I have family that lives down the street, I have been coming to Big Jim's for over 20 years. I used to really enjoy coming here but stopped visiting several years ago. Although the food was always good, the place was getting dirtier every time I was there.

Yesterday my wife and I decided to stop for lunch. I figured that the place was probably cleaned up since the Diners, Drive-ins and Dives episode. After being seated, I wanted to leave. To be honest, I don't know why I stayed. Nothing had changed. In fact I think it got worse.

The floor was filthy. There was food under tables that looked like it was there for days. Remember, I was here for lunch and they just opened. The tables and chairs in the dining room looked as though they were purchased at a yard sale. Very old and falling apart.

The only reason I'm giving this two stars is because the service and food was good. I had an Italian hoagie and my wife had a salad. Both tasted good but I really couldn't enjoy it.

I kept thinking that if the dining room was this dirty, what is the kitchen like?
yelp:test:4519.para:
For more than two decades, I've been frequenting Big Jim's due to my family living nearby. While I once relished these visits, I haven't been there in years. Despite the food consistently being decent, the establishment seemed to deteriorate with each visit.

Yesterday, my wife and I decided to have lunch there, hoping the place had improved after the Diners, Drive-ins and Dives episode. However, I regretted staying almost immediately. Everything was the same, if not worse. The floor was extremely dirty, with food debris under tables that appeared to have been there for days. It was puzzling, as they had just opened for the day. The dining room furniture looked like it had been sourced from a yard sale, old and in poor condition.

I gave it two stars solely because the service and food were satisfactory. I had an Italian hoagie, and my wife had a salad; both tasted good, but I couldn't fully enjoy them. My mind kept wandering to the state of the kitchen, wondering how bad it might be.

yelp:test:4537.orig: The \""chicken\"" was soggy and a little rubbery.  The ice looked like it was icicles from the side of the building (It was winter when went).  The waiter was a friendly guy and very nice, although I'm not sure what is going on with the food...I've never been there since.
yelp:test:4537.para: The "chicken" was limp and somewhat rubbery. The ice appeared like icicles from a building's side (it was winter when we visited). The waiter was friendly and very nice, but I'm unsure about the food quality... I haven't returned since.

yelp:test:4540.orig: Horrible customer service! The WORST i've experienced in a long time - in fact, I don't think I've EVER been treated with such disrespect. I asked a simple question about what the person ordered who was with me and the young ladies working glared and cut eyes at me - awful attitudes. My guess is the 2 girls working must be related to same because there is no way anyone with common business sense would hire such disrespectful workers with no clue about offering acceptable, good customer service.
yelp:test:4540.para: Terrible customer service! It was the WORST I've ever encountered—actually, I can't recall ever being treated with such disrespect. When I inquired about what the person with me had ordered, the young women working there gave me a hostile look and rolled their eyes, which was incredibly rude. I suspect these two girls are related, as it’s hard to believe anyone with basic business acumen would hire staff like that, who clearly lack the skills to provide good customer service.

yelp:test:4558.orig:
I have many fond memories at Lulu's. It was my first off campus dining experience while I was at CMU. Food was plenty and affordable. Yesterday, I went back for the first time in more than 5 years. 

The positives:
- things haven't changed
- affordable pricing
- generous portions
- fast service
- variety

The negatives:
- things haven't changed
- variety (see more explanation below)
- overly-Americanized ""Asian"" food
- bubble tea overly sweet and artificial

I stick with what I know is decent:
- Crab Rangoons
- Beef Chow Fun
- Pan Fried Noodles
- Wonton Noodle Soup

This really isn't a place where you should try something new. If you decide to dine here, check out the reviews and pick which has the most votes.
yelp:test:4558.para:
I cherish many memories from my time at Lulu's, where it was my initial off-campus dining adventure during my studies at CMU. The food was plentiful and reasonably priced. Last week, I revisited after over five years.

Pros:
- Everything remains the same
- Affordable prices
- Generous serving sizes
- Quick service
- Diverse menu options

Cons:
- Everything remains the same
- Limited menu variety (more details below)
- Food that feels overly Americanized
- Bubble tea is too sweet and artificial

I continue to rely on what I know is good:
- Crab Rangoons
- Beef Chow Fun
- Pan Fried Noodles
- Wonton Noodle Soup

This isn't a place to try new dishes. If you decide to dine there, read the reviews and choose the most popular options.

yelp:test:4636.orig:
I love Gullifty's!!! Its a really excellent place to get some dinner or dessert with your friends before a night out or just to spend some time catching up. 

Friday and Saturday nights can have a little bit of a wait, so be prepared for that. The desserts are way better than some of the reviewers here give them credit for and they have a really excellent wide variety to choose from. 

Private lot in the back as well as street park all require coins for the meter (pain!) but, when i'm back in pittsburgh about once a year, a stop to gullifty's is always on my to-do list!
yelp:test:4636.para:
I adore Gullifty's! It's an outstanding spot for dinner or dessert with friends, whether you're heading out for the evening or simply want to catch up. On Fridays and Saturdays, there might be a bit of a wait, so plan accordingly. The desserts are actually much better than what some reviewers suggest, and they offer a fantastic range to choose from.

There's a private parking lot in the back and street parking, both of which require coins for the meter (though it can be a hassle). However, my trip to Pittsburgh wouldn't be complete without a visit to Gullifty's!

yelp:test:4649.orig: I ve been living here for a year and have faced no problems at all. The apartments on the penthouse floor which is the 22nd floor are great. You have an option of choosing an apt with new appliances which are much better than the really old ones. The maintainence staff and the office are always available and helpful. I did have some problems with the dishwasher and the kitchen sink but it was fixed.
yelp:test:4649.para: After a year of living here, I haven't encountered any issues. The apartments on the 22nd floor, the penthouse level, are excellent. You can opt for a unit with new appliances, which are significantly better than the older ones. The maintenance team and office staff are always responsive and helpful. There were a couple of issues with the dishwasher and kitchen sink, but they were promptly resolved.

yelp:test:4650.orig: Came back, and I'd write the exact same review all over again.\n\nNow pass me the potato gnocchi, please. And as for Tony P's issue, sorry Tony - but go marry yourself that British chic and bring her back here for some good Gnocchi and Chianti! I'll buy if you do!
yelp:test:4650.para:
I'd write the exact same review if I were to come back, and I still would.

Could you please pass me the potato gnocchi?

Regarding Tony P's comment, Tony, I apologize—but why don't you marry that British lady and bring her back for some excellent gnocchi and Chianti? I'd even pay for it if you do!

yelp:test:4652.orig:
You'll have to forgive me. I live in Los Angeles where there is valet parking for hamburgers and top chefs have food trucks that can be found here, there and everywhere. A burger with a side of fries smothered in Duck Confit with White Truffle Sauce - so perhaps the bar is a tad higher than here in - ack - Pittsburgh where I found myself searching for sustenance before attending the wedding that brought me here. I only hope the godawful mess I actually ate doesn't rear it's ugly head mid-ceremony.

It sounded like such a novel concept, a sandwich with all the sides just piled on. After all, it's all going to the same place, right? Having been born and raised in Chicago it was a familiar concept. The noble Chicago Dog, a study in contradictions: sweet and sour, spicy and mild, hot and cold - a veritable melange that blends and tantalizes from the first bite to the last. Yes! I'll try it!

With my omnivore brother and his lovely wife I made my way through the chilly streets of downtown Pittsburgh on this frosty Saturday. A bustling little metropolis, scant parking so (I am shamed to admit) I pulled in a nearby lot that charged an $8 flt fee. A small price to pay, I reasoned, for
yelp:test:4652.para:
I apologize for the confusion. In Los Angeles, where you can find valet parking for burger joints and top chefs operate food trucks, my standards for a burger with fries topped with Duck Confit and White Truffle Sauce are naturally higher. When I found myself in Pittsburgh, searching for something to eat before a wedding, my expectations were much lower. I only hope the meal I ended up choosing doesn't cause issues during the ceremony.

The idea of a sandwich with all the sides piled on seemed fresh and exciting. Growing up in Chicago, this concept was quite familiar to me. The Chicago Dog, a mix of sweet and sour, spicy and mild, hot and cold, is a delightful blend that tantalizes from the first to the last bite. So, I decided to give it a try.

With my omnivore brother and his wife, we navigated the chilly downtown Pittsburgh streets on this cold Saturday. Despite the bustling city and limited parking, I had to park in a nearby lot that charged an $8 fee. I thought it was a small price to pay for the convenience.

yelp:test:4661.orig: I love this pizza. If you like sweet sauce then you need to try this pizza.
yelp:test:4661.para: This pizza is fantastic, and if you enjoy a sweet sauce, you really should give this one a try.

yelp:test:4663.orig: Good Stuff!  Everything on the menu is pretty good.  They usually have a few decent beers on tap too!  The place gets busy, though, so be prepared to wait.
yelp:test:4663.para: Great Options! The menu features mostly delicious items, and they typically offer several satisfactory beers on tap as well. However, the establishment can get quite crowded, so plan for some waiting time.

yelp:test:4675.orig:
For years now, I have been telling my boyfriend about my hopes and dreams in life.  One that kept coming up, time and time again, was that I wanted to hug a penguin someday.  I was resigned to the fact that this would never happen - where on earth would I possibly be able to hug a penguin?  Antarctica?  Not going there.  Zoos - yeah, they have gates separating me from the huggable waddlers.  So it was just another dream destined to never come true - until my 26th birthday when my boyfriend presented me with two tickets to the Penguin Encounter at the National Aviary.

I was so childishly excited when we arrived at the Aviary one Saturday.  We were early for the penguin encounter, so we explored the rest of the Aviary first.  I was surprised at how delightful and interesting it was - yeah it's just birds, but like - who knew birds could be so cool?  It's essentially a zoo for birds, which sounds boring, but it is not!

My favorite part (besides the penguins) was going in the tropical habitat room.  This trainer gathered up a big crowd of us and did a feeding demonstration which was awesome.  Only kids got to be participants - well, it was an unspoken rule, but how dumb would I l
yelp:test:4675.para:
For a long time, I shared my aspirations and dreams with my partner, and one recurring wish was to hug a penguin. I had given up on this idea, thinking it was impossible—how could I ever get close enough to a penguin? Antarctica was out of the question, and while zoos had penguins, they were behind barriers. So, it seemed like just another unfulfilled dream—until my 26th birthday, when my partner surprised me with tickets to the Penguin Encounter at the National Aviary.

I was thrilled when we arrived at the Aviary on a Saturday morning. We arrived early for the penguin encounter, so we explored the rest of the Aviary first. I was pleasantly surprised by how engaging and fascinating it was—birds, I thought, could be really cool! It’s essentially a bird zoo, which might sound mundane, but it’s far from it.

My favorite part, aside from the penguins, was the tropical habitat room. A trainer gathered a crowd and did a feeding demonstration, which was fantastic. Only kids were allowed to participate, but I wouldn’t have missed it for the world.

yelp:test:4694.orig: No HEAT late Sunday (January) night and no one around to tell.  45 degrees for a 3 hour movie.  Too many options to go back here! Good Luck!
yelp:test:4694.para: On a late Sunday night in January, there was no heat, and I was alone to notice. The temperature dropped to 45 degrees during a 3-hour movie. With so many alternatives, I won't be coming back here again! Good luck!

yelp:test:4710.orig:
I love salad bars. Love. LOVE. 

But I can't eat here. And by that I don't mean that it isn't veg-friendly - it most def is - I mean that the quality of ingredients, salad, toppings, potato bar, made-from-powder soups are so low that I get scared. Fear is an appetite inhibitor. 

I've hit this trough three times, and had gurgley tummy after each and every one. The ladies that work here are totally great - even acknowledge and remove and replace, say, the cukes, when I express concerns about their harboring of evil bacteriums and such (WOW they smelled weird last time I was here). But any effort on my part to save my and others' bellies from grossville feels like polishing the brass on the Titanic. 

So I continue to harass Sweet Tomatoes via email, monthly, with the hopes that one day we'll actually have a decent Bar in Charlotte. Fingers crossed. I might start a petition. Let me know if you want to sign.
yelp:test:4710.para:
I adore salad bars, truly and deeply. However, I can't dine here. This isn't about the food not being vegetarian-friendly—it most certainly is—but rather the poor quality of the ingredients, the salad, the toppings, and the made-from-powder soups, which make me wary. Fear can dampen one's appetite.

I've visited this place three times, and each time, I've experienced an upset stomach. The staff is fantastic; they even replace cucumbers when I express concerns about potential contamination, even though the cucumbers smelled off last time. Yet, my efforts to protect my health and others' from potential food issues feel futile, like trying to polish the Titanic.

Thus, I persist in emailing Sweet Tomatoes monthly, hoping for a better salad bar in Charlotte. Fingers crossed. I might even start a petition. If you're interested in signing, let me know.

yelp:test:4750.orig:
This funky little eatery in the South End has grown quite a bit (not in size, but in appeal) over the last few years.  What started as not much more than a rather ugly yellow cinder block building on an oddly-shaped lot is now that and more - they've added some landscaping, a paved lot instead of the gravel parking and a nice outdoor eating area too.  Inside the food is the same great, simple combinations you're used to getting.

The cramped quarters also haven't changed much, but that's just part of the appeal.  As strange as it may sound, the sheer volume that moves through this place makes it possible to place your order and get a table by the time the order is ready - provided everyone cooperates and doesn't hog their table out of their place in line.  When you're done, get up and let someone else have the table, and everything keeps moving as it should.

Table tops still contain business cards from around town, and there is plenty of artwork to see as well, and the atmosphere is worth coming for, but it's the food that should keep you coming back.  While the burrito is the namesake of the place, make sure you try the quesadilla too.  They are excellent.
yelp:test:4750.para:
This quirky eatery in the South End has significantly increased in appeal over the past few years, despite not expanding in size. What began as an unattractive yellow cinder block building on an oddly-shaped plot has transformed into something more. They've added landscaping, replaced the gravel parking with a paved lot, and introduced a pleasant outdoor dining area. The menu remains the same, offering the familiar, delicious, and straightforward combinations you expect.

The tight space hasn't changed much, but that's part of the charm. The bustling nature of the place means you can usually place your order and find a table by the time your food is ready, as long as everyone cooperates and doesn't monopolize their table. When you're finished, it's courteous to vacate the table to keep the flow going smoothly.

The tables still display business cards from local businesses, and there's plenty of artwork to admire. However, the atmosphere is what draws people in, but the food is what keeps them coming back. While the burrito is the star of the menu, the quesadilla is also highly recommended and absolutely outstanding.

yelp:test:4789.orig:
Equal parts old-fashioned soda shop, restaurant, bar, and hangout. The location is absolutely crucial here. Located in one of the more walkable parts of South End, Pike's is a gem with a hefty menu complete with plenty of sweets and southern treats.

Haven't been to Pike's in quite some time and this was my first go for lunch. Decided to dine al fresco and enjoyed every second of it. This time 'round, didn't go for anything on the sweet side of things, but rather went for the lunch menu solely. 

Started with the mozzarella sticks. Both myself and my dining counterpart were shocked that they weren't the ""out of the bag"" variety. These appeared to be hand breaded with a higher quality cheese than typically served. Marinara was standard, but the mozz sticks themselves were great. They also weren't covered with the typical panko, moon dust, crappy breading like usual.

Went with the buffalo chicken sandwich for my entree. Holy craaaaaap. Ditch the bun, eat a few of the house-made chips, and enjoy the chicken. Not only is this sucker lightly breaded and flavored well with the buffalo sauce, it's straight up baptized in the sauce. Swimming, rather. I'm usually not for a pool o
yelp:test:4789.para:
Pike's is a unique spot that blends the charm of a traditional soda shop with a restaurant, bar, and casual hangout. Its prime location in a walkable area of South End makes it a standout, offering a substantial menu with a variety of sweet and southern delicacies.

I hadn't visited Pike's in a while, and this time I decided to try their lunch menu outdoors. I was thoroughly enjoying my al fresco dining experience.

I started with the mozzarella sticks, which were a pleasant surprise. They were hand-breaded with a higher quality cheese than usual, and the marinara was standard, but the mozzarella sticks themselves were excellent. They weren't coated in the usual panko or other inferior breading.

For my main course, I opted for the buffalo chicken sandwich. It was absolutely delicious. I recommend ditching the bun, enjoying a few of the house-made chips, and savoring the chicken, which was lightly breaded and perfectly seasoned with buffalo sauce. The sandwich was drenched in sauce, almost swimming in it. I usually prefer a bit more control over the sauce, but this one was a standout.

yelp:test:4799.orig: I found this monogramming place in Dilworth and, although I don't need anything monogrammed at the moment, I wanted to check it out for the future. You walk in and are basically on top of everything; there is a pathway cleared amongst all the items and 2 counters that forces you in and around the store even if you don't want to go. I was immediately looked at as if I were in the wrong place as I had nothing in my hands to be monogrammed, and was quickly and snottily asked if I was dropping anything off. I was stuck behind a gaggle of women debating which Kate Spade purse they wanted done as I desperately tried to get out but could hardly make my way around them. I may try again when I actually have the need for some monogramming, and I will try to overlook the pretentiousness of the employees and clientele.
yelp:test:4799.para: I discovered a monogramming shop in Dilworth and, despite not needing anything monogrammed right now, I decided to visit to see what it's like for future use. Upon entering, you're immediately surrounded by items with a narrow path leading you through the store, even if you're not interested in browsing. I felt out of place right away, as no items were in my hands, and was quickly questioned if I was there to drop something off. I had to wait behind a group of women debating Kate Spade purses, trying to exit but barely able to maneuver around them. I might return when I actually need monogramming services, and I'll try to ignore the pretentiousness of both the staff and customers.

yelp:test:4803.orig: The decor is just so fun and upbeat! I'm usually there a little later in the day, so it's not too busy or smelly. Everything is clean, everyone is friendly, and I always look prettier coming out than I do going in!
yelp:test:4803.para: The ambiance is incredibly lively and cheerful! When I visit later in the day, it's neither overcrowded nor unpleasantly smelly. Everything is kept spotlessly clean, and the staff are very welcoming. Plus, I always feel more put-together when I leave than when I arrived!

yelp:test:4879.orig: If you're at the hospital and want something other than hospital food, this place may be the ticket.  Right across the street, you can get a good variety of food.  It's quick and easy and not too expensive.  Just don't go for the atmosphere because, well, there isn't much.  But keep your head down and that won't matter much.
yelp:test:4879.para: If you're in the hospital and seeking food beyond what's offered there, this spot across the street could be just what you need. They provide a nice selection of meals, are convenient and reasonably priced. However, don't expect a fancy ambiance; it's quite simple. Just focus on your meal and you won't mind the plain setting much.

yelp:test:4887.orig: The food here is good, but wasn't exactly what I was expecting. Everything was was good quality and well prepared (and fast!) and the price was very reasonable. My wife and I both ordered the 1/4 rotisserie chicken (white) which came with cornbread and two sides. I got the baked beans and the special: spicy mac & cheese. The first thing I tried was the cornbread, and found it had jalape\u00f1os and whole kernels of corn baked in. I know some people really like the whole corn in the cornbread thing, but I'd rather keep my breads and vegetables separate. Next up was the spicy mac & cheese. I love mac & cheese, and I've become a big fan of having a bit of hot sauce added to give it some kick, so I was really excited about this. It certainly had the spicy; it had lots of jalape\u00f1os mixed in and was quite hot. What it was lacking was the cheese. There was no creaminess to it at all. The baked beans, however, were very good. They also had jalape\u00f1os mixed in (are you sensing a theme here?), but only had a subtle kick which was balanced with a slightly sweet tangy sauce. As for the chicken, the flavor was excellent but most of the breast was pretty dry. The wing, on the other hand
yelp:test:4887.para: The food was decent, though not quite what I anticipated. The quality and preparation were top-notch, and the prices were quite reasonable. My wife and I both ordered the 1/4 rotisserie chicken (white), served with cornbread and two side dishes. I had the baked beans and the special spicy mac & cheese. Starting with the cornbread, it contained jalapeños and whole corn kernels, which some people enjoy, but I prefer to keep my bread and vegetables separate. Moving on to the spicy mac & cheese, it was very spicy with plenty of jalapeños, but it lacked the creamy texture I was hoping for. The baked beans, however, were quite good, with a subtle kick and a sweet tangy sauce. The chicken was flavorful, but the breast was quite dry. The wing, by contrast, was better.

yelp:test:4915.orig: I will not be returning as a client due to an extremely rude female doctor that attempted to reprimand me for questioning the services rendered as well as the amount of the bill. It is our right as a client to ask questions about what we are paying for as well as question the care for our animals, and as a business it is their job to make the clients feel comfortable enough to do so. They did the very opposite and unfortunately most of my prior visits there have been met with rude cold customer service. If they can't provide their human clients with respect and kindness when we are the ones footing the bill \nit is unnerving to think how they treat the animals when they are in their care.
yelp:test:4915.para: I won't be coming back as a client because of a very rude female doctor who tried to scold me for questioning the services and the bill. As clients, we have the right to ask about what we're paying for and to question the care of our animals, and businesses should ensure we feel comfortable doing so. Instead, they were rude and cold, which unfortunately has been the case for most of my previous visits. If they can't treat human clients with respect and kindness, it's concerning to think about how they might treat the animals in their care.

yelp:test:4938.orig:
After I THOUGHT I had ordered a stack of pizzas for a meeting to be delivered at 11:45 am, I called at noon to inquire as to the whereabouts of our lunch to be told I had placed the order for 11:45 PM - ACK!  Panic! SH**!!!!  Whomever the gentleman was who answered the phone put the pizza makers to work immediately and 9 pizzas and an order of wings were delivered within 30 minutes, smoking hot and correct.  5 stars for the excellent customer service that saved me from being drug out back and beaten like a pinata by the hungry mob of nerds... er um... architects.  

Our office orders from this Papa John's quite frequently for meetings and late nights that require the delivery of dinner.  They always get the orders correct, the pizza is always delivered hot and they always bring a stack of plates and napkins - which is nice so we don't have to eat off of legal folders and wipe our hands on our pants.

THANK YOU, PAPA JOHN'S!
yelp:test:4938.para:
Initially, I believed I had arranged for a pizza delivery at 11:45 am for a meeting, but when I called at noon to check on the order, I was informed it was scheduled for 11:45 pm—oh no! This caused a panic. The person who answered quickly got the pizza place to start working, and within 30 minutes, 9 pizzas and wings were delivered, piping hot and exactly as requested. I gave them 5 stars for their outstanding customer service, which prevented me from facing a mob of hungry architects—er, I mean, our team of hungry architects. 

We regularly order from Papa John's for our meetings and late-night work sessions, and they consistently get the orders right. The pizzas are always delivered hot, and they provide plates and napkins, which is a big plus since we usually eat off legal folders and wipe our hands on our pants.

Thank you, Papa John's!

yelp:test:4939.orig: Ordered food around 8:00 now it's around   11:30, called twice but no answer- weird for a restaurant that is open until 1:30 A.M and has already charged my credit card. When I finally got my food it was cold and sucked- I'm not a food snob either (papa John or dominos delivery pizza is fine by me). The pizza was awful, wings were soggy, and mozzarella sticks were cold on the inside. If you're looking for good service and food aim elsewhere this place was awful- bad enough for me to take the time to download this app, and make a review..
yelp:test:4939.para: Placed my order around 8:00, and it's now 11:30. I've called twice, but there's no answer—odd for a restaurant open until 1:30 A.M. that has already charged my card. When the food finally arrived, it was cold and disappointing. I'm not picky; even Papa John's or Domino's would be better. The pizza was terrible, the wings were soggy, and the mozzarella sticks were cold inside. If you're seeking good service and food, look elsewhere; this place was so bad that I took the time to write a review on this app.

yelp:test:4944.orig: Favorite delivery pizza in town.  Great selection of pies!  Delicious.  Only place we order from now.
yelp:test:4944.para: Our go-to pizza place for deliveries. They offer a fantastic variety of pizzas, and the taste is outstanding. We exclusively order from them now.

yelp:test:4962.orig:
Spoiler: I don't golf.

I've been to Leatherman's twice recently, once to play at the driving range and once to play miniature golf.  They have a decent selection of clubs that you can borrow if you're like me and have nothing related to golf.  The pro shop looks pretty cool and the people were nice when I was in buying a bucket.

Now the fun stuff, miniature golf.  This isn't one of those courses with giant animals & cheesy holes, but its a well maintained 18-hole course with a few sneaky holes.  Adults are $7.00 and it is pretty challenging - I got nowhere near par, but it definitely was fun!
yelp:test:4962.para:
Warning: I don't golf.

In the past couple of weeks, I've visited Leatherman's twice—once for the driving range and once for miniature golf. They offer a good range of clubs for borrowing, which is handy if you, like me, don't own any golf equipment. The pro shop is quite impressive, and the staff were friendly when I purchased a bucket.

Now, let's talk about the miniature golf. It's not one of those courses with oversized animals and tacky holes; instead, it's a well-maintained 18-hole course with a few tricky holes. Admission for adults is $7.00, and while it's quite challenging—I didn't come close to par—it was definitely enjoyable!

yelp:test:4973.orig: Finally came in here once recently. It's pretty ok. Nothing to write home about, but decent food not too overpriced.
yelp:test:4973.para: I visited this place recently, and it was alright. While there wasn't anything particularly impressive, the food was decent and not overly expensive.

yelp:test:4983.orig: Incompetent idiots; these people are. Don't waste your time with this Enterprise location. Thumbs down.
yelp:test:4983.para: These individuals are clearly incompetent. I wouldn't recommend this Enterprise location at all. I give it a thumbs down.

yelp:test:5009.orig: To quote Arrest Development, \""I've made a huge mistake.\""
yelp:test:5009.para: To paraphrase, as in Arrested Development, one might say, "I've committed a significant error."

yelp:test:5018.orig: Stonecrest Chick-Fil-A is my favorite by far.  They do a phenomenal business and are very well organized.  They hire young folks and train them well.  When busy, they bring the food to your table and are constantly circulating asking if there's anything you need including re-filling beverages.  Everyone seems to have a great attitude which is hard to find in the service industry!  This particular location also seems to have a lot of special events (free breakfasts, buy a combo-get a kid's meal free, etc).  If you live in the area, be sure to sign up for their text updates so you can stay up to date with their offerings!  I wish I owned this place....CASH COW!  Did I say cow?!?  Eat more chicken...
yelp:test:5018.para: Stonecrest Chick-Fil-A is my top choice without a doubt. They run their business exceptionally well and are highly organized. They employ young people and provide them with thorough training. During busy times, they bring the food to your table and frequently check to see if you need anything, such as refilling your drinks. The staff always seems to have a positive attitude, which is rare in the service industry! This particular location also hosts many special events, like free breakfasts and buy-one-get-one-free deals for kids' meals. If you're in the area, make sure to sign up for their text alerts to stay informed about their promotions! I wish I could run this place—it's a real money-maker! Did I mention it's a cow-themed restaurant? Enjoy the chicken!

yelp:test:5077.orig:
I have never been to the store itself but walked by many times. My boyfriend picked up some lotion, soap and body wash for me for our anniversary and let me just say, he did a good job. The lotion is heavenly and I use it all the time. And the soaps are nice too. We will definitely be 
stopping by here the next time we need a nice gift.

Edit - I just wanted to add my boyfriend calls this place ""My Hookup."" I always get something from there for Valentine's Day, birthdays, etc and I LOVE it!  :)
yelp:test:5077.para:
I haven't visited the store personally, but I've passed by numerous times. My boyfriend selected some lotion, soap, and body wash for me as an anniversary gift, and I must say, he chose well. The lotion is absolutely delightful, and I use it regularly. The soaps are also quite nice. We'll definitely return here next time we need a thoughtful gift.

Edit - I just wanted to mention that my boyfriend refers to this place as "My Hookup." I always get something from there for Valentine's Day, birthdays, and other occasions, and I absolutely adore it! 😊

yelp:test:5089.orig: This place is the American Gothic of breakfast food and decor, purposefully bland.\n\nIf I were to take a guess, this place gets most of its high ratings because of it's proximity to campus/greek row. A quaint place for sorority girls to quell their hangovers with tasteless food while telling stories about last night.
yelp:test:5089.para:
This establishment exudes a classic American Gothic vibe through its breakfast fare and ambiance, intentionally plain and unremarkable.

I suspect the restaurant receives many of its top ratings due to its location near campus and Greek life areas. It's a charming spot where sorority sisters can nurse their hangovers with flavorless food while sharing tales from the night before.

yelp:test:5103.orig: I've now order take out a couple of times from here and GUESS WHAT? They will send you coupons if you order online! What?! BTW, the Indo mac and cheese is amazing.
yelp:test:5103.para: I've placed a few takeout orders from here, and here's the surprise: they send coupons if you order online! Can you believe it? By the way, the Indo mac and cheese is fantastic.

yelp:test:5116.orig: Seriously disappointing experience at this restaurant. The service was so slow and our waitress was beyond dull and unfriendly. I'm usually crazy about any type of Mediterranean bread, but the bread I had at Husnu's was dry and thick. When our food finaaaaally came it was another disappointment! Everything on my plate and on my husband's plate was smothered in yogurt sauce. There are way, way, way better Mediterranean restaurants in Madison - this place was not worth the money I reluctantly handed over.
yelp:test:5116.para: My experience at this restaurant was thoroughly disappointing. The service was excruciatingly slow, and our waitress was not only unengaging but also unfriendly. I typically enjoy Mediterranean bread immensely, but the piece I received at Husnu's was overly dry and thick. When our food, which seemed to take forever, finally arrived, it was another letdown. Both my plate and my husband's were drenched in yogurt sauce. Given the numerous superior Mediterranean options in Madison, this place definitely did not justify the money I reluctantly paid.

yelp:test:5117.orig: Love the food - great kebabs! Especially lamb. Raspberry chicken dish - delicious. Service is excellent. Owner is devoted to the quality of food and enjoyment of customers. He is often there to greet customers! Great atmosphere - great music. Great hummus! Oh - and try the dumplings! yum yum!
yelp:test:5117.para: I adore the food, particularly the fantastic kebabs, especially the lamb. The raspberry chicken is also outstanding. The service is top-notch, and the owner is deeply committed to ensuring both the quality of the food and the customers' enjoyment; he's usually around to welcome everyone. The atmosphere is wonderful, with great music playing, and the hummus is superb. Don't miss the dumplings—yum yum!

yelp:test:5124.orig: Great looking restaurant.  We couldn't enjoy the atmosphere though since they crammed everyone in the restaurant into one tiny section.  I agree with the comment about the food being a joke.  Service wasn't great either - lots of employees around but few smiles or greetings.  Don't be fooled by the looks of this place if you want to have a nice dinner.
yelp:test:5124.para: The restaurant has a great appearance, but we found the atmosphere disappointing because they packed most of the diners into a small area. I concur with the feedback that the food is subpar. The service was also lacking; despite having many staff members present, there were few smiles or welcomes. If you're looking for a pleasant dining experience, don't let the restaurant's exterior deceive you.

yelp:test:5185.orig: Like Clay P who posted before me, I too love pancakes. Though I love chocolate chip pancakes. But like Clay I did not love the ones that I got a the Original Pancake House. Typically, restaurants just don't do it the way I like them and I have come to expect that. Grading OPH on those terms, they did a respectable job. It is definitely a worthwhile destination for a pancake lover.
yelp:test:5185.para: Similar to Clay P, I have a fondness for pancakes, especially those with chocolate chips. However, my experience at the Original Pancake House did not meet my expectations. As is often the case with restaurants, they didn't prepare them the way I prefer. Still, OPH managed to deliver a satisfactory meal. For anyone who loves pancakes, it's definitely a place worth visiting.

yelp:test:5248.orig: The staff is really nice, and it is a cute little shop, but OMG flies galore!  Flies crawling all over the doughnuts, flies dive bombing all around the store.  The only thing this place needs to complete it is Jeff Goldblum.
yelp:test:5248.para: The employees are very friendly, and the shop is charming, but there are so many flies it's unbelievable! Flies are everywhere, crawling on the doughnuts and swooping around the entire store. The only thing missing to make this place perfect is Jeff Goldblum.

yelp:test:5280.orig: I am just shocked!  I took this same dress in to be cleaned again after I wore it, and my experience this time was the exact opposite of the first!  To begin with, I was charged $3 more this time - for the exact same item.  I questioned it, and was told they obviously charged me incorrectly the first time.  I wasn't happy about it, but what could I do.  I paid and took my dress out to the car, and as I was putting it in the car, I noticed a dark \""x\"" shaped stain on the bottom of the dress, about the size of a quarter.  This stain was NOT there when I took it in - I had inspected the entire dress thoroughly so I could point out any stains it did have (there had been some water type stains in the middle front, and a small dark dot towards the bottom).  Upon looking further, the small dot stain was gone, but the water stains were still there.  The dress also did not have that same sparkling brand new appearance to the fabric it had when they cleaned it the week before.  I took it back inside and pointed out the non-removed stain and the dark x one that hadn't been there before.  The woman said they would try to get it out and I could pick it up on Friday.  I left, and had been gon
yelp:test:5280.para: I'm truly stunned! This time, when I brought the same dress for cleaning, my experience was completely different from the last. Initially, I was charged $3 extra—still for the same dress. I questioned it, and was told they must have made a mistake the first time. Although I wasn't pleased, what else could I do? I paid and left the dress in the car. As I was placing it in the vehicle, I noticed a dark "x" shaped stain on the bottom of the dress, roughly the size of a quarter. This stain wasn't there when I dropped it off; I had carefully inspected the entire dress to highlight any existing stains (there were some water-like spots in the middle front and a small dark spot near the bottom). Upon closer inspection, the small dark spot was gone, but the water stains remained. The dress also lacked the same fresh, sparkling appearance it had after the previous cleaning. I returned inside and pointed out the stain that hadn't been removed and the new "x" shaped one. The attendant said they would attempt to clean it and I could pick it up on Friday. I left, and have been gone since.

yelp:test:5287.orig: Eh! Taste fresh for take out, I guess. I ordered the Spicy Basil with Beef. The sauce was spicy, and the vegetables were fresh, well-prepared, and plentiful. A little too plentiful. I only had a small portion of beef in my meal so I won't be returning. :-(
yelp:test:5287.para: Ah! It's fresh for takeout, I suppose. I got the Spicy Basil with Beef. The sauce was quite spicy, while the vegetables were fresh, well-cooked, and in abundance—perhaps a bit too much so. My portion of beef was quite small, and I don't plan on coming back. :-(

yelp:test:5322.orig:
It's passable. Just don't try calling the front desk. Service here is good when you can find the people or they're not on the phone. On the cell phone, with their friend, that is. -1.

The rooms were pretty small, but they got the job done. They were in the middle of remodeling, and I think we still had an unremodeled room. I say this because the beds were noticeably softer in another room that we had than the one I stayed in. -1

There was a sick stain on one of the box springs, it looked like blood. -1.

Plenty of parking, close enough to campus, easy access from I-74.
yelp:test:5322.para:
The service is acceptable, though it's hit or miss; staff members are sometimes hard to reach, and when you do get through, they might be on their cell phones with friends. -1

The rooms were on the small side but functional. We were in the midst of renovations, and I believe we had an unrenovated room, which is why the beds in another room felt noticeably softer. -1

There was a concerning stain on one of the box springs, which looked like blood. -1

The hotel offers ample parking, is conveniently located near the campus, and has easy access from I-74.

yelp:test:5327.orig:
This locksmith store seems to know what they are doing and the only locksmith store that is capable of duplicating my key. However, I was left standing there in the store without a word on for close to 10 minutes after requesting a key to be duplicated... 

When I said ""Excuse me, I don't mean to rush you, but could you tell me how long the process will take?"" I was given back the key by the owner and told that he would not be rushed. I responded ""I did not mean mean to be rude or anything"" he just walked away with his back turned against me. 

The other employee apologized and told me to come back another time.

In all honesty, how can you be the owner of a business and treat customers with so little respect and courtesy. I am not a fan.
yelp:test:5327.para:
This locksmith shop appears to be competent and the only one capable of duplicating my key. Yet, I waited for nearly 10 minutes without receiving any response after asking for a key to be duplicated.

When I politely asked, "Excuse me, I don't mean to rush you, but could you tell me how long this will take?" the owner handed me the key and said he wouldn't be hurried. I quickly added, "I didn't mean to be rude." But he turned his back and walked away.

The other employee apologized and suggested I return at another time.

Frankly, as a business owner, how can you treat customers with such a lack of respect and courtesy? I am definitely not a fan.

yelp:test:5347.orig:
Nothing is new here about my bad experience. But hopefully I can shed some light into their evil world. And then the travelers can choose wisely.

US Worst has retained its title for me in 2011.

Typical story. Mechanical failure. Flight was delayed in Palm Springs. I missed the connection in Phoenix. I was rescheduled for later flight. A delay of 4 hours.

I always avoid US Worst but sometimes it's just impossible. It helps when US Worst is part of Star Alliance (Wrong... more later). I was a United Premier member. I thought I still can get my benefit on US Worst. That's a wrong assumption.

I have experienced nightmares on more than 50% of US Worst flights. More so lately... 100% in past 2 years (2 flights). Luckily I've shifted all possible flights to other not so worst airlines.

To make a long tedious nightmare educational:
1) US Worst does not recognize the full status of United Premier. Not like United and Continental.

2) It's business as usual for US Worst. The costumer service rep expressed indifference. It reminds me of rental clerks in Las Vegas and FlorIda (""you don't like it? Too bad! Move aside, there's a long line waiting for our premiere service"")
yelp:test:5347.para:
My experience hasn't changed, but I hope to expose the true nature of US Worst, so travelers can make informed choices. In 2011, US Worst remained the worst for me.

The usual tale: a mechanical issue caused a delay in Palm Springs, leading to a missed connection in Phoenix. I was rebooked on a later flight, facing a 4-hour wait.

Even as a United Premier member, I tried to leverage my status on US Worst, but that was a mistake. Over 50% of my flights with US Worst have been problematic, and in the last two years, it's been 100% of my flights. Fortunately, I've switched to other airlines whenever possible.

To break down the experience:

1) US Worst doesn't fully honor the United Premier status, unlike United and Continental.
2) Customer service at US Worst is indifferent, similar to rental car counters in Las Vegas and Florida, where the attitude is, "If you don't like it, too bad; there are plenty of others waiting."

yelp:test:5371.orig: Loved the location for First Fridays! I loved the older crowd and more of a family atmosphere. The exhibits were absolutely wonderful. Coming from NYC and Chicago, I was not expecting too much having been spoiled with the likes of the Met, Moma, Art institute of Chicago, and museum of contemporary art in Chicago, but I was wrong! There was a special under water theme area with adorable DIY crafts and nibbbles (similar to first friday in Chicago). The fashion section was also great as was the modern exhibits with heavy hitters like my favorite Rothko. I grew a lot of appreciation for some new artists. The museum is a great size in that it is actually accomplishable in a night and similar in size to the Guggeheim. Some areas leave something to be desired but I have no regrets leaving. It was a fabulous time.
yelp:test:5371.para: I adored the location for First Fridays! The older crowd and family-friendly atmosphere were delightful. The exhibits were simply outstanding. Having come from NYC and Chicago, where I was accustomed to places like the Met and MoMA, I wasn't expecting much, but I was pleasantly surprised! There was a charming underwater-themed area with cute DIY crafts and light bites, much like the First Friday in Chicago. The fashion section and modern exhibits, featuring artists like Rothko, were also fantastic. I developed a new appreciation for some emerging artists. The museum is well-sized, making it feasible to visit in one night, similar to the Guggenheim. While some areas could be improved, I have no regrets about my visit—it was an incredible experience.

yelp:test:5396.orig: Boo on the Food! This place is way over hyped. They tried to charge $7 for a little waffle and 2 cold, greasy chicken thighs. Not impressed at all. The only reason it gets 2 stars is because the waiter was nice and the place looked cool. \n\nFirst impressions are everything, so they say, and in this instance I would agree. Since moving here over a year ago I have heard people go on and on about Lolo's chicken and waffles, especially when they find out I moved from the south. \""Oh it is the best soul food\"", \""They have the best fried chicken I have had anywhere..\"" are some of the things people have said. We live in Mesa and there is not a location near us but this morning  we were running errands in Phoenix and drove about 15 minutes out of our way so I could finally try this place that so many people have raved about. The place was decorated nice, it was not too long after they opened and it was not busy, we were seated right away. Took about 10 minutes before we saw a server, our drinks were brought out fairly quick and our order taken. Our food came out pretty quick but what difference does quick service make when the food is cold? The skin on the chicken was not even crisp
yelp:test:5396.para:
Boo on the Food! This place is way overhyped. They tried to charge $7 for a small waffle and two cold, greasy chicken thighs. I was not impressed at all. The only reason it rates two stars is due to the polite waiter and the cool ambiance. 

First impressions are crucial, as they say, and in this case, I agree. Since moving here over a year ago, I've heard people endlessly praise Lolo's chicken and waffles, especially when they learn I'm from the south. They'd say things like, "It's the best soul food," and "They have the best fried chicken I've had anywhere." Living in Mesa, we don't have a nearby location, but this morning, we drove about 15 minutes out of our way from Phoenix to finally try this place everyone raves about. The place looked nice, it wasn't too crowded, and we were seated promptly. However, it took about 10 minutes before we saw a server, and our drinks were brought quickly, but our order was taken after about 10 minutes. Our food came out fast, but what does quick service matter when the food was cold? The chicken's skin wasn't even crispy.

yelp:test:5443.orig: Really cool lights at the fair tonight look to the north and see such a delight.\nWell last night was the last day of the fair is closed it's gone now for next year but they will be the next fair in the spring.
yelp:test:5443.para: The fair had amazing lights tonight, especially when you look to the north. It was a real treat. Although last night was the final day of the fair, which has now closed and won't be back until next year, there will be another fair in the spring.

yelp:test:5484.orig:
The food is always been amazing there and they have great deal
When my wife wants to go out to breakfast that is where we go

The omelettes are the best
yelp:test:5484.para: The food is consistently amazing, and they offer fantastic deals. Whenever my wife craves breakfast outside, that's our go-to place. The omelettes are simply the best.

yelp:test:5559.orig: Best place in the valley for dim sum.  They are always consistent.  I've been coming here for over 10 years.  Since I'm allergic to MSG and dim sum always contains MSG, I often order off the menu and request no MSG.  I'll eat some of the dim sum and suffer the effects of MSG afterwards.  My dim sum favs - har gow, sui mai, char sui bao, and coconut dessert.  Dinner - best peking duck with the buns and steamed fish.  Overall, good place for chinese.
yelp:test:5559.para: This valley's best spot for dim sum, consistently reliable. I've been a regular for more than a decade. Given my MSG allergy, I frequently ask for items without it. I enjoy the dim sum but then experience the MSG effects later. Among my favorites are har gow, sui mai, char sui bao, and coconut dessert. For dinner, the Peking duck with buns and steamed fish are top-notch. In summary, it's a great Chinese restaurant.

yelp:test:5594.orig: This is actually kind of sad. The customer service here is very good. Food was served quickly and tasted fine. Here's my problem. I ordered a 3 pc meal. What I got was two pieces of chicken (leg & thigh) and the one thigh had been cut into two pieces. No, really, I'm not kidding! (see photo) WTF? Are you kidding me. Then, once you get to your table and sit down, you realize the Salt Police have left a note insinuating that your eating too much Sodium and you need some extra exercise if you want the salt shaker because you have to get back up and go get one. COME ON GUYS! For a $10 meal I want 3 REAL pieces of chicken and a salt shaker! Ugh!
yelp:test:5594.para: This situation is quite disappointing. The customer service is excellent, and the food was served promptly and tasted decent. However, there's an issue I need to address. I ordered a 3-piece meal, but what I received were two pieces of chicken (a leg and a thigh), and the thigh was cut into two smaller pieces. No, I’m not joking—check the photo. This is really frustrating! Then, when you sit down at your table, you notice a note from the Salt Police suggesting that you need to exercise more if you want to use the salt shaker, as you have to get up and retrieve it yourself. This is ridiculous! For a $10 meal, I expect three whole pieces of chicken and easy access to a salt shaker! Ugh!

yelp:test:5661.orig:
I can't remember how we came upon this company, but dealing with this company last year was very pleasant.  After calling several A/C companies, we settled on having this company put in the new A/C unit with a good warranty on it.  We had a Carrier unit put on and it was in the middle of the range in terms of price - not the cheapest nor the least expensive.  

I think after everything was said and done, it was close to $7K for a new ground unit to adequately cool an almost 1800 sq ft home in central AZ.  

They did not try to high pressure sell us or anything.  Once we decided and set up the appointment, they came at the time they said they would and installed the outside unit as well as replaced the heater coil or whatever it's called up in the attic.

We were up and running in no time and the electric bills have been lower with a new more efficient unit.  It keeps the house cool and works great.  We typically don't run the unit in the winter - the heater, so at least part of the year it gets rest.

Would use this company again.  Very professional.
yelp:test:5661.para:
Last year, we had a positive experience with this company when we installed a new A/C unit. After contacting a few A/C providers, we chose this company for its good warranty and a price that was neither the lowest nor the highest. The Carrier unit they installed was around the middle of the price range, suitable for our nearly 1800 square foot home in central Arizona, which cost close to $7,000 for the new ground unit.

They didn't pressure us to buy anything extra. They arrived on time for the scheduled installation and replaced the heater coil in the attic. We were up and running quickly, and since the new unit is more efficient, our electricity bills have decreased. It effectively cools the house and works well. We usually don't use the heater part of the unit in the winter, giving it a break for at least part of the year.

I would definitely use this company again; they are very professional.

yelp:test:5670.orig:
UGGGHH ~ DON'T do it!!! I really wanted 2 like this place but it's not a 'Gr8' anything except @ giving violent lengthy sessions praying 2 the porcelain gods as a result of giving them a try (a gamble I was pretty quickly sorry 4 having taken if it weren't 4 my lunch companion's insistence).

   I wasn't expecting much & everything I tried seemed 2 b @ the right temp & most items ranged from decent-good tasting, but 15 min8es in I fell ill w/ severe pain & loud thunderous disapproval stemming from my extremely unhappy stomach. yelp:test:5670.para:
Ughhh ~ NO! I really hoped I would like this place, but it's only great for giving long, intense sessions of prayer to the porcelain gods after trying their food (a gamble I regretted almost immediately, thanks to my lunch companion's insistence). 

I didn't have high expectations, and most of the food was at the right temperature, ranging from decent to good. However, about 15 minutes in, I started feeling ill with severe pain and loud, thunderous disapproval from my upset stomach.
