yelp:test:5689.orig:
So I live in the ghetto and this is the Home Depot I go to even though there is one a tad closer to my house. 

The staff here is always very friendly and very very helpful! On my recent trip Denny in the hardware section was beyond helpful, I wouldnt have been able to complete my project without his help! 

The Hubs and I also purchased carpeting from here for our bedrooms. They look great and were installed quickly!
yelp:test:5689.para: I reside in the ghetto and frequently visit this Home Depot, despite another one being closer to my home. The staff is consistently very friendly and extremely helpful. During my last visit, Denny in the hardware section was exceptionally supportive; I couldn't have finished my project without his assistance! Additionally, The Hubs and I bought carpet for our bedrooms from here, and the results are fantastic—plus, the installation was done swiftly!

yelp:test:5716.orig:
Movers Beware- Before you use this company- read this!  We used this company because the salesperson said they were the best and that they had no complaints.  They didn't have any complaints when I checked.  When the packers showed up, and the truck, everyone was great.  I even went out and bought everyone lunch so they could eat because otherwise they were not going to take a break during packing or loading.  

From AZ to CO the truck had just over a week before we could move into our house so they said they went straight to the casino in New Mexico.  

When we moved in our new house - the driver gave us two options - 1) check off the boxes to make sure you receive everything, or 2) have them place the furniture where you want it in the house.  If you pick option # 1 they ""dump"" the furniture wherever and you place it later after they leave.  At least that's what I was told when the truck arrived to our new house in CO. 

As I was unpacking, I found items missing - a Kitchen Aid 6 quart mixer, and a brand new Vita Mix in the box my mom had purchased for us as a gift.  We left it in the box for them to pack, thinking it would be easier for them to pack.  Also missing was
yelp:test:5716.para:
Caution for Movers—Read This Before You Hire!

We chose this moving company based on a salesperson's recommendation and the assurance that they had no complaints. Upon checking, they indeed had no issues. The packers and the truck arrived, and everyone was excellent. I even bought lunch for them to ensure they could take breaks during the packing and loading.

The journey from Arizona to Colorado took just over a week, so they drove directly to a casino in New Mexico.

Upon moving into our new home, the driver offered two choices: either check the boxes to confirm receipt of all items or have them place the furniture where we wanted it. If you opt for the first choice, they will simply "dump" the furniture wherever and expect you to arrange it later. That's what I was told when the truck arrived in Colorado.

As I began unpacking, I discovered several items were missing, including a KitchenAid 6-quart mixer and a brand new Vita Mix blender that my mother had packed for us as a gift. We left it in the box, thinking it would be easier for them to pack.

yelp:test:5771.orig:
Blech. The Good Egg my dupa! It's more like ""The Bad Egg""! As someone who loves trying new places for breakfast food, the one and only time I have ever eaten here, I got sick. In fact, both the BF and I didn't feel good the rest of the day after eating omelettes from this crap-hole.

Every time I drive by this place (which is every single day because I live in the neighborhood) I say out loud, ""Blech. More like the Bad Egg!"" 

I don't know about other locations in the valley...but stay away from the one on 29th/Bell!
yelp:test:5771.para:
Ugh, The Good Egg? More like "The Bad Egg"! As a breakfast food enthusiast, my only visit to this place left me feeling unwell. My partner and I didn't feel great for the rest of the day after having omelettes there.

Every day as I pass by this establishment, I can't help but exclaim, "Ugh, more like the Bad Egg!" 

I'm not sure about other locations, but avoid the one on 29th and Bell at all costs!

yelp:test:5772.orig: We went to Top Shelf because we had a coupon from our Entertainment book for a buy one, get one free entree.  When we got to the restaurant, we hung out in the waiting area for a few minutes before the hostess came to seat us, but we enjoyed looking at the fish tank while we waited.  Our waitress was nice and kept our drinks filled and the food was pretty good, but maybe a little pricey for the portions.  When the bill came, we gave the waitress our coupon.  She brought back the bill and our kid's meal was the one given to us free.  When we asked, she said she tried to give us the second adult entree as the free meal, but the manager wouldn't let her.  She then had the manager come talk to us, but he wouldn't budge on the matter.  I have never been to a restaurant that considers a kid's meal to be an entree.  It seems this company is more concerned with making a couple bucks than good service that brings back return customers.
yelp:test:5772.para: We visited Top Shelf with a buy one, get one free entree coupon from our Entertainment book. We waited a few minutes in the lounge before being seated, during which we enjoyed watching the fish tank. Our server was pleasant, kept our drinks topped up, and the food was decent, though perhaps a bit expensive for the portion sizes. Upon receiving the bill, we presented our coupon. The server returned with the bill, and it turned out the free meal was a kids' meal instead of an adult entree. When we inquired, she said the manager wouldn't allow her to give us a free adult entree. The manager then spoke with us but refused to change the policy. I've never encountered a restaurant where a kids' meal is considered an entree. It appears the company prioritizes profit over customer satisfaction and repeat business.

yelp:test:5801.orig: Love this little place. The coffee is always fresh and they have some yummy salads, sandwiches and sweet treats. I'm here about once or twice a month and always something good to enjoy.
yelp:test:5801.para: I adore this cozy spot. The coffee is consistently fresh, and they offer delicious salads, sandwiches, and sweet snacks. I visit here roughly once or twice a month, and there's always something delightful to savor.

yelp:test:5870.orig:
My husband always chooses Watson's when he orders me flowers and they never disappoint.  I received an arrangement of white lilies with white babies breath on September 13th for our 35th wedding anniversary.  My husband didn't know the address of my office, but told them the name of the company and they took care of the rest.  My flowers arrived at the correct location, no problem.

The arrangement came with quite a few buds and one by one they all opened.  It is now September 21st and I still have one lily left.  I know I'll have to probably throw it out tomorrow, but the babies breath still look as good as they day they arrived.

Watson's always uses the freshest flowers that last days longer then any other florist's I've experienced.
yelp:test:5870.para:
My husband consistently opts for Watson's when he sends me flowers, and they never fail to impress. On September 13th, for our 35th wedding anniversary, I received a beautiful arrangement of white lilies and white baby's breath. My husband didn't have my office address, so he provided the company name, and Watson's handled the delivery seamlessly. The flowers were delivered to the correct location without any issues.

The bouquet included numerous buds that gradually bloomed. As of September 21st, I still have one lily remaining. While I'll likely need to discard it tomorrow, the baby's breath remains in excellent condition, just as it was on the day it arrived.

Watson's consistently uses the freshest flowers, which last significantly longer than those from other florists I've used.

yelp:test:5915.orig: The supreme breakfast burrito is the number one breakfast burro in chandler, a must try for all.  I am impressed with the meat portions in the taco/enchilada combos as well..the downers...they desperately need some spicy hot sauce.  I hope to see this place do well and stick around for a long time to come.  I would also like to see the owner be a little tougher on a few of his employees (dress code, on the phone while working, smoking out front, etc). Overall, great spot to fill the hunger void for less than $10.00..giant drinks as well.
yelp:test:5915.para: The top breakfast burrito in Chandler is a must-try, and I'm particularly impressed with the generous meat portions in their taco and enchilada combos. However, they could improve by offering more spicy hot sauce. I hope this place continues to thrive and remains open for a long time. I also wish the owner would enforce stricter standards for his staff, such as proper dress code and no smoking or phone use while working. Overall, it's an excellent spot for a satisfying meal under $10, with large drink portions to boot.

yelp:test:5933.orig: not the best for family dining and man was it not worth it! I am a huge fan of Elmer's Tacos (right down the street) and thought I would give Guedo's a try for once. MISTAKE. What kind of a place doesn't take CC's?  Disappointing to say the least. Food was below average and the lack of service and smiles really annoyed me.
yelp:test:5933.para: Definitely not a great choice for family dining, and it was a huge letdown! As a big fan of Elmer's Tacos just a block away, I decided to check out Guedo's for a change. Big mistake. How can a restaurant not accept credit cards? The experience was thoroughly disappointing. The food was subpar, and the poor service and lack of friendly smiles really irked me.

yelp:test:5936.orig: I found the food to be okay, not great,  but the prices were quite high.  $3 for a side of chips and I think you could have counted about 35 chips in the bowl.  The salsa was delicious but the chicken burro was not that good and again quite pricey for the small size of it.  Also, shabby chic would be a huge upgrade from this mess of a restaurant.  Just a little too run-down for my liking.
yelp:test:5936.para: The food was decent but not exceptional, and the prices seemed steep. A side of chips cost $3, and the bowl contained only about 35 chips. While the salsa was excellent, the chicken burro was disappointing and similarly overpriced for its size. The restaurant could use a significant upgrade; it feels a bit too rundown for my taste.

yelp:test:5989.orig: Maybe I haven't been to Dos Gringos in a while, or maybe this location is just grosser than the Tempe location, but this place is dirty!  The bathroom has a bad smell coming from it and everything just seems kinda filthy.  I would never ever order food from here, if their bar area is this dirty I can only imagine how gross the kitchen is... I'm not really sure why people would hang out here when there are plenty of nicer and more fun spots in Scottsdale.
yelp:test:5989.para: I haven't visited Dos Gringos recently, but this location appears to be even more unsanitary than the one in Tempe. The place is quite dirty; the bathroom has a foul odor, and everything seems rather grimy. Given how messy the bar area is, I can only assume the kitchen is even worse. It's hard to understand why anyone would stay here when there are so many cleaner and more enjoyable places to hang out in Scottsdale.

yelp:test:5994.orig: Read all the reviews before going so I was a little skeptical but thought I would try anyway. Cute little place, seated right away which was good for a Saturday at 1230. Ordered eggs Benedict but they had sold out! A breakfast place that runs out of breakfast food, hum. Got the breakfast sandwich which came out cut in half, on a large white plate with no garnish. Had to ask for silverware and napkins. Service was ok, sandwich average.
yelp:test:5994.para: I decided to read all the reviews beforehand, which made me a bit doubtful, but I still decided to give it a try. The place is small and charming, and they seated me promptly, which was nice for a Saturday lunchtime around 12:30. I ordered the eggs Benedict, but they were sold out, which was disappointing for a breakfast spot. I ended up getting the breakfast sandwich, which was served in half on a large white plate with no additional toppings. I had to ask for silverware and napkins myself. The service was just okay, and the sandwich was average.

yelp:test:6001.orig: I've picked up a gyro from here before and couldn't really remember if I had liked it, so I stopped to grab something quick on my way back to work. I've read some reviews that say their falafel is good, which I can't speak to. I can say that the gyro, the side greek salad that came with it and the baklawa were overpriced and disgusting. The shredded iceberg that topped the gyro and comprised most of the salad was browing and reminded me of what subway would have thrown out .The baklawa was soggy. This might explain why they were completely empty and able to serve me quickly right around noon on a week day. I'd say the Schlotsky's two doors down would be a better and cheaper options. If I really want a gyro, I'll go the mall food court and get a cheaper gyro that actually tastes good from Pita Jungle.
yelp:test:6001.para: I had previously picked up a gyro from this place without really knowing if I enjoyed it, so I stopped by for a quick bite on my way back to work. While some reviews praise their falafel, I can't comment on that. What I can say is that the gyro, the accompanying Greek salad, and the baklawa were all overpriced and unappetizing. The shredded iceberg lettuce on top of the gyro, which made up most of the salad, was browned and reminded me of discarded Subway vegetables. The baklawa was also soggy. This might explain why the place was nearly empty and able to serve me so quickly around noon on a weekday. I think Schlotsky's just two doors away would be a better and more affordable option. If I want a decent gyro, I’ll head to the mall food court and get one from Pita Jungle, which is cheaper and tastier.

yelp:test:6124.orig:
All you chocolate elitists can turn your noses up at See's all you want.  I love it, and I always will.

See's was the ""special"" candy my family tried to order every Christmas.  Back in those days before the internet (we still had 8-track tape players) at a time when no one really knew anything existed other than what you had seen, there was Russell Stover, Whitman's Samplers (that my cheap ass uncle was fond of giving in lieu of a real present), and See's.  There was no comparison.  See's was it.  I didn't even know they had stores then, much less stores that give out free candy just for coming in.  Kind of like a test drive without the pressure.

And I still prefer See's over it's closest competitor to me, location-wise, Godiva.  Why?  Well, the free candy for one.  Number two, it doesn't cost $60 a pound, more like $16.  Granted, Godiva has prettier packaging and perhaps a better product, but not enough to compromise my loyalty.  

I was recently saddened to see the store at Fashion Square close, but luckily, this one is nearby.  Much larger and easier to shop in, but my only complaint is that I had to stand in line with people hand-picking their boxes to pay for my pr
yelp:test:6124.para:
Despite all the chocolate connoisseurs who disdain See's, I remain a devoted fan and always will be.

In the pre-internet era, when 8-track tapes were the norm and our world was limited to what we could see, See's was the standout candy my family would try to order every Christmas. Compared to Russell Stover and Whitman's Samplers, See's was unparalleled. I didn't even know they had physical stores back then, let alone ones that offered free samples to visitors—it was like a sampling without the pressure.

Even now, I prefer See's to its closest competitor, Godiva, especially in terms of pricing. See's is much more affordable, coming in at around $16 per pound, whereas Godiva can cost up to $60. While Godiva does have more attractive packaging and possibly a superior product, it's not enough to sway my loyalty.

I was disappointed to see the Fashion Square store close, but I'm relieved that a nearby one is still open. This one is larger and more convenient to shop in, but my only gripe is having to wait in line while others carefully select their boxes.

yelp:test:6130.orig: May be good - but must have more business than he can handle.\nCalled and left a message that the heater in my Phoenix house had quit.  Left phone number.  No response.
yelp:test:6130.para: It could be promising, but he seems to be overwhelmed with work. I called to report that the heater in my Phoenix home had stopped working and left my contact number, but there was no reply.

yelp:test:6178.orig: It's PF Changs.  It's generic Americanized asian food.  What else is there to say.
yelp:test:6178.para: It's PF Changs, offering typical, Americanized Asian cuisine. Is there anything else worth mentioning?

yelp:test:6201.orig: Love this place, great Thai food. We ordered Panang, Egg Rolls, Thai Fried Rice and Pad Thai. Everything was amazing except the Pad Thai. They use really thin noodles, which I've not seen before. It wasn't my favorite, but everything else was delicious. I would definitely go back!
yelp:test:6201.para: I absolutely adore this restaurant, and their Thai cuisine is outstanding. We tried the Panang, Egg Rolls, Thai Fried Rice, and Pad Thai. While everything else was fantastic, the Pad Thai stood out as different because they used very thin noodles, a style I haven't encountered before. It wasn't my top pick, but the rest of the dishes were delightful. I definitely plan to return!

yelp:test:6206.orig: New Mexican cuisine ...awesome food....and our waiter was right on the ball...sat outside on patio which at night is terrific...lighting ....fire places .......heaters to keep you warm...causual and relaxing.....prices on menu very affordable for all that you get....as Meg says this place is \""bomb.com\""
yelp:test:6206.para: New Mexican cuisine is fantastic, and our waiter was very attentive. We enjoyed sitting outside on the patio, which is especially pleasant at night with its great lighting, fireplaces, and heaters to keep us warm. The atmosphere is casual and relaxing. The menu prices are very reasonable for everything you get. As Meg puts it, this place is "bomb.com."

yelp:test:6228.orig: Their 'shrimp & scallops Antoinette' (with white wine & artichoke hearts) was delicious!
yelp:test:6228.para: The 'shrimp and scallops Antoinette' (cooked with white wine and artichoke hearts) was superb!

yelp:test:6311.orig: Poor Management!!! I wish I would have read the other reviews before eating at Bandera tonight. I was a long time fan and I'm still a big fan of Hillstone on Camelback. But will not go back to Bandera until I'm notified the manager \""Mark Poltntan\"" is no longer employed by Hillstone.
yelp:test:6311.para: Such Poor Management! Regretfully, I wish I had checked the previous reviews before dining at Bandera tonight. Although I've been a loyal customer for a long time and still adore Hillstone on Camelback, I won't return to Bandera until I'm informed that "Mark Poltntan" is no longer with the company.

yelp:test:6319.orig: A lot better than Starbucks... Love the hazelnut iced blended drink.  I always search out coffee bean wherever I go. I only need Starbucks if there is no coffee bean.\n\nThe chai tea latte is also far better than Starbucks.
yelp:test:6319.para: Much preferable to Starbucks... I adore the hazelnut iced blended drink. Whenever I travel, I make sure to find Coffee Bean. If there's no Coffee Bean, I'll settle for Starbucks. The chai tea latte also surpasses Starbucks in quality.

yelp:test:6326.orig:
This boutique was one of my absolute favorites! I used to always shop here when I was trying to find a cute outfit for a special night out.  I was so sad to see the actual store front close.  Although I guess they are still online- that seems to be the direction many clothing stores are headed right now.  

I think the Hilton Village is doing a complete remodel because many of the stores there are all closed right now.  

I did find out that their other location Sherre's up in Cave Creek is still open so I will continue shopping there!
yelp:test:6326.para:
This boutique was my top pick, and I frequently shopped there to find stylish outfits for special occasions. I was deeply disappointed to see the physical store close. While they are still operating online, it appears that many clothing stores are moving that way. 

I understand that the Hilton Village is undergoing a major renovation, as numerous stores there are currently closed. 

Fortunately, I learned that their other location, Sherre's in Cave Creek, is still open, so I'll continue shopping there.

yelp:test:6329.orig: I have been to this restaurant dozens of times throughout the years. I find the steaks are always good, but the seafood is really hit or miss. Was there yesterday and my lobster was totally over cooked. It was like complete rubber. It was barely edible. I should have known better to order it there, but I love surf and turf so I gave it a shot. Very disappointing.
yelp:test:6329.para: Over the years, I've visited this restaurant numerous times. While the steaks are consistently satisfying, the seafood can be unpredictable. Yesterday, I ordered lobster, which was severely overcooked—almost like rubber and barely edible. Despite knowing it might not be the best choice, I decided to try the surf and turf. Overall, it was a very disappointing experience.

yelp:test:6396.orig: Really an average course that was fairly easy. The bummer was no beverage cart when we played Saturday and it was 100. I would not golf here again.
yelp:test:6396.para: The course was pretty ordinary and quite easy to play. The downside was that there was no beverage cart available on Saturday when the temperature hit 100 degrees. I don't plan to golf there again.

yelp:test:6404.orig: Rarely do I give a 1 star rating but after four attempts in four months to get my fax line and internet rolling I can honestly say they have earned this.  After finally showing up for a scheduled appointment the tech told us our internet was fine but we disagree because we are getting the same speed we had with Qwest in Cave Creek (SLOW)  and they are charging us $64 a month for what they call the upgraded 20mbs.  Furthermore, I tried to send out a couple faxes after he left and the line is not responding.  Im going to drive down to the store tomorrow and demand that they remove the fees for service I have not received and just get efax.  As I noted in the first review we were excited to upgrade to faster internet so that makes this experience even worse.
yelp:test:6404.para: I rarely give a 1-star rating, but after making four attempts over four months to activate my fax line and internet, I must say they deserve it. Despite the tech's claim that our internet was fine during a scheduled visit, we still experience the same slow speeds we had with Qwest in Cave Creek, and we're being charged $64 a month for what they term an "upgraded" 20mbps service. Additionally, the fax line isn't working as expected after the tech left. I plan to visit the store tomorrow to demand the removal of fees for the service I haven't received and to switch to efax. Given that we were looking forward to faster internet, this experience is even more disappointing.

yelp:test:6409.orig: Don knows how to treat a customer.  Outstanding customer service and products are the best.  Honest, reliable and trustworthy.  I agree with the other post that rate this business 5 stars.  I will not take my vehicle any place else.
yelp:test:6409.para: Don excels at customer service. The products are top-notch, and he's honest and dependable. I fully concur with the previous review and would give this business a perfect 5-star rating. I won't consider taking my vehicle anywhere else.

yelp:test:6410.orig:
Woo Loo Loo!

It's official. I'm now a part of the Monk's Club. I'm stoked! Wait, who says that? I'm totally showing my age, huh?

I love beer!
yelp:test:6410.para:
Yay!

I've officially joined the Monk's Club, and I'm really excited about it. Oh wait, did I just say "stoked"? Maybe I am showing my age... 

I absolutely adore beer!

yelp:test:6485.orig: This is really an exceptional italian deli!  Great sandwich's - great atmosphere.  Would certainly come again when in the Scottsdale area.
yelp:test:6485.para: This is truly an outstanding Italian deli! The sandwiches are fantastic, and the ambiance is wonderful too. I'd definitely return when I'm in the Scottsdale area.

yelp:test:6488.orig:
I had heard about this place for years but never went. Tragic I know! Just recently I discovered that it was literally walking distance from Jester'Z Improv where I work. Oh, how i must now make up for lost time!

Pop the Soda Shop is a true place of brilliants. They have a fantastic selection and a very knowledgeable staff. When you come to pops that is what you are looking for, product. And they have the best selection in town. 

A couple of recommendations. Doctor Eli's Blueberry, Jackson Hole Huckelberry, or really any thing in the Birch Beer section!
yelp:test:6488.para:
For years, I'd heard about Pop the Soda Shop but never visited. What a regret! Now that I've realized it's just a short walk from Jester'Z Improv, where I work, I feel compelled to catch up on lost time.

Pop the Soda Shop truly shines with its outstanding selection and knowledgeable staff. When you visit, you're seeking top-notch products, and they offer the best in town. 

I highly recommend trying the Doctor Eli's Blueberry, Jackson Hole Huckelberry, or any Birch Beer from their array!

yelp:test:6508.orig:
I have been to RA a few times and 2-3 have been at this location. My most recent meal here was incredible.

The shishito peppers are a must-have. The ponzu sauce had us tipping the empty bowl over to lick, drink, and pour on our remaining rice. It was that good.

We tried the Pacific Roll, which is essentially the experience of eating fresh mango salsa. It's not what I would call sushi, but it was tasty and refreshing. The sashimi is solid as well. The lunch combo is ~$10 and they will mix and match any 7 pieces of tuna/salmon/yellowtail you want.

This location, located in downtown Tempe on Mill Ave, is a bit more of a club/bar style than the others I've seen. They play lots of upbeat club/remix/techno music at all times of day. The service was friendly and decent.
yelp:test:6508.para:
I've visited RA a couple of times, and two of those visits were at this particular location. My latest meal there was outstanding.

The shishito peppers are a must-try. The ponzu sauce was so delicious that we emptied the bowl, licked the bottom, and poured it over our rice. It was that good.

We ordered the Pacific Roll, which offered a fresh mango salsa experience. While it's not traditional sushi, it was quite tasty and refreshing. The sashimi is also of good quality. The lunch combo costs around $10 and allows you to choose any seven pieces of tuna, salmon, or yellowtail.

This Tempe location, situated on Mill Avenue, has a club/bar atmosphere, unlike some of the others I've visited. They play upbeat club/remix/techno music throughout the day. The service was friendly and satisfactory.

yelp:test:6520.orig: its an enjoyable atmosphere for all 21+\n(: The beer is Delicious and so is the food - However I unfortunately, can not say the same about the HELP.The service was terrible the waitress were rude not only  to us but to each other....
yelp:test:6520.para: It's a pleasant environment for those 21 and over (:) The beer and food are both excellent, but I must遗憾地说，我对服务员的态度非常不满意。她们对我们和其他顾客都很粗鲁……

yelp:test:6527.orig: If you are ever in Tempe, AZ find your way over here. The food is American/Bar food but it is a huge step above your average American/Bar food. We sampled the entire menu and everything was great. The batter for the fish and chicken is straight amazing. The beer bread they use on the wraps is simply great. The wings are top notch. See what I mean, doesn't matter what you order. Then to compliment all the great food are their tasty home brewed craft beers. They have something for everyone. On the off chance you don't like beer, the Bloody Mary spicy or not is a great alternative. The reason I gave this place the five stars because to round out the total experience is the service. I only rate a place five start as when I receive the total package drink, food, and service. Great place, come on in.
yelp:test:6527.para: If you're ever in Tempe, AZ, make sure to visit this place. Their food, which is a mix of American and bar fare, exceeds expectations. We tried everything on the menu, and it was all fantastic. The batter for the fish and chicken is outstanding, and the beer bread in the wraps is simply delicious. The wings are top-notch as well. No matter what you order, it's going to be great. To top it off, they offer tasty, home-brewed craft beers that cater to everyone's taste. Even if you don't enjoy beer, their Bloody Marys, spicy or not, are a fantastic alternative. I gave this place five stars because the service is exceptional, completing the overall experience. Great place, definitely worth a visit.

yelp:test:6529.orig:
Only stopped in for one drink, but like it enough to return to try the rest out!

The atmosphere was great, you might have to yell a little bit to be heard, but that's part of the thrill of coming here. 

I ended up with a seasonal brew called Odelay! which is a delicious mexican chocolate ale. If you're worried about too much sweetness, then there are no worries with this brew. Get it if you are looking for a solid dark ale. 

Sidenote - Had I seen it, I would have gone for the beer sampler that they had. There were a ton of beers on the wood board and it looked delicious!

My partner had the Raj IPA. For those who don't drink IPA often this was a smooth one. Had a little kick, per usual of the brew, but a nice introduction to what standard IPA's taste like. In addition, the appetizers were good, but I personally found them a little flavorless. Don't get me wrong though, they were FILLING. The calamari and the spinach dip were rich, and we felt pretty full after trying both of them. A little more salt wouldn't hurt though. 

This place loses a star for the service. Everyone was friendly, but our server was fairly unattached to our experience and stopped by three times to
yelp:test:6529.para:
I only stopped by for one drink, but I enjoyed it enough to come back and try more!

The ambiance was fantastic, though you might need to shout a bit to be heard, which adds to the experience. I opted for the seasonal brew, Odelay, a delightful Mexican chocolate ale. If you're concerned about sweetness, this ale won't disappoint. It's a great choice for a robust dark ale.

By the way, if I had noticed, I would have gone for the beer sampler. There were numerous beers on the wooden board, and it looked very appealing!

My companion tried the Raj IPA. For those who don't frequently drink IPAs, this was a smooth option. It had a slight kick, as expected, but it was a good introduction to the taste of standard IPAs. The appetizers were decent, though I found them a bit bland. They were filling, though, with the calamari and spinach dip being particularly rich. A bit more salt would have been nice.

The place loses a star due to the service. Everyone was friendly, but our server was somewhat detached, checking in on us only three times.

yelp:test:6534.orig: Gotta be the most affordable sushi happy hour prices in all of Phoenix. Really great sushi, really great service!
yelp:test:6534.para: The sushi happy hour prices here are the most affordable in Phoenix. The quality of the sushi and service is really great!

yelp:test:6541.orig:
Was out on a date yesterday, and we had worked up an appitite.  We were on the light rail, and decided to stop off on Mill to find food.  Walked down mill for a second, and found silvermine subs.  SCORE!

I had never been here before but I liked it.  Its not the fanciest place.  Simple location, good food, decent prices.  They seemed to have a good selection of hot and cold subs, with different side items and combo meals.  I got the King Bullion, and it was tasty!  I went with the small sub (5 inches) a large pop and some chips.  Food was up in no time flat.  Seems to be a college kid hang out, especially considering the location. 

Would return in a heartbeat.  Tasty, reasonably priced, and right off the light rail on Mill.
yelp:test:6541.para:
Yesterday, I went on a date and we got quite hungry. We were on the light rail and decided to stop at Mill Street to find something to eat. After a short walk, we found Silvermine Subs. SCORE!

I hadn't been there before, but I enjoyed it. It’s not a fancy place; it’s more simple with a straightforward setup. The food was good, and the prices were reasonable. They offered a variety of hot and cold subs, along with different side dishes and combo meals. I ordered the King Bullion, and it was delicious! I got the small sub (5 inches), a large soda, and some chips. The food arrived quickly. The place seemed to be popular among college students, given its location.

I would definitely return. The food was tasty, the prices were reasonable, and it’s conveniently located right off the light rail on Mill Street.

yelp:test:6554.orig: Came back, service was on the ball and friendly, food was fast, and was what we ordered. Tables and counters were way cleaner too though we did come much earlier this time. Soda machine was still flat but didn't matter since we went right back up for Kool-aid. Win.
yelp:test:6554.para: Upon returning, the service was prompt and courteous, and the food arrived quickly, matching our order exactly. The tables and counters were notably cleaner this time, even though we arrived earlier. The soda machine was still flat, but that didn't matter as we opted for Kool-aid instead. A win all around.

yelp:test:6560.orig:
I was so pleased with the service that we received on a recent visit to Chili's.  

We often go get an afternoon snack of appetizers when we're out and about.  Hands down, one of our new favorite places to go is Chili's for their bottomless chips and salsa.  Order a couple of drinks and we're set for an afternoon snack.  Server was so friendly!  Honestly, it's been a while since we've had such great customer service!  He was all smiles while he brought us basket after basket of chips.  We actually joked about feeling bad that it was so cheap and that we ate so many chips.  His response, ""I'll bring you as many baskets of chips as you want!  That's what I'm here for!""  

Oh, and the chips and salsa are so good!  Totally unexpected for a large chain restaurant.  Fresh chips made in house and yummy salsa......it's actually kind of pathetic that we thought that the salsa was better than what is served in MANY of the Mexian food restaurants around town.  Salsa should never be an afterthougt.....

Thanks for surprising us Chili's!
yelp:test:6560.para:
On my recent visit to Chili's, I was thoroughly delighted with the service we received. We frequently stop by for afternoon snacks, and Chili's has become one of our favorite spots, especially for their bottomless chips and salsa. We order a couple of drinks, and it’s perfect for an afternoon treat. The server was incredibly friendly, bringing basket after basket of chips with a smile. We joked about feeling bad that the chips were so cheap and that we ate so many, to which he replied, "I'll bring you as many baskets as you want! That's what I'm here for!"

The chips and salsa were outstanding, far exceeding our expectations for a large chain restaurant. The chips are freshly made in-house, and the salsa is delicious. We were so impressed that we now think the salsa served at many local Mexican restaurants is subpar. Salsa should never be an afterthought.

Thank you, Chili's, for such a pleasant surprise!

yelp:test:6563.orig: This is the most overpriced food in Tempe.  It has a great spot on mill and you can watch everyone go by, but too bad you couldn't do that and not buy anything.  If you want to sit on this block, you might as well go to hooters across the way.  At least you could save some money and eat the same quality food.  There are many good places to eat on Mill, so skip this one.
yelp:test:6563.para: While this place in Tempe is well-located on Mill Street with great people-watching, it's unfortunately too expensive for the experience. If you're just looking to sit and observe, you might as well head to Hooters next door, where the food is just as good and the prices are more reasonable. With plenty of other quality dining options on Mill, it's best to avoid this one.

yelp:test:6614.orig: WoW.. Great Service, Great Food.. Typical traditional Diner.. Fabulous.. Enjoy!
yelp:test:6614.para: Wow! Excellent service and delicious food. It's a classic diner experience. Simply fabulous—enjoy your meal!

yelp:test:6644.orig: Went with a Groupon for the Buffet. At least half the dishes were too salty to eat. I mentioned this to the Owner(?) and she said that everyone's taste is different. The mango lassi was too sweet too.
yelp:test:6644.para: Used a Groupon for the buffet, but at least half the dishes were overly salty and inedible. I brought this up to the owner, who responded that people's tastes vary. The mango lassi was also excessively sweet.

yelp:test:6652.orig:
This place definitely wow'd me!  I'm a California native and I was in Tempe for a wedding and me and fiance came here on two occasions, for lunch and late night drinks.
For lunch we decided to visit this place, since it was so close to our hotel.  It was fairly quiet in there so we got seated and helped immediately.  Our server did a great job making sure we were happy and satisfied.  I believe her name was Rachel, very talkative lively lady, kudos to her for doing a good job.
The next day we came here with a bunch of friends for some late night drinks.  All I can say was it was busy!  But I particularly liked the environment and feel of the place.  There was a live band rocking out to keep everyone entertained, the outside patio was alive with people but we all managed to find a great spot to chill out at.  The servers were incredibly polite and made sure everyone had a drink and didn't have to wait.  They also were very quick to clean up empty mugs.
Overall some really good service here!  I would definitely recommend this place to anyone in the Tempe area.
yelp:test:6652.para:
This location truly impressed me! As a native Californian, I visited Tempe for a wedding, and my fiancé and I went to this place twice—once for lunch and another time for late-night drinks.

For lunch, we chose to dine here because it was conveniently close to our hotel. The place was relatively quiet, and we were promptly seated. Our server, whom I believe was named Rachel, was very attentive and ensured we were satisfied. She was a chatty and lively person, and her service was excellent.

The following day, we returned with a group of friends for drinks in the evening. It was quite busy, but I really enjoyed the atmosphere and vibe of the place. There was a live band playing, which kept everyone entertained. The outdoor patio was bustling, but we managed to find a comfortable spot to relax. The staff was extremely polite and made sure everyone had a drink without waiting. They also quickly cleared away empty mugs.

Overall, the service was really good here! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone in the Tempe area.

yelp:test:6668.orig: Very vegan. The menu includes a variety of choices. Under the sandwiches and burger section everything is 'mock'. I like the Big Wac it's the same as a Big Mac but it's bigger and more filling. The fries are way better than mcdonalds. \n\nPlus they have Jones soda. I love this place. Don't be surprised to see some artzy fartzy people though
yelp:test:6668.para: Extremely vegan-friendly. The menu offers a wide range of options. In the sandwiches and burger category, everything is plant-based. I enjoy the Big Wac; it's similar to a Big Mac but larger and more satisfying. The fries are much better than those from McDonald's. They also serve Jones soda, which I adore. Be prepared to see some artistically inclined individuals there.

yelp:test:6760.orig: I had the prime rib and the mashed potatoes, it was amazing! My fianc\u00e9 got the porter house and the Mac n cheese! We will come back! Great romantic atmosphere, great service! Would recommend for a great date night!
yelp:test:6760.para: I enjoyed the prime rib and mashed potatoes, which were outstanding! My fiancé had the porterhouse and Mac n' cheese! We plan to return! The place offers a wonderful romantic ambiance and excellent service! I would highly recommend it for a memorable date night!

yelp:test:6774.orig:
New Zealand lamb and the salted caramel bread pudding. 

I was left grunting with happiness. 

Twice. 

Nothing more to say, except come here. 

More than once. 

Life becomes that much better when you do.
yelp:test:6774.para:
The New Zealand lamb and the salted caramel bread pudding left me grinning with joy twice over. 

There's nothing else to add except to urge you to come here, multiple times. 

Life truly improves when you experience it.

yelp:test:6775.orig:
Why do I keep returning to UNO restaurants??

Oh yeah, because I am a borderline alcoholic and I like their happy hour specials, but that is where it ENDS.

I always thought the one by my house was just poorly managed and probably not indicative  of the rest of the chain... WRONG.

This place has the NASTIEST restrooms, consistently, and smells like shit throughout the restaurant. Never again.
yelp:test:6775.para:
Why can't I stop going back to UNO restaurants?

Sure, I enjoy their happy hour deals, but that's the extent of my interest.

I used to believe that the location near my home was poorly run and not representative of the chain, but I was wrong.

This restaurant has the most unpleasant restrooms, and the place smells terrible. I won't be returning.

yelp:test:6795.orig:
Oh Caffe Boa, I don't even know where to start! First off I never give a place 2 stars and it would have been 1 star if I had not had a pleasant experience before my most recent one!

One of my best friends was planning her 25th birthday dinner and she was trying to decide where to go and I suggested we go to Caffe Boa since she has never been and I had such a great experience the first time I had gone, I thought it would be a good idea to go again... Well I was wrong!

First off I had asked the hostess to do me a favor of surprising my friend with a gift from her boyfriend, since he was out of town and was not able to be there, and they were very friendly and said that would not be a problem, I was very appreciative of them doing that for me. My friend had also brought cupcakes in as her dessert and we asked if we could just put them in their fridge until after we had dinner and the owner had mentioned to me there would be a small cake cutting fee for holding them (he never mentioned how much it was), at this moment I thought ok $3-$5, no biggie, I thought it was odd and had never been to a restaurant where they have a cake cutting fee!  our whole group went in to wine and din
yelp:test:6795.para:
Oh Caffe Boa, I really don't know where to begin! Typically, I wouldn't give a place less than 2 stars, but I would have if not for a positive experience I had earlier. 

My best friend was planning her 25th birthday dinner and was trying to decide on a venue. I suggested Caffe Boa because she hadn't been there before and I had such a great time the first time. However, this time, things didn't go as planned. 

I had asked the hostess to surprise my friend with a gift from her boyfriend, who was out of town, and they agreed without any issues, which I appreciated. My friend also brought cupcakes as a dessert, and we asked if we could store them in their fridge until after dinner. The owner mentioned there would be a small cake-cutting fee, which I thought would be around $3 to $5. I found this unusual, as I've never encountered a restaurant with such a fee before. Our group then went in to enjoy some wine and dine.

yelp:test:6797.orig:
As others have pointed out, the menu has changed drastically, but I didn't actually have a problem with the change. The food we ordered came out fine. Not anything to write home about, but certainly a touch above mediocre. 

The problem was the waitress. We were sitting outside and it was quite chilly. She convinced us to order some spiced tea to warm ourselves up and did a good job selling the idea. But the tea never came and the waitress never checked in on us. We didn't even get any waters or the chance to flag her down. Another server dropped off our food in about twenty minutes and we had to ask him to get us some water. How is this acceptable at all? The waitress stopped by and said the bar didn't get the tea together and apologized, promising that she'd send the manager over. The manager never came over and it took another fifteen minutes after we finished eating to get the check and to pay. 

This place isn't cheap, but even if it was, I would expect better service than what my friend and I received.
yelp:test:6797.para:
While others have noted the significant menu changes, I wasn't bothered by them. The food we ordered was acceptable, not exceptional but better than just okay. The issue lay with the service. It was cold outside, and the waitress suggested we get spiced tea to warm up, which seemed like a good idea. However, the tea never arrived, and she didn't check on us. We didn't even get waters, and we had to ask another server for water after about twenty minutes. Another server brought our food, but we had to request water ourselves. When we mentioned the missing tea, the waitress said the bar hadn't prepared it and apologized, promising the manager would come. The manager never appeared, and it took another fifteen minutes to get the check and pay after we finished eating.

This establishment isn't inexpensive, but even so, I wouldn't expect such poor service.

yelp:test:6828.orig: Not the worst hotel. Comfortable bed with a decent TV. The staff are rude and nosy. We were given a ridiculous fine because we didn't read what we signed carefully. Watch out. Location is great right by the mall and highways. Although, at night it can be noisy and creepy because it is literally RIGHT BEHIND a strip club. We stayed 7 nights and every day the housekeeping came at a different time..got woke up as early 9:am which is rough if you plan on going out all night. Housekeeping does not clean the floors or toilets they pretty much do the bare minimum...The hotel itself isn't bad at all....the staff is just bad.
yelp:test:6828.para: While not the worst, the hotel offers a comfortable bed and a decent TV. However, the staff can be rude and intrusive. We were penalized unfairly due to a fine we didn't realize we owed because of our signature. Be cautious. The location is excellent, situated near the mall and highways. Yet, at night, it can be noisy and unsettling, as it's right next to a strip club. During our seven-night stay, housekeeping arrived at varying times, sometimes as early as 9 AM, which disrupts plans for late nights. Housekeeping doesn't thoroughly clean the floors or toilets, barely doing the minimum. The hotel itself is fine, but the staff need improvement.

yelp:test:6860.orig:
Anyone who knows me well knows that I hate grocery shopping. Hate it. Recently I was introduced to Trader Joe's and this past weekend, I took my husband there for the first time. While I can't say I have fallen in love with grocery shopping, I have found that I can at least go to TJ's when need be.

The layout of the store is fabulous. It's just a big enough store to give you variety and some choices, but not big enough to overwhelm you, especially if you are not a seasoned grocery store veteran. The staff is very friendly and always willing to help you find something, and the check out clerks are chatty without being annoying. I really can't compare TJ's prices to those you would find at a regular big box grocery store, but according to my husband who does all of our grocery shopping and knows which stores are the best for certain items, he says that TJ's prices are comparable if not lower than other grocery stores.

I like the pre-packaged salads, sandwiches, and wraps, which are perfect to take to work for lunch. In fact, I had a TJ's chicken caesar wrap for lunch today and it was delicious! Do make sure to check the dates before purchasing to ensure that if you aren't going
yelp:test:6860.para:
I've always detested grocery shopping, but recently, after trying Trader Joe's, I've discovered that I can manage to go there when necessary. The store's layout is fantastic—it offers a good variety without being too overwhelming, especially for those new to grocery shopping. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, and the checkout staff is friendly without being intrusive.

While I can't say I've developed a fondness for grocery shopping, I find Trader Joe's to be a more tolerable option. My husband, who does most of our grocery shopping, says that TJ's prices are often competitive or even lower than other stores. I particularly enjoy the pre-packaged salads, sandwiches, and wraps, which are ideal for taking to work. In fact, I had a TJ's chicken Caesar wrap for lunch today, and it was fantastic! Just remember to check the expiration dates to ensure the freshness, especially if you're not planning to use them right away.

yelp:test:6868.para: I experienced the worst customer service ever. I rented a worn-out UHAUL truck, and upon return, they claimed I had "backed into a tree." yelp:test:6891.orig: I have given this place a try twice. The first time my roomie and I ordered a white pizza we were super excited to get it only to get food poisoning and be hostage to our house for the next 48 hours. So I think fluke incident went back and had a pizza and wings and it was sub par. Not a great place to eat in my opinion just greasy bar food.
yelp:test:6891.para: I've given this place a couple of chances. On my first visit, my roommate and I were really looking forward to our white pizza, but we ended up with food poisoning and had to stay home for two days. On my second attempt, I ordered pizza and wings, but the food was still disappointing. In my opinion, it's not a great place to dine; the food seems more like greasy bar fare.

yelp:test:6916.orig:
Heard a lot of good things about Pete's. I am from the Gulf Coast and was not expecting to find anything that would compare to the delicious fried seafood of back home. Glad I set my expectations low.
  Pete's fish is ok, square, almost like processed but not. Strange but tasty. Chips are decent, taste like typical Ore-Ida frozen fries. The Onion rings were good (super greasy though). My biggest problem is that I am a bit of a traditionalist. If you are gonna call it ""fish and chips"" like they would in the UK, then you have to at least have malt vinegar. The red sauce is good with their fries and rings (and maybe shrimp) but not on fish. It is the only sauce they have. I hear the burgers are good and may go back, if I am already in the area, to try one. I wonder if they have mustard? They may be trying to do too many things at once here. Seafood, Americana, Mexican, (fish, shrimp, burritos, hot dogs, chicken, oysters) Just a thought.
  The seating is outside, if its summer you must get it to go. Between the heat, pigeons and huge flies (serious kitchen hawks) you will not have a good time. 
  The prices are very reasonable but they only accept cash. I would not go out of my
yelp:test:6916.para:
I've heard great things about Pete's, but I wasn't sure I'd find anything to match the delicious fried seafood from the Gulf Coast. I'm glad I kept my expectations low.

Pete's fish is okay, almost like processed food but not quite. It's strange but tasty. The chips are decent, similar to frozen fries like Ore-Ida. The onion rings were good, though very greasy. My main issue is that I'm a traditionalist. If you're calling it "fish and chips" like in the UK, you should at least have malt vinegar. The red sauce is good with fries and onion rings, but not on the fish. They only have this sauce. I've heard the burgers are good and might return to try one, if I'm in the area. They might be trying to do too much, offering seafood, American, and Mexican dishes.

The seating is outside, but if it's summertime, it's best to get takeout. Between the heat, pigeons, and large flies, you won't have a pleasant experience. The prices are reasonable, but they only accept cash. I wouldn't travel far for this place.

yelp:test:6941.orig: Mr. Puss got sick last month the day I had to leave town for a week for work. Estrella got me a rush appointment within 20 minutes of my initial call, took kitty in right away and carefully performed X-rays and blood tests. They sent me home with a bag full of meds (which my lucky pet sitter got to administer) and kept me up to date on test results via the phone. Once again I found them to be caring and responsive, and I will keep going back.
yelp:test:6941.para: When Mr. Puss fell ill last month just as I had to leave town for a week of work, Estrella arranged a rush appointment for us within 20 minutes of my first call. She promptly took the kitty in and conducted thorough X-rays and blood tests. I returned home with a medication bag (which my fortunate pet sitter administered), and I was kept informed about the test results via phone. As before, I found them to be caring and responsive, and I plan to continue using their services.

yelp:test:6963.orig: The food was amazing! Service was great!  The chicken Marsala was everything that I was looking for. Eating there felt like eating at your Italian grandma's house. We will be going back often.
yelp:test:6963.para: The cuisine was outstanding! The service was superb! The chicken Marsala perfectly met my expectations. Dining there was akin to enjoying a meal at my Italian grandmother's home. We plan to return frequently.

yelp:test:6997.orig:
If you are looking for a great bar with excellent prices then look no further.  We went in on a Sunday night just after 10 pm. I had driven by earlier in the day and the parking lot was full, so it's a great place to watch a game with some buds and brew. I sat and talked with some of the regulars and it was a great conversation. It's the kind of place I wish didn't revolve around drinking, cuz I don't really like drinking all that much but I can see how somebody might get into that at the Deli Sports bar. I guess you could say the place can be addicting. From talking with the clientele it sounds like Friday and Saturday nights the place can be very busy, as well as the average Sunday and Monday night football season, (and I'm assuming any time a series of games are being played on the same day regardless of the sporting event.)

The juke box is awesome because it's actually hooked up to some proprietary Internet server system so you have tons of options for music (even classical, blues and Jazz). 
One saw one person get a little out of hand but he was promptly dealt with, but even with that I would still like to go there the again.  Deli Sports Bar is relaxed atmosphere with exc
yelp:test:6997.para:
If you're seeking a fantastic bar with great value, you've found the perfect spot. We visited on a Sunday night around 10 pm, and the parking lot was already packed, indicating it's a popular place for watching games with friends. I chatted with some regulars and had a wonderful conversation. While I don't particularly enjoy drinking, the atmosphere at Deli Sports Bar is engaging enough that others might find it appealing. It almost feels addictive. Based on my conversations, it seems the place gets very busy on Fridays and Saturdays, and during the football season, especially on Sundays and Mondays, and likely whenever there are multiple games on the same day.

The jukebox is fantastic, as it's connected to an internet server system, offering a wide range of music options, including classical, blues, and jazz. Although one person got a bit rowdy, they were quickly handled, and I'd still like to visit again. Deli Sports Bar offers a relaxed ambiance with excellent music.

yelp:test:7015.orig: The new item on the menu is BBQ.  Marty has nailed it. Smokey, meaty and great prices. Definitely worth a visit or two.
yelp:test:7015.para: The latest addition to the menu is BBQ, and Marty has really hit the mark. The meat is smoky and flavorful, and the prices are fantastic. It's definitely worth stopping by for a couple of visits.

yelp:test:7019.orig: Super nice staff!  Food is delicious! So Fresh !  I always sppreciate the hostess asks if we have preferred sesting.  Such a simple question but so appreciated.  Thankyou Madeleine. Having never eaten there before our waiter John was very helpful. He helped us make the best choices for our appetites and tastes!
yelp:test:7019.para: The staff is super friendly! The food is delicious and so fresh! I really appreciate how the hostess asks if we have any seating preferences—it's such a thoughtful touch. Thank you, Madeleine. Our waiter, John, was very helpful since it was our first time dining there. He assisted us in making the best choices for our appetites and tastes!

yelp:test:7053.orig: Watch out for city council meetings! They gave us the run around for 8 months on a re-zoning process, plus were incredibly condescending. Words cannot express my dismay at the double standard that Councilwoman Schroder presented--reprimanding one side of a communal dispute without acknowledging the other side's continual bullying and threats.
yelp:test:7053.para: Be wary of upcoming city council meetings! They kept us waiting for 8 months during the re-zoning process and were extremely condescending in their approach. My disappointment is profound, especially regarding Councilwoman Schroder's double standard. She criticized one side of a community dispute while ignoring the other side's persistent bullying and threats.

yelp:test:7113.orig: OK you can gamble here but the retail/dining is a total, TOTAL suck fest and even though they have tons of land in Vegas the airport feels cramped and small: more like oakland then los angeles. It is spared the one star because of the very convenient location.
yelp:test:7113.para: Sure, you can gamble here, but the retail and dining options are really subpar. Despite the ample space in Vegas, the airport feels quite cramped and small, more akin to Oakland than Los Angeles. It wouldn't deserve a one-star rating if not for its convenient location.

yelp:test:7156.orig: I absolutely LOVE Southwest Airlines. Many of you already know about the 2 free bags, low prices, and great service. Something however that shocked me was when I needed to cancel my flight, they made it such hassle free. All I remember was before with AA that I went through such loop holes to try to cancel a flight and they charged me fees on top of overprices tickets. But with Southwest, I was able to call the night before to cancel my flight and they send me a confirmation right away. I just used those credits to rebook another flight and I got the low prices offered on the site and there was no charge to rebook. Excellent service and motto. I will always fly southwest if I can!
yelp:test:7156.para: I absolutely adore Southwest Airlines. Many of you are aware of their two free bags, affordable fares, and excellent customer service. What really surprised me was how smooth their flight cancellation process was. With American Airlines, I had to jump through numerous hoops and faced additional fees on top of overpriced tickets. In contrast, Southwest made it incredibly easy; I called the night before to cancel my flight and received immediate confirmation. I later used those credits to rebook another flight at the same low prices listed on their website, with no extra charges. Their service is top-notch, and I'll always choose Southwest whenever possible!

yelp:test:7181.orig:
Saw the high Yelp reviews for this place, and we were staying in the adjoining Main Street Station, so we ended up in here for dinner one night.  We got there around 7, and there was a line of maybe a dozen folks ahead of us.

I had the saimin (good, but nothing special), as well as the garlic chicken.  GF got the combo plate that had Korean beef and chicken, along with the obligatory rice and macaroni salad.  This isn't fine dining by any stretch - presentation isn't really a concern, and we're not talking about any crazy complimentary flavors or subtle undertones or anything.  Portions are large - GF and I could easily have just split the combo plate and been more than full.  Solid, stick-to-your-ribs, Hawaiian style food.  The beef and chicken were solid, maybe a bit fatty, but that's to be expected.

Cash only was a bit of a surprise, but fortunately I hadn't handed over all my money on the blackjack tables.

This is one of those places that looks like a hole in the wall, but looks like it's always packed.  Large portions and great bang for the buck.  Not amazing food, but a great value, especially if you're craving Hawaiian style.
yelp:test:7181.para:
We checked out the highly-rated place after seeing the Yelp reviews and, since we were staying at the nearby Main Street Station, decided to dine there one evening. We arrived around 7 and found a line of about a dozen people waiting.

I ordered the saimin (it was good but not exceptional) and the garlic chicken. My partner got the combo plate featuring Korean beef and chicken, along with rice and macaroni salad. This isn't fine dining; the focus isn't on presentation or complex flavors. The portions are generous—GF and I could have easily shared the combo plate and still been quite full. The food is hearty, typical Hawaiian fare. The beef and chicken were decent, though a bit fatty, which is to be expected.

We were surprised to learn they only accept cash, but fortunately, I still had some money left from my blackjack winnings.

This place has a casual, no-frills vibe but is always bustling. The large portions and good value make it a great choice, especially if you're in the mood for Hawaiian-style cuisine. It's not outstanding, but it delivers a satisfying meal at a reasonable price.

yelp:test:7191.orig: horrible service if your not drinking beer we were regulars because of the 2for 1 shrimp cocktail they were ok defenetly  not made to order my husband tried the 7 mares and got a horrible diareah and stomach ache everything was ok then they finally got they're license to sell beer  and they were the main priority! we were waiting for our order for over an hour we would see everyone get served but us even ppl for takeout my husband asked the rude owner and she said they had a lot of orders for take out i guess they come first than customers sitting and waiting for over an hour of course they're was a table of a family drinking and of course everything was rushed to them we finally got tired and told my husband lets go he paid for the waters we had and the horrible rude ass OWNER dint even apologize or acknowledge we were leaving never again the food is not made to order everything is fake not fresh not worth the wait and the bad service ur cocktails can be 3 for 1 u still cudnt pay me to come back
yelp:test:7191.para: We experienced terrible service, especially if you're not drinking beer. We used to be regulars due to the 2-for-1 shrimp cocktail offer, which was decent but not made to order. My husband tried the 7 Mares and ended up with severe diarrhea and a stomach ache. After they got their beer license, beer became their top priority. We waited over an hour for our order, while others, including takeout customers, were served. The owner, who was rude, said they had many takeout orders. A family at a table nearby got their drinks rushed to them. Eventually, we decided to leave without an apology from the owner. The food isn't made to order; it's fake, not fresh, and not worth the wait. The service was bad, and even a 3-for-1 cocktail deal couldn't convince us to return.

yelp:test:7207.orig: Greyhound is the black hole of happiness. There was a girl at the package express desk who after realizing there was only one person that could help with luggage, helped me get my boxes to my car. She da KING! And the only reason they get two stars. But Greyhounds nationally need to find a way to take pride in themselves again. Let's beg for some government assistance here? 2 people at the desks to help a quadrillion tired, angry guests? And, of course, the ticket machines weren't working. And since the girl was helping me with my stuff that leaves OOOOOONNNEEEEE guy to face a packed house of very angry and weary travelers? It's inhumane. And STIFLING HOT!! Set up a couple of desk top fans, damn! The vending machines were stocked, so that's cool. I hope the machines took dollars because there weren't any change machines, as another disgruntled patron (well, not \""patron\"" so much as an \""only slightly bathed individual who wanted $5 in quarters\"" noted.) Where I had sent my packages from was also an awful, dryer place where sunshine never touched. (Literally! Because I was in the pacific northwest, HAH!!) However, if you you're moving on a budget, it's the cheapest you're going
yelp:test:7207.para: Greyhound is a real happiness drain. A girl at the package desk assisted me with my luggage, and she was fantastic! But that's the only reason it's not getting a one-star rating. Greyhound needs to boost their pride and improve their service. Maybe they should ask for government help? Having just two people at the desks to handle a massive crowd of exhausted and irritable travelers is absurd. And the ticket machines were down. With one person left to deal with a packed waiting area, it's inhumane. It was also unbearably hot; setting up some desk fans would have been a big help. The vending machines were well-stocked, which was good. I hope they accept dollars since there were no change machines, as another upset traveler mentioned needing $5 in quarters. The place I sent my packages from was also a dreary, sunless environment, fitting for the Pacific Northwest. If you're traveling on a budget, Greyhound is your best bet.

yelp:test:7213.orig: Great pizza. 2 slices for $4.50.\n Best food deal in all of downtown.
yelp:test:7213.para: Delicious pizza at an excellent deal—2 slices for $4.50. This is the best food offer in the entire downtown area.

yelp:test:7222.orig: Amazing experience overall. Staff and service was excellent. Ambience was superb. Food was simply amazing. My dad did say the rice was on the salty side. But aside from that the food was on point. The table side salad that comes with every entree is filling and excellent as well.
yelp:test:7222.para: Overall, it was a fantastic experience. The staff and service were outstanding, and the atmosphere was terrific. The food was simply incredible. My dad did mention that the rice was a bit too salty, but apart from that, everything was perfect. The table-side salad that accompanies each main course is both satisfying and excellent.

yelp:test:7260.para: this buffet is the worst value for the money

yelp:test:7261.orig:
Old Vegas. Some people love it, and other people....act like it doesn't even exist.

I happen to be one of those people who love it.

So cheap. So tacky. And such a blast.

Sure, modern Vegas is great & fun, but you can do so much more for so much less on Fremont Street!


The Golden Nugget is where you should stay if you're into hanging out on Fremont Street, hands down.

Myself and 3 other people stayed in one of the Rush Tower deluxe rooms. And the room was fantastic. 2 Televisions, a fantastic bathroom, 2 couches......

...but only one bed.

When I reserved the room, the website said it was for up to four people and had the option of getting two full beds.

When we arrived they told us that was an option, but not a guarantee.

Normally this sort of customer service would merit a god awful review.

But....they have a slide that goes through a shark tank!

And as I said, the room was very nice for the price, especially for 4 people. There was plenty of room to sleep on the couches...but when you're two couples, it's a little less than ideal.

But if you're going with a few friends or if that doesn't bother you, then go for it. No regrets staying at the Go
yelp:test:7261.para:
Old Vegas has its fans and those who seem to ignore it entirely. I'm one of the enthusiasts who appreciate it.

It's incredibly affordable and rather gaudy, yet incredibly enjoyable.

While modern Vegas is fantastic and entertaining, you can experience a lot more for less on Fremont Street.

For those who want to immerse themselves in Fremont Street, the Golden Nugget is the best choice, without a doubt.

Myself and three others booked a deluxe room in the Rush Tower, and it was outstanding—two TVs, a great bathroom, and two couches.

However, there was only one bed.

When I made the reservation, the website indicated it could accommodate up to four people and offered the option of two full beds.

Upon arrival, they mentioned this as a possibility but not a guarantee.

Typically, such service would warrant a terrible review.

Yet, they have a shark tank slide, which is a unique perk.

The room was excellent for the price, especially considering four people. There was ample space on the couches, though it wasn't ideal for two couples.

Still, if you're traveling with friends or don't mind the arrangement, it's a great choice with no regrets staying at the Golden Nugget.

yelp:test:7269.orig: Terrible service and total lack of hospitality.\nWe were sitting in the Ice Bar when the Bar Back knocked my drink over. He informed the Bartender. We then went up to the bar to order another drink and was told that we were sh*t outta luck because we didn't purchase the drink from her.\nAs a local we will never return and will make sure to let our friends know what terrible service we received
yelp:test:7269.para: The service was awful, and there was no hospitality at all. When the Bar Back accidentally knocked over my drink, he reported it to the Bartender. Upon going to the bar to get a new drink, we were told we couldn't have one because we hadn't bought the original from her. As a local, we won't be coming back, and we'll definitely warn our friends about the poor service we experienced.

yelp:test:7314.orig: One of the biggest tourist traps around. Skip this overpriced crap and look for McDonald's in that one casino for cheap food, or a sit-down restaurant for a better value. $5.99 is apparently a \""special\"" price for two average (at best) slices of cheese pizza and a pretty small soda, and the rest of the menu is definitely overpriced. Only reason this gets two stars is that the food and service weren't actually horrible.
yelp:test:7314.para: This place is one of the most notorious tourist traps. I recommend avoiding it and opting for McDonald's in the nearby casino for affordable meals, or a sit-down restaurant for a better deal. The $5.99 price tag for two mediocre (at best) slices of cheese pizza and a small soda is misleading, as the rest of the menu is excessively priced. The only reason it merits two stars is because the food and service weren't terrible.

yelp:test:7355.orig:
Haven't even eaten my food yet but I ordered it at 11:30pm when no one else was in there, and it still took a half hour for them to make me ONE thing. 
Place is a little sketchy looking too


--  Update

I ate the food and it was decent. So I boosted my rating from 1 star to 2. 
Still wouldn't go back
yelp:test:7355.para:
I placed my order at 11:30pm when the place was empty, but it still took about half an hour to get just one item. The establishment has a somewhat suspicious appearance. 

-- Update --

I tried the food and found it to be acceptable, so I raised my rating from one star to two. However, I wouldn't return there.

yelp:test:7378.orig:
went for Dim Sum, I asked for water, the waitress kept insisting that I get tea also. I finally said fine. She brought 2 tea cups, which by the way, one was for me the other person with me is my 3 year old son. Does he drink hot tea, I think not. There must be something to it. 

I keep wanting to get the satay hot sauce, and asked several ladies pushing the carts, they keep telling me "" ask the waitress."" I haven't seen a waitress pass for any request. when I finally raised my voice to get the attention of a waitress, she said we only have 1 type of hot sauce. 
NOT REAL AUTHENTIC dim sum, if they do not have the satay hot sauce. 

The fried shrimp balls was OK, a bit dry. The steam rice noodle with beef on the inside, was weird. Noodles too chewy, and the beef seems like it was from some kind of beef paste, (its and Asian thing) 

I did like the siu-mai though, it was good. seems like it was steam with little fish eggs on top. 

I got my check, they actually charge $.50 for tea for each person. That was why the waitress keep wanting me to say yes for tea. Forget the $ amount, it's the principles of the matter. 

So I will keep to my usual favorite place Cathay House,
yelp:test:7378.para:
I went for Dim Sum and requested water, but the waitress insisted I get tea instead. Eventually, I agreed, and she brought two cups—one for me and one for my 3-year-old son. I doubt he'd enjoy hot tea. There must be a reason for this.

I wanted the satay hot sauce and asked several cart-pushers, but they directed me to the waitress. No waitress attended to my requests until I raised my voice. When she finally came, she said they only had one type of hot sauce. This place isn't truly authentic; they should have the satay hot sauce.

The fried shrimp balls were okay but a bit dry. The beef-stuffed rice noodles were strange; the noodles were too chewy, and the beef tasted like paste. However, I liked the siu-mai, which was good and had fish eggs on top.

They charged $0.50 for tea per person, which is why the waitress kept pushing it. While I don't mind the price, the principle is important. I'll stick to my usual favorite place, Cathay House.

yelp:test:7385.orig: Best Thai food in Vegas. I had been told archies was the old standard but Thai spice takes that title. Their lunch specials are awesome.  Highly recommend the pepper steak with a level 7 spice. Yes u can request your spice level!
yelp:test:7385.para: Thai Spice is the top Thai restaurant in Vegas, according to my experience. While Archie's was considered the original go-to, Thai Spice has surpassed it. Their lunch specials are outstanding. I particularly recommend the pepper steak, which offers a level 7 spice—though you can adjust the heat to your preference.

yelp:test:7408.orig:
We always visit Nora's when we come to Las Vegas. It is a nice alternative to something in the hotel and the food and service are always great. 

I opted for the ""Crazy Alfredo"" on my last visit and it was decent. I still prefer their Vodka Penne over most of the pasta dishes there. The place has a decent selection of wines by the glass as well. 

The antipasto salad is pretty good and plenty for two people to share as a starter.
yelp:test:7408.para:
Whenever we visit Las Vegas, we make it a point to stop by Nora's. It offers a pleasant change from the hotel dining options, and the food and service are consistently excellent.

On my last visit, I tried the "Crazy Alfredo" and found it satisfactory, though I still favor their Vodka Penne over most other pasta dishes on the menu. They also have a reasonable selection of wines by the glass.

The antipasto salad is quite good and ample enough for two people to enjoy as an appetizer.

yelp:test:7423.orig: part of my power walk routine ....although this last week it was jog - power walk ...at times i'll stop at fresh and easy, other times, albertson's and if it's one of those days i didn't wake up until 10 or so ( sorry boodah for late breakfast ! )  then i might end the exercise at the doorsteps of black bear diner ....it's all about the breakfast ( they are open for lunch and heck...maybe dinner...not even sure ! ) my sis loves their country fried steak ...just give me the ham steak, eggs and those biscuits and i'm a happy camper !!!  i'm not sure...but the place might actually be a chain....it doesn't feel that way ..it feels like a local hangout....if you need a good hearty breakfast and your on the westside - black bear diner is worth a looksy
yelp:test:7423.para: A part of my daily routine involves jogging and power walking, though this past week I've been alternating between jogging and power walking. Sometimes I stop at Fresh and Easy, other times at Albertson's. If I sleep in until around 10, I might end my workout right outside Black Bear Diner. It's all about the breakfast there—they're open for lunch and possibly dinner too, though I'm not entirely sure. My sister adores their country fried steak, but I prefer the ham steak, eggs, and those biscuits. That's all I need to be content! I'm not certain, but the place might be a chain, but it feels like a local spot to me. If you're looking for a hearty breakfast on the westside, Black Bear Diner is definitely worth checking out.

yelp:test:7435.orig: Who doesn't want to watch hockey in the desert? Even though the team is under .500 right now, they play hard and games are always entertaining. They played the Idaho Steelheads (I have no idea what a steelhead is) this past Thursday and Friday and both games ended in a shootout, with the teams splitting the games. There really isn't a bad seat in the house and prices are very reasonable. I had seats about 10 rows up from behind the net and they were only about $21 a piece. Kids under 2 get in for free. Not a bad family-friendly event, fights and all.
yelp:test:7435.para: Who wouldn't enjoy watching hockey in the desert? Despite the team's current record below .500, their games remain exciting and competitive. Last Thursday and Friday, they faced the Idaho Steelheads (I'm clueless about what a steelhead is), and both matches concluded in shootouts, with the teams sharing the wins. The arena offers excellent viewing from any seat, and ticket prices are quite affordable. My seats, located about 10 rows behind the net, cost only $21 each. Additionally, kids under 2 enter for free. It's a great family-friendly event, even with the occasional fights.

yelp:test:7473.para: The bartender, an unfriendly old woman with a poor wig, and her colleague, another elderly lady, spent their time gossiping about patrons behind the counter. I was seated nearby, eavesdropping, much like two envious schoolgirls. DUMP!!

yelp:test:7498.para: I've eaten here before and found the food and service to be good, with no issues until now.
