yelp:test:13385.para:
Fresh, Flavorful Sushi with Excellent Service!

The Situation:
I was in Scottsdale for the weekend and felt a sudden craving for sushi after a long day of work on a Saturday. It was around 9 pm, and I was quite hungry. Using Yelp, I found Dozo and called to place my order, which was ready just five minutes after I arrived (they initially said it would take 20 minutes, but it was quicker).

The Pickup Experience:
When I arrived, a friendly hostess welcomed me and directed me to a waiting area where there were newspapers to read. A server came by to offer a drink, knowing exactly which order I was waiting for and informing me that the sushi chef was preparing it. The chef even waved at us. My wait was under five minutes, and I left with reasonably priced sushi.

The Food:
The sushi was exceptionally fresh, flavorful, and delicious. I didn't order any unique rolls since I didn't have a menu, but I appreciated the creative twists on standard rolls. Even the vegetable roll included a variety of vegetables beyond the usual.

yelp:test:13400.orig: Madhouse coffee is the local coffee shop I've been looking for all my life! My fave is the blended caramel mocha, way better than any other coffee places! Prices are reasonable and employees are great! I love the wannabe sandwich on focaccia. I never liked pesto but this one is the only pesto I would ever eat! The owner, Marco, is a great guy, he cares about his customers and he takes care of any concerns one might have. Andrea is my fave barista- thanks to her natural sincerity and jolliness! Every morning before work, this is where I'd be found. And on my days off, my system still asks for some madhouse! I'm so madly in love with this place. No one will understand my obsession...
yelp:test:13400.para: Madhouse Coffee is the perfect local café that I've always dreamed of! Their blended caramel mocha is my absolute favorite and surpasses any other coffee shop I've tried! The prices are fair, and the staff are fantastic! I also enjoy their sandwich on focaccia, which is the only pesto I can stomach. Marco, the owner, is a wonderful person who genuinely cares about his customers and addresses any issues promptly. My favorite barista, Andrea, is incredibly genuine and cheerful, making every visit delightful. I always stop by before work, and even on my days off, I crave a visit. I'm hopelessly in love with this place, and no one can truly grasp my devotion...

yelp:test:13404.orig: Had a lovely lunch with my friend. The Scallop roll is to die for! sushiwa is one of my favorite places to lunch in Newer henderson....it is so relaxing and the staff is friendly. The Sushi chefs are absolutely adorable!
yelp:test:13404.para: Enjoyed a delightful lunch with a friend at sushiwa in Newer Henderson. The Scallop roll was outstanding! It's one of my go-to spots for lunch, as the place is incredibly relaxing and the staff are very friendly. The sushi chefs are simply charming!

yelp:test:13409.orig: Pretty good market considering that most buy from the national grocery chains (Phoenix is a chained city!!). Maya Farms is one of my favs.. not only do they carry more exotic vegetables (romanesca) but they also added Save Our Farm raw milk! That's worth the trip alone! \n\nIf only the local bakers and such would join the scene.. where's Willo, Tammie Coe and MJ Bread? The market is only as strong as the people willing to participate in it.
yelp:test:13409.para:
While it's a decent market given that most people shop at national grocery chains (Phoenix is quite chain-heavy!), Maya Farms stands out as my favorite. They offer a wider range of exotic vegetables, like romanesco, and have recently added Save Our Farm raw milk—definitely worth a visit! 

It would be great if local bakers like Willo, Tammie Coe, and MJ Bread were part of this scene too. After all, the market's strength depends on the participation of local businesses.

yelp:test:13448.orig: What a lovely restaurant. One of the best salad bars I've ever experienced. The Pot Roast was like mom used to make, the carrots were to die for. The Bread Pudding was over the top. Service was very good. \nI look forward to returning.
yelp:test:13448.para: What a delightful restaurant it is. I've rarely tasted a salad bar as impressive as this one. The Pot Roast reminded me of my mother's cooking, and the carrots were absolutely delicious. The Bread Pudding was simply outstanding. The service was excellent. I can't wait to come back.

yelp:test:13451.orig: When my mom worked in the area, we came here quite often, after picking her up from work. It's a busy location, so parking can be a pain. I don't like the store because there is a strong unpleasant smell in the produce section. I am used to ethnic markets and have been to so many of them in my life (childhood memories of visiting numerous ethnic markets) and I just couldn't stand it. I noticed that so many senior citizens shop here BTW. So when my mom no longer worked in the area, I did not miss coming here.
yelp:test:13451.para: My mom used to work nearby, which is why we frequented this place after picking her up. The area is quite bustling, making parking challenging. I dislike the store due to the strong, unpleasant odor in the produce section. Growing up, I visited numerous ethnic markets, and I simply couldn't tolerate this one. Interestingly, I observed that many seniors shop here. After my mom stopped working in the area, I didn't miss this place.

yelp:test:13470.orig: Great food, great selection of craft beer and great service.  Love Chris and Bridget! Slainte!
yelp:test:13470.para: Delicious food, an excellent variety of craft beers, and outstanding service. I really adore Chris and Bridget! Cheers!

yelp:test:13481.para: I visited again because the first time was enjoyable, and I wanted my friends to experience the same. We ordered the queen bbq combo. yelp:test:13488.orig: Quite honestly, the reason that I am a fan is that they have a lot of pool tables, they offer free pool on certain nights, and the bartenders, male or female, are always awesome. PLUS, I get this humongous beer for 2.50 during happy hour with my PT card. Or free if playing 5 quarters. Can one really beat this? Okay, maybe, but I still love this location of the PTs. The food is okay, but what do you expect? It's a bar.
yelp:test:13488.para: To be honest, I love this place because of its abundance of pool tables, free pool nights, and fantastic bartenders—regardless of gender. Additionally, I can enjoy a huge beer for just $2.50 during happy hour with my PT card, or it's free if I play five quarters. Is there anything better? Well, maybe, but I still adore this PT location. The food is decent, but what should you expect from a bar?

yelp:test:13508.orig:
Always order a pizza from here when I am out at the pool...well...not ever again...had a simple order and didn't get it right..BUT the manager was very nice and gave it to me for free.

I ordered an appt. to eat while my pizza was cooking since I wanted to take the pizza to go...well the pizza came and no appt....oh well.. pizza was ok, had better from there...

Guess I should have just waited....
yelp:test:13508.para:
I always get pizza from here when I'm at the pool, but I won't anymore. My simple order wasn't correct, but the manager was kind and gave me a free one.

I had planned to eat at the restaurant while my pizza was cooking so I could take it away, but the pizza arrived without an appointment. The pizza was decent, but I've had better from there.

Maybe I should have just waited to pick it up.

yelp:test:13523.orig: Mediocre at best. Much better AYCE in the area.
yelp:test:13523.para: At best, it's mediocre. There are much better all-you-can-eat options nearby.

yelp:test:13544.orig: I change mind, this place is the BOMB BAY! The steak special is cheap and delicious!
yelp:test:13544.para: I've changed my mind; this place is fantastic! The steak special is not only affordable but also incredibly tasty!

yelp:test:13552.orig: I ate here twice.  The first time, I had a steak dinner, and found they forgot to season the meat, forgot to season the spinach, forgot to bring me any bread (I get just a little and look forward to it), and FORGOT I WAS THERE.\n\nTwo days later, 20 people for breakfast, they were OK, but JUST OK.
yelp:test:13552.para: On two occasions, I dined here. The first visit was for a steak dinner, and I noticed they neglected to season the meat and the spinach. They also failed to bring me any bread, which I usually enjoy a bit of. On my second visit, two days later, for breakfast with a party of 20, the food was merely satisfactory.

yelp:test:13592.orig:
I absolutely loved this restaurant. Amazing food, awesome ambience and great personalized service. 

I had the spicy bananna pepper appetizer stuffed with italian sausage and cheese. topped with sauce and served with a side of toasted italian bread. Very good. a little spicy but really good.

for dinner had the tortellini and loved it. best i've ever had. i'm going to try to recreate this dish . so good.

overall very good place and i'd recommend to anyone visiting vegas and willing to drive off the strip a bit.
yelp:test:13592.para:
I absolutely adored this restaurant. The food was outstanding, the atmosphere fantastic, and the service incredibly personalized.

I started with the spicy banana pepper appetizer, stuffed with Italian sausage and cheese, topped with sauce and served with toasted Italian bread. It was very good, just a bit spicy but delicious.

For dinner, I had the tortellini, which was exceptional—the best I've ever tasted. I plan to try to recreate this dish at home; it was so good.

Overall, it was a very enjoyable experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Las Vegas, even if it means driving off the strip a bit.

yelp:test:13602.orig:
Hey, I take part of the blame for this review......Lesson learned, when you walk in a restaurant that primarily serves hot dogs, order a hot dog.

I just left Chicago Dogs after having one of their $8.00 burgers.  At the suggestion of the waiter/cashier I went with the burger, fries and drink special which cashed me out at ten dollars and change.  Add a $1.00 tip in the jar and the total was about $11.50.

I then noticed the preformed ""Angus"" patty (which I can buy at Costco) between a store-bought bun.

If a burger is served with a  store bought bun, -2 points.  If the meat is a preformed, previously frozen, store bought patty, -2 points.  Cold or cool bun, -2 points.

Back to Chicago Dogs........Unfortunately, before I even bit into this burger it h
yelp:test:13602.para:
I share some responsibility for this review... A key takeaway is that when you visit a hot dog-focused restaurant, opt for a hot dog.

I recently visited Chicago Dogs and ordered their $8 burger, along with fries and a drink, which came to around $11.50 including a $1 tip.

The service was prompt, but the quality might have been compromised for speed. Upon receiving the burger, I noticed the top bun was cool, possibly room temperature. The patty, labeled "Angus," seemed like a store-bought one, similar to what I could get at Costco.

Here’s my burger rating system: Start with a "10." Subtract 2 points for a store-bought bun, another 2 for a preformed, frozen patty, and 2 more for a cold bun. Applying this to Chicago Dogs...

Before I could even take a bite, the burger...

yelp:test:13689.orig:
Best Price in Las Vegas for lunch Buffet.

yelp:test:13689.para:
The Best Lunch Buffet Deal in Las Vegas.

I enjoy all-you-can-eat buffets, and this place stands out as excellent.

It's conveniently located just 1.5 miles from the strip.

yelp:test:13697.orig: Visited the Tied House on Superbowl Sunday, only to realize that our party were the only customers in the place who weren't friends of the owner.  As a result, a server came by perhaps three times, and we could never tell if the staff were working or were there to drink.\n\nFood-wise, standard but good brew-pub food, very good beers, including the amber ale and stout.  Warning: smoking is allowed in the restaurant.
yelp:test:13697.para:
On Superbowl Sunday, we visited the Tied House and found ourselves the sole patrons who weren't acquaintances of the owner. Consequently, we encountered the server only a few times, and it was unclear whether the staff were working or just there to enjoy the evening. 

In terms of food, it was typical but quite satisfying brew-pub fare, paired with excellent beers, particularly the amber ale and stout. A caution: smoking is permitted in the restaurant.

yelp:test:13750.orig: Run of the mill cheap Chinese fast food and other poor quality fast food grade food.
yelp:test:13750.para: Ordinary, budget Chinese fast food along with other subpar, fast-food quality meals.

yelp:test:13751.orig: On the first day of my Vegas Vacation I realized somewhere during our travels to Vegas my camera had broke. Ugh. My mind was preoccupied by the thought of a vacation with no camera. I lamented the whole morning about my options, ruling out disposables because no self respecting photog would stoop that low. I even called all of the local camera repair shops with no luck for a place to get my broken baby repaired. I started to get frustrated as we walked to the Forum Shops at Caesar's Palace. I finally had a mini-meltdown where I burst into tears by the fountain at the shops. After wiping away my tears I looked up to see a beacon of light - no wait, it was just the Sony Style shop where I bit the bullet and bought a brand new Cybershot for $180 (totally compatible with the fully charged battery and 4GB memory card from my broken camera). The day was saved! I immediately started taking pictures and felt a million times happier.\n\nLong story short, thank god for this store. The staff was totally helpful (and sympathetic) and the price was right.
yelp:test:13751.para:
On my first day in Vegas, I noticed my camera was broken somewhere during our trip. Ugh, it was a real downer. The whole morning was spent worrying about how to capture our memories without a camera. I dismissed disposable cameras as a last resort, thinking no serious photographer would use them. I even tried calling local camera repair shops, but to no avail. As we headed to the Forum Shops at Caesar's Palace, I started to get frustrated. I had a small breakdown, bursting into tears by the fountain. After composing myself, I spotted a bright light—no, it was just the Sony Style shop. I decided to buy a new Cybershot for $180, which was compatible with my old camera's battery and memory card. The day was salvaged! I began snapping photos right away and felt much happier. 

In short, I'm so grateful for this store. The staff was incredibly helpful and understanding, and the price was perfect.

yelp:test:13758.orig:
This review is for the Casino only.

A great place to play Black Jack.
Excellent dealers, professional staff and classy old school Vegas.

Check out the Egyptian ship at Cleopatra's; it's actually floating.
yelp:test:13758.para:
This review focuses solely on the casino.

It's an outstanding spot for playing Blackjack.
The dealers are top-notch, the staff is professional, and the atmosphere exudes classic Vegas charm.
Don't miss the Egyptian-themed ship at Cleopatra's; it's a real floating attraction.

yelp:test:13769.orig: Wow this place has gone down hill. Old smelly rooms. Service is horrible
yelp:test:13769.para: This place has really declined in quality. The rooms are old and smell bad, and the service is terrible.

yelp:test:13770.orig:
I was here on business over the weekend and just had a mediocre experience. The block rate we got for the business was between $132 and $152 a night. 

+ Attached to the Forum Shops
+ Registration staff was friendly
+ Bell man Federico helped us out a LOT
+ Cool fountains and decor
+ Comfy beds
+ Free Parking (as most hotels in Vegas have)

- Our first room smelled moldy/rank
- Got moved, but to a smaller room
- Reception/Front Desk takes a WHILE to pick up
- Housekeeping forgot to clean our room one day
- There was calcium buildup on one of the sinks
- Found out they only vacuum their floors (wear slippers because they're never formally cleaned!)
- There was a CD player in our room, but no ipod hookup (I know this is minor, but who brings CDs with them to a hotel in Vegas?!)
- Bell hop services charge $20 for a full cart, or $5 per box/piece for the convention center (a little steep for someone who is staying there)

Overall, I think this place needs a massive facelift considering all of their new competition around them. Not sure if I'd pay that much to stay here.
yelp:test:13770.para:
During my business trip last weekend, I had a somewhat average stay. The block rate for our business was in the range of $132 to $152 per night.

Pros:
- Located adjacent to the Forum Shops
- Registration staff were very friendly
- Bellman Federico was extremely helpful
- The fountains and decor were interesting
- The beds were comfortable
- Free parking was available (as is common in most Vegas hotels)

Cons:
- The first room we were given had a musty smell
- We were moved to a smaller room
- Reception and the front desk were slow to respond
- Housekeeping missed cleaning our room one day
- There was calcium buildup on one of the sinks
- They only vacuum the floors, so they're never formally cleaned (I suggest wearing slippers)
- The room had a CD player but no iPod hookup (this seems outdated for a Vegas hotel)
- Bell hop services charge $20 for a full cart or $5 per box/piece for the convention center (a bit steep for a hotel guest)

In summary, this hotel needs significant improvements to compete with its newer rivals. I'm not sure I would pay that much to stay here again.

yelp:test:13826.orig:
Don't let the exterior set your expectations for the place! It's super cute on the inside with cupcakes that look more like pieces of art than food. 

I was hoping it would be more of a cafe where you could sit and hang out - to enjoy the ambiance but they only had a few stools and it didn't even seem to have a restroom. Majority of the patrons came, ordered to go, and left. Which is a bit of a shame because it's super cute and cozy in there. 

I did notice that they sell cold brewed Cartel coffee (awesome!) in addition to the bottled drinks in the cooler but no hot coffees. Also, I have to agree with the woman who posted about not having tap water available. Personally, I believe offering tap water is just a basic gesture of hospitality. 

Enough about what they *aren't* and into what they are - they are an awesome bakery to get some pretty amazing tasty cookies and cupcakes.  Seemed to have more cupcakes than cookies despite the name. Perfect for special occasions, gifts, or to really indulge your sweet tooth. 

They also change up flavors according to the season. They had pumpkin bread they were selling which seemed to be pretty popular.  Also had gluten-free options, 3
yelp:test:13826.para:
Avoid judging the place by its exterior! Inside, it’s incredibly charming, with cupcakes that look more like exquisite art pieces. 

I was hoping for a cozy spot where one could linger and enjoy the atmosphere, but there were only a few stools available, and no restroom either. Most visitors seemed to order to go and leave quickly. It’s a pity, as the interior is both cute and cozy. 

They do offer cold-brewed Cartel coffee (excellent!) and bottled drinks, but no hot coffee options. I also concur with another reviewer who mentioned the lack of tap water; I think providing tap water is a simple act of hospitality. 

Let’s focus on what they do offer: they’re an outstanding bakery with delectable cookies and cupcakes. There seemed to be more cupcakes than cookies, which is fitting for special occasions, gifts, or satisfying a sweet craving. 

They also rotate their flavors seasonally; pumpkin bread was a popular choice, and they have gluten-free options too.

yelp:test:13902.orig: I had a great time here and the only complaint I got was the place being too small for the amount of people they let in. The music was great, a lot of attractive people and everyone seemed to be having a blast. We got bottle service which came with nice comfy seats that fits four in front of one of the pools. For the boos, we got blended redbull vodka which was bomb! Never had it blended before.. The strawberry vodka was also refreshing and tangy.\n\nIf you want to party daytime, this is one spot you want to hit up.
yelp:test:13902.para: I enjoyed my visit immensely, with the main feedback being that the venue was a bit cramped for the number of guests. The music was fantastic, and there were many attractive individuals present, all clearly having a great time. We opted for bottle service, which included comfortable seating for four people in front of one of the pools. The drinks, like the blended Red Bull vodka, were outstanding! I had never tried it blended before, and the strawberry vodka was both refreshing and tangy. If you're looking to party during the day, this place is definitely worth checking out.

yelp:test:13903.orig: MEH MEH MEH. This place was just meh. \n\nThe only reason I didn't give this place one star was because my guy friend got in here for free so that's +1 for that. Venue wise....this place is SO SMALL! WHERE'S THE DANCEFLOOR?! COME ON!! yelp:test:13903.para: Meh, Meh, Meh. This place just didn't impress me much. If not for my friend getting in for free, I would have given it one star. The venue is incredibly small; where's the dance floor? It's ridiculous! We also noticed some unsettling behavior from a group of older men who were being quite forward with the girls. The venue is tiny, the pool is small and crowded...overall, it was quite disappointing.

yelp:test:13904.orig: Came here with the BF last year with one of those VIP tickets.  TAO Beach itself is pretty small and packed.  There's nowhere to stand and trying to get drinks is horrendous. People pushing you as if they were giving out free drinks or something.\nWe actually enjoyed the other part of the pool area better. Plus, you can still hear the music from there, so why not?
yelp:test:13904.para:
Last year, I visited TAO Beach with my boyfriend using a VIP ticket. The venue is quite compact and crowded, making it hard to find standing room. Getting drinks is a real challenge; people push you around as if they're trying to hand out free drinks. 

We actually preferred the other section of the pool area, where it's less packed and you can still enjoy the music. So, that's where we spent most of our time.

yelp:test:13906.orig: Went at 2pm on a Thursday and they were closed. Sign on the window says open daily 10am to 11pm.  Except 2pm on Thursdays apparently. \n\nBy the way, if you happen to go and they are actually open, they accept cash only (as evidenced by their huge sign on the window). I don't think I'll be giving them another shot.
yelp:test:13906.para:
Visited at 2pm on a Thursday and found the place closed. The window sign indicates they're open from 10am to 11pm daily, but not on Thursdays at 2pm. 

By the way, if you do stop by and they are open, they only accept cash, as advertised on their large window sign. I don't plan to try my luck there again.

yelp:test:14001.orig: I had a feeling it was gonna be bad but I didn't know it was gonna be this bad. Came in here looking for yarn, and I immediately didn't like any I liked or was worth looking at! yelp:test:14001.para: I sensed it wouldn't be great, but I had no idea it would be this disappointing. I came in searching for yarn and instantly found nothing appealing or worth considering. The colors reminded me of 70s ski suits or 90s cat glitter strings. Anyway, I spotted a yarn that seemed okay, but the price was shocking—it was barely $4 for a ball, not even enough for a tiny mouse's tea cozy. yelp:test:14011.orig: Never enough employees working especially in the morning. Food is good and customer service is standard. Just wish they had more people working there to speed up the process.
yelp:test:14011.para: There are always not enough staff, particularly in the mornings. The food is satisfactory, and the customer service is typical. I just wish they could have more people to speed things up.

yelp:test:14021.orig: This place is very unique and healthy! Their wraps are amazing and the blended \""buzz\"" is very addicting. The only downside is the parking situation. I hate having to pull into this place because I feel like im either holding up traffic or about to get hit. A better idea - park at the Albertsons parking lot and WALK over. yelp:test:14021.para: This location is quite unique and health-conscious! Their wraps are outstanding, and the blended "buzz" is highly addictive. The only drawback is the parking. I find it stressful to park there, as I either block traffic or fear getting hit. A better option would be to park at the Albertsons lot and then walk over. It might involve a few extra steps, but it's definitely worth it!

yelp:test:14023.para: There's an employee named Leslie Ybarra who has been a real problem. After receiving two evaluations and a plan, I was prepared to proceed. This explains why other reviews are negative. I'm relieved she didn't call; I might have made things worse.

yelp:test:14027.orig: Nick's is our favorite Italian restaurant in the valley.  The Baked Ziti is the best.  We frequent Nick's once a month.  Great happy hour specials and friendly staff.
yelp:test:14027.para: Our go-to Italian eatery in the valley is Nick's, and their Baked Ziti is outstanding. We make it a point to visit Nick's every month. They offer fantastic happy hour deals, and the staff is very welcoming.

yelp:test:14043.orig:
Good place to go for a mexican quick meal.  Ive never had anything that I dont like. The salsa bar is good with nice choices and fresh.

Ole!
yelp:test:14043.para: A great spot for a quick Mexican meal where everything I've tried has been delightful. The salsa bar offers a variety of tasty, fresh options. Prices are reasonable, and they serve beer and margaritas too. Ole!

yelp:test:14058.orig: Very disappointing. A very unimaginative menu with fair at best food
yelp:test:14058.para: quite disappointing. The menu is rather uncreative, and the food is merely average at best.

I asked how much they were. she told me 2 for $4. uh... give me back my money..  she got all hurt that she didn't wasn't able to TAKE my money.  Also ordered a FIREBALL. poured me a cheap knock off. yelp:test:14081.para:
I approached the bar, ordered a beer, and laid out a five and four ones. The bartender brought two bottles and scooped up all my money. When I asked how much they were, she said $4 for two. I won't return there.

yelp:test:14084.orig: This used to be my go to Chipotle, compared to the one at Alma cause their rice was always undercooked. But I might head back there now cause like stated before on other reviews, the portions SUCK! The amount of food they give: whether it's rice, meat, salsa, etc., its all VERY LITTLE. not to mention the workers there are never happy. Never. Again.
yelp:test:14084.para: Previously, this was my preferred Chipotle location, as I found their rice to be better than the one at Alma, which often had undercooked rice. However, I might consider returning now based on recent reviews, which mention that the portions are extremely small. yelp:test:14127.orig:
Never returning. Gave this place two shots. First time 30 minute wait for an unmemorable sandwich. 
Second time,  called ahead to avoid wait. Picked up food. My soup was forgotten. I called to have the charge removed. They ""cannot refund my money, only the owner can and she's at the other location."" I ask them to have her call me as I'm getting irritated at this nonsense. An hour passes, no call. 
I call other location, owner answers with HUGE attitude and I explain what happened. She says ""so you forgot your soup?"" Bc it's of course my fault.  She starts babbling/complaining about how they're short staffed and busy. I really don't give a crap about her excuses or staffing levels, I just want my money back. I cannot possibly explain the owners terrible attitude in this review..comparable to Amy's baking co.

O
yelp:test:14127.para:
I never returned after giving this place two chances. On my first visit, I waited 30 minutes for a sandwich that was forgettable. On my second attempt, I called ahead to skip the line and picked up my order, only to find my soup missing. I asked for a refund, but they said I couldn't get a money refund; only the owner at the other location could, and she wasn't available. I requested she call me, but no one got back to me. 

When I called the other location, the owner was extremely rude and asked if I had forgotten my soup, as if it was my fault. She started complaining about being short-staffed, but I didn't care about her excuses. I just wanted my money back. I interrupted her and asked for a refund. She offered to call me back, but I said no, as she had already wasted too much of my time.

Finally, she refunded my money with a bad attitude, saying sorry for forgetting my soup and sorry for being short-staffed. The owner's attitude was terrible, similar to Amy's Baking Co. 

Moreover, if the owner doesn't trust her staff to refund $2.75, why should I trust them to make my sandwich properly?

yelp:test:14151.orig: Just got my bill and my rate went from $55.99/month to $62.99/month.  Wake up Cox!  A price increase of over 10% in this economy will send me and others searching for our next provider.\n\nNetflix and Youtube videos stall and buffer at night during peak usage times so it's not like you have a superior product.  Grrrr!  Unjustified price increases really make me mad!
yelp:test:14151.para:
My monthly bill just jumped from $55.99 to $62.99. Cox, you need to wake up! With a more than 10% price hike in the current economy, many of us, including myself, will look for alternative providers.

The streaming quality of Netflix and YouTube drops at night, so it's clear you don't offer a better product. This unjustified price increase really frustrates me!

yelp:test:14158.orig: We had been their costumer over 6 years now and we're finally moving on, their poor costumers service had exceed anything I ever come across. The last two month we paid the bill with cash in the store but they seem to have lost the records of any bill being paid and they are charging us fees over fees. I personally try to go in and show them the payment that was made but they give me a hard time. with 30 minutes of arguing and explaining they finally removed one fee, \n\nI got to say I am disappointed how much they have changed in costumers service. I really hope they will turn around and give more happy costumers their time and services that they want and deserve.
yelp:test:14158.para:
We've been a customer for over six years, but we're now deciding to move on due to their poor customer service, which has surpassed anything I've encountered. For the past two months, we've paid our bills in cash at the store, but they can't seem to find any record of these payments and are now charging us multiple fees. Every time I try to show them the payment receipts, they make it difficult. After a 30-minute argument and explanation, they only removed one fee.

I must say I'm disappointed by how much their customer service has deteriorated. I sincerely hope they will improve and provide the happy customers they deserve with the time and service they want.

yelp:test:14176.orig: I made appointments for my daughter and I to have mani-pedicures.  We are from another state and I just moved here and she was visiting me and we thought it would be fun.  I checked Yelp and saw good reviews so I was thinking this would be a great treat for my daughter.  I had the man working on me and he did a passable job but the woman who worked on my daughter didn't speak any English and within hours her manicure was chipping off and she had to re-file her toenails because they were so jagged and sharp.  Our feet were so dry from the pedicures that we had to apply tons of lotion to them to make them stop hurting.  The manicures hurt for days from all nicks we had around our nails from the cuticle scissors they used.  We would not recommend this nail salon to anyone.  By the time my daughter left from her vacation, her nail polish had completely chipped off.  What a waste of $85.00!!
yelp:test:14176.para: I scheduled mani-pedicures for myself and my daughter, who was visiting from another state after my recent move. We thought it would be a fun treat. After reading positive reviews on Yelp, we decided to go. The technician on my nails did a decent job, but the one working on my daughter struggled with English and her manicure started chipping within hours. Her toenails were also very jagged and needed reshaping. Our skin was extremely dry post-pedicure, so we had to apply lots of lotion to soothe the discomfort. The nail cuts from the scissors caused painful nicks around her nails, which lasted for days. By the end of her visit, her nail polish was completely chipped. It was a total waste of $85.00.

yelp:test:14178.orig:
I enjoyed a Pastrami Sandwich here for a reasonable price. Their bread here is great  (it is AZ Bread Co for a reason) and they toasted this sandwich perfectly. Loved every bite of it! 

Could it have been piled a little higher for a traditional deli style sandwich, yes, but it was good anyway, and think of the calories I saved. 

My friend had their french toast which looked mouth watering good!  Thick toast cooked perfectly with plenty of warm syrup on the side.
yelp:test:14178.para:
I relished a Pastrami Sandwich here at a fair price. The bread is outstanding (that's why it's AZ Bread Co), and they toasted it to perfection. I savored every bite!

While it might have been a bit more generous with the fillings for a classic deli sandwich, it was still delicious, and I probably saved on calories. My friend tried the French toast, which looked absolutely delectable! The thick slices were cooked to perfection, with plenty of warm syrup on the side.

yelp:test:14203.orig: I've eaten here 3 times and I kick myself for going back the other 2 times. The first time it was terrible. It was fish and chips and there was nothing but heavy batter, you had a hard time finding the fish, it must have been thin as a sheet of paper. But I gave it a second chance, figuring it might have been a bad day for the cook. So this time a got adventurous and had a rib-eye steak. What a disaster, it was cooked dry, so overly done I couldn't cut it with a knife. I asked for medium-rare. So, convinced I would not ever go back, until my neighbor begged me to go with her and again, terrible food. This place I would never recommend to anyone and I made it very clear to my neighbor I would not be returning.
yelp:test:14203.para: I visited this place three times, regretting my second and third visits. On my first trip, the fish and chips were a letdown; the batter was thick, and the fish was barely noticeable. Hoping it was just a bad day, I tried a rib-eye steak on my second visit. It was a disaster, overcooked and too dry to cut. I requested medium-rare. Despite my clear dissatisfaction, my neighbor convinced me to go again, and the food was still subpar. I won't recommend this place to anyone and made it known to my neighbor that I won't be returning.

yelp:test:14222.orig:
Our cheap rental is turning out to be $450 more because of the dent on the hood they insist was our responsibility. 

BIG TIP: Make a representative walk around the car with you and sign off on the no dents before you take the car off the lot or you could be the next one duped. 

I have never given a company a bad rating and I should have looked  here before renting at Fox since not many people had anything good to say.
yelp:test:14222.para:
The rental car we thought was cheap ended up being $450 more due to a dent on the hood they claim we caused.

A MAJOR TIP: Have a representative inspect the car with you and agree on no dents before you drive off the lot to avoid similar issues. 

I've never rated a company poorly, but I should have checked reviews before renting from Fox, as few people had positive things to say.

yelp:test:14223.orig: I live in Scottsdale and went out of town to Southern California for 4 days and booked this rental. The price was $116.00 total and I got there at 6 am on a Thursday so there was no line. The woman was nice and didn't try to up-sell me AT ALL. I didnt have a credit card so I had to put down a $400.00 deposit which was annoying but manageable. Brand new Chevy Malibu with 4900 miles which ran great. Brought it back at 3pm on Sunday with no line. Overall, I was pretty impressed. Last time we took a trip to Sedona and used Payless at the airport and it was horrid. I would rent again from Fox.
yelp:test:14223.para: I reside in Scottsdale and traveled to Southern California for a 4-day trip, where I rented a car. The total cost was $116.00, and I arrived at 6 am on a Thursday, finding no queue. The woman who assisted me was friendly and didn't try to sell me any additional services. Since I didn't have a credit card, I had to pay a $400.00 deposit, which was a bit frustrating but acceptable. The car was a brand new Chevy Malibu with only 4,900 miles and performed excellently. I returned it at 3 pm on Sunday without any wait. Overall, I was quite satisfied with the experience. Previously, when we went to Sedona, we used Payless at the airport, and it was a terrible experience. I would definitely rent from Fox again.

yelp:test:14251.orig: Because of this NNY I will never eat at another one. I wish I could leave no stars. I got served a hamburger with Brillo pad cooked in it. Then they only gave me 1/2 off the cost of my bill. Worthless. They should have comped the meal because I didn't finish it and was grossed out. Do not go to this NNY
yelp:test:14251.para: Due to this experience, I'll never return to another NNY. I wish I could give them zero stars. I received a hamburger that contained a Brillo pad, and they only offered a half-price discount on my bill. This was completely unacceptable. The meal should have been free since I couldn't eat it and found it revolting. Avoid this NNY at all costs.

yelp:test:14268.orig:
The layout of this store is great. My only complaint is that it takes just about as much time to check out as it does to shop. I'll admit....they have improved recently. ..however,  I would still like to see more cashiers. The store appears clean and organized. The clientele is less 'duck dynasty' inspired (code for white trash) than the Queen Creek store.

If you could reduce the checkout time, I'd give more stars.

Ok...now I'm extremely ANGRY! When I got home I scanned my receipt using the new Walmart app. When the app pulled up my receipt I reviewd the prices of the items I purchased, & I noticed a discrepancy. While I was at the store Pepsi was advertised that $2.24 a 12 pack. So, I bought eight. When I reviewed the receipt, I realized they charged me $3 a Pepsi. 
I called the customer service number and explain what happened to the lady over the phone. She put me on hold. After four and a half she came back on the line and ask me to explain explain what happened again. Then she told me I had to come to the store. I explained that now is going to have to spend gas money to go and resolve their mistake.  I told the lady to just pull my receipt up by the transaction number.
yelp:test:14268.para:
The store's layout is excellent, but the checkout process is quite lengthy, taking nearly as long as shopping itself. They have made some improvements recently, but I still think they could add more cashiers. The store looks clean and well-organized, and the customer base seems more refined compared to the Queen Creek store.

If they could shorten the checkout time, I would rate it higher.

Now, I'm extremely angry. When I got home, I used the Walmart app to scan my receipt. Upon reviewing the prices, I noticed a discrepancy. At the store, Pepsi was advertised at $2.24 per 12-pack, so I bought eight. However, my receipt showed I was charged $3 for each Pepsi. I contacted customer service, and the representative put me on hold for four and a half minutes before coming back to ask me to recount the issue. She then instructed me to visit the store to resolve the matter, which would require me to spend gas money. I suggested she could simply look up the transaction by the transaction number.

yelp:test:14358.orig:
I used to LOVE Freddy's.  We started going when we were in Texas on vacation and then the opened this location and WOW...we had a favorite.

We have been to this location several times and the location in Gilbert twice.  It used to be that EVERY time we went it was AMAZING!!  Now, it is hit or miss.  Last visit to this location the fries were WAY overcooked...quality control would tell you not to send out burnt fries, but no they sent them right out to us.  I think the little burger has shrunk and it was small before.  

Ouch, why is it that when you start to really love a place it goes downhill?  Well, at least In & Out burger stays consistant and since I now live in SoCal I guess we won't be missing Freddy's anymore.
yelp:test:14358.para:
I used to absolutely adore Freddy's. When we visited during our Texas vacation, and then they opened a location here, it was fantastic—we even had a go-to spot.

We've been to this location multiple times, and the Gilbert location twice. It used to be consistently amazing every time we visited. Now, it's more hit or miss. During our last visit, the fries were severely overcooked; quality control standards clearly wouldn't approve of sending out burnt fries, but they did. I suspect the little burger has gotten even smaller, and it was already small before.

It's frustrating how a place you come to love can decline in quality. At least In & Out Burger remains consistent, and since I now live in Southern California, we won't be missing Freddy's anymore.

yelp:test:14360.orig: This is the place to go for an after work Happy Hour, family feast, birthday celebrations, etc.  We go there 8 times a year for only celebrating special birthdays.  Everyone loves the food and the service is great.  Take a table or a booth, either way, the atmosphere is very nice.  Try their special appetizer platters and if you like margarita's, try their on the rocks ones, really the best in town.
yelp:test:14360.para: This spot is perfect for after-work Happy Hours, family dinners, and birthday parties. We visit eight times a year just for celebrating special birthdays. The food is adored by everyone, and the service is outstanding. Whether you choose a table or a booth, the ambiance is delightful. Don't miss their special appetizer platters and, if you enjoy margaritas, try their on-the-rocks versions; they're the best in town.

yelp:test:14375.orig: Great place for a dinner date or to woo a client or a propective hire. Great steak!! Went there for my anniversary and the valet puts a nice touch on the evening. Be prepared to walk out full.
yelp:test:14375.para: A fantastic spot for a romantic dinner or to impress a client or potential hire. The steak is outstanding! I celebrated my anniversary there, and the valet service added a nice touch to the evening. Be ready to leave feeling satisfied.

yelp:test:14377.orig:
Had dinner with five friends here. Four of us arrived and had a cocktail at the bar. We were seated after a 10 minute wait. Someone came by the table to greet us as soon as we were seated but we weren't sure if he was the waiter or not. He said bread was on the way (but we didn't see it till 20 minutes later) and gave us some menus.

We sat for nearly 10 minutes waiting for our waiter and no one showed up. I also want to note that the restaurant wasn't too busy on a Friday night (perhaps this review will explain why). One of my buddies asked another waiter for our server. The same guy who greeted us came back and said he was our waiter. I am not going to say his name as I don't want our country's unemployment rate to go up. The waiter made excuses on why he didn't come back. Whatever...

One of my buddies who's a wine connoisseur ordered a 2007 Syrah and the waiter brought out a 2008 instead. We politely sent it back. My buddy followed with another 2007 Cabernet and we again received the 2008 instead. How hard is it to update the wine menu? There's a huge difference in wine when it comes to the year. How can a ""famous"" steakhouse have such an oversight on the menus.

All
yelp:test:14377.para:
We had dinner with five friends at this place. Four of us got a cocktail at the bar before being seated after a 10-minute wait. A person greeted us promptly once we sat down, but we weren't sure if he was the waiter. He mentioned bread was coming (but we didn't see it for another 20 minutes) and handed us menus.

We waited almost 10 minutes for our waiter, who didn't appear. The restaurant wasn't very busy on a Friday, which might explain the service. One friend asked another waiter for our server, and the same greeter said he was our waiter. I won't mention his name to avoid increasing unemployment.

The waiter made excuses for his tardiness. One of my friends, a wine expert, ordered a 2007 Syrah, but received a 2008 instead. We politely returned it. He then ordered a 2007 Cabernet, and again got the 2008. It's surprising how a "famous" steakhouse could have such a mistake on its menu.

yelp:test:14381.orig: Went there last night for my first time and food was not that great, I have had better filet mignon. But that is not the reason why I am writing this review. We arrived and the hostess had asked my date to remove his hat which I could understand being a nice restaurant and all. After we had completed our dinner and waiting for the check to come, we see a large group seated and most of them were wearing hats, and t-shirts. Now, I am not one to complain about the food or service but if I am paying good $$$$ to eat at this so called nice place, I would accept the same rules apply to all customers. I had expressed my dissatisfaction to our lovely waitress but the manager came by and said sorry like it was no big deal. Regardless of why we were treated differently, If I am going to fork up $200 to eat at a nice restaurant I expect respect, great service and great food. I can say, I will never dine at Donovan's ever again and would give Hillstone my business. Way better service at Hillstone and better food.
yelp:test:14381.para: Last night marked my first visit, and the food didn't impress me much; I've had superior filet mignon before. However, that's not why I'm writing this review. Upon arrival, the hostess requested my date remove his hat, which I could accept given the restaurant's upscale nature. Post-dinner, while waiting for our bill, we noticed a large group seated, most of whom were wearing hats and t-shirts. Although I generally don't complain about food or service, I believe everyone should adhere to the same rules when dining at a premium establishment. I voiced my concerns to our waitress, but the manager merely apologized, making it seem like it was no big deal. Regardless of the reason for the disparity in treatment, if I'm spending around $200 on a nice meal, I expect respect, excellent service, and delicious food. I can confidently say I won't return to Donovan's and will instead support Hillstone, which offers superior service and cuisine.

yelp:test:14387.orig: I am an avid Black & White shopper, I love it! I just relocated to Scottsdale from Southern California and I have been SO disappointed with the service at the Kierland Commons location. Both my mom and I have been there several times and at first I thought it was just me, but confirming with my mom,  unfortunately we have both had the same experience. The ladies we have encountered have been so unfriendly and snobby which is so unlike the experience I have had in the past with other B&W locations. It makes me not want to shop there anymore! \nCome on ladies, it's not Chanel, please loosen up a little!
yelp:test:14387.para: I'm a big fan of Black & White, and I really enjoy shopping there. Recently, I moved to Scottsdale from Southern California, and I've been quite let down by the service at the Kierland Commons store. My mom and I have visited several times, and initially, I thought it might just be my experience, but when I checked with her, we both agreed that we've had the same frustrating experience. The staff we've interacted with have been very unfriendly and condescending, which is very different from how I've been treated at other Black & White locations. This has made me want to avoid shopping there. Come on, ladies, it's not Chanel, so please try to be more approachable!

yelp:test:14397.orig: I have driven by the this place countless times and never even knew it was there. It's tucked into a tiny strip mall on the north side. The owners/employees are extremely friendly and very helpful. We ordered a Philly Mushroom Cheese Steak and a Turkey Hoagie. Although both were delicious, we agreed the Cheese Steak was amazing. It's a little bit of a drive for us but will continue to go back because it was that good. I highly recommend trying this hidden little gem. It's as close to the real thing as you're going to get without going to Philly.
yelp:test:14397.para: I've passed this spot numerous times without realizing it existed. Located in a small strip mall on the north side, it's quite discreet. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful. We tried a Philly Mushroom Cheese Steak and a Turkey Hoagie; both were fantastic, but the Cheese Steak was truly outstanding. Despite the distance, we plan to return because it was so delicious. I strongly suggest giving this hidden gem a try—it's practically the real deal, just like in Philadelphia.

yelp:test:14410.orig:
This place is dead to me.  

I've been going here for years and used to be a regular for lunch.  The service went way town hill a couple of years ago so I stopped going as often but would occasionally go if I didn't have afternoon meetings.  Not anymore.  The service just isn't slow it's terrible.  I walked out after 20 minutes of no service today, the place was only half full and one of the waitresses was prioritizing bussing a table instead of taking care of guests.  

Too bad, the food is actually decent.
yelp:test:14410.para:
This place has lost its appeal for me. 

I used to frequent it regularly for lunch over the years. However, the service quality declined significantly a few years back, prompting me to visit less often. I'd still go if I didn't have afternoon meetings, but not now. The service is not just slow; it's awful. Today, I left after 20 minutes of waiting, even though the restaurant was only half full, and one of the waitresses was focusing on clearing tables rather than attending to customers. 

Unfortunately, the food is quite good.

yelp:test:14448.orig: While I acknowledge I got there at 5:05 am - 5 minutes after they were set to close, the complete lack of compassion of the people I encountered was quite surprising.  Here I am, 5 months pregnant with a sick toddler still in his PJs, in an obvious rush to make it in the doors by 5 a.m.  The lobby is completely empty and the front door unlocked when I arrive.  I hear someone in the back say \""that's not someone new, is it?\""  and another voice responded \""no, probably just someone leaving.\""  Next thing I know I see the people who own the voices I heard - one looks like one of the doctors or nurses and the other like the person who runs the front desk area.  All I get is \""sorry, we're closed.\""  With the fact that I didn't make it in time sinking in, near tears (I blame the pregnancy hormones) I explain that I had a difficult time finding them in the strip mall where they are located and got stuck at a light.  This time I get one word - \""sorry.\""  I look up to see faces of stone.  Nothing.  Neither of the ladies offered any suggestion on where else I might be able to take my sick child to be seen by a doctor, which we were obviously in need of since we'd come to their urg
yelp:test:14448.para: Although I arrived at 5:05 am, five minutes after their scheduled closing time, the lack of empathy from the people I met was surprising. I was 5 months pregnant and had a sick toddler in his pajamas, rushing to get inside by 5 a.m. The lobby was empty, and the front door was unlocked when I arrived. I overheard someone in the back say, "That's not someone new, is it?" and another voice replied, "No, probably just someone leaving." Then, I saw the individuals who owned those voices—one looked like a doctor or nurse, and the other like the front desk staff. They simply said, "Sorry, we're closed." As the reality of not making it in time sank in, and I was on the verge of tears (due to pregnancy hormones), I explained that I had trouble finding their location in the strip mall and got stuck at a traffic light. This time, I received only one word: "Sorry." Their faces were expressionless, and neither offered any suggestions on where else I could take my sick child for medical attention, which was clearly necessary since we had come to their urgent care facility.

yelp:test:14454.orig: Arrived to sit down with a good crowd & ambiance. Soon a stinky bar tender assisted with our order.\nHis body oder was so offensive that it made me gag... We didn't want him to come near us. Couldn't even enjoy our meal. Came here on a Monday evening to watch a football game.
yelp:test:14454.para: Upon arriving, I found a pleasant atmosphere and a good crowd. However, the bartender who assisted with our order had a very unpleasant body odor that was quite offensive. We were so put off by it that we didn't want him to come close to us. The smell made it impossible for us to enjoy our meal. We had come on a Monday evening to watch a football game.

yelp:test:14456.orig: Lost my health insurance application along with many others according to the health insurance exchange. Very poor customer service and zero accountability. I would stay away even though their prices are low.
yelp:test:14456.para: I couldn't find my health insurance application, and it seems I'm not the only one, based on the reports from the health insurance exchange. The customer service is very poor, and there's no accountability at all. Despite their low prices, I wouldn't recommend this service.

yelp:test:14462.para:
One star is more than this company deserves. Following my initial review, I reached out to Aaron Pools via their contact form. Here is their response (last names omitted):

Dear Becky,

We have no record of you or your judgment of our company, which has been operating for over 35 years. You are not a customer of ours.

Mr. A. is our customer and the one with whom you should perhaps share this letter. He can contact us to dispute any claims in this message.

Mr. A. scheduled an appointment with us to replace the filter grids at 2939 E. Bonanza Road, Gilbert, AZ. He canceled the appointment to research grid costs and find a better deal. He found grids and planned to drop them off early the week of May 7th, informing us he would call to confirm. The only point of agreement between your office staff and us is that he did not drop them off until the afternoon of May 10th, and when he called, he expected an immediate appointment. We informed him we couldn't guarantee an immediate service.

yelp:test:14466.orig: took my scooter to get serviced here. worst experience ever,  I had read the bad reviews but still decided to try it out. My scooter has an oil leak, he told me it would be $55 for the first hour to find out where it was leaking from and call me to see how to proceed. He called me 2 days later and told me that there was a big leak, which I understood. But then he told me that the twist throttle was broken so they removed it. Something that had nothing to do with the leak.  Now I can't ride my scooter because the throttle is stuck.  He says they didnt break it, he blamed on me. I had half a tank when I took it to him, when I picked it up it was on empty. I don't recommend this place to anyone. They're just looking to make money off you.
yelp:test:14466.para: I brought my scooter in for service here, and it was the worst experience. Despite reading negative reviews, I decided to give them a chance. They said it would cost $55 for the first hour to locate the oil leak and then call me to discuss further. Two days later, they informed me of a significant leak, which I accepted. However, they also claimed the twist throttle was broken and removed it, even though it wasn't related to the leak. Now, my scooter won't start because the throttle is stuck. They insist they didn't break it and blame me. Moreover, my scooter was nearly full when I dropped it off, but it was nearly empty when I picked it up. I strongly advise against using this shop; they only seem interested in profiting from their customers.

yelp:test:14507.orig: So, I really don't like complaining, but, only having two people run the joint in the early evening is definitely not enough. My husband and I first attempted to go through the drive though and after a few minutes, we weren't even sure if the place was open so we pulled around to try to go inside. By the time we parked, someone else was already in the drive through being helped. It was slightly annoying but still laughable at this point. When we went inside, we quietly waited for the guy in front of us to finish his order. However, as soon as he was done, they told us to wait and started helping all of the drive through customers. Either we have extremely bad luck or they definitely need to get their act together and hire more people. They made up for at least two stars by being friendly when they finally helped us and giving us fresh, hot fries. I don't think we'll ever have time to come to this location again.
yelp:test:14507.para: While I generally avoid complaining, it's clear that having just two people manage the place during early evenings is insufficient. My husband and I initially tried the drive-through but, after a few minutes, we weren't sure if the restaurant was open and decided to park inside. By the time we did, another customer was already being served at the drive-through window. This was mildly frustrating but still amusing. Inside, we patiently waited for the person in front of us to complete their order. However, as soon as they finished, they began assisting the drive-through customers, leaving us waiting. Either we had particularly bad luck, or they need to hire more staff. Despite the wait, the staff was friendly and provided us with fresh, hot fries, which was a positive. Unfortunately, we probably won't visit this location again.

yelp:test:14565.orig:
Ok, I have way better Chinese style Western food in Los Angeles.
I will say half of the dishes in its menu are soso or not good. Half of them meets my expectation.

I give it  2 stars.
yelp:test:14565.para:
Sure, here is the paraphrased version:

In Los Angeles, I find much superior Chinese-style Western cuisine. About half of the dishes on their menu are just okay or not up to par, while the other half meet my expectations.
