yelp:test:14571.orig: good boba milk tea!  wonderful food. had the Mongolian beef and chicken wings w/ fried rice. the beef was subtely spicy and very flavorful. I will be back.
yelp:test:14571.para: Delicious boba milk tea! Excellent food overall. I tried the Mongolian beef and chicken wings with fried rice. The beef was subtly spicy and incredibly flavorful. I look forward to returning.

yelp:test:14575.orig: I have had to change my review from 5 to 2 because the last few times I have gone my steak has not been cooked correctly. It is disappointing, but this place is still ok for the view.
yelp:test:14575.para: I had to adjust my rating from 5 to 2 due to the steak not being cooked properly on my recent visits. While it's disappointing, the view is still a plus, making it tolerable.

yelp:test:14577.orig: Read reviews elsewhere to get the real picture.  This place is getting really, really bad.  Corporate management needs to change out the office staff and enforce posted policies before this whole complex goes to ruin.  It's so sad to see such a pretty location be handled so poorly.  It could be (and used to be) a great complex.  Now it's not worth the high rent they charge, the crime you'll be exposed to, and the noisy neighbors.
yelp:test:14577.para: To get an accurate impression, check reviews from other sources. This establishment has significantly declined in quality. Corporate leadership should replace the office staff and strictly enforce the existing policies to prevent further deterioration. It's heartbreaking to witness such a beautiful site being managed so poorly. With proper management, it had the potential to be excellent, but now it's overpriced, unsafe due to increased crime, and plagued by noisy neighbors.

yelp:test:14602.orig: I love so many things about this place....the Bloody Mary is stellar, the fingerling potatoes are addictive, and I really like the \""window seat\"" for large groups. The parking guys are great and the location is right in my backyard.  Now for the \""requires improvement\""...I've talked with a specific employee, both on the phone and in person, and she is not customer-friendly, which has caused me to take this place off my list for special occasions (dinner club, monthly brunch).  Once the service improves, this place will double its business.  I'm also not a fan of the inside jazz on Sundays.  Once it moves outside during the winter, things will be better.\n\nThe bottom line: if you are very patient with inconsistent service and loud music, try it ASAP.  Otherwise, you have to take your chances!
yelp:test:14602.para:
I adore numerous aspects of this establishment...the Bloody Mary is outstanding, the fingerling potatoes are incredibly satisfying, and I particularly enjoy the "window seat" for larger groups. The parking attendants are excellent, and the location is conveniently close to my home. However, there are areas that need improvement...I've spoken with a particular staff member both by phone and in person, and she isn't customer-oriented, which has led me to exclude this place from my special occasions (dinner club, monthly brunch). Once the service quality improves, this venue could see a significant increase in business. I also dislike the indoor jazz music on Sundays; once it's moved outside during the winter, things should improve. 

In summary: If you can be patient with inconsistent service and loud music, give it a try right away. Otherwise, proceed with caution!

yelp:test:14607.orig: Visited this place during happy hour on a Saturday.  Seated in outdoor dining area.  Even though it was cool outside, the heaters kept us warm.  Started with the baked goat cheese.  It was very good, but had a little too much tomato and not enough of the goat cheese.  I had the pork chile verde.  Not huge portions but it had great flavor and the meat was very tender.  Husband had the french onion burger and it was yummy.  The table next to us ordered the flatbread and it looked delicious.  I might have to try it next time around.  Our waiter was attentive.  I will be back in the future.
yelp:test:14607.para: On a Saturday during happy hour, we dined outdoors where the heaters ensured we stayed warm despite the cool weather. We began with baked goat cheese, which was quite good, though it had an excess of tomato and lacked goat cheese. My main course was pork chile verde; while the portions weren't large, the flavor was excellent, and the meat was very tender. My husband enjoyed the French onion burger, which was delicious. The flatbread from the neighboring table appeared very appetizing, and I plan to try it next time. Our waiter was attentive, and I look forward to returning.

yelp:test:14628.orig: As someone who used to play the violin I really appreciate this place. I was most recently here at Christmas seeing The Nutcracker Ballet with my boyfriend. Thanks for coming with me baby! :) They usually feature a mixture of orchestra concerts, ballets, operas, and musical performances. Coming here is a great way to support the Arts in Arizona, and I have never been less than amazed by the performances they put on here. Located in the heart of downtown Phoenix, The Symphony would make a great cultured date or place to bring an out of towner. \n\nP.S The new Nutcracker was brilliant, check it out next Xmas you won't be disappointed!
yelp:test:14628.para:
As a former violinist, I truly value this venue. My most recent visit was during Christmas when I saw The Nutcracker Ballet with my partner. Thank you for accompanying me, my love! :) They typically offer a variety of events including orchestra concerts, ballets, operas, and musical performances. Attending here is an excellent way to support the arts in Arizona, and I've always been thoroughly impressed by their shows. Situated in downtown Phoenix, The Symphony is perfect for a cultured date or to impress out-of-town guests. 

P.S. The new Nutcracker was outstanding. Make sure to see it next Christmas; you won't be disappointed!

yelp:test:14631.orig: When this place first opened they had some really good Mexican food and service. New management came in and really changed the feel of this place, trying to make it more of a restaurant then fast food Mexican. Unfortunately this place has really gone down hill and their food isn't that great anymore. I have given them more then one chance thinking they maybe having a bad day, but each time I have gone back it's been worse. I wouldn't recommend it.
yelp:test:14631.para: Initially, this establishment offered excellent Mexican cuisine and service. However, with the new management, the atmosphere shifted towards a more formal dining experience, away from its fast-food roots. Unfortunately, the quality has declined significantly, and the food is not as good as it used to be. Despite giving them multiple chances, each visit has been worse than the last. I no longer recommend it.

yelp:test:14654.orig: Good wings.  A person who worked there recommended the Gold Fever sauce.  I must say I was not disappointed.  It was spicy, yet tasty...  two things I like when I eat wings.  Too bad I don't live closer or else this would be a good place to go when I have a wing fix.
yelp:test:14654.para: The wings were excellent, and a colleague suggested the Gold Fever sauce, which I found quite satisfying. It was spicy but delicious—exactly what I enjoy in wings. If only I lived nearer, this place would be perfect for when I crave wings.

yelp:test:14655.orig: Went to sardellas for the first time since, I was new to the area and was presently surprised. When I walked in I was greeted by a younger gentleman named Matt who gave me great descriptions of different types if pizza and even sold me on the wings which are my new favorite! Great customer service along with short waiting time for the food must go an try for your self!
yelp:test:14655.para: My first visit to Sardellas was a pleasant surprise, especially since I was new to the area. Upon entering, I was greeted by Matt, a younger staff member, who provided excellent descriptions of various pizza options and convinced me to try their wings, which are now my favorite! The customer service was top-notch, and the wait for my food was minimal. I highly recommend giving it a try!

yelp:test:14669.orig: This place is shit the workers lie about transfer fees and when they find out you dont have an AR or Glock they are dicks.
yelp:test:14669.para: This location is really disappointing; the staff misrepresent the transfer fees, and if they discover you don't have an AR or Glock, they become uncooperative.

yelp:test:14673.orig: beware of this dealership and avoid them at any cost. I was ready to buy a new Camry and had a quote from another dealership and they told me they'll match the price if i go there. After driving long distance, we went there and told them at the beginning the quote i had for LE model and they said they'll match. fast forward 2-3 hours later after showing us several cars and many \""manager\""s came and talk to us. a very rude, unprofessional and aggressive person came introduced himself as Tim. The written quote I had was $1k below their price on KBB and we were fine for paying whatever they advertised on KBB since they had the exact color we wanted. but **TIM** was so rude and aggressive that we decided to leave. Other staffs were good specially the boy who showed us the cars, but one terrible person is enough to make the whole experience disaster. They wasted our afternoon, save yours!
yelp:test:14673.para: Be cautious of this dealership and do your best to steer clear of them. I was prepared to purchase a new Camry and had a quote from another dealership, which they promised to match if I visited them. After a lengthy drive, we arrived and informed them of the quote for the LE model. They agreed to match the price. However, after viewing several cars and interacting with multiple "managers," a particularly rude and aggressive individual named Tim approached us. The written quote I had was $1,000 less than their price on KBB, and we were content to pay the advertised amount since they had the exact color we desired. But **TIM**'s behavior was so unpleasant that we chose to leave. While other staff members were helpful, especially the young man who showed us the cars, one bad experience is enough to ruin the entire visit. They wasted our afternoon, so please avoid them!

yelp:test:14679.orig:
I decided to walk in here on a whim, and kinda regret doing so. The food could have been pretty decent, but it was -extremely- oily. There was a visible puddle of oil left after I scooped the meat and veggies out of the plate they were delivered to, and onto the rice. Outside of that it was fine, it was pleasantly spicy, and would have otherwise been mediocre Chinese food (I prefer thai in any case).

This is definitely a place geared for delivery. The internal appearance was very dingy, and as another reviewer commented, there are boxes and things sitting around out in the main area. The service wasn't horrible; it's not exactly sit down service; you order from a counter, but I -did- have the food brought to my table. 

Had the food not been so greasy (seriously, they could have used 1/4th the oil they did, which still would have been a little much, but certainly within the realm of 'okay' for my standards), and had the internal decor been a bit better (remove the boxes, ensure everything is clean and a bit better lit), and I could see giving this place another star or two...but as it was, I regretted going in.
yelp:test:14679.para:
I stumbled in here on a whim and now I'm not sure it was a good idea. The food had potential, but it was overly greasy. There was a clear oil spill on my plate after I transferred the meat and vegetables onto the rice. Apart from that, it was okay; it was nicely spicy, though still on the mediocre side for Chinese food (I prefer Thai). 

This place seems more suited for takeout. The interior was quite dim and messy, with boxes and other items scattered in the main area, as another reviewer noted. The service wasn't bad; it wasn't sit-down service, but my food was brought to my table. 

If the food hadn't been so greasy (they could have used much less oil, even if it was still a bit on the greasy side), and if the decor had been a bit cleaner and better lit, I might have given it a higher rating. But as it was, I'm glad I didn't stay longer.

yelp:test:14686.orig:
My sunglasses were stolen! 

Now, I'm an adult and a highly reasonable one.  I'm not prone to public whining sessions or making scenes.   I'm very aware that leaving a pair of NICE sunglasses in a rental car when you turn it in is not an advisable thing to do.  I would also expect to never see those sunglasses again if the car had not been thoroughly inspected or had been immediately rented out again to another customer.  

I rented a car from the San Diego location and drove to Scottsdale to attend a conference.   During that drive I made the mistake of taking off my sunglasses and instead of planting them firmly on top of my head, I put them in the dash compartment.  I made the drive on Sunday, the location to drop off wouldn't be open when I got there.  Ok, fine - not that big a deal.  The conference didn't start until 9am on Monday morning, plenty of time to get to the drop off point, turn in my car and catch a taxi back to the conference hotel.   The taxi was late and in my panic to get back to the conference in time, I was scrambling.    The taxi shows up, mad dash back to the hotel, run to the conference room and as soon as my butt hits the chair, I remember - the SUNGLA
yelp:test:14686.para:
My sunglasses were taken! 

As a mature and rational individual, I don't tend to complain publicly or create a scene. I fully understand that leaving valuable sunglasses in a rental car upon return is not a wise move. I also expect that the sunglasses would be gone if the car hadn't been inspected or immediately rented out to someone else.

I rented a car from the San Diego location and drove to Scottsdale for a conference. While on the way, I removed my sunglasses and placed them in the dash compartment instead of keeping them on my head. Since the drop-off location wouldn't be open when I arrived, I planned to return the car and catch a taxi to the conference hotel the next morning. However, the taxi was late, and in my rush to make it to the conference on time, I forgot about the sunglasses until I sat down in the conference room.

yelp:test:14696.orig: I have been to crackers and company over 17 times. The service is always outstanding especially Byron. He knows the menu and he tells you exactly what you need to know to make sure your meal is fabulous. The food is always prepared perfectly and I'm very very picky about my breakfast. I would recommend crackers and company to everyone. Would I come back here, of course it's my favorite place to go in the Mesa area for breakfast or lunch
yelp:test:14696.para: I've visited Crackers and Company more than 17 times, and the service has consistently been exceptional, particularly with Byron. He is well-versed in the menu and provides detailed information to ensure your meal is outstanding. The food is always prepared flawlessly, and I'm quite particular about my breakfast. I highly recommend Crackers and Company to everyone. Would I return? Absolutely; it's my go-to spot for breakfast or lunch in the Mesa area.

yelp:test:14714.orig: Tried a few more dishes, and was most impressed with the tofu soup which spicy, flavorful, and filled with a good amount of meat and tofu.  The bbq items were all too sweet (kalbi and beef bulgolgi), while the jap chae was decent and came in a gigantic bowl for everyone to share.
yelp:test:14714.para: I sampled a few more dishes and was particularly impressed with the tofu soup, which was spicy, flavorful, and packed with a substantial amount of meat and tofu. The BBQ items, however, were overly sweet (the kalbi and beef bulgolgi), whereas the jap chae was satisfactory and served in a large bowl for everyone to enjoy.

yelp:test:14743.orig: I have been to this location twice in the past month and each time they mess up our order. Either they put two pieces of nuts I. A whole large ice cream or completely don't put in any item at all! I won't be coming to this location anymore.
yelp:test:14743.para: In the last month, I visited this place twice, and both times there were issues with our orders. They either included an extra large ice cream or forgot to add an item altogether. I won't be returning there.

yelp:test:14762.orig: This is such a great little neighborhood spot! I've been here several times since we moved to Mesa and service is always great. Food is great! I haven't had a dish that I didn't like and I've had a variety from their menu. If they forget something or make an error they most definitely make up for it before you leave. That's really all you can ask for!
yelp:test:14762.para: This neighborhood place is fantastic, and I've visited it multiple times since moving to Mesa. The service is consistently excellent, and the food is terrific too. I've tried several dishes from their menu, and none have disappointed me. If there's a minor issue or mistake, they ensure it's resolved before I leave. That's really all you could hope for!

yelp:test:14772.orig: Dr. Heather & Megan are the best! They love the kitties and are so knowledgeable.We wouldnt go anywhere else.
yelp:test:14772.para: Dr. Heather and Megan are outstanding! They adore the cats and possess a wealth of knowledge. We have no doubt that they are the best choice for our feline friends.

yelp:test:14783.orig:
I was very disappointed with the service or lack there of from benefit air. 

My A.C. unit wasn't working properly so I called Benefit heating and air. I was charged a $79 service for the tech to come out which seems to be standard with most of the companies. From the moment Chuck the tech came out he was only concerned with selling me a new unit. He spent almost all of his time taking measurements and giving me a quote on a $9000 new unit. When he finished I asked him if he repaired or replaced anything and he said no. When it was all said and done I paid $79 for a quote on a new unit. 

IN MY OPINION THEY SENT OUT A SALESMAN NOT A TECH.

After he left I called around for a second opinion. I found a company that didn't charge a service fee for coming out. The new tech arrived, determined the problem within 10 minutes and asked if I wanted it repaired for $149.00. What would you have done? $9000 or $149? That was a no brainer for me. 

Benefit heating and air was NO BENEFIT to me.

( In response to Michaels reply )

I did contact Michael who apologized for my negative experience and offered and sent out a refund of my $79.  

Thanks again Michael
yelp:test:14783.para:
I was highly dissatisfied with Benefit Air's service, or rather, the lack thereof. My air conditioning unit wasn't functioning correctly, so I contacted Benefit Heating and Air. I was billed $79 for the technician to visit, which is typical across many companies. When Chuck, the technician, arrived, he seemed more focused on selling me a new unit than fixing my current one. He spent most of his time measuring and providing a quote for a $9,000 new unit. When I inquired if he had made any repairs, he confirmed that no repairs were done. In the end, I paid $79 for a quote on a new unit.

IN MY OPINION, THEY SENT OUT A SALESMAN INSTEAD OF A TECHNICIAN.

After Chuck left, I sought a second opinion by calling another company that didn't charge for a service call. The new technician diagnosed the issue within 10 minutes and offered to repair it for $149. Given the choice between $9,000 and $149, it was an easy decision for me. Benefit Heating and Air provided no benefit to me.

(Regarding Michael's response)

I did reach out to Michael, who apologized for my negative experience and offered to refund the $79 I paid. Thank you, Michael.

yelp:test:14805.orig: Huge fan of this place. I go there every couple of months. Amazing food!
yelp:test:14805.para: I'm a big fan of this spot, and I visit it about every two months. The food is fantastic!

yelp:test:14849.orig: Checked in online and was in and out in under half an hour. Location was clean and my stylist, Tasha, was great. Conversational and adept at what she does - she knew exactly what I was looking for and completed it efficiently.
yelp:test:14849.para: I completed the check-in online and managed to come and go within less than half an hour. The place was clean, and my stylist, Tasha, was excellent. She was conversational and highly skilled at her work—she understood precisely what I wanted and executed it efficiently.

yelp:test:14864.orig: I am a hot wing fan and this place has some pretty awesome ones. They're always meaty and crispy. Sometimes they need more sauce, as I like them saucey, but the waitress will easily comply with that request. Their individual pizzas are very good, they have lots of topping choices and they have good crust. Reasonably priced and great for a loud night out with friends.
yelp:test:14864.para: I'm a big fan of hot wings, and this place serves some really delicious ones that are always juicy and crispy. While I prefer them drenched in sauce, the staff is happy to accommodate that. The individual pizzas are also quite tasty, with a wide variety of toppings and a nice crust. The prices are reasonable, making it a great spot for a lively night out with friends.

yelp:test:14883.orig: I am a regular. I come every week and the bagels are just nothing like the others in town. Originally from the east coast, BB is the closest thing to a nice chewy bagel from home. \n\nI get the Tijuana hot. Omg it's amazing. The boys that work are so pleasant and such a great staff.
yelp:test:14883.para: I frequent this place regularly and find their bagels to be far superior to any others in town. The bagels from BB, originally from the east coast, are the closest I've found to the nice, chewy ones from home. The Tijuana hot bagel is outstanding. The staff is incredibly friendly and makes for a great experience.

yelp:test:14898.orig: Do not go here for a check up.  They made me wait in the room for an hour before the doctor came to see me.  And she just walks in like nothing is wrong.   The doctor sat down and just asked me a few basic questions about my health history and squeezes my legs and arms and says \""you seem healthy\"".  I ask for a blood test and they send the lab work OUTSIDE of my insurance network.  A month later, I get a bill for 1500 bucks for a blood test -____-.   Save yourself the money and the headache.  Go elsewhere
yelp:test:14898.para: Avoid this place for your check-up. I had to wait an hour in the room before the doctor arrived, and when she did, she seemed completely unfazed. The doctor asked a few basic health history questions, gave a quick physical, and concluded, "You seem healthy." I requested a blood test, but they sent it to a lab outside my insurance network. A month later, I received a bill for $1,500—frustrating! Save yourself the hassle and expense; find another provider.

yelp:test:14902.orig:
Came here for a special event. Based on the food served, I would not come as a paying customer. Bland penne with blander, sparse sauce. Overdone broccoli. Nice looking Caesar with big croutons and... ranch dressing? Ew. Chicken slimy something. Not sure what it was. 

Bathrooms were gas-station dirty.

Two stars for free food.
yelp:test:14902.para:
Attended for a special occasion, but I wouldn't order from here if I were paying. The penne was bland with a meager, lackluster sauce. The broccoli was overcooked. The Caesar salad looked good with large croutons, but the ranch dressing was off-putting. The chicken was unappetizing, almost slimy, and I can't recall the exact dish. 

The restrooms were extremely unclean, more like those at a gas station. Rated it two stars solely for the free food.

We arrived around midnight and took over 2 hours to check in.  Although we had a reservation, we had to let about 100 people with no reservations check in before us.  A plane was cancelled and a large group sent to SouthPoint.  I am happy for SouthPoint getting business, but what is advantage to prebook a room.  After 2 hours we finally got checked in however they could not make room keys - so although we got a room, we could not get in the room another 20 minutes or so.  In the morning we called to ask if we could get another room since the one we were given had a brick wall as our window and supervisor said for more money we can upgrade you.  When I mentioned long checkin issue, as a supervisor she said there were people before you checking in.  We were there a month ago - paid half what we paid for this weekend and had a great room.   The staff (Supervisor) basically blamed me for booking a cheap room? Did not have any reason to believe paying more than last visit would get us such a poor room.  Last month cheaper and b
yelp:test:14915.para: We recently stayed at the SouthPoint during the extended Valentine's weekend. We've stayed there before and appreciate its location off the strip, which offers numerous amenities. Upon arrival around midnight, we faced an unusually long check-in process, taking over two hours. Despite having a reservation, we had to wait for about 100 people without reservations. It turned out a plane cancellation had led to a large group being directed to SouthPoint. While I'm glad the hotel received guests, I question the benefit of reserving a room under these circumstances. After finally checking in, we discovered the room keys were unavailable, so we couldn't enter our room for another 20 minutes. In the morning, we inquired about a room change because our assigned room had a brick wall for a window. The supervisor suggested we could upgrade for extra money. When we brought up the long wait, she stated that people were checked in before us. A month ago, we paid half the price and had a much better room. The supervisor seemed to blame us for choosing a cheaper room, which made no sense to us since we didn't expect a worse room for paying more.

yelp:test:14933.orig:
For a place that I have expected to be trendy with amazing food, this place falls flat.  

The cocktails were mediocre, and food was mediocre.  The only thing that was sort of OK was the atmosphere.  

We were first there for drinks, but later decided to have dinner.  The bartender that day didn't seem too happy and had a straight face the whole time.  He didn't try to make any kind of conversation and just made drinks and took our order.  Ok, I don't mind it too much because as long as he made great drinks and didn't mess up our orders I didn't mind.  The drinks as I said, were mediocre.  

We had a couple rolls and it was still mediocre, which was very disappointing.  I had hanabi with spicy tuna which I thought the flavors just didn't mesh well at all.  The tuna itself was amazing, but with the fried cube of sushi rice dipped in sweet soy sauce... it just doesn't fit.  The seaweed salad was a little bit on the salty side, and that it was nothing more special than the ones I can get from a Japanese market.  
I also had Shima roll, which was shrimp wrapped with spicy tuna, avocado, and cilantro.  It was not bad, but not good either. Just bland I guess.  Not impressed. 

O
yelp:test:14933.para:
I was hoping for a lively spot with fantastic cuisine, but this place fell short. The cocktails and food were both just okay. The ambiance was the only positive aspect.

We initially went for drinks, but ended up having dinner as well. The bartender seemed unenthusiastic, barely engaging in conversation and just focusing on making drinks and taking our order. While I didn't mind his lack of chit-chat, the drinks were still just average.

For dinner, we tried a few rolls, and they were also just average, which was quite disappointing. My hanabi with spicy tuna had flavors that didn't complement each other well. The tuna was delicious, but the fried sushi rice dipped in sweet soy sauce didn't work. The seaweed salad was a bit too salty and wasn't much different from what I could get at a Japanese market. 

The Shima roll, with shrimp, spicy tuna, avocado, and cilantro, was okay but not great. It was just bland. Overall, I wasn't impressed.

yelp:test:14947.orig: we had a great server but we came with a whole soccer team and apparently the other server helping them can't do her job and the manager didn't seem too concerned with the poor service.
yelp:test:14947.para: We enjoyed our server, but when we brought along a full soccer team, it became clear that the other server assisting them was struggling to handle the situation. The manager didn't seem particularly worried about the subpar service.

yelp:test:14986.orig: If you are a big fan of slow service then this is the Taco Bell for you . I say that the average time of waiting is about 15 minutes and that is just for a burrito. And this isn't just an isolated slow time this is every single time I go to this Taco Bell. And don't think just because you go to the drive through that it be quick though the drive through is  super slow too.  Every time I go there I can be guaranteed that my wife says to me when I get home what took you so long? Also they suck at making your order right too. I had the stuff nacho griller thing the other day and it looked like a four-year-old had folded it up. Pay the extra couple bucks for Del Taco is my advice.
yelp:test:14986.para: If you enjoy long waits, this Taco Bell is perfect for you. On average, I spend around 15 minutes just for a burrito, and this slow service is consistent every time I visit. My recommendation is to spend a bit more at Del Taco instead.

yelp:test:14987.orig: terrible service; pay with debit card and get an attitude plus an additional $1 for the privilege.  Typical service of a business that couldn't care less, and think THEY are doing YOU the favor.   Do YOURSELF a favor and go somewhere they actually value their customers.  Here they DO NOT!!

This is the kind of treatment you'd expect from a business that doesn't care and considers themselves doing you a favor. Save yourself and go somewhere that actually values its customers. This place definitely does not!

yelp:test:15000.orig: Great steaks, salads, ambiance, decor. Highly recommend coming.
yelp:test:15000.para: Excellent steaks, salads, and the atmosphere are all top-notch. I highly recommend you visit.

yelp:test:15005.orig: I've used the north location without problems in the past. I live in the SW now so went here despite the bad reviews. I have a q5 with 45k miles on it and only had 4mm left on my front pads. I was told by just brakes that I needed new rotars and told that there's \""not enough metal\"" on them to be re surfaced. The bill would be 650 bucks. (Better than 900 which the dealership quoted me) but I decided to get a 2nd opinion anyway. I took it to another garage on trop/dec and they said they can resurface them and change the pads for under 200 bucks. Always get a 2nd opinion.
yelp:test:15005.para: In the past, I had no issues with the north location, but now that I live in the SW, I chose to go there despite the negative reviews. My Q5, with 45,000 miles, had only 4mm left on the front brake pads. Just Brakes informed me that I needed new rotors and that there wasn't enough material to resurface them, estimating a cost of $650 (which was better than the $900 quoted by the dealership). However, I sought a second opinion. At another garage on Trop/Dec, they offered to resurface the rotors and change the pads for less than $200. It's always wise to get a second opinion.

yelp:test:15133.para: Oh, I can't express how frustrating my experience at this place was. To put it simply, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, especially strangers. I needed to get my industrial piercing reinserted for a hair appointment, so I went to this nearby shop. The moment I entered, the staff was unkind to me. They told me the piercer was on her lunch break and that I had missed her. I said it was okay to wait and asked about the wait time and if my piercing would be okay. yelp:test:15137.orig:
Sadly, the steak was disappointing! 

So we were in vegas for a quick trip and wanted desperately to go to The SW Steakhouse. We tried making last minute reservations but they only had 5pm and 10pm available and since we didn't want to eat with the blue haired patrons or eat with the wait staff, we decided to explore our options. 

Cut also only had a 5:15pm available and Carnevino had no openings... so I went down my steakhouse list and found Charlie Palmer Steakhouse. Anticipating a booked night, I still called and was surprised by how many openings they had. I originally asked for 8pm and then changed it later to 7pm and with each call, there was a ""sure no problem""... All of this should have been a precursor to our meal. 

My steak preferences are as follows:
I like when steak is seared with a crust and then finished in a really HOT oven. I like when steak is seasoned with a bit of salt and pepper prior to being cooked. Good steak should never be covered in a sauce. Finally, I like when they take out a really hot steak and finish it with a little bit of butter. Is that too much to ask? 

Well the steak that I ordered at CP did not have any of the above. In fact the
yelp:test:15137.para:
Unfortunatley, the steak at our meal was underwhelming!

We had planned a quick trip to Vegas and were eager to dine at The SW Steakhouse. However, we could only secure reservations at 5pm and 10pm. Given our preferences, we opted to look elsewhere. Cut Steakhouse had a 5:15pm slot, but Carnevino was fully booked. After checking my list, I called Charlie Palmer Steakhouse, expecting it to be booked, but to my surprise, there were several available spots. I initially requested a 8pm reservation, then changed it to 7pm, and each time, the response was a smooth "no problem." This should have been a sign of what was to come.

My ideal steak is seared with a crisp exterior and cooked in a very hot oven. I prefer a steak that's seasoned with just a bit of salt and pepper before cooking, and I don't like steaks that are drenched in sauce. Ideally, a steak should be finished with a touch of butter. Was this too much to ask for?

Unfortunately, the steak I ordered at Charlie Palmer did not meet any of these criteria.

yelp:test:15187.orig:
I like this mall a lot, but I get a headache EVERY EFFIN TIME I come!  I seriously think it has to do with the massive amount of cologne/perfume you can smell walking it.  Or maybe I just have a real heightened sense of smell....?

They have a ginormous Forever 21 (just like in Cerritos, CA) but I couldn't find anything this time around. Nothing in Wet Seal either :/  Usually I leave with something but I had bad luck this weekend. The layout/architecture of this mall is so random.  You have to come here to kind of see what I'm talking about.  They have a nice food court too.  Me having worked in a mall for most of my working career, I can appreciate a mall with a good food court.  

They have some higher end stores so be ready to ball out!
yelp:test:15187.para:
I really enjoy this mall, yet I suffer from a severe headache each time I visit. I suspect it might be due to the overwhelming scent of cologne or perfume. Alternatively, it could just be that my sense of smell is particularly acute.

The mall features a massive Forever 21, similar to the one in Cerritos, CA, but I didn't find anything this time. Neither did I find anything at Wet Seal. Typically, I leave with a purchase, but my luck was poor this weekend. The mall's layout is quite disorganized, and you really need to experience it to understand. There is a good food court, which I appreciate, having worked in malls for most of my career. Some of the stores are upscale, so be prepared to spend some money.

yelp:test:15219.orig:
Having never been to vegas to drink my friends took me here and boy oh boy was I in for a treat.

I'm not much of a drinker but taking the advice that the only way to really experience vegas is to constantly drink. After getting Lobster Me next door I came over here to get a yard stick

the cool thing i like about here is the samples and how they served it, how unique and their service phenomenal, being patient and informative 

anyways i opted for the 190 octane its kind of strong but man it was good, get it with an extra shot or maybe even two and it'll definitely be different

other then that i couldn't explain the taste but all i could remember was next time i come back i guess i'll get another one
yelp:test:15219.para:
My friends, who hadn't visited Vegas to drink before, brought me here, and I was thoroughly impressed.

Although I don't drink much, I followed their advice that the best way to experience Vegas is to keep drinking. After trying the Lobster Me next door, I came here to get a yard stick.

What I really appreciated was the sample offerings and the way they were served. The drinks were unique, and the service was outstanding—patient and informative.

I chose the 190 octane, which is quite strong, but it was fantastic. I would recommend getting an extra shot or even two to really enhance the experience.

The taste was hard to describe, but all I could think about was getting another one next time I visit.

yelp:test:15227.para: They offer Cirepil wax for sale!

yelp:test:15247.orig: I wish you would deliver to is since you keep sending your adds
yelp:test:15247.para: I hope you could send it to me instead of keeping sending your advertisements.

yelp:test:15262.orig:
My husband and I have been coming here now for quite sometime.   It reminded us of our honeymoon in morrea and bora bora.  We have used the facility a lot.  Family reunions and graduation parties.  
My husband has a lot of classes and advanced education he has to take. They are held here twice a year.   Thr property I'd very convenient.   The strip doesn't appeal to us much so we really like the location. 
We save money on food and enjoy cooking in the kitchen.   
We have taken advantage of other properties as ee travel alot.   Looking forward to the info of the new owners.
Great place for families and sharing with friends.  It has been a great investment for us.

yelp:test:15262.para:
We've been frequenting this place for a while now, and it brings back memories of our honeymoons in Morocco and Bora Bora. We've utilized the facilities for various events like family reunions and graduation parties. My husband attends many classes and advanced education sessions here twice a year. The property is very convenient for us. We appreciate the location, as the strip doesn't appeal to us much. We enjoy saving money on food by cooking in the kitchen. We've also stayed at other properties while traveling. We're looking forward to learning more about the new owners.

This is a great place for families and social gatherings. It has been a wonderful investment for us. If you're expecting a flashy, noisy, and crowded strip casino, this isn't the place for you. However, there are some nearby options that might suit that preference.

yelp:test:15297.orig:
I saw Dr. Lucious Blanchard on 3-31-14 at the Tenaya location. I arrived at 12:30pm. My appointment was for 1:15pm. I left this office at 2:45pm. I was given a prescription cream to rub all over my body where there were rashes. He said it was severe eczema with a possible infection from scratching. 

I asked for antibiotics, he said no. Ask your primary care doctor. I told him I'm asking you for it because my primary care doctor won't give it to me because it has to do with these rashes, and the primary doctor's excuse is since it has to do with these rashes, and it's a dermatology specialist's concern, let him give you the antibiotics.

So, I have an infection from scratching all my ""eczema"" rashes that look like measles or chicken pox, and neither my primary care doctor nor my dermatology specialist will give me a prescription for some antibiotics, just cream to rub all over my body. 

I filled the prescription for the cream, rubbed it on my rashes, and felt like a little worm tickling and crawling under my skin. I called my primary care doctor about it. He said call the specialist back. I called the specialist. They didn't return my call that week.

I called my ""te
yelp:test:15297.para:
On March 31, 2014, I visited Dr. Lucious Blanchard at the Tenaya location. I arrived at 12:30 PM, with my appointment scheduled for 1:15 PM. I left the office at 2:45 PM. Dr. Blanchard prescribed a cream to apply to all areas of my body where I had rashes, indicating severe eczema possibly complicated by an infection from scratching.

I requested antibiotics, but Dr. Blanchard declined, suggesting I consult my primary care doctor. I explained that my primary care doctor wouldn't prescribe antibiotics because they believed it was a dermatologist's responsibility. 

As a result, I have an infection from scratching my eczema rashes, which resemble measles or chicken pox, and both my primary care doctor and dermatologist won't provide antibiotics, only the cream.

I filled the cream prescription and found the application uncomfortable, like tiny worms crawling under my skin. I contacted my primary care doctor, who advised me to call Dr. Blanchard again. I did, but the dermatology office didn't return my call that week.

yelp:test:15307.orig: What a rip-off!!!\nBought a bottle of Kraken Rum, paid $10 too much. $28.99 for 750ml whereas one can buy it for $18.99 at the Wal-Mart on Eastern Avenue next to the airport.\nLesson learned!
yelp:test:15307.para: What a scam! I paid $10 extra for a bottle of Kraken Rum, which cost me $28.99. The same bottle can be bought for only $18.99 at Wal-Mart on Eastern Avenue, right next to the airport. This experience taught me a valuable lesson.

yelp:test:15316.orig: I called the Henderson store wanting to change my home store.  They said that since both stores are in Nevada, I can't do that.   I asked to cancel my membership.  The Henderson store told me I had to come in person to cancel my membership.  I told her I would not drive 20 miles each way to do that.  She gave me the membershiptermination@gmail.com email address to send written notice of my termination.  She than promptly hung up. yelp:test:15316.para: I contacted the Henderson store to switch my home store, but they explained that because both locations are in Nevada, I couldn't make that change. I had to call back to clarify if it was an immediate process or required a 30-day notice. I feel the need for a massage to relax after the disrespectful treatment I received.

yelp:test:15317.orig: I joined Massage Envy during my second pregnancy because I experienced severe pain in my lower back and hips (sometimes I couldn't walk). After trying a few different therapists, I got Tim. He is awesome! He gives the best massages, and has been the only therapist to alleviate the pain in my lower back and hips. If you want a massage, go to Tim!\nThe front desk staff is always friendly and polite, and the rooms are always clean and relaxing. If you have chronic problems with muscle tension, Massage Envy is well worth the commitment.
yelp:test:15317.para:
During my second pregnancy, I joined Massage Envy due to intense lower back and hip pain (at times, I couldn't walk). After trying several therapists, I found Tim, who is outstanding! His massages are exceptional, and he's the only one who has effectively reduced my pain. If you're seeking a massage, Tim is your best choice.

The front desk staff is consistently friendly and courteous, and the rooms are always clean and inviting. If you suffer from chronic muscle tension, Massage Envy is definitely worth the commitment.

yelp:test:15345.orig: Best Costco experience. Ever. Seriously, I don't know if it was a fluke, or the time change or what. A typical outing to Costco brings on short tempers, honking horns in the parking lot, and ridiculously crowded aisles as kids grab for every free sample they can. Not here. No horns, plenty of open parking spaces, no crowds for the samples, short lines and actual room at the food court. It was great.
yelp:test:15345.para: An exceptional Costco visit, without a doubt. I'm not sure if it was just a lucky day, the time change, or something else, but my usual Costco trip usually involves irritable moods, honking cars in the parking lot, and packed aisles with kids grabbing every free sample. This time, there were no honks, ample parking, no crowds for the samples, quick lines, and even space at the food court. It was fantastic.

yelp:test:15349.orig: Fast service & food. They have quick daytime drive through staff. Have been coming here for about a year and a half. Sometimes the WiFi works, which is always nice, if you're inside. The free drink refills are good, as some places inside of casinos, charge the entire price for a refill. It is conveniently located across the street from Mandalay Bay and is frequented by people who work on the strip, so you know it's easy to deal with.
yelp:test:15349.para: The service and food are swift, and there's a speedy drive-through option during the day. I've been visiting for around 18 months. The WiFi is occasionally available, which is handy if you're inside. They offer free refills on drinks, which is a plus compared to some casino venues that charge full price for refills. Its convenient location across from Mandalay Bay makes it accessible, and it's a popular spot for strip workers, indicating it's user-friendly.

yelp:test:15405.orig: Sampled some great chocolates with my boyfriend and he ended up purchasing the $40 box.  I wasn't feeling well so I didn't try very much, but what I did try was so good, especially one with sea salt.  Sea salt and chocolate are kind of a problem for me when they join forces.  Sooo delicious. \n\nBUT what stood out to me that day (in 100+ degree Vegas heat where we'd already had BEAUTIFUL pastries purchased from another store MELT just from walking outside for a bit!!) was they offer you ice packs to put around your chocolate purchase in case you will be heading outside. Brilliant! I wish the bakery I'd gone to had done the same!
yelp:test:15405.para:
My boyfriend and I sampled some excellent chocolates, and he bought a $40 box. Although I wasn't feeling well, what I did taste was fantastic, particularly one with sea salt. Sea salt and chocolate usually cause issues for me, but this was incredibly delicious. 

However, what really impressed me that day (in the 100+ degree heat of Vegas, where pastries from another bakery melted just from a short walk outside!) was that they provided ice packs to keep the chocolates cool if you were going to be outdoors. That was a brilliant touch! I wish the bakery I visited had offered something similar.

yelp:test:15442.orig: A+ for seating at the bar during a busy Las Vegas lunch time. The bartender there gave us the best service, always attentive to filling drinks if needed and also even giving us hot towels after first squeezing lemon juice into our hands after digging into the succulent Joe's Stone Crabs.\n\nI had high expectations for this place after having it first from a previous trip to Miami and this place did not disappoint. The service, decor, ambience were impeccable, and matched with the Vegas setting. I ordered the lunch combination that included 5 medium sized claws, as well as cole slaw, potato hash and also the key lime pie for dessert. The hubs got a dry aged rib-eye sandwich with fries shaped like thick potato chips that were delicious. We left really full and satisfied and would definitely come back again.
yelp:test:15442.para:
During a bustling Las Vegas lunchtime, we received excellent seating at the bar, and the bartender provided top-notch service, attentively refilling drinks and even offering hot towels after we squeezed lemon juice onto our hands before enjoying the delicious Joe's Stone Crabs. 

This place exceeded my expectations, much like my previous visit to Miami. The service, ambiance, and decor were outstanding, fitting the Vegas vibe perfectly. I enjoyed a lunch combo with five medium-sized crab claws, cole slaw, potato hash, and key lime pie for dessert. My partner had a dry-aged rib-eye sandwich with fries shaped like thick potato chips, which were delightful. We left feeling very satisfied and would definitely return.

yelp:test:15463.orig: Service was slow and snooty. Lots of seating. I tried their meat jun. Its okay but their tiger roll makes me go \""grrrrrr\"".  They took their time on this work of art, it took me a fraction of that time to devour. I ate so fast that I wasn't sure if I even really ate it. Well, the plate was the proof, I guess.
yelp:test:15463.para: The service was sluggish and rather haughty. There was ample seating available. I ordered the meat jun, which was decent, but the tiger roll was so delicious it made me want to roar. It took them a long time to prepare this masterpiece, whereas I devoured it in a fraction of the time. I ate so quickly that I wasn't sure if I had actually tasted the food. The empty plate served as my proof.

yelp:test:15472.orig: I'm really suprised to see that this place has gotten 4 stars.  I thought it was flat out gross.  My lamb was extra gamey, and I'm a season lamb eater.  Sides were nothing to ride home about.  I probably could have had a better meal at Chili's and paid half the price.\n\nI would give this place 1star for just food.  But the ambience was nice, so I'm gonna bump to 2.
yelp:test:15472.para:
I was quite surprised to find this restaurant with a 4-star rating; I found it to be thoroughly unappealing. The lamb was particularly gamey, even though I enjoy season lamb. The side dishes were lackluster. I might have gotten a better meal at Chili's for half the cost.

The food alone would warrant a 1-star rating, but the ambiance was pleasant, so I'll adjust it to 2 stars.

yelp:test:15493.orig: Honestly, the WORST SERVICE I have ever had at a restaurant in Las Vegas. I have lived here for 12 years and this was the first time I made it out to Lake Las Vegas. I am so disappointed. The prices are unreasonable for the amount of food you get and for a tapas place they are slow. It took us two hours before we got our food and some items were missing. Granted the food is amazing, it was just absolutely ridiculous with the service.
yelp:test:15493.para: Truly, this was the poorest service I've experienced at any restaurant in Las Vegas. Having lived here for 12 years, this was my first visit to Lake Las Vegas, and I'm deeply let down. The prices are unjustifiably high for the quantity of food served, and as a tapas place, the service is unbearably slow. We waited two hours for our food, and some items were missing. While the food is outstanding, the service was just absurdly poor.

yelp:test:15498.orig: Great food fast service..that's Chicago style at tasty dogs that what I got great place to eat...and if you where anything Chicago you get a discount\nvery nice faces when you walk in. Many people miss that Chicago feel and great taste. Pictures on the wall represent the city and the culture well. If you ever in Vegas you have to stop by and grab a dog and dress it the way you want.
yelp:test:15498.para: Fast service and delicious food define the Chicago style at Tasty Dogs—exactly what I experienced. It's a fantastic dining spot, and locals get a discount. The moment you enter, you're greeted with friendly faces. Many miss the authentic Chicago vibe and taste here. The walls are adorned with pictures that beautifully capture the city and its culture. If you're ever in Vegas, make sure to visit and customize your hot dog as you like.

yelp:test:15526.para: Pizza is terrible, and it's also very pricey!

yelp:test:15531.orig:
I read a reveiw below that someone blamed Home Plate for getting sick.  Sorry lady but the onset for almost ALL foodborne illnesesses is at LEAST 24 hours, so it wasnt your breakfast. Before you bash someone publicly, educate yourself on the possibilites of why you may be sick.  

 I eat here often.  No place is perfect, but all in all Home Plate is Family freindly and good food and affordable food.  GREAT place for sports
I have eaten there 20 plus times and always consistent.  I had 1 issue with slow service and some chicken wings but managemnet was rt on top of it.  I am going there tonight with Friends and kids.  FYI...garlic knots need more flavor....a little more salt in the dough maybeL:)
yelp:test:15531.para:
I recently came across a review where someone accused Home Plate of causing their illness from the meal. I must say, lady, the typical incubation period for foodborne illnesses is at least 24 hours, so it wasn't likely your breakfast there. Before you publicly criticize someone, make sure you understand the possible causes of your illness.

I frequent Home Plate regularly. No establishment is perfect, but overall, it's a family-friendly place with good, affordable food and it's great for sports. I've eaten there more than 20 times and the food is consistently good. There was one instance of slow service and some chicken wings, but the management handled it promptly. I'm heading there tonight with friends and kids. Just a tip: the garlic knots could use a bit more flavor—maybe a little extra salt in the dough.

yelp:test:15542.orig: We used to get sandwiches from here all the time and they were great. Now they have raised their prices and hardly have any meat in them. yelp:test:15542.para: We used to frequently order sandwiches from here, and they were excellent. However, they've increased their prices and the meat content is minimal; it's mostly just bread and filler with very little turkey! Additionally, my son almost choked on a bone in one of the sandwiches! I won't be returning to SUMMERLIN CAPRIOTTI'S!

yelp:test:15548.orig: Peter in the pharmacy is amazing! I wish he could be my doctor. He's very knowledgable with prescriptions as well as over the counter medicines. I trust his opinion and I don't ever seem myself changing pharmacies. The wait here is never long and I never have any trouble getting generics or using coupons. I would give more stars if possible.
yelp:test:15548.para: Peter at the pharmacy is outstanding! I wish he could treat me as a doctor. He has a wealth of knowledge about both prescriptions and over-the-counter medications. I have complete confidence in his advice, and I see no reason to switch pharmacies anytime soon. The wait is always short, and I never face any issues getting generics or using coupons. If I could, I'd rate him even higher.

yelp:test:15561.orig: This is one of my FAVORITES...Great service and food everytime!!
yelp:test:15561.para: This is one of my top choices...I always enjoy the excellent service and delicious food!

yelp:test:15581.orig: There's nothing better than having a flat tire, standing in line for service, and having the staff completely ignore you. What made my last visit even better, was four people being helped before me. Despite their arriving after me. Apparently, I am not the type of customer they want money from. Too bad, as I have used them many times over the years. Not anymore.
yelp:test:15581.para: Experiencing a flat tire, waiting in line, and having staff ignore you is the worst. My recent visit was even more disappointing because four others were attended to before me, even though they arrived later. Clearly, I don't fit their customer profile. It's a shame, as I've been a regular customer for years. I won't be returning.

yelp:test:15598.orig:
This is the most self-inflicted adrenaline I've felt since bungee jumping.

First, let me say that guns scare the crap out of me. I don't even like being near a police officer with a holstered weapon... so walking into a shop full of assault rifles is like my adult version of a horror movie.  Still, I was with 5 other guys who were up for the adventure, so I got hold of my nerves and jumped into the breach.

We paid $110 each for some version of a party package that gave each of us the chance to shoot (a) a clip full on each of 4 different machine guns and (b) 2 rounds from a 50 caliber desert eagle handgun. For all those boys (and girls) out there who grew up with plastic guns or even shooting a rifle out somewhere at a range, it's fair to say that this is in a whole different league.

For the machine guns, we chose the Uzi, Mac-10, M-5 and Grease Gun. The M-5 and Grease Gun were scarily easy and accurate to shoot, whereas the Uzi and Mac-10 felt a bit more wild but were fun just because they show up so often in the gangster movies.

The Desert Eagle handgun was intense. I'm not a big guy, so this thing felt like I could barely hang onto it. Still, we were able to shoot it
yelp:test:15598.para:
This experience delivered a rush of adrenaline comparable to bungee jumping.

To start, guns terrify me; even a police officer with a holstered weapon makes me uneasy. So, stepping into a shop filled with assault rifles felt like my grown-up version of a horror movie. However, with five others eager for the adventure, I managed to steady my nerves and dive in.

We each paid $110 for a party package that allowed us to fire a clip from four different machine guns and two rounds from a 50-caliber Desert Eagle handgun. For those who grew up with toy guns or have shot at a range, this experience is on a whole different level.

For the machine guns, we selected the Uzi, Mac-10, M-5, and Grease Gun. The M-5 and Grease Gun were surprisingly easy and accurate, while the Uzi and Mac-10 felt wild and exciting, reminiscent of gangster movies.

The Desert Eagle handgun was intense. Being a smaller person, I found it challenging to hold, but we managed to shoot it.

yelp:test:15604.orig:
Panera Bread, although a tad overpriced in my opinion, is a decent place to a grab a quick bite to eat. I am not going to say they are a healthy option compared to other ""fast"" type eateries because I don't think everything on their menu is really promoting great health. However, it is a step up from a burger and fries combo at McDonald's. 

This Panera is a staple of The District, sits directly facing the parking lot and is conveniently located. The establishment is large and spacious, which is good, because anytime I have been here the place has been steady with patrons. Customer service is good, although I always get hit up to get their card, which I decline, because I don't go to Panera enough to warrant getting the card. Plus, all in all I am kind of fed up with this every freakin' place I go wants to give me some card deal. Hrumph. Anyway.

Food - I ordered the Chipotle Panini and my husband ordered the Smokehouse Trukey Panini. Both came out deliciously melty and warm, pressed perfectly. I received mine with chips, my husband got a cut up apple, so we shared. Overall loved the paninis. We also ordered a yummy blueberry muffin which was dense and flavorful. 

Qualit
yelp:test:15604.para:
Panera Bread, while a bit pricey in my view, is a reasonable choice for a quick meal. I wouldn't call it a healthy option compared to other fast-food places, as not all their items promote great health. But it's still better than a burger and fries at McDonald's.

This Panera is a mainstay in The District, situated right by the parking lot, and is conveniently placed. The place is large and open, which is beneficial since it's always busy. The customer service is decent, though I always decline their card offer because I don't frequent Panera enough to justify it. Plus, I'm getting tired of all these card deals everywhere I go. Anyway.

The food was great. I had the Chipotle Panini, and my husband got the Smokehouse Trukey Panini. Both were perfectly warm and melty. I had it with chips, and he had a sliced apple, which we shared. Overall, we really enjoyed the paninis. We also got a delicious blueberry muffin that was dense and flavorful.

yelp:test:15625.orig: This is place is a must try if you are in Las Vegas. We always get the vanilla chocolate chip concrete when we stop by. I have nothing negative to say about this place. I LOVE LOVE LOVE IT! =_
yelp:test:15625.para: This spot is an absolute must-visit if you're in Las Vegas. Every time we stop by, we order the vanilla chocolate chip concrete. I have no complaints at all about this place. I absolutely adore it! =_)

yelp:test:15628.orig: Great bartenders and great food.  Hit a couple of jackpots here on keno.  Great gaming promotions and new tvs.
yelp:test:15628.para: Excellent bartenders and delicious food. I hit a few keno jackpots and appreciate the great gaming promotions along with the new TVs.

yelp:test:15641.orig:
Good food, as far as I can tell since in 45 minutes we have only gotten our appetizer.

So far, the only reason to come is to get $35 in free drinks.

Stay away!
yelp:test:15641.para: Based on what we've experienced in the 45 minutes we've been here, the food quality is lacking. The sole attraction seems to be the offer of $35 in free drinks. I would advise you to avoid this place.

yelp:test:15662.orig: I started out super excited about this limo company. They were reasonably priced and they had a really cool Dodge Challenger limo! They really were great as my wedding day started out because we were running late (of course) and the limo driver was super patient and waited for us! We had booked two separate times because it was cheaper than way, so we had a different driver on the way to the ceremony and on the way to the reception. It was the second driver that I had a problem with. We got into the limo and noticed that he was taking a very odd route. He was going in directions completely opposite of where we needed to be going. He then took surface streets for about 15 minutes and then decided to get on the freeway. He got off on the wrong exit and took us up some more surface streets. We finally arrived, annoyed, but glad to be there and the driver approached me stating that we exceeded our time by 20 minutes, therefore we would have to pay them for an hour. yelp:test:15664.para:
This establishment could have become a regular spot for us, but they really messed it up. My toddler, who is still not potty trained, needs frequent changes, and there's no bathroom at the nearby therapy office where I take her. I thought I'd try the restaurant to use their facilities. However, when I asked, I was immediately confronted, which was very rude. They insisted I had to purchase something to use their restroom, so I bought an expensive lunch. The wait for my order was long, and it seemed to have been sitting out for a while. I took it home and ate the lasagna and salad. The salad was quite good, but the lasagna was just average. My husband suggested it might be due to the area being in a less desirable part of town.

This week, I need to use the bathroom again and plan to buy something as required. However, there's a bad smell in the area.

yelp:test:15670.orig: Went there to get a simple trim and the rude and full of herself \""master stylist\"" Amy cut my hair. I had the bad fortune of getting the worst haircut of my life. yelp:test:15670.para: I went in for a basic haircut and was served by Amy, described as a "master stylist" but who came across as rude and arrogant. Avoid this place at all costs; the customer service was abysmal, and the stylists act like they work in an upscale salon, but their skills are clearly subpar.

yelp:test:15686.orig: The staff at this location just take the cake. They are pure rude just unkind so not humble or friendly people. How can they help people with such nasty attitudes its beyond me. How they have a job at all is beyond me. I will never return here.
yelp:test:15686.para: The employees at this place are trulypicable. They exhibit pure rudeness and a lack of kindness, showing no humility or friendliness. yelp:test:15704.orig: closed down - hope they open close by - granted the guy behind the counter was awful but the food was tasty-not as good as precious owners (even tho same guy cooking) but it was still tasty.
yelp:test:15704.para: The place shut down, but I wish they'd open a nearby location. The counter guy wasn't great, but the food was delicious—though not quite as good as when the previous owners ran it (even though the same person was cooking). Still, it was tasty.

yelp:test:15713.orig: Horrible just horrible. Aren't they suppose to clean your teeth? I hate going to businesses with lazy workers. The Doctor is lazy. Go elsewhere for better work.
yelp:test:15713.para: Terrible, truly terrible. Don't they supposed to clean your teeth? I really dislike going to places where the staff are lazy. The dentist seems lazy to me. You should consider other places for better service.

yelp:test:15724.orig: They have really fast service and the food is always warm always friendly  I like the fact the manger personally takes the food to you and treats you awesome .  He also gave me a whole bunch of coupons
yelp:test:15724.para: The service is incredibly swift, and the food is consistently served hot. What I appreciate most is that the manager personally brings your food and is exceptionally kind. Additionally, he provided me with a generous set of coupons.

yelp:test:15757.orig:
Carne Asada fries!! That's it. Get those and you will love yourself. They are enough to share with someone.

The tacos are good too, but I'm just saying. I liked the tacos al pastor and the asada ones. The chicken tacos were my least favorites. But they were still good. 

I came here with a party of 8 HUNGRY people--and they did a great job getting our stuff together. There was a little confusion, as we were missing some tacos, but the employees there were really friendly and were helpful.
yelp:test:15757.para:
Carne Asada fries are fantastic! You should definitely try them; they're perfect for sharing. The tacos are also quite good, with the al pastor and asada varieties being my favorites. The chicken tacos were my least favorite, but they were still tasty.

We had a party of eight very hungry people, and the staff did an excellent job serving us. There was a minor mix-up with a few missing tacos, but the employees were very friendly and helpful in resolving the issue.

yelp:test:15767.orig:
Ok, so you read the other reviews and maybe you think I am just being a lemming.  No, I think this very non-descript place has it going in the taste and authenticity departments.  Today at lunch was my 2nd visit as I was torn between my satisfaction at Ping Pong Thai down further on Sunset and this place.   
So today I had their chicken satay app, papaya salad Lao/Thai style and then the awesome green tea steamed buns!  Yes, they had them today!   
The satay app is rather hearty.  5 skewers of marinated grilled chicken served with the traditional peanut sauce and a small refreshing cucumber salad.
It was very good and I used the peanut sauce sparingly;  just enough for added flavor. 

Their payaya salad blew away Ping Pong's version.   They grate the payaya just slightly larger so it has great texture and crunch.   Instead of tomato slivers they use halved baby roma tomatoes which explode with tomato-y flavor.  They cut the long beans just large enough so you know they are beans.  The dressing is very light, non-oily and you can order your heat accordingly.   Loved it!

I ended with the steamed green buns.  They are little pillows of deliciousness!   HINT: Order the steamed
yelp:test:15767.para:
Sure, so after reading the other reviews, you might wonder if I'm just following the crowd. But I believe this unassuming spot excels in taste and authenticity. Today, it was my second visit, as I was balancing my enjoyment of Ping Pong Thai further down Sunset with this place.

Today, I tried their chicken satay appetizer, the papaya salad in Lao/Thai style, and the fantastic green tea steamed buns! Yes, they had them today!

The chicken satay is substantial. Five skewers of marinated grilled chicken come with traditional peanut sauce and a small, refreshing cucumber salad.

It was quite good, and I used the peanut sauce sparingly, just enough to enhance the flavor.

Their papaya salad surpassed Ping Pong's version. They grate the papaya in larger pieces for a great texture and crunch. Instead of tomato slices, they use halved baby Roma tomatoes that burst with tomato flavor. The long beans are cut to a perfect size, and the dressing is light and non-oily, with adjustable heat. I adored it!

I finished with the steamed green buns, which are little pockets of deliciousness! TIP: Order the steamed...

yelp:test:15768.orig:
Sticky, sticky, oh so sticky crispy garlic chicken!

I don't know exactly what goes on in this dish at Penn's but I like it. There is something in that sauce that makes you want to lick the entire foil plate clean. (Not even kidding) That sauce goes great with everythingggg and the chicken is so crispy and tender that it just makes for a delight in your mouth :O

Other than the chicken, the other Thai dishes are really tasty and good quality. I've have the pad thai and fried rice from here and I can definitely taste the difference here compared to other Thai establishments in Henderson. 

But that chicken though!

I have to admit that the first time I came to Penn's was not what I expected. It is located in... a less desirable? side of town and you wouldn't even think there would be a Thai restaurant in this plaza but behold!

Parking has never been a problem here so that's another plus. Have I mentioned the chicken yet?
yelp:test:15768.para:
Oh so sticky, crispy garlic chicken—deliciously so!

I’m not sure what magic Penn’s uses in their sauce, but it’s irresistible. You really do want to clean the entire foil plate, and that sauce pairs wonderfully with everything. The chicken is both crispy and tender, making each bite a delight.

The other Thai dishes here are also quite tasty and of good quality. I’ve tried the pad thai and fried rice, and they stand out compared to other Thai restaurants in Henderson.

But the chicken is truly exceptional!

My first visit to Penn’s wasn’t what I expected. It’s situated in a less desirable part of town, and you wouldn’t guess there’s a Thai restaurant here, but there is! 

Parking is never an issue, and let’s not forget about that amazing chicken!

yelp:test:15805.orig: Not too impressed , very crowded ,Loud , poor seating , Gyro had little to no flavor, Expensive , Poor parking. Sorry Guy's ,I wont be back.
yelp:test:15805.para: Not particularly satisfied, it was quite crowded and noisy. The seating was uncomfortable, and the gyro lacked flavor. It was also quite pricey, and parking was a hassle. I'm sorry, but I won't be returning.

yelp:test:15809.orig:
For anyone who says, doing half and half pizza sauces, as in half margherita and half banana peppers and sausage, is ""weak"", lemme tell you...they're making the pizza in the kitchen. They are under pressure, orders flying in from all different angles, take out here, order in there, medium with extra sundrieds, sub black olives for broccoli add pine nuts, extra sauce...it's no joke. So, that being said, they can't always split a pizza in half because the sauces just don't mix and they gotta cook it and prep and all that jazz.

So, is the pizza good? Yes, hands down, this pizza is really friggin' good. The BBQ chicken is wet my pants good. The Algo Malgo or whatever it is called is truly delicious. 

If you're looking for a quick lunch spot, get your ass in there and enjoy the pizza/salad lunch deal, for it will not disappoint. Order the cheese slice if you like, but since they have the dozens of toppings to choose from, live a little and put some meatballs or eggs or fresh artichokes and make it the way you dream it. 

OVERALL: One of the top pizza place in Madison or Middleton.
yelp:test:15809.para:
For those who think making a pizza with half margherita and half banana peppers and sausage is "weak," let me explain... they're the ones in the kitchen, handling the pressure of multiple orders coming in from all directions—takeout, dine-in, special requests like extra sundried tomatoes, black olives instead of broccoli, extra sauce... it's no laughing matter. So, they can't always split a pizza in half because the sauces don't mix well and they need to cook and prep everything.

That said, the pizza is definitely top-notch. The BBQ chicken is so good it might make you wet your pants. The Algo Malgo, or whatever it's called, is truly delicious. 

If you're in need of a quick lunch, head over and enjoy the pizza/salad combo, as it won't disappoint. Consider ordering a cheese slice, but since they offer dozens of toppings, go ahead and add some meatballs, eggs, or fresh artichokes to make it your dream pizza.

OVERALL: One of the best pizza places in Madison or Middleton.

yelp:test:15822.orig: Was looking for a restaurant near Boca Park where we could eat outside, and found this on google maps.  Saw the 4-star yelp review, and decided to check it out.\n\nWe arrive, and our waiter, Diego, was definitely an Italian immigrant -- immediate street-cred.   We proceeded to completely over-order and pretty much everything was excellent. We all enjoyed the bruschetta mix, cheese plate and prosciutto (all pronounced very precisely by Diego).  For mains, we got the monkfish picatta, the pappardelle, the chicken thighs, the roman gnocchi, and a pizza.  We polished it all off.  We topped it off with the chocolate dessert platter, which probably put me over the edge fullness-wise but just to the brim with deliciousness.
yelp:test:15822.para:
I was searching for an outdoor restaurant near Boca Park and found one on Google Maps. A 4-star Yelp review piqued my interest, so we decided to give it a try.

Upon arrival, we were greeted by our waiter, Diego, who had a distinct Italian accent, adding to his charm. We ended up ordering more than we needed, and everything was fantastic. We particularly enjoyed the bruschetta mix, the cheese plate, and the prosciutto, which Diego pronounced with perfect Italian precision. For our main courses, we ordered the monkfish picatta, pappardelle, chicken thighs, Roman gnocchi, and a pizza. We finished everything. To conclude our meal, we had the chocolate dessert platter, which, while very satisfying, was just the right amount of indulgence.

yelp:test:15832.orig: Love the lunch buffets. The Goat biryani is very good. Would definitely recommend this to a friend!
yelp:test:15832.para: I really enjoy the lunch buffets. The Goat biryani is outstanding, and I would definitely suggest it to a friend.

yelp:test:15852.orig: Great tasting nigiri and loved both the (spicy) San Diego and Rainbow rolls. Stopped by for lunch on a Sunday and was pleasantly surprised as the place looked deserted. Nice service and high quality fish. Will return next time in town! Thank you for the wonderful experience
yelp:test:15852.para: I enjoyed the delicious nigiri and particularly liked both the spicy San Diego and Rainbow rolls. On a Sunday lunch visit, I was surprised to find the restaurant nearly empty. The service was excellent, and the fish was of high quality. I look forward to returning on my next visit. A big thank you for providing such a great experience.

yelp:test:15853.orig: This place is great for going after work, and it's down the street from my place, so it's great for happy hour specials where appetizers are $5 and you can get $2 drafts. There are tons of tv's so you can watch all sorts of games, but beware, the owner is a huge cowboys fan so those games will always take precedence over other teams. We held our fantasy football draft here as well, and they put us in the boardroom (like on the apprentice) and we kind of got our own private, quieter area for hanging out which is great. yelp:test:15853.para: This spot is perfect for after-work drinks, and it's conveniently located just down the street from my home, making it ideal for happy hour. Appetizers are just $5, and you can enjoy $2 drafts. There are numerous TVs, so you can catch all the games you want. Just be aware that the owner is a big Cowboys fan, so those games will always be prioritized. The food has been excellent, and the happy hour cocktails are strong and well-priced. I particularly love the nachos, sweet chili Thai wings, and fried zucchini. We even held our fantasy football draft here, and they set us up in a private boardroom-like area, giving us a more secluded space to relax and chat. Karaoke nights are a hoot; some folks really let loose!

yelp:test:15911.orig:

We found our way to the elevators and found Brittney Spears plastered everywhere! The decor felt dated and there was not the clean feeling one would expect.
