I had my second gel manicure and polish with Shannon on 10/12, and I wish I had opted for the full spa pedicure again; I should have done it. The entire bridal party, including the bride who was serviced by Eve, and the other technicians, all received outstanding service. Everyone was extremely satisfied.

While I agree with another reviewer that their prices are a bit higher than my usual salon/spa budget, I appreciate that they frequently offer group discounts. I've been a repeat customer, both with and without group deals, and I highly recommend giving them a try when a groupon is available.

yelp:test:18634.orig: went first sunday of the month thanks bofa, museum is cute! Only if you're with a kid or if you are at a yelp adult only event!
yelp:test:18634.para: Visits are scheduled for the first Sunday of the month, thanks, Bofa! The museum is quite charming, but it's more enjoyable if you're there with a child or attending a Yelp event for adults only.

yelp:test:18644.orig: I usually find going to Town Square to be a pain in the butt.  However, sometimes this is the best meeting location for people coming from all over town.  Had a very good dinner here for a large group.  Our server was very friendly and efficient.  Everyone enjoyed their dinner without being overly wowed.  Love being able to cross the street after dinner to shop at Sephora.
yelp:test:18644.para: While I generally find Town Square to be quite inconvenient, it can be an ideal spot for meetings when folks are scattered across the town. We had a pleasant dining experience for a large group there. The server was both courteous and prompt. Everyone appreciated their meals without any overly dramatic impressions. I also enjoy the convenience of crossing the street afterward to do some shopping at Sephora.

yelp:test:18649.orig:

The only thing I don't like about this place is their lack of fitting rooms. I think they have only 2 or 3 ever open, even though there are tons scattered throughout the store . This makes for longer lines, antsy people, and more of a hassle to get clothes back to racks. There are so many employees around, why not just open more fitting rooms to make it easier for them ( and us! ) ? 

But anyway, I really love this forever 21. I alw
yelp:test:18649.para:
There's no comparison. When I first visited, I spent two full days, from opening to closing, trying to navigate the store. I'm not exaggerating. Now, it's much quicker—just a day, 4-5 hours if I'm in a hurry.

They have an incredible array of clothes—it's like a Forever 21 paradise. The place is clean, spacious, and offers a vast selection. The good news: there are two floors, making it department store-sized.

They have almost everything you'd find online, not just a limited selection. There are maternity and kids' sections too. The accessory area is a bit lacking, but that's okay.

The staff is generally friendly and check in to see if you're okay. However, the cashiers are the most stressed and impatient people I've ever encountered.

The only thing I dislike is the lack of fitting rooms. They only have 2 or 3 open, despite having many scattered throughout the store. This leads to long lines and people getting antsy. With so many employees around, it would be better to open more fitting rooms to make things easier for everyone.

But overall, I really love this Forever 21.

yelp:test:18656.orig: Mediocre food and dirty ass tables. Suffice it to say, there's room for improvement.
yelp:test:18656.para: The food is average at best, and the tables are quite dirty. In short, there's definitely room for enhancement.

yelp:test:18669.orig: Food was great! Mahi mahi is great and wife loves spicy prawn basil.
yelp:test:18669.para: The food was fantastic! My wife particularly enjoys the spicy prawn basil, and the mahi mahi was also excellent.

yelp:test:18681.orig:
If I could travel back in time 30 minutes, I would just so I could punch myself in the face for opting to try this place.

For starters, this is NOT a coffee shop.  While they are trying to angel themselves as such, they fail in that attempt.  Their failure really isn't any surprise, as the coffee menu was very limited and the girl behind the counter clearly wasn't a barista.  

I ordered a latte, for lack of my normal (seemingly generic) mocha being on the menu.  After 10 minutes, I finally got it only to have it taste like what I assume old engine oil tastes like.

They also fail at being a bakery.  I don't want to be too harsh, but if I wanted a Fry's croissant, I'd go to Fry's.  They have a very limited bakery selection with their display having little more than a few cookies.

I will give them credit that their prices are cheap.  I also give the girl behind the counter credit.  She was having to wear 4 hats at once.  She worked hard and was very nice.  And they do have a lot of space.  But I really can't see myself going back, which is sad because there aren't a lot of independent coffee shops in this part of Chandler.
yelp:test:18681.para:
If I could rewind time by 30 minutes, I'd do just that to avoid choosing this place. It's clear this isn't a true coffee shop, despite their efforts to portray it as such. Their attempt fails due to a limited coffee menu and the barista's lack of expertise.

I settled for a latte when my usual mocha wasn't available, and after waiting 10 minutes, it arrived tasting like old engine oil.

They also fall short as a bakery. If I wanted a Fry's croissant, I'd stick to Fry's. Their selection is minimal, with only a few cookies on display.

While their prices are reasonable, and the staff, particularly the counter girl, worked hard and was friendly, the limited offerings and poor quality make me hesitant to return. It's a shame, as this area in Chandler lacks independent coffee shops.

yelp:test:18760.orig: Great hotel.  Appreciate the \""boutique\"" feel.  Small casino without poker room. \nReally nice rooms.  Nice amenities.\nWould come back over Venetian.  Less kids ( I have 2--but took a break).
yelp:test:18760.para: This is a fantastic hotel with a unique, boutique atmosphere. It features a small casino that lacks a poker room. The rooms are very comfortable, and there are pleasant amenities available. I would choose to return here over the Venetian, partly because there are fewer children around—I have two, but I decided to take a break from it.

yelp:test:18799.orig: I don't know if it is because my family and I went early or what but service shouldn't take 20 minutes to get a roll. Not only were we not greeted right away it took forever to get our sushi. The sushi rolls were okay but not worth the wait or the money especially since they were slow. Plus it sounded more like we were in a Mexican restaurant than a Japanese restaurant. I am all for speaking a different language but not so loud you make your customers uncomfortable. All in all we will not be coming back.
yelp:test:18799.para: Our service experience was unsatisfactory, as it took an unusually long 20 minutes just to get a roll. We weren't greeted promptly, and the sushi preparation was excessively slow. While the sushi rolls were acceptable, they certainly didn't justify the wait or the cost, especially given the slow service. Additionally, the atmosphere felt more like a Mexican restaurant than a Japanese one, with loud, uncomfortable language use. Overall, we won't be returning.

yelp:test:18808.orig:
I was trying so damn hard to school these fools around here about PinkBerry/RedMango goodness and then bam- I happen to stumble in on Ice Tango. 
It was like a force of nature that great day. I was searching for a place to hang before an appt and considered nearby Starbucks. But then, I see this place and ran inside screaming ""Are you like Pinkberry!?!"" The girls then gave me yummy samples and I was in heaven again. 
My pic- the regular tangytart with carob chips and strawberries. 
The next day I hit the north location after a day at the pool. My friend in tow, I turned her on to my discovery and FINALLY another Phx friend knew the pleasure I had been describing.
I am thinking about pomegranate with pineapple right about now.
Thank you Ice Tango!
yelp:test:18808.para:
I was really eager to educate everyone here about the amazing PinkBerry/RedMango experience, but then, out of nowhere, I discovered Ice Tango. It was a thrilling day. I was looking for a spot to relax before an appointment and was thinking about stopping at a nearby Starbucks. However, when I spotted Ice Tango, I rushed in excitedly asking, "Are you like Pinkberry!?" The staff then offered me some delicious samples, and I was overjoyed. 

My photo shows the regular tangytart with carob chips and strawberries. 

The following day, after a swim at the pool, I visited the north Ice Tango location with a friend. I introduced her to this delightful discovery, and finally, another Phoenix friend understood the joy I had been talking about.

I'm craving pomegranate with pineapple right now.

Thank you, Ice Tango!

yelp:test:18811.orig: My favorite place in this city! So many options and so delicious! You can go with a huge group and everyone can be happy. I have tried almost all of the desserts :) and they are all fantastic! AND under 200 calories!!!! The staff is always nice and helpful... can't go wrong with this place!
yelp:test:18811.para: This city has a fantastic spot that I adore! There are so many choices and everything is so yummy! You can bring a large group and everyone will find something they love. I've sampled nearly all the desserts, and they're all outstanding! Plus, they're under 200 calories! The staff is always friendly and helpful... you really can't go wrong here!

yelp:test:18877.orig: the fact that they reopened after an abrupt closure had me excited to go back. i was ready to enjoy one of my favorite cupcake places once again. unfortunately, the combination of dry, possibly day-old cupcakes and an overtly rude staff/management team will ensure that i will never return again. ever.
yelp:test:18877.para: Reopening after such a sudden closure made me eager to revisit my favorite cupcake spot. However, the dry, potentially stale cupcakes paired with the staff's and management's overly rude behavior have convinced me I'll never go back—ever.

yelp:test:18882.orig:
Fans of the dramatic misfortunate adventures of RyanC read on...

WikiWiki, whose name creates instant old school rap flashbacks*, catered the recent Tiki Party PBR Concert featuring Fishbone and other cool local acts.
The grilled meat smelled good (although when does grilled meat not) so I stepped up to their little table setup and surveyed a grill full of what looked like flattened chicken thighs and their menu sign which offered a limited selection from their regular menu: 

$5 Chicken 
$7 Beef Short Ribs
or $7 Meat Combo

-all with white rice and macaroni salad.

I ordered the combo.  A few moments later I opened up the styrofoam clamshell the Young Male (YM) staffer handed me.  I'd gotten all rice,and there were in fact two small icecream scooper mounds of glutenous grain, but slapped on top of it was one small piece of chicken, perhaps one very small or half a large deboned thigh, and one small strip of short rib, which had less meat than a steroid-addict musclebound lunkhead's got in his roomy banana hammock.

I extended my hand holding the food back towards him and said ""that's all I get?""
Making no gesture towards grabbing the tray at all, he replies matt
yelp:test:18882.para:
Fans of RyanC's dramatic misfortunes, keep reading...

WikiWiki, with a name that evokes old-school rap vibes, ran the Tiki Party PBR Concert, which included Fishbone and other local acts.

The grilled meat smelled great (as it usually does), so I approached their setup. The grill was filled with what appeared to be flattened chicken thighs, and their menu offered a limited selection: 

$5 Chicken  
$7 Beef Short Ribs  
or $7 Meat Combo

Both came with white rice and macaroni salad.

I opted for the combo. A moment later, the Young Male staffer handed me a styrofoam container. Inside, I found mostly rice, with two small mounds of grain, but atop it was a tiny piece of chicken and a small strip of short rib—so little that it seemed like a mere fraction of a thigh and a musclebound lunkhead's banana hammock.

I held the food out and asked, "Is that all I get?" 

Without offering to take the tray, he replied, matt

yelp:test:18912.orig: I've ridden my bike here with friends and lunched on the non-smoking patio a few times. I always order the Reuben and have never been disappointed. The service is good and the waitresses are friendly.\n\nI just learned that both patios are dog friendly, as long as the dogs are leashed.  I'll add Duke's to my list of Dog Friendly establishments. Peekaboo is going to be happy to hear that.
yelp:test:18912.para:
I've visited this place with friends on multiple occasions, biking here and dining on the non-smoking patio. Each time, I've ordered the Reuben and been satisfied. The service is pleasant, and the waitstaff is friendly.

I recently found out that both patios now allow leashed dogs. This makes Duke's a new addition to my list of dog-friendly spots. Peekaboo is going to be thrilled to hear this news.

yelp:test:18922.orig: While visiting friends in Scottsdale (from Seattle, where we are spoiled with good Thai food) we got a craving and our friends suggested Thai House. Everything was so good! I had the lunch special with panang curry. Could have been a little spicier (though I did only order 2 star) but otherwise it was perfect. Will be sure to come back here on my next trip to Phoenix!!!
yelp:test:18922.para: During our visit to Scottsdale (from Seattle, known for its excellent Thai cuisine), we felt a craving and our friends recommended Thai House. Everything we tried was fantastic! I ordered the lunch special with panang curry. It was great, though I wished it could have been a bit spicier (I only asked for 2 stars). Overall, it was perfect. I definitely plan to return on my next trip to Phoenix!

yelp:test:18937.orig: This is truly the best Mexican food I've ever had--high quality dishes with fresh ingredients.  They served large portions at a ridiculously reasonable cost, and I've never had such good service from the staff there.  They went out of their way to serve me with style.  Even though I have family in. Charlotte, I might have to come back here just to come to Las Margaritas!
yelp:test:18937.para: I've never tasted better Mexican cuisine; the dishes are of exceptional quality with fresh ingredients. The portions are generous, and the prices are surprisingly affordable. The service from the staff is outstanding, going above and beyond to ensure a stylish dining experience. Given how great everything was, I might consider visiting Las Margaritas again, even for a trip from Charlotte.

yelp:test:18948.orig: A little cold in here. They used to have $9.99 lunch buffet all you can eat was a good deal and good food.  I love the stir fried squid dish and Kalbi dish and of course all the kimchi.  Staff is better than last time I was here.
yelp:test:18948.para: The place feels a bit chilly. Previously, the $9.99 lunch buffet was a great value with tasty food. I particularly enjoy the stir-fried squid and Kalbi dishes, as well as all the kimchi. The service has improved since my last visit.

yelp:test:18951.orig: it was very convenient for lunchtime. Customer service was okay they weren't very excellent to explain some sauce to us first timers. Parking was available.
yelp:test:18951.para: Lunchtime was quite convenient. The customer service was alright but could have been better at explaining the sauces to us newcomers. There was parking available.

yelp:test:18957.orig: I really don't like giving bad reviews and I've had my fair share of delicious and really bad tasting pho. Today I came here with my family and ordered a pho chin (brisket) and my mom got the seafood pho... my goodness I might as well have gotten noodles in a bowl of plain water. The broth was disappointingly bland even with sriracha and hoysen sauce... we seriously had to reach for the salt. The noodles were kinds hard... Maybe it was an off day for them but I probably won't be back
yelp:test:18957.para: I generally avoid writing negative reviews, but I've experienced both fantastic and terrible pho. Today, my family and I tried the pho chin and my mom ordered the seafood pho. It was so disappointing; it felt like we were eating noodles in plain water. The broth was surprisingly bland, even with added sriracha and hoysen sauce, and we had to add salt to make it palatable. The noodles were quite tough. It could have been a bad day for them, but I probably won't return.

yelp:test:18960.orig: This is where I always go to pick up my cats' food due to their wide selection of high quality cat food. \n\nOnce I sent my boyfriend to pick up the cats' food, but the specific type we usually get was no longer being made with the same ingredients as before. They were knowledgable enough to help him select a high quality alternative... which is now our regular food!
yelp:test:18960.para: I regularly visit this store for my cats' food because they offer a variety of high-quality options. On one occasion, my boyfriend was tasked with getting the usual food, but he found that the specific type we usually buy had been reformulated with different ingredients. The staff were knowledgeable enough to recommend a high-quality alternative, which we have since started using regularly.

yelp:test:18971.orig: Not impressed.  There are so many great burger places in Vegas, this unfortunately is not one of them.  We sat at our table for 10-15 minutes before being acknowledeged.  The menu is basically a la carte and completley overpriced even for Vegas standards. If you want a plain burger, fries, and a drink its almost 20 bucks.  The food took forever despite the restaurant only being half full and about 8-10 guys working in the exposed kitchen.  Told our server if she could put a rush in the order that would be great considering we had to catch a show and we had already waited insanely long, she gave me attitude and said everything is made to order so theres nothing she can do, rather than just saying \""ok sir\"" to shut me up, which I would have preferred.  She then said she was leaving cause her shift was over and someone else would take care of us (no problem).  He checked on us once, and gave us the bill.  There are a lot better options for a place to eat and I suggest finding one of them (unfortunately mirage really does not have that great of options).
yelp:test:18971.para: Disappointed. With so many excellent burger joints in Vegas, this place doesn't quite make the cut. We waited 10-15 minutes at our table before being acknowledged. The menu is mostly a la carte and shockingly pricey, even by Vegas standards. A basic burger, fries, and a drink cost nearly $20. Despite the restaurant being only half full and having around 8-10 staff in the open kitchen, our food took a long time to arrive. When we mentioned needing to catch a show and had already waited so long, our server got defensive, saying everything is made to order and there was nothing she could do. Instead of just saying "okay," she gave us a curt response. She then left, saying her shift was ending, and another server only checked on us once before bringing the bill. There are much better dining options available, and I recommend exploring some of those instead (unfortunately, the Mirage doesn't offer many great choices).

yelp:test:19015.orig: Here's the thing: I love Starbucks. I get at least 3 lattes everyday and use the Internet access. At this Starbucks the Internet wasn't working, the electrical outlets didn't work, and it was so dirty I didn't wanna sit down. I went to the starbucks down the street and was much happier.
yelp:test:19015.para: The truth is, I adore Starbucks and visit at least three lattes daily, taking advantage of their internet. However, at this particular Starbucks, the internet was down, the power outlets weren't functioning, and the place was so untidy that I didn't want to sit. I ended up at the Starbucks next door, where I felt much more content.

yelp:test:19053.orig:
This place has a small assortment of pastries and breads made fresh and with obvious love for quality product.

While located far from where live, we like to drop in before our favorite pastry (which I am not disclosing, so as to have less competition), disappears. The breads are all good.

Try getting to the place early, as stuff disappears by the end of the day. There is a small selection of bottled/canned drinks as well, so if your desire to eat something cannot be contained, you'll have something to wash all the goodness down with.
yelp:test:19053.para:
This spot offers a limited range of pastries and breads, crafted fresh with clear dedication to quality. 

Although it's a bit distant from our home, we often stop by before our preferred pastry (which I won't reveal to avoid competition) sells out. The breads are all quite good.

It's best to arrive early, as items tend to run out by the end of the day. They also have a few bottled or canned drinks, so you'll have something to enjoy with your treat if you get there just in time.

yelp:test:19072.orig: THIS LOCATION HAS CLOSED.\n\nGood luck finding that out otherwise, seeing that the company doesn't have a website with all location info...
yelp:test:19072.para:
THIS PLACE IS NO LONGER OPEN.

It's not easy to discover this closure, especially since the business doesn't provide a website with comprehensive location details.

yelp:test:19093.orig: Other reviewers have already commented about the sewage smell that on occasion tends to linger through the restaurant on certain days.  I've been here often enough to see this place go downhill fast.  The last time I went (in December) there was a notice on the door that the health district had shut it down for a cockroach infestation.  I wanted to puke, I'd been eating food from their kitchen!   It has since reopened....but for obvious reasons I will never return.  Beware of seriously unsanitary food methods if you choose to eat here.
yelp:test:19093.para: Previous reviews have noted the occasional sewage odor that lingers in the restaurant on some days. Having visited frequently, I've witnessed a rapid decline in the establishment's quality. During my last visit in December, I noticed a sign on the door indicating the health department had closed it due to a cockroach infestation. The thought of the food prepared there made me feel sick. It has since reopened, but for clear reasons, I won't be returning. Be wary of the unsanitary food preparation methods if you decide to dine here.

yelp:test:19145.orig: Awesome NY style pizza, great tasting sauce and just enough of it, and good quality cheese (not the rubbery stuff).  Slices big enough you need to fold--perfect!  Salad was nice too, very generous amounts of meat and cheese, and presented nicely.  Will go back next time we are in Charlotte
yelp:test:19145.para: Delicious NY-style pizza with fantastic sauce that's neither too much nor too little, and high-quality cheese that's not rubbery. The slices are sizable, requiring you to fold them—just right! The salad was also delightful, featuring generous portions of meat and cheese, and it was beautifully presented. I plan to return when we're in Charlotte again.

yelp:test:19177.orig:
I went to Jet with three guys... not an idea situation since clubs in Vegas basically hate men. 

I happened to be in Vegas for work the same week my 21-year-old brother came to town for some reunion drunk fest with all the people he did a semester with in Spain. We also happened to be in the same hotel. I didn't mind, I love my little bro and some of his friends look like the runners up for the cast of Twilight. Plus, we had passes. Even with them we endured the ""Vegas Game"" where you get the evil eye for bringing too many guys with you. The passes did make the process a lot easier, since we didn't have to wait in that mob of desperate people. Sorry, no offense. If my friend hadn't gone to high school with one of the employees, we'd have been right there with you. 

I don't know what to say about this place really, but I think something my brother said best describes it. As we made our way through the sea of people gyrating in the strobe lights my brother goes, ""This would be a lot better on drugs."" It's true. It really is and I don't even do drugs. 

The first stop was the bar, surprisingly easy to get a drink compared to other places I've been.  I wanted to be a ni
yelp:test:19177.para:
I went to Jet with three friends, and it wasn't the ideal scenario given that clubs in Vegas often aren't fond of groups of men. My 21-year-old brother was in town for a reunion with his Spanish exchange friends, and we were staying at the same hotel. I didn't mind; I adore my younger brother, and some of his friends are quite handsome. Plus, we had VIP passes, which helped a lot. Even with the passes, we still had to endure the "Vegas Game," where you get a disapproving look for bringing too many guys. The passes made the process smoother, as we didn't have to wait in the long line of eager people. If my friend hadn't known an employee, we might have faced the same challenge. 

To be honest, I'm not sure what to say about Jet, but my brother summed it up best. As we navigated the crowd of people dancing under the strobe lights, he said, "This would be a lot better on drugs." It's true; it really is, and I don't even use drugs. 

Our first stop was the bar, which surprisingly was easier to get into than other places I've visited. I was about to say something else...

yelp:test:19237.orig: This place is shady as.fuck. they tried to.over charge on bottles and some stripper hoes falsely advertised their price. The girls here are nothing special. Vegas is way better. Im fat and ugly but still not impressed . Avoid these shaddy aholes
yelp:test:19237.para: This place is really shady. They attempted to overcharge for bottles, and some strippers advertised their prices inaccurately. The girls here aren't特别出色。拉斯维加斯要好得多。即使我很胖很丑，也依然不感到印象深刻。尽量避开这些骗子。

yelp:test:19276.orig: This is my go-to breakfast/brunch place when I'm staying in Montreal. It has your basic breakfast menu and serves delicious eggs benedict (if that's what you're into), crepes, fruit, and other typical breakfast offerings. I don't see why people have hated on this restaurant. It's nothing spectacular, just a great, cheap place to get breakfast. I wouldn't go there for dinner, but they do have a good pasta carbonara. If you're looking for dinner, head up the block a little toward Edoardo's. It has DELICIOUS pasta dishes for a totally affordable price.
yelp:test:19276.para: When I'm in Montreal, this spot is my favorite for breakfast or brunch. They offer standard breakfast items like eggs benedict, crepes, fresh fruit, and other typical options. I can't understand why anyone would dislike this place; it's simply a fantastic, budget-friendly choice for a morning meal. While I wouldn't recommend it for dinner, their pasta carbonara is quite good. For dinner, I suggest checking out Edoardo's a bit further down the street, where you can enjoy delicious pasta dishes at a very reasonable price.

yelp:test:19291.orig: My friends and I are vegetarians that enjoy trying interesting vegan fare. We ordered a Thai bowl, Mexicali plate and the Dragon Wrap. The wrap was rather bland and tasted very raw, but the Thai bowl and Mexicali plate were flavorful and filling. The atmosphere inside the restaurant didn't seem that nice, but we ate outdoors in the back patio area which was very cute and relaxing. The menu is offered in both English and French, which turned out well for us since we don't know a lick of French. Overall an enjoyable meal!
yelp:test:19291.para: My friends and I, who are vegetarians fond of exploring new vegan dishes, placed an order for a Thai bowl, a Mexicali plate, and a Dragon Wrap. While the wrap was quite lackluster and seemed undercooked, the Thai bowl and Mexicali plate were both delicious and satisfying. Although the interior ambiance wasn't particularly appealing, we enjoyed our meal al fresco on the back patio, which was charming and tranquil. The menu was available in both English and French, which was fortunate for us as we don't speak a word of French. All in all, it was a pleasant dining experience!

yelp:test:19302.orig:
This is a restaurant with great atmosphere and lots of potential but poor service and average food takes this review from four stars to two. 

Would you be happy spending $85+tip on this? 

1. The reservation for table on the terrace was ""lost"" and we sat inside.
2. Our food was left under the kitchen heater so long it was hot and cold at the same time (was there no one designated to run food?)
3. Our waiter was covering too many tables and could not manage all of them (e.g. I asked for a second glass of wine with dinner and was brought the menu half way through my entree). 

Management take note. The food is average at best and the menu predictable. Montreal is supposed to be one of the best ""culinary cities"" in North America. Either fire your manager or get a new chef because mediocre food and sloppy service is a recipe for unhappy foodies. I really wanted to love this restaurant but even duck fat fries can't save this one.
yelp:test:19302.para:
This establishment has a promising ambiance and potential, yet subpar service and mediocre food drop its rating from four to two stars.

Would you be satisfied paying $85+tip here?

1. Our reservation for a terrace table was "lost," and we were seated indoors instead.
2. The food was left under the kitchen heater for too long, making it both hot and cold simultaneously (was there no one to deliver it promptly?).
3. Our waiter was overwhelmed with too many tables and couldn't attend to them all (e.g., I requested a second glass of wine with my meal, but was given the menu halfway through my main course).

Management, take note: the food is merely average, and the menu is unoriginal. Montreal is known as one of North America's top culinary cities. Either replace your manager or hire a new chef, as mediocre food and poor service will only disappoint food enthusiasts. I genuinely hoped to enjoy this restaurant, but even duck fat fries couldn't salvage it.

yelp:test:19305.orig: J'y suis all\u00e9e avec une amie pour boire un verre et je ne pense pas y retourner, mon cosmopolitan \u00e9tait vraiment mauvais, je n'ai pas pu le boire. Le serveur ma demand\u00e9 s'il y avait un probl\u00e8me, je lui ai expliqu\u00e9 et j'ai command\u00e9 autre chose. Au moment de payer je pensais avoir un geste de leur part  pour l'incident du cosmo mais non, j'ai pay\u00e9 la totalit\u00e9 et pas une excuse. Je n'y retournerai surement pas!
yelp:test:19305.para: I went there with a friend for a drink, and I don't think I'll be returning. My cosmopolitan was really bad; I couldn't even finish it. The server asked if there was a problem, I explained, and I ordered something else. When it came time to pay, I expected them to offer some compensation for the cosmopolitan issue, but they didn't. yahoo:train:376704.orig:
Is Rascal's Wager a good argument in support of agnosticism? (See details.)? The mathematician Rascal imagines a simple wager.  He could remain agnostic, carefully evaluating all evidence on God's existence which comes his way, or he could throw reason to the wind and simply believe in God through faith.

"There are four possibilities," he decides.  "If God exists and I devote myself to a life of rational agnosticism, thus doubting him, I will be rewarded with infinite bliss in Heaven for fully exercising God's greatest gifts of reason and critical thinking -- the capacities which most greatly separate us from other animals.  If God does not exist and I live my life in this way, I will have lost nothing.  If God exists and I blindly believe in him given no evidence (thus willfully ignoring the gifts bestowed on me), it would be such a grave insult that I would undoubtedly suffer for all eternity in Hell.  If God does not exist and I live a life of blind faith, I will have lost little."

Rascal, seeing the extreme danger in a life of faith, remains agnostic.
yahoo:train:376704.para:
Is Rascal's Wager a compelling case for agnosticism? Consider the scenario: Rascal ponders two paths—remaining an agnostic, rigorously assessing evidence about God's existence, or embracing faith without evidence.

He outlines four scenarios:
1. If God exists and Rascal dedicates his life to rational agnosticism, he will receive infinite bliss in Heaven, having fully utilized his unique human abilities of reason and critical thinking.
2. If God does not exist and Rascal lives this way, he incurs no loss.
3. If God exists and Rascal believes without evidence, he risks eternal punishment in Hell for ignoring his intellectual gifts.
4. If God does not exist and Rascal lives in blind faith, he loses little.

Recognizing the severe risks of faith, Rascal opts to stay agnostic.

yahoo:train:492133.para: Is dating or marrying only within one's own race considered racist? yahoo:test:19198.orig:
Why does the US give so much aid to Israel? The Israeli government is the largest recipient of US financial aid in the world, receiving over one-third of total US aid to foreign countries4, even though Israel’s population comprises just .001% of the world’s population and has one the world’s higher per capita incomes. 

Since 1949 the US has given Israel a total of $84,854,827,200. The interest costs born by US taxpayers on behalf of Israel are $49,937,000,000 – making the total amount of aid given to Israel since 1949 $134,791,507,200 (more than $134 billion).5

Since 1992, the US has offered Israel an additional $2 billion in loan guarantees every year.6 

The U.S. should not be aiding Israel no more than it should have been aiding South Africa under apartheid, Iran under the Shah, Iraq's Saddam during his war with Iran, Cambodia under Pol Pot, or Indonesia during its campaign against the East Timorese.
yahoo:test:19198.para:
Why does the United States provide such substantial aid to Israel? Despite Israel's small population—just 0.001% of the global population—and its relatively high per capita income, it receives over one-third of all U.S. foreign aid, making it the largest recipient globally. Since 1949, the U.S. has provided Israel with a total of $84.85 billion in aid, with interest costs to U.S. taxpayers adding another $49.94 billion, bringing the total to over $134.79 billion.

Starting in 1992, the U.S. has annually offered Israel $2 billion in loan guarantees. The U.S. should not continue to aid Israel any more than it should have aided South Africa during apartheid, Iran under the Shah, Iraq under Saddam Hussein during his war with Iran, Cambodia under Pol Pot, or Indonesia during its campaign against East Timor.

yahoo:test:24408.orig: what are unit trust and how do unit trust companies operate? PLEASE GIVE ANSWER IN ESSAY FORM
yahoo:test:24408.para: Unit trusts, also known as mutual funds, are investment vehicles that pool money from multiple investors to purchase a diversified portfolio of assets. These assets can include stocks, bonds, and other securities. The operation of unit trust companies involves several key steps. First, investors purchase units in the trust, which represents a share of the portfolio. The company then invests the pooled funds according to a predefined investment strategy. As the value of the underlying assets fluctuates, the net asset value (NAV) of each unit changes. Investors can buy or sell their units at the current NAV, which is typically calculated daily. This structure allows individual investors to access a diversified portfolio without having to manage it themselves. The intent behind unit trusts is to provide a convenient and cost-effective way for people to invest in a range of assets, thereby potentially increasing their returns and reducing risk.
